name: Aboleth Hatchling
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex -1, Con +1, Int +4, Wis +2, Cha +4

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Defensive Telepathy
traits.description: A creature that attempts to harm the hatchling must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed by the hatchling for the next minute. A creature Charmed by the hatchling has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws.

actions.name: Weaken Mind
actions.description: One creature within 30 ft. that the hatchling can see must make a DC 14 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failure, the target must roll a d4 and subtract it from the total of the next saving throw it makes before the end of the hatchling's next turn.

savingThrows: Str +5, Dex -1, Con +5, Int +7, Wis +5, Cha +4

traits.name: Mucous Cloud
traits.description: While underwater, the area in a 10-foot radius around the Aboleth counts as difficult terrain for non-aberrations.

traits.name: Probing Telepathy
traits.description: If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns, in broad terms, the creature's greatest desires.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The aboleth makes three tentacle attacks. It may replace one of these with a use of its compel.

A creature that fails this save by 5 or more gains vulnerability to the next source of Bludgeoning damage it takes in the next minute.

actions.name: Compel
actions.description: One creature charmed by the aboleth makes a weapon attack or casts a cantrip, targeting a creature of the Aboleth's choice.

actions.name: Dominate (Recharge 5-6, concentration)

Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

name: Aboleth Mindtaker Overlord
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex -1, Con +14, Int +11, Wis +8, Cha +4

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Viscous Mucous
traits.description: While underwater, the area in a 10-foot radius around the Aboleth counts as difficult terrain for non-aberrations. A creature affected by the mucous that attempts to make an attack other than its first on a turn must first make a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, the attack fails.

traits.name: Probing Telepathy
traits.description: If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns, in broad terms, the creature's greatest desires.

traits.name: Mindtaker Resilience (3/Day)
traits.description: If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does, each creature dominated by the aboleth may make a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw at Advantage, freeing itself on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The aboleth makes four tentacle attacks. It may replace up to two of these with its Compel or Dominate abilities.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or become diseased. A diseased creature can only breathe water and can't regain Hit Points while outside of water. After 1 minute, a diseased creature's skin begins to turn slimy and translucent. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more gains vulnerability to the next source of Bludgeoning damage it takes in the next minute.

actions.name: Compel
actions.description: One creature charmed by the Aboleth makes a weapon attack or casts a cantrip, targeting a creature of the aboleth's choice.

actions.name: Dominate (Concentration)
actions.description: 60 ft. range, targets 1 creature the aboleth can see. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or be magically charmed and under the aboleth's control. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is additionally stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Enslave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature Charmed by the aboleth must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 110 (20d10) Psychic damage, or half as much on a success. If this damage reduces the Charmed creature to 0 Hit Points, it gains 110 (20d10) Hit Points and the aboleth no longer requires Concentration to Dominate it.

actions.name: Tentacle Whirlwind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 15 ft. radius must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 49 (14d6) Bludgeoning damage and be shoved 20 feet back, or half damage on a success.

reactions.name: Reactive Camoflauge (1/day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 100 Hit Points, the aboleth becomes invisible to creatures more than 30 feet away from it. This invisibility lasts for 1 hour, or until the aboleth regains any Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Dive
legendaryActions.description: The aboleth moves up to half its movement speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. If its Reactive Camoflauge is active, it may then attempt to Hide as part of this action.

legendaryActions.name: Compel
legendaryActions.description: The aboleth uses its Compel ability.

legendaryActions.name: Mental Fog (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 120 feet of the aboleth must make a DC 19 Intelligence Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage and subtracts 1d6 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of the aboleth's next turn.

name: Balhannoth
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -1, Con +9, Int -2, Wis +2, Cha -1

traits.name: Dead Magic Grip
traits.description: A creature grappled by the balhannoth that attempts to cast a spell with a casting time of one Action must first roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, the spell doesn't take effect until the creature's next turn, and the creature must use its action on that turn to complete the spell.

traits.name: Superior Camouflage
traits.description: The balhannoth is invisible to creatures more than 10 feet away from it. It may attempt to hide without cover.

traits.name: False Hope
traits.description: The landscape in a 500 ft. radius around the balhannoth warps to fit ideas of safety and security it gleans from passing creatures through telepathic eavesdropping. The balhannoth cannot create functional or moving objects in this way, and close inspection of objects created in this way reveals them to be facsimiles.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.description: If the balhannoth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The balhannoth makes a bite attack and up to two tentacle attacks, or it makes up to four tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15) and is moved up to 5 feet toward the balhannoth. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the balhannoth can't use this tentacle against other targets. The balhannoth has four tentacles.

legendaryActions.name: Drain Magic
legendaryActions.description: Each creature grappled by the balhannoth must succeed on a DC 15 Constitiution saving throw or lose its highest level unexpended spell slot. The balhannoth gains 4 (1d8) Temporary Hit Points for each spell level expended this way.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport
legendaryActions.description: The balhannoth magically teleports, along with each creature it has grappled, up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space.

legendaryActions.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The balhannoth makes a bite attack against a creature it has grappled.

name: Gazer
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +2, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +1
languages: Can crudely mimic any language it has heard

traits.name: Flighty Familiar
traits.description: An Incapacitated gazer subjected to the Find Familiar ritual is transformed into a familiar spirit. It obeys the caster's commands until it fails an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma Saving Throw, at which point it becomes hostile once more.

traits.name: Spying Eye
traits.description: Each beholder within 5 miles of the gazer can perceive the world through the gazer's senses.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description:
The gazer shoots two of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing targets it can see within 60 feet:



1. Dazing Ray. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The creature is Charmed and Dazed until the end of its next turn.

2. Fear Ray. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The creature is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

3. Frost Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 10 (3d6) Cold damage.

4. Force Ray. The target must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target is pushed 25 (1d10 x 5) feet away from the gazer.

name: Spectator Sentinel
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +2

traits.name: Eyestalks
traits.description: While the spectator is Bloodied, a creature that scores a Critical Hit against it can disable one of the spectator's eye rays of its choice.

actions.name: Needling Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description:
The spectator shoots two of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates and disabled rays), choosing targets it can see within 90 feet:

1. Wound. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage.
2. Panic. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target must use its Reaction to make a melee attack against itself or one of its allies.
3. Paroxysm. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the end of the spectator's next turn, or until it takes any damage.
4. Fear. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target is Frightened until the end of the spectator's next turn.

reactions.name: Turn Magic
reactions.description: Trigger: The spectator succeeds on a saving throw against a spell of Level 3 or below that targets only it. Response: The spectator avoids all effects from the spell and instead causes the spell to target the caster.

name: Thousand-Year Spectator
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +3, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +2

traits.name: Budding Demise
traits.description: When the spectator dies, each of its Eye Rays that isn't disabled tears free as a newborn Spectator Sentinel (size Tiny, AC 12, 4 Hit Points) that acts on its parent's Initiative.

traits.name: Eyestalks
traits.description: While the spectator is Bloodied, a creature that scores a Critical Hit against it can disable one of the spectator's eye rays of its choice.

actions.name: Needling Bite
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description:
The spectator shoots two of the following magical rays at random (reroll duplicates and disabled rays) at targets it can see within 90 feet:

1. Panic Ray. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The target must use its Reaction to make a melee attack against itself or one of its allies.
2. Paranoia Ray. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The target is Frightened until the end of the spectator's next turn. If the target was already Frightened, it becomes hostile to all creatures for as long as it remains Frightened.
3. Wounding Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage.
4. Petrification Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The creature is Petrified until it takes any damage.

reactions.name: Turn Magic
reactions.description: Trigger: The spectator succeeds on a saving throw against a spell of Level 5 or below that targets only it. Response: The spectator avoids all effects from the spell and instead causes the spell to target the caster.

reactions.name: Retributive Ray
reactions.description: Trigger: The spectator is hit with an attack. Response: The spectator uses one of its eye rays at random, targeting the attacker.

name: Mindwitness
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +4, Int +5, Wis +5, Cha +3

traits.name: Telepathic Relay
traits.description: When the mindwitness receives a telepathic message, each other creature in a 600-foot Emanation from it receives the same message.

traits.name: Eyestalks
traits.description: While the mindwitness is Bloodied, a creature that scores a Critical Hit against it can disable one of the mindwitness' eye rays of its choice.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mindwitness makes two attacks, or uses three of its eye rays chosen at random (reroll duplicates and disabled rays).

actions.name: Spiral Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft., one Grappled target. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). A creature Grappled in this way takes 9 (2d8) Psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. If this damage exceeds the target's Intelligence score, it is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description:
The mindwitness shoots one of the following magical at a target it can see within 120 feet:

1. Telekinesis Ray. The target must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target is flung 35 (2d6 x 5) feet in a direction of the mindwitness' choice.
2. Apathy Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target falls Prone and is Dazed until the end of its next turn.
3. Stunning Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target is Stunned until the end of the mindwitness' next turn, or until it takes any damage.
4. Torment Ray. The target must make an Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 27 (6d8) Psychic damage and the target loses Concentration, if it was holding it.
5. Paranoia Ray. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target is Frightened until the end of the mindwitness' next turn. If the target was already Frightened, it becomes hostile to all creatures for as long as it remains Frightened.
6. Aversion Ray. The target must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature becomes revolted by one object it is carrying. For 1 minute, whenever it starts its turn carrying that object the creature takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.

bonusActions.name: Mind-Tether Gaze
bonusActions.description: The mindwitness' central eye emits an zone of psychic linkage in a 150-foot Cone, which lasts until the start of its next turn. The first time each turn that the mindwitness takes any damage, it can deal 5 (1d10) Psychic damage to each creature in the area.

name: Eye of the Deep
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +7, Int +5, Wis +5, Cha +2

traits.name: Eyestalks
traits.description: While the eye is Bloodied, a creature that scores a Critical Hit against it can disable the eye's Glacial Ray or Paroxysm Ray.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The eye has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Purge Distractions (2/Day)
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the eye can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does, the next attack that targets it scores a Critical Hit on a 15-20.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The eye makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Abyssal Mirage.

actions.name: Chitinous Claw
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Crushing Rend
actions.description: One creature Grappled by the eye must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 36 (8d8) Bludgeoning damage. Failure by 5 or More: The creature additionally has Disadvantage on d20 Tests that use Strength or Dexterity until it regains any Hit Points.

actions.name: Abyssal Mirage (Concentration)
actions.description: The eye fills the area in a 100-foot Emanation from it with phantasmal images; attacks against the eye have Disadvantage, and the eye has Advantage on attempt to Hide. This effect ends if the eye uses one of its Legendary Actions or loses the use of one of its eye rays.

bonusActions.name: Strobeflash Gaze
bonusActions.description: A pulse of searing light extends from its central eye in a a 30-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature is Blinded until the start of the eye's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Glacial Ray
legendaryActions.description: One creature the eye can see within 60 feet must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 9 (2d8) Cold damage the creature's Speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Paroxysm Ray
legendaryActions.description: One creature the eye can see within 60 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the end of the eye's next turn, or until it takes any damage.

name: Gouger
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +7, Int -2, Wis +5
immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Unconscious

traits.name: Eye-Hunter
traits.description: The gouger's melee attacks score a Critical Hit on an 17-20 against any creature with more than one eye.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gouger makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Staggering Lash.

actions.name: Tonguespear Gouge
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 15 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage. On a Critical Hit, the target must choose one of the following if it has one or more eyes: 14 (4d6) extra Piercing damage and the creature is Blinded until the end of the gouger's next turn. One of the creature's eyes is gouged out.

actions.name: Prising Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 15 ft. Hit: The target is Grappled (escape DC 14). While lifted into the air, a creature Grappled in this way is additionally Restrained.

actions.name: Staggering Lash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The gouger whips its tongue in a 15-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 10 (3d6) Slashing damage and the creature falls Prone.

bonusActions.name: Antimagic Gaze
bonusActions.description: The gouger’s central eye emits an antimagic wave in a 150-foot Cone. Until the start of the gouger’s next turn, that area acts as an Antimagic Field spell.

name: Director
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +5, Cha +4

traits.name: Eyestalks
traits.description: While the director is Bloodied, a creature that scores a Critical Hit against it can disable one of the director's eye rays of its choice.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The director makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of one of its Eye Rays, chosen at random (reroll duplicates).

actions.name: Vicious Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Barbed Tendrils
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 15 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and the director becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 15).

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description:
The director shoots one of the following magical rays at a target it can see within 120 feet:

1. Searing Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 21 (6d6) Fire damage.

2. Rotting Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage. Then, if the target is Bloodied, it takes an extra 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

3. Freeze Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage and the creature's Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn, or until it takes any damage.

4. Shocking Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 19 (3d12) Lightning damage, then each other creature within 10 feet of it takes 6 (1d12) Lightning damage.

5. Anchor Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 16 (3d10) Force damage and the target is Cursed for 1 minute. Whenever the Cursed creature teleports, it takes 16 (3d10) Force damage.

6. Translocation Ray. The target must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The director teleports the creature to an unoccupied space it can see within 40 feet of itself.

bonusActions.name: Verminbond
bonusActions.description: One creature the director is Attached to must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature is Dominated by the Director until the end of its next turn, or until the director is removed from it.

bonusActions.name: Repulsion Gaze
bonusActions.description: The director’s central eye emits a steady stream of force in a 150-foot Cone; creatures in the area treat movement toward the director as being over Difficult Terrain and the director has Half Cover against their attacks.

reactions.name: Sacrifice Mount
reactions.description: Trigger: The director is targeted with an attack while Attached to a creature. Response: The Attached creature becomes the new target of the attack and the director ends its Attachment.

name: Doomsphere
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +8, Wis +6, Cha +4
immunities: Cold, Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Sacrificial Purge (2/Day)
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the doomsphere can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does, one eye ray of its choice is disabled for 24 hours.

actions.name: Spectral Bite
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 24 (4d10 + 2) necrotic damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) psychic damage. This attack treats creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier).

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description:
The doomsphere shoots two of the following magical rays at random (reroll duplicates and disabled rays), choosing targets it can see within 120 feet:

1. Ethereal Ray (Concentration). The target must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target is shunted partially into the Border Ethereal; for 1 minute the target deals half as much damage with melee attacks, has a Fly Speed of 30 feet, and can move through solid objects on its turn.

2. Grave Chill Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 27 (6d8) Cold damage. Success or Failure: Until the end of the doomsphere's next turn, any magical healing the creature receives is reduced by half.

3. Corpselight Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 33 (6d10) Necrotic damage and the target gains a point of Exhaustion. If the creature dies in the next minute, it immediately rises as a Barrow Wight under the doomsphere's control.

4. Death-Urge Ray. The target must make a Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target is Frightened for one minute (Save Ends at end of turn). Whenever the creature fails a saving throw to end this effect, it must use its Reaction to make a melee attack against itself.

5. Bonecrack Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: Something cracks within the target. Until it completes a Long Rest, it takes 10 (2d6) Slashing damage whenever it makes its second attack in a turn or casts a spell of Level 3 or above.

6. Possession Ray. The target must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target is Possessed by the doomsphere until the start of the doomsphere's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Fade Away
bonusActions.description: The doomsphere becomes invisible and gains the Invisible condition until the start of its next turn, or until it takes any hostile action.

bonusActions.name: Spirit-Grip Gaze
bonusActions.description: The doomsphere's central eye calls forth ghostly claws in a 30-foot Cone; each creature in the area must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The creature's Speed is halved until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The creature is Restrained and Levitates 5 feet off the ground until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Malice Eternal (1/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: The doomsphere is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Response: The doomsphere regains 1 Hit Point and uses its Possession Ray.

name: Death Kiss
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +8, Wis +5

traits.name: Crackling Ichor
traits.description: The first time each turn that the death kiss takes any Piercing or Slashing damage, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Tendrils
traits.description: When the death kiss is dealt a Critical Hit, one of its tendrils is disabled; until it completes a Long Rest, the death kiss makes one fewer attack with its Multiattack.

traits.name: Magic Resistance

actions.name: Feeding Tendril
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 20 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16). This attack has Advantage against targets Grappled by the death kiss.

actions.name: Corrupted Charge
actions.description: One creature Grappled by the death kiss must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The creature gains 55 (10d10) Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the creature is Dominated by the death kiss and its melee attacks deal an additional 7 (2d6) Lightning damage on a hit. Success: 27 (5d10) Lightning damage.

bonusActions.name: Hemorrhagic Gaze
bonusActions.description: The death kiss' eye emits a field that draws forth blood in a 150-foot Cone. Creatures the death kiss can see in the area lose 5 (2d4) Hit Points at the start of each of their turns and have Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws.

bonusActions.name: Blood Vortex
bonusActions.description: Each creature Grappled by the death kiss must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The creature loses 1d4 unexpended Hit Dice, or drops to 0 Hit Points if it can't, then the death kiss gains 10 Temporary Hit Points for each Hit Die lost in this way.

reactions.name: Fling Husk
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature Grappled by the death kiss falls Unconscious. Response: The death kiss flings the creature at a target within 30 feet, forcing it to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked Prone. Success or Failure: The thrown creature fails a Death Saving Throw.

reactions.name: Bane Transfusion
reactions.description: Trigger: The death kiss is forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect that targets only it. Response: The death kiss causes the triggering effect to instead target a creature Grappled by it.

name: Beholder Night-Eye
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +7, Int +8, Wis +6, Cha +4

traits.name: Eyestalks
traits.description: While the beholder is Bloodied, a creature that scores a Critical Hit against it can disable one of the beholder's eye rays of its choice.

traits.name: Umbral Resistance
traits.description: While it is in Dim Light or Darkness, the beholder has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Gnashing Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description:
The beholder shoots two of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing targets it can see within 120 feet:


1. Animus Ray. The target must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target's shadow transforms into a Shadow Strangler under the beholder's control that acts on Initiative 0 and the target becomes immune to this effect for 24 hours.
2. Sonic Blast Ray. The target must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 27 (6d8) Thunder damage and the target is pushed up to 30 feet away.
3. Frailty Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 44 (8d10) Necrotic damage and the creature gains a point of Exhaustion that lasts 1 minute.
4. Darkfire Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 17 (5d6) Fire damage plus 27 (5d10) Necrotic damage.

bonusActions.name: Shadow-Surge
bonusActions.description: If the beholder is in Dim Light or Darkness, it can move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and can move through solid objects with this movement.

bonusActions.name: Gloom Gaze
bonusActions.description: The beholder’s central eye emits a pulse of elemental darkness in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the area that isn't illuminated by Bright Light takes 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage, then each nonmagical light source in the area is extinguished.

name: Beholder Eye Tyrant
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +9, Int +8, Wis +7, Cha +3

traits.name: Eyestalks
traits.description: While the beholder is Bloodied, a creature that scores a Critical Hit against it can disable one of the beholder's eye rays of its choice.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The beholder has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Purge Distractions (3/Day)
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the beholder can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does, the next attack that targets it scores a Critical Hit on a 15-20.

actions.name: Gnashing Bite
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description:
The beholder shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing targets it can see within 120 feet:


1. Charm Ray. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage and the target is Charmed by the beholder until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target is Dominated by the beholder until the end of its next turn.

2. Paralyzing Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the end of the beholder's next turn, or until it takes any damage.

3. Fear Ray. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage and the target is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

4. Slowing Ray. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target is Dazed for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn), or until the beholder uses this ability again. while Dazed in this way, a creature has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

5. Enervation Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 13 (3d8) Poison damage and the target is Poisoned until the end of its next turn; while Poisoned in this way, the target can't regain Hit Points.

6. Telekinetic Ray (Concentration). The target must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target is flung up to 30 feet in a direction of the beholder's choice and is Restrained there until the start of the beholder's next turn.


7. Sleep Ray. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target falls Unconscious for 1 minute. This effect ends early if the creature takes any damage, or if a creature uses an Action to wake it.


8. Petrification Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. First Failure: The target is Restrained and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target is Petrified.

9. Disintegration Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 36 (8d8) Force damage. A target reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage dies and turns to dust.


10. Death Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 55 (10d10) Necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage must immediately make three Death Saving Throws.

bonusActions.name: Antimagic Gaze
bonusActions.description:
The beholder’s central eye emits an antimagic wave in a
150-foot Cone. Until the start of the beholder’s next turn or until it uses this ability again, that area acts as an Antimagic Field spell that works against the beholder’s own Eye Rays.

legendaryActions.name: Adjust Gaze
legendaryActions.description: The beholder moves up to half its Fly Speed, then uses its Antimagic Gaze.

legendaryActions.name: Eye Ray
legendaryActions.description: The beholder uses one random eye ray.

name: Beholder Death Tyrant

traits.name: Magic Resistance

traits.name: Sacrificial Purge (3/Day)
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the beholder can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does, one eye ray of its choice is disabled for 24 hours.

actions.name: Deathfang Bite
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description:
The beholder shoots three of the following magical rays at random (reroll duplicates and disabled rays), choosing targets it can see within 120 feet:

1. Shriveling Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage and the target’s Maximum Hit Points are reduced to its current Hit Points, to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

2. Compulsion Ray. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 33 (6d10) Psychic damage and the creature can't voluntarily leave the area of the beholder's Antilife Gaze until the end of its next turn.

3. Terror Ray. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The creature is Frightened for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn). At the start of each of the Frightened creature’s turns, it takes 22 (4d10) Psychic damage.

4. Dispersal Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The beholder ends one spell affecting the target.


5. Convulsion Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The creature is Poisoned for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn). Whenever the Poisoned creature casts a spell of Level 1 or above, it falls Prone and is Stunned until the start of its next turn.



6. Hemorrhage Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: For 1 minute, the creature is Cursed. Whenever the Cursed creature takes any damage, it begins Bleeding (2d10), or has its Bleeding Value increase by 2d10 if it was already Bleeding.

7. Ethereal Ray (Concentration). The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target is shunted partially into the Border Ethereal; for 1 minute the target deals half as much damage with melee attacks, has a Fly Speed of 30 feet, and can move through solid objects on its turn.



8. Chaining Ray. The target must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The creature is Restrained (escape DC 17) as chains of seething shadow envelop its body. A creature illuminated by Bright Light can attempt to escape this restraint as a Bonus Action.

9. Doom Ray. The target must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage and the creature gains a Doom Counter that lasts for a minute. If the creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it immediately fails one Death Saving Throw for each Doom Counter it has.

10. Death Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 44 (8d10) Necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage must immediately make three Death Saving Throws.

bonusActions.name: Antilife Gaze
bonusActions.description: The beholder's central eye emits negative energy in a 150-foot Cone. Creatures in the area can't regain Hit Points. Each intact humanoid corpse in the area rises as a Zombie Rotter under the beholder's control.

legendaryActions.name: Eye Ray

legendaryActions.name: Death Ray (Costs 3 actions)

3. Deepchill Ray. The target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: 52 (8d12) Cold damage and the target's Speed is halved until it regains any Hit Points or takes any Fire damage.

4. Despair Ray. The target must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: Crushing despair weighs upon the target; until it succeeds on an attack or saving throw, it has Disadvantage on all d20 Tests.

5. Displacement Ray. The target must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: The target teleports to an unoccupied space the beholder can see within 60 feet.

6. Stasis Ray. The target must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: The creature is frozen in time; until the end of the beholder's next turn, it is Petrified and Immune to all damage and conditions.

7. Death Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: 44 (8d10) Necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage must immediately make three Death Saving Throws.

8. Disintegration Ray. The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: 36 (8d8) Force damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage dies and turns to dust.

3. Terror Ray. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: The creature is Frightened for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn). At the start of each of the Frightened creature's turns, it takes 27 (5d10) Psychic damage.

If the creature was already Incapacitated or Restrained, it is additionally Swallowed into the ground while Restrained in this way; while Swallowed, it is Blinded, Choking, and has Total Cover form all outside effects.


9. Betrayal Ray. The target must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: A shadowy clone of the target is created in an unoccupied space adjacent to it, which acts on the target's Initiative under the beholder's control. The clone has 25 Maximum Hit Points, but otherwise shares the target's abilities and statistics.


10. Death Ray . The target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: 55 (10d10) Necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage must immediately make three Death Saving Throws.

While Banished, the creature takes 26 (4d12) Slashing damage plus 26 (4d12) Psychic damage at the start of each of its turns.

bonusActions.name: Vapor Drain
bonusActions.description: A sucking void opens in the beholder's eye, pulling each creature in a 150-foot Cone up to 10 feet toward the beholder. Clouds and Magical Darkness in the area are dispersed, and each spell effect of Level 5 or below in the area ends.

bonusActions.name: Nightmare Gaze

legendaryActions.name: Eye Ray

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Dream of Perfection (1/Round)
legendaryActions.description: The beholder regains 100 Hit Points and can end one Condition affecting it. It can use this ability even while Incapacitated.

name: Berbalang

traits.name: Read Bones
traits.description: By carefully examining the bones of a creature, the berbalang can extract any secrets it knew in life.

traits.name: Dream Travel
traits.description: While the berbalang sleeps, its spirit leaves its body. In spirit form, the berbalang has the same statistics, except that its attacks deal Psychic damage instead of any other type and it can teleport to another plane as an action. If the berbalang dies in spirit form, its body dies.

traits.name: Weak Flier
traits.description: While grappling a creature larger than size Small, the berbalang cannot fly unless the creature is also grappled by one of its duplicates.

actions.name: Bonegnaw Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma Saving Throw or reveal one of its secrets to the berbalang.

actions.name: Grasping Claws
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Absorb Duplicate
actions.description: The berbalang absorbs one of its duplicates, destroying it and gaining 20 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Detonate Duplicate
actions.description: The berbalang detonates one of its duplicates. Each creature within 15 ft. of the duplicate must succeed on a DC 13 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Psychic damage.

bonusActions.name: Duplicate Self (Original Only)
bonusActions.description: If the berbalang has at least 20 Hit Points, the berbalang creates a duplicate of itself, reducing its current Hit Points by 1/4. The duplicate has Hit Points equal to those lost in its creation, and acts on the berbalang's initiative.

traits.name: Exclusion Field (Concentration)

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 30 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage and the target is Tethered (remove DC 15). While Tethered, the creature can't move outside the brain's reach.

actions.name: Nerve Shock

bonusActions.name: Collapse Space
bonusActions.description: The brain folds reality in a 15-foot radius Sphere within 500 feet, dragging each creature in the area up to 15 feet toward its center.

reactions.description: Trigger: The brain is Bloodied. Response: Each other creature in a 60-foot Emanation must make an Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The creature is Dazed until the end of its next turn.

traits.description: At the beginning of each of the nothic's turns, one corpse within 30 ft. of it rises as a zombie for the next minute under the nothic's control, and acts on the nothic's initiative. The zombie dies instantaneously if the nothic cannot see it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The nothic has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Blighted Claw

actions.description:
One creature the nothic can see within 120 ft. must make a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw. A creature that fails this save voluntarily is additionally Stunned for the next minute, and learns a 1st, 2nd, or 3rd level wizard spell of the nothic's choice, which it may cast once per long rest without expending a spell slot. A Stunned creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun effect on a success.

reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack by a creature it can see, the nothic turns invisible until the end of its next turn and teleports up to 30 ft. to a location it can see.

resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: Understands Common but can't speak it, Telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The phaerimm has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Desiccating Dweomer
traits.description: A creature that fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect of the phaerimm's has any potions or other liquids it is carrying dry up, becoming unusable until rehydrated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The phaerimm makes five attacks, one of which may be with its bite or its stinger.

actions.name: Grinding Bite
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 46 (8d10 + 2) piercing damage. A creature killed by this damage has its corpse utterly destroyed.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the phaerimm can grapple the target (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (3d8 + 2) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned for the next minute. A Poisoned creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Implant Egg
actions.description: The phaerimm makes a stinger attack against a Poisoned creature. If the attack hits, the phaerimm deposits an egg in the wound. The creature is Paralyzed and levitates 3 ft. off the ground until a creature makes a DC 17 Wisdom (Medicine) check to remove the egg, or until the egg hatches in 2d20 hours, killing the host. Each attempt (successful or not) deals 1d4 points of damage to the host.

reactions.name: Absorption
reactions.description: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the phaerimm gains Temporary Hit Points equal to 10 times the level of the spell.

reactions.name: Reflection
reactions.description: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the phaerimm changes the spell's target to a creature of its choice that it can see within 30 ft.

legendaryActions.name: Tortuous Compulsion (Level 4 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Psychic damage. A creature that takes 10 or more Psychic damage in this way acts under the phaerimm's control on its following turn.

legendaryActions.name: Wrack (Level 2 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 60 ft. is overwhelmed with indescribable pain. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or fall prone and be unable to stand on its following turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more subtracts 1d4 from attacks and saving throws it makes for the next minute.

legendaryActions.name: Drown in Blood (Level 4 Spell, Concentration, Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Blood wells up in the mouth and lungs of a creature, suffocating it. One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage and be unable to speak or breathe for the next minute. An affected creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Puppeteer Parasite
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +4, Con +6, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha -4
languages: The languages of any creature it is attached to. Telepathy 30 ft.

traits.name: Custom Mimicry
traits.description: The puppeteer can add its Intelligence modifier to Charisma checks made to mimic behavior it has observed in the last 24 hours.

traits.name: Psionic Backlash
traits.description: If a creature the parasite is Attached to succeeds on a saving throw against one of the parasite's abilities by 5 or more, the Parasite falls prone and is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Clinging Flop
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage and the parasite becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 12).

actions.name: Drain Mind
actions.description: The parasite digs its ventral teeth into a humanoid creature it is attached to, connecting directly to the creature's nervous system. The creature takes 7 (2d6) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Psychic damage, then must make a DC 13 Intelligence Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature loses all memory of the parasite and the parasite becomes undetectable to the creature until the parasite is removed or deals any damage to the creature.

actions.name: Insidious Suggestion (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The parasite telepathically whispers a command to a creature it is attached to. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or follow that command for the next hour, or until the parasite uses this ability again.

actions.name: Assume Control (1/Day, Concentration)
actions.description: The parasite attempts to directly take control of the body of a humanoid creature it is attached to, forcing it to succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Dominated by the parasite for the next 24 hours. While Dominated in this way, a creature can't cast spells and uses the parasite's knowledge, mental statistics and proficiencies in place of its own.

reactions.name: Slither
reactions.description: When a creature the parasite can see targets it with an attack while it is attached to a creature, it crawls deeper into the creature's clothing or armor, gaining half cover against the attack. If the attack misses the parasite, the attacker makes a new attack roll targeting the creature the parasite is attached to.

actions.description: One creature whose dreams the quori is invading must succeed on a DC 21 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 155 (10d10 + 100) Psychic damage.

legendaryActions.name: Flickering Psychoport
legendaryActions.description: The quori teleports up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 ft. of a creature.

legendaryActions.name: Waking Nightmare
legendaryActions.description: The quori attempts to take control of an unconscious creature whose dreams it is invading. The creature takes 11 (2d10) Psychic damage, then must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma Saving Throw or gain Temporary Hit Points equal to half its maximum Hit Points and rise under the quori's control. While the creature has these Temporary Hit Points, it automatically fails Charisma Saving Throws.

legendaryActions.name: Mind Seed (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: One unconscious creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed as one of the quori's spectral eyes worms through its flesh and embeds itself deep within. The quori sees and hears everthing that the cursed creature does, and whenever the cursed creature takes a long rest the quori may cause the creature to sleepwalk under the quori's control until it wakes.

name: Roach Thrall
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +4, Int +2, Wis +6, Cha -1
languages: Common, Telepathy 5 ft. (Can only telepathically communicate with other roach thralls)

traits.name: Host Body
traits.description: The roach thrall is hidden in a Medium size humanoid host body (AC 10, 10 HP). While in its host body, the roach thrall can't attack or use its climb speed, and can emerge as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Oxidizing Exoskeleton
traits.description: At the beginning of each of its turns after it emerges from its host body, the roach thrall's AC increases by 2, to a maximum of 18. If the roach thrall is outside its host and has 14 or fewer AC, it has vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Versatile Movmement
traits.description: If the roach thrall does not use its multiattack, it may Dash or Disengage this turn as a Bonus Action, and gains a climb speed equal to its movement speed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The roach thrall makes five attacks, one of which may be with its Clacking Mandibles.

actions.name: Clacking Mandibles
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Razor Claws
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Swallow Whole
actions.description: The roach thrall makes a bite attack at Advantage against a Medium or smaller creature it has grappled. On a hit, the creature is swallowed (escape DC 15). It may have only one creature swallowed in this way. The swallowed creature is Blinded, restrained, and takes 21 (6d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the roach thrall's turns. A swallowed creature treats the roach thrall's AC as 14.

actions.name: Snatch Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The roach thrall forces up to two creatures within 10 feet of it and within 5 feet of each other to make a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the roach thrall snatches one object the target is carrying or wielding away from it and swallows it.

reactions.name: Emerge
reactions.description: As a reaction to its host body taking damage, the roach thrall emerges, tearing its way out in spectacular fashion. Each creature within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Scuttle
reactions.description: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the roach thrall moves up to half its speed. If it ends this movement out of the range or area of the spell or magical effect, the roach thrall is unaffected.

name: Silthilar (Coalesced)
savingThrows: Dex +8, Con +6, Int +5, Wis +1, Cha +3

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The silthilar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Grafter
traits.description: Over the course of an hour, the silthilar can warp a willing or incapacitated creature's body, reducing either its Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by two, to a minimum of 8, and increasing its Strength or Dexterity by the same amount.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The silthilar makes four attacks, no more than three of which may target the same creature.

actions.name: Impaling Spike
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16) until the silthilar uses its multiattack again or Disperses. An unconscious creature grappled in this way stabilizes automatically and cannot regain Hit Points.

actions.name: Ankle Slice
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone.

bonusActions.name: Disperse
bonusActions.description: The silthilar regains all of its Hit Points and transforms into a Huge swarm of Tiny aberrations. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is tucked into a pocket dimension. It reverts to its swarm form if it dies.

name: Silthilar (Dispersed)
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +8, Con +6, Int +5, Wis +1, Cha +3

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The silthilar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Dispersed Vulnerability
traits.description: If the silthilar takes at least 10 Thunder damage from a single source or is exposed to a strong wind, it cannot coalesce on its following turn.

traits.name: Infesting Swarm
traits.description: The silthilar can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny aberration. A creature that starts its turn in the silthilar's space must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 3 (1d6) Piercing damage and be Poisoned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Warp Flesh
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 0 ft. Hit: The target has its Charisma score reduced by 1d4 until it completes a Short or Long Rest. A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 0 in this way is polymorphed into a form of the silthilar's choice until cured by Greater Restoration or simlar magic. The new form can by any Small or Medium creature the silthilar is familiar with of CR 4 or lower. The creature adopts the new form's statistics, but retains its alignment, personality, proficiencies, Hit Points, and class levels.

bonusActions.name: Coalesce
bonusActions.description: The silthilar regains all of its Hit Points and transforms into a Medium swarm of aberration. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is tucked into a pocket dimension. It reverts to its swarm form if it dies.

name: Slaad Tadpole
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +4, Int -3, Wis -4, Cha -4

traits.name: Rapid Evolution
traits.description: Each hour it survives, the tadpole adds 10 Hit Points to its current and maximum Hit Points. Every 4 hours, the tadpole's size category increases by one step. After 13 hours, the tadpole transforms into a full grown slaad.

traits.name: Bloody Trail
traits.description: For the first hour after it emerges, the tadpole leaves a clear trail of blood that creatures have Advantage on Survival (Wisdom) checks made to track.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Goreslick Scuttle
actions.description: The tadpole takes the dodge action. Until the start of its next turn, whenever the tadpole is missed with an attack, it may move up to 10 ft. without provoking attacks of opportunity.

actions.name: Emerge
actions.description: The tadpole bursts forth from its host's chest in a spray of gore. Each creature that can see it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the tadpole's next turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more is instead Stunned until the end of the tadpole's next turn.

name: Red Slaad
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +3, Int -2, Wis -2, Cha -2

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Chaotic Resilience
traits.description: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The slaad makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite. It may replace up to one of its attacks with a use of its Mighty Leap.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Vicious Kick
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 5 (2d4) damage to a prone creature.

actions.name: Ovoduct Claws
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with a slaad egg.

actions.name: Mighty Leap
actions.description: The slaad leaps up to 20 ft., and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

name: Blue Slaad
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +4, Int -2, Wis -2, Cha -1

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Chaotic Resilience
traits.description: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

traits.name: Wall Lurker
traits.description: The slaad may pass through wood, plaster, or stone walls without resistance.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The slaad makes three attacks, one of which may be with its phage-laden bite. It may replace any number of these attacks with uses of its Mighty Leap.

actions.name: Phage-Laden Bite
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Chaos Phage.

actions.name: Rending Bonescythes
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

actions.description: The slaad leaups up to 20 ft., and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

name: Green Slaad
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +3, Wis -1, Cha +1

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The slaad can use its action to polymorph itself or another slaad into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.description: The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Chaotic Resilience
traits.description: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

traits.name: Disordered Transposition
traits.description: At the beginning of the slaad's turn, a randomly selected creature within 60 ft. is teleported up to 30 ft. to a location of the slaad's choice that the slaad can see.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The slaad makes three melee attacks, up to two of which it may replace with uses of its chaos flame.

actions.name: Brainstaff
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away. On a critical hit, the slaad must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Chaos Flame (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 60 ft. Hit: 21 (6d6) fire damage. The fire ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried. If this attack misses, the slaad makes a second attack roll against a random creature within 10 ft. of the original target.

actions.name: Pandemoniac Ephemera (Concentration)
actions.description: The slaad creates the image of an object or creature no larger than a 20-foot cube. It seems real to all senses, though a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check reveals its illusory nature. The slaad may interact with the illusion physically as though it were real. As a Bonus Action on each of its turns, the slaad can move the illusion up to 30 ft.

actions.name: Madness Croak (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The slaad and each other creature within 30 ft. of it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be forced to use its reaction to make a melee attack against a radom creature in its reach, or against itself if there are no other creatures within range. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

name: Grey Slaad
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +3, Int +4, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Chaotic Resilience

traits.name: Rift Mage
traits.description: The slaad has a small private pocket dimension, which it can enter or exit as an Action. When the slaad exits its pocket dimension, it appears in the unoccupied space nearest to where it departed. When the slaad dies, the contents of its pocket dimension explode from its chest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The slaad makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite, and uses its Pandemoniac Ideal. It may replace up to two of its attacks with uses of its Junkdrop.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Knuckle Rap
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or drop one object it is holding.

actions.name: Junkdrop
actions.description: The slaad opens a small portal over a creature's head, showering it with planar detritus. One creature the slaad can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 22 (5d8) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much on a success.

actions.name: Pandemoniac Ephemera (Concentration)

actions.name: Uncontrolled Burst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each other creature within 20 ft. of the slaad must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Portal Catch
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature within 30 ft. drops an object, the slaad briefly opens a tiny dimensional rift, causing the object to fall into its private pocket dimension.

reactions.name: Insubstantiate
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking 15 or more damage from a single source, the slaad disintigrates into a shower of fine particles, reforming at any point within 10 ft. of where it disappeared from at the start of its next turn.

name: Death Slaad
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +8, Int +2, Wis +4, Cha +7

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The slaad makes three attacks, one of which may be with its havoc bite. It may replace any number of these attacks with uses of its Mighty Leap or Death Croak, if available.

actions.name: Havoc Bite
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. Additionally on a hit, the first 10 ft. of movement the target takes on its following turn is made in a random direction.

actions.name: Entropic Touch
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) force damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A creature killed by this damage disintigrates.

actions.name: Mighty Leap
actions.description: The slaad leaps up to 20 ft., and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

As a Bonus Action on each of its turns, the slaad can move the illusion up to 30 ft. and force one creature within 5 ft. of it to succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 26 (4d12) damage of a type appropriate to the illusion. A creature that has investigated the illusion makes this save with Advantage.

actions.name: Death Croak (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The slaadi lets out a horrible, atonal croak that destabilizes matter around it. Until the end of the slaad's next turn, a non-slaad creature that ends its turn within 20 ft. of the slaad takes 22 (4d10) Force damage.

actions.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
actions.description: The slaad and any number of slaadi adjacent to it teleport to a different plane of existence.

name: Chronos Slaad
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +10, Int +4, Wis +3, Cha +11

traits.name: Timeline Swapper
traits.description: At the beginning of each of its turns, the slaad teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet and all conditions on it end.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Chaotic Resilience
traits.description: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The slaad makes three attacks, one of which may be with its havoc bite, and uses its 4-Dimensional Leap.

actions.name: Chronoclaws
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) force damage and the target must make a DC 19 Charisma Saving Throw or have its Charisma score reduced by 1d4 for the next minute. A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 0 in this way takes 99 (18d10) Psychic damage and has this reduction end as it replaced with a nearly identical version of itself from the nearest adjacent timeline.

actions.name: 4-Dimensional Leap
actions.description: The slaad leaps up to 20 ft. in up to two different directions simultaneously, splitting in the air into an original and a copy and landing in two different spaces. The copy cannot take actions, and disintegrates at the beginning of the slaad's next turn or if it takes any damage. Each creature in a space where the slaad landed must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage and be knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

A creature that has investigated the illusion makes this save with Advantage.

actions.name: Time Croak (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The slaadi lets out a horrible, atonal croak that propels nearby creatures into the future. The slaad and each other creature within 20 ft. must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma Saving Throw or disappear, reappearing at the end of the slaad's next turn.

actions.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
actions.description: The slaad and any number of slaadi adjacent to it teleport to a different plane of existence.

reactions.name: Timeclone Freakout
reactions.description: As a reaction when reduced below 111 Hit Points, the slaad pulls versions of itself from adjacent timelines into this one. Up to three copies of the slaad appear in the nearest unoccupied spaces to the slaad. Each copy uses the original's stastistics, except it cannot use its multiattack and disintegrates if it is hit by an attack or fails a saving throw.

name: Void Slaad
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +2, Con +11, Int +10, Wis +9, Cha +11

traits.name: Light Eater
traits.description: The void slaad reflects no light, and is invisible in darkness. At the start of its turn, each light source within 20 ft. of it is extinguished.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Chaotic Resilience
traits.description: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

traits.name: Annihilating Collapse
traits.description: When the slaad dies, it condenses to a sphere of annihilating energy. Until the start of its next turn, a creature that starts its turn within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled 20 ft. towards the sphere. Then, each creature within 5 ft. of the sphere takes 22 (4d10) Force damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or disintegrate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The slaad makes three attacks, one of which may be with its havoc bite, and uses its Void Leap.

actions.name: Vaccuum Slash
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 20 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) force damage and the target is dragged 10 ft. toward the slaad.

Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled up to 15 ft. toward the slaad, then each creature within 5 ft. of the slaad falls prone and takes 14 (4d6) Force damage.
