A creature that has investigated the illusion makes this save with Advantage.

actions.name: Void Croak (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The slaadi lets out a horrible, atonal croak that destroys all matter. Each nonmagical object and surface within 20 ft. that is not worn or carried disintegrates, leaving a circular crater. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or take 66 (8d10) Force damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw and is reduced to 0 Hit Points by the damage disintegrates.

actions.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
actions.description: The slaad and any number of slaadi adjacent to it teleport to a different plane of existence.

name: Spellweaver
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +4, Con +6, Int +9, Wis +8, Cha +4

traits.name: Chromatic Disk
traits.description: At the beginning of each of its turns, the spellweaver rolls a d6. On a 5-6, it regains a use of one of its expended spells of 4th level or above

traits.name: Incomprehensible Mind
traits.description: A creature that attempts to read the spellweaver's mind must make a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature suffers Disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws until it completes a short or long rest.

traits.name: Planar Impenetrability
traits.description: The area within 30 ft. of the spellweaver is inimical to interplanar magic, causing the following effects: Creatures in the area have resistance to Force damage. Interplanar teleportation magic in or out of the area fails. Divination magic that targets a creature or object in the area fails.

actions.name: Spellweaving
actions.description: The spellweaver casts any number of spells of 1st level or above with a total spell level of no more than 6.

actions.name: Magic Misile (Level 1 Spell)
actions.description: Three darts of magical force hit a creature within 120 ft., each dealing 3 (1d4 + 1) Force damage.

actions.name: Blindness (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: One creature theat the spellweaver can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded for 1 minute. A Blinded creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Hold Person (Level 2 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Paralyzed for 1 minute. A Paralyzed creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Invisibility (Level 2 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The spellweaver turns invisible for the next hour, or until it casts another spell.

actions.name: Dispel Magic (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The spellweaver ends one magical effect of 3rd level or below on a creature it can see within 60 ft.

actions.name: Thunder Step (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The spellweaver teleports up to 90 ft. to an unoccupied location it can see. Each creature within 10 ft. of the space it left must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) Thunder damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Ice Storm (1/Day, Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Each creature in a 20 ft. radius, 400 ft. high cylinder centered on a point within 300 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Dexgterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning and 14 (4d6) Cold damage, or half as much on a success. The affected area becomes difficult terrain until the end of the spellweaver's next turn.

actions.name: Wall of Fire (1/Day, Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The giant creates up to six contiguous panels of fire within 120 feet, each of which is 20 feet tall, 10 feet wide, and 1 foot thick. A creature that passes through a panel, or is in its space when the wall appears, must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 23 (5d8) Fire damage, or half as much on a success. The wall lasts 1 minute.

actions.name: Cone of Cold (1/Day, Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Each creature in a 60 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) Cold damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Counterspell (Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 60 feet, the spellweaver may make an Intelligence check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, negating the spell on a success. If the spell is 3rd level or below, the spellweaver succeeds automatically.

reactions.name: Shield (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack, the Spellweaver may add 5 to its AC until the start of its next turn.

name: Star Spawn Grue
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +1, Int +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Minion
traits.description:
If the grue takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the grue takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes
no damage.

traits.name: Waning Light
traits.description: At initiative count 0, each light source within 30 feet of at least three grues is diminished by one level; from bright light to dim light, or from dim light to darkness. Each light source within 30 feet of at least ten grues is instead extinguished.

actions.name: Gleaming Bite (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 4 Piercing damage if no non-aberration creature can see the grue.

actions.name: Pitch Dark
actions.description: The grue fills a 10-foot radius centered on a point in darkness it can see within 60 feet with a magical darkness that lasts until the end of the grue's next turn. When the magical darkness appears, each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to make a melee attack against a randomly selected creature in its reach.

name: Star Spawn Mangler
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +7, Con +4, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Aura of Hysteria
traits.description: Creatures within 30 feet of one or more manglers have Disadvantage on saving throws against being Frightened. Each Frightened creature in the area takes 7 (2d6) Psychic damage at the beginning of each of the mangler's turns.

traits.name: Crawler
traits.description: The mangler is not slowed by being prone or by difficult terrain, and while prone may Dash as a bonus action and stand from prone by spending 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mangler makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Skullbreaker Bite

actions.name: Skullbreaker Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. Any hit with this attack against a restrained or Incapacitated target becomes a critical.

actions.name: Mangling Claw
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. A creature affected by the mangler's Weaken Flesh ability takes an additional 3 (1d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Flurry of Claws (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The mangler makes six attacks with its Mangling Claw.

reactions.name: Weaken Flesh
reactions.description: When the mangler is reduced below 50 Hit Points, it may force one creature it can see within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or have its flesh soften and sag. For the next minute, whenever the affected creature takes bludgeoning, piercing, or Slashing damage, it takes an additional 3 (1d6) Slashing damage.

name: Star Spawn Emissary of Caiphon
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +7, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +6

traits.name: Blessed Sight of the Guidestar
traits.description: The emissary knows the precise location of each creature that can see the night sky.

traits.name: Visions of the Final Hour
traits.description: While it is concentrating on a spell or magical effect that targets the emissary, a creature is Blinded with visions of an unfamiliar constellation.

actions.name: Touch of Creeping Despair (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage and the target is Cursed. The first time a creature Cursed in this way fails a saving throw, this curse ends and the creature takes 18 (4d8) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Fevered Certainty of Caiphon (Concentration, Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The emissary foretells the impending doom of a creature it can see within 60 feet. When the target makes a saving throw, it does not add any modifiers to its rolled result. When the target fails a saving throw, this effect ends. The emissary has Disadvantage on saving throws made to Concentrate on this spell.

actions.name: Release of Dreams (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature the emissary can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or regain its highest level expended spell slot, then take 13 (3d8) Psychic damage per level of the spell slot regained. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more becomes hostile to all other creatures until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Steps Upon the Purple Stair (Level 4 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The emissary steps into a fleeting echo plane and disappears, taking 13 (3d8) Psychic damage and emerging in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of where it departed at the start of its next turn.

name: Star Spawn Doomsayer of Khirad
savingThrows: Dex +1, Con +6, Int +6, Wis -2, Cha +5

traits.name: Echoing Doom of Khirad
traits.description: When the doomsayer is reduced below 83 Hit Points, Khirad flares in the sky overhead, becoming visible even in daylight. For the next minute, it and each other creature within 1 mile of it subtract 1d4 from any attacks or saving throws they make.

actions.name: Starlight Lance
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 120 ft. Hit: 27 (5d10) radiant damage. If this attack hits, the doomsayer may make a second attack roll against another creature in range that is directly behind the first target.

actions.name: Stammered Whisper
actions.description: The doomsayer clutches at a creature within 5 feet and attempts to share a fragment of its unbearable knowledge. If the creature can hear and understand the doomsayer, it must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence Saving Throw or gain 10 (3d6) Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, a creature is Dominated by the doomsayer and takes 1d6 Psychic damage at the end of each of its turns.

actions.name: Summons of the Radiant King
actions.description: A pillar of blue starfire pours down upon one creature the doomsayer can see within 120 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or begin Burning (3d10). At the beginning of each of the Burning creature's turns, the doomsayer may teleport it up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the doomsayer can see.

actions.name: Gruesome Illumination (Concentration)
actions.description: A blue flame flares upon the brow of the doomsayer, casting a Dim Light in a 30-foot radius that uncovers and awakens old wounds. When a creature starts its turn in the area, the doomsayer may deal Necrotic damage equal to the creature's level or challenge rating to it.

name: Star Spawn Herald of Hadar
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +6, Int +4, Wis +4, Cha +5

traits.name: Dread Shadows
traits.description: Areas within 30 feet of the herald that are not illuminated by Bright Light have their shadows thicken and twist into unsettling shapes, becoming difficult terrain.

traits.name: Cloak of Embers (1/Day)
traits.description: If the herald fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it begins Burning (1d10).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The herald makes two attacks with its Claws of Frenzied Dark, or makes one attack against each creature in the area of its Dread Shadows.

actions.name: Claws of Frenzied Dark
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. This attack treats each creature in an area affected by the herald's Dread Shadows as though they were within 5 feet of the herald.

actions.name: Hunger of Hadar (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The herald opens a path to the unknowable horrors that lair in the dark between the stars, filling a 20-foot radius centered on a point it can see within 150 feet with chittering, tendrilous blackness for the next minute. The area is heavily obscured and difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in the area takes 7 (2d6) Cold damage. A creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Acid damage.

actions.name: Call to the Ebon Brood (Recharge 5-6, Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: The herald sings to the darkness concealed in the body of a creature it can see within 30 feet, awakening its hunger. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more has 5 (2d4) Star Spawn Grues spill forth from its eyes and mouth, appearing in the nearest unoccupied spaces. The grues act on the herald's initiative and under its control.

reactions.name: Breath of a Dying Star (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the herald is reduced below 83 Hit Points for the first time, it can cast forth a stream of swirling, incandescent embers in a 15-foot cone that blacken and burn the very air around them. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) radiant damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. Until the beginning of the herald's next turn, the area is filled with Magical Darkness, and creatures in the area can't regain Hit Points.

name: Star Spawn Hollowed of Zhudun
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +7, Int +4, Wis -2, Cha -3

traits.name: Puppet of the Radiant Void
traits.description: When the hollowed is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it moves up to half its speed and makes a single attack with its Hammer Sanity on each of its turns, taking no other actions. If it ends its turn while at 0 Hit Points without dealing damage, the hollowed dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hollowed makes three attacks with its Hammer Sanity.

actions.name: Hammer Sanity (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d8) psychic damage. If the damage dealt by this spell is greater than the target's Wisdom score, the target becomes indifferent to the hollowed and hostile to each other creature until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Visions of the Endless End (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 45 (10d8) Psychic damage and be Blinded until the end of the hollowed's next turn with visions of the infinite timeless void at the end of all things. If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage, it is instead Blinded until cured by Lesser Restoration or similar magic, and permanently gains Blindsight with a range of 5 feet.

actions.name: Corpse-Light of Zhudun (Recharge 5-6, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: The hollowed manifests a blank and flickering visage of the evershining absence left where Zhudun once burned, sending forth its screaming light in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Psychic damage plus 22 (4d10) radiant damage and be Frightened until the end of the hollowed's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

name: Star Spawn Maw of Acamar
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +4, Int +4, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Rim of the Void
traits.description: The maw projects Dim Light in a 5-foot radius, blocking out all other light sources. Creatures in the area are immune to Radiant damage, and a creature must spend 20 additional feet of movement to leave the area.

actions.name: Devouring Touch
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 33 (6d10) force damage.

actions.name: Endless Hunger of Acamar (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in the area of the maw's Rim of the Void aura must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Force damage plus 18 (4d8) Psychic damage.

bonusActions.name: Corpse-Star's Grip
bonusActions.description: Each creature within 30 feet of the maw's Rim of the Void aura must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be drawn up to 15 feet directly toward the maw.

bonusActions.name: Feed the Void
bonusActions.description: The maw draws a Medium or Large corpse or other nonmagical object within 5 feet into its body, destroying it utterly. For the next minute, the radius of its Rim of the Void aura increases by 10 feet.

reactions.name: Distort Time (1/Day, Concentration)
reactions.description: The first time the maw is reduced below 90 Hit Points, it may warp the passage of time in the area affected by its Rim of the Void ability. For the next minute, each creature in the area cannot make more than a single attack on its turn, and each creature in the area has Advantage on saving throws against effects originating outside of it.

name: Star Spawn Hulk
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +3, Con +5, Int -2, Wis +5, Cha -1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Psychic Mirror
traits.description: A creature that attempts to read the hulk's mind instead reads deeply into its own, its deepest fears, insecurities and repressed memories laid bare before it.

traits.name: Freed From Will
traits.description: Whenever the hulk voluntarily fails a saving throw, it gains 11 (2d10) Temporary Hit Points. While it has these Temporary Hit Points, the hulk's attacks are made at Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hulk makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Hurl ability.

actions.name: Pallid Claws
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Hurl
actions.description: The hulk hurls a grappled creature up to 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Ragdoll Slam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The hulk slams a grappled creature into the ground repeatedly, forcing it to make three DC 17 Constitution Saving Throws. For each save it failed, the creature takes 21 (3d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage, and half as much damage for each save on which it succeeded. A creature that fails two or more of these saving throws in a turn is Stunned until the end of the hulk's next turn.

reactions.name: Psychic Dispersal
reactions.description: When the hulk takes any Psychic damage, it may force each creature within 10 feet of it to succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence Saving Throw or take the same damage, or half as much damage on a success.

name: Star Spawn Glare of Delban
savingThrows: Str +1, Con +9, Int +3, Wis +5, Cha +9

traits.name: Stilling Glow
traits.description: Colors fade and motion stills within 20 feet of the glare. Spells and ranged weapon attacks that target a creature or point in the area deal half as much damage.

traits.name: Unseasonable Flare
traits.description: When the glare loses concentration on a spell, it flares with freezing light. Each other creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Cold damage and be Blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Boreal Gaze
actions.description: The glare turns its impassive gaze upon a creature it can see within 30 feet and an evil chill begins to creep through the creature's veins. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 45 (10d8) Cold damage and have its movement reduced by half until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Hateful Silence (Level 6 Spell, Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A horrid magical silence descends in a 30-foot radius extending from the glare, stifling all sound but that of a creature's own thunderous heartbeat. A non-aberration creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Psychic damage and be Frightened until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Doom of Delban (Level 9 Spell, Concentration, 1/Day)
actions.description: The glare calls down a shaft of freezing starlight on a a 5-foot radius space it can see. Each creature in the space when it appears, or that enters it for the first time on a turn, must make a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw On a failed save, a creature takes 66 (8d8 + 30) Cold damage plus 33 (6d10) radiant damage and is Paralyzed until the end of the glare's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success. While concentrating on this spell, the glare takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage at the beginning of each of its turns, then may use its action to move the effect up to 120 feet.

name: Star Spawn Seer
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +6, Con +4, Int +11, Wis +9, Cha +8
resistances: Cold; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: Common, Deep Speech, Undercommon, Telepathy 30 ft.

traits.name: Out-of-Phase Movement
traits.description: The seer can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. Each creature it moves through takes 5 (1d10) Psychic damage; no creature can take this damage more than once per turn. The seer takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Mind Colonizer
traits.description: When the seer casts a spell that requires concentration, it may have a willing aberration within 30 feet of it maintain concentration in its stead.

traits.name: Fractal Demise
traits.description: When the star spawn is reduced to 0 Hit Points, if one or more friendly aberrations are within 30 ft. it casts Astral Maelstrom before it dies centered on itself, its body tearing apart into a ragged spiral.

actions.name: Untether Mind (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (3d10) force damage plus Hit: 39 (6d12) psychic damage and the target must make a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature is Frightened and Blinded until the end of the seer's next turn as its field of perception expands and expands and expands until it encompasses the entirety of the multiverse. A creature that fails by 10 or more is additionally Paralyzed until the end of the seer's next turn.

actions.name: Astral Maelstrom (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The seer creates a 5-ft. radius disk of unimaginable density in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet that lasts for a minute; raw voidstuff compressed until it glows with a searing light that does not reflect or illuminate. A creature that begins its turn within 10 ft. of the sphere must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or take 33 (6d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Crumple Space (Recharge 5-6, Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: The seer chooses a point along a 5 ft. wide line that is 30 ft. long and wholly within 120 feet. Each creature in the line's area must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma Saving Throw or be teleported to the nearest unoccupied space to the point chosen by the seer, then take 22 (4d10) Force damage plus 13 (2d12) Psychic damage.

legendaryActions.name: Warp (Level 1 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: A 10 ft. radius of space centered on a point the seer can see within 60 ft. becomes difficult terrain for non-aberrations until the beginning of the seer's turn.

legendaryActions.name: Music of the Spheres (Level 3 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The seer chooses two creatures or objects it can see within 120 ft. The first creature or object is levitated off the ground and revolves up to 30 ft. clockwise around the second, maintaining the same distance. A creature levitated in this way makes a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw, resisting the effect on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Beckoning of the Expanse (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 30 ft. of the seer's Astral Maelstrom must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to move 10 ft. towards it.

name: Star Spawn Larva Mage
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +6, Con +6, Int +4, Wis +6, Cha +8
immunities: Psychic; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Restrained

traits.name: Seething Mass
traits.description: The larva mage can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the larva mage can move through any opening large enough for a tiny creature. A creature that starts its turn in the larva mage's space must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Endurance of the Never-Living
traits.description: If the larva mage would take more than 15 damage from a source that targets only it, it instead takes 15 damage.

traits.name: Return to Worms
traits.description: When the larva mage is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it breaks apart into a swarm of insects in the same space. Unless the swarm is destroyed, the larva mage reforms from it 24 hours later.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The larva mage makes two attacks with its Nerverot Bolt, one of which it may replace with a use of its Squirming Touch.

actions.name: Nerverot Bolt
actions.description: Attack: +9 range 60 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

actions.name: Squirming Touch
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must make a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature falls prone and is Frightened and Poisoned until the end of its next turn as it becomes briefly aware of the number and direction of each worm on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Plague of Worms (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 22 (5d8) Necrotic damage and be Blinded and restrained by a mass of swarming worms (Save Ends at end of turn). A creature restrained in this way takes 22 (5d8) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the larva mage's turns.

reactions.name: Feed on Weakness
reactions.description: When a creature within 20 feet of the larva mage fails a saving throw, the larva mage regains an expended legendary action.

reactions.name: Sprouting Flesh (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the larva mage is reduced below 106 Hit Points, it can force each other creature within 30 feet that has fewer than half of its Hit Points to succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage as writhing grubs sprout from its wounds. The larva mage gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the total damage dealt this way.

legendaryActions.name: Boil Out
legendaryActions.description: The larva mage teleports to the space of a corpse within 60 feet or that of a creature restrained by its Plague of Worms.

legendaryActions.name: Detritus Feeding
legendaryActions.description: The larva mage reduces one corpse in its space to bones. If it does, it gains Advantage on saving throws until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Squirming Touch
legendaryActions.description: The larva mage uses its Squirming Touch.

legendaryActions.name: Conquer Life (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The mage forces one creature with 0 Hit Points within 15 feet to make a Death saving throw. On a failure, the larva mage gains 18 (4d8) Temporary Hit Points and the creature does not reset that failure until it completes a Long Rest.

name: Star Spawn Scion of Gibbeth
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +12, Int +13, Wis +5, Cha +2

traits.name: Shroud of Cosmic Revulsion
traits.description: A creature with a Wisdom score of 10 or higher must avert its gaze from the scion if it is more than 10 feet away, treating the scion as Invisible.

traits.name: Invoker of the Vengeful Endless
traits.description: The scion must maintain Concentration to avoid recalling what dwells in Gibbeth. When it loses Concentration on this effect or ends its turn while not Concentrating on this effect, formless limbs spring from the scion's body to lash at it, dealing 5 (1d10) Force damage to it and restraining it until it regains Concentration on this ability.

traits.name: Knowledge of the Coming Hour
traits.description: At the end of each creature's turn, the scion may take 4 (1d8) Psychic damage. If it does, the scion immediately makes a saving throw to end each effect on it that ends on a successful saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scion makes two attacks with its Unbearable Touch and uses its Dread Fascination or Mind-Splinter, if available.

actions.name: Unbearable Touch
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 27 (6d8) psychic damage and the target must use its reaction to move 15 feet directly away from the scion, if available.

actions.name: Dread Fascination
actions.description: One creature the scion can see within 120 feet must make a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature must use all of its movement on its following turn to approach the scion by the most direct route available.

actions.name: Mind-Splinter (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each other creature within 10 feet of the scion must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against itself, if available. On a hit, this attack deals an additional 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.

bonusActions.name: Squamous Lurch
bonusActions.description: The scion moves up to its speed, then each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Psychic damage and be Frightened until the end of the scion's next turn. While Frightened in this way, a creature makes Intelligence and Wisdom Saving Throws at Disadvantage.

bonusActions.name: Suppress Memories
bonusActions.description: The scion hastily attempts to clear thoughts of Gibbeth from its mind, making a DC 10 Intelligence check. On a success, the scion regains Concentration on its Invoker of the Endless ability.

bonusActions.name: Unmaking Gaze
bonusActions.description: The scion assaults the mind of one creature that can see it, revealing a fragmentary vision of infinite possible futures converging unerringly toward the moment of Gibbeth's inevitable birth. The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence Saving Throw or become hostile toward each creature it can see (Save Ends at end of turn).

bonusActions.name: Embrace of Ancient Hate
bonusActions.description: Slivers of a being outside of time violently extrude through reality, squirming across a 10-foot radius column that is 60 feet high and centered on a point the scion can see within 120 feet. A creature that starts its turn in the area or that enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Psychic damage and be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside the area.

bonusActions.name: Veil of the Clinging Void
bonusActions.description: An obscuring wall of starry void crashes into existence within 120 feet of the scion. The wall is 60 feet long, 10 feet wide, and arbitrarily high. A creature that starts its turn in the wall or enters its space for the first time on a turn takes 18 (6d8) Cold damage, and is Blinded and Choking until the start of its next turn as clinging tendrils of black nothing envelop it.

name: Tsochar Parasite
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +1
languages: Tsochar, the languages of its host, Telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Slitherer
traits.description: Outside of a host, the tsochar always counts as prone. It can enter or move through the space of any creature without spending additional movement.

traits.name: Mindsight
traits.description: The tsochar knows the exact location of each creature with an Intelligence score of at least 2 within 120 feet. It has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive anything else.

actions.name: Leaping Clutch
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: The tsochar moves up to 10 ft. toward the target. If it ends this space in the target's space, the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). A creature that starts its turn grappled by the tsochar must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (5d8) nonlethal poison damage and be Poisoned until the start of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Crush
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 0 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is restrained until the end of the tsochar's next turn..

actions.name: Silence (Level 2 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The tsochar is surrounded by a 5 ft. radius sphere of silence for the next minute. Creatures inside the sphere are immune to Thunder damage and cannot perform the verbal components of spells.

actions.name: Wear Flesh
actions.description:
One incapacitated humanoid grappled by the tsochar must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or have the tsochar begin to invade and take control of its body. At the beginning of the tsochar's next turn, the tsochar enters the grappled creature's body, bores into its nerve centers and takes control. Tsochar Parasitism. When the tsochar takes control of a host, it may choose to leave the brain intact or destroy it. If it chooses to leave the brain intact, it can access the creature's stored memories, though doing so takes visible effort for the first several weeks after taking control of a new host. Tsochar continuously absorb nutrients from their host. At the end of each month, a tsochar host has its Constiution score reduced by a cumulative and permanent 1d4, until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic. If its host takes any Fire damage, the tsochar must make a Constitution Saving Throw with DC equal to 10, or half the damage dealt, whichever is higher. On a failure, the tsochar is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space. If a host dies, the tsochar exits the host automatically at the start of its next turn. When a tsochar exits its host, the host begins to bleed profusely, losing 10 (3d6) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns until a creature stanches the bleeding as an action with a successful DC 17 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

Fleshclad Template.
A fleshclad creature has: Creature Type. The creature's type becomes Aberration. Ability Scores. The creature's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores become the higher of its own or its tsochar's. Telepathy. The creature gains Telepathy 120 ft. Whispercast. The creature ignores any verbal or somatic components for spells it casts. Spellcasting. The creature knows and can cast any spells its tsochar knows, in addition to its own. Flesh Exchange. As an action, the fleshclad expels its Tsochar controller onto a creature grappled by the fleshclad. The tsochar parasite exits into the grappled creature's space and immediately makes a Leaping Clutch attack.

name: Tsochar Noble
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +5, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +4
languages: Tsochar, the languages of its host, Telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Slitherer
traits.description: Outside of a host, the tsochar always counts as prone. It can enter or move through the space of any creature without spending additional movement.

traits.name: Dweomerbarbed Grip
traits.description: If a creature that it is grappling teleports, the tsochar teleports with it.

traits.name: Mindsight
traits.description: The tsochar knows the exact location of each creature with an Intelligence score of at least 2 within 120 feet. It has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive anything else.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tsochar makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Leaping Clutch
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 15 ft. Hit: The tsochar moves up to 15 ft. toward the target. If it ends this space in the target's space, the target is Grappled (escape DC 16). A creature that starts its turn grappled by the tsochar must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) nonlethal poison damage and be Poisoned until the start of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Crush
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 0 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is restrained until the end of the tsochar's next turn.

actions.name: Silence (Level 2 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The tsochar is surrounded by a 5 ft. radius sphere of silence for the next minute. Creatures inside the sphere are immune to Thunder damage and cannot perform the verbal components of spells.

actions.name: Greater Invisibility (1/Day, Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The tsochar and its host become invisible for the next minute.

actions.name: Phantasmal Killer (1/Day, Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature within 120 ft. that the tsochar can see must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence Saving Throw or be Frightened for the next minute as it hallucinates an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 22 (4d10) Psychic damage on a failure or ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Memory Slip (1/Day Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or forget one event that occurred in the last minute. On a success, the creature knows it was targeted with a spell.

actions.name: Wear Flesh
actions.description: One incapacitated humanoid grappled by the tsochar must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or have the tsochar begin to invade and take control of its body. At the beginning of the tsochar's next turn, the tsochar enters the grappled creature's body, bores into its nerve centers and takes control.

reactions.name: Counterspell (Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 60 feet, the tsochar may make an Charisma check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, negating the spell on a success. If the spell is 3rd level or below, the tsochar succeeds automatically.

name: Spirrax
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +2, Con +13, Int +9, Wis +9, Cha +11

traits.name: Adamantine Shell
traits.description:
The spirrax has a shell of pure adamantine that protects it from most harm. If it has fewer than 163 Hit Points, the spirrax cannot use its fly speed while encased in its shell and attacks against it are made at Advantage while encased in its shell. While encased in its shell, the spirrax has the following traits:
*

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description:
The spirrax can't be affected or detected by spells of 3rd level or lower. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.
*

traits.name: Critical Immunity
traits.description:
Any critical hit against the spirax becomes a normal hit.
*

traits.name: Increased AC
traits.description:
The spirrax gains +6 to its AC (included).
*

traits.name: Impenetrable Flank
traits.description:
A creature receives no benefit from flanking the spirrax.
*

traits.name: Constrained
traits.description: The spirrax makes four fewer attacks with its multiattack.

traits.name: Aura of Indifference
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 120 ft. of the spirrax must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or become indifferent to the spirrax's presence until the start of its next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more retains no memory of the affected period after the spirrax leaves.

traits.name: Implosion
traits.description: When the spirrax dies, the dimensional gate contained within it implodes. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be sucked in and transported to a random plane. A creature that succeeds on this save may use its reaction to repeat the save to rescue a creature that failed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spirrax makes two attacks with its lashing tendrils, or makes six attacks and takes the Dash action if it is out of its shell.

actions.name: Lashing Tendril
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 20 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 20). Instead of grappling a creature, the spirrax may force it to succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 10 ft. away and knocked prone.

actions.name: Fling
actions.description: One Large or smaller creature grappled by the spirax is thrown up to 60 feet and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Void Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature, object or creation of magical force within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target takes 75 (10d6 + 40) Force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it is disintegrated.

reactions.name: Foul Emergance (1/day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking damage while below 163 Hit Points, the spirax surges out of its shell in a tide of whirling tentacles. As part of this reaction, the spirrax may move up to its speed and use its multiattack. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the spirax's next turn.

reactions.name: Adamantine Shell
reactions.description: The shell of a spirrax contains roughly 16,000 gp worth of adamantine.

name: Uvuudaum
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +11, Con +4, Int +9, Wis +9, Cha +9

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The uvuudaum has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The uvuudaum can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Non-Euclidian
traits.description: The space in a 10-foot radius around the uvuudaum is difficult terrain, as the uvuudaum's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries.

traits.name: Four Dimensional
traits.description: Time does not seem to pass during the Uvuudaum's turn. It does not provoke attacks of opportunity, and its melee attacks are made at Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The uvuudaum makes three attacks with its head spike.

actions.name: Head Spike
actions.description:
Attack: +10 reach 15 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6+5) piercing damage and the target has its Wisdom score reduced by 1d6, to a minimum of 1. If this reduces the target below 10 Wisdom, the target suffers one additional effect of the uvuudaum's choice. The uvuudaum may not choose the same effect twice in a turn:

*

actions.name: Amnesia
actions.description:
The target loses a chunk of memory, reducing its proficiency bonus by 1 for the next minute.
*

actions.name: Anoxia
actions.description:
If the target cast a spell since the end of the uvuudaum's previous turn, it loses the ability to cast that spell until it completes a long rest.
*

actions.name: Apnea
actions.description:
The target forgets how to breathe. At the end of each of its turns, it may make a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw, remembering how to breathe on a success.
*

actions.name: Mania
actions.description:
On the target's next turn, it may make one melee attack as a bonus action, but its targets are selected at random from those it can reach with its movement.
*

actions.name: Paranoia
actions.description:
The target becomes Frightened of one of its allies until the end of its next turn. While Frightened in this way, it cannot willingly accept assistance from that ally.
*

actions.name: Seizure
actions.description: If the target casts a spell on its following turn, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or fall prone and end its turn.

reactions.name: Ruin Mind
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature within 15 ft. hitting it with an attack, the uvuudaum uses its multiattack, targeting the attacker with each attack.

reactions.name: Scuttle
reactions.description: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the uvuudaum moves up to half of its speed. If this movement puts the uvuudaum out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the uvuudaum is unaffected.

reactions.name: Psychic Storm
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 115 Hit Points, the uvuudaum lets out a telepathic shriek. Each creature within 60 ft. that has a Wisdom score of 1 is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

name: Giant Worker Ant
savingThrows: Str +1, Int -4, Cha -3

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the ant takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the ant takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

traits.name: Spiracle Breathing
traits.description: The ant has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws against inhaled toxins.

traits.name: Chemical Communication
traits.description: Each other ant within 120 feet is aware of the number and type of creatures that the ant can see.

actions.name: Mandibles (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Hive Frenzy
reactions.description: When another ant within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the ant can move up to 10 feet toward it.

name: Giant Soldier Ant
savingThrows: Str +2, Con +2, Int -4, Cha -3

traits.description: The ant has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws against inhaled toxins.

traits.name: Chemical Communication

traits.name: Death Throes

actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 5-6)

reactions.name: Hive Frenzy
reactions.description: When another ant within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the ant can move up to 10 feet toward it.

actions.description: The ant lowers its head, increasing its AC by 2 until the start of its following turn. Each hostile must spend two feet of movement for every foot it moves through the ant's reach.

actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Queen's Command
actions.description: Up to two friendly ants within 60 ft. may each move up to 20 ft. and make a melee attack.

actions.name: Pheromonic Control (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 15 ft. of the queen must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Charmed by the queen for the next minute. A charmed creature repeates this saving throw at the end of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

name: Silky Anteater
savingThrows: Dex -1, Con +1, Int -4, Cha -2

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The anteater has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Prehensile Tail
traits.description: If the anteater falls prone while climbing, it may make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the anteater catches itself and does not fall.

actions.name: Nestripper Claws
actions.description: Attack: +2 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Slashing damage.

actions.name: Sticky Tongue Pluck
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity Saving Throw or have one item it is carrying that weighs 1 lb or less stolen by the anteater.

reactions.name: Clumsy Tumble
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature hits the anteater with a melee attack, the anteater forces the creature to reroll the attack, taking the second result, then falls prone.

actions.name: Earthgouge Claws
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. This attack is made at Disadvantage against any creature not grappled by the anteater.

actions.name: Sticky Tongue Pluck
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or have one item it is carrying that weighs 1 lb or less stolen by the anteater.

actions.name: Threatening Pose
actions.description: The anteater rears on its hind legs and spreads its arms. Until the anteater lowers itself as a bonus action or falls prone, its speed is reduced to 0.

reactions.name: Clumsy Tumble
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature hits the anteater with a melee attack, the anteater forces the creature to reroll the attack, taking the second result, then falls prone.

traits.name: Bristle-Tail Shade
traits.description: The anteater has Advantage on saving throws against effects that deal radiant damage.

actions.name: Balled Claw Fist
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Earthgouge Claws
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. This attack is made at Disadvantage against any creature not grappled by the anteater.

actions.name: Sticky Tongue Pluck
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or have one item it is carrying that weighs 1 lb or less stolen by the anteater.

actions.name: Threatening Pose
actions.description: The anteater rears on its hind legs and spreads its arms. Until the anteater lowers itself as a bonus action or falls prone, its speed is reduced to 0.

reactions.name: Clumsy Tumble

reactions.name: Perilous Hug
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature makes a melee attack against the anteater while the anteater is using its Threatening Pose, the anteater forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 14).

name: Hinscourge Anteater
savingThrows: Str +5, Con +5, Int -4, Cha -1

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The anteater has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Bristle-Tail Shade
traits.description: The anteater has Advantage on saving throws against effects that deal radiant damage.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The anteater can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The anteater makes two attacks with its Balled Claw Fist, or makes three attacks with its Vacuum Tongue Flick. If the anteater is using its Threatening Pose, it may instead make two attacks with its Earthgouge Claws.

actions.name: Balled Claw Fist
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Stonecutter Claws
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage. This attack is made at Disadvantage against any creature not grappled by the anteater.

actions.name: Vacuum Tongue Flick
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 20 ft. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) slashing damage and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the anteater. The target gains no benefit from cover or obscurement against this attack, so long as an uninterrupted path exists between it and the anteater.

actions.name: Bristled Sweep
actions.description: The anteater sweeps its tail in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away.

bonusActions.name: Threatening Pose
bonusActions.description: The anteater rears on its hind legs and spreads its arms. Until the anteater lowers itself as a bonus action or falls prone, its speed is reduced to 0.

bonusActions.name: Suck Up
bonusActions.description: Each Small or smaller creature within 10 feet of the anteater that it hit with its Vacuum Tongue Flick this turn must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be Swallowed (escape DC 16). A creature swallowed in this way takes 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of the anteater's turns.

reactions.name: Clumsy Tumble
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature hits the anteater with a melee attack, the anteater forces the creature to reroll the attack, taking the second result, then falls prone.

reactions.name: Perilous Hug
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature makes a melee attack against the anteater while the anteater is using its Threatening Pose, the anteater forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 16).

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the ape can gain Advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have Advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Juggernaut Leap
traits.description: The ape's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start. If the ape jumps at least 20 feet, it may land in the space of any medium or smaller creature. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone. On a successful save, is instead pushed 5 feet out of the ape's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 10 (3d6) damage to a grappled creature.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 25/50 ft. Hit: (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Juggernaut Leap
traits.description: The ape's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start. If the ape jumps at least 20 feet, it may land in the space of any large or smaller creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone. On a successful save, is instead pushed 5 feet out of the ape's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12+6) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 21 (6d6) damage to a grappled creature.

actions.name: Hurl
actions.description: The ape hurls a huge or smaller grappled creature up to 40 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't knocked prone. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Attack: +9 range 50/100 ft. Hit: 30 (7d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

name: Aurumvorax
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +4, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -3

traits.name: Treasure Sense
traits.description: The aurumvorax can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 ft. of it.

traits.name: Ornery
traits.description: The aurumvorax does not die or fall unconscious due to dropping to 0 HP if it was attacked by a hostile creature since the end of its previous turn. If the badger starts its turn with 0 HP without having been attacked since the end of its previous turn, it dies.

traits.name: Incredible Density
traits.description: The aurumvorax has Advantage on attempts to shove creatures, and on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws made against effects that would shove it or knock it prone. The aurumvorax may grapple or shove creatures up to three sizes larger than it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The aurumvorax makes five attacks: one with its locking jaws and four with its scrabbling claws. It may replace any of its claw attacks with a Shove attempt.

actions.name: Locking Jaws
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage and the target is grappled. Until this grapple ends, the aurumvorax can bite only the grappled creature and has Advantage on attack rolls to do so.

actions.name: Scrabbling Claws
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4+3) piercing damage. If this attack is made at Advantage, it does an additional 2 (1d4) damage.

actions.name: Treasure Beasts
actions.description: The corpse of an aurumvorax contains roughly 150-200 lbs of gold that may be smelted from it, for a total value of 3,000-4,000 gp. Its hide can be used as a component in crafting Armor of Fire Resistance.

traits.name: Swarm

traits.name: Cold Blooded
traits.description: If the viper takes any Cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Braille
traits.description: The swarms's eyes are covered by transparent scales that protect them from harm. It has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, and Advantage on saving throws to avoid being Blinded.

traits.name: Gliding Flyby
traits.description: The swarm may disengage as a bonus action. If it does, it cannot use its fly speed to gain altitude until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 0 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 27 (6d8) poison damage, or half as much poison damage if the swarm has half of its Hit Points or fewer.

reactions.name: Bluff Strike
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature entering the swarm's reach while it is not flying, the swarm may force the creature to succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom Saving Throw or be forced to immediately move 10 ft. away from the swarm, if it can.

actions.name: Bluff Strike

traits.name: Web-Dweller

actions.name: Venomous Bite

reactions.name: Crushed Vengeance
reactions.description: When the widow is reduced to 0 Hit Points by a melee attack, it can make a Venomous Bite attack with Advantage against the attacker.

actions.description: The spider scrapes off some of its barbed bristles and flings them toward a creature within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn) or until it takes an action to clear its eyes.

reactions.name: Crushed Vengeance

name: Grandmother Moru, Beast of the Veiled Pass
savingThrows: Str +13, Dex +11, Con +7, Int +4, Wis +5, Cha +12

traits.name: Dread Will

traits.name: With Hunger Like Death (Mythic Trait, recharges after a Short or Long rest)
traits.description: When Grandmother is reduced to 0 Hit Points, she doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, she resets to 262 Hit Points. For the next hour, whenever Grandmother kills a spiderkind creature with her Stilling Bite, she regains 30 Hit Points and a Legendary Resistance.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
traits.description: If Grandmother fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Grandmother makes four attacks, one of which may be with her Stilling Bite.

actions.name: Stilling Bite
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) poison damage and the target must make DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target is Poisoned for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn), and is Incapacitated while Poisoned if it is not illuminated by Bright Light.

actions.name: Loathly Legs
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 15 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or suffer one additional effect: The creature is knocked prone and grappled (escape DC 21) until Grandmother moves. The target drops one object it is carrying and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

bonusActions.name: Web Bind
bonusActions.description: Grandmother attempts to wrap a grappled or prone creature within 15 feet in webbing, forcing it to succeed on a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 21). bonusActions.name: Dread Snare

Until the end of her next turn, light sources in the area have the area they illuminate reduced by half, and a creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened and Choking until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Tangle the Weave
reactions.description: When Grandmother is targeted with a spell, she can cause the spell to leave a tangle of blackened silk in a 5-foot wide line in the air behind it. Attacks that pass through the web have Disadvantage, and a creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 21). Each 5-foot section of the line can be attacked (AC 20, 15 HP, resistance to all but fire and magical Slashing damage).

legendaryActions.name: Loathly Lurch
legendaryActions.description: Grandmother moves up to half her speed and can make an attack with her Loathly Legs.

legendaryActions.name: Devour Light
legendaryActions.description: Grandmother extinguishes a light source she can see within 15 feet of her or one of her webs, then she gains 15 Temporary Hit Points. If the light source is produced by a spell of 3rd level or above (or equivalent magic), this ability fails.

legendaryActions.name: Nameless Progeny
legendaryActions.description: 1d4 Goliath Bristle Spiders that act on initiative count 0 emerge from their burrows in Grandmother's back and immediately crawl to unoccupied spaces within 15 feet of her.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Stilling Bite
legendaryActions.description: Grandmother makes an attack with her Stilling Bite.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Fatal Despair
legendaryActions.description: One creature restrained by Grandmother's black webs must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom Saving Throw or lose its will to survive. The creature becomes immune to the Frightened condition for the next minute and can't voluntarily move away from Grandmother, attempt to escape from restraints, or heal itself.
