actions.name: Howlpath Aurora (1/Day, Concentration)
actions.description: Gansulfr opens the sky above it and shimmering lights spill forth, bathing the area in a 500-foot radius in an eldritch glow. At the end of each of Gansulfr's turns, he can call 2 (1d4) Dire Wolves, or one Dire Wolf Pack if his Mythic Trait is active, to rain down from the sky into unoccupied spaces within range.

reactions.name: Hem In
reactions.description: When a friendly creature Gansulfr can see misses with a melee attack, he can move up to half his speed toward the attack's target.

reactions.name: Consume Offering
reactions.description: Whenever a creature within 30 feet consumes a potion or similar item, Gansulfr can negate its effects, then regains 15 Hit Points or a use of his Devouring Altar.

legendaryActions.name: Shift Pack
legendaryActions.description: Each other wolf that Gansulfr can see can use its reaction to move up to its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Contagion Mists
legendaryActions.description: Gansulfr shakes and snorts, shedding a sickening mist that Heavily Obscures a 30-foot radius around him until he is hit with a melee attack. A creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Gnawnerves.

legendaryActions.name: Bounding Snap (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Gansulfr leaps up to 30 feet, then can make an attack with its Cruel Jaws against a creature it can see.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Shatter the Sun (1/Day, Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Dark, celestial jaws begin close around the sun and moon, plunging the world into darkness for the next minute. Creatures on this plane have Disadvantage on saving throws against being Frightened for the duration, and Gansulfr regains a use of his Howlpack Aurora.

name: Deva
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +4, Int +3, Wis +9, Cha +9
resistances: Radiant; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.description: The angel's weapons are manifestations of its innate divine magic, and appear only as the angel is attacking with them.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The deva has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Numinous Presence
traits.description: If the angel has at least 69 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the angel must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to take hostile action against the angel until the start of its next turn. A creature passes this save automatically if it took damage from the angel since the end of its last turn.

traits.name: Wrathful Presence
traits.description: If the angel has 68 HP or fewer, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the angel must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or become Frightened of the angel until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a bonus action, the deva may transform into a humanoid or beast, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in any form, and it reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the deva's choice).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The deva makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Luminous Mace
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
actions.description: The deva touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) Hit Points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness. If the target is a corpse that died in the last 10 days, it is restored to life.

reactions.name: Shielding Wings
reactions.description: As a reaction to an ally being hit with an attack, the deva may move up to half its speed. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of the targeted creature, the creature's AC is increased by 2 (including against the triggering attack) and the deva's AC is decreased by 2 until the end of the deva's next turn.

reactions.name: Radiant Retribution
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the deva may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be forced to expend each unexpended hit die it has, rolling each of them and taking radiant damage equal to the total rolled.

name: Planetar
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +5, Con +12, Int +4, Wis +11, Cha +12
resistances: Radiant; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.description: The planetar's weapons are manifestations of its innate divine magic, and appear only as the planetar is attacking with them.

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.description: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The planetar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Cowing Presence
traits.description: If the planetar has at least 101 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the planetar must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to take hostile action against the planetar until the start of its next turn. A creature has Advantage on this save if it took damage from the planetar since the end of its last turn.

traits.name: Wrathful Presence
traits.description: If the planetar has 100 HP or fewer, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the planetar must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or become Frightened of the planetar until the start of its next turn. While frightened in this way, the creature has vulnerability to radiant damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The planetar makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Sword of Wrath
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage plus Hit: 22 (5d8) radiant damage and the creature must make a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, a target begins to turn to salt and is restrained. The restrained target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends on the target. On a failure, the target is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

actions.name: Plague of Locusts
actions.description: Each creature of the planetar's choice within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or take 27 (5d10) Piercing damage. Until the end of the planetar's next turn, the affected area is difficult terrain and heavily obscured for all other creatures.

actions.name: Judgement of Heaven
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or be reduced to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
actions.description: The planetar touches another creature that is alive, or has been dead for no more than a century. If the target was dead, it is restored to life with 1 HP. Then, the target magically regains 30 (6d8 + 3) Hit Points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, deafness, or petrification.

name: Solar
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +6, Con +8, Int +14, Wis +14, Cha +17
resistances: Radiant; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.description: The solar's weapons are manifestations of its innate divine magic, and appear only as the Solar is attacking with them.

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.description: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The solar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Cowing Presence
traits.description: If the solar has at least 122 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the solar must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to take hostile action against the solar until the start of its next turn. A creature has Advantage on this save if it took damage from the solar since the end of its last turn.

traits.name: Wrathful Presence
traits.description: If the solar has 121 HP or fewer, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the solar must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or become Frightened of the solar until the start of its next turn. While frightened in this way, the creature has vulnerability to radiant damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
traits.description: If the solar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The solar attacks with its sword twice, one of which it may replace with a longbow attack.

actions.name: Sword of Ruin
actions.description: The solar slashes with its sword and a line of incandescent light 5 feet wide and 30 feet long appears within 120 feet and lasts for a minute. A creature that starts its turn in one or more such lines, or enters one for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) radiant damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Lifeburst Longbow
actions.description: Attack: +13 range 150/600 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage and the target is pushed back 10 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or take an additional Hit: 9 (2d8) radiant damage per unexpended hit die it has, then regains one hit die.

actions.name: Healing Touch (4/Day)
actions.description: The solar touches another creature that is alive, or has been dead for no more than a century. If the target was dead, it is restored to life with 1 HP. Then, the target magically regains 40 (8d8 + 4) Hit Points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness. If the target is a corpse that died in the last century, it is restored to life.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport
legendaryActions.description: The solar magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendaryActions.name: Searing Burst (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The solar emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10-foot radius centered on the solar must make a DC 23 Dexterity Saving Throw, taking 14 (4d6) Fire damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryActions.name: Blinding Gaze (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The solar targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be blinded until magic such as the lesser restoration spell removes the blindness.

name: Lantern Archon
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +2, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Peaceful Illumination
traits.description: The	archon	sheds	bright	sunlight	in	a	30-foot	radius	and	dim	light	in	an	additional	30	feet. Creatures illuminated by it have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to deescalate conflict.

actions.name: Celestial Aid
actions.description: Up to three creatures within 60 ft. each gain 10 Temporary Hit Points. While a creature has any of those Temporary Hit Points, its vision is not impeded by ordinary or magical darkness.

actions.name: Light the Path
actions.description: One creature within 60 ft. sees the shortest and most direct physical route to their current destination illuminated before them for the next eight hours, if such a route exists.

actions.name: Plane Shift (1/Day, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: The archon teleports to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reactions.name: Oppressive Radiance
reactions.description:
As a reaction to being hit with an attack or harmful spell, the archon fires a beam of holy light at the attacker or spell caster. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) radiant damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is blinded until the end of the archon's next turn.

 Using Lantern Archons In Your Game. A lantern archon might be how you characterize a cleric casting Find the Path, or might appear to guide one through a hidden or treacherous passage. One could appear to a cleric at a time of great portent, perhaps after rolling a nat 20 on a death save.

name: Hound Archon
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +3, Wis +4, Cha +2

traits.name: Calm and Ready
traits.description: Creatures of the archon's choice within 30 ft. have Advantage on initiative checks and on saving throws against Fear.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The archon can use its action to polymorph into any canine, such as a wolf, dog or fox, or back into its true form, which is celestial. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed, and isn't usable while polymorphed. It reverts to its celestial form if it dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archon makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee	Weapon Attack: +7	to	hit, reach	5	ft., one	target. Hit: 8	(1d8	+	4)	piercing	damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee	Weapon Attack: +7	to	hit, reach	5	ft., one	target. Hit: 8	(1d8	+	4)	piercing	damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone if it is a medium or smaller creature.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee	Weapon Attack: +7	to	hit, reach	5	ft., one	target. Hit: 11	(2d6	+	4)	piercing	damage.

actions.name: Plane Shift (1/Day, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: The archon teleports to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reactions.name: Loyal Defender
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature within 5 ft. being hit with an attack, the archon may cause the attack to hit it instead.

name: Warden Archon
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +4, Wis +5, Cha +3

traits.name: Menacing Presence
traits.description: If the archon has fewer than 69 Hit Points, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the archon must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened of the archon until the beginning of the archon's next turn. A creature that passes this save is immune to the Menacing Presence of this archon for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Far-Seeing
traits.description: The archon cannot be surprised. If it would otherwise be surprised, it acts on initiative count 20 this combat, instead of rolling initiative.

traits.name: Concussive Strength
traits.description: A creature knocked prone by the archon must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The archon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 4 (1d8) radiant damage. This attack does an additional Hit: 9 (2d8) piercing damage to a prone creature.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Bear Hug
actions.description: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 45 (9d8+5) Bludgeoning damage and be grappled. While the archon has a creature grappled in this way, it cannot use its multiattack.

actions.name: Plane Shift (1/Day, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: The archon teleports to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reactions.name: Crush
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature the archon has grappled speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the archon crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature immediately begins to suffocate.

name: Trumpet Archon
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +6, Con +4, Int +7, Wis +8, Cha +3

traits.name: Rallying Presence
traits.description: If the archon has fewer than 85 Hit Points, creatures within 60 feet that can hear the archon have Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws, and regain the maximum number of Hit Points possible from any healing.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The archon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archon makes three attacks with its trumpet blade, one of which it may replace with its Clarion Call, if available.

actions.name: Trumpet Blade
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage and Hit: 9 (2d8) radiant damage. Before or after this attack, the archon's trumpet may become a greatsword, or vice versa.

actions.name: Clarion Call (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 60 ft. that can hear the archon has its life essence bolstered. Non-undead creatures affected by this ability cannot be reduced below 1 HP until the beginning of the archon's next turn. Fiends have Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws until the beginning of the archon's next turn.

actions.name: Plane Shift (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: The archon teleports to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reactions.name: Trumpet Blast
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the archon forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Thunder damage and be Deafened for the next minute. A Celestial or Fiend that fails this save by 5 or more is banished to its home plane.

name: Sword Archon
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +8, Con +5, Int +6, Wis +8, Cha +2

traits.name: Dive Attack
traits.description: If the archon is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on an 18, 19, or 20.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The archon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The archon makes two attacks with its holy flameblades.

actions.name: Holy Flameblades
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) fire damage and Hit: 18 (4d8) radiant damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or be banished to a prison demiplane until the archon uses this ability again or is incapacitated, reappearing in the nearest unoccupied space to the space it departed.

actions.name: Wing Buffet
actions.description: Each creature within 15 ft. of the archon must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 23 (4d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Plane Shift (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: The archon teleports to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reactions.name: Hallowed Blood (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 115 Hit Points, the archon blesses the weapons of each friendly creature within 30 ft. Weapon attacks made by those creatures for the next minute do an additional 9 (2d8) radiant damage on a hit.

name: Couatl
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +5, Con +5, Int +4, Wis +7, Cha +6
immunities: Psychic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The couatl's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The couatl has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Dream Traveler
traits.description: The couatl can appear in the dreams of any creature it is familiar with. While in a creature's dream, the couatl may appear however it wishes, can communicate with the creature, and can free it from any poison, disease, or curse it is afflicted with.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a bonus action, the couatl may transform into a humanoid or beast, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in any form, and it reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the couatl's choice).

traits.name: Leaf on the Wind
traits.description: The first time each turn that a creature ends its movement adjacent to the couatl, the couatl may move up to 15 feet. Opportunity Attacks that it provokes with this movement are made at Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The couatl attacks once with its bite and once with its constrict.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be poisoned. While poisoned in this way, the target perceives its reality as though in a dream, and the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks. The target may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. When the effect ends, the target retains no memory of events that transpired while it was poisoned.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the couatl can't constrict another target.

name: Couatl Cloud Serpent
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +10, Con +8, Int +9, Wis +10, Cha +8
immunities: Psychic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The couatl's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The couatl has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Dream Traveler
traits.description: The couatl can appear in the dreams of any creature it is familiar with. While in a creature's dream, the couatl may appear however it wishes, can communicate with the creature, and can free it from any poison, disease, or curse it is afflicted with.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a bonus action, the couatl may transform into a humanoid or beast, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in any form, and it reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the couatl's choice).

traits.name: Leaf on the Wind
traits.description: The first time each turn that a creature ends its movement adjacent to the couatl, the couatl may move up to 15 feet. Opportunity Attacks that it provokes with this movement are made at Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The couatl attacks once with its bite and once with its constrict.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage and Hit: 27 (6d8) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be poisoned. While poisoned in this way, the target perceives its reality as though in a dream, has a fly speed of 60 feet, and deals only half damage with weapon attacks. The target may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. When the effect ends, the target retains no memory of events that transpired while it was poisoned.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the couatl can't constrict another target.

actions.name: Crack the Sky (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 120 feet of the couatl, and up to three creatures within 30 feet of the first target, must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 22 (5d8) radiant damage and 22 (5d8) lighting damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Deathpact Angel
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +4, Con +4, Int +9, Wis +10, Cha +11
resistances: Necrotic, Radiant; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Beneficent Presence
traits.description: If the angel has at least 103 Hit Points, a creature in the angel's debt that starts its turn within 60 feet of the angel must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed by the angel until the start of its next turn. A creature passes this save automatically if the angel attacked it in the last minute.

traits.name: Exacting Presence
traits.description: If the angel has 102 Hit Points or fewer, a creature Frightened by the angels Visions of Death is additionally Paralyzed.

traits.name: Debt Keeper
traits.description: A creature that is indebted to the angel is psychically connected to it. The angel can telepathically communicate with it over any distance and can choose to perceive through its senses. Once per day, the angel can force an indebted creature to reroll an attack, skill check, or saving throw, taking the second result.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The angel has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Shed Asset (3/Day)
traits.description: If the angel fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to shift the effect to a creature in its debt within 30 feet. If it does, that creature is freed from the angel's debt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The angel makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Visions of Death, if available, and uses its Debt to the Deathless.

actions.name: Golden Scythe
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. On a critical hit, the target loses 2 (1d4) unexpended hit dice, or drops to 0 Hit Points and loses an extremity if it cannot.

actions.name: Debt to the Deathless
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet that is in the angel's debt loses 11 (2d10) Hit Points, and the angel gains that many Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Visions of Death (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet that the angel can see must make a DC 19 Intelligence Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Blinded and Frightened until the end of the angel's next turn as it begins to vividly hallucinate its own gruesome death at the angel's hands.

actions.name: Touch of Life (3/Day)
actions.description: The angel touches a living creature or one that has been dead no longer than ten days. The creature returns to life in the angel's debt if it was dead, then regains Hit Points equal to half its maximum.

reactions.name: Offer Relief
reactions.description: When another creature it can see within 30 feet fails a saving throw, the angel grants it the ability to choose to reroll the saving throw, taking the second result. A creature that does so is indebted to the angel.

reactions.name: Recall Obligations
reactions.description: When a creature in the angel's debt that the angel can see casts a spell, the angel forces the creature to expend an additional spell slot of any level. If the creature cannot, the spell fails.

name: Empyrean
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex +5, Con +10, Int +5, Wis +6, Cha +8
immunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Weapons, Damage from Falling

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the empyrean fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The empyrean has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Empyrean uses its Shift Mood ability and makes three attacks with its maul or bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Maul
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 10 ft. Hit: 45 (10d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus an additional 1d6 Bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet the empyrean fell this turn. The target must succeed on a DC 23 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 15 feet away and knocked prone.

actions.name: Bolt
actions.description: Attack: +15 range 600 ft. Hit: 42 (12d6) damage of one of the following types (empyrean's choice): acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, radiant, or thunder. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the empyrean's next turn. A Blinded creature has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Shift Mood
actions.description:
The Empyrean adopts one of the following moods. It may not choose the same one twice until it has selected all of them.

*

actions.name: Impatient
actions.description:
Creatures within 30 feet of the Empyrean have their movement speed doubled and Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws. The Empyrean makes an additional attack when it uses its multiattack.

*

actions.name: Fearful
actions.description:
Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean must make a DC 23 Wisdom Saving Throw or be frightened until the end of the Empyrean's next turn. As part of this action, the Empyrean may attempt to teleport to another plane of existence (Level 7 Spell)

*

actions.name: Joyous
actions.description:
Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean are unaffected by difficult terrain, and have a fly speed equal to their movement speed. The empyrean adds its Charisma modifier its damage rolls.

*

actions.name: Lonely
actions.description:
Creatures within 100 feet of the empyrean are dragged 100 feet closer to it. The Empyrean has vulnerability to Psychic damage.

*

actions.name: Melancholic
actions.description:
Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean have their movement speed halved and have Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws. The empyrean's attacks deal an addition 2d6 Psychic damage this turn.

*

actions.name: Peaceful
actions.description:
Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean who targets another creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a DC 23 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the attack or spell fails.

*

actions.name: Regretful
actions.description:
Creatures within 30 feet are healed for 20d8 Hit Points and freed of all debilitating effects.

*

actions.name: Wrathful

legendaryActions.name: Shine Bright
legendaryActions.description: The senmurv gains 15 Temporary Hit points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the senmurv emits Bright Light in a 30-foot Radius and attacks against it have Advantage.

name: Unicorn
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Wis +3, Cha +3

traits.name: Numinous Presence
traits.description: If the unicorn has at least 34 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the unicorn must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to take hostile action against the unicorn until the start of its next turn. A creature passes this save automatically if it took damage from the unicorn since the end of its last turn.

traits.name: Elusive
traits.description: The unicorn has Advantage on stealth checks to hide from non-good-aligned creatures.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the unicorn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The unicorn has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The unicorn makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn. If it has 33 or fewer HP, it instead makes three attacks with its hooves and one with its horn.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet back. This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) damage to a prone creature.

actions.name: Horn
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch (3/day)
actions.description: The unicorn magically restores 11 (2d8 + 2) Hit Points to a creature within 5 feet. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target.

actions.name: Teleport (1/Day)
actions.description: The unicorn magically teleports itself and up to three willing creatures it can see within 5 feet of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the unicorn is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

reactions.name: Shimmering Shield
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a creature make an attack, the unicorn creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the unicorn's next turn.

name: Unicorn Celestial Charger
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +8, Wis +8, Cha +3

traits.name: Numinous Presence
traits.description: If the unicorn has at least 86 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the unicorn must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to take hostile action against the unicorn until the start of its next turn. A creature passes this save automatically if it took damage from the unicorn since the end of its last turn.

traits.name: Elusive
traits.description: The unicorn has Advantage on stealth checks to hide from non-good-aligned creatures.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the unicorn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The unicorn has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The unicorn makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn. If it has 85 or fewer HP, it instead makes three attacks with its hooves and one with its horn.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet back. This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) damage to a prone creature.

actions.name: Horn
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch
actions.description: The unicorn magically restores 22 (4d8 + 4) Hit Points to a creature within 5 feet. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target.

actions.name: Teleport (1/Day)
actions.description: The unicorn magically teleports itself and up to three willing creatures it can see within 5 feet of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the unicorn is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

reactions.name: Shimmering Shield
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a creature make an attack, the unicorn creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target gains a +3 bonus to AC until the end of the unicorn's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Hooves
legendaryActions.description: The unicorn makes one attack with its hooves.

legendaryActions.name: Skittish Dash (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The unicorn moves up to half its speed. Opportunity Attacks it provokes with this movement are made at Disadvantage.

legendaryActions.name: Healing Touch (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The unicorn uses its healing touch.

name: Bane, Tyrant Supreme
savingThrows: Str +17, Dex +5, Con +17, Int +7, Wis +16, Cha +17
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Tyrant's Presence
traits.description: At the start of each of Bane's turns, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation from him can choose to be Charmed or Frightened until the start of his next turn. Then, each creature that chose neither takes 22 (4d10) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Invincible Avatar (2/Round)
traits.description: If Bane fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead. If he does, he regains one fewer legendary action on his following turn. At the end of each of Bane's turns, he can end one spell or condition affecting him.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Bane makes three attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Shatter Strength, Condem, or Malevolent Vise.

actions.name: Kingsclaw, Blade of Strife
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 10 ft. Hit: 35 (6d8 + 8) slashing damage, plus an extra Hit: 9 (2d8) necrotic damage for each creature Charmed by Bane within 20 feet of him.

actions.name: The Black Gauntlet
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 5 ft. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If this attack exceeds the target's AC by 10 or more, the target is additionally pushed up to 30 feet and falls Prone.

actions.name: Shatter Strength (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Bane can see within 60 feet takes 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage. Then, if it is Bloodied, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: Bane chooses one of the following effects. Success: The target chooses one of the following effects. For 1 hour, the creature can't benefit from Immunity to the Charmed or Frightened conditions. For 1 hour, the creature has Disadvantage on Saving Throws that use Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. For 1 hour, the creature can't take Bonus Actions or Reactions.

actions.name: Condemn (Level 8 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Bane conjures a looming blade above a creature within 60 feet. At the start of each of the creature's turns, it takes 11 (2d10) Psychic damage. When this effect ends, the blade falls, forcing the creature to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: 67 (5d10 + 40) Force damage, plus an extra 10 Force damage for each full round that Bane concentrated on the spell. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Malevolent Vise (Level 8 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: An iron claw envelops a creature Bane can see within 120 feet, Restraining it (escape DC 25). The Restrained creature can't teleport, and at the end of each of its turns must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: 48 (4d8 + 30) Force damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Almighty Fist (Recharge 4-6, Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: A titanic, searing fist plummets from the heavens, crashing down to strike a 10-foot Emanation within 300 feet. Each creature in the area is knocked Prone, then must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: 126 (4d12 + 100) Force damage and the creature is Restrained (escape DC 25) until the end of Bane's next turn. Success: Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Edict of Conquest
bonusActions.description: Until the start of Bane's next turn, all attacks against creatures Frightened by him have Advantage.

bonusActions.name: Edict of Cruelty
bonusActions.description: Until the start of Bane's next turn, he and creatures Charmed by him each gain a +10 bonus to the first attack roll they make each turn.

bonusActions.name: Edict of Contempt
bonusActions.description: Until the start of Bane's next turn, he and creatures Charmed by him each reduce the first source of damage they take each turn by 10.

legendaryActions.name: Bear Down
legendaryActions.description: Bane teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet and makes an attack.

legendaryActions.name: Grind Underfoot
legendaryActions.description: Bane moves up to his Speed, then can force one Prone creature within 5 feet to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: 33 (6d10) Bludgeoning damage and the target is Dazed until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage.

legendaryActions.name: Supreme Command
legendaryActions.description: Each creature Charmed by Bane must use its Reaction, if available, to move up to its Speed and make a weapon attack or cast a Cantrip under Bane's control.

name: Bhaal, Eternal Blasphemy
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +17, Con +16, Int +9, Wis +19, Cha +8
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Thrill of the Edge
traits.description: Whenever a creature within 30 feet of Bhaal is reduced to 0 Hit Points, each other creature in the area gains Advantage on the next attack it makes. If Bhaal's Mythic Trait is active, creatures in the area can make a melee attack as a Bonus Action on their turn.

traits.name: Red Sun's Rise (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
traits.description: When Bhaal is reduced to 0 Hit Points, he doesn’t die or fall Unconscious. Instead, he resets to 506 Hit Points and his spilled essence burns with unholy hunger. Each Humanoid corpse within 120 feet of him rises as a Horde Ghoul that acts on Intiative 0 under his control.

traits.name: Invincible Avatar (2/Round)
traits.description: If Bhaal fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead. If he does, he regains one fewer legendary action on his following turn. At the end of each of Bhaal's turns, he can end one spell or condition affecting him.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Bhaal makes three attacks and uses his Gore Inversion, Wreath of Blades, or Maiming Gale.

actions.name: Thirsting Knife
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) piercing damage, plus one of the following effects: Relentless Intent. The next attack Bhaal makes against the target this turn has Advantage. Open Vein. The target begins Bleeding (1d10) or has its Bleeding Value increase by 1d10, if it was already Bleeding. Crimson Reap. This attack deals an extra 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage for each Bleeding creature within 30 feet of Bhaal.

actions.name: Gore Inversion (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: One Paralyzed or Unconscious creature Bhaal can see within 60 feet must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: The creature dies and turns inside-out in a spray of gore. Each of the target's allies within 60 feet that can see it is Frightened until the end of Bhaal's next turn.

actions.name: Wreath of Blades (Level 7 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Razor-sharp blades of hardened magic whirl through the air in a 10-foot Emanation from Bhaal. When a creature starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn, Bhaal can force it to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: 38 (7d10) Slashing damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Maiming Gale (Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: Bhaal casts forth a torrent of invisible blades to slice through the air in a 60-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: 62 (4d10 + 40) Slashing damage. Success: Half damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is dismembered, losing one limb of its choice.

bonusActions.name: Twist Knife
bonusActions.description: Immediately after Bhaal exceeds a target's AC by 10 or more with a Melee Attack Roll, he can take this action to make that attack a Critical Hit.

bonusActions.name: Exultation of Blood (Level 2 Spell)
bonusActions.description: Bhaal gains 5 Temporary Hit Points for each creature he hit with an attack since the end of his last turn. While he has any of these Temporary Hit Points, Bhaal's attacks have Advantage.

legendaryActions.name: Slaughter Rush
legendaryActions.description: Bhaal moves up to his Speed and can make two attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Unstoppable Will
legendaryActions.description: Bhaal armors himself in hallowed blood; the next source of damage that Bhaal takes before the start of his next turn is reduced to 1.

legendaryActions.name: Death is Here
legendaryActions.description: Bhaal teleports to an unoccupied space within 120 feet, then can make an attack or force a creature within 5 feet to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: The creature is Frightened until the end of its next turn. While Frightened in this way, the target is Paralyzed.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Power Word Kill (Recharge 4-6, Level 9 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: Bhaal speaks a word of power, compelling death. One creature he can see within 60 feet dies if it has 100 Hit Points or fewer. Otherwise, it takes 78 (12d12) Psychic damage.

name: Myrkul, the End Incarnate
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +6, Con +10, Int +18, Wis +19, Cha +17
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Ossuary Call
traits.description: Skeletal Undead within 90 feet of Myrkul may use his attack bonus (+17) in place of their own.

traits.name: Keeper of the Dead
traits.description: Creatures killed by Myrkul can't be returned to life by any means without his sanction.

traits.name: Invincible Avatar (2/Round)
traits.description: If Myrkul fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead. If he does, he regains one fewer legendary action on his following turn. At the end of each of Myrkul's turns, he can end one spell or condition affecting him.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Myrkul makes two attacks with his Scythe of Ages, one of which he can replace with a use of his Maggot Feast, Eternity Reap, or Fray Time.

actions.name: Scythe of Ages
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 15 ft. Hit: 52 (8d10 + 8) force damage, plus an extra Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage for each point of Exhaustion the target has.

actions.name: Maggot Feast (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: *Fat white worms spill from every wound.* Each creature of Myrkul's choice in a 60-foot Emanation from him must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: 44 (8d10) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. A creature that fails this saving throw while it is Bloodied, Diseased, or Poisoned additionally becomes Dazed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Eternity Reap (Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: Myrkul sweeps his scythe, sending forth a wave of shrieking death in a 120-foot Cone. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: 27 (5d10) Force damage plus 27 (5d10) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. Each creature reduced to 0 Hit Points in this way must immediately make three Death Saving Throws, then each corpse in the area crumbles to dust.

actions.name: Fray Time (Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: Myrkul stretches seconds into days, forcing one creature he can see within 60 feet to make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: The creature gains 3 (1d4 + 1) points of Exhaustion. Success: The creature gains one point of Exhaustion.

actions.name: Thousand Deaths (Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: A torrent of howling spirits rushes around and through a creature Myrkul can see within 60 feet, forcing it to make immediately make three Constitution Saving Throws: DC 25. 1st Failure: 50 (1d100) Cold damage. 2nd Failure: 50 (1d100) Psychic damage and the creature is Poisoned for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn). 3rd Failure: 50 (1d100) Necrotic damage and the target dies if it has less than 50 Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Draw of the Void<!-- Level 7 Spell -->
bonusActions.description: Each creature of Myrkul's choice within 120 feet must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage and the creature is dragged up to 60 feet toward Myrkul.

bonusActions.name: Death Looms<!-- (Level 9 Spell) -->
bonusActions.description: The last creature to hit Myrkul with a melee attack since the end of his previous turn must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: The creature drops to 0 Hit Points. Success or Failure: The creature gains a point of Exhaustion.

legendaryActions.name: Inevitable Approach
legendaryActions.description: Myrkul moves up to his Speed and can make a Scythe of Ages attack. This movement can't be impeded or prevented by any means.

legendaryActions.name: Judgement of the False
legendaryActions.description: One non-Cleric creature that Myrkul can see within 60 feet must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: The creature gains Vulnerability to the next source of damage that it takes.

legendaryActions.name: Unearth Attendants
legendaryActions.description: Myrkul conjures three Necromite Reapers that act on Initiative 0 in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet.

name: Shar, Mother of Sorrows
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +17, Con +16, Int +16, Wis +16, Cha +19
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Touch of Solace
traits.description: When Shar deals damage to a creature, she can choose to keep it secret, Cursing the creature instead. Make a note of the total damage prevented in this way to the creature. When the curse ends, the creature takes that amount of Psychic damage.

traits.name: Invincible Avatar (2/Round)
traits.description: If Shar fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. If she does, she regains one fewer legendary action on her following turn. At the end of each of Shar’s turns, she can end one spell or condition affecting her.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Shar makes two attacks, each of which she can replace with a use of her Banish Hope, Carve Void, or Shackles of Agony.

actions.name: Bitter Caress
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 10 ft. Hit: 102 (4d10 + 80) cold damage and the target is Dazed until the end of Shar's next turn.

actions.name: Banish Hope (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A wave of overwhelming despair washes forth from Shar in a 60-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: The creature falls Prone and is Dazed for one minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Carve Void (Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: An inviolable abyss blooms in a 20-foot radius Sphere within 120 feet, ending each spell effect of Level 5 or below, extinguishing each light, and disintegrating each unattended nonmagical object in the area. Each creature in the area is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside the area, then must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: 65 (10d12) Force damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Shackles of Agony (Level 8 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Crippling pain wracks a creature Shar can see within 60 feet, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: 54 (12d8) Psychic damage and the creature is Paralyzed for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn). Success: Half damage and the target is Dazed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Soul's Eclipse (Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: A black orb appears behind a creature within 60 feet, burning with dark radiance. At the start of each of that creature's turns, it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: The creature is Dominated until the start of its next turn. Success: The creature is Dazed until the start of its next turn. The orb is Invisible to the target and can be destroyed (AC 20, 50 HP, Vulnerability to Radiant).

actions.name: Hollow Out (Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Shar can see within 60 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: Shar chooses one of the following effects she has not yet chosen this turn, then the creature must save against this spell a second time. The target gains one point of Exhaustion if it has no points of Exhaustion, or takes 62 (4d10 + 40) Necrotic damage otherwise. The target loses 7 (2d6) levels worth of Spell Slots, or takes 62 (4d10 + 40) Force damage if it can't. The target loses attunement to one magic item of its choice, or takes 62 (4d10 + 40) Psychic damage if it can't.

bonusActions.name: Ephemerate (Level 6 Spell)
bonusActions.description: Each corpse, conjured creature, illusion, or creation of magical force in a 60-foot Emanation from Shar turns to shadow and disintegrates.

bonusActions.name: Extinction Urge
bonusActions.description: Each Dazed creature within 120 feet must use its Reaction to make a weapon attack or cast a Cantrip under Shar's control, targeting itself.

legendaryActions.name: Dark Dance
legendaryActions.description: Shar teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet, then can use her Carve Void, Shackles of Agony, Soul's Eclipse, or Hollow Out.

legendaryActions.name: Embrace Oblivion
legendaryActions.description: Shar moves up to her Speed, then can force a Dazed or Unconscious creature within 10 feet to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: The creature is Dazed and can't regain Hit Points until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

legendaryActions.name: Nightsong
legendaryActions.description: Shar's hums a hauntingly beautiful melody; each creature within 120 feet that is Cursed by Shar's Touch of Solace takes 20 Necrotic damage, then Shar can end the curse for one of them.

name: Tiamat, Exalted Queen
savingThrows: Str +14, Dex +12, Con +11, Int +7, Wis +15, Cha +7
immunities: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Exalted Ward
traits.description: While she has more than half her Hit Points, Tiamat is immune to any effect that would incapacitate her, and can move through any barrier or structure without slowing, destroying it.

traits.name: Invincible Avatar
traits.description: If Tiamat fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. If she does, she regains two fewer legendary actions on her following turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Tiamat can cast up to two different spells, each of which she can replace with two melee attacks.

actions.name: Artyevorel, Staff of Nemesis
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, plus one additional effect: Breath's Whorl. The attack deals an additional 10 (3d6) damage of a type that Tiamat has not chosen since the beginning of her last turn (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison). Titan's Might. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or take an additional 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away. Retribution Divine. The target is Cursed; if the creature dies while Cursed in this way, it cannot be resurrected unless 10,000 gp worth of treasure is sacrificed to Tiamat as part of the spell to do so.

actions.name: Wyrmwing's Howl (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: A thunderous wind descends around Tiamat, forcing each creature within 15 feet of her to succeed on a DC 23 Strength Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Then, Tiamat can fly up to 60 feet.

actions.name: Terrible Majesty (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Tiamat's eyes flash with dread, implacable fury. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn) and fall prone. Creatures Frightened in this way can't stand.

actions.name: Cold-Iron Shock (1/Round, Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Tiamat touches a metal object and cold radiates through it, forcing one creature wearing or wielding that object to succeed on a DC 23 Constitution Saving Throw or take 45 (10d8) Cold damage, or half as much on a success. If the object was a nonmagical weapon, shield, or suit of armor, it cracks and shatters, becoming unusable.

actions.name: Blood to Vitriol (1/Round, Level 6 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Tiamat raises her staff toward a creature she can see within 60 feet and its wounds begin to blacken as its blood turns to acid, forcing it to succeed on a DC 23 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned for 1 minute. A Stunned creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 22 (5d8) Acid damage on a failure, or ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Dragonfire Purification (1/Round, Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: White-hot flames engulf a target Tiamat can see within 60 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 48 (8d6 + 20) Fire damage and have Tiamat end each spell effect of 5th level or below that is affecting it or that the target is Concentrating on.

actions.name: Death-Fume Globe (1/Round, Level 7 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A globe of force envelops a Huge or smaller creature Tiamat can see within 60 feet and begins to fill with sickening fumes. At the beginning of each of its turns, the creature must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) poison damage and be Poisoned until the start of its next turn, or take half as much damage on a success. The globe moves with the target, preventing anything from moving in or out; it can be damaged and destroyed (AC 20, 100 HP, immunity to psychic and poison damage, vulnerability to Force damage).

actions.name: Skyhammer Bolt (1/Round, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: A bolt from the blue rockets downward, forcing a creature Tiamat can see to succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 77 (14d10) Lightning damage, or half as much on a success. A flying creature that fails this saving throw is immediately pushed up to 500 feet downward; if it collides with a solid surface, it takes damage as though it had fallen.

legendaryActions.name: Windborne Strike
legendaryActions.description: Tiamat moves up to her speed in a straight line, then can make an attack with Artyevorel, Staff of Nemesis.

legendaryActions.name: Dragonmaw (Level 3 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: A spectral dragon's head appears to snap at a creature Tiamat can see within 30 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) damage (Tiamat's choice of acid, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, or poison).

legendaryActions.name: Chromatic Potency (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Tiamat uses her Cold-Iron Shock, Blood to Vitriol, Dragonfire Purification, Skyhammer Bolt, or Death-Fume Globe.

name: Tiamat, the Godheads Manifest
savingThrows: Str +19, Dex +9, Con +19, Int +8, Wis +17, Cha +9
immunities: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Sources; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Exalted Ward
traits.description: While she has more than half her Hit Points, Tiamat is immune to any effect that would incapacitate her, and can move through any barrier or structure without slowing, destroying it.

traits.name: Fivefold Titan
traits.description: Attacks made against Tiamat by a creature Attached to her have Advantage, and Tiamat has Disadvantage on attacks she makes against creatures Attached to her. While she is Bloodied, a creature that scores a critical hit against her while Attached to or grappled by her can force her to succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw with DC equal to the damage dealt or lose a head. Tiamat takes one fewer legendary action each round for each head she is missing, and the attacker can choose one damage type, removing her ability to choose that type when using her Paragon Breath or Fivefold Maw.

traits.name: Invincible Avatar
traits.description: If Tiamat fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. If she does, she regains two fewer legendary actions on her following turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Tiamat uses her Apocalyptic Presence and makes five attacks, one of which she can replace with a use of her Earthquake Stomp or Demolishing Sweep.

actions.name: Fivefold Maw
actions.description: Attack: +19 reach 20 ft. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) piercing damage and Tiamat can either deal an additional 7 (2d6) damage (her choice of acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison), or grapple the target with one of her heads (escape DC 27).

actions.name: Sovereign Barb
actions.description: Tiamat spears her tail barb into a dragon she can see within 30 feet; the target takes 20 Piercing damage, then must succeed on a DC 27 Constitution Saving Throw or die.

actions.name: Earthquake Stomp
actions.description: Tiamat moves up to 15 feet, then one creature whose space she entered in this way must succeed on a DC 27 Dexterity or Strength Saving Throw (target's choice) or take 33 (6d10) Bludgeoning damage, fall prone and be restrained (escape DC 27) until Tiamat moves.

actions.name: Demolishing Sweep
actions.description: Tiamat sweeps her tail at a creature she can see within 30 feet, pushing it up to 20 feet away and forcing it to succeed on a DC 27 Strength Saving Throw or take 27 (4d8 + 10) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half as much on a success. Each other creature within 20 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take half as much damage, be pushed back 10 feet and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Rip to Shreds
actions.description: One creature grappled by at least two of Tiamat's heads must succeed on a DC 27 Constitution throw or take 110 (20d10) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points due to failing this saving throw is ripped into pieces and dies.

actions.name: Apocalyptic Presence
actions.description: Each creature of Tiamat's choice within 300 feet of her must succeed on a DC 27 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Psychic damage and be Turned until the beginning of her next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

actions.name: Paragon Breath (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: One of Tiamat's heads exhales a gout of elemental energy (her choice of acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison) in a 300-foot long, 15-foot wide line. Each creature in the area must make a DC 27 Dexterity or Constitution Saving Throw (target's choice), taking 85 (10d6 + 50) damage on a failed save. A creature takes no damage on a successful Dexterity Saving Throw, or half as much damage on a successful Constitution Saving Throw.

legendaryActions.name: Chromatic Assault
legendaryActions.description: Tiamat makes a Fivefold Maw attack or uses her Earthquake Stomp.

legendaryActions.name: Paragon Breath
legendaryActions.description: Tiamat uses her Paragon Breath, if available, choosing a damage type she hasn't chosen since the beginning of her last turn. If it isn't available, she can instead roll to recharge it.

legendaryActions.name: Rip to Shreds (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Tiamat uses her Rip to Shreds.

legendaryActions.name: Chromatic Mastery (Recharges when Tiamat is Bloodied, Level 10 Spell, Costs 4 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Tiamat casts up to 5 different spells listed on her Tiamat, Exalted Queen stat block, using her own Spell Save DC. If two or more of these spells require Concentration, she can Concentrate on each of them as though they were a single spell.

name: Vecna, the Arch-Lich
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +11, Con +12, Int +14, Wis +15, Cha +11
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Turned; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Vilespeech Casting
traits.description: Whenever Vecna casts a spell, each other creature in a 15-foot Emanation that can hear him takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Perfected Mind
traits.description: If Vecna fails a saving throw while Concentrating, he can stop Concentrating to succeed instead. At the end of each of his turns, Vecna can end one Condition affecting him or destroy a barrier containing him.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Vecna makes two attacks with his Unhallowed Touch or Serpent's Whisper, one of which he can replace with a use of his Wrest Secrets.

actions.name: Unhallowed Touch (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 5 ft. Hit: 42 (4d10 + 20) necrotic damage. If the target is wielding a holy symbol, it can choose to either take an additional 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage or have the holy symbol crumble to dust.

actions.name: Serpent's Whisper (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +14 range 30 ft. Hit: 35 (10d6) psychic damage and Vecna can force the target to move up to 15 feet or make a weapon attack under his control.

actions.name: Wrest Secrets (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description:
One creature Vecna can see within 60 feet must make an Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: 42 (12d6) Psychic damage plus one of the following effects: Vecna can end one spell effect affecting the target. Vecna learns the target's two weakest saving throws. Vecna gains Advantage on the next saving throw he makes in the next minute against an ability the target controls. The target has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against Vecna until the end of its next turn.

A creature keeping any significant secret from its closest allies has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Price of Knowledge (Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Vecna can see within 60 feet can choose to unprepare up to three of its prepared spells, then takes 4 (1d8) Psychic damage per spell it has prepared.

actions.name: Ashen Silence (Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Vecna can see within 60 feet begins Suffocating. At the end of each of its turns, the target takes 27 (5d10) Fire plus 27 (5d10) Necrotic damage, then makes a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 22. Success: The effect ends. A creature that would be killed while under the effect of this spell is instead Petrified with 0 Hit Points, and disintegrates if it takes any damage from another source.

bonusActions.name: Dweomer-Rot (Level 6 Spell)
bonusActions.description: One creature Vecna can see within 60 feet that is either Concentrating on a spell or that is the target of a spell being Concentrated on takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage per level of the spell.

bonusActions.name: Drag to the Netherworld
bonusActions.description: One corpse or creature with 0 Hit Points within 60 feet must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: The creature dies and its body disappears to a hidden demiplane.

reactions.name: Still Ichor (Level 5 Spell)
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature hits Vecna with a melee attack. Response: The creature must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: The creature is Frightened and Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Infinite Abhorrence (Level 9 Spell)
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature Vecna can see within 60 feet casts a spell of Level 1 or above. Response: The creature loses the ability to cast that spell until cured with a Wish spell or similar magic.

legendaryActions.name: Vile Stride
legendaryActions.description: Vecna teleports to an unoccupied space within 30 feet and can use his Serpent's Whisper.

legendaryActions.name: Withering Glare (Concentration)
legendaryActions.description: Vecna fixes his eye upon a creature he can see within 120 feet, giving it Disadvantage on all d20 Tests that use Strength or Dexterity. At the start of each of its turns, the creature takes 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage and ages 10% of its natural lifespan until cured by Greater Restoration.

legendaryActions.name: Coerced Return (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Vecna raises the last creature affected by his Drag to the Netherworld to undeath in his service, conjuring it to an unoccupied space within 60 feet. The creature's type becomes Undead and it gains Vulnerability to Radiant damage, otherwise retaining its own statistics.
