name: Animated Feather Duster
savingThrows: Str -2, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the duster is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the duster remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal feather duster.

actions.name: Handle Bash
actions.description: Attack: +2 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Insistent Tickle
actions.description: The duster tickles a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or lose concentration, if it was holding it, and make a melee attack against a random creature in its reach.

reactions.name: Stuff Face
reactions.description: When a creature within 5 feet of the duster casts a spell, the duster can force it to succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or begin Choking until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more has its spell fail, additionally.

name: Animated Pillow
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex -2, Con +1, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the pillow is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the pillow remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal pillow.

traits.name: Feather Burst
traits.description: When the pillow is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it explodes in a shower of feathers, heavily obscuring the area in a 5-foot radius until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Cushioned Collision
actions.description: Attack: +0 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target is pushed up to 5 feet away.

actions.name: Smothering Clutch
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 8 Strength Saving Throw or have the pillow become Attached to it (remove DC 8, Save Ends at end of turn). A creature the pillow is Attached to has resistance to Bludgeoning damage, is Blinded, and is Choking.

name: Animated Book
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex +1, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the book is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the book remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal book.

actions.name: Heavy Thwack
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Release Spell
actions.description: The book releases a spell trapped in its pages, choosing new targets for it and using its own spellcasting ability (Spell Attack Bonus +2, Spell Save DC 10).

reactions.name: Trap Spell (Recharges when the book uses its Release Spell)
reactions.description: When the book is targeted with a spell of 1st level or below, it can make a Constitution Saving Throw against the spell caster's Save DC. On a success, the spell is negated and trapped within the book's pages, and the book takes 1 Force damage at the beginning of each of its turns until it uses its Release Spell.

name: Animated Broom
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the broom is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the broom remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal broom.

actions.name: Bristled Bash
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Sweep Leg
actions.description: The broom forces one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Dust Up
actions.description: The broom furiously sweeps a dust-covered surface within 5 feet, kicking up a thick cloud in a 5-foot radius that Lightly Obscures the area and lasts for a minute, or until cleared by a strong breeze.

reactions.name: Splintry Snap
reactions.description: When the broom is hit with a melee attack, it can allow that attack to score a critical. If it does, the broom snaps in half, splitting into two Animated Brooms that each have Hit Points equal to half the original broom's, act on its initiative, and can't use this reaction or regain Hit Points.

name: Animated Kettle
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +1, Con +1, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Fire, Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the kettle is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the kettle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal kettle.

actions.name: Heavy Crash
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage, plus an additional 1 Fire damage for each remaining use of its Scalding Splash.

actions.name: Screaming Whistle
actions.description: The kettle produces an ear-splitting whistle, forcing each creature within 30 feet that can hear it to succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or be Deafened and lose concentration, if it was holding it.

reactions.name: Scalding Splash (3/Day)
reactions.description: When the kettle takes any non-Cold damage, it can fling boiling water toward a creature within 5 feet, dealing 2 (1d4) Fire damage to it. The teapot regains all uses of this ability whenever it takes any Fire damage.

name: Animated Candelabrum
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +3, Con +1, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the candelabrum is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the candelabrum remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal candelabrum.

traits.name: Snuff Out
traits.description: If the candelabrum is subjected to strong wind, doused in water, or a creature blows on it as a bonus action, the candelabrum must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or have its flames extinguished. Until it hits a target with its Sconce Flare, the candelabrum's attacks have Disadvantage and it can't use its Set Flame.

actions.name: Sconce Flare
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) fire damage. A Blinded, Incapacitated, or Surprised creature hit with this attack begins Burning (1d10, Save Ends at end of turn)

actions.name: Fling Wax
actions.description: Attack: +5 range 30 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) fire damage.

actions.name: Set Flame
actions.description: The candelabrum sets a space within 5 feet of it aflame for the next minute. A creature that starts its turn in the space or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Animated Clothing Iron
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the iron is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the iron remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal iron.

traits.name: Steam Off
traits.description: If the iron takes any Cold damage while its Heat Up is active, it exudes a cloud of steam in a 5-foot radius, Heavily Obscuring the area until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Flatiron Smash
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is not wearing armor, the iron can become Attached to it (remove DC 12).

reactions.name: Heat Up
reactions.description: If the iron would take any Fire damage, it can reduce that damage to 0 and begin to glow a dull red, gaining the following effects for the next minute, or until it takes any Cold damage: The iron's attacks deal an additional 3 (1d6) Fire damage. A creature that grapples the iron or hits it with an unarmed attack takes 3 (1d6) Fire damage. A creature that starts its turn grappling the iron or with the iron Attached to it takes 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

name: Flying Sword
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +4, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the sword is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the sword remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal sword.

actions.name: Drill-Thrust
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical on a 19-20.

actions.name: Twirling Flourish
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must make a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or have one object it is wielding flung up to 15 feet away.

actions.name: Whirligig Rush
actions.description: The sword begins to spin wildly and moves up to half its speed. Attacks of opportunity provoked by this movement have Disadvantage. Until the start of its next turn, a creature that misses the sword with a melee attack takes 4 (1d8) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The sword adds +2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it.

name: Animated Armor
savingThrows: Str +2, Con +1, Int -5, Wis -4, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the armor is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the armor remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.

traits.name: Clattering Collapse
traits.description: When the armor takes or deals a critical hit, it falls prone in a heap and is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The armor makes two attacks with its Lurching Slam.

actions.name: Lurching Slam
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the armor can grapple the target (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Twist Limbs
actions.description: One creature that is wearing or grappled by the armor must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage and be restrained until the end of its next turn.

name: Animated Door
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +3, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the door is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the door remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal door.

traits.name: Hinged Prison
traits.description: The door is ordinarily affixed to a doorway, and cannot move or be moved from its space. At the beginning of any turn when the door does not have all of its Hit Points, it can make a DC 10 Strength Saving Throw, freeing itself on a success.

actions.name: Sudden Slam
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, plus one additional effect: The target is Restrained (escape DC 13) until the door moves or makes another attack. The target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Hardwood Endurance
actions.description: The door braces itself, gaining resistance to damage from ranged weapon attacks until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Knock Back
reactions.description: When a creature hits the door with a melee attack while the door is affixed to a doorway, the door can make a Sudden Slam attack against it.

reactions.name: Knob Shock (1/Day)
reactions.description: When a creature attempts to open or unlock the door, the door can force it to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Lightning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

name: Animated Portrait
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the portrait is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the portrait remains silent and motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal portrait.

traits.name: Whispering Walls
traits.description: The portrait can hear each other animated portrait in the same building as though it was within 5 feet of them.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The portrait makes two attacks with its Spinning Frame Strike, one of which it can replace with its Inchoate Shriek.

actions.name: Spinning Frame Strike
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft., one target that isn't restrained by the portrait. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the portrait has a creature restrained with its Sacrificial Embrace, the restrained creature is Dazed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Inchoate Shriek
actions.description: One creature within 15 feet that can hear the portrait must make a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature is Frightened until the end of the portrait's next turn. While the creature is Frightened in this way, the portrait's attacks against it have Advantage.

actions.name: Sacrificial Embrace
actions.description: The portrait attempts to impale itself upon a creature within 5 feet, forcing the target to make a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage and is Restrained (escape DC 12), and the portrait takes an equal amount of Piercing damage. The portrait maintains this restraint even if it is incapacitated or killed.

name: Animated Trophy Head
savingThrows: Str +2, Con +1, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the head is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the head remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal trophy head.

traits.name: Unguarded Rear
traits.description: Whenever the head makes a melee attack, up to one creature within 5 feet other than its target may use its reaction to make an Opportunity Attack against the head.

actions.name: Snarling Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage. The head can make this attack as a Bonus Action against a prone target.

actions.name: Toppling Assault (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The head moves up to its fly speed, then plunges downward, forcing up to one creature whose space it lands in to make a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, the target takes 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone, and the head takes no damage. On a success, the target moves to the nearest unoccupied space and the head takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage.

name: Animated Coat Rack
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the rack is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the rack remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal coat rack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The coat rack makes four attacks with its Oakhook Chain-Punch, one of which it can replace with a use of its Coat Call.

actions.name: Oakhook Chain-Punch
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit with three or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Coat Call
actions.description: The rack regains an expended use of its Coatflare Whirl, then each creature within 30 feet that is wearing a coat, cloak, hat, or mantle must make a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, one such item the creature is wearing flies to the rack and becomes Attached to it (remove DC 12).

actions.name: Coatflare Whirl (1/Day)
actions.description: The rack spins, flinging clinging hats and cloaks at up to four creatures within 10 feet of it and forcing. Each target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or be Blinded (Save Ends at beginning of turn). This effect ends early if the rack uses its Coat Call.

reactions.name: Base Trip
reactions.description: When a creature leaves the rack's reach, it can force the creature to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone.

name: Animated Cupboard
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +2, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the cupboard is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the cupboard remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cupboard.

traits.name: Delicate Contents
traits.description: If the cupboard is knocked prone, it takes 9 (2d8) Slashing damage and makes 1 fewer attack with its multiattack until it regains all of its Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cupboard makes three attacks with its Fling Porcelain, one of which it can replace with a use of its Scraping Slide.

actions.name: Fling Porcelain
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 30/60 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. On a miss, the target takes 1 Slashing damage.

actions.name: Scraping Slide
actions.description: The cupboard moves up to 15 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature in this way. Each creature whose space it enters in this way must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or take 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away. On a success, a target takes half as much damage the cupboard's movement ends.

name: Animated Grandfather Clock
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +3, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the clock is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the clock remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal clock.

traits.name: Cog Jam
traits.description: A creature Swallowed by the clock can attempt to jam its gears with a successful DC 10 Dexterity (Thieves' Tools) check, Stunning it until the end of the clock's next turn on a success.

actions.name: Pendulum Slice
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft., one target Swallowed by the clock. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage. On a miss, the clock can make a second attack with this weapon against the same target.

actions.name: Crushing Leap
actions.description: The clock jumps up to 10 feet, and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each creature whose space it lands in must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage, be knocked prone, and be restrained (escape DC 13) until the clock moves. On a success, a target takes half as much damage and is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

reactions.name: Open Wide
reactions.description: When a Medium or smaller creature misses the clock with a melee attack, the clock can force it to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or be Swallowed by the clock (escape DC 16).

name: Rug of Smothering
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Int -5, Wis -4, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the rug remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal rug.

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the rug is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.description: While it is grappling a creature, the rug takes only half the damage dealt to it by creatures it is not grappling, and the creature grappled by the rug takes the other half.

actions.name: Smothering Wrap
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The target is Grappled (escape DC 13). While grappled in this way, the target is Blinded and Choking. If the rug has fewer than 28 Hit Points, the creature can attempt to escape this grapple as a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Wild Thrash
actions.description: The rug thrashes wildly, lurching 15 feet in a random direction. Then, the rug and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Rug Pull
reactions.description: When initiative is rolled, the rug can force each creature that is standing on it to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone and reroll its initiative, taking the lower of the two rolls.

name: Swarm of Animated Cutlery
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, it can move through any opening large enough for a piece of cutlery, and it can't regain Hit Points.

traits.name: Animated Swarm
traits.description: If the swarm is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it loses half its current Hit Points.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the swarm remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal set of cutlery.

actions.name: Clattering Assault
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 0 ft. Hit: Hit Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage, or Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its Hit Points or fewer.

bonusActions.name: Cutlery Call
bonusActions.description: The swarm targets a creature it can see within 30 feet that is carrying a dagger. Each dagger the creature is carrying leaps into motion and joins the swarm, and the swarm regains 5 Hit Points for each dagger that joined it in this way. A creature wielding an affected dagger can make a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw, preventing that dagger from animating on a success.

name: Animated Cauldron
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the cauldron is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the cauldron remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cauldron.

traits.name: Boiling Brew
traits.description:
The cauldron gains 1 level of heat whenever it takes any Fire damage, to a maximum of 4, gaining the following cumulative effects.
 1. Quivering. The cauldron's attacks deal an additional 3 (1d6) Fire damage for each level of heat it has.
 2. Simmering. The cauldron can use its Fire Up as a Bonus Action.
 3. Rolling. The cauldron's fly speed is increased by 5 feet for each level of heat it has.
 4. Superheated. Any attack that hits the cauldron becomes a critical.

actions.name: Blistering Bash
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Up
actions.description: The cauldron's Boiling Brew grows 1 level hotter.

reactions.name: Scalding Slosh (Simmering or hotter)
reactions.description: When the cauldron is hit with a melee attack, it can force one creature within 5 feet other than the attacker to make a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failure, the target takes 3 (1d6) Fire damage for each level of heat the cauldron has.

name: Animated Chandelier
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +2, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the chandelier is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the chandelier remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal chandelier.

traits.name: Mooring Chain
traits.description: A 40-foot long chain dangles beneath the chandelier. A creature grasping the chain is considered Attached to the chandelier, and can spend half its movement to make a contested Strength (Athletics) check, dragging the chandelier up to 30 feet toward it on a success.

actions.name: Crystal Shard Volley
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 40 ft. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) piercing damage. On a miss, the chandelier can make a second attack against a creature directly behind the first target.

actions.name: Chain Fling
actions.description: One creature that is grasping the chandelier's Mooring Chain must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage and be flung up to 30 feet.

reactions.name: Crystalline Drop
reactions.description: When a creature enters a space directly beneath the chandelier, the chandelier can crash down onto it, forcing each creature whose space it lands in to make a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet the chandelier fell and is knocked prone, and the chandelier takes no damage from falling. On a success, a creature moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

name: Animated Wardrobe
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +4, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the wardrobe is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the wardrobe remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal wardrobe.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wardrobe makes two attacks with its Questing-Garment Grasp.

actions.name: Questing-Garment Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). A target already grappled by the wardrobe that is hit with this attack must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be Swallowed (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Wardrobe Change
actions.description: One creature Swallowed by the wardrobe takes 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage, then must make a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, the wardrobe removes any armor or clothing the creature is wearing and replaces it with a different set of clothing, then expels the creature.

name: Animated Bed
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +1, Con +7, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the bed is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the bed remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal bed.

traits.name: Inviting Form
traits.description: Medium or smaller creatures can freely enter and move through the bed's space.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bed makes three attacks with its Curtain Tendril, one of which it can replace with a use of its Headboard Smash or Swallow Sleeper.

actions.name: Curtain Tendril
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 15 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is dragged up to 5 feet toward the bed.

actions.name: Headboard Smash
actions.description: Each other creature in the bed's space must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally Dazed until the end of the bed's next turn.

actions.name: Swallow Sleeper
actions.description: One Dazed or Incapacitated creature that is grappled by the bed is drawn into its mattress and Swallowed (escape DC 15). The Swallowed creature takes 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of the bed's turns.

reactions.name: Shin Scoop
reactions.description: When a creature enters a space within 5 feet of the bed, the bed can force it to succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or tumble onto the bed and be grappled (escape DC 15).

name: Animated Cookstove
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +5, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Fire, Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the cookstove is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the cookstove remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cookstove.

traits.name: Iron Arsenal
traits.description: At the beginning of each of the cookstove's turns, its flung cookware returns to it. A creature grasping a piece of cookware can make a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw to prevent its return, reducing the number of attacks the cookstove can make with its Multiattack this turn by one on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cookstove makes three attacks with its Hurl Cookware, one of which it can replace with a use of its Burner Flare.

actions.name: Hurl Cookware
actions.description: Attack: +7 range 30 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the cookstove used its Burner Flare this turn, this attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Burner Flare
actions.description: The cookstove's burners roar with flame, forcing each creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

bonusActions.name: Blackiron Scoot
bonusActions.description: The cookstove moves up to 5 feet, and can enter the space of any Medium or smaller creature with this movement, pushing it 5 feet directly away. A creature that would be pushed into a solid surface in this way instead takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage and is Restrained (escape DC 15) until the cookstove moves.

name: Oversized Rug of Smothering
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -5, Wis -4, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the rug remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal rug.

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the rug is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.description: While it is grappling one or more creatures, the rug takes only half the damage dealt to it by creatures it is not grappling, and one creature grappled by the rug takes the other half.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rug makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Wild Thrash.

actions.name: Smothering Slam
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). While grappled in this way, the target is Blinded and Choking. If the rug has fewer than 42 Hit Points, the creature can attempt to escape this grapple as a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Wild Thrash
actions.description: The rug thrashes wildly, lurching 15 feet in a random direction. Then, the rug and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Rug Pull
reactions.description: When initiative is rolled, the rug can force each creature that is standing on it to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone and reroll its initiative, taking the lower of the two rolls.

name: Animated Carriage
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +3, Con +5, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Animated Object
traits.description: If the carriage is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as Dispel Magic, it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the carriage remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal carriage.

traits.name: Selective Passage
traits.description: When a creature attempts to exit the carriage, the carriage can force it to succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or suffer one of the following effects: The creature is Grappled (escape DC 16) until the start of its next turn. The creature is pushed up to 15 feet away.

actions.name: Collect Passenger
actions.description: The carriage lurches to grasp a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be drawn into the carriage.

actions.name: Doomride Rush
actions.description: The carriage moves up to its speed in a straight line, and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. Each creature whose space the carriage enters in this way must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reactions.name: Spiteful Crash
reactions.description: When the carriage moves within 5 feet of a wall or similar solid, vertical surface, it can take 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet it moved directly toward that surface this turn. If it does, each creature in the carriage must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take an equal amount of damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Cadaver Collector Headcounter
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -1
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Spiked Armor
traits.description: A Medium or larger creature that grapples, shoves, or hits the cadaver collector with an unarmed attack or natural weapon takes 1d4 Piercing damage.

actions.name: Flesh Snips
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. Any hit with this attack against a grappled or incapacitated creature becomes a critical.

actions.name: Spikeroll Charge
actions.description: The cadaver collector uses any amount of its remaining movement to run in a straight line, then curls into a ball and rolls for an equal distance. If the cadaver collector's roll would collide a creature, the creature makes a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success, or taking 14 (4d6) Piercing damage and stopping the cadaver collector's roll on a failure.

reactions.name: Battlespike Caltrop
reactions.description: When a Medium or larger creature enters the cadaver collector's space, it can force the creature to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 5 (2d4) Piercing damage and fall prone.

name: Cadaver Collector Goreclad
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +4, Int -3, Cha -1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks That Aren't Adamantine
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Subdual Emission
traits.description: If the cadaver collector ends its turn without moving, it vents an invisible, paralytic gas in a cloud that extends 5 feet around it and disperses at the start of its next turn. A creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Paralyzed until the start of its next turn. This gas explodes if any Fire damage is dealt to a creature in the area, dealing 10 (3d6) Fire damage to each creature in the area.

traits.name: Limited Magic Resistance
traits.description: The cadaver collector has Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects that do not deal acid or Thunder damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cadaver collector makes two attacks with its Spiked Slam, one of which it may replace with a use of its Claim Limb.

actions.name: Spiked Slam
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). This attack deals an additional 7 (2d6) Piercing damage to a creature grappled by the cadaver collector.

actions.name: Claim Limb
actions.description: The cadaver collector attempts to twist a limb off a grappled or Paralyzed creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more loses the limb.

name: Cadaver Collector Wargrave
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +10, Int -3, Cha -1
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks That Aren't Adamantine; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
languages: Understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Armor of the Fallen
traits.description: The cadaver collector's natural armor is augmented by the numerous shields and breastplates cemented to it with gore. While the Cadaver Collector's AC is 20, it has resistance to magical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. Whenever the cadaver collector takes Acid or Thunder damage, its AC is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 16

traits.name: Subdual Emission
traits.description: If the cadaver collector ends its turn without moving, it vents an invisible, paralytic gas in a cloud that extends 15 feet around it and disperses at the start of its next turn. A creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be Paralyzed until the start of its next turn. This gas explodes if any Fire damage is dealt to a creature in the area, dealing 10 (3d6) Fire damage to each creature in the area.

traits.name: Limited Magic Resistance
traits.description: The cadaver collector has Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects that do not deal acid or Thunder damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cadaver collector makes two attacks with its Goresteel Grasp, one of which it may replace with a use of its Claim Limb.

actions.name: Goresteel Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 16 (3d10) necrotic damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Claim Limb
actions.description: The cadaver collector attempts to twist a limb off a grappled or Paralyzed creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much damage on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more loses the limb. If the limb was wielding a shield or clad in Heavy Armor, the cadaver collector's AC increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

actions.name: Collect Corpse
actions.description: The cadaver collector attempts to impale a grappled or Paralyzed creature or corpse within 5 feet on one of its back spikes. The creature must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or take 65 (10d12) Piercing damage and be restrained (escape DC 18). A creature restrained in this way takes 13 (2d12) Piercing damage whenever it takes an action.

reactions.name: Spell Turning
reactions.description: When the cadaver collector succeeds on a saving throw against a spell of 7th level or lower that targets only it, it avoids all effects from the spell and instead causes the spell to target the caster.

reactions.name: Haunts of the Torment-Engine (1/Day, Concentration)
reactions.description: When the cadaver collector is reduced below 121 Hit Points, it becomes wreathed in deathly energies. For the next minute, at the beginning of each of the cadaver collector's turns a Sword Wraith Warrior that acts on initiative count 0 emerges from it into the nearest unoccupied space. The sword wraiths dissipate after 1 minute, and become hostile to the cadaver collector if it loses concentration on this ability.

name: Clockwork Caretaker
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +3, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Electricity Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the caretaker is subjected to electricity damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the electricity damage dealt.

traits.name: Nonslip
traits.description: The caretaker has Advantage on saving throws that would force it to move or knock it prone.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The caretaker's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Oil Spray
actions.description: Slick oil covers the ground in a 30-foot cone and turns it into difficult terrain until cleared. When the oil appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there must also succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Adhesive Spray
actions.description: Sticky gunk covers the ground in a 30-foot cone and turns it into difficult terrain. When the gunk appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Pressure Wash
actions.description: High pressure water blasts in a 30-foot line, dousing any flames in its path. A creature in the path must succeed on a DC13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet away on a failure, or suffer half damage on a success.

name: Golden Vessel Dross
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -1, Con +1, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -5
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Soul Imprint
traits.description: If the vessel takes any Psychic damage, each non-minion golden vessel within 15 feet of it takes the same damage.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the vessel takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the vessel takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Decrepit Assault (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Bludgeoning damage. If three or more dross contributed to this attack, the target takes an additional 5 Slashing damage and one of the dross dies.

actions.name: Part Out
actions.description: The vessel tears itself apart and dies, donating its still-functional parts to its allies. Up to two non-minion golden vessels within 5 feet can each use their reaction to regain 5 Hit Points.

name: Golden Vessel Palimpsest
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -3
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Soul Vessel
traits.description: A living creature killed within 30 feet of one or more Golden Vessel Palimpsests must make a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature's spirit Possesses one of them at random. The possessed vessel becomes a Golden Vessel Cloister for as long as it remains Possessed, retaining its current Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vessel makes two attacks with its Gilded Fist.

actions.name: Gilded Strike
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target is pushed 5 feet away and knocked prone.

actions.name: Air Lens (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: The vessel manipulates a source of bright light it can see within 60 feet, briefly condensing its radiance into a 15-foot long, 5-foot wide beam that extends from it. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) radiant damage and be Blinded until the start of its next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

bonusActions.name: Heavy Leap

actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Osseous Grasp
actions.description: The golem leaps up to 20 feet and may move into the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each creature whose space the golem lands in must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.description: Each creature grappled by the golem must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or gain 11 (2d10) cumulative Temporary Hit Points as plates of bone begin to grow over its skin. reactions.description: When the golem takes 20 or more damage from a single source, it can make an attack with its Bone Spur Strike, afterwards making one fewer attack whenever it uses its multiattack.

traits.name: Snuff Out
traits.description: The golem is covered in candles, which it can ignite when it rolls Initiative and which are extinguished if it takes any Cold damage.

traits.name: Golemcraft Ward (2/Day)

Failure: 10 (3d6) Piercing damage, plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage if the golem's candles are lit, and the creature is pushed up to 10 feet. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Effigy Seal
actions.description: Wax flows over a creature Grappled by the golem and hardens, forcing it to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature is Restrained (escape DC 15). While Restrained in this way, the creature is Blinded and Suffocating. If the Restrained creature would die, it instead is Petrified. This restraint ends if the creature takes any Fire damage.

reactions.name: Reignite
reactions.description: Trigger: The golem becomes Bloodied or takes any Fire damage while its candles are extinguished. Response: The golem relights its candles and each creature within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity

traits.name: Words of the Creator

A creature that can read this language and can see the golem may use its reaction to halve one source of damage dealt by the golem this turn. A creature may use its action to write a word in the same language on the golem's surface. If the word describes an action, the golem must take that action on its following turn. If the word describes a condition, the golem must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom Saving Throw or be afflicted with that condition until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Grip of Clay

A creature grappled by the golem stays grappled by it in this form.

name: Snow Golem
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -2, Con +1, Int -5, Wis -2, Cha -5
immunities: Cold, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Refreeze
traits.description: If the golem takes any Fire damage, it loses its immunities to Cold damage and cantrips until the start of its next turn. If the golem takes any Cold damage, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or freeze solid and be Petrified.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The golem can't be affected or detected by cantrips unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two attacks, or takes the Dash action and uses its Snowslide.

actions.name: Ice-Packed Slam
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) cold damage. On a critical hit, the target has disadvantge on Dexterity Saving Throws until the end of the golem's next turn.

actions.name: Snowball
actions.description: Attack: +0 range 60 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Snowslide (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The snow golem falls prone in the space of a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet and ends its turn. The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or be engulfed and restrained (escape DC 12), or move to an adjacent space on a success. A creature restrained in this way can't speak or breathe, and must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw at the start of each of its turns or lose one unexpended hit die, or drop to 0 Hit Points if it cannot.

name: Stained Glass Golem
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +2, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Leadlight Blessing
traits.description: The golem emits Bright Light in a 15 ft. radius, and Dim Light for an additional 15 ft. If a living creature within the light would take half damage for succeeding on a saving throw against a spell, it instead takes no damage.

traits.name: Sharper When Shattered
traits.description: If the golem has fewer than 53 Hit Points, its attacks score a critical on an 18-20.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The golem can't be affected or detected by cantrips unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two razor edge attacks.

actions.name: Razor Edge
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage and the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of the targets turns, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or lose 4 (1d8) Hit Points, ending the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Keen
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking Slashing damage, the golem releases a terrible sound. Each creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the golem's next turn.

reactions.name: Shard Storm
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking bludgeoning or Thunder damage, golem flings shards of itself in every direction. Each creature within 15 ft. of the golem must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Stone Golem
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex -1, Con +5, Int -4, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks That Aren't Adamantine; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
languages: Understands The Languages Of Its Creator But Can't Speak

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The golem can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Brittle Body
traits.description: If the golem takes 20 or more Bludgeoning damage from a single source, it can no longer use its multiattack until it completes a short or long rest. If it takes 20 or more Bludgeoning damage from a single source a second time, it falls prone and cannot stand until it completes a short or long rest.

traits.name: Implacable Advance
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the golem may end all effects that would reduce its speed or incapacitate it. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

traits.name: Richochet
traits.description: A ranged weapon attack that misses the golem by 5 or more instead targets another creature within 15 ft., making a new attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit the same Large or smaller creature, the creature has its movement speed halved and is unable to make more than a single attack in a turn until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Crush
actions.description: One creature grappled by the golem must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 66 (12d10) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this damage has its skull crushed.

reactions.name: Hurl
reactions.description:
As a reaction to being damaged by a creature it is grappling, the golem hurls the creature up to 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage on be knocked prone, or half as much on a success. If the target is
thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

name: Tombstone Golem
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex -1, Con +4, Int -4
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks That Aren't Adamantine; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the golem may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the golem. While climbing on the gome, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the golem, and the golem has Disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The golem can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the golem fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes three attacks with its Slab Slam, one of which it may replace with its Golem's Gravemark.

actions.name: Slab Slam
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone and unable to stand on its following turn.

actions.name: Golem's Gravemark
actions.description: One creature the golem can see must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed for the next minute. Whenever the golem hits a cursed creature with a melee attack, the creature takes an additional 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Smash to Dust (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The golem throws itself prone onto a prone creature within 10 feet and ends its turn. If the creature has fewer than 100 Hit Points, it drops to 0 Hit Points and must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or immediately fail two death Saving Throws.

reactions.name: Stonecrack Epitaph
reactions.description: When the golem takes 30 or more damage from a single source, an ominous crack rings out from deep within the golem. Each living creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage.

name: Tome Golem
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +3, Con +4, Int -4, Wis +2, Cha -4
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Flammable
traits.description: If the golem takes any Fire damage, it begins Burning (1d10).

traits.name: Golemcraft Ward (3/Day)
traits.description: When the golem fails a saving throw that would alter its form or incapacitate it, it can choose to succeed instead. The golem adds +3 to its saving throws against spells and magical effects for each use of this ability it has remaining.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes three attacks and can use its Awaken Spellbook or Dweomer Flare.

actions.name: Codex Crush
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the golem is Burning, this attack deals an additional 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Awaken Spellbook
actions.description: The golem calls upon the stored magic of one spellbook within 30 feet, transforming it into an Animated Book that uses the golem's Attack Bonus (+10) for one hour.

actions.name: Dweomer Flare
actions.description: Raw magic bursts from the golem's pages; one randomly selected creature within 15 feet must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 16 (3d10) Force damage.

reactions.name: Archive Spell (Concentration)
reactions.description: Trigger: The golem is targeted with a spell of Level 3 or below. Response: The golem traps the spell, delaying its effects. At the start of the golem's next turn, it releases the spell, and can choose a new target within 30 feet for it.

name: Topiary Golem Ornamental
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -4, Cha -5
immunities: Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Hedgeblend
traits.description: The golem can move through hedges or other dense foliage without impediment, and can occupy their space.

traits.name: Golemcraft Ward (1/Day)
traits.description: When the golem fails a saving throw that would alter its form or incapacitate it, it can choose to succeed instead. The golem adds +3 to its saving throws against spells and magical effects for each use of this ability it has remaining.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two attacks with its Manicured Slash.

actions.name: Manicured Slash
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage. If the golem is Bloodied, this attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) Slashing damage on a hit.

bonusActions.name: Extend Roots
bonusActions.description: The golem drives its roots into the ground, becoming utterly immobile and gaining Tremorsense to a range of 90 feet until it ends this effect as a Bonus Action. While in this state, the golem is indistinguishable from an ordinary topiary.

name: Topiary Golem Mazewatch
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +3, Con +10, Int -3, Wis +4, Cha -5
immunities: Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Hedgeblend
traits.description: The golem can move through hedges or other dense foliage without impediment, and can occupy their space.

traits.name: Golemcraft Ward (2/Day)
traits.description: When the golem fails a saving throw that would alter its form or incapacitate it, it can choose to succeed instead. The golem adds +3 to its saving throws against spells and magical effects for each use of this ability it has remaining.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Custodian's Command or Bough Shelter, if available.

actions.name: Manicured Slash
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage. If the golem is Bloodied, this attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) Slashing damage on a hit.

actions.name: Thorn Dart
actions.description: Attack: +7 range 30/60 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Custodian's Command
actions.description: One allied Plant creature or Construct within 30 feet can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed or make an attack.

actions.name: Bough Shelter (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The golem or one Plant creature it can see within 30 feet gains 30 Temporary Hit Points a shield of boughs grows to envelop it, Restraining the target until the start of the target's next turn. If the target starts its turn with any of these Temporary Hit Points, it loses all of them and regains 30 Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Extend Roots
bonusActions.description: The golem drives its roots into the ground, becoming utterly immobile and gaining Tremorsense to a range of 90 feet until it ends this effect as a Bonus Action. While in this state, the golem is indistinguishable from an ordinary topiary.

legendaryActions.name: Rustling Rancor
legendaryActions.description: The topiary golem moves up to 10 feet, then can make one attack with its Manicured Slash or Thorn Dart.

legendaryActions.name: Growth Burst
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 5 feet of the golem must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: the creature is pushed up to 10 feet away.

legendaryActions.name: Sculpt Cutting (1/Day, Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The golem drags forth a Topiary Golem Ornamental from a Large or larger inanimate hedge or shrub within 5 feet that acts on its Initiative and under its control. After 1 minute, the created golem turns back into inanimate foliage.

name: Graven Colossus
savingThrows: Str +18, Con +10, Int -4, Wis +8, Cha +7
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Vessel of the Divine
traits.description: The colossus is animated directly by the will of a Power, attracting the attention of its rivals. Clerics within 500 feet of the colossus treat their Cleric Level as 5 levels higher for the purposes of Divine Intervention.

traits.name: Infinite Terror
traits.description: Creatures of the colossus' choice within 500 feet of it are Frightened. At the start of a Frightened creature's turn, it can take 5 (1d10) Psychic damage to ignore this effect until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Invulnerable Titan
traits.description: If the colossus would take 15 or fewer damage from a single source, it instead takes no damage. If the colossus would fail a saving throw, it can lose 25 Hit Points and succeed, instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The colossus uses its Gaze of the Divine twice, each of which it can replace with a use of its Ponderous Slam.

actions.name: Gaze of the Divine
actions.description: One creature the colossus can see within 300 feet takes 21 (6d6) Radiant damage plus 11 (2d10) Psychic damage. If the target is Frightened, it falls Prone.

actions.name: Ponderous Slam (Countdown 4)
actions.description: The colossus begins a titanic strike, choosing a 20-foot radius Sphere within 60 feet; start a Countdown at four, decreasing it by one whenever another creature ends its turn. If the colossus is already using its Ponderous Slam, it instead decreases the Countdown by 1. When the Countdown reaches 0, each creature in the area must make a Dexterity or Constitution Saving Throw: DC 26. Failure: 82 (4d20 + 40) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Annihilation Ray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The colossus' chest opens and a torrent of divine energy pours forth in a 300-foot long, 15-foot wide Line; each creature in the area must make a Dexterity or Constitution Saving Throw: DC 26. Failure: 96 (4d12 + 70) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage. Failure by 5 or More: If the creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage, it Disintegrates. While this ability is Recharging, the colossus can't take Legendary Actions and attacks against it have Advantage.

actions.name: Thunderous Edict (1/Day)
actions.description: The voice of a Power blares from the colossus in a 300-foot Emanation. Each creature of the colossus' choice in the area must make a ConstitutionSaving Throw: DC 26. Failure: 45 (10d8) Thunder damage. Failure by 5 or More: The creature is Stunned until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage.

legendaryActions.name: Ponderous Slam
legendaryActions.description: The colossus uses its Ponderous Slam.

legendaryActions.name: Brush Off
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 5 feet must make a Strength or Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 26. Failure: 26 (4d12) Bludgeoning damage and the creature is flung up to 30 feet away.

legendaryActions.name: Shockwave Stride
legendaryActions.description: The colossus moves up to 50 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then each creature in a 15-foot Emanation from it that isn't Attached to it is pushed up to 15 feet away.

name: Grisgol
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +4, Int -4
immunities: Poison, Psychic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks That Aren't Adamantine; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Final Curse
traits.description: A creature that reduces the grisgol to 0 Hit Points must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed. While cursed, a creature becomes obsessed with the idea that the wrappings of the grisgol to contain an important secret, if only they can be properly pieced together, and has its Intelligence score reduced by one each week until the curse is removed. If the grisgol takes 40 or more Fire damage from a single source, this trait ceases to function until the grisgol is repaired.

traits.name: Imprisoned Lich
traits.description: The grisgol is animated by life force drained form a defeated lich's phylactery, preventing the lich from returning to life. If the grisgol is defeated and the phylactery is not destroyed, the lich gains a new body in 1d10 days.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The grisgol has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The grisgol makes two attacks with its Wilting Touch.

actions.name: Wilting Touch
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 31 (5d10 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Vent Magic
actions.description: The grisgol vents raw weave in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 22 (5d8) Force damage and roll on the Wild Magic Table (PHB p. 103), or take half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Erratic Fireball (Level 5 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The grisgol chooses a direction, launching a fireball that explodes in a 20-foot radius centered on a point 35 (2d6*5) feet away from the grisgol. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 35 (10d6) Fire damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Mindwrack Binding (Level 8 Spell, 1/Day)
actions.description: Each creature of the grisgol's choice within 30 feet must succeed on DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Paralyzed until the end of the grisgol's next turn.

reactions.name: Containment Breach
reactions.description: When the grisgol succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can use its Vent Magic.

reactions.name: Mycotoxin Dust
reactions.description: When the grisgol is hit with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning or Slashing damage, the grisgol can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or contract Mind Fog.

name: Helmed Horror
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +3
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't adamantine
immunities: Force, Necrotic, Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The helmed horror can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The helmed horror makes two longsword attacks, one of which it may replace with a cleaving sweep if available.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Cleaving Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 5-foot radius must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Disarming Swipe
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature missing it with an attack, the helmed horror may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or drop its weapon and have it flung 15 feet in a random direction.

name: Homunculus
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex +2, Cha -2
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Telepathic Bond
traits.description: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.

traits.name: Unobtrusive
traits.description: The homunculus may attempt to hide as a bonus action when adjacent to two or more creatures that are one size larger than it.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is instead poisoned for 5 (1d10) minutes and unconscious while poisoned in this way.

name: Kolyarut
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +9, Wis +7, Cha +7
resistances: Necrotic, Radiant; and Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Dimensional Lock
traits.description: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the kolyarut. Any attempt to do so is wasted.

traits.name: Unyielding Form
traits.description: The kolyarut is immune to any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, or alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The kolyarut has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Implacable Tracker
traits.description: The kolyarut knows the distance to and direction of each creature whose contract or oath it is sworn to enforce, even if the creature and the kolyarut are on different planes of existence. If a creature being tracked by the kolyarut dies, the kolyarut knows.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The kolyarut makes two unerring clutch attacks, either of which it may replace with a use of its claim damages, if available.

actions.name: Unerring Clutch
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* automatic hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 Force damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15) and restrained.

actions.name: Exemplary Damages
actions.description: One creature grappled by the kolyarut must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw or permanently lose one hit die or its lowest level spell slot (kolyarut's choice). This can be recovered only through the use of a Wish spell or equivalent magic, or by appealing its case at one of the civil courts of Mechanicus.

actions.name: Curse of the Oathkeeper (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: One creature grappled by the kolyarut must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) radiant damage plus 18 (4d8) Psychic damage and be cursed to keep its oaths, suffering the following effects. The cursed creature cannot voluntarily renege on an oath or valid contract it is a party to. The cursed creature is branded an oathkeeper. A creature proficient in History or Arcana is aware of the cause and effects of the creature's curse.

actions.name: Curse of the Oathbreaker (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description:
One creature grappled by the kolyarut must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage plus 18 (4d8) Psychic damage and be cursed to be mistrusted, suffering the following effects. The cursed creature cannot voluntarily enter into oaths or contracts. The cursed creature has Disadvantage on Charisma checks made to declare its intent. The cursed creature is branded an oathbreaker. A creature proficient in History or Arcana is aware of the cause and effects of the creature's curse.
