name: Zelekhut
savingThrows: Str +11, Dex +2, Con +5, Int +2, Wis +9, Cha +3
resistances: Lightning; and Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Dimensional Lock
traits.description: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the zelekhut. Any attempt to do so is wasted. The zelekhut's own abilities are not subject to this trait.

traits.name: Unyielding Form
traits.description: The zelekhut is immune to any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, or alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The zelekhut has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Lawkeeper's Awareness
traits.description: The zelekhut knows what laws a creature it can see has broken.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zelekhut makes two chain attacks and uses its Subduing Shock.

actions.name: Spiked Chains
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* automatic hit, reach 20 ft. Hit: 27 (5d10) Slashing damage and the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 19). The zelekhut has two chains, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Subduing Shock
actions.description: Each creature grappled by the zelekhut must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) Lightning damage. This damage can't reduce the target's Hit Points below 1.

actions.name: Curse of Inevitable Justice (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the zelekhut can see within 120 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed with a mark of judgement, suffering the following effects: Any creature that can see the cursed creature knows what laws it has broken. If this curse is removed, another zelekhut is summoned in an unoccupied space within 60 ft.

actions.name: Justify (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: One creature grappled by the zelekhut and affected by its Curse of Inevitable Justice must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or be teleported to a teleportation circle in the Hall of Concordance in Sigil. A target fails automatically if it has 1 or fewer Hit Points. If the target is teleported in this way, the zelekhut teleports with it to the circle.

actions.name: Plane Shift (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: The zelekhut and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet teleport to another plane of existence.

name: Varakhut
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +2, Con +5, Int +10, Wis +10, Cha +12
resistances: Thunder; and Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Dimensional Lock
traits.description: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the varakhut. Any attempt to do so is wasted. The varakhut's own abilities are not subject to this trait.

traits.name: Unyielding Form
traits.description: The varakhut is immune to any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, or alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The varakhut has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Implacable Tracker
traits.description: The varakhut knows the distance to and direction of each creature that has exceeded its natural lifespan, even if the creature and the varakhut are on different planes of existence. If a creature being tracked by the varakhut dies, the varakhut knows.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The varakhut uses its disintegration ray twice, one of which it may replace with its disjunctive blast or curse of diminished ambition, if available.

actions.name: Disintegration Ray (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: One creature or object the varakhut can see within 60 ft. must make a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target takes 50 Force damage and each nonmagical item it is wearing or carrying turns to dust. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is also reduced to dust.

actions.name: Disjunctive Blast (Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: One creature or object the varakhut can see within 60 ft. must make a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, all spells of 8th level or below affecting the target end, and one magic item that the target is carrying (target's choice) becomes inert and nonmagical for the next minute.

actions.name: Purge Mind (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the varakhut can see within 60 ft. must make a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the varakhut removes one piece of knowledge related to process of ascending to divinity from the creature's mind.

actions.name: Curse of Diminished Ambition (Level 9 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature the varakhut can see within 120 ft. must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed to be barred from divinity, suffering the following effects: While a cursed creature is outside its home plane, it must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw at the beginning of each of its turns or be returned to its home plane. While a cursed creature is concentrating on a spell or ritual, it takes one Psychic damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

actions.name: Plane Shift (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: The Varakhut and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet teleport to another plane of existence.

traits.description: The marut knows the distance to and direction of each creature that has exceeded its natural lifespan, even if the creature and the marut are on different planes of existence. If a creature being tracked by the marut dies, the marut knows.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The marut makes three slam attacks, one of which it may replace with its Curse of Inevitable Death, if available.

actions.name: Unerring Slam
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* automatic hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 60 Force damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away. A creature that has legendary resistances loses one.

actions.description: One creature the marut can see within 120 ft. must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed to die, suffering the following effects: If a cursed creature is restored to life, it dies. If a cursed creature gains a new body, the new body is destroyed. If this curse is removed, another marut is summoned in an unoccupied space within 60 ft.

actions.name: Plane Shift (Level 7 Spell)

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.description: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the quarut. Any attempt to do so is wasted. If a creature within 60 ft. alters the flow of time for itself, either through Haste, Time Stop, Wish, or similar magic, the quarut is affected by the same magic.

traits.name: Unyielding Form
traits.description: The quarut is immune to any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, or alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The quarut has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Time Sense
traits.description: The quarut knows the distance to and direction of each creature that has traveled through time or circumvented the restrictions of the Wish spell, even if the creature and the quarut are on different planes of existence. If a creature being tracked by the quarut dies, the quarut knows.

actions.name: Slow Time Bubble (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: The quarut creates a permanent 30 ft. diameter bubble of slowed time. A creature that starts its turn in the bubble, or enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom Saving Throw or suffer the following effects until the end of its turn. The creature's movement speed is reduced by half. The creature cannot make more than a single attack on its turn. If the creature casts a spell, the spell doesn't take effect until the start of its following turn.

actions.name: Magics Undone
actions.description: The quarut ends each magical effect of the quarut's choice affecting one creature or object it can see within 60 ft.

actions.name: Stasis Lock (Level 9 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature in the quarut's slow time bubble must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom Saving Throw or be unaffected by the passage of time until the quarut releases it. A stasis locked creature is incpacitated and immune to all damage and the effects of aging, and does not need to eat, drink, breathe, or sleep.

actions.name: Temporal Purge (Level 9 Spell, 1/day)
actions.description: One creature affected by the Quarut's stasis lock must make a DC 23 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is removed from the flow of time. It ceases to exist and cannot be returned to life by any known magics, and the marks it left on the material plane fade and are forgotten.

actions.name: Curse of Contemporality (Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the quarut can see within 120 ft. must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed to experience time conventionally, suffering the following effects: The creature can no longer voluntarily be the target of spells of 8th level or above, or of equivalent effects. If this curse is removed, another quarut is summoned in an unoccupied space within 60 ft.

actions.name: Plane Shift (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: The quarut and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet teleport to another plane of existence.

actions.name: Chaos Ram

The living spell rockets up to 20 feet directly toward a creature it can see within 25 feet, then forces it to make a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target takes 13 (3d8) damage of a randomly selected type:
 1. Acid
 2. Cold
 3. Fire
 4. Lightning
 5. Poison
 6. Thunder

While concentrating on this ability, the living spell can use its action to repeat this effect on each of its turns.

reactions.name: Spiteful Shatter

reactions.description: When the suppressor is targeted with a spell, it may gain one charge counter that lasts for a minute.

reactions.name: Waste-Magic Cycling
reactions.description: When the suppressor is targeted with a spell, it may gain one charge counter that lasts for a minute.

actions.description: The duodrone makes two attacks with its Pressure Point Jab.

actions.name: Pressure Point Jab
actions.description: Attack: +2 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or drop each object it is holding and be unable to use its hands until the end of the duodrone's next turn.

actions.name: Deft Binding
actions.description: The modron quickly binds an incapacitated creature it can see within 5 feet in a lattice of intricate knots. The creature is Restrained (escape DC 12). A creature that is not restrained succeeds automatically on checks made to free the restrained creature.

actions.name: Break Time (1/Day)
actions.description: The duodrone regains all of its Hit Points, and falls unconscious until the start of its next turn, or until it takes any damage.

reactions.name: Upgrade
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a tridrone within 60 feet die or transform, the duodrone may transform into a tridrone, retaining its current Hit Points. No more than one duodrone may take this reaction.

savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +1, Con +3, Int -1, Cha -1
immunities: Radiant, Necrotic; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Clockwork Repetition

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tridrone makes three attacks with its Equitempered Javelins and uses its Recall Javelins, if available.

actions.name: Equitempered Javelin
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 4 Piercing damage. The tridrone has three javelins.

actions.name: Recall Javelins (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Each of the tridrone's thrown javelins grow dozens of slender legs and crawls up to 30 feet toward the tridrone before retracting them.

reactions.name: Supervise Work
reactions.description: As a reaction when a duodrone within 30 feet that the tridrone can see misses with an attack against a creature, the tridrone makes a note. Duodrones under the tridrone's control add +1 to their attack rolls for each note the tridrone has made in the last minute.

reactions.name: Upgrade
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a quadrone within 60 feet die or transform, the tridrone may transform into a quadrone, retaining its current Hit Points. No more than one tridrone may take this reaction.

actions.description: The quadrone makes four attacks with its Springlock Shortbow, two of which it may replace with its Clanking Kick.

actions.name: Clanking Kink
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Springlock Shortbow
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Troubleshoot
reactions.description: As a reaction when a friendly modron within 5 feet fails a Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom Saving Throw, the quadrone adds 4 to its result.

reactions.name: Upgrade
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a pentadrone within 60 feet die or transform, the quadrone may transform into a pentadrone, retaining its current Hit Points. No more than one quadrone may take this reaction.

actions.description: The pentadrone makes five attacks with its Spinning Slap.

actions.name: Spinning Slap
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 Bludgeoning damage. *Chaos Alert!* The modron loudly lists the violations of the laws of cosmic order it can see. Until the start of its next turn, friendly quadrones that can hear it have Advantage on attacks against any creature that is concentrating on a spell.

actions.name: Pyschosoma Ether (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The pentadrone exhales a desensitizing gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or be Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Restrain Chaos (Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the pentadrone can see within 30 feet makes an attack or casts a damaging spell, the pentadrone causes the attack or spell to deal minimum damage.

reactions.name: Upgrade
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a decaton within 60 feet die or transform, the pentadrone may transform into a decaton, retaining its current Hit Points. No more than one pentadrone may take this reaction.

languages: Celestial, Common, Infernal, Modron 5, Modron 6, Modron 7, Telepathy 44 miles

traits.name: Shuffling Gait
traits.description: The decaton's walking speed is reduced to 0 while in difficult terrain.

actions.name: Flailing Tubes
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Oil Joints
actions.description: One friendly modron within 10 feet gains 10 Temporary Hit Points that last for 10 minutes. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, a modron has vulnerability to Fire damage and can make a melee attack as a bonus action.

actions.name: Pruning Cull
actions.description: The decaton destroys one friendly pentadrone it can see, then restores each modron that transformed as a result to full health.

reactions.name: Gas Up
reactions.description: As a reaction when it is hit with a melee attack, the decaton fills itself with a buoyant gas, immediately rising 10 feet directly upward.

reactions.name: Upgrade
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a nonaton within 60 feet die or transform, the decaton may transform into a nonaton, retaining its current Hit Points. No more than one decaton may take this reaction.

name: Nonaton
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +7, Int +3, Wis +5, Cha +1
immunities: Radiant, Necrotic; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone
languages: Celestial, Common, Infernal, Modron 6, Modron 7, Modron 8, Telepathy 63 miles

traits.name: Clockwork Repetition

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nonaton makes four attacks with its Flailing Tubes.

actions.name: Flailing Tubes
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Interrogate Loyalties
actions.description: One creature the nonaton can see within 10 feet must make a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failed save, the creature takes 25 Psychic damage and the nonaton learns its alignment and surface thoughts.

actions.name: Torpedo Toss
actions.description: The nonaton spits out a small torpedo, then rapidly spins and tosses it to a space it can see within 30 feet. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 15 radiant damage and be Blinded until the end of the nonaton's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Seal of Approval
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature voluntarily fails its saving throw against the nonaton's Interrogate Loyalties, the nonaton affixes a gold star sticker to it. Until the creature completes a Long Rest, it has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

reactions.name: Upgrade
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a octon within 60 feet die or transform, the nonaton may transform into a octon, retaining its current Hit Points. No more than one nonaton may take this reaction.

name: Octon
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +5, Con +8, Int +7, Wis +6, Cha +2
immunities: Radiant, Necrotic; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone
languages: Celestial, Common, Infernal, Modron 7, Modron 8, Modron 9, Telepathy 80 miles

actions.name: Teetering Tubes
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 Bludgeoning damage. On a roll of 1, the octon falls prone. This attack is made at Disadvantage if the octon is flying.

actions.name: Spinlift Collar
actions.description: The octon extends its tubes and begins to rapidly spin its collar, gaining a fly speed equal to its movement speed until the end of its next turn. Each creature within 10 feet of the octon must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 24 Slashing damage and be pushed 5 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Cut Ribbon (1/Day)
actions.description: The octon reveals a set of magical, springloaded scissors that emerge from a door in its chest, cutting open a portal through which twelve monodrones immediately tumble forth, falling prone in the nearest unoccupied spaces before the portal seals itself shut.

reactions.name: Upgrade
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a septon within 60 feet die or transform, the octon may transform into a septon, retaining its current Hit Points. No more than one octon may take this reaction.

actions.description: The septon makes four attacks with its Clockwork Clipboard.

actions.name: Clockwork Clipboard
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Curse of Self-Reporting
actions.description: One creature the septon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature that engages in any non-Lawful behavior has Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until it records and reports those transgressions to a figure of Lawful authority.

actions.name: Stop Order (1/Day)
actions.description: The septon sends forth a pulse of temporal stasis in a 60-foot radius, ending each spell or magical effect of 8th level or below in the area. Each creature in the area of the septon's choice must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or be frozen in time until the end of the septon's next turn. While frozen, a creature is incapacitated and immune to all damage.

reactions.name: Upgrade
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a hexton within 60 feet die or transform, the septon may transform into a hexton, retaining its current Hit Points. No more than one septon may take this reaction.

When it casts this spell and at the beginning of each of the hexton's turns, it may move the factory up to 30 feet. A each creature that starts its turn beneath the factory must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 30 Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Heximate (Level 8 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The hexton bombards a creature it can see within 60 feet with the pure force of cosmic Law, forcing each particle of its being into a rigid and baleful alignment. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw or have its hit point total set to 1/6 of its hit point maximum, or to 5/6 of its hit point maximum on a success. A construct succeeds automatically on this saving throw.

reactions.name: Upgrade
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a quinton within 60 feet die or transform, the hexton may transform into a quinton, retaining its current Hit Points. No more than one hexton may take this reaction.

actions.description: The quinton makes three attacks with its Axiomatic Bolt and uses its Stickler for Procedure.

actions.name: Axiomatic Bolt
actions.description: Attack: +11 range 60 ft. Hit: The target loses 1/5 of its maximum Hit Points.

actions.name: Stickler for Procedure
actions.description: The quinton identifies some procedural error, invalidating one Declaration of Hostile Intent that it has seen in the last minute.

actions.name: Convene Meeting (1/Day)
actions.description: The quinton teleports itself and any number of other modrons it can see within 60 feet to a private demiplane to discuss how to procede. As an action, the quinton may end this effect, and each modron in the demiplane reappears in the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed.

reactions.name: Check Papers
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the quinton can see within 30 feet makes an attack against a modron, the quinton demands a written Declaration of Hostile Intent. An attacker with such a declaration on its person may use its reaction to reveal it. If the attacker does not, the attack fails. As a Bonus Action, a creature may write a Declaration of Hostile Intent.

reactions.name: Upgrade
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a quarton within 60 feet die or transform, the quinton may transform into a quarton, retaining its current Hit Points. No more than one quinton may take this reaction.

actions.name: Command Chain (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: One of each other type of modron within 60 feet of the quarton may use its reaction to make an attack.

reactions.name: Upgrade
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a tertian within 60 feet die or transform, the quarton may transform into a tertian, retaining its current Hit Points. No more than one quarton may take this reaction.

languages: Celestial, Common, Infernal, Modron 12, Modron 13, Modron 14, Telepathy 405 miles

actions.name: Tertian Gavel
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target is pushed up to 30 feet away and must make three DC 21 Constitution Saving Throws. For each save it fails, the creature takes Force damage equal to a third of its maximum Hit Points.

actions.name: Impose Order
actions.description: Each spell effect with a duration other than Until Dispelled within 30 feet of the tertian ends. Each harmful condition affecting a creature in the area ends. Each creature with 0 Hit Points in the area stabilizes.

actions.name: Inescapable Judgement (Recharge 5-6, Level 8 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature the tertian can see within 60 feet is bound in an opaque cocoon of force. While bound in this way, the creature is Blinded, restrained and has full cover from all outside effects. As a Bonus Action on each of its turns, the tertian may move the coccoon up to 60 feet.

reactions.name: Upgrade
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a secundus within 60 feet die or transform, the tertian may transform into a secundus, retaining its current Hit Points. No more than one tertian may take this reaction.

name: Secundus

immunities: Radiant, Necrotic; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone
languages: Celestial, Common, Infernal, Modron 13, Modron 14, Modron 15, Telepathy 420 miles

traits.name: Clockwork Repetition
traits.description: The secundus may choose to treat any d20 roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

traits.name: Perfect Synchrony
traits.description: If the secundus is within 30 feet of Primus, it uses Primus' attack bonus instead of its own.

traits.name: Iterative Order
traits.description: Whenever a creature deals damage to the secundus, the creature and the secundus each teleport up to 15 feet to unoccupied spaces the secundus can see.

actions.name: Gaze of Purest Law
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma Saving Throw or be incapacitated if it is of non-lawful alignment. As an Action, an affected creature may attempt a DC 22 Charisma (Deception) check to feign a change of alignment, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Revolve the Cosmic Gears (Concentration)
actions.description: The secundus chooses one school of magic. Until it or another secundus uses this ability again, spells of that school fail, and magical effects of that school cease to function.

actions.name: Voice of the One and the Prime (1/Day)
actions.description: The secundus relays the words of Primus, which though incomprehensible remain forever impressed upon the minds of those who hear them. Each creature who can hear the secundus must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature takes 25 Psychic damage the first time each day that engages in non-lawful behavior. This curse can be removed only by a Wish spell or equivalent magic.

reactions.name: Upgrade
reactions.description: As a reaction when Primus dies, the secundus may transform into Primus, retaining its current Hit Points. No more than one secundus may take this reaction.

name: Nimblewright
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +6, Con +3, Int -1, Cha -2
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Graceful Lander
traits.description: If the nimblewright would take damage from falling, it instead takes half as much and is not knocked prone.

traits.name: Unexpected Attacker
traits.description: The nimblewright has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature that has not yet taken a turn in the combat.

traits.name: Temperature Sensitive
traits.description: If the nimblewright takes any Cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 for the next minute. If the nimblewright takes any Fire damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nimblewright makes four melee attacks.

actions.name: Fold-Out Rapiers
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away. On a critical hit, the target drops one item is is holding or carrying.

actions.name: Repair Protocols
actions.description: The nimblewright restores 11 (2d8 + 2) Hit Points to one construct within 5 ft.

actions.name: Adopt Disguise (3/Day, Level 2 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The nimblewright transforms its appearance to that of a Medium humanoid for the next 8 hours.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The nimblewright adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it.

name: Tatterdemanimal
savingThrows: Dex +4, Con +1, Wis +1, Cha +3

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.description: While attached to a creature, the tatterdemanimal takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

traits.name: Handsome Attire
traits.description: A non-humanoid creature under the tatterdemanimal's control has Advantage on Charisma checks.

actions.name: Clinging Slam
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft., one Small or smaller creature. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the tatterdemanimal may wrap around the creature, attaching itself to it (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Refit
actions.description: One creature the tatterdemanimal is attached to must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 (2d4), to a minimum of 1, until the tatterdemanimal is removed. A creature reduced below 10 Wisdom in this way has Disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws. A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way acts under the tatterdemanimal's telepathic control.

name: Common Raggamoffyn
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +2, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.description: While attached to a creature, the raggamoffyn takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

traits.name: Lurching Puppeteer
traits.description: At the end of each of its turns, the raggamoffyn can force one creature it is attached to to make a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature uses its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a melee attack under the raggamoffyn's control.

actions.name: Clinging Slam
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the raggamoffyn wraps around the creature, attaching itself to it (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Refit
actions.description: One creature the raggamoffyn is attached to must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 (2d4), to a minimum of 1, until the raggamoffyn is removed. A creature reduced below 10 Wisdom in this way has Disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws. A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way acts under the raggamoffyn's telepathic control.

reactions.name: Wrest the Wrapped
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature it is attached to makes an attack or casts a spell, the raggamoffyn forces it to succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or have the raggamoffyn choose the attack or spell's target.

name: Gutterspite

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.description: While attached to a creature, the gutterspite takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

traits.name: Glitterglass Core
traits.description: A creature that hits the gutterspite or a creature it is attached to with a melee attack cannot benefit from Invisibility for the next 24 hours, or until rendered clean by magical means.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gutterspite makes two attacks with its Clinging Slam, each of which it may replace with a use of its Refit.

actions.name: Clinging Slam
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the gutterpite wraps around the creature, attaching itself to it (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Refit
actions.description: One creature the gutterpite is attached to must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 (2d4), to a minimum of 1, until the gutterpite is removed. A creature reduced below 10 Wisdom in this way has Disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws. A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way acts under the gutterpite's telepathic control.

reactions.name: Glitterburst
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature hits it with a melee attack, the gutterspite expels a puff of glitter, forcing the attacker to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of the gutterspite's next turn.

traits.description: While attached to a creature, the shrapnyl takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

traits.name: Jagged Encasement
traits.description: A creature the shrapnyl is attached to has its AC increased to 18, if it was lower, and takes an additional 7 (2d6) Piercing damage whenever it or the shrapnyl is hit with an attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shrapnyl makes two attacks with its Clinging Slam, each of which it may replace with a use of its Refit.

actions.name: Encasing Slam
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft., one Huge or smaller creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage and the shrapnyl wraps around the creature, attaching itself to it (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Persistent Refit
actions.description: One creature the shrapnyl is attached to must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 (2d4), to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Short or Long Rest without the shrapnyl attached to it. A creature reduced below 10 Wisdom in this way has Disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws. A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way acts under the shrapnyl's telepathic control while the shrapnyl is attached to it.

actions.name: Cloud of Steel (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The shrapnyl explodes outward in a spray of metal. Each creature within 10 feet of the shrapnyl that it is not attached to must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success, then each creature it was attached to is freed and the shrapnyl reforms in the nearest unoccupied space.

name: Retriever
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +3, Con +5, Int -4, Wis +5, Cha +2
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, and Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks not made with Adamantine Weapons; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned
languages: Understands Abyssal, Common, Elvish, and Undercommon but can't speak

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The retriever can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Faultless Tracker
traits.description: The retriever is given a quarry by its master. The quarry can be a specific creature or object the master is personally acquainted with, or it can be a general type of creature or object the master has seen before. The retriever knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence. The retriever can have only one such quarry at a time. The retriever also always knows the location of its master.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The retriever has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The retriever makes two foreleg attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its telekinetic beam.

actions.name: Rending Forelegs
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone. If the target is wearing nonmagical armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

actions.name: Telekinetic Beam
actions.description: Attack: +8 range 120 ft. Hit: 16 (3d10) force damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be dragged 30 ft. toward the retriever.

actions.name: Force Beam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The retriever emits a beam of transdimensional force in an 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 77 (14d10) Force damage, or half as much on a successful save. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Plane Shift (Level 7 Spell, 2/Day)
actions.description: The retriever and up to four unconscious or incapacitated creatures on its back teleport to a location on this or another plane of existence. An unwilling creature makes a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw, and is not teleported away on a success.

bonusActions.name: Bind
bonusActions.description: The retriever restrains an incapacitated or prone target with steel netting (escape DC 18). If the target is Large or smaller, the retreiver may then attach the creature to its back as part of this action. The netting can be attacked and destroyed (AC 18; HP 10; immunity to poison and Psychic damage)

reactions.name: Scuttle
reactions.description: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the retriever moves up to half its speed. If this movement puts the retriver out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the retriever is unaffected.

reactions.name: Bloodied Beam (1/day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 144 Hit Points, the retriever immediately recharges and uses its force beam.

name: Scarecrow Shambler
savingThrows: Dex +1, Cha +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Unconscious
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the scarecrow remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary, inanimate scarecrow.

traits.name: Moved by Ill Intent
traits.description: If the scarecrow's creator dies, it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw or die as well. On a success, the scarecrow gains self-awareness.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scarecrow makes two attack with its Bramble Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Terrifying Glare.

actions.name: Bramble Claws
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage. If the target is Frightened, it takes an additional Hit: 5 (2d4) psychic damage.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.description: One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn. While Frightened in this way, the creature has its movement speed reduced by half, and must use all of its movement to move directly away from the scarecrow on its turn.

reactions.name: Dread Shamble
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the scarecrow can see fails a saving throw against being Frightened, the scarecrow moves up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

name: Scarecrow Haunter
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +2, Wis +1, Cha +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Unconscious
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the scarecrow remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary, inanimate scarecrow.

traits.name: Moved by Ill Intent
traits.description: If the scarecrow's creator dies, it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw or die as well. On a success, the scarecrow gains self-awareness.

traits.name: Volatile Spores
traits.description: If the scarecrow is killed by Fire damage, it explodes. Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scarecrow makes two attacks with its Bramble Claws and uses its Horrid Glare.

actions.name: Bramble Claws
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. If the target is Frightened, it takes an additional Hit: 5 (2d4) psychic damage.

actions.name: Horrid Glare
actions.description: One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened for the next minute. While Frightened in this way, the creature has its movement speed reduced by half, and must use its all of its movement to move directly away from the scarecrow on its turn. A Frightened creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Dread Shamble
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the scarecrow can see fails a saving throw against being Frightened, the scarecrow moves up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

name: Questing Scarecrow
savingThrows: Dex +3, Con +3, Wis +4, Cha +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Unconscious
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the scarecrow remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary, inanimate scarecrow.

traits.name: Moved by Ill Intent
traits.description: If the scarecrow's creator dies, it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw or die as well. On a success, the scarecrow gains self-awareness.

traits.name: Volatile Spores
traits.description: If the scarecrow is killed by Fire damage, it explodes. Each creature within 20 feet must must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

traits.name: Relentless Tracker
traits.description: The scarecrow knows the distance to and direction of the creature whose clothes it wears as long as it is on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scarecrow makes two attacks with its Harvest Blade, one of which it may replace with a use of its Paralyzing Glare.

actions.name: Harvest Blade
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. On a critical hit, this attack rolls its damage dice three times, instead of twice.

actions.name: Paralyzing Glare
actions.description: One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn. While Frightened in this way, the creature is Paralyzed.

reactions.name: Dread Shamble
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the scarecrow can see fails a saving throw against being Frightened, the scarecrow moves up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

name: Scarecrow Effigy
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex +2, Con +9, Wis +3, Cha +2
immunities: Fire, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Unconscious
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Wicker Cage
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the scarecrow may shove each Large or smaller creature grappled by it into its chest cavity, which knits shut to seal the creature in. A trapped creature that deals 10 or more Slashing damage to the scarecrow in a turn cuts a hole through which a creature may attempt to escape by spending half its movement (escape DC 18).

traits.name: Oil-Soaked Body
traits.description: If the scarecrow is exposed to fire, it is immediately engulfed in flame for the next minute. While the scarecrow is burning, a creature inside of climbing on the scarecrow takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage at the start of its turn, and the scarecrow's attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

traits.name: Volatile Spores
traits.description: If the scarecrow is killed while on fire, it explodes. Each creature within 30 feet must must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the scarecrow may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the scarecrow. While climbing on the scarecrow, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the scarecrow, and the scarecrow has Disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scarecrow makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Paralyzing Glare or Knit Together.

actions.name: Abductor Claw
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 15 ft., each target in a 5-foot radius. Hit: 13 (3d4 + 6) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Wrecking Fist
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 15 ft., each target is a 5-foot radius. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) piercing damage and each target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Paralyzing Glare
actions.description: One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn. While Frightened in this way, the creature is Paralyzed.

actions.name: Knit Together
actions.description: The effigy gains 22 (4d10) Temporary Hit Points, and any holes that have been cut in its wicker cage close. Each creature in its Wicker Cage takes 22 (4d10) nonlethal Psychic damage.

reactions.name: Dread Shamble
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the scarecrow can see fails a saving throw against being Frightened, the scarecrow moves up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

name: Shardsoul Slayer
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +6, Int -1, Wis -1, Cha +5
resistances: Radiant; Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Deranging Aura
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more shardsouls must make a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature makes attacks at Disadvantage and its attacks deal an extra die of damage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Shardsoul Release
traits.description: When the shardsoul dies, up to one shardsoul within 30 feet gains 22 (4d10) Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the shardsoul takes two actions on its turn, instead of one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shardsoul makes three melee attacks.

actions.name: Fell-Iron Claws
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) radiant damage. A creature hit by four or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or gain a point of Exhaustion.

reactions.name: Deranged Thrash
reactions.description: As a reaction when it is missed with an attack by a creature affected by a Deranging Aura, the shardsoul causes the creature to make a new attack roll without Disadvantage against another creature in range of the shardsoul's choice.

name: Shardsoul Avatar
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +1, Con +8, Int +1, Wis -1, Cha +7
resistances: Radiant; Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Deranging Aura
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more shardsouls must make a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature makes attacks at Disadvantage and its attacks deal an extra die of damage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Shardsoul Release
traits.description: When the shardsoul dies, up to one shardsoul within 30 feet gains 22 (4d10) Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the shardsoul takes two actions on its turn, instead of one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shardsoul makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Meteor Stomp.

actions.name: Fell-Iron Claws
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) radiant damage. A creature hit by four or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or gain a point of Exhaustion.

actions.name: Meteor Stomp
actions.description: Each creature within 5 feet of the shardsoul must make a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (3d6) radiant damage, is pushed 10 feet away, and knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage.

actions.name: Starsick Beam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The shardwoul emits a beam of sickening starlight. Each creature in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide must make a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 42 (12d6) radiant damage and is Poisoned for the next minute, or takes half as much damage on a success. A creature Poisoned in this way has its speed reduced by half, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Deranged Thrash
reactions.description: As a reaction when it is missed with an attack by a creature affected by a Deranging Aura, the shardsoul causes the creature to make a new attack roll without Disadvantage against another creature in range of the shardsoul's choice.

reactions.name: Bloodied Starshriek (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 100 Hit Points, the shardsoul forces each creature within 15 feet of it to succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Psychic damage and be Stunned until the end of the Shardsoul's next turn.

name: Shield Guardian
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +4, Int -2, Cha -4
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned
languages: Understands commands given in any language but can't speak

traits.name: Bound
traits.description: The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guardian makes two fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target must then make a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or take Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage and be pushed 10 ft. away.

actions.name: Protective Wall
actions.description: The shield guardian can fold into a whirling wall of grinding metal, comprised of three contiguous 10 ft. x 10 ft. x 1 ft. segments. Creatures in the wall's space when it appears must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Slashing damage and be pushed to a side of the guardian's choice. The shield guardian cannot move or take actions while in this form except to resume its normal form as a bonus action.

actions.name: Death Ward
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the shield guardian is granted a measure of protection from death. The first time in the next minute that the creature would drop to 0 Hit Points, it instead drops to 1 hit point.

reactions.name: Interpose
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature within 5 feet targeting the wearer of the guardian's amulet with an attack, the guardian may impose Disadvantage on the roll.

name: Stone Cursed
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -3, Con +3, Int -3, Wis -1, Cha -2
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Petrified, Poisoned
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Lithified
traits.description: If the stone cursed would take 15 or fewer damage from a single source, it instead takes no damage.

traits.name: Tormented Echoes
traits.description: A creature that kills the stone cursed must succeed on a DC 10 Intelligence Saving Throw or fall prone and be Blinded until the end of its next turn as it relives one of the stone cursed's memories.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the stone cursed remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

actions.name: Stony Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Petrifying Sludge
actions.description: The stone cursed covers one grappled creature in petrifying sludge. The creature's speed is reduced to 10, and at the end of each of its turns the creature must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be Petrified for 24 hours, or until it takes 10 or more Bludgeoning damage. This effect ends when a creature clears the sludge away as an action with a successful DC 12 Strength (Survival) check.

reactions.name: Shambling Pursuit
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the stone cursed can see makes a ranged attack, the stone cursed moves up to its speed directly toward the creature.

name: Stone Juggernaut
savingThrows: Str +12, Dex -1, Con +10, Int -4, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks That Aren't Adamantine; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Deathroller
traits.description: The juggernaut is equipped with a series of stone rollers, granting it the following traits: Facing. The juggernaut has a facing, and can only move in a straight line in the direction it is facing. Turning. The juggernaut may spend 10 feet of movement to make a turn of up to 90 degrees, and cannot turn otherwise. Prone Vulnerability. While prone, the juggernaut is incapacitated.

traits.name: Rear Hatch
traits.description: The juggernaut is hollow, and can be entered through a locked hatch in its rear, which can be opened with a successful DC 18 Dexterity (Thieves' Tools) or DC 24 Strength (Athletics) check. A creature in the juggernaut moves with it, and its attacks bypass the juggernaut's Damage Resistances and Damage Threshold.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The juggernaut makes two Piston Fist attacks, each of which must be against a different target, and uses its Flattening Charge.

actions.name: Piston Fist
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 10 ft. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone. The juggernaut has six fists, and can use each of them once before it must use its Vent Hydraulics to retract them.

actions.name: Flattening Charge
actions.description: The juggernaut moves up to its speed in a straight line and can move through the space of any creature smaller than Huge. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, the creature takes 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. A creature that is already prone takes an additional 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Vent Hydraulics (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The juggernaut retracts each of its fists, and vents boiling steam into its interior. Each creature inside of it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Tomb Mote
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -3, Wis +3, Cha +2
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Curious Climber
traits.description: The mote may climb onto any adjacent Medium or larger creature by spending 15 feet of movement. An unwilling creature may prevent this with a successful DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw. While climbing on a creature, the creature has Disadvantage on attacks that target the mote.

traits.name: Hateful Helper
traits.description: When the mote uses the help action to grant an attack Advantage, the attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Shin Kick
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) nonlethal Bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target falls prone if it is Large or smaller.

actions.name: Yank Ear
actions.description: One creature the tomb mote is crawling on must make a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature has Disadvantage on attacks it makes before the end of the mote's next turn.

reactions.name: Mischievous Trip
reactions.description: When a creature leaves its reach, the tomb mote can force the creature to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone.

name: Tomb Tapper
savingThrows: Str +6, Con +5, Int +2, Wis +2
languages: Understands Common and Undercommon but can't speak, Telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Petrified Death
traits.description: A tomb tapper reduced to 0 Hit Points turns into a lifeless stone statue. Obects it is wearing or carrying are not transformed.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The tomb tapper can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.description: If the tomb tapper takes any Thunder damage, it is Deafened until the end of its next turn. While Deafened, the tomb tapper is also Blinded.

traits.name: Magic Sense
traits.description: The tomb tapper knows the precise location of each source of magic within 240 ft. of it.

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the tomb tapper may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the tomb tapper. While climbing on the tomb tapper, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the tomb tapper, and the tomb tapper has Disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tomb tapper makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its stoneshock hammer drive.

actions.name: Arenite Sledgehammer
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 15 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) force damage and the creature is pushed 5 feet away. Creatures within 5 feet of the target must make a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw, taking half the attack's damage on a failed save. As a bonus action, the tomb tapper can return the hammer to its hand.

actions.name: Sweeping Claws
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the creature is Grappled (escape DC 18). A creature that attempts to cast a spell while grappled in this way must succeed on a DC 18 saving throw using its spellcasting modifier or have its spell fail.

actions.name: Swallow Whole
actions.description: One Large or smaller creature grappled by the tomb tapper must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or take 66 (12d10) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is swallowed whole. A creature with proficiency in Perception can see and target the swallowed creature with ranged abilities. As an action, a creature can pry the tomb tapper's mouth open with a successful DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: Stoneshock Hammer Drive (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The giant throws its hammer. Each creature in a 10-foot wide, 120 ft. long line must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 32 (5d12) Bludgeoning damage, be knocked prone, and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success. Walls of Wood or Stone up to 10 ft. thick in the area are destroyed.

reactions.name: Hunt Magic
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature within 15 ft. casting a spell, using a psionic ability, or activating a magic item, the tomb tapper makes a melee attack against it.

name: Tomb Tapper Hulkdriver
savingThrows: Str +11, Dex +5, Con +10, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +6
languages: Understands Common and Undercommon but can't speak, Telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Hulk Driver
traits.description: While not incapacitated, the tomb tapper telepathically controls each umber hulk within 60 ft. At the beginning of each of the tomb tapper's turns, each umber hulk within 60 ft. may use its reaction to move up to its burrow speed.

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the tomb tapper may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the tomb tapper. While climbing on the tomb tapper, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the tomb tapper, and the tomb tapper has Disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

actions.description: The tomb tapper makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its stoneshock hammer drive.

actions.description: One Large or smaller creature grappled by the tomb tapper must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or take 66 (12d10) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is swallowed whole. A creature with proficiency in Perception can see and target the swallowed creature with ranged abilities. As an action, a creature can pry the tomb tapper's mouth open with a successful DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: Stoneshock Hammer Drive (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The giant throws its hammer. Each creature in a 10-foot wide, 120 ft. long line must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 39 (6d12) Bludgeoning damage, be knocked prone, and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success. Walls of Wood or Stone up to 10 ft. thick in the area are destroyed.

reactions.name: Hunt Magic
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature within 15 ft. casting a spell, using a psionic ability, or activating a magic item, the tomb tapper makes a melee attack against it.

reactions.name: Telepathic Shriek (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 119 Hit Points, the tomb tapper lets out a telepathic shriek. Each creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence Saving Throw or fall prone and lose concentration, if it was holding it. Each umber hulk in the area is freed from the tomb tapper's control until the end of its following turn.

name: Umbral Blot
savingThrows: Dex +10, Con +5, Int +2, Wis +5, Cha +5
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Sources; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Restrained, Stunned
languages: Understands Supernal but does not speak, Telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Annihilating Guise
traits.description: The blot is nearly indistinguishable from a Sphere of Annihilation. A creature can determine that the blot is not what it appears with a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Insight) check.

traits.name: Portal Annihilation
traits.description: If the blot touches a planar portal, such as an active Gate spell or a portable hole, both the blot and the portal are destroyed, and travel between the two connected planes becomes impossible for 1d10 days.

traits.name: Hostile Void
traits.description: A creature that touches the blot, or whose space the blot enters for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Force damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage disintegrates. Nonartifact objects dealt damage in this way disintegrate.

traits.name: Inviolable
traits.description: If the blot fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points. Creatures that fail saving throws against effects controlled by the blot cannot use abilities to choose to succeed on them.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The blot uses its Void Collapse and makes one attack with its Disintegrating Touch.

actions.name: Disintegrating Touch
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 5 ft. Hit: 110 (20d10) force damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is disintegrated.

actions.name: Void Collapse
actions.description: The blot briefly suspends the field that protects the air around it from destruction, forcing each creature within 60 feet to succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled up to 30 feet toward the blot. Until the beginning of the blot's next turn, movement away from the blot by creatures within 60 feet of it counts as being over difficult terrain.

actions.name: Plane Shift
actions.description: The blot teleports to a location on this or another plane that it is familiar with.

reactions.name: Deceptive Response
reactions.description: When a creature within 60 feet of the blot attempts to mentally control it, the blot can move up to half its speed in the direction indicated by the creature.

reactions.name: Pure Entropy
reactions.description: When the blot is hit with a nonartifact weapon, the blot can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity or Strength Saving Throw (target's choice) or have the weapon wrenched from its grip and disintegrated.

traits.name: Scute Armor
traits.description: Creatures cannot benefit from flanking the ankylosaurus unless it is prone.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage to a prone creature.

actions.name: Tail Club
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, the target is pushed 10 feet away, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be knocked prone. A Large or larger creature that fails this save by 5 or more is unable to stand until it completes a short or long rest.

reactions.name: Flatten
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking 10 or more damage from a single source, the ankylosaurus presses its body to the ground, protecting its soft underbelly. Until the start of its next turn, the Anklyosaurus adds 3 to its AC.

reactions.description: When a creature enters its reach, the plesiosaurus can make a Shellsplitter Bite attack against it, then move up to 10 feet.

Whenever the elasmosaurus uses this ability, each creature already grappled in its mouth is dragged to the nearest unoccupied space to the target, then may use its reaction to attempt to escape.

actions.name: Dark Water Ambush
actions.description: The elasmosaurus moves up to its speed in a straight line towards a creature it is hidden from and uses its Cage-Mouth Bite against it. If the attack hits, the target takes an additional 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the plesiosaurus' next turn.

actions.name: Sediment Churn (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The elasmosaurus dives up to its speed straight down and attempts to Hide. If it ends this movement within 10 feet of the bed of the body of water it is submerged in, it kicks up a cloud of murky sediment, heavily obscuring the area in a 20-foot radius around itself that lasts until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Darting Snap
reactions.description: When a creature enters its reach (20-foot radius), the elasmosaurus can use its Cage-Mouth Bite against it, then move up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Dark Water Ambush
actions.description: The liopleurodon moves up to its speed in a straight line towards a creature it is hidden from and makes an attack against it with its Shellcrusher Bite. traits.name: Reserved Resistance (5/Day)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Sparking Bite, and uses its Frightful Presence.

actions.name: Cavernous Maw
actions.description: Attack: +18 reach 15 ft. Hit: 26 (3d10 + 10) piercing damage plus Hit: 16 (3d10) lightning damage. If the target was grappled, the dragon may force it to succeed on a DC 26 Strength Saving Throw or be Swallowed. While swallowed in this way, a creature takes 22 (4d10) Lightning damage at the beginning of each of the dragon's turns. If a creature inside the dragon deals 50 or more damage to the dragon in a turn, the dragon immediately regurgitates each creature swallowed by it.

actions.name: Sandhoned Claw
actions.description: Attack: +18 reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 26). Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity Saving Throw or take half the attack's damage.

actions.name: Ridgetail Sweep
actions.description: The dragon sweeps its tail in a 30-foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away from the dragon, or take half as much damage and be pushed up to half as far on a success.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

actions.name: Shattered Heavens Roar (Concentration)

At the start of the dragon's next turn, a cascade of lightning bolts arcs down, striking up to four creatures the dragon can see within 300 feet. Each target must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 44 (8d10) Lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Scourgebolt Breath (Recharge 5–6)

A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Battle of Wits
reactions.description: When the dragon is targeted with a ranged attack by a creature it can see, it can throw a creature grappled by it up to 20 feet into the attack's path. The attacker must succeed on a contested Intelligence (Insight) check against the dragon or have its attack instead target the thrown creature.

reactions.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)

legendaryActions.name: Sand Dive

legendaryActions.name: Wither

legendaryActions.name: Ridgetail Sweep (Costs 2 Actions)

actions.name: Aqua Regia
actions.description: Aqua regia is a mix of hydrochloric acid and nitric acid that is notable for its ability to dissolve gold and platinum, while leaving silver intact. Real aqua regia does dissolve copper, but I think it's much more on-theme for a copper dragon to keep all its copper and silver in a big, easily plunderable pile, while its gold and platinum is kept dissolved in massive pools of fuming acid. If you've got a chemist in your group who's a stickler for that kind of thing, just call it Alkahest Breath instead.

actions.name: Recovering the Treasure
actions.description: A creature proficient in alchemy tools may use them to attempt a DC 15 ability check over the course of a work day, precipitating 2d10 x 100gp worth of gold dust out of the acid on a success. A creature may attempt this check any number of times, though the total amount of gold recovered in this way is limited by the amount originally disolved in the acid. A creature that fails this check by 5 or more exhausts their supply of reagents and must acquire a new kit to attempt it again.

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Unattended gold and platinum in the area dissolves entirely.

actions.name: Slowing Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The dragon exhales gas in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the creature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. These effects last for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save.

reactions.name: Heckler's Veto
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature it can see within 60 ft. casting a spell, the dragon forces the creature to make a DC 19 saving throw using the creature's spell casting ability. On a failed save, the spell fails.

reactions.name: Bloodied Breath (1/day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 176 Hit Points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

legendaryActions.name: Banter

If it does, both the creature and the dragon have Advantage on the next attack or saving throw they make in the next minute. If it fails to do so, the creature has Disadvantage on the next attack or saving throw it makes in the next minute.

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Shadow Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The dragon exhales writhing shadow in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 26 Constitution Saving Throw, taking 105 (30d6) Necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature with a shadow reduced to 0 by this damage falls into its shadow, and its shadow climbs into the material plane to replace it, with the following attributes: The creature's shadow has the same statistics and abilities as the creature and has one hit point. It acts on the dragon's initiative and is under the dragon's control. The creature remains conscious, but may only target its shadow with spells and abilities. A creature can wrestle the shadow back into the shadow realm with a successful DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. If it does, the creature returns to the material plane with one hit point. If the creature's shadow receives any healing, the shadow is banished to the shadow realm. The creature returns to the material plane with one hit point. If the creature's shadow dies, the creature is lost forever to the realm of shadow.

reactions.name: Snuff (1/day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 369 HP, the dragon extinguishes all lights within 300 ft.

reactions.name: Shadow Glide (Dim Light Only)
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking damage of a type it is resistant to, the wraith may teleport up to 60 feet and turn invisible until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

legendaryActions.name: Snatch
legendaryActions.description: The dragon makes a claw attack against a creature that it is hidden from. If the attack hits, the target is grappled, stunned, and hidden from its allies until the start of its next turn. This attack does not automatically reveal the dragon's position.

legendaryActions.name: Shadow Tether
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 60 ft. that the dragon can see must make a DC 22 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the next time the dragon takes damage in the next minute, it takes half as much damage and the target takes the same amount.

legendaryActions.name: Waken Shadows
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled and restrained (escape DC 22) as its shadow lunges to grip it. A creature is freed if it is in bright light.

name: Dragon Eel
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +9, Con +11, Int +1, Wis +8, Cha +2

traits.name: Slender Body
traits.description: The dragon eel may move through any space large enough for a Large creature without squeezing.

traits.name: Surface Nerves
traits.description: If the dragon eel takes 30 or more Bludgeoning damage in a turn, it is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Gargantuan Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the dragon eel may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the dragon eel. While climbing on the dragon eel, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks made against it.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the dragon eel fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon eel makes three wriggling ram attacks, one of which it may replace with its gulping bite or stunning shock.

actions.name: Massive Gulp
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 10 ft. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be swallowed. While swallowed, the target's attacks bypass the dragon eel's resistances and it takes 21 (6d6) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the dragon eel's turns. If the dragon eel takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the dragon eel regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in the nearest unoccupied space.

actions.name: Wriggling Ram
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away. Before or after making this attack, the dragon eel may move up to a quarter of its speed.

actions.name: Stunning Shock
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 10 ft. Hit: 27 (6d8) lightning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Broadcast Current (Recharge 5–6, underwater only)
actions.description: The dragon eel briefly electrifies the water in a 20 ft. radius around itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw, taking 36 (8d8) Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the dragon eel's next turn.

reactions.name: Thrash
reactions.description: As a reaction to failing a saving throw, the dragon eel forces each creature within 15 ft. to succeed on a DC 20 Strenght saving throw or be pushed 15 ft. away.

reactions.name: Bloodied Current (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 149 Hit Points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses its Broadcast Current.

legendaryActions.name: Dive
legendaryActions.description: The dragon eel moves up to half its speed. If it is submerged, each creature climbing on it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or fall off.

legendaryActions.name: Suction Feeding
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 20 ft. must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled up to 20 ft. toward the dragon eel. A creature that fails by 5 or more is immediately swallowed.

legendaryActions.name: Coil Up (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The dragon eel rolls to recharge its broadcast current, reducing its movement on its following turn to 0. If the dragon eel uses its broadcast current on its following turn, its range is doubled and its damage is increased by 18 (4d8).

legendaryActions.name: Rock Boat (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The dragon eel rocks a boat or ship within 10 ft. Each unsecured creature on the vehicle's deck is pushed 15 ft. in the same direction. If this movement would eject a creature from the vehicle, it makes a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw, catching itself on the edge on a success. A creature hanging from the edge of a ship is considered Prone.

reactions.name: Bloodied Agitation

reactions.description: When the cinderspawn takes any Cold damage, it can release a gout of ash. Each creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage and be Blinded until the end of the Cinderspawn's next turn.

name: Desiccator
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +1, Int -1, Cha +1
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Cursed Thirst
traits.description: Water recedes from the desiccator as though magnetically repelled, and is destroyed if the dessicator touches it. If the desiccator begins its turn fully submerged in water, it explodes in a hail of jagged salts.
