Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

traits.name: Parch the Weak
traits.description: The desiccator's attacks score a critical on an 18-20 against a creature with a Constitution score of 10 or lower.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The desiccator makes two attacks with its crumbling touch.

actions.name: Crumbling Touch
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft., *Hit* 7 (1d8 + 3) Necrotic damage. A creature killed by this attack crumbles to dust. On a critical hit, the target gains a point of Exhaustion that lasts for a minute.

actions.name: Desiccation Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The desiccator inhales, draining the moisture from a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 1 until it completes a Short or Long Rest. A creature with its Constitution score reduced in this way that would receive any healing instead receives half as much and repeats this save, ending the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Ragged Panting
reactions.description: When the dessicator takes any Fire damage, it falls prone and rolls to recharge its Desiccation Breath.

name: Drelb
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +3, Cha +1
immunities: Necrotic, Psychic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Unconscious

traits.name: Twilight Haunt
traits.description: At dawn, if the drelb is outside the Plane of Negative Energy it is banished there until the next dusk.

traits.name: False Undeath
traits.description: Spells and magical effects that reveal creature type detect the drelb as undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The drelb makes two attacks with its Bloodless Fists.

actions.name: Bloodless Fists
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft., *Hit* 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Nether Chill (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The drelb fixes its gaze upon a Medium or smaller creature it can see within 30 feet, turning its blood cold. The target takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage and falls prone, then must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be unable to stand for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

reactions.name: Trick of Perspective
reactions.description: When a creature makes an Opportunity Attack against the drelb, the drelb can reveal that it was simply shrinking, rather than moving away. The Opportunity Attack misses, and the drelb teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the attacker, then uses its Nether Chill against the attacker, if available.

reactions.name: Psionic Repeater
reactions.description: When a creature within 60 feet of the drelb uses a psionic ability that targets one or more creatures, the drelb can cause that ability to target one additional creature.

name: Droproll Floodarch
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex -2, Con +5, Int -2, Wis -1, Cha +1
resistances: Fire; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Acid, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Level-Bound
traits.description: While on a slope, the droproll must concentrate to avoid rolling downhill; if the droproll loses concentration, it moves 10 feet downhill at the beginning of each creature's turn until it reaches level ground.

traits.name: Tension Trap
traits.description: A creature whose space the droproll enters is engulfed in the droproll and restrained (escape DC 19). A creature with a swim speed has Advantage on attempts made to escape this restraint.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The droproll makes two attacks with its Clumsy Bump, one of which it can replace with a use of its Strained Lean.

actions.name: Clumsy Bump
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away. This attack's targets are chosen at random, selected from other creatures, structures, and vehicles within the droproll's reach.

actions.name: Laborious Lean
actions.description: The droproll strains, rocks, and reaches, choosing a direction. At the start of its next turn, it can make a DC 17 Strength check, rolling 20 feet in the chosen direction on a success, or half as far on a failure.

reactions.name: Rippling Retort
reactions.description: When the droproll takes 15 or more damage from a melee attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

name: Earthrazer
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +4, Con +5, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Attacks Not Made With Stone Weapons
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Dust Form
traits.description: The earthrazer can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The interior of the earthrazer is heavily obscured.

traits.name: Hacking Expulsion
traits.description: At the beginning of the earthrazer's turn, each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 20 feet away and Blinded until the beginning of the earthrazer's next turn.

traits.name: Steel to Stone
traits.description: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the earthrazer turns to stone after dealing damage. A creature with a strength score lower than 19 has Disadvantage on attacks made with it, and on a roll of 1 the weapon shatters.

traits.name: Earth-Sickened
traits.description: While touching a solid surface of earth or stone, the earthrazer gains vulnerability to each damage type to which it is not resistant or immune.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The earthrazer uses its Choking Sweep twice, one of which it may replace with its Decay to Dust or its Dust Burial, if available.

actions.name: Choking Sweep
actions.description: Each creature in a 20-foot cone extending from the earthrazer must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. Until the end of the earthrazer's next turn, the affected area becomes heavily obscured and difficult terrain, and creatures in the area can't speak or breathe.

actions.name: Decay to Dust
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet must make a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, one piece of nonmagical armor the creature is wearing crumbles to dust, one spell affecting the creature ends, and it loses all Temporary Hit Points. If a creature with 0 Hit Points fails this save, it dies and turns to dust.

actions.name: Dust Burial (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The earthrazer turns the ground to dust in a 10-foot radius, 40-foot deep cylinder extending from a point it can see within 60 feet. A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or sink 5 feet into the earth and be restrained (escape DC 18). A creature restrained in this way is Blinded and can't speak or breathe, and sinks an additional 5 feet into the dust at the end of each of its turns. A creature that is not restrained may move through the dust at half its swim speed.

reactions.name: Wheezing Draw
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the earthrazer draws in a labored, wheezing breath. Each creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be drawn up to 30 feet toward the earthrazer.

name: Elder Tempest
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +9, Con +6, Int -4, Wis +11, Cha +10
resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: lightning, poison, thunder; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The tempest deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Air Form
traits.description: The tempest may enter a creature's space and stop there. A huge or smaller creature whose space the tempest passes through is sucked into its maelstrom.

traits.name: Grab the Wind
traits.description:
The tempest is divided into 5 sections: Head, forewings, midwings, rearwings, and Maelstrom.
*

traits.name: Maelstrom
traits.description:
A creature that starts its turn in the maelstrom takes 14 (4d6) bludgeoning and 7 (2d6) Thunder damage.
*

traits.name: Damage Resistant
traits.description:
The maelstrom is immune to all damage, and the wings are resistant to all damage.
*

traits.name: Movement
traits.description:
A creature can make a DC 19 Strength (Athletics), Dexterity (Acrobatics), Intelligence (Nature), or Wisdom (Survival) check and spend all of its movement to move one section closer to the head. A creature that succeeds by 5 or more instead advances two sections. A creature that fails by 5 or more loses its grip and falls.
*

traits.name: Gaining Advantage
traits.description:
If the wings take 20 or more damage from a single source (after reductions), the tempest contracts and thrashes, giving all creatures Advantage on checks made to move along its length until the tempest's next turn. A creature with a fly speed has Advantage on checks to navigate the tempest.
*

traits.name: Falling
traits.description: A creature that loses its grip falls toward the maelstrom. It may make a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw for each section it falls past, catching itself there on a success.

traits.name: Living Storm
traits.description: Strong winds swirl in the area covered by the storm. The winds impose Disadvantage on ranged attack rolls made from further than 30 feet, or one section, away. Ranged attack rolls made from more than 60 feet, or two sections away, miss automaticially.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The tempest doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If the tempest fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tempest uses its thunderous wingbeat twice.

actions.name: Thunderous Wingbeat
actions.description: Creatures in one section of the tempest's body other than the maelstrom or head must make a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or take 23 (5d8) Thunder damage. A creature that fails this save by five or more loses its grip and falls toward the maelstrom. *Sheet Lightning ((Recharge 5-6).)* Each creature in or adjacent to the tempest must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Lightning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more drops what its holding. Nonmetal objects fall to the maelstrom, metal objects have a 50% chance to fall to the maelstrom and a 50% chance to drop out of it.

actions.name: The Living Wind (1/day)
actions.description: The tempest summons two Air Elementals that appear at its head and act on initiative count 20. The elementals disperse when the tempest dies. *Screaming Ascent. (1/day)* Each creature in the tempest must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Thunder damage and lose its grip and begin to fall toward the maelstrom

actions.name: Galvanic Ruin (1/day)
actions.description: The tempest releases a blast of lightning and wind in a line that is 1 mile long and 20 feet wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 88 (16d10) damage, or half as much on a failure. A creature behind full cover makes this Saving Throw at Advantage, takes half damage on a failure, or 1/4 damage on a success. Objects and structures take double damage from this ability.

actions.name: Shed Refuse
actions.description: If the tempest is below 100 HP, it may attempt to eject one creature from its body. One creature in a section other than the head must make a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be lauched 30 feet away from the tempest into open air.

reactions.name: Crackling Rebuke
reactions.description: When a creature deals 20 or more damage to the tempest's head with a melee attack, the tempest may use its reaction to force the attacker to succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Lightning damage as electricity erupts from the wound.

name: Air Mephit
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +2, Con -1

traits.name: Weightless
traits.description: Whenever the mephit takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the damage's source.

traits.name: Airburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, a 10-foot Emanation burst of air tears out from it, pushing each Medium or smaller creature up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Blow Gust
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 15 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away. This attack has Advantage against a Levitating or Flying target.

actions.name: Updraft
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 9. Failure: The creature floats 10 feet into the air and Levitates there until the end of the mephit's next turn, or until the mephit is killed. When this effect ends, the creature immediately falls.

name: Ash Mephit
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +3, Con +1, Int -2, Wis -2, Cha -1

traits.name: Weightless
traits.description: Whenever the mephit takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the damage's source.

traits.name: Ashburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a 5-foot Emanation of burning ash; each creature in the area takes 3 Fire damage and is Blinded until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Ashen Slash
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) fire damage. Then if the target is Bloodied, it begins Choking. As an Action or Bonus Action, the Choking creature can make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. Success: The effect ends.

actions.name: Ember Gout
actions.description: One creature within 15 feet must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The creature begins Burning (1d10).

reactions.name: Wheeze Cinder
reactions.description: Trigger: The mephit is hit with a melee attack. Response: The attacker takes 3 Fire damage.

name: Dust Mephit
savingThrows: Dex +1, Con +1, Int -2, Wis -2, Cha -1

traits.name: Weightless
traits.description: Whenever the mephit takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the damage's source.

traits.name: Dustburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a 5-foot Emanation of dust, Heavily Obscuring the area for 1 minute or until cleared by a strong wind. Creatures in the area are Choking. If the mephit is doused in water (at least one gallon), this trait is disabled for 1 minute.

actions.name: Scrabblescratch
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage. If this attack had Advantage, it deals an additional 3 (1d6) Slashing damage on a hit.

actions.name: Dust Nimbus
actions.description: An aura of pale dust clings to a creature within 5 feet; until cleared with an Action or Bonus Action, attacks that target the creature have Advantage and it can't benefit from the Invisible condition.

reactions.name: Detonate
reactions.description: Trigger: The mephit would take any Fire damage. Response: The mephit gains Vulnerability to the triggering damage. Then, each other creature in a 15-foot Emanation from it must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The creature takes an equal amount of Fire damage.

name: Earth Mephit
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -1, Con +1, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The mephit can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

traits.name: Dirtburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a 5-foot Emanation of packed earth; each creature in the area takes 5 Bludgeoning damage. If the mephit is doused in water (at least one gallon), this trait is disabled for 1 minute.

actions.name: Clodcutter Claws
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) Slashing damage to a Prone target, or one made out of inorganic materials.

actions.name: Microquake
actions.description: The ground in a 15-foot long, 5-foot wide Line extending from the mephit becomes Difficult Terrain, then each creature in the area must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage and the creature falls Prone.

name: Fire Mephit
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Spreading Flame
traits.description: Unattended flammable objects and surfaces that the mephit touches ignite.

traits.name: Fireburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a 5-foot Emanation of flame; each creature in the area begins Burning (1d10).

actions.name: Forgeglow Strike
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) fire damage. This attack has Advantage against a target wearing metal armor.

actions.name: Burning Steel
actions.description: One creature within 15 feet that is wielding a metal weapon takes 5 (2d4) Fire damage, then must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The creature drops the weapon.

name: Ice Mephit
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2

traits.name: Frozen Shell
traits.description: If the mephit is missing any of its Hit Points, its AC is reduced to 12.

traits.name: Chillburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it bursts in a 5-foot Emanation of freezing air; each creature in the area takes 5 Cold damage and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. Until a creature removes the shards as an Action, an affected creature loses 1 Hit Point for each 5 feet it moves.

actions.name: Frostclaw
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) cold damage and the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Bind in Rime
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet whose Speed is reduced must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the end of the mephit's next turn, or until it takes any damage.

name: Light Mephit
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +1, Con +1, Wis -1, Cha +1

traits.name: Revealing Radiance
traits.description: The mephit emits Bright Light in a 15-foot Emanation; creatures in the area can't benefit from Invisibility.

traits.name: Blinding Burst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it bursts in a flash of light; each creature in the area illuminated by its Revealing Radiance is Blinded until the start of its next turn. A creature who is averting its gaze is unaffected by this ability.

actions.name: Glimmerstrike
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) radiant damage and the next attack made against the target before the end of the mephit's next turn has Advantage.

actions.name: Noonflare Ray
actions.description: One creature within 15 feet must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: 7 (2d6) Radiant damage. A Blinded target has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

name: Lightning Mephit
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex +3, Con +1, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Charged Body
traits.description: A creature that hits the mephit with a melee attack loses its Reaction.

traits.name: Sparkburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it bursts in a 5-foot Emanation shower of sparks; each creature in the area takes 5 Lightning damage, plus 1d4 additional Lightning damage if the creature is wearing metal armor.

actions.name: Static Shock
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) lightning damage and the target has Disadvantage on the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Electrify
actions.description: The mephit touches an unattended object, charging it with electricity. The first creature to touch that weapon in the next minute must make a Constitution {{ Saving Throw:}} DC 11. Failure: 7 (2d6) Lightning damage and the creature is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Numb Fingers
reactions.description: Trigger: The mephit is hit with a melee attack using a metal weapon. Response: The attacker must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The attacker drops its weapon and ends its turn.

name: Magma Mephit
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -1, Con +1, Int -1, Cha -1

traits.name: Molten Body
traits.description: If the mephit takes any Cold damage, it becomes Petrified until it is dealt any Fire damage.

traits.name: Magmaburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it bursts in a 5-foot Emanation splash of magma; each creature in the area takes 5 Fire damage and is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Volcanic Slam
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) fire damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet.

actions.name: Sling Lavadrop
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 30 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) fire damage.

reactions.name: Melt Weapon
reactions.description: Trigger: The mephit is hit with a melee attack using a nonmagical metal weapon. Response: After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to attack and damage rolls.

name: Mineral Mephit
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -1, Con +2

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The mephit can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

traits.name: Prismatic Burst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it bursts in a 5-foot Emanation shower of glittering crystal; each creature in the area takes 5 Slashing damage and can't benefit from the Invisible condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Faceted SLash
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fool's Greed
actions.description: The mephit brandishes a worthless gemstone, forcing one creature within 5 feet to make a Wisdom {{ Saving Throw:}} DC 12. Failure: The creature is Charmed and Dazed until the end of the mephit's next turn. This effect ends early if the Charmed creature takes the gemstone from the mephit, or if the mephit is Incapacitated.

reactions.name: Scratchproof Facing
reactions.description: Trigger: The mephit is targeted with an attack that deals Piercing or Slashing damage Response: The mephit adds +2 to its AC against the triggering attack.

name: Mirror Mephit
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +1, Int -2, Wis +1

traits.name: Molten Repair
traits.description: If the mephit is dealt any Fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Fire damage dealt.

traits.name: Shatterburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it shatters in a 5-foot Emanation; each creature in the area takes 5 Slashing damage and has glass shards embedded in its body. Until a creature removes the shards as an Action, an affected creature loses 1 Hit Point for each 5 feet it moves.

actions.name: Glassclaw Slice
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. If the mephit was Invisible, the target takes an additional 3 (1d6) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Clearshine Veil
actions.description: If the mephit is not Bloodied, it becomes invisible and gains the Invisible condition until the end of its next turn, then can move up to half its Speed. This effect ends early if the mephit takes any damage.

actions.name: Mirrorwalk
actions.description: The mephit touches a Small or larger flat, reflective surface, transporting through it to the Mirror Realm from the Prime Material, or vice versa.

reactions.name: Refract Mana
reactions.description: Trigger: The mephit is targeted with a spell of Level 1 or below. Response: The mephit causes the spell to target one additional creature within 15 feet of it.

name: Mud Mephit
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -2, Con +1, Int -2, Wis +1

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The mephit can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

traits.name: Muckburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, sticky mud gushes from it in a 5-foot Emanation; each Medium or smaller creature in the area is Restrained (escape DC 11) until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Mudslap
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. This attack has Advantage against a creature in Difficult Terrain.

actions.name: Soften Earth
actions.description: The ground in a 10-foot Emanation around the mephit becomes Difficult Terrain.

name: Ooze Mephit
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -2, Con +1, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The mephit can move through a space as narrow as 1-inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Oozeburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, acrid ooze splashes out from it in a 5-foot Emanation, covering each creature in the area. Until cleared with an Action, an ooze-covered creature takes 2 (1d4) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Viscid Grip
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). A creature can attempt to escape this grapple by spending half their movement.

actions.name: Leech Minerals
actions.description: One target Grappled by the mephit must make a Constitution {{ Saving Throw:}} DC 11. Failure: 9 (2d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage. This effect deals maximum damage to a target made of inorganic materials, instead of rolling.

name: Salt Mephit
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +2, Int -2, Wis -1, Cha -2

traits.name: Dissolving Weakness
traits.description: If the mephit is doused in water, it must make a Constitution {{ Saving Throw:}} DC 10. Failure: The mephit dies and disintegrates.

traits.name: Saltburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, powdered salt bursts from it in a 5-foot Emanation, covering each creature in the area. Until cleared with an Action or Bonus Action, a salt-covered creature takes 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage whenever it takes damage from another source.

actions.name: Stinging Slash
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. This attack has Advantage against a Bloodied target.

actions.name: Desiccate
actions.description: The mephit touches a creature, draining the moisture from it and forcing it to make a Constitution {{ Saving Throw:}} DC 12. Failure: 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage and the target gains a point of Exhaustion that lasts until the end of the mephit's next turn.

name: Smoke Mephit
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +4, Wis -1, Cha +1

traits.name: Disturbed Dispersal
traits.description: The first time each turn that the mephit takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, it can teleport to an unoccupied space within 15 feet.

traits.name: Smokeburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, smoke billows forth from it in a 10-foot Emanation, Heavily Obscuring the area for 1 minute or until cleared by a strong wind. A creature that casts a spell with a verbal component while in this area begins Choking until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Soot Slash
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage. If the target has taken any Fire damage in the last minute, it takes an additional 2 (1d4) Fire damage.

actions.name: Cinder Ring (Concentration
actions.description: One creature the mephit can see is surrounded in a ring of burning cinders. The first time each turn that the creature moves or is moved at least 5 feet, it takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage, then can make a Dexterity {{ Saving Throw:}} DC 11. Success: The effect ends.

name: Steam Mephit
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex +2, Wis +1

traits.name: Confounding Blur
traits.description: The mephit's attacks have Advantage against creatures with a Passive Perception of 14 lower.

traits.name: Fogburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it bursts in a 15-foot Emanation of dense fog, Heavily Obscuring the area for 1 minute or until cleared by a strong wind.

actions.name: Sweltering Strike
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) fire damage. If this attack had Advantage, the mephit can Grapple the target (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Burden Breath
actions.description: One creature grappled by the mephit must make a Constitution {{ Saving Throw:}} DC 10. Failure: The creature is Dazed until the grapple ends.

name: Void Mephit
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +4, Int -1, Wis -1, Cha -1

traits.name: Void Aura
traits.description: The area in a 5-foot Emanation from the mephit is magically silent and devoid of air; creatures in the area are Choking.

traits.name: Implosion
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it implodes. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation from it takes 5 Force damage and is dragged up to 10 feet towards the mephit's space.

actions.name: Vacuum Scratch
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) force damage and the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the mephit. This attack has Advantage against a target that is Flying or Levitating.

actions.name: Devour Air
actions.description: Each creature in a 15-foot Emanation from the mephit must make a Strength {{ Saving Throw:}} DC 10. Failure: The creature is dragged up to 10 feet toward the mephit and is Restrained (escape DC 10) until the end of the mephit's next turn.

name: Water Mephit
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -1, Int -1, Wis +1

traits.name: Hard Freeze
traits.description: If the mephit takes any Cold damage, it freezes solid, becoming Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Waterburst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, water gushes forth from it in a 5-foot Emanation. Each creature in the area takes 5 Bludgeoning damage, then is knocked Prone if it is small or smaller.

actions.name: Seaspray Slam
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. This attack has Advantage against a target that is at least partially submerged in water.

actions.name: Drench
actions.description: The mephit sprays a stream of frigid water at a creature within 20 feet, forcing it to make a Dexterity {{ Saving Throw:}} DC 10. Failure: 5 (2d4) Cold damage and the creature has Disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal Cold or Lightning damage until the start of its next turn.

name: Cloudscale Melozoa
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +3, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -3
resistances: Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Air Form
traits.description: The melozoa can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any gap large enough for air to pass through without squeezing.

traits.name: Zephyr Tendrils
traits.description: The area within 10 feet of the melozoa counts as difficult terrain for creatures of its choice. A creature that begins its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 13) until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Cutting Jet
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and the melozoa is pushed up to 10 feet from the target.

actions.name: Skyhook Launch
actions.description: One creature grappled by the elemental is flung up to 40 feet upward. A creature that collides with a ceiling or other solid surface takes 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and can make a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw, clinging to the surface on a success.

name: Air Elemental
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +5, Con +2, Int -2, Cha -2
resistances: Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Air Form
traits.description: The elemental can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any gap large enough for air to pass through without squeezing.

traits.name: Updraft
traits.description: A Medium or smaller creature that starts its turn in the elemental's space must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or begin Levitating until the start of its next turn. When the elemental moves, each Levitating creature in its space is moved with it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes two attacks with its Buffeting Slam.

actions.name: Buffeting Slam
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. This attack has Advantage against a levitating or flying target.

actions.name: Whirlwind Fling (Recharge 4–6)
actions.description: Each creature in the elemental's space must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or take 15 (3d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage and be flung up 20 feet away in a random direction and knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success. A thrown target that strikes a creature or solid object takes an additional 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage. A creature struck by a thrown target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Abrupt Ejection
reactions.description: When a creature Levitating in the elemental's space hits it with an attack, the elemental can move up to half its speed, then push the creature up to 10 feet.

name: Invisible Stalker
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +4, Con +2, Wis +2
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
languages: Auran, Understands Common but doesn't speak it

traits.name: Innate Invisibility
traits.description: The stalker is Invisible. If fine particles are scattered in its space, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it uses its Expel Debris.

traits.name: Faultless Tracker
traits.description: The stalker can detect, by scent, the direction and distance to its summoner and to the target named as part of the spell to summon it, as long as each of those creatures are on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The stalker makes two attacks with its Seal Throat, each of which it can replace with a use of its Hammer Lungs or Sudden Gust, if available.

actions.name: Seal Throat
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). While grappled in this way, a creature is Choking.

actions.name: Hammer Lungs
actions.description: The stalker attempts to smash the air from the lungs of a Choking creature within 5 feet that is holding its breath. The target takes 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage, then must succeed on DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or lose its held breath and immediately begin Suffocating.

actions.name: Sudden Gust (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 30 feet in a direction of the stalker's choice. A creature the stalker is Hidden from makes this saving throw with Disadvantage.

reactions.name: Expel Debris
reactions.description: When the stalker is reduced below 53 Hit Points, it can purge itself of particles suspended in its form, then can attempt to Hide.

name: Breathdrinker
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +5, Con +3, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Innate Invisibility
traits.description: The breathdrinker is Invisible. If fine particles are scattered in its space, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it uses its Expel Debris.

traits.name: Breath Tracker
traits.description: The breathdrinker can detect, by scent, the direction and distance to each creature on the same plane of existence that has been affected by its Breath Siphon.

actions.name: Breath Siphon
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: An Invisible tether of breath ties the creature to the breathdrinker. Until the breathdrinker uses this ability again or the creature moves more than 40 feet away from it, the target is Dazed.

actions.name: Wind Scythe
actions.description: The stalker sends forth a plane of pressurized air in a 15-foot cone, cutting cleanly through each Medium or smaller unattended nonmagical object in the area. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Slashing damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

bonusActions.name: Breath Mimicry (Concentration)
bonusActions.description: The breathdrinker wrenches air from the lungs of a creature affected by its Breath Siphon, forcing it to succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or begin Suffocating. While using this ability, the breathdrinker appears as a misty, red-eyed duplicate of its target, and cannot benefit from Invisibility.

bonusActions.name: Expel Debris
bonusActions.description: The breathdrinker purges itself of particles suspended in its form, then can attempt to Hide.

name: Havocwind
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +12, Con +9, Int +1, Wis +6, Cha +3
resistances: Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Squallshield
traits.description: Ranged attacks made against creatures within 30 feet of the havocwind have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Howling Gyre
traits.description: The havocwind can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. A Huge or smaller creature that that starts its turn in the havocwind's space must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage and begin Levitating (escape DC 20). When the havocwind moves, each Levitating creature in its space is moved with it.

traits.name: Wandering Destruction
traits.description: Whenever the havocwind takes 20 or more damage from a single source, it moves up to 10 feet in a random lateral direction.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The havocwind makes two attacks with its Downdraft Slam, one of which it can replace with a use of its Ploughwind Drive

actions.name: Downdraft Slam
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 20 ft. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone. A Levitating creature hit with this attack takes an additional 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage and immediately stops Levitating.

actions.name: Ploughwind Drive
actions.description: The havocwind moves up to its speed in a straight line. Each Huge or smaller creature whose space the havocwind enters in this way must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage and begin Levitating within the havocwind (escape DC 20).

actions.name: Gyre Twist (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The cyclone's winds pick up, forcing each creature Levitating within it to make a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage plus an additional 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage for each other creature Levitating in the havocwind's space, or takes half as much damage on a success

name: Slingrock Blocklet
savingThrows: Str +1, Con +1, Int -3, Wis -2, Cha -3
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Sources
immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Weathering Weakness
traits.description: If the blocklet is doused in water or takes any Acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

traits.name: Living Weapon
traits.description: The blocklet counts as a Simple Melee Weapon with the Thrown Property (range 20/60, 2d4 bludgeoning).

actions.name: Hurl Self
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. or range 20 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the blocklet lands prone in the target's space.

actions.name: Stub-Toe Hazard
actions.description: The blocklet plants itself firmly and ends its turn. Until the start of its next turn, creatures in the blocklet's space fall prone if they fail a Strength or Dexterity-based check or saving throw, in addition to any other effects.

reactions.name: Skipping Tumble
reactions.description:
When the blocklet takes any damage that would not reduce it to 0 Hit Points, it can reduce that damage to 1. If it does, the blocklet is pushed up to 20 feet away from the damage's source and falls prone.


 Design Note: Living Weapon and Hurl Self. The blocklet is not intended to take damage when using its Hurl Self action or Living Weapon trait in most typical circumstances.

name: Geoderm
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha -3
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Sources
immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The geoderm can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

traits.name: Weathering Weakness
traits.description: If the geoderm is doused in water or takes any Acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

actions.name: Jagged Crash
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target must choose one of the following: The target is pushed 5 feet away. The target takes an additional 4 (1d8) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Gleamvein Absorption
actions.description: The geoderm attempts to absorb a spell effect within 5 feet of it, making a Constitution Saving Throw against a DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level. On a success, the spell ends and the geoderm's melee attacks have Advantage for the next minute. On a failure, the geoderm explodes in a spray of shrapnel, dealing 7 (2d6) Slashing damage to each creature within 10 feet of it.

name: Earth Elemental
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex -1, Con +5, Int -3, Cha -3
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Sources
immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

traits.name: Weathering Weakness
traits.description: If the elemental is doused in water or takes any Acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes two attacks with its Boulder-Fist Slam.

actions.name: Boulder-Fist Slam
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit with this attack must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Shatter Earth (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The elemental strikes the earth, sending forth a violent shockwave in a 30-foot cone. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage and fall prone, or half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Eternal Impression
reactions.description: When the elemental scores a critical hit with its Boulder-Fist Slam against a prone target, it can press the creature into a solid surface beneath it. The target is Restrained (escape DC 16) as the surface conforms to its body. The restraining material can be broken (AC 17, 15 HP), freeing the creature.

name: Lodestone Marauder
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex -1, Con +6, Int -2, Cha -3
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Sources
immunities: Lightning, Poison; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Ironflake Aura
traits.description: The marauder is surrounded by a cloud of razor-sharp metal flakes. Another creature that moves within 10 feet of the marauder takes 5 (2d4) Slashing damage for each 5 feet it moves.

traits.name: Weathering Weakness
traits.description: If the marauder is doused in water or takes any Acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The marauder makes three attacks with its Dipole Smash, each of which it can replace with a use of its Razor Sweep, if available.

actions.name: Dipole Smash
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away. If the target is wearing metal armor, before making this attack the marauder can drag the creature up to 15 feet toward it.

actions.name: Razor Sweep (2/Day)
actions.description: A torrent of metal flakes sweeeps forth from the marauder in a 20-foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Slashing damage and begin Bleeding (1d4).

bonusActions.name: Lodestone's Claim
bonusActions.description: Each Small or smaller metal object within 20 feet is magnetically dragged into the marauder's space and becomes Attached to it (Remove DC 18). Each creature in the area can make a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw, preventing objects it is carrying from being affected on a success.

bonusActions.name: Churn Grindfield
bonusActions.description: The elemental magnetically shreds a nonmagical metal object Attached to it, regaining one expended use of its Razor Sweep.

name: Rubblehulk
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex -1, Con +6, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha -3
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Sources
immunities: Lightning, Poison; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Demolition Animus
traits.description: Whenever the rubblehulk deals any damage to a stone object, structure, or surface with a melee attack, it absorbs the rubble, regaining a number of Hit Points equal to the damage dealt.

traits.name: Weathering Weakness
traits.description: If the rubblehulk is doused in water or takes any Acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rubblehulk makes three attacks with its Pillar-Rock Press, one of which it can replace with a use of its Flagstone Bombardment.

actions.name: Pillar-Rock Press
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A prone target hit with this attack must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or lose the use of a limb of its choice until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Flagstone Bombardment
actions.description: The rubblehulk lobs a volley of stones at a target it can see within 60 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is knocked prone, additionally.

reactions.name: Rubblework Avalanche
reactions.description: When the elemental destroys a wall or structure with a melee attack, it can send a cascade of rubble sliding forth in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone and restrained (escape DC 19).

name: Scorch-Mort
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +2, Con -1, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Sources
immunities: Fire, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Air-Hungry
traits.description: If the scorch-mort takes any Cold damage, or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish. Until the end of its next turn, the scorch-mort can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the Burning condition.

actions.name: Kindlescratch Claws
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Fire damage. If the target has taken any other Fire damage since the end of the scorch-mort's last turn, it begins Burning (1d10).

reactions.name: Snuffsmoke Remnant
reactions.description: When the scorch-mort is reduced to 0 Hit Points by a source it can see, it can turn into a wisp of dark smoke that dissipates at the end of its next turn. If this smoke is dealt any Fire damage, the scorch-mort returns to life with full Hit Points.

name: Pyreling
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex +2, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Sources
immunities: Fire, Poison; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Air-Hungry
traits.description: If the pyreling takes any Cold damage or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish. Until the end of its next turn, the pyreling can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the Burning condition.

actions.name: Spit Fire
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. or range 15 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target has taken any other Fire damage since the end of the pyreling's last turn, it begins Burning (1d10).

actions.name: Devour Flames
actions.description: The pyreling ends the Burning condition on a creature within 15 feet, consuming the flames and gaining 5 (1d10) Temporary Hit Points that last for a minute. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it can make an attack with its Spit Fire as a Bonus Action.

reactions.name: Skitterflame Leap
reactions.description: When the pyreling or a creature within 10 feet of it is dealt any Fire damage, the pyreling can jump up to 15 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: Fire Elemental
savingThrows: Dex +3, Con +3, Int -2, Cha -2
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Sources
immunities: Fire, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Air-Hungry
traits.description: If the elemental takes any Cold damage or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish. Until the end of its next turn, the elemental can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the Burning condition.

traits.name: Fire Incarnate
traits.description: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing, and can move through and stop in the space of other creatures. A creature who has the elemental enter its space for the first time in a turn takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage and begins Burning (1d10).

actions.name: Stoke
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) fire damage. A Burning target takes an additional 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Seethe
actions.description: The elemental's flames darken and roil. The first time the elemental takes any non-Cold damage before the start of its next turn, flame bursts forth from it in a 15-foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Fire damage and be pushed up to 5 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Flashover (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the elemental is reduced below 52 Hit Points, it can cause each creature and flammable object within 20 feet of it to begin Burning (1d10). A creature or object in the area that is already Burning instead takes 16 (3d10) Fire damage.

name: Plasmastrider
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +3, Int -4, Wis +3
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Sources
immunities: Fire, Poison; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Air-Hungry
traits.description: If the plasmastrider takes any Cold damage or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish. Until the end of its next turn, the plasmastrider can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the Burning condition.

traits.name: Plasma Conduit
traits.description: The plasmastrider has Disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal Lightning damage, and attacks that deal Lightning damage have Advantage against it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The plasmastrider makes two attacks with its Blueflame Impact, one of which it can replace with a use of its Lob Fluxflame or Incinerating Embrace.

actions.name: Blueflame Impact
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) fire damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away. On a hit or miss, each Burning creature within 5 feet of the target takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Lob Fluxflame
actions.description: The plasmastrider hurls a glob of crawling blue flames at a point within 60 feet where it explodes in a 5-foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Fire damage and begin Burning (1d10). A creature that the Burning creature ends its turn within 5 feet of begins Burning (1d10).

actions.name: Incinerating Embrace (Concentration)
actions.description: The plasmastrider lunges at a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 15) until the plasmastrider moves or loses concentration. The restrained creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage at the end of each creature's turn. A creature killed in this way is reduced to ash.

name: Spitefire Crawler
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +3, Con +4, Int -1, Wis +3
immunities: Fire, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Sources; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Air-Hungry
traits.description: If the crawler takes any Cold damage or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish. Until the end of its next turn, the crawler can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the Burning condition.

traits.name: Blazing Trail
traits.description: When the crawler moves through a space, each flammable object and surface in that space begins Burning. Until extinguished, a creature that enters that space for the first time on a turn takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Pureflame Slash
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) fire damage plus Hit: 16 (3d10) force damage. This attack has Advantage against any creature not resistant or immune to Fire damage.

actions.name: Spitefire Flare
actions.description: A towering plume of baleful flame erupts from the ground beneath on a creature the crawler can see within 60 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) Fire damage and begin Burning (1d10).

bonusActions.name: Razing Rush
bonusActions.description: The crawler moves up to its speed in a straight line and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. Each creature whose space it enters in this way must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Fire damage and be knocked prone, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

bonusActions.name: Spitefire Eruption (Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.description: The crawler uses its Spitefire Flare three times, choosing targets at random from hostile creatures it can see.

name: Pyroclasm Vortex
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +10, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +3, Cha +7
immunities: Fire, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Sources; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Fire Incarnate
traits.description: The vortex can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing, and can move through and stop in the space of other creatures. A creature who has the vortex enter its space for the first time in a turn takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage and begins Burning (1d10).

traits.name: Raze-Winds
traits.description: A Large or smaller creature whose space the vortex enters for the first time on a turn, or that starts its turn in the vortex's space, must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be carried aloft and restrained (escape DC 18) in the vortex. Burning creatures in the vortex's space take maximum damage from the condition, instead of rolling.

traits.name: Air-Hungry
traits.description: If the vortex takes any Cold damage or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish. Until the end of its next turn, the vortex can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the Burning condition.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the vortex fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vortex makes four attacks with its Furnace-Gust Grasp, or makes two attacks and uses its Burning Whorl.

actions.name: Furnace-Gust Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 20 ft. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) fire damage and the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the vortex's center. A flammable object hit with this attack catches fire.

actions.name: Burning Whorl
actions.description: Each creature in the vortex's space must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) Fire damage, or half as much on a success. A Burning creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more has its Burning value increase by a cumulative 1d10 until it leaves the vortex's space.

actions.name: Fireburst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The vortex flares explosively, searing each creature within 10 feet of it. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d8) Fire damage, or take half as much damage on a success. On a success or failure, each creature restrained in the vortex is hurled 30 feet in a random direction and takes an additional 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Guttering Revival
reactions.description: When the vortex uses its Implacable trait, it can teleport up to 90 feet to a space that contains an open flame, then make two melee attacks.

reactions.name: Scorch Lungs
reactions.description: When a creature in the vortex's space speaks or casting a spell with a verbal component, the vortex can force the creature to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Fire damage and begin Suffocating (Save Ends at end of turn).

name: Spraylark
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2, Int -2, Wis +1
immunities: Acid, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Restrained, Prone, Unconscious

traits.name: Water Form
traits.description: The elemental can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Hard Freeze
traits.description: If the elemental takes any Cold damage, it freezes solid, becoming Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Brineswipe Dive
actions.description: The spraylark flies up to 10 feet in a straight line without provoking attacks of opportunity. A creature whose space it enters in this way must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Cold damage and be Blinded until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Frigid Cascade
actions.description: The spraylark begins to shed a spray of chilling droplets in a 5-foot radius. Until the start of its next turn, creatures in the area add 1d4 to saving throws against effects that deal Fire damage, and subtract 1d4 from saving throws against effects that deal Cold damage.

name: Water Weird
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +1
resistances: Fire; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical attacks
immunities: Acid, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Restrained, Prone, Unconscious

traits.name: Water-Bound
traits.description: The weird dies if it begins or ends its turn more than 5 feet away from a body of water.

traits.name: Creeping Freeze
traits.description: If the weird takes any Cold damage, it partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the weird ignores its damage resistances and its speeds are reduced to 10 feet.

actions.name: Slithering Coil
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit with this attack is pulled into the weird's space and grappled (escape DC 13) until the weird uses this attack again.

actions.name: Lung Gush
actions.description: The weird blasts a burst of water into the lungs of an air-breathing creature grappled by it, forcing it to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Bludgeoning damage and immediately begin Suffocating. As an action, it or a creature within 5 feet can allow it to repeat this saving throw, expelling the water and ending the effect on a success.

bonusActions.name: Twisting Arc
bonusActions.description: The weird leaps up to 30 feet through the air from one space of open water to another. At any point in this jump, the weird can use its action to make an attack with its Slithering Coils.

bonusActions.name: Laminar Shimmer
bonusActions.description: If the weird is fully submerged in clear water and doesn't have a creature grappled, it can become Invisible until the start of its next turn. This Invisibility ends early if the weird makes an attack or takes any Cold damage.

name: Water Elemental
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +4, Int -3, Cha -1
resistances: Fire; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Acid, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Water Form
traits.description: The elemental can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. Large or smaller air-breathing creatures in the elemental's space are Choking.

traits.name: Creeping Freeze
traits.description: If the elemental takes any Cold damage, it partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the elemental ignores its damage resistances and its speeds are reduced to 10 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes two attacks with its Crashing Slam, one of which it can replace with a use of its Whelm.

actions.name: Crashing Slam
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A target that is holding its breath must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or lose its breath and begin Suffocating.

actions.name: Whelm (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The elemental lurches up to 10 feet, then can force each creature in its space to succeed on DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage, or be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space on a success. A Large or smaller creature that fails this saving throw is additionally grappled (escape DC 15), and is Restrained while grappled in this way.

reactions.name: Vengeful Surge
reactions.description: When the elemental is missed with a melee attack, it can use its Whelm, if available.

name: Griptide
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +2, Con +9, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha -1
resistances: Fire; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Acid, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Water Form
traits.description: The griptide can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. Large or smaller air-breathing creatures in the griptide's space are Choking.

traits.name: Creeping Freeze
traits.description: If the griptide takes any Cold damage, it partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the griptide ignores its damage resistances and its speeds are reduced to 10 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The griptide makes four attacks with its Hands of the Deep, or makes one attack and uses its Scouring Tide.

actions.name: Hands of the Deep
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 15 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 17). The griptide can grapple any number of creatures in this way.

actions.name: Scouring Tide
actions.description: The griptide sends a wave of sand and debris tumbling forth in a 30-foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Slashing damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success. A creature released from the griptide's grapple as a result of failing this saving throw takes an additional 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Drag Out
bonusActions.description: Each creature grappled by the griptide must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or be dragged up to 20 feet toward the griptide's center.

bonusActions.name: Pressure Spike
bonusActions.description: A pulse of intense pressure ripples through the griptide, forcing each other creature in its space to succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Thunder damage.

name: Waterveiled Assassin
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +9, Con +8, Wis +3
resistances: Fire; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Acid, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Whelming Wave
traits.description: The assassin can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A Huge or smaller creature whose space the assassin enters for the first time on a turn, or that starts its turn in the assassin's space, must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled and restrained (escape DC 19).

traits.name: Creeping Freeze
traits.description: If the assassin takes any Cold damage, it partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the assassin ignores its damage resistances and its speeds are reduced to 10 feet.

actions.name: Shipbreaker Slam
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 84 (12d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Tumbling Churn
actions.description: Each creature in the assassin's space must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A target that was holding its breath and fails this saving throw by 5 or more loses its breath and begins Suffocating.

reactions.name: Surge Wave
reactions.description: When the assassin is missed with a melee attack, it can move up to 10 feet directly toward the attacker.

reactions.name: Liquid Dodge
reactions.description: When the assassin would make a saving throw, it can make a Dexterity Saving Throw of the same DC instead. On a success, the assassin suffers no harmful effects.

name: Seamaw Vortex
savingThrows: Str +13, Dex -2, Con +12, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha +4
resistances: Fire; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Acid, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Vortex Trap
traits.description: The vortex can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. Water revolves around the vortex in a 120-foot radius. Aquatic travel away from the vortex or against the direction of its spin costs three times as much movement. A Gargantuan or smaller creature or vehicle that starts its turn in the area is dragged 10 feet toward its center and up to 30 feet in the direction of the vortex's spin.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the vortex fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vortex makes two attacks with its Swiftwater Crash, one of which it can replace with a use of its Maelstrom Grind.

actions.name: Swiftwater Crash
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 120 ft. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet in a lateral direction of the vortex's choice. A creature or vehicle the target is pushed into in this way must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or take half the attack's damage.

actions.name: Maelstrom Grind
actions.description: Each creature and vehicle in the area of the vortex's Vortex Trap must make a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, a target takes 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage and is dragged up to 5 feet in the direction of the vortex's spin for each point it failed by.

actions.name: Yawning Void
actions.description: The vortex forces one creature or object within 10 feet of its center to succeed on a DC 21 Strength or Dexterity (target's choice) saving throw or be Swallowed (escape DC 21). At the beginning of each of the vortex's turns, each creature and vehicle Swallowed by it takes 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage and descends 100 feet toward the seafloor.

reactions.name: Raging Reversal (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the vortex is reduced below 180 Hit Points, it can suspend the effect of its Vortex Trap until the start of its next turn, at which point the vortex begins spinning in the opposite direction. If it does, the vortex can use its Yawning Void as a Bonus Action on each of its turns for the next minute.

name: Air Myrmidon
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +2, Int -1

traits.name: Chained Essence
traits.description: If the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the Charmed or Possessed conditions, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The myrmidon dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The myrmidon makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with its Razor Whirl or Updraft.

actions.name: Cloudsteel War-Fan
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 15 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet. This attack has Advantage against a target that is Flying or Levitating.

actions.name: Razor Whirl
actions.description: Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation from the myrmidon must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 13 (3d8) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Updraft (Concentration)
actions.description: One creature the myrmidon can see within 30 feet must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target rises 10 feet into the air and is Levitating for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

reactions.name: Zephyr Rush
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature moves or is pushed out of the myrmidon's reach. Response: The myrmidon moves up to half its Speed.

reactions.name: Bolt-Slice
reactions.description: Trigger: The myrmidon would be hit with a ranged attack. Response: The myrmidon gains +3 to its AC against the triggering attack.

name: Ash Myrmidon
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +2, Int -1
immunities: Fire, Poison; Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Chained Essence
traits.description: If the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the Charmed or Possessed conditions, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The myrmidon dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The myrmidon makes two attacks and can use its Ember Crash or Snuff Out.

actions.name: Ashwake Halberd
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) poison damage. This attack has Advantage against a Burning target.

actions.name: Ember Crash
actions.description: The myrmidon slams into a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target is pushed 10 feet away and begins Burning (1d10).

actions.name: Snuff Out
actions.description: One Burning creature within 15 feet has the Burning condition end for it, then must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 9 (2d8) Cold damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Wheeze Cinder
reactions.description: Trigger: The myrmidon is hit with a melee attack. Response: Each creature in a 5-foot Emanation from the myrmidon takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

name: Dust Myrmidon
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +2, Int -1

traits.name: Chained Essence
traits.description: If the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the Charmed or Possessed conditions, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The myrmidon dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The myrmidon makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with its Dust Clog or Tomb Gout.

actions.name: Cramblade Stiletto
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If this attack had Advantage, it deals an additional 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage on a hit.

actions.name: Dust Clog
actions.description: The myrmidon forces a creature within 5 feet to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature is Choking for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn), or until the creature ends this effect as an Action.

actions.name: Tomb Gout
actions.description: Decayed dust spews from the myrmidon in a 15-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage and the target is Blinded until the end of the myrmidon's next turn.

reactions.name: Detonate
reactions.description: Trigger: The myrmidon would take any Fire damage. Response: The myrmidon gains Vulnerability to the triggering damage. Then, each other creature in a 15-foot Emanation from it must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature takes an equal amount of Fire damage.

name: Earth Myrmidon
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +3, Int -1

traits.name: Chained Essence
traits.description: If the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the Charmed or Possessed conditions, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The myrmidon dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The myrmidon makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with its Earthbreak Rush or Quake Slam.

actions.name: Meteor Greataxe
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (3d12 + 4) slashing damage. This attack scores a Critical Hit on a 15-20 against a Prone target.

actions.name: Earthbreak Rush
actions.description: The myrmidon moves up to half its Speed, then can make an attack with Advantage. On a hit, the target is additionally pushed up to 15 feet away.

actions.name: Quake Slam
actions.description: The myrmidon strikes the ground, forcing each creature in a 15-foot Emanation from it to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage and the creature falls Prone.

reactions.name: Earthen Endurance
reactions.description: Trigger: The myrmidon takes any Piercing, or Slashing damage. Response: The myrmidon gains Resistance to the triggering damage.

name: Fire Myrmidon
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +2, Int -1
immunities: Fire, Poison; Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Air-Hungry
traits.description: If the myrmidon takes any Cold damage, or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish. Until the end of its next turn, the myrmidon can't take Reactions or use its Flamewheel Dash.

traits.name: Chained Essence
traits.description: If the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the Charmed or Possessed conditions, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The myrmidon dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The myrmidon makes two attacks and can use its Flamewheel Dash.

actions.name: Inferno Lash
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Flamewheel Dash
actions.description: The myrmidon flies up to half its Speed in a straight line; each creature it flies within 5 feet of in this way must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature begins Burning (1d10). A creature that makes an Opportunity Attack provoked by this movement has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

reactions.name: Sudden Flare
reactions.description: Trigger: A Burning creature targets the myrmidon with a melee attack. Response: The attacker takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage and gains Disadvantage on the attack.

name: Ice Myrmidon
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -1
immunities: Cold, Poison; Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Springmelt
traits.description: While the myrmidon is Bloodied, it has Vulnerability to Fire damage.

traits.name: Chained Essence
traits.description: If the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the Charmed or Possessed conditions, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The myrmidon dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The myrmidon makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Frost Lock.

actions.name: Rimecast Blade
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Hailstream
actions.description: Attack: +7 range 30 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Frost Lock
actions.description: One creature the myrmidon can see within 60 feet takes Cold damage equal to twice the number of Temporary Hit Points that it has, then must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature is Restrained until the end of the myrmidon's next turn.

reactions.name: Freezing Retort
reactions.description: Trigger: The myrmidon is hit with a melee attack. Response: The attacker takes 13 (3d8) Cold damage, then gains an equal amount of Temporary Hit Points.

name: Light Myrmidon
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -1
immunities: Poison, Radiant; Blinded, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Revealing Radiance
traits.description: The myrmidon emits Bright Light in a 15-foot Emanation; creatures in the area can't benefit from Invisibility.

traits.name: Chained Essence
traits.description: If the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the Charmed or Possessed conditions, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The myrmidon dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The myrmidon makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Blistering Glare.

actions.name: Sunstrike Flail
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 4 (1d8) radiant damage. On a Critical Hit, the target is Blinded until the end of the myrmidon's next turn.

actions.name: Blistering Glare
actions.description: The myrmidon shines an unbearable light in a 15-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 13 (3d8) Radiant damage and the next attack against the target has Advantage. Success: Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Bolster Life
bonusActions.description: The myrmidon loses 10 Hit Points, then one of its allies within 15 feet gains 10 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the creature has Advantage on Attack Rolls and Constitution Saving Throws.

reactions.name: Sudden Flash
reactions.description: Trigger: The myrmidon is targeted with a melee attack. Response: The attack gains Disadvantage; if it misses, the myrmidon can make a melee attack against the attacker as part of this Reaction.

name: Lightning Myrmidon
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +2, Int -1
