immunities: Lightning, Poison; Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Charged Body
traits.description: A creature that hits the myrmidon with a melee attack loses its Reaction.

traits.name: Chained Essence
traits.description: If the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the Charmed or Possessed conditions, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The myrmidon dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The myrmidon makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Bridgebolt.

actions.name: Static Lance
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

actions.name: Bridgebolt
actions.description: The myrmidon hurls a bolt of energy at a creature it can see within 60 feet, forcing it to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 21 (6d6) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage. Then, if the target is wearing metal armor, the myrmidon can teleport to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it.

reactions.name: Spiteful Jolt
reactions.description: Trigger: The myrmidon is hit with a melee attack. Response: The attacker takes 7 (2d6) Lightning damage and the next attack it makes this turn has Disadvantage.

name: Magma Myrmidon
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -1

traits.name: Molten Core
traits.description: If the myrmidon takes any Cold damage, it is Paralyzed until the start of its next turn, or until it is dealt any Fire damage.

traits.name: Chained Essence
traits.description: If the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the Charmed or Possessed conditions, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The myrmidon dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The myrmidon makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use if its Molten Fissure.

actions.name: Magma Hammer
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Molten Fissure
actions.description: A spray of magma bursts from the ground in a 20-foot long, 5-foot wide Line extending from the myrmidon, forcing each creature in the area to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 10 (3d6) Fire damage and the creature falls Prone. A Prone creature has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Eruption-Blast
actions.description: Molten debris explodes from the myrmidon in a 15-foot Emanation, forcing each creature in the area to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 17 (5d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage. Then, the myrmidon can leap up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

reactions.name: Melt Weapon
reactions.description: Trigger: The myrmidon is hit with a melee attack using a nonmagical metal weapon. Response: After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to attack and damage rolls.

name: Mineral Myrmidon
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -1
immunities: Poison, Radiant; Blinded, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Inner Brilliance
traits.description: If the myrmidon is dealt any Radiant damage, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation from it is Blinded until the start of the creature's next turn.

traits.name: Chained Essence
traits.description: If the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the Charmed or Possessed conditions, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The myrmidon dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The myrmidon makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with its Dazzling Display.

actions.name: Crystalline Spear
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage. This attack scores a Critical Hit on an 18-20 against a target that is Concentrating on a spell.

actions.name: Dazzling Display
actions.description: Scintillating colors dance through the air in a 30-foot Cone extending from the myrmidon, forcing each creature in the area to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: Until the end of the myrmidon's next turn, the creature is Dazed and attacks against it have Advantage.

reactions.name: Harden Facet
reactions.description: Trigger: The myrmidon is targeted with an attack. Response: The myrmidon adds +5 to its AC against the triggering attack. If the attack hits, it becomes a Critical Hit.

name: Mirror Myrmidon
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -1

traits.name: Molten Repair
traits.description: If the myrmidon is dealt any Fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Fire damage dealt.

traits.name: Chained Essence
traits.description: If the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the Charmed or Possessed conditions, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The myrmidon dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The myrmidon makes three attacks, or makes one attack and uses its Clearshine Veil or Mirrorwalk.

actions.name: Razor Greatshard
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target begins Bleeding (1d6).

actions.name: Mirrorwalk
actions.description: The myrmidon touches a Medium or larger flat, reflective surface, transporting through it to the Mirror Realm from the Prime Material, or vice versa.

actions.name: Clearshine Veil
actions.description: If the myrmidon is not Bloodied, it becomes invisible and gains the Invisible condition until the end of its next turn, then can move up to half its Speed. This effect ends early if the myrmidon takes any damage.

reactions.name: Refract Mana
reactions.description: Trigger: The myrmidon is targeted with a spell of Level 2 or below. Response: The myrmidon causes the spell to target one additional creature within 15 feet of it.

name: Mud Myrmidon
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -1

traits.name: Slipstride
traits.description: The myrmidon's movement is not hindered by Difficult Terrain, and it can attempt to escape from a Grapple or Restraint as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Chained Essence
traits.description: If the myrmidon is targeted with a spell or magical effect that could end the Charmed or Possessed conditions, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The myrmidon dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The myrmidon makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Mire Down.

actions.name: Mudslide Maul
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (3d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away. This attack has Advantage against a target in Difficult Terrain.

actions.name: Sludge-Shot
actions.description: Attack: +5 range 40 ft. Hit: 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the area in a 10-foot Emanation from the target becomes Difficult Terrain.

actions.name: Mire Down
actions.description: The myrmidon forces one creature in Difficult Terrain within 60 feet to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature is Restrained (escape DC 15).

name: Ooze Myrmidon
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +2, Int -1
immunities: Acid, Poison; Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Slipstride

languages: The languages spoken by a creature Possessed by one of its Biome Cores.

traits.name: Invulnerable Titan
traits.description: Whenever the genius loci takes damage from a source other than its Biome Cores trait, it reduces that damage by 40, to a minimum of 0.

traits.name: Tectonic Pace
traits.description: The genius loci does not roll Initiative or take turns in combat. It regains its Legendary Actions on Initiative count 0.

traits.name: Biome Cores
traits.description: The genius loci has six Biome Cores, spectral organs that act as focuses for its elemental power. Whenever one of its Biome Cores takes damage, the genius loci takes the same amount of damage. If the genius loci goes four hours without losing any Hit Points, it regains one of its lost Biome Cores and 250 Hit Points. It can't otherwise regain Hit Points.

traits.name: Primeval Avatar
traits.description: If reduced to 0 Hit Points, the genius loci becomes dormant for an indefinite length of time but does not die. After 2d100 years, it may be awoken by powerful druidic magic, such as a Storm of Vengeance spell.

legendaryActions.name: Terrain Shift
legendaryActions.description: The genius loci subtly alters its terrain, adding or removing any number of areas of Difficult Terrain or terrain features that offer cover.

legendaryActions.name: Alter Core
legendaryActions.description: One of the genius loci's Biome Cores transforms into a different Biome Core; the transformed core retains its current Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Surface Core (Recharge 5-6)
legendaryActions.description: The genius loci draws forth one of its remaining Biome Cores, causing it to emerge in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of a creature on the genius loci's surface. If the genius loci is Bloodied, it can instead draw forth each of its remaining Biome Cores.

name: Dune Core
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +11, Con +7, Int -5, Wis +16, Cha +17

traits.name: Desolate Touch
traits.description: Whenever the core or a creature Possessed by it forces another creature to make a saving throw, the target loses one unexpended Hit Die, or gains a point of Exhaustion if it can't.

traits.name: Spirit Well
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the core can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The core makes four attacks, two of which can be with its Dune Lash.

actions.name: Spirit Thrash
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) force damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Dune Lash
actions.description: Attack: +15 range 60 ft. Hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) slashing damage. *Hit or Miss:* Each other creature in a 10-foot Emanation from the target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 14 (4d6) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Flensing Gale (Concentration)
actions.description: Sand begins to whip around the core in a 20-foot Emanation, Heavily Obscuring the area. When a creature starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn, the core can force it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 27 (5d10) Slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Inhabit Vessel (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the core must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature is Possessed by the core until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Only one of a genius loci's cores can possess a creature in this way at a time, and a creature that this effect ends for becomes immune to it for 24 hours.

name: Flood Core
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +11, Con +7, Int -5, Wis +16, Cha +17

traits.name: Mana Cascade
traits.description: A creature Possessed by the core can cast any spells it knows of Level 5 or lower without expending spell slots, and adds a +10 bonus to any saving throws it makes to maintain Concentration.

traits.name: Spirit Well
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the core can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The core makes four attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Droplet Lock.

actions.name: Spirit Thrash
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) force damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Purewater Barrage
actions.description: Attack: +15 range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit with this attack for the second time in one turn is knocked Prone.

actions.name: Droplet Lock (Concentration)
actions.description: A clinging blob of water coalesces around the head of a creature the core can see within 60 feet, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage and the creature begins Choking (Save Ends at end of turn). Failure by 5 or More: The creature can't hold its Breath and immediately begins Suffocating.

bonusActions.name: Inhabit Vessel (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the core must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature is Possessed by the core until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Only one of a genius loci's cores can possess a creature in this way at a time, and a creature that this effect ends for becomes immune to it for 24 hours.

name: Glacier Core
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +11, Con +7, Int -5, Wis +16, Cha +17

traits.name: Winter's Wrath
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, a creature Possessed by the core gains 30 Temporary Hit Points. Whenever it loses the last of these Temporary Hit Points, each other creature within 15 of it takes 18 (4d8) Cold damage.

traits.name: Spirit Well
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the core can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The core makes two attacks and uses its Biting Ice or Sap Vigor.

actions.name: Spirit Thrash
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) force damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Biting Ice
actions.description: One creature the core can see within 150 feet must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 36 (8d8) Cold damage and, if the creature is within 5 feet of a surface, it is Restrained in place (escape DC 23) until the next time it is hit with an attack or forced to move.

actions.name: Sap Vigor
actions.description: Each creature of the core's choice in a 10-foot Emanation from it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 22 (5d8) Cold damage and the target is Dazed until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Inhabit Vessel (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the core must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature is Possessed by the core until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Only one of a genius loci's cores can possess a creature in this way at a time, and a creature that this effect ends for becomes immune to it for 24 hours.

name: Quagmire Core
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +11, Con +7, Int -5, Wis +16, Cha +17

traits.name: Mire's Claim
traits.description: Other creatures treat the area within 20 feet of the core or a creature Possessed by it as Difficult Terrain. Whenever a creature Possessed by the core deals damage to a target, it can move the target up to 10 feet in any direction.

traits.name: Spirit Well
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the core can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The core makes two attacks and uses its Muck Tendril.

actions.name: Spirit Thrash
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) force damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Muck Tendril
actions.description: A river of mud lunges from the earth, forcing one creature within 150 feet to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 45 (10d8) Bludgeoning damage and the creature is dragged 30 feet in a direction of the core's choice.

actions.name: Drag Down
actions.description: Each non-Flying creature in a 20-foot Emanation from the core must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature is dragged partially into the ground and Restrained (escape DC 23). A creature that was already Restrained sinks fully below the surface, becoming Blinded and Choking for as long as it remains Restrained.

bonusActions.name: Inhabit Vessel (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the core must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature is Possessed by the core until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Only one of a genius loci's cores can possess a creature in this way at a time, and a creature that this effect ends for becomes immune to it for 24 hours.

name: Savage Core
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +11, Con +7, Int -5, Wis +16, Cha +17

traits.name: Savage Speed
traits.description: A creature Possessed by the core can make two Melee Weapon Attacks on each of its turns as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Untamed Aura
traits.description: Allied Beasts and Plants within 1 mile of the core can use its Attack Bonus (+15) and Save DC (23) in place of their own.

traits.name: Spirit Well
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the core can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The core makes four attacks, or makes one attack and uses its Primal Tide.

actions.name: Spirit Thrash
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) force damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Primal Tide
actions.description: Spectral beasts surge forth in a 15-foot Emanation from the core, forcing each creature of the core's choice in the area to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 36 (8d8) Piercing damage and the creature falls Prone. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Feed the Pack
actions.description: Each creature of the core's choice within 100 feet gains 25 Temporary Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Inhabit Vessel (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the core must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature is Possessed by the core until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Only one of a genius loci's cores can possess a creature in this way at a time, and a creature that this effect ends for becomes immune to it for 24 hours.

name: Spire Core
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +11, Con +7, Int -5, Wis +16, Cha +17

traits.name: Towering Might
traits.description: A creature Possessed by the core becomes size Huge; its Melee Attack Rolls have Advantage and deal an additional 2d12 damage on a hit.

traits.name: Spirit Well
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the core can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The core makes three attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Grindstone Spire.

actions.name: Spirit Thrash
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 10 ft. Hit: 38 (5d12 + 6) force damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Grindstone Spire
actions.description: A 10-foot wide pillar of stone thrusts up to 60 feet from the ground within 150 feet of the core. Each creature in its path must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage and the creature is lifted by the pillar. Success: Half damage and the creature moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

bonusActions.name: Inhabit Vessel (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the core must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature is Possessed by the core until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Only one of a genius loci's cores can possess a creature in this way at a time, and a creature that this effect ends for becomes immune to it for 24 hours.

name: Verdant Core
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +11, Con +7, Int -5, Wis +16, Cha +17

traits.name: Unchained Vitality
traits.description: Whenever a creature Possessed by the core deals damage with an attack or spell, it can expend up to four of its Hit Dice, rolling them. The creature regains Hit Points equal to total rolled, and the attack or spell deals the same amount of additional Radiant damage.

traits.name: Spirit Well
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the core can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The core makes three attacks, or makes two attacks and uses either its Growth Spasm or Bounty Unrelenting.

actions.name: Spirit Thrash
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) force damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Growth Spasm
actions.description: An explosion of vegetation bursts forth in a 20-foot radius within 150 feet; each creature in the area is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside that area and must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 33 (6d10) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bounty Unrelenting
actions.description: One creature the core can see within 60 feet regains 52 (5d20) Hit Points. Then, if the creature has all of its Hit Points, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature takes 50 (1d100) Radiant damage.

bonusActions.name: Inhabit Vessel (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the core must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature is Possessed by the core until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Only one of a genius loci's cores can possess a creature in this way at a time, and a creature that this effect ends for becomes immune to it for 24 hours.

name: Geonid
savingThrows: Str +1, Con +3, Int +2, Wis -1

traits.name: Boulder Guise
traits.description: While fully withdrawn into its shell, the geonid can't see and is indistinguishable from a small boulder.

traits.name: Stone Tell
traits.description: When the geonid touches a stone, it learns the number and type of creatures that have passed within 10 feet of it in the past 24 hours.

actions.name: Furtive Snatch
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target is Grappled (escape DC 11). While it has a creature grappled in this way, the geonid can't target another creature with attacks or abilities. If the target was already grappled by the geonid, the geonid may instead steal one object it is carrying but not wielding.

actions.name: Grinding Mouthstones
actions.description: One creature restrained by the geonid's Drag In ability must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

bonusActions.name: Crush Toes
bonusActions.description: The geonid lurches its shell heavily onto a creature grappled by it, forcing it to succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or take 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Drag In
bonusActions.description: The geonid attempts to drag a prone creature grappled by it partially into its shell, forcing it to succeed on a DC 11 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 11). A Small or smaller creature that fails this saving throw is dragged fully into the shell, and while restrained in this way is Blinded, makes checks to escape at Disadvantage, and the geonid has vulnerability to damage dealt by it.

name: Inferno Spider Moltling
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -1, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Web-Dweller
traits.description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Molten Body
traits.description: If the spider takes any Cold damage, it is Petrified and its AC becomes 18 until the end of its next turn. While it is not Petrified, any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the spider melts and warps. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spider makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Searfang Bite.

actions.name: Searfang Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage and the target begins Burning (1d10).

actions.name: Eruption Kick
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft., Hits: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away. A creature the target is pushed into takes 3 (1d6) Fire damage and is pushed up to 5 feet away.

actions.name: Molten Web Trail (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The spider drags its spinnarets accross the ground, leaving a carpet of magmatic webbing in any space it leaves until the end of its turn. For the next minute, a creature that begins its turn in one of those spaces or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Fire damage and be restrained (escape DC 12) until the start of its next turn.

name: Inferno Spider Volcanid
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Web-Dweller
traits.description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Molten Body
traits.description: If the spider takes any Cold damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or be Petrified and have its AC become 22 until the end of its next turn. While it is not Petrified, any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the spider melts and warps. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

traits.name: Volcanic Flare
traits.description: When the spider takes 15 or more non-Cold damage from a single source while it is not Petrified, waves of heat pulse outward from its body, dealing 5 (1d10) Fire damage to each creature within 10 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spider makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Bloodboil Bite.

actions.name: Bloodboil Bite
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). While Poisoned in this way, a creature is also Burning 11 (2d10).

actions.name: Eruption Kick
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft., Hits: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away. A creature the target is pushed into takes 3 (1d6) Fire damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

bonusActions.name: Molten Web Trail
bonusActions.description: The spider drags its spinnarets accross the ground, leaving a carpet of magmatic webbing in any space it leaves until the end of its turn. For the next minute, a creature that begins its turn in one of those spaces or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Fire damage and be restrained (escape DC 16) until the start of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Devour Webs
bonusActions.description: The spider gathers and consumes all of the molten webbing within 5 feet of it, gaining 5 Temporary Hit Points per 5-foot square of webbing consumed. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the spider has Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws.

name: Isimir, Scream of the Frozen World
savingThrows: Str +18, Con +18, Int +8, Wis +13, Cha +11
immunities: Cold, Poison; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If the isimir fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Earth Shaking Movement
traits.description: Whenever the isimir moves at least 10 feet, the ground in a 60-foot radius becomes difficult terrain for other creatures until the start of its next turn. Structures in the area collapse. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Titanic Stature
traits.description:
A creature adjacent to the isimir and equipped with ice climbing gear may spend 30 feet of movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the isimir's legs. A creature may attempt the same check to climb from the isimir's legs to its waist, waist to torso, or from its torso to its head.
*

traits.name: Legs
traits.description:
While climbing on the isimir's legs, a creature must make a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw at the start of its turn or fall off.
*

traits.name: Waist
traits.description:
While climbing on the isimir's waist, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the isimir.
*

traits.name: Torso
traits.description:
While climbing on the isimir's torso, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the isimir and on saving throws against its abilities.
*

traits.name: Head
traits.description: While climbing on the isimir's head, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the isimir and on saving throws against its abilities. If a creature on the isimir's head scores a critical hit against it, the isimir falls prone at the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Ponderous
traits.description: The isimir moves only when it uses its stride action.

traits.name: Hoarfrost Aura
traits.description:
A creature that ends its turn within 300 ft. of the isimir must succeed on a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or gain 36 (8d8) Temporary Hit Points. A creature that moved at least 20 ft. on its turn makes this save at Advantage. While it has these Hit Points, a creature is restrained and gains vulnerability to bludgeoning and Fire damage. A creature killed by bludgeoning or Thunder damage in this area shatters, destroying its body.
	>

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The isimir makes two attacks with its stride, one of which it may replace with its Blade of the Cold Mountain or its Brush off.

actions.name: Stride
actions.description: The isimir takes a single step, moving up to its movement speed. Each creature within 10 ft. of where it ends this movement must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 26 (3d10 + 10) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half as much on a success. A prone creature has Disadvantage on this save.

actions.name: Blade of the Cold Mountain
actions.description: The isimir begins to swing its blade, targeting a 100 ft. long, 20 ft. wide line within 100 ft. At the start of its next turn, the strike lands, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 66 (12d10) Bludgeoning damage and 45 (10d8) Cold damage, or half as much on a success. A creature with at least 15 Passive Perception knows precisely where the strike will land.

actions.name: Brush Off
actions.description: The isimir attempts to dislodge a creature climbing on it. The creature must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 32 (5d12) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed 30 ft. away.

reactions.name: Bone-Shattering Scream (1/day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 267 Hit Points, the isimir emits a titanic scream in a 600-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw, taking 63 (14d8) Thunder damage and 63 (14d8) Cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is permanently deafened.

legendaryActions.name: Inhale
legendaryActions.description: The isimir takes a breath in. Creatures in a 120 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled 30 ft. towards the isimir.

legendaryActions.name: Exhale
legendaryActions.description: The isimir lets a breath out. Creatures in a 120 ft. cone must succeed a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) Cold damage and be pushed 30 ft. away from the isimir, or half as much damage on a success. The isimir may use this ability only if it used its Inhale on the previous turn.

name: Lava Child
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +3
immunities: Fire, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks made with Metal Weapons

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: When the lava child dies, it explodes in a burst of fire and magma. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw, taking 10 (3d6) Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried in that area are ignited.

traits.name: Metal Immunity
traits.description: The lava child can move through metal without hindrance, and it has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature wearing metal armor or using a metal shield.

traits.name: Molten Body
traits.description: If the lava child takes any Cold damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or be petrified. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the lava child melts and warps. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lava child makes two attacks: one with its Furnace Grin and one with its obsidian claws.

actions.name: Furnace Grin Gape
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) fire damage and the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the lava child's next turn.

actions.name: Obsidian Claws
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage and the target ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and takes Hit: 5 (1d10) fire damage at the end of each of its turns.

actions.name: Swallow Whole
actions.description: The lava child begins to swallow a Medium or smaller creature that is incapacitated. At the beginning of the lava child's next turn, the target is swallowed and incinerated, and the lava child regains all Hit Points. This action is disrupted if the lava child takes any Cold damage.

name: Leviathan
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex +7, Con +10, Int -4, Wis +10, Cha +9
immunities: Lightning, Poison, Thunder; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If the leviathan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Partial Freeze
traits.description: If the leviathan takes Cold damage, the leviathan partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, its speeds are reduced by 20 feet and its normally invisible vital organs are revealed. Attacks made from inside the leviathan against it have Advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The leviathan deals double damage to objects and structures (included in Tidal Wave).

traits.name: Water Form
traits.description: The leviathan can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Slow to Wrath
traits.description: When the Leviathan is reduced below 100 HP, it gains a fourth legendary action and immediately regains all spent actions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The leviathan makes two attacks: one with its whelming slam and one with either its evoke essence, brine, or tidal wave abilities, if available.

actions.name: Whelming Slam
actions.description: Creatures in a 20-foot radius within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 15 (1d10+10) Bludgeoning damage and be grappled in the leviathan's space (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is unable to breathe unless it can breathe water and moves with the leviathan. If the leviathan moved at least 100 feet before using this ability, it deals an additional 11 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Evoke Essence
actions.description: Each creature within 60 feet of the leveiathan must make a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or have their lungs fill with water. If the creature cannot breathe water, it cannot speak or breathe and begins to drown. A creature may take its action to cough and retch up water, ending the effect.

actions.name: Brine (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature that is drowning must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or have the water ripped from its lungs, taking 36 (8d8) Bludgeoning damage. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is forced to expend 1d4 unexpended hit dice. If it cannot, the creature drops to 0 HP.

actions.name: Tidal Wave (Recharge 6)
actions.description: While submerged, the leviathan magically creates a wall of water centered on itself. The wall is up 250 feet long, up to 250 feet high, and up to 50 feet thick. When the wall appears, all other creatures within its area must each make a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw. A creature takes 33 (6d10) Bludgeoning damage and is pushed 50 feet away on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The leviathan may affect creatures inside of it with this ability.

legendaryActions.name: Undertow
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be dragged up to 60 feet toward and into the leviathan, grappled and restrained per its Whelming Slam ability. The leviathan then rolls to recharge its Tidal Wave, if applicable.

legendaryActions.name: Waterspout
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or be launched 60 feet into the air by a watery tornado. It remains there until the end of its next turn, when it drops. *Jet Breath (Costs 2 Actions.)* The Leviathan spews a line of seawater 10 feet wide and 120 feet long. Creatures in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed 15 feet away. The leviathan may choose to eject a creature that is inside of it with this ability, launching it up to 60 feet away.

legendaryActions.name: Wash Away (Costs 4 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The leviathan creates an enormous 100-foot radius whirlpool that lasts for a minute. Each creature that starts its turn in the whirlpool has one spell or magical effect of its choice dispelled, and must make a strength saving throw or be drawn 30 feet towards the whirlpool's center. Creatures in the leviathan are immune to this effect.

name: Crawlspark Hellion
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +4, Con +1, Int -1, Cha -2
resistances: Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Lightning, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Amplify Charge
traits.description: If the hellion would take any Lightning damage, it instead takes no damage and gains Advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hellion makes two attacks with its Furtive Zap.

actions.name: Furtive Zap
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (2d4) lightning damage. Before or after making this attack, the hellion can teleport up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Haywire Charge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the hellion must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Lightning damage and use its reaction, if available, to make a melee attack against a random target in its reach. A Construct that fails this saving throw is additionally Possessed by the hellion until the end of the construct's next turn.

name: Lightning Elemental
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +5, Con +1, Int -1, Cha -2
resistances: Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Lightning, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Amplify Charge
traits.description: If the elemental would take any Lightning damage, it instead takes no damage and gains Advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Spark Gap
traits.description: When the elemental is hit with an attack, it teleports up to 10 feet directly toward the largest metal object within 60 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes two attacks with its Thrumming Sparkbolt.

actions.name: Thrumming Sparkbolt
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 20 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) lightning damage. This attack has Advantage if it targets the closest creature wearing metal armor or wielding a metal weapon.

actions.name: Static Field (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The elemental charges the air in a 20-foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet, raising the hair of creatures in the area on end. The first time a creature in the area takes Lightning damage before the end of the elemental's next turn, each other creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take the same damage.

reactions.name: Arc Flash
reactions.description: When a creature wearing metal armor leaves an area affected by the elemental's Static Field, the elemental can force it to succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 15 feet toward the field's center and knocked prone.

name: Cracklestep Conduit
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +11, Con +9, Int -1, Wis +8, Cha +3
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Lightning, Thunder, Poison; Blinded, Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Amplify Charge
traits.description: If the conduit would take any Lightning damage, it instead takes no damage and gains Advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Field-Bound Flight
traits.description: While it is within 40 feet of a solid surface, the conduit has a fly speed equal to its movement speed.

traits.name: Return Path
traits.description: When the conduit misses with an attack, it is dragged up to 10 feet directly toward the nearest solid surface. If it ends this movement within 10 feet of the surface, the conduit falls prone and is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The conduit makes four attacks with its Fulgur Arc.

actions.name: Fulgur Arc
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 40 ft. Hit: 18 (2d8) lightning damage and the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the conduit. This attack has Advantage if it targets the closest creature wearing metal armor or wielding a metal weapon. *Electroskewer Impalement (Concentration)* A searing bolt spears toward a creature the conduit can see within 30 feet, drawing it into the air. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 35 (10d6) Lightning damage and begin Levitating 10 feet into the air until the end of the conduit's next turn, or until the conduit moves more than 30 feet away from it. Whenever the Levitating creature takes any Lightning damage, it takes an additional 11 (2d10) Force damage.

actions.name: The Sky Alight (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The conduit makes 3 (1d4 + 1) attacks with its Fulgur Arc against each creature within 15 feet of it.

reactions.name: Plasma Flash
reactions.description: When the conduit fails a saving throw to maintain concentration on its Electroskewer Impalement, it can ionize the air around it. Each other creature within 30 feet that can see the conduit must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Magmin
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: When the magmin dies, it explodes in a burst of fire and magma. Each creature and flammable object within 5 feet of it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

traits.name: Ignited Illumination
traits.description: As a bonus action, the magmin can set itself ablaze or extinguish its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

traits.name: Molten Body
traits.description: If the magmin takes any Cold damage, it is petrified. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the magmin melts and warps. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

actions.name: Touch
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d6) fire damage and the target ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and takes Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage at the end of each of its turns.

reactions.name: Cackling Caprice
reactions.description: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the magmin may force the creature to make a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

name: Magmin Firebug
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: When the magmin dies, it explodes in a burst of fire and magma. Each creature and flammable object within 5 feet of it begins Burning (1d10).

traits.name: Molten Body
traits.description: If the magmin takes any Cold damage, it is petrified at the end of its next turn. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the magmin melts and warps. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Burning Touch (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target begins Burning (1d10).

reactions.name: Cackling Caprice
reactions.description: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the magmin may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

name: Magmin Pyroclast
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +5, Con +4, Int -1, Cha +5
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: When the magmin dies, it explodes in a burst of fire and magma. Each creature and flammable object within 5 feet of begins Burning (1d10).

traits.name: Molten Body
traits.description: If the magmin takes any Cold damage, it is petrified at the end of its next turn. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the magmin melts and warps. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

traits.name: Aura of Dancing Flames
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of the magmin that is Burning has Disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Magmin makes two attacks with its Burning Touch, one of which it may replace with a use of its Flaming Panic, if available.

actions.name: Burning Touch
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target begins Burning (1d10).

actions.name: Flaming Panic (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The magmin stokes the flames around it to ever greater heights and brightness. Each creature creature within 30 feet of the magmin that is Burning takes 10 (3d6) Fire damage and must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to move up its speed in a direction of the magmin's choice.

actions.name: Magmitic Division (1/Day)
actions.description: The magmin crams as much earth and rock into itself as it can, darkening and growing larger as it does. At the start of its next turn, the magmin dies and separates into 5 new Magmin Firebugs, which act on its turn.

reactions.name: Cinder Dance
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature that is Burning ends its turn within 30 feet of the magmin, the magmin forces another creature within 10 feet of that creature to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or begin Burning (1d10).

reactions.name: Cackling Caprice
reactions.description: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the magmin may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

name: Mud Lasher
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -1, Wis +2
resistances: Acid; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The mud lasher can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Caking Mud
traits.description: Whenever the mud lasher takes Fire damage, its speed is reduced by 10 and its AC increases by 2 for the next minute. The mud lasher dies if its speed is reduced to 0 in this way.

actions.name: Drowning Slam
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft., *Hit* 17 (3d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Mud Ball
actions.description: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, range 30 ft., *Hit* 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone. A creature knocked prone in this way must spend its full movement to stand.

reactions.name: Shifting Form
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the mud lasher moves up to 15 ft. without provoking attacks of opportunity.

reactions.name: Stuff Face
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature it has grappled attempting to speak or cast a spell, the mud lasher forces it to make a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature's mouth and throat filled with mud, preventing it from speaking or breathing until the start of its next turn.

name: Meerak Nerra
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Mirror Dweller
traits.description: The nerra may spend half its movement to pass through a Medium or larger reflective surface within 5 feet, entering or exiting an extradimensional mirrorspace resembling the space reflected in the surface. If a mirrored surface containing the nerra ceases to be reflective, the nerra is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the nerra takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the nerra takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Razor Claws (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 Slashing damage. If at least two other meerak nerras attacked with it, the target begins Bleeding (2d6).

bonusActions.name: Mirror Step
bonusActions.description: The nerra teleports up to thirty feet to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of a reflective surface. If the nerra is inside a mirrorspace, it instead may teleport into another mirrorspace reflected by a surface it can see within 30 feet.

name: Varoot Nerra
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +3, Cha +1

traits.name: Mirror Dweller
traits.description: The nerra may spend half its movement to pass through a Medium or larger reflective surface within 5 feet, entering or exiting an extradimensional mirrorspace resembling the space reflected in the surface. If a mirrored surface containing the nerra ceases to be reflective, the nerra is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

traits.name: Reflected Assassin
traits.description: While inside of a mirrorspace, the nerra treats any creature reflected in that mirrorspace as adjacent to it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nerra makes two attacks with its Honed Shard, one of which it may replace with a use of its Mirror Grasp.

actions.name: Honed Shard
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target begins Bleeding (2d6). This attack deals an additional 7 (2d6) Slashing damage to a Bleeding target.

actions.name: Mirror Grasp
actions.description: One creature the nerra can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or have one object it is holding or carrying teleport into the nerra's hands.

bonusActions.name: Mirror Step
bonusActions.description: The nerra teleports up to thirty feet to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of a reflective surface. If the nerra is inside a mirrorspace, it instead may teleport into another mirrorspace reflected by a surface it can see within 30 feet.

name: Kalareem Nerra
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +8, Con +5, Int +1, Wis +8, Cha +8
immunities: Poison, Radiant, Nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing; Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Mirror Dweller
traits.description: The nerra may spend half its movement to pass through a Medium or larger reflective surface within 5 feet, entering or exiting an extradimensional mirrorspace resembling the space reflected in the surface. If a mirrored surface containing the nerra ceases to be reflective, the nerra is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nerra makes four attacks with its Glessine Greatblade, one of which it may replace with a use of its Liquimetal Encasement.

actions.name: Glessine Greatblade
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the blade shatters, dealing 10 (3d6) Slashing damage to the target and each other creature within 5 feet of it. The nerra can extrude a new blade as a Bonus Action on its turn.

actions.name: Liquimetal Encasement
actions.description: The nerra enters the space of a creature within 5 feet and engulfs it (escape DC 18). An unwilling creature may make a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw, resisting the effect on a success. An engulfed creature can't have an AC lower than 20, takes 21 (6d6) poison damage at the end of each of its turns, and has its movement speed reduced by half. While it has a creature engulfed, the nerra moves with the creature, can't make attacks, and may exit the creature's space as a Bonus Action.

reactions.name: Mercurial Double
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature makes an attack against a creature within 5 feet of the nerra, the nerra warps its body and the light around it, changing the target to itself.

name: Silit Nerra
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +8, Con +8, Int +11, Wis +9, Cha +3

traits.name: Mirror Dweller
traits.description: The nerra may spend half its movement to pass through a Medium or larger reflective surface within 5 feet, entering or exiting an extradimensional mirrorspace resembling the space reflected in the surface. If a mirrored surface containing the nerra ceases to be reflective, the nerra is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

traits.name: Reflective Rampart
traits.description: Whenever a nerra within 60 feet of the silit nerra is missed with a spell attack, the nerra may force the attacker to make a new attack roll for the spell against a target of the silit nerra's choice.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nerra makes three attacks with its Quicksilver Helix, one of which it may replace with a use of its Fractalize.

actions.name: Quicksilver Helix
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 30 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) slashing damage plus Hit: 14 (4d6) poison damage. The nerra may choose for this attack's source to be any reflective surface it can see within 100 feet.

actions.name: Fractalize
actions.description: The nerra shatters one non-minion nerra it can see within 60 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of it takes 11 (2d10) Slashing damage, then three new Merrak Nerras rise from the shards in unoccupied spaces within the area.

actions.name: Steal Reflection (Concentration)
actions.description: One creature the nerra can see within 60 feet must make a DC 19 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the nerra changes its appearance to match the creature, and whenever the nerra takes damage, the creature takes half as much damage of the same type.

actions.name: Mirrorspace Banishment (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature the nerra can see within 60 feet that is within 5 feet of a reflective object must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma save or be dragged into that object's mirrorspace and trapped there. The creature may repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, and is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space on a success, or when the object ceases to be reflective.

bonusActions.name: Mirror Portal
bonusActions.description: The nerra teleports itself or a creature it can see up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of a reflective surface. An unwilling creature may make a DC 19 Charisma Saving Throw, resisting the effect on a success. If the nerra is inside a mirrorspace, it instead may teleport into another mirrorspace reflected by a surface it can see within 30 feet.

reactions.name: Mirrorweave Symmetry
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the nerra can see casts a spell, the nerra casts the same spell, choosing new targets (Spell Attack Bonus +11, Save DC 19).

reactions.name: Infinite Reflections (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 127 Hit Points, the nerra causes up to four 10-foot by 10-foot flat surfaces that it can see within 100 feet to smooth and shimmer, reaching a mirror polish.

name: Phoenix
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +8, Con +7, Int -5, Wis +10, Cha +9
immunities: Fire, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Gargantuan Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the phoenix may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the phoenix. While climbing on the phoenix, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the phoenix, and the phoenix can't make melee attacks against it. A creature that isn't prone may attempt this check as a reaction in place of an attack of opportunity.

traits.name: Dampened Flames
traits.description: If the phoenix takes 10 or more Cold damage from a single source, attacks against it are made at Advantage until the start of its next turn. If the phoenix takes 20 or more Cold damage from a single source, its Inner Fire trait ceases to function until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Fiery Rebirth
traits.description: When the phoenix is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die. Instead, its body crumbles to ash, revealing a new phoenix fledgeling. This trait is suspended in an area infused with unholy power by the Hallow spell. If the phoenix's body is completely destroyed while this trait is suspended, the phoenix dies.

traits.name: Inner Fire
traits.description: A creature that touches the phoenix or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 11 (2d10) Fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If the phoenix fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The phoenix makes two attacks, one of which may be with its beak.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 34 (4d12 + 8) piercing damage and Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 10 ft. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) slashing damage and Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the phoenix can't use its talons on another target.

actions.name: Shake Off
actions.description: Each creature climbing on the phoenix must succeed on a DC 18 Strength or Dexterity Saving Throw (target's choice) or lose its grip and fall. The phoenix may then make a talon attack targeting a creature that failed this save as it falls.

actions.name: Wing Attack
actions.description: The phoenix beats its wings. Each creature within 20 feet of the phoenix that isn't climbing on it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 36 (8d6 + 8) Bludgeoning damage, be pushed 10 ft. away, and and be knocked prone. The phoenix can then fly up to half its flying speed.

actions.name: Eruption Wake (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The phoenix moves up to its fly speed, and a 20-foot wide section of the ground it passes over begins to shake violently. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone. At the beginning of the phoenix's next turn, lava erupts in the area. For the next minute, each creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there takes 55 (10d10) Fire damage.

reactions.name: Quickening Scream (1/day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 158 Hit Points, the phoenix lets out a mighty screech. Each creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the phoenix's next turn. 1d4 Lava Children emerge from unoccupied areas of lava within range.

name: Phoenix Fledgling
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +5, Con +3, Int -5, Wis +4, Cha +3
immunities: Fire, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Dampened Flames
traits.description: If the phoenix takes 10 or more Cold damage from a single source, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Fiery Rebirth
traits.description: When the phoenix is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die. Instead, its body crumbles to ash, revealing a new phoenix fledgeling. This trait is suspended in an area infused with unholy power by the Hallow spell. If the phoenix's body is completely destroyed while this trait is suspended, the phoenix dies.

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.description: The phoenix can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and Hit: 5 (1d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage and Hit: 5 (1d10) fire damage. On a critical hit, the target is blinded until the end of the phoenix's next turn.

name: Pyroclasm Vortex
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +10, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +3, Cha +7
immunities: Fire, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.description: The vortex can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there.

traits.name: Raze-Winds
traits.description: A Large or smaller creature whose space the vortex enters for the first time on a turn, or that starts its turn in the vortex's space, must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be carried aloft and restrained (escape DC 18) in the vortex. A creature that starts its turn in the vortex's space takes 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

traits.name: Quenching Weakness
traits.description: Whenever the vortex takes Cold damage, it makes one fewer attack with its multiattack on its following turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vortex makes four attacks with its fiery windspike.

actions.name: Fiery Windspike
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 20 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) fire damage and the target is dragged 5 ft. toward the vortex. An unoccupied space targeted with this attack catches fire.

actions.name: Fireburst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 10 ft. of the vortex must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d8) Fire damage and be pushed 10 ft. away, or take half as much damage on a success. On a success or failure, a creature in the vortex's space is pushed an additional 30 ft. in a random direction, and takes an additional 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Whirlflame
reactions.description: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack or harmful spell. The vortex teleports up to 90 ft. to an unoccupied space that contains a burning flame. If the vortex is no longer a valid target, the attack or spell fails.

reactions.name: Scorch Lungs
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature in the vortex's space speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the vortex forces the creature to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Fire damage and be unable to breathe. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Salamander Lancer
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Cha +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Heated Body
traits.description: A creature that hits the salamander with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The salamander makes two attacks, one of which may be with its tail.

actions.name: Snake-Tongue Ranseur
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) fire damage).

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). A creature grappled in this way takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage at the beginning of each of the salamander's turns.

actions.name: Whirlwind of Fire (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 10 ft. of the salamander must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Fire damage and be pushed 10 ft. away, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Brace
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the salamander forces the creature to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or have its movement reduced to 0 until the end of its turn.

reactions.name: Drop Tail (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the salamander reduces the attack's damage to 0.

name: Salamander Flame-Archer
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +4, Con +3, Cha +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Heated Body
traits.description: A creature that hits the salamander with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The salamander makes two attacks, one of which may be with its tail.

actions.name: Blazing Bow
actions.description: Attack: +7 range 150/600 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage).

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the salamander can automatically hit the target with its tail, and the salamander can't make tail attacks against other targets.

actions.name: Rain of Ruin (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The salamander makes a blazing bow attack against each creature in a 20 ft. radius.

reactions.name: Tail Lash
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature entering the salamander's reach, the salamander forces the creature to succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 10 feet backwards and knocked prone. A creature has Advantage on this save if the salamander has used its drop tail ability.

reactions.name: Drop Tail (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the salamander reduces the attack's damage to 0.

name: Salamander Noble
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +4, Con +3, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha +3
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Heated Body
traits.description: A creature that hits the salamander with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

traits.name: Trail of Flame
traits.description: Whenever the salamander moves, the space it left catches fire until the end of the salamander's next turn. A creature that enters the space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The salamander makes two attacks, one of which may be with its tail, and uses its guardian flames ability.

actions.name: Ashen Sarissa
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 15 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage).

actions.name: Guardian Flames
actions.description: One creature the salamander can see within 60 ft. that is immune to Fire damage is wreathed in protective flames. The next time the creature is attacked before the end of the salamander's next turn, the attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the salamander can automatically hit the target with its tail, and the salamander can't make tail attacks against other targets.

reactions.name: Drop Tail (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the salamander reduces the attack's damage to 0.

name: Unraveler
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +7, Wis +1, Cha +9
immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Elemental Balance
traits.description: Whenever the unraveler takes damage of a type it is resistant to, its elemental balance is disrupted, granting the following effects until it takes damage of another type it is resistant to, or until it uses its Restore Balance action: The unraveler's attacks deal an additional 2d6 of the triggering damage type. The unraveler becomes immune to the triggering damage type. The unraveler cannot use its Disjoin action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The disjoiner makes two attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its Disjoin or Restore Balance, if available.

actions.name: Omnimental Strike
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft., Hit 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Disjoin
actions.description: One creature within 10 feet that the unraveler can see must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed. A creature Cursed in this way begins to unravel into its raw elemental components, and must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns or take 9 (2d8) Force damage. A creature that succeeds on 3 of these saving throws has the effect abate for 24 hours, after which it returns and the creature must save against it anew. A creature killed by this damage collapses into a loose pile of water and minerals.

actions.name: Restore Balance (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The unraveler restores itself to perfect order, ending any spells or magical affect on itself, and any ongoing effects from its Elemental Balance trait.

reactions.name: Disjoin Weapon
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a nonmagical melee weapon attack, the unraveler forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or have the weapon disintegrate in its grasp as it separates into its component elements.

name: Voidwraith
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +5, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha +2
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Thunder; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Airless Aura
traits.description: Creatures within 15 feet of the voidwraith can't speak or breathe, and the voidwraith's movement makes no sound.

traits.name: Voidform
traits.description: It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. While fully obscured, the voidwraith may attempt to Hide as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Shifting Nothingness
traits.description: If the voidwraith would roll at the end of its turn to end a magical effect, it may roll at the start of its turn to end the effect as well.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The void wraith makes two attacks with its void intrusion.

actions.name: Void Intrusion
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 8 ft., *Hit* 9 (1d8 + 5) Slashing damage. A creature hit by this attack that is out of breath must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or drop to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Wheezing Reclamation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The voidwraith attempts to wrench forth the air from the lungs of creatures nearby. Each creature within 15 feet of the voidwraith that is holding its breath must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage and lose its held breath, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Howling Void
reactions.description: When the voidwraith fails a saving throw, it can briefly intensify the sucking winds that surround it. Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the voidwraith. Until the start of its next turn, the area within 30 feet of the voidwraith is difficult terrain for creatures attempting to move away from it.

name: Xorn Minewaif
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +4
resistances: Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Adamantine

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

traits.name: Buoyant Burrower
traits.description: If the xorn is burrowing at the end of its turn, it is immediately expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

actions.name: Awkward Gnaw
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft., one Medium or larger target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage. On a missed attack, the xorn falls prone.

actions.name: Spinning Claw Flurry
actions.description: Each creature within 5 feet of the xorn must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 3 (1d6) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Ducking Dive
reactions.description: When the xorn would make a saving throw against an effect that did not target it, it may immediately move up to its burrow speed. If it ends this movement outside the spell's area, the xorn is unaffected by it.

name: Earthmaw Xorn
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +6
resistances: Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Adamantine

traits.name: Flesh-Sickened
traits.description: While it has a dead or unconscious creature grappled in its Dorsal Maw, the xorn is Poisoned.

traits.name: Treasure Sense
traits.description: The xorn can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious or magical metals and stones within 60 feet of it.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The xorn makes three attacks with its Scrabbling Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Devour Weapon.

actions.name: Scrabbling Claws
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. A creature hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or drop one object it is carrying.

actions.name: Dorsal Maw
actions.description: The xorn emerges into the space of a creature within 5 feet it is burrowing beneath, forcing it to succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 14), or move into the nearest unoccupied space on a success. A creature grappled in this way takes 10 (3d6) Piercing damage at the beginning of each of the xorn's turns.

actions.name: Devour Weapon
actions.description: The xorn eats one weapon within 5 feet of it that isn't worn or carried, gaining 13 (3d8) Temporary Hit Points. While the xorn has any of these Temporary Hit Points, its attacks deal an additional die of damage and gain any magical effects the weapon had.

reactions.name: Sink into Stone (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the xorn is reduced below 36 Hit Points, it may move up to half its burrow speed.

name: Diamondhide Xorn
savingThrows: Str +5, Con +9, Int +1, Wis +5
resistances: Piercing and Slashing from Attacks that aren't Adamantine

traits.name: Crystaline Armor
traits.description: Whenever the xorn takes 15 or more acid or Bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 19, until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Flesh-Sickened
traits.description: While it has a dead or unconscious creature grappled in its Dorsal Maw, the xorn is Poisoned.

traits.name: Treasure Sense
traits.description: The xorn can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious or magical metals and stones within 60 feet of it.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The xorn makes three attacks with its Scrabbling Claws.

actions.name: Scrabbling Claws
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage. A creature hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or drop one object it is carrying.

actions.name: Dorsal Maw
actions.description: The xorn emerges into the space of a creature within 5 feet it is burrowing beneath, forcing it to succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 16), or move into the nearest unoccupied space on a success. A creature grappled in this way takes 21 (6d6) Piercing damage at the beginning of each of the xorn's turns.

bonusActions.name: Devour Weapon
bonusActions.description: The xorn eats one weapon within 5 feet of it that isn't worn or carried, gaining 13 (3d8) Temporary Hit Points. While the xorn has any of these Temporary Hit Points, its attacks deal an additional die of damage and gain any magical effects the weapon had.

bonusActions.name: Strip Armor
bonusActions.description: One creature grappled in the xorn's Dorsal Maw must make a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, one piece of nonmagical metal armor the creature is wearing takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers as part of it is torn away.

reactions.name: Sink into Stone (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the xorn is reduced below 70 Hit Points, it may move up to half its burrow speed.

name: Zaratan
savingThrows: Str +10, Con +10, Int -4, Wis +11, Cha +10
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; and Attacks made without Advantage
immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If the zaratan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Earth Shaking Movement
traits.description: Whenever the zaratan moves at least 10 feet, the ground in a 120-foot radius becomes difficult terrain for other creatures until the start of its next turn. Structures in the area collapse. Each creature in the area, and each creature climbing on the zaratan must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Titanic Stature
traits.description:
