A creature adjacent to the zaratan may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the zaratan's legs. A creature may attempt the same check to climb from the zaratan's legs to its back, or from its back to its head.
*

traits.name: Legs
traits.description:
While climbing on the zaratan's legs, a creature has Advantage on attacks against it.
*

traits.name: Back
traits.description:
While climbing on the zaratan's back, the zaratan has immunity to damage the creature deals and cannot target the creature with melee attacks. A creature on the zaratan's back that falls prone does not fall off.
*

traits.name: Head
traits.description: While climbing on the zaratan's head, the creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the zaratan and the zaratan cannot target the creature with melee attacks. A creature on the zaratan's head that falls prone does not fall off.

traits.name: Ponderous
traits.description: The zaratan moves only when it uses its stride action.

traits.name: Slow to Wrath
traits.description: When the Zaratan is reduced below 100 HP, it gains a second legendary action and immediately regains all spent actions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zaratan makes two attacks: one with its stride and one with its bite, its spit rock or its swalow.

actions.name: Stride
actions.description: The zaratan takes a single step, moving up to its movement speed. Each creature in a 20-foot radius area within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 26 (3d10 + 10) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half as much on a success. A prone creature has Disadvantage on this save.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +16 reach 20 ft. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is Grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the zaratan can't bite another target.

actions.name: Spit Rock
actions.description: Attack: +16 range 120/240 ft. Hit: 31 (6d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The zaratan makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the zaratan, its attacks bypass the zaratan's resistances, and it takes 28 (8d6) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the zaratan's turns. If the zaratan takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the zaratan.

actions.name: Spew Debris (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The zaratan exhales rocky debris in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw. A creature takes 33 (6d10) Bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is knocked prone.

legendaryActions.name: Stride
legendaryActions.description: The zaratan uses its stride.

legendaryActions.name: Chomp
legendaryActions.description: The zaratan makes one bite attack or uses its Swallow.

legendaryActions.name: Retract
legendaryActions.description: The zaratan retracts its head into its shell. Each creature climbing on its head must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall 100 feet. On a successful save, the creature may leap to the zaratan's back as a reaction. If it cannot, it falls.

legendaryActions.name: Bone-Shattering Roar (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The zaratan emits a titanic roar in a 120-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw, taking 54 (12d8) Thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Ogrémoch
savingThrows: Str +14, Con +15, Wis +8, Cha +6
immunities: Lightning, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Titanic Stature
traits.description:
Ogrémoch body is divided into several connected zones; a creature Attached to a zone has Advantage on attacks that target Ogrémoch, and can use its full movement to make a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Athletics) check, climbing to an adjacent zone on a success.
*

traits.name: Base
traits.description:
A creature Attached to Ogremoch's base has Advantage on saving throws against its Skyblot Slam, and takes no damage on a success.
*

traits.name: Trunk
traits.description:
A creature that hits Ogrémoch with a critical hit while attached to its trunk breaks open a crevice that a Medium creature can squeeze through, becoming Swallowed.
*

traits.name: Arms
traits.description:
A creature that succeeds on a saving throw against Ogrémoch's Skyblot Slam can use its reaction to attempt to climb onto Ogrémoch arms.
*

traits.name: Head
traits.description: When Ogrémoch uses its Skyblot Slam, a creature Attached to Ogrémoch's head can use its action to shift the target by 25 (1d10 * 5) feet.

traits.name: Weathering Weakness
traits.description: If Ogrémoch is doused in water or takes any Acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

traits.name: Gemheart Core
traits.description: A creature Swallowed by Ogrémoch can access it's pulsing diamond heart; the heart has AC 25 and any hit against it becomes a critical against Ogrémoch.

traits.name: The Earth Unceasing (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
traits.description: When Ogrémoch is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it resets to 253 Hit Points and the earth in a 500-foot radius around it becomes difficult terrain for the next hour.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If Ogrémoch fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Skyblot Slam
actions.description: Ogrémoch begins to swing a titanic fist at a 15-foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet. At the beginning of Ogrémoch's next turn, each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or take 101 (2d100) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Tectonic Wade
actions.description: Ogrémoch moves or burrows up to 50 feet in a straight line, tearing through the earth as it does. Each creature and object in its path is pushed ahead of it, then must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Boulderfall Cascade
actions.description: Each creature within 15 feet of Ogrémoch that isn't Attached to its Head must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 33 (6d10) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is knocked prone.

legendaryActions.name: Scrape Off
legendaryActions.description: Ogrémoch forces one creature within 60 feet of it to succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 26 (4d12) Bludgeoning damage, be knocked prone, and be pushed up to 20 feet away. On a success, the target takes no damage and Ogrémoch takes half the effect's damage.

legendaryActions.name: Raise Spire
legendaryActions.description: A 10-foot radius pillar of stone rises 60 feet from the earth, centered on a point Ogrémoch can see within 300 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Metamorphic Awakening
legendaryActions.description: Ogrémoch creates up to two earth elementals from his flesh with a total CR of up to 2 (1d4), or of up to 5 (2d4) if Ogrémoch's Mythic Trait is active. The elementals act on initiative count 0, and Ogrémoch loses 10 Hit Points per CR of elemental created this way.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Earthcrest Quakewave
legendaryActions.description: A wave of earth ripples out from Ogrémoch in a 500-foot radius, forcing each creature on the ground in the area to succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or be launched 20 feet into the air.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Creepstone Blight (Recharge 4-6)
legendaryActions.description: Each creature Attached to or Swallowed by Ogrémoch must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or gain 25 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, a creature is restrained and must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns or become Petrified until it loses them.

name: Almiraj
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +3, Int -4, Wis +2

traits.name: Magic Vulnerability
traits.description: The almiraj has Disadvantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects. Charm effects that target the almiraj have a duration of Until Dispelled.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Horn
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. A creature killed by this damage turns to stone.

actions.name: Disrupt Hex (1/day)
actions.description: The almiraj ends a spell or magical effect of 2nd level or below affecting a creature within 5 ft.

name: Bakegumo
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +3, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +2

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The bakegumo can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.

traits.name: Veiled Reality
traits.description: The bakegumo can sculpt her packed webs into the approximate likeness of a mundane creature or object such as a satchel, musical instrument, or swaddled baby. While in humanoid form, she can magically disguise such objects within 120 feet of her, making them appear to all senses as mundane objects. A creature can determine the illusory nature of such objects with a successful DC 14 Intelligence (Investigation) check.

traits.name: Insatiable Appetite
traits.description: The bakegumo can swallow any number of Medium or smaller creatures without displaying any external change. Creatures Swallowed by her are restrained, take 9 (2d8) poison damage at the beginning of each of their turns, and automatically stabilize if reduced to 0 Hit Points. The bakegumo splits open and releases each creature swallowed by her if killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bakegumo makes three attacks, one of which can be with her Slow-Venom Kiss.

actions.name: Slow-Venom Kiss
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d8) poison damage plus one additional effect: Spider Form. The target takes an additional 5 (1d10) Piercing damage. Humanoid Form The target is Cursed. Whenever the Cursed creature completes a Short or Long Rest, it takes 4 (1d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Tanglebraid Locks
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 20 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 19). A creature hit with this attack two or more times in a turn is additionally restrained until this grapple ends.

actions.name: Hidden Net-Web (1/Day)
actions.description: The bakegumo unfurls a meticulously packed web, flinging it forth in a 20-foot cone. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 14).

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: The bakegumo assumes the form of an ancient, Small humanoid, or returns to her Large spider form. Her statistics are the same in each form, and she reverts to its spider form if she dies.

bonusActions.name: Reclaim Webs
bonusActions.description: The bakegumo begins to devour her webs, dragging each creature grappled or restrained by her up to 10 feet toward her. A Medium or smaller creature that ends this movement within 5 feet of her must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be Swallowed (escape DC 15). Then, if no creatures are restrained in her Hidden Net-Web, she regains a use of it.

name: Jorogumo
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +4, Con +4, Int +7, Wis +9, Cha +7

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The jorogumo can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.

traits.name: Insatiable Appetite
traits.description: The jorogumo can swallow any number of Large or smaller creatures without displaying any external change. Creatures Swallowed by her are restrained, take 13 (3d8) poison damage at the beginning of each of their turns, and automatically stabilize if reduced to 0 Hit Points. The jorogumo splits open and releases each creature swallowed by her if killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The jorogumo makes two attacks, one of which can be with her Sickening Kiss, and uses her Disgorge Spawn.

actions.name: Sickening Kiss
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) poison damage, plus one additional effect. Spider Form. The target takes an additional 11 (2d10) Piercing damage. Humanoid Form The target must succeed on DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Clawed Strike
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. While in spider form, this attack has a reach of 15 feet.

actions.name: Disgorge Spawn
actions.description: The jorogumo drags a Tiny spider trailing a silk umbilical from deep within her mouth and casts it toward a creature she can see within 40 feet, forcing it to make a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failure, the spider becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 17). While Attached, the creature can't move away from the jorogumo, and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: The jorogumo assumes the form of a Medium or smaller humanoid, or returns to her Huge spider form. Her statistics are the same in each form, and it reverts to its spider form if it dies.

bonusActions.name: Feed Egg
bonusActions.description: The jorogumo inserts a pouch of egg-laden webbing into the mouth of a grappled creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Skitterguts.

bonusActions.name: Broodfire Breath
bonusActions.description: Each spider created by the jorogumo's Disgorge Spawn breathes forth a gout of flame, dealing 5 (1d10) Fire damage to the creature it is Attached to.

legendaryActions.name: Instinctive Skitter (Spider Form Only)
legendaryActions.description: The jorogumo moves up to half its speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. It can take this action even while Incapacitated.

legendaryActions.name: Disgorge Spawn
legendaryActions.description: The jorogumo uses her Disgorge Spawn.

legendaryActions.name: Reclaim Webs
legendaryActions.description: The jorogumo begins to devour her webs, dragging each creature affected by her Disgorge Spawn up to 10 feet toward her. A Large or smaller creature that ends this movement within 5 feet of her must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be Swallowed(escape DC 19).

name: Bakeneko
savingThrows: Dex +3, Con +2, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +2

traits.name: Soundless Stalk
traits.description: The bakeneko counts as Hidden from any creature that cannot see it.

traits.name: Gnaw Through
traits.description: The bakeneko can burrow a Small hole through one foot of nonmagical wood, stone, or steel in ten minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bakeneko makes two attacks with its Secret Needles, one of which it can replace with a use of its Stumbling Dance.

actions.name: Secret Needles
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing or Slashing damage. This attack has Advantage against a Surprised target, or one the bakeneko started its turn Hidden from.

actions.name: Stumbling Dance (Cat Form Only, Concentration)
actions.description: Spectral flames wreath the bakeneko's tail. Whenever the bakeneko leaves a creature's reach, it can force that creature to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or begin Burning (1d10).

bonusActions.name: Death-Puppet Spring
bonusActions.description: The bakeneko leaps up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each humanoid corpse that has been dead fewer than 49 days that the bakeneko leaps over in this way immediately rises as a Horde Ghoul that acts on the bakeneko's turn and under its control.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: The bakeneko assumes the form of a Medium or smaller humanoid creature it has touched, or returns to its Small cat form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its cat form if it dies.

name: Nekomata
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +6, Con +3, Int +3, Wis +6, Cha +5
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks or from falling; Poisoned

traits.name: Soundless Stalk
traits.description: The nekomata counts as Hidden from any creature that cannot see it.

traits.name: Gnaw Through
traits.description: The nekomata can burrow a Small hole through one foot of nonmagical wood, stone, or steel in ten minutes.

traits.name: Retching Return
traits.description: When the nekomata fails a saving throw, it can regurgitate a creature swallowed by it in the last hour to succeed instead. When the nekomata dies, it regurgitates each creature and object swallowed by it in the last week in the same condition they were swallowed in.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nekomata makes two attacks with its Secret Needles, one of which it can replace with a use of its Bloodlap Bite or Stumbling Dance.

actions.name: Bloodlap Bite
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target has fewer than half its Hit Points after taking this damage, the nekomata gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Secret Needles
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing or Slashing damage. This attack has Advantage against a Surprised target, or one the nekomata started its turn Hidden from.

actions.name: Stumbling Dance (Cat Form Only, Concentration)
actions.description: Spectral flames wreath the nekomata's tails. Whenever the nekomata leaves a creature's reach, it can force that creature to succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or begin Burning (1d10).

actions.name: Deranged Yowl (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The nekomata lets out a horrid sound, forcing each creature that can hear it within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or have its back violently bend for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). An affected creature has Disadvantage on attacks and has its movement speed reduced by a cumulative 15 feet until the effect ends at the beginning of each of its turns. A creature that has its speed reduced to 0 in this way is Paralyzed.

bonusActions.name: Death-Puppet Spring
bonusActions.description: The nekomata leaps up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each humanoid corpse that has been dead fewer than 49 days that the nekomata leaps over in this way immediately rises as a Horde Ghoul that acts on the nekomata's turn and under its control.

bonusActions.name: Devour the Sleeping
bonusActions.description: The nekomata distends its mouth and begins to swallow a Large or smaller unconscious creature or object within 5 feet whole. At the beginning of the nekomata's next turn, the target is swallowed and disappears entirely. This action is disrupted if the nekomata is knocked prone or Incapacitated, or if the target regains consciousness.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: The nekomata assumes the form of a humanoid creature it has touched or that of a Large cat. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its cat form if it dies.

legendaryActions.name: Secret Needles
legendaryActions.description: The nekomata makes an attack with its Secret Needles.

legendaryActions.name: Devious Dance
legendaryActions.description: The nekomata uses its Stumbling Dance, then moves up to half its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Slow Blink
legendaryActions.description: The nekomata locks eyes with a creature it can see within 30 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or fall asleep for the next minute. A sleeping creature wakes early if a creature takes an action to shake it awake, or if it takes any damage.

languages: Blink Dog, understands Sylvan but can't speak it

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The dog has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the dog's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Teleport (Recharge 4–6)
actions.description: The dog magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, then makes a bite attack at Advantage.

traits.name: Slick Sheen
traits.description: Any creature that attempts to move through the boggle's space or that is pushed into it for the first time on a turn must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The creature gains the Prone condition.

traits.name: Portal Creep
traits.description: Once on each of the boggle's turns, it can treat any opening or frame as adjacent to each space within 50 feet of it, and can move, reach, or attack through it.

actions.name: Gnaw Neck
actions.description:
Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

This attack can only target a Prone creature, or one the boggle is Attached to.

actions.name: Drippy Grip
actions.description:
Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Flash-Splash
reactions.description: Trigger: The boggle is missed with a melee attack. Response: The boggle teleports up to 15 feet, and the attacker's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the turn.

reactions.name: Glopmire Grasp
reactions.description: Trigger: The boggle is hit with a melee attack. Response: The attacker's weapon sticks to the boggle, becoming unusable until freed as an Action or Bonus action with a Strength Saving Throw: DC 11.

name: Boggle See-Snatch
savingThrows: Dex +4, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +2, Cha -2

actions.name: Twist Ear

actions.name: Drippy Grip

actions.name: Got Your Eyes
actions.description: One creature the boggle is Attached to. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The creature gains the Blinded condition for as long as the boggle remains Attached to it.

reactions.name: Slippery Scrabble
reactions.description: Trigger: The boggle is missed with a melee attack. Response: The boggle can make a Drippy Grip attack against the attacker.

reactions.name: Face Rip
reactions.description: Trigger: The boggle stops being Attached to a creature. Response: The boggle deals 4 Slashing damage to the creature.

name: Boggle Chase-Tricker
savingThrows: Dex +6, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Portal Creep
traits.description: Once on each of the boggle's turns, it can treat any opening or frame as adjacent to each space within 50 feet of it, and can move, reach, or attack through it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The boggle makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with the Dodge action or a use of its Tag!

actions.name: Footsnare Claw
actions.description:
Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

If a creature hit by this attack moves more than 15 feet on its following turn, it must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature gains the Prone condition.

actions.name: Slubber-Spit
actions.description:
Attack: +6 range 10/20 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) poison damage and the target's speed is reduced by a cumulative 5 feet until a creature cleans it off as an Action.

A creature whose Speed is reduced to 0 in this way has the Restrained condition. *Tag!* The boggle teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet, then each creature it hit with an attack this turn must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The creature must use all of its movement on its following turn to approach the boggle by the most direct route.

reactions.name: Pry Boot
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature wearing shoes within 5 feet of the boggle gains the Prone condition. Response: The boggle makes a Sleight of Hand check against the target's AC. On a success, the boggle steals one of the target's shoes.

name: Boggle Slosh-Body
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +8, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +6, Cha -2

traits.name: Portal Creep
traits.description: Once on each of the boggle's turns, it can treat any opening or frame as adjacent to each space within 50 feet of it, and can move, reach, or attack through it.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The boggle can move through a space as narrow as 1-inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The boggle makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with the Dodge action.

actions.name: Drippy Grip
actions.description:
Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) slashing damage.

If this attack wasn't made using the boggle's Portal Creep, the boggle additionally becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 14) on a hit.

actions.name: Pummel
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Body Snatch (1/Day)
actions.description:
*Slithering and distending, the boggle pushes its way through mouth and nose and ears and wounds.* The boggle disappears into a creature it is Attached to.

At the beginning of each of its turns, the creature must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature has the Dominated condition until the start of its next turn. Success by 5 or More: The boggle is expelled into an unoccupied adjacent space and gains the Prone condition.

reactions.name: Peek-a-Bash
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature ends its turn within 5 feet of a creature the boggle is inside. Response: The boggle can make a Pummel attack against it. On a miss, the target can use its Reaction to make a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check, ending the boggle's Body Snatch effect on a success.

name: Brownie
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +3, Con +1, Int +2, Wis +3, Cha +2
skills: Nature +6, Sleight Of Hand +7, Stealth +7, Survival +5

traits.name: Home Defender
traits.description: Whenever a creature passes through a threshold in a home that contains one or more brownies, the brownie can force the creature to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer one of the following effects: Triptwine. The creature takes 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. Fingerstinger. The creature takes 2 (1d4) poison damage and drops one object it is carrying. Pepperpouch. The creature is Blinded and unable to speak or breathe until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Corner of Your Eye
traits.description: The brownie is invisible to creatures with less than 20 Passive Perception. Whenever it is hit with an attack, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it is missed with an attack.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The brownie has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The brownie makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with its Brownie's Cunning.

actions.name: Toe-Stubber
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone if it is Medium or smaller and has its movement speed reduced by 10 for the next minute.

actions.name: Rubber Sling
actions.description: Attack: +5 range 30/60 ft. Hit: 4 Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Brownie's Cunning
actions.description: The brownie makes a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) or Dexterity (Stealth) check.

reactions.name: Trick Shot
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the brownie can see within 30 feet drops an object, the brownie makes an attack with its rubber sling against an AC of 20. On a hit, the dropped object is pushed 15 feet in a direction of the brownie's choice.

name: Centaur Charger
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -1, Wis +1

traits.name: Poison Vulnerability

traits.name: Charge

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The centaur may make this attack as a bonus action against a prone creature.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Centaur Longbow
reactions.description: The centaur longbow can be wielded by ordinary humanoids, but requires a Strength of 15 and can only be fired while mounted, due to its size.

name: Darkling
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +3, Con +1, Int +1

traits.name: Death Flash
traits.description: When the darkling dies, nonmagical light flashes out from it as its body burns to ash. Each creature in a 10-foot radius that can see must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Prematurely Aged
traits.description: The darkling has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws.

actions.name: Shoddy Stiletto
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. If this attack was made at Advantage, it deals an additional extra Hit: 7 (1d6) piercing damage. On a natural 1, the blade breaks and becomes unusable.

actions.name: Absorb Light
actions.description: The light level within 30 ft. of the darkling has its degree of brightness decreased by one, from Bright Light to Dim Light, from Dim Light to Darkness, or from Darkness to Magical Darkness. The Darkling takes 5 (2d4) radiant damage.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Hex
bonusActions.description: Baleful shadows cling to one creature within 60 ft. that the darkling can see. Whenever the target takes damage, it takes an additional 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage. This effect ends if the cursed creature is illuminated with Bright Light.

traits.description: On solstices and equinoxes, the dryad may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.description: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Tree Stride

traits.name: Fervent Protectors

actions.name: Club

actions.description: One humanoid creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be magically charmed. actions.name: Entreat
actions.description: One creature charmed by the dryad moves up to its speed and makes an attack against a target of its choice.

reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the dryad may cause the attacker's weapon to sprout thorns, dealing 1d8 Piercing damage to the attacker. resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from Weapons that aren't Named

traits.name: Fey Magic Resistance

traits.name: Stormshield
traits.description: Whenever the green man would take Lightning damage, he can channel and direct the lightning through his shield. One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take the Lightning damage in his stead.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
traits.description: If the green man would fail a saving throw, he may speak a secret name of the forest to succeed. If he uses his third legendary resistance, the forest ceases to aid him until the next dawn. Will, Will, Weald You Who Know The Gate The Everclosing All and One

legendaryActions.description: The green man is struck with a bolt of lightning. He and each creature within 5 ft. of him must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) Lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Nourish the Earth (costs 2 actions)
legendaryActions.description: Rootlike tendrils worm out of the green man's briar tomb, piercing the flesh of those within it. Each creature inside the briar tomb must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage and be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, its maximum Hit Points are reduced to its current Hit Points. The nearest plant creature friendly to the green man gains 5 Temporary Hit Points for each hit die expended this way.

name: Hound of the Wild Hunt
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -1, Wis +3, Cha +1
immunities: Lightning, Thunder, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Exhaustion, Frightened

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the hound takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the hound takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

traits.name: Moonhunter's Baying
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of three or more hounds of the wild hunt that can hear them subtracts 1d4 from saving throws it makes agains being Frightened.

actions.name: Snarling Bite (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 Piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the hound can grapple the target (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Worry (Group Action)
actions.description: One creature grappled by both the hound and at least one of the hound's allies must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or fall prone and take 12 damage per creature grappling it.

actions.name: Harry
actions.description: One Frightened creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly away from the hound.

reactions.name: Planelock Howl (Group Reaction)
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature it can see attempts to teleport, the hound begins to howl forcing the creature to succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or have its teleportation fail. Up to four other hounds may join this reaction, increasing the DC by 1 for each additional hound.

traits.name: Hollow Back

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The huldra makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Huntersbane Breath, if available.

actions.name: Hurl Boulder
