reactions.description: When the nereid takes any damage, she can force a creature she can see within 60 feet to succeed on a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed until it sets foot on land. The Cursed creature's pockets and any seagoing vessel it is in continually overflow with gold pieces that turn to sand if brought upon land or if the curse is removed. While swimming, the creature descends 30 feet at the beginning of each of its turns. A seagoing vessel begins to capsize after 1d12 hours of carrying a Cursed creature.

name: Nilbog Wag
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Anarchic Tenacity
traits.description: If two or more creatures with this trait would be killed by a single damage source, one of them (chosen at random) survives unharmed.

traits.name: Healing Reversal
traits.description: If the nilbog would receive any magical healing from a source other than its Wound Reversal, it instead loses that many Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nilbog makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with its Distort Perception or a use of the Dodge action.

actions.name: Toe-Smasher
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit with this attack falls Prone.

actions.name: Distort Perception
actions.description: One creature the nilbog can see within 60 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: Until the end of the creature's next turn, the creature has Disadvantage on attacks and the nilbog controls its movement.

reactions.name: Trade Trinket
reactions.description: Trigger: The nilbog is missed with a melee weapon attack. Response: The nilbog trades weapons with the attacker. It can use any weapons acquired in this way as though it were proficient with and attuned to them.

reactions.name: Wound Reversal
reactions.description: Trigger: The nilbog would take 20 damage or less from a single source. Response: The nilbog takes no damage, and is instead healed an equal amount. The nilbog receives any healing beyond its maximum Hit Points as Temporary Hit Points.

name: Nilbog Pandemoniac
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +7, Con +5, Wis +1, Cha +6

traits.name: Anarchic Tenacity
traits.description: If two or more creatures with this trait would be killed by a single damage source, one of them (chosen at random) survives unharmed.

traits.name: Healing Reversal
traits.description: If the nilbog would receive any magical healing from a source other than its Wound Reversal, it instead loses that many Hit Points.

traits.name: Nilbog Spirit
traits.description: When the nilbog is killed, the nearest goblin within 60 feet receives the Nilbog spirit, transforming into a Pandemoniac.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nilbog makes two attacks and uses its Distort Perception or Infectious Cackle.

actions.name: Fool's Scepter
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is Cursed for 1 minute. Whenever the Cursed creature fails a d20 Test, it falls Prone and takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Distort Perception
actions.description: One creature the nilbog can see within 60 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: Until the end of the creature's next turn, the creature has Disadvantage on attacks and the nilbog controls its movement.

actions.name: Infectious Cackle (Concentration)
actions.description: Uncontrollable laughter wells up within a creature the the nilbog can see within 60 feet, forcing it to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature falls Prone and begins Choking (Save Ends at end of turn), then the nilbog can target an additional creature in range with this effect.

reactions.name: Trade Trinket
reactions.description: Trigger: The nilbog is missed with a melee weapon attack. Response: The nilbog trades weapons with the attacker. It can use any weapons acquired in this way as though it were proficient with and attuned to them.

reactions.name: Wound Reversal
reactions.description: Trigger: The nilbog would take 20 damage or less from a single source. Response: The nilbog takes no damage, and is instead healed an equal amount. The nilbog receives any healing beyond its maximum Hit Points as Temporary Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Trickster's Tumble
legendaryActions.description: The nilbog moves up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Until the start of the nilbog's next turn, attacks against it have Disadvantage.

legendaryActions.name: Vicious Kick
legendaryActions.description: The nilbog moves up to its Speed, then can deal 5 (1d10) Bludgeoning damage to a Prone creature within 5 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Banish Wits
legendaryActions.description: One goblin affected by the nilbog's Infectious Cackle transforms into a Nilbog Wag under the nilbog's control, retaining its current Hit Points. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14. Success: The effect ends. After three failed saving throws, the effect becomes permanent.

name: Nuckelavee
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +3, Con +9, Int -2, Wis +8, Cha +7
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from weapons that aren't coated in fresh water or Named
languages: Understands Common and Sylvan but can't speak

traits.name: Wound-Swathed and Skin-Wanting
traits.description: Creatures with skin are Frightened of the nuckelavee while within 30 feet of it. As an action, an affected creature can make a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw, becoming immune to this effect for one hour on a success. Any hit with an attack by a non-Frightened creature that is grappled by the nuckelavee becomes a critical.

traits.name: Impure Terror
traits.description: The nuckelavee cannot voluntarily cross or enter fresh water. If splashed with fresh water, the nuckelavee must use its reaction to move 10 feet away from its source, or fall prone if it cannot. If submerged in fresh water, the nuckelavee is Frightened for the next minute.

traits.name: Restless Evil
traits.description: If the nuckelavee is destroyed and the largest remaining piece of it is not submerged in fresh water, it grows a new body from that piece at the next dusk, regaining all of its Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nuckelavee makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Blackreek Maw.

actions.name: Blackreek Maw
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 14 (4d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Dragging Graspers
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Red-Raw Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Flaying Embrace
actions.description: The skin of a creature grappled by the nuckelavee begins to recede from its touch, revealing muscle and sinew beneath. The target begins Bleeding (1d8, Save Ends at end of turn) and must succeed on a DC 17 Constituion saving throw or take 44 (8d10) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more becomes fused with the nuckelavee; while it remains grappled the creature is restrained and has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws. When this grapple ends, the creature takes 14 (4d6) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Writhing Pursuit
reactions.description:
When a Frightened creature leaves the area affected by the nuckelavee's
Wound-Swathed and Skin-Wanting, the nuckelavee can move up to its speed towards the creature and make a Dragging Graspers attack against it.

reactions.name: Yawning Howl
reactions.description: When the nuckelavee is reduced below 117 Hit Points, it can tear each of its mouths wide and howl forth a torrent of pestilence in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Mortasheen. Beasts fail this saving throw automatically.

name: Nymph Wayfarer
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +2, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +4

traits.name: Captivating Visage
traits.description: A creature that can see the nymph treats all other creatures and objects as Invisible. A creature that isn't Charmed or Surprised by the nymph can avert its eyes to avoid this effect at the start of its turn, instead treating the nymph as Invisible until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
traits.description: On solstices and equinoxes, the nymph may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

actions.name: Parting Touch (Concentration)
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). A creature Charmed in this way takes 3 (1d6) nonlethal Psychic damage at the start of each of its turn for each 5 feet away from the nymph that it is.

actions.name: Entreat
actions.description: One creature Charmed by the nymph must use its reaction to move up to its speed toward and make an attack against a target of the nymph's choice.

actions.name: Ensnare (1/Day)
actions.description: The nymph sets a faintly visible magical trap that lasts for a minute in a 5-foot radius centered on herself, which triggers the first time a nonfey creature enters the area. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or fall Unconscious until it takes any damage or a creature uses its action to wake it.

reactions.name: Blinding Beauty (1/Day)
reactions.description: When a creature that can see the nymph hits it with a melee attack, the nymph may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

name: Nymph Whisperer
savingThrows: Dex +4, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +5

traits.name: Captivating Visage
traits.description: A creature that can see the nymph treats all other creatures and objects as Invisible. A creature that isn't Charmed or Surprised by the nymph can avert its eyes to avoid this effect at the start of its turn, instead treating the nymph as Invisible until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Eldritch Grace
traits.description: While the nymph is moving on her turn, she becomes indistinct and insubstantial, gaining resistance to all damage.

traits.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
traits.description: On solstices and equinoxes, the nymph may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

actions.name: Whisper Game
actions.description: One creature within 10 feet of the nymph must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed by her for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). Whenever a Charmed creature succeeds on a saving throw to end this effect, the nymph may force one creature within 10 feet of it to make a saving throw against the same effect.

actions.name: Borrow Dreams
actions.description: One Unconscious creature within 5 feet of the nymph must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) nonlethal Psychic damage. If the creature fails this saving throw by 5 or more, this damage does not wake it, and the nymph gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt. If the Unconscious creature awakes, the nymph loses any of these Temporary Hit Points that it has and the creature gains an equal number of Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Ensnare (1/Day)
actions.description: The nymph sets a faintly visible magical trap that lasts for a minute in a 5-foot radius centered on herself, which triggers the first time a nonfey creature enters the area. The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or fall Unconscious until it takes any damage or a creature uses its action to wake it.

bonusActions.name: Parting Touch
bonusActions.description: The nymph touches a Charmed creature within 5 feet. Until the Charmed effect ends for it, the creature takes 7 (2d6) nonlethal Psychic damage at the beginning of each of its turns for each 5 feet away from the nymph that it is.

bonusActions.name: Entreat
bonusActions.description: One creature Charmed by the nymph must use its reaction to move up to its speed toward and make an attack against a target of the nymph's choice.

reactions.name: Blinding Beauty (1/Day)
reactions.description: When a creature that can see the nymph hits it with a melee attack, the nymph may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

name: ÅŒmukade
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +11, Con +12, Int -2, Wis +9, Cha +4
immunities: Poison, Attacks made without Advantage; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed

traits.name: Desiccation Weakness
traits.description: If the omukade takes any fire or Necrotic damage, it loses an unspent Legendary Action, or takes a point of Exhaustion if it can't.

traits.name: Saliva-Pierced
traits.description: Attacks against the omukade with weapons coated in saliva have Advantage, and the omukade has vulnerability to damage dealt by them.

traits.name: Segment Titan
traits.description: The omukade's body is divided into 15 contiguous sements, each of which fills a 15-foot cube and has the following properties. Movement. When one of the omukade's segments moves, each connected segment is dragged behind it to the nearest unoccupied space. Its movement can originate from any of its segments. Reach. The omukade's Headclipper Mandibles and Mountain-Metal Toxicognaths attacks originate from the segment that contains its head. Its Stomp of Nine Agonies can originate from any segment. Climbing. A creature within 5 feet of a segment can spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check, becoming Attached to that segment or moving from one segment to another on a success.

traits.name: Reflexive Molt (1/Day)
traits.description: When the omukade fails a saving throw or takes any damage, it can choose to succeed on the saving throw or reduce that damage to 0 by rapidly shedding its exoskeleton, disgorging its soft inner body through its mouth into the nearest unoccupied spaces. The exoskeleton can be attacked and destroyed (AC 18; 60 HP). Until it completes a Long Rest or uses its Devour Chitin, attacks against the omukade have Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The omukade makes four attacks, one of which can be with either its Headclipper Mandibles or Mountain-Metal Toxicognaths.

actions.name: Mountain-Metal Toxicognaths
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 22).

actions.name: Headclipper Mandibles
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 10 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) slashing damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or be beheaded.

actions.name: Stomp of Nine Agonies
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 15 ft. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) piercing damage. A creature that takes 20 or more damage from this attack is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Caudal Thrash
bonusActions.description: Each creature climbing on the omukade must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage and fall prone in the nearest unoccupied space. Until the end of its turn, the omukade's melee attacks have a reach of 200 feet and Advantage.

bonusActions.name: Devour Chitin
bonusActions.description: The omukade gorges itself upon its shed exoskeleton, consuming it. Until it takes a Long Rest, the omukade's AC is increased by a cumulative +2, to a maximum of 24.

bonusActions.name: Impure Infusion
bonusActions.description: The omukade pumps venom into a creature it is grappling, forcing it to succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or take 35 (10d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success. Then, if the creature has 30 or fewer Hit Points, it drops to 0 Hit Points and fails two death saving throws. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw permanently gains resistance to poison damage from other sources.

reactions.name: Scalding Vent
reactions.description: When the omukade takes any fire or Necrotic damage, it can vent boiling steam through the spiracles that run down its body, dealing 7 (2d6) Fire damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.

legendaryActions.name: Skittering Stampede
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 10 feet of the omukade that is not climbing on or grappled by it must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away, then the omukade moves up to half its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Two-Hundred-Torch Gaze
legendaryActions.description: Blinding light blazes from the omukade's eyes in a 60-foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of the omukade's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Agonizing Trample (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The omukade makes an attack with its Stomp of Nine Agonies against each creature in its reach that is not climbing on it.

name: Oread
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +2, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +4

traits.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
traits.description: On solstices and equinoxes, the oread may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

traits.name: Sure-footed
traits.description: The oread has Advantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oread makes two attacks with its elusive bow.

actions.name: Elusive Bow
actions.description: Attack: +5 range 150/600 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage and the oread becomes invisible to the target until the end of the oread's next turn. This bow can fire arrows, bolts, or javelins.

actions.name: Rough Shove
actions.description: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or take 17 (4d6+3) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed 15 ft. away. A creature that cannot see the oread makes this save at Disadvantage.

reactions.name: Catch Token
reactions.description: As a reaction to being missed with a ranged weapon attack, the oread catches the projectile. As long as it holds this projectile, it gains +2 AC against the attacker's attacks. If the oread fires the projectile back at its owner, the attack hits automatically.

name: Oread Protokynegos
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +7, Con +6, Int +2, Wis +6, Cha +4

traits.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
traits.description: On solstices and equinoxes, the oread may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

traits.name: Sure-footed
traits.description: The oread has Advantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

traits.name: Mountain Echo
traits.description: Whenever a spell is cast within 30 ft. of the oread, the spell takes effect twice. The oread chooses the targets for the duplicate spell. If the spell requires concentration, the oread must concentrate on it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oread makes three attacks with its elusive bow, one of which it may replace with a Rough Shove.

actions.name: Elusive Bow
actions.description: Attack: +7 range 150/600 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and the oread becomes invisible to the target until the end of the oread's next turn. This bow can fire arrows, bolts, or javelins.

actions.name: Rough Shove
actions.description: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or take 25 (6d6+4) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed 20 ft. away. A creature that cannot see the oread makes this save at Disadvantage.

reactions.name: Catch Token
reactions.description: As a reaction to being missed with a ranged weapon attack, the oread catches the projectile. As long as it holds this projectile, it gains +3 AC against the attacker's attacks. If the oread fires the projectile back at its owner, the attack hits automatically.

name: Pixie
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +5, Con +1, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The pixie has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Corner of Your Eye
traits.description: The pixie is invisible to creatures with less than 20 Passive Perception. Whenever it is hit with an attack, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it is missed with an attack.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Attack: +7 range 80/320 ft. Hit: 6 (1 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Pixie Dust
actions.description: One creature within 15 feet gains a 60-foot fly speed for the next hour.

actions.name: Grasping Vines
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained by entangling vines (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Drowsy Drift
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or fall asleep until the sleeper takes damage or someone uses an action to shake or slap the sleeper awake.

name: Pugwampi Stumblun
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +1, Con +1, Int -1, Wis -3, Cha -2

traits.name: Aura of Unluck
traits.description: The pugwampi and each creature within 30 feet of it has Disadvantage on all d20 rolls. A affected creature that rolls a 1 on a d20 takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage and falls prone.

actions.name: Rib-Rattle Kick
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 2 (1d4) damage to a prone target.

actions.name: Hazardslash
actions.description: The pugwampi twirls and slashes its blade through the air madly, forcing itself and each other creature within 5 feet of it to make a Dexterity Saving Throw. The target with the lowest result takes 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, and each other target takes half as much.

reactions.name: Dodge-Roll
reactions.description: When a Medium or larger non-prone creature targets the pugwampi with a melee attack, the pugwampi can tumble through the attacker's legs to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. The attacker must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or choose a new target for its attack.

name: Pugwampi Slunk
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -1, Wis -3, Cha -2

traits.name: Aura of Unluck
traits.description: The pugwampi and each creature within 30 feet of it has Disadvantage on all d20 rolls. An affected creature that rolls a 1 on a d20 takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage and falls prone.

actions.name: Rib-Rattle Kick
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 2 (1d4) damage to a prone target.

actions.name: Skipping Stone
actions.description: Attack: +5 range 30 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. On a miss, the pugwampi makes a second attack roll against a random creature in range, ignoring the effects of Disadvantage.

actions.name: Mud Dive
actions.description: The pugwampi falls prone with a splash as the ground beneath it briefly turns to slop. Until the slunk stands, it becomes Invisible to creatures more than 5 feet away from it. Then, if no creature is within 5 feet of it, the pugwampi can attempt to Hide.

reactions.name: Barked Jeer
reactions.description: When a creature within 30 feet of the pugwampi falls prone, it can force each creature within 30 feet that it is hidden from to use its reaction to make a Wisdom (Perception) check to search for the pugwampi.

name: Pugwampi Snaggrat
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -1, Wis -3, Cha +2

traits.name: Aura of Unluck
traits.description: The pugwampi and each creature within 30 feet of it has Disadvantage on all d20 rolls. An affected creature that rolls a 1 on a d20 takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage and falls prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pugwampi makes two attacks with its Rib-Rattle Kick, one of which it can replace with a use of its Invoke Misfortune, if available.

actions.name: Rib-Rattle Kick
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 2 (1d4) damage to a prone target.

actions.name: Drag Pit (Concentration)
actions.description: The pugwampi grasps the edge of a pit, trap, or other hazard no larger than 15 feet in any dimension. Until the pugwampi makes an attack, the pit and any creatures trapped in it move with the pugwampi. A creature whose space the pit is dragged into for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall in.

actions.name: Invoke Misfortune (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The pugwampi and each other creature within 30 feet of it must make a Charisma Saving Throw. Each creature that rolls a 1 suffers a freak accident that inflicts two of the following effects, as determined by the DM: The creature takes 7 (2d6) damage of any one type. The creature is Blinded until the end of its next turn. The creature begins Burning (1d10). The creature is Restrained (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Wasp Grenade (1/Day)
actions.description: The pugwampi hurls a jar of angry wasps at a point it can see within 30 feet. Each creature within 10 feet takes 5 poison damage, then must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from that point.

reactions.name: Wobble Apart
reactions.description: When a creature the pugwampi can see misses with an attack with a weapon made of two or more pieces, the pugwampi can cause the weapon to fall apart, becoming an Improvised Weapon. A creature may use its action or bonus action to repair the weapon with a successful DC 12 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.

name: Quickling
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex +6, Con +1, Wis +1, Cha +3
skills: Acrobatics +8, Perception +5, Sleight Of Hand +8, Stealth +8

traits.name: Blurred Movement
traits.description: Attack rolls against the quickling have Disadvantage unless the quickling is incapacitated or has its movement speed reduced.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If the quickling is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity Saving Throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Small and Distant
traits.description: While at least 60 ft. from any hostile creature, the quickling can attempt to Hide as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The quickling makes three dagger attacks.

actions.name: Cutpurse Dagger
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 8 (1d4 + 6) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the quickling steals a worn or carried item from the target.

reactions.name: Cackling Caprice
reactions.description: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the quickling may force the creature to succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

name: Redcap Skinner
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +4, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Iron Boots
traits.description: While moving, the redcap has Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

traits.name: Outsize Strength
traits.description: While grappling, the redcap is considered to be size Medium. Additionally, wielding a heavy weapon doesn't impose Disadvantage on its attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The redcap makes two attacks with its skin peeler.

actions.name: Skin Peeler
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage and the target begins to bleed, losing 1d4 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. This effect ends when a creature succeeds on a DC 12 medicine check as an action, or when the bleeding creature receives magical healing.

actions.name: Ironbound Pursuit
actions.description: The redcap moves up to its speed to a creature it can see and kicks with its iron boots. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 20 (3d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Soak Cap
bonusActions.description: The redcap soaks its hat in the blood of a dead or unconscious creature. Until the end of its next turn, the redcap has resistance to damage dealt by weapons not made of cold iron and Advantage on all attacks.

name: Redcap Barber
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +4, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Iron Boots
traits.description: While moving, the redcap has Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

traits.name: Outsize Strength
traits.description: While grappling, the redcap is considered to be size Medium. Additionally, wielding a heavy weapon doesn't impose Disadvantage on its attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The redcap makes three attacks with its barbed sling.

actions.name: Barbed Sling
actions.description: Ranged or *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target begins to bleed, losing 1d4 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. This effect ends when a creature succeeds on a DC 12 medicine check to stanch the wound as an action, or when the bleeding creature receives magical healing.

actions.name: Ironbound Pursuit
actions.description: The redcap moves up to its speed to a creature it can see and kicks with its iron boots. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 20 (3d10+4) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Soak Cap
bonusActions.description: The redcap soaks its hat in the blood of a dead or unconscious creature. Until the end of its next turn, the redcap has resistance to damage dealt by weapons not made of cold iron and Advantage on all attacks.

name: Redcap Master of Cruelty
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +4, Wis +3

traits.name: Iron Boots
traits.description: While moving, the redcap has Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

traits.name: Outsize Strength
traits.description: While grappling, the redcap is considered to be size Medium. Additionally, wielding a heavy weapon doesn't impose Disadvantage on its attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The redcap makes three attacks with its cruel nail.

actions.name: Cruel Nail (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage and the target's speed is reduced to zero as its shadow is nailed to the ground. The creature may remove a nail as an action with a successful DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check, or may free itself by spending half its movement and taking 7 (2d6) damage per nail it rips itself free from.

actions.name: Ironbound Pursuit
actions.description: The redcap moves up to its speed to a creature it can see and kicks with its iron boots. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 26 (4d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Soak Cap
bonusActions.description: The redcap soaks its hat in the blood of a dead or unconscious creature. Until the end of its next turn, the redcap has resistance to damage dealt by weapons not made of cold iron and Advantage on all attacks.

name: Redcap Crow King
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +4, Con +5, Wis +7, Cha +6

traits.name: Iron Boots
traits.description: While moving, the redcap has Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the redcap remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a corpse.

traits.name: Outsize Strength
traits.description: While grappling, the redcap is considered to be size Medium. Additionally, wielding a heavy weapon doesn't impose Disadvantage on its attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The redcap uses its Peck Eyes ability twice, one of which it may replace with a use of either its Rouse Blood or its Ironbound Pursuit.

actions.name: Peck Eyes (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The redcap calls a flock of crows down to peck at the eyes of up to peck at the eyes of a creature. One creature the redcap can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 31 (7d8) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 10 or more loses an eye.

actions.name: Rouse Blood (Level 5 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The redcap targets a friendly redcap within 30 ft., giving it Bloodlust for the next minute. A creature affected by Bloodlust may make an attack or attempt to grapple a creature as a Bonus Action each turn, and gains 10 Temporary Hit Points when it reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack.

actions.name: Ironbound Pursuit
actions.description: The redcap moves up to its speed to a creature it can see and kicks with its iron boots. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 27 (4d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Soak Cap
bonusActions.description: The redcap soaks its hat in the blood of a dead or unconscious creature. Until the end of its next turn, the redcap has resistance to damage dealt by weapons not made of cold iron and Advantage on all attacks.

name: Wild Rider Moon Witch
savingThrows: Dex +5, Con +4, Int +8, Wis +6, Cha +3

traits.name: Never There
traits.description: When the rider succeeds on a saving throw made against a spell or magical effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The rider has Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rider casts Slithermist and uses one of its Moon Virtues. If its Mist Reflections trait is active, it instead uses a number of Moon Virtues equal to its current number of Mist Reflections.

actions.name: Slithermist (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +8 ranged 60 ft. Hit: 21 (6d6) necrotic damage and the rider may make another attack against a creature within 15 feet of the previous target. A creature may be the target of this spell only once per turn.

actions.name: Moon Virtues
actions.description: The rider targets a creature it can see within 60 feet, choosing one of the following effects: Confounding Lurch. The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or be teleported up to 30 feet. * Hazy Transposition. One target creature within 60 feet must make a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or switch positions with one of the rider's Mist Reflections. * Shifting Silhouettes. A stark silver light reduces everyone to shadowy silhouettes for the creature. The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence Saving Throw or treat all creatures as hostile until the end of the rider's next turn. * Treacherous Footing. The creature must succeed on DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 18) until the end of the rider's next turn as the ground beneath it becomes briefly insubstantial. * Moonstruck. The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be disoriented by the dancing moonlight, suffering Disadvantage on its next attack roll. If the attack misses, the creature falls prone.

reactions.name: Vaporize
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the rider reduces the projectile to wisps of vapor, reducing the attack's damage to 0.

reactions.name: Mist Reflections (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 55 Hit Points, the rider gains 55 Temporary Hit Points, splits into five Mist Reflections that each appear at an unoccupied location within 60 feet, and gains resistance to all damage as long as it has at least two Mist Forms. A Mist Reflection dissipates when it is dealt damage, and when only one remeains it becomes corporeal and this effect ends. If all remaining Mist Reflections are dealt damage simultaneously, the rider is slain.

name: Wild Rider Bulwark
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +5, Con +8, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: As long as it wields its shield, the rider is unaffected by spells of 2nd level or below. Whenever it negates a spell in this way, the next attack roll against the rider has Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rider makes two attacks; one with its crushing maul and one with its shield bash. If it doesn't have its shield, it instead makes three attacks with its maul.

actions.name: Crushing Maul
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Ponderous Strike (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 10-foot cube originating from the rider must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 39 (6d12) Bludgeoning damage. Until the end of its next turn, attacks against the rider are made at Advantage.

reactions.name: Vengeful Smash
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature missing it with a melee attack, the rider makes an attack with its Shield Bash. If it hits, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the rider's next turn.

reactions.name: Flickering Rampage (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 95 Hit Points, the rider hurls its shield at a creature within 20 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. For the next minute, whenever the rider makes an attack it may teleport up to 15 feet as part of the attack, and it loses all damage resistances and its Limited Magic Immunity.

name: Wild Rider Mist Thief
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +5, Con +7, Int +2, Wis +7, Cha +3

traits.name: Dread Revels
traits.description: The rider has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are Frightened.

actions.name: Clutch of Terror
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 15 ft. Hit: 55 (10d10) necrotic damage and the target is dragged up to 15 feet toward the rider, then must make a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened for the next minute. If a creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage and fails the save, it immediately regains one hit point and acts under the rider's control for as long as it remains Frightened. A creature may repeat this save at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

bonusActions.name: Steal Away
bonusActions.description: The rider ends one spell of 3rd level or below affecting a friendly creature, or duplicates a spell affecting an enemy it can see, choosing new targets for the spell.

reactions.name: Echoing Chuckle
reactions.description: As a reaction when the rider succeeds on a saving throw, the rider teleports up to 60 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of the space it teleports to must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the rider's next turn.

reactions.name: Fade Away
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 85 Hit Points, the rider becomes insubstantial while it is in dim light or darkness for the next minute. While in this misty state, attacks against the rider are made at Disadvantage.

name: Rusalka
savingThrows: Dex +3, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Land Vulnerability
traits.description: The rusalka takes 20 Acid damage if it starts its turn outside of running water. For the week surrounding the Spring Equinox, this trait is suspended.

traits.name: Watery Rebirth
traits.description: If the rusalka dies while submerged in water, its body dissolves into water, reforming at the next dusk in the body of water where it lairs.

actions.name: Strangling Locks
actions.description: Weapon Attack: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). A creature grappled in this way is restrained and cannot speak or breathe.

actions.name: Comb of Needles
actions.description: Weapon Attack: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Slashing damage and the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of a bleeding creature's turns, it must make a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw, losing 1d4 Hit Points on a failed save, or ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Luring Song (concentration)
actions.description: The rusalka sings a magical melody. One humanoid within 60 ft. that the rusalka can see must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed until the rusalka stops singing. The rusalka may continue the song as a bonus action on each of its turns. A creature charmed in this way uses its movement to approach the rusalka on its turn. A charmed target repeats saving throw at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Tickle
reactions.description: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack by a creature holding its breath, the rusalka forces the attacker to succeed on DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or release its held breath.

name: Rusalka (During Rusalka Week)
savingThrows: Dex +3, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Watery Rebirth
traits.description: If the rusalka dies while submerged in water, its body dissolves into water, reforming at the next dusk in the body of water where it lairs.

traits.name: Ecstatic Dance
traits.description: Each creature within 30 ft. of the rusalka has Disadvantage on saving throws against being Charmed. A creature Charmed in this area uses its action to dance on its turn. If at least three creatures are Charmed by the rusalka, the area counts as difficult terrain for creatures that are not charmed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rusalka makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Strangling Locks
actions.description: Weapon Attack: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). A creature grappled in this way is restrained and cannot speak or breathe.

actions.name: Comb of Needles
actions.description: Weapon Attack: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Slashing damage and the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of a bleeding creature's turns, it must make a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw, losing 1d4 Hit Points on a failed save, or ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Luring Song (concentration)
actions.description: The rusalka sings a magical melody. One humanoid within 60 ft. that the rusalka can see must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed until the rusalka stops singing. The rusalka may continue the song as a bonus action on each of its turns, and may choose a new target when it does so. A creature Charmed in this way uses its movement to approach the rusalka on its turn, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Ensnare
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature attempting to leave the range of its Ecstatic Dance while the rusalka is singing, the rusalka uses its Luring Song targeting the creature.

name: Satyr Bounder
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +3, Int +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Feinting Frolick
traits.description: Whenever the satyr is missed with an attack or succeeds on a saving throw, it gains Advantage on the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The satyr has Advantage on saving throws against spells or other magical effects.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.

actions.name: Merciless Mockery
actions.description: One creature within 90 feet that the satyr saw fail a D20 test since the end of the satyr's last turn must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 9 (2d8) Psychic damage. This damage can't reduce a creature below 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Impulsive Rush
actions.description: The satyr takes the Dodge action, then can move up to half its Speed.

name: Satyr Celebrant
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +5, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Feinting Frolick
traits.description: Whenever the satyr is missed with an attack or succeeds on a saving throw, it gains Advantage on the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The satyr has Advantage on saving throws against spells or other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The satyr makes two attacks and can use its Thrashing Leap or Impulsive Rush.

actions.name: Spirited Flail
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The first time each turn that this attack misses, the satyr must make an additional attack roll, choosing a different target in its reach.

actions.name: Thrashing Leap
actions.description: The satyr leaps up to 15 feet, then each creature within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Impulsive Rush
actions.description: The satyr takes the Dodge action, then can move up to half its Speed.

reactions.name: Pluck Free
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 5 feet rolls a 1 on an attack roll. Response: The satyr steals the attacker's weapon, and counts as proficient with it.

reactions.name: Wild Whirl
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature enters the satyr's reach for the first time on a turn. Response: The satyr makes a melee attack against it with Disadvantage.

name: Satyr Throng
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +6, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha +2
immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Packed Swarm
traits.description: The throng can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, can move through any opening large enough for a single satyr, and can't regain Hit Points. When the swarm moves, each Medium or smaller creature in its space moves with it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The throng has Advantage on saving throws against spells or other magical effects.

actions.name: Riotous Rampage
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 0 ft. Hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or half as much if the throng is Bloodied. This attack targets each enemy in the throng's space.

actions.name: Hurl Firebrands
actions.description: One target within 30 feet must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 22 (4d10) Fire damage and the target begins Burning (1d10). Success: Half damage. A Medium or smaller target has Advantage on this saving throw.

reactions.name: Revel's Allure
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature attempts to exit the throng's space. Response: The creature must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The creature can't willingly leave the throng's space this turn.

name: Satyr Revelmaster
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +7, Con +1, Int +1, Wis +5, Cha +3

traits.name: Feinting Frolick
traits.description: Whenever the satyr is missed with an attack or succeeds on a saving throw, it gains Advantage on the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The satyr has Advantage on saving throws against spells or other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The satyr makes three attacks and can use its Impulsive Rush or Share Libations.

actions.name: Wild Strike
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away. On a miss, the target can use its Reaction to make an Opportunity Attack.

actions.name: Impulsive Rush
actions.description: The satyr takes the Dodge action, then can move up to half its Speed.

actions.name: Share Libations (1/Day)
actions.description: Each Charmed or willing creature within 5 feet gains 10 Temporary Hit Points that last for a minute. A Swarm affected by this ability gains twice as many Temporary Hit Points. While a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it is Charmed by the satyr, Poisoned, and has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Ecstatic Dance (Level 2 Spell)
bonusActions.description: Each creature the satyr hit with an attack this turn must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature is Charmed until the end of the satyr's next turn, or until it takes any damage. While Charmed in this way, the creature must use its Action to Dash, Disengage, or Dodge.

bonusActions.name: Incite Abandon
bonusActions.description: Each creature Charmed by the satyr must use its Reaction to make a melee attack against a random creature in its reach.

name: Snipe
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +3, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Bushpilot
traits.description: A bush or shrub that contains one or more snipes gains the statistics of an Awakened Shrub and follows any verbal commands given it in sylvan.

traits.name: Corner of Your Eye
traits.description: The snipe is invisible to any creature with less than 20 Passive Perception. Whenever the snipe is hit with an attack or grappled, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it is missed with an attack.

actions.name: Curious Nip
actions.description: Attack: +2 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage and the target may use its reaction to attempt to grapple the snipe.

actions.name: Tuck and Roll
actions.description: The snipe retracts all of its limbs and moves up to twice its speed. Attacks of opportunity provoked by this movement are made at Disadvantage.

reactions.name: Panic
reactions.description: As a reaction when it realizes a creature can see it, the snipe lets out a gurgling scream and uses its Tuck and Roll to move in a random direction, bouncing if it hits a creature or solid object.

name: Spriggan Wrack
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Wis +3, Cha +1

traits.name: Giant Distention (Recharge 5-6)
traits.description: As a bonus action, the spriggan grows to size Large until the end of its turn. While enlarged, the spriggan makes melee attacks at Advantage, and it makes one fewer attack with its multiattack.

traits.name: Fey Weakness
traits.description: The spriggan has Disadvantage on attack rolls that target a creature wearing inside-out clothing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spriggan makes three melee attacks, or two melee attacks if it is enlarged.

actions.name: Kneecapper (Small Size Only)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target falls prone and cannot stand on its following turn.

actions.name: Skullsmasher (Large Size Only)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the spriggan's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Evil Eye (Concentration)
bonusActions.description: As a bonus action, the spriggan forces one creature within 30 ft. that can see the it to make a DC 13 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature subtracts 1d4 from any attacks or saving throws it makes until the end of its next turn.

name: Spriggan Powrie
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +4, Wis +3, Cha +1

traits.name: Giant Distention (Recharge 5-6)
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the spriggan grows to size Large until the end of its turn. While enlarged, the spriggan makes melee attacks at Advantage, and it makes one fewer attack with its multiattack.

traits.name: Blood Slide
traits.description: The spriggan can Disengage as a Bonus Action while adjacent to one or more creatures that are bleeding.

traits.name: Fey Confusion
traits.description: The spriggan has Disadvantage on attack rolls that target a creature wearing inside-out clothing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spriggan makes three melee attacks, or two melee attacks if it is enlarged.

actions.name: Skin Peeler (Small Size Only)
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage and the target begins to bleed, losing 1d4 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. This effect ends when a creature succeeds on a DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check as an action, or when the bleeding creature receives magical healing.

actions.name: Skin Shredder (Large Size Only)
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage and the target begins to bleed, losing 2d4 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. This effect ends when a creature succeeds on a DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check as an action, or when the bleeding creature receives magical healing.

reactions.name: Punt the Fallen (Large Size Only)
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature falling prone within 5 ft. of it, the powrie forces the creature to succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed 20 ft. away.

name: Sprite Miscreant
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +4, Int +1, Wis +1

traits.name: Corner of Your Eye
traits.description: While it is not Incapacitated, the sprite is Invisible to any nonbeast, nonfey creature with a Passive Perception below 16.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the sprite takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the sprite takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Needleblade Slice (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Slashing damage.

actions.name: Gossamer Hobble
actions.description: The sprite flies around the legs of a Small or larger creature within 5 feet, trailing a length of clear silk. The first time each turn that the creature moves more than 30 feet, it must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone. This distance is reduced by 5 feet each additional time the creature is affected by this ability, and the effect ends when the creature succeeds on the saving throw or removes the silk as an action.

name: Sprite Trifler
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex +4, Con +1, Int +1, Wis +1

traits.name: Corner of Your Eye
traits.description: While it is not Incapacitated, the sprite is Invisible to any nonbeast, nonfey creature with a Passive Perception below 16.

traits.name: Trifling Strength
traits.description: The sprite can grapple and shove creatures up to three sizes larger than it, and may wield improvised weapons that are up to one size larger than it without penalty.

actions.name: Improvised Weapon
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. or range 20/60, Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Collar Grab
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). A creature grappled in this way that the sprite attempts to lift into the air may make a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw. On a success, the sprite cannot lift the creature this turn.

actions.name: Instigating Shove
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the sprite must make a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed up to 10 feet, then must make a melee attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

reactions.name: Brazen Theft
reactions.description: When a creature misses the sprite with a melee weapon attack, the sprite can force the creature to make a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the sprite wrenches one object the attacker is carrying free from its grasp.

reactions.name: Go Limp
reactions.description: When the sprite takes damage from a weapon attack or from a spell that did not target it, the sprite reduces that damage to 0. Then, the sprite is pushed up to 15 feet from the source of that damage and falls prone.

name: Sprite Beetleknecht
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex +4, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Corner of Your Eye
traits.description: While it is not Incapacitated, the sprite is Invisible to any nonbeast, nonfey creature with a Passive Perception below 16.

traits.name: Beetle-Rider
traits.description: While the sprite is riding a Tiny beetle, it acts on the beetle's initiative, instead of rolling its own, and the beetle gains the effects of the sprite's Corner of Your Eye trait.

traits.name: Delaminating Shell
traits.description: Whenever the sprite takes damage, it may reduce that damage to 1. If it does, its AC is reduced by 1 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sprite makes three attacks with its Beetleprong Lance.

actions.name: Beetleprong Lance
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Occupy Mouth
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the sprite must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or have the sprite (and its mount) enter the creature's mouth and lodge there, becoming Attached to the creature and gaining full cover against outside effects. The creature cannot speak, but may attempt to bite the sprite with an unarmed attack as a bonus action, and can expel the sprite as an action with a successful DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw.

actions.name: Pry Tooth
actions.description: The sprite attempts to pull a tooth from a creature's mouth that the sprite is lodged in. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more loses a tooth.

actions.name: Ironclad Investiture (1/Day, Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Each friendly non-sprite, non-humanoid creature within 30 feet of the sprite with an AC lower than 17 grows a layer of iridescent chitin over its skin that lasts for an hour, increasing its AC to 17.

name: Sprite Grammary
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +5, Con +1, Int +2, Wis +3, Cha +5

traits.name: Heart Sight
traits.description: The sprite can magically sense the emotional state of creatures it can see, and knows when it hears a lie.

traits.name: Corner of Your Eye
traits.description: While it is not Incapacitated, the sprite is Invisible to any nonbeast, nonfey creature a Passive Perception below 16.

traits.name: Shilly-Shally (5/Day)
traits.description: If the sprite would take any damage or fail a saving throw, it may teleport to switch places with any Tiny object it can see within 30 feet of it and be unaffected by the triggering damage or saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sprite makes three attacks with its Dead-Nettle Switch, two of which it may replace with its Lullwright's Whisper.

actions.name: Dead-Nettle Switch
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) poison damage. Saving throws to maintain concentration that are triggered by this damage are made at Disadvantage.

actions.name: Lullwright's Whisper
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the sprite must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or fall prone and be unable to take hostile actions until the end of the sprite's next turn. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more falls asleep for the next hour. These effects end early if a creature takes an action to shake the creature awake, or if it takes any damage.

actions.name: Weave Glamer (Level 6 Spell, 1/Day, Concentration)
actions.description: The sprite weaves a subtle illusory charm, affecting the area within 60 feet of it for the next hour. Each creature or object in the area of the sprite's choice appears to be a different creature or object of similar size, and creatures in the area subtract 1d4 from the result of any Wisdom Saving Throws they make. A creature that successfully disbelieves the illusion as an action with a successful DC 16 Intelligence (Investigation) check is unaffected.

bonusActions.name: Trooping Trounce
bonusActions.description: Each friendly sprite within 20 feet of a prone or unconscious creature the sprite can see within 60 feet may use its reaction to move up to 15 feet towards the creature and kick it repeatedly. The creature takes 2 Bludgeoning damage per sprite within 5 feet of it, or twice as much damage if the creature was unconscious.

bonusActions.name: Spirit Away (Level 3 Spell)
bonusActions.description: One unconscious creature the sprite can see within 60 feet is wreathed in dancing lights and begins to levitate 15 feet off the ground until it wakes or leaves the forest the sprite is bound to. At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it floats 20 feet in a direction of the sprite's choice.

reactions.name: Expand Truth (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the sprite hears a creature make a true statement using a word or phrase with multiple possible meanings, the sprite can force it to succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed for a year and a day. While the creature is Cursed in this way, its statement becomes true under another meaning of that word or phrase.

reactions.name: Animate Lie (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the sprite hears a creature tell a lie or voice a wish relating to its abilities, intentions, or memories, the sprite can force it to succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed for a year and a day. While Cursed in this way, the creature's statistics, class levels, proficiencies, intentions, and memories change to fit the lie.

name: Verdant Prince Oathsealer
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +4, Int +8, Wis +7, Cha +10
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from Weapons that aren't Named

traits.name: Tree Stride
traits.description: Once on its turn, the prince can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into one living tree within its reach and emerge from a second living tree within 500 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or larger.

traits.name: Fey Magic Resistance
traits.description: The prince has Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The prince makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with one of its Lesser Spells.

actions.name: Crann-TabuÃ¡ll, The Apple-Staff
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 31 (5d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Sling Feat-Apple (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Attack: +8 range 120/500 ft. Hit: 59 (10d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target's name was spoken as the piece of amunition was crafted, the attack is made at Advantage, does Force damage instead of any other type, and the creature must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma Saving Throw or be Stunned for 1 minute. A stunned creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Oath Bond
actions.description: The verdant prince seals an agreement between itself and another creature with powerful magic. The bargain can be nearly anything, but must involve an exchange of goods or services. A creature that fails to perform its duties under the bargain has Disadvantage on any ability check not made to remedy its debt, and its failure and location is known to the other party.

actions.name: Harmless Gift (Level 1 Spell)
actions.description:
One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or accept a small gift from it. While it carries the gift, the creature has Disadvantage on attacks that target the prince. The creature may repeat this saving throw as an action, discarding the gift on a success.
-

actions.name: Adopt Guise (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description:
The prince changes its face that of any humanoid, though it retains its unearthly beauty, in a manner undetectable by divination Spells.
-

actions.name: Misty Step (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description:
The prince teleports up to 30 ft. to a location it can see.
-

actions.name: Dispel Magic (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The prince targets one spell effect within 60 ft. and makes an Intelligence check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, ending the spell on a success. If the spell is 3rd level or below, the prince succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Baleful Polymorph (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description:
One creature within 60 ft. that the prince can see must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw be transformed into a goat for one minute, though it retains its mental ability scores, proficiencies, and languages. If the creature is a debtor to the prince and the prince maintains concentration for one minute, the transformation instead lasts until the creature's debt is made good or forgiven.

*

actions.name: Repel Metal (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Each creature wielding a metal weapon or shield or wearing metal armor within 30 ft. of the prince must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or take 35 (10d6) Bludgeoning damage and be hurled up to 30 ft. away, or take half as much damage and be pushed 15 ft. on a success.

reactions.name: Deft Parry
reactions.description: The prince adds 4 to its AC against one attack that would hit it. If this causes the attack to miss and the prince has fewer than half its Hit Points, the prince may make a melee attack as part of this reaction.

reactions.name: Thorny Retort
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the prince causes the attacker's weapon to sprout thorns, dealing 9 (2d8) Piercing damage to the attacker. The attacker must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or drop its weapon. If the attacker picks up its weapon this turn, the prince may immediately make a club attack against it.

traits.name: Invulnerable Sheath
traits.description: While the prince wields its sheath in its off-hand, it regains its reaction any time a creature casts a spell within 60 ft.

traits.name: Light-Footed
traits.description: The prince has a fly speed equal to its walk speed on its turn. Whenever a creature misses the prince with a melee attack, it may move up to 5 ft.

traits.name: Heavy Strikes
traits.description: Whenever the prince hits a creature whose name it knows with an attack, it is pushed 5 ft. back. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone.

traits.name: Fey Magic Resistance

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The prince makes three attacks with its unchallengable blade. If it does not use its multiattack, it scores a critical hit on an 11-20 on its turn.

actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage. On a critical hit, if the target is holding a weapon that isn't named, the weapon shatters.

reactions.name: Lightning Deflection
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack or spell that targets only it, the prince makes an unchallengable blade attack roll against an AC of 20. On a hit, the attack or spell fails.

name: Verdant Prince Lifeshaper

traits.name: Lifeblood Conduit

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The prince casts one of its lesser works and one greater work.

actions.name: Heart Sunder (Level 1 Spell)

The prince touches a weapon, attuning it to the blood of a creature whose name it knows. The next time the enchanted weapon hits the named creature, it deals maximum damage, instead of rolling.

actions.name: Lifesight (Level 2 Spell)

-

actions.name: Reveal True Name (Level 3 Spell)

actions.name: Lifetide (Level 5 Spell)

*

actions.name: Line of Light (Level 5 Spell, concentration)
actions.description:
The prince raises a 60 ft. long, 5 ft. wide, 10 ft. high opaque wall of light. A creature that starts its turn in the wall or passes through must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) radiant damage and be Blinded until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.
*

actions.name: Ossify (Level 6 Spell, 1/day)
actions.description:
One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw take 75 (10d6 + 40) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage has all of its soft tissues turn to bone and is petrified.
*

actions.name: Bone Burst (Level 7 Spell, 1/day)
actions.description: The prince flings a chip of bone that erupts into a huge, sea urchin-like ball of jagged bone spikes. Each creature in a 20 ft. radius within 120 ft. is pushed up to 20 ft. out of the area and must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 42 (12d6) Piercing damage, or half as much on a succeess.

reactions.name: Counterspell (Spell, 3rd level)

reactions.name: Steal Life
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature the prince can see within 60 ft. being targeted with magical healing, the prince changes the target to itself.

name: Windigo Hungerer
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +4, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Acquisitive Hunger
traits.description: Whenever the windigo eats a humanoid creature, its maximum Hit Points increase by 5 for each hit die the creature had.

traits.name: Greed-Eaten Spirit
traits.description: While the windigo has more than 85 Hit Points, it has Disadvantage on Charisma Saving Throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The windigo makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its Ravenous Bite.

actions.name: Ravenous Bite
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage and the windigo gains 5 Temporary Hit Points. While the windigo has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it has Advantage on saving throws against spells or other magical effects.

actions.name: Horn Dagger
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed, losing 2 (1d4) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. This effect ends when a creature succeeds on a DC 12 medicine check to stanch the wound as an action, or when the bleeding creature receives magical healing.

actions.name: Hurled Stone
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 60 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Insatiable Craving
reactions.description: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell or magical effect, the windigo makes a Ravenous Bite attack against itself.

traits.name: Empty Spirit

traits.name: Heart of Ice

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.description: If the windigo fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
