Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage must make a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature falls asleep for the next minute, or until it takes any damage or another creature uses its action to wake it. On a success, the creature is instead Blinded until the end of the windigo's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Light-Footed Lope
legendaryActions.description: The windigo moves up to half its speed. Until the end of its next turn, it may treat any surface as solid ground.

legendaryActions.name: Snatch
legendaryActions.description: The windigo makes an attack with its Grasping Claws.

legendaryActions.name: Swallow Whole (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The windigo grapples an incapacitated creature within 10 feet (escape DC 20) and begins to cram it into its mouth. At the beginning of the windigo's next turn, if the creature is still grappled it is swallowed and the windigo regains 10 Hit Points and an expended Legendary Resistance. The swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained, and takes 10 (3d6) Cold damage at the end of each of its turns. A creature that deals 20 or more piercing or Slashing damage to the windigo in a turn may use its Bonus Action to cut a hole through which swallowed creatures may attempt to escape (escape DC 20).

name: Yeth Hound
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +3, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -2
immunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks not made with Silvered Weapons; Charmed, Frightened
languages: understands Common, Elvish and Sylvan but can't speak

traits.name: Beasts of Nightmare
traits.description: A Frightened creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of one or more yeth hounds has its speed reduced by half until the start of its next turn. A creature affected by this ability that Dashes must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone.

traits.name: Banished by Sunlight
traits.description: If the hound ends its turn in sunlight, it dissolves into smoke and dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hound makes two attacks with its Heel Snap, one of which it may replace with a use of its Ghastly Baying, if available.

actions.name: Heel Snap
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft., one Frightened target. Hit: 14 (4d6) psychic damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or suffer a failed saving throw.

actions.name: Ghastly Baying (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The hound lets out a shrieking, exultant howl. Each enemy within 300 feet that can hear the hound must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the hound's next turn. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more must use its action to Dash on its following turn.

reactions.name: Sooted Slip
reactions.description: When the yeth hound is targeted with a spell that targets only it, it can turn briefly to smoke, making a contested Dexterity check against the spell's caster. On a success, the spell passes through it without effect.

name: Auril (First Form)
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +9, Int +7, Wis +12, Cha +9
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from Weapons that aren't Named
immunities: Cold, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Eyes of Endless Night
traits.description: While she is not Blinded, Auril knows the location of each creature within 1000 feet of her. If Auril takes any radiant damage, she must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of her next turn.

traits.name: Divine Rejuvination
traits.description: When Auril drops to 0 Hit Points, her body crystalizes to glistening ice which shatters in an instant, the shards hanging in air as more ice joins them to form her second Form, which appears in her space. Her initiative doesn't change.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Auril has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day in This Form)
traits.description: If Auril fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Auril makes two attacks with her Merciless Claws and uses either her Unrelenting Gaze or Frostfog Apparition.

actions.name: Merciless Claws
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) cold damage. If this attack was made at Advantage, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone and unable to stand on its following turn.

actions.name: Sleet Deluge (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +13 range 90 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Unrelenting Gaze
actions.description: Auril fixes her inscrutable gaze upon a creature she can see within 60 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of Auril's next turn. If the creature was already Frightened, it is instead Paralyzed until the end of her next turn.

actions.name: Frostfog Apparition (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Auril's form shimmers and dissolves into a haze of freezing fog, coalescing and reappearing at a point she can see within 30 feet of where she disappeared.

actions.name: Glacial Hiss (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Auril lets forth a piercing hiss in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Thunder damage plus 10 (3d6) Cold damage, then gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Cold damage taken. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and gains no Temporary Hit Points. While a creature has any of these these Temporary Hit Points, it is restrained and cannot be stabilized.

reactions.name: Freeze Breath
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature Auril can see within 60 feet attempts to cast a spell, Auril forces the creature to make a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature must use a spell slot of one level higher to cast the spell, or have the spell fail.

reactions.name: Crone's Vengeance (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 100 Hit Points, Auril teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see and makes two attacks with her Merciless Claws at Advantage.

legendaryActions.name: Cloak of Feathers
legendaryActions.description: Auril moves up to half her fly speed. Attacks of opportunity provoked by this movement are made at Disadvantage.

legendaryActions.name: Winter's Tribute (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: One creature Auril can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Cold damage. The creature may sacrifice any number of unexpended hit dice or spell slots, preventing 5 of this damage per hit die or spell level expended. A creature who takes no damage from this ability has Advantage on saving throws imposed by Auril until the end of her next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Unrelenting Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Auril uses her Unrelenting Gaze.

name: Auril (Second Form)
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +9, Int +7, Wis +12, Cha +9
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from Weapons that aren't Named
immunities: Cold, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Rimeclad
traits.description: If Auril takes any Fire damage, her AC is reduced by 1 until the beginning of her next turn.

traits.name: Divine Rejuvination
traits.description: When Auril drops to 0 Hit Points, her body turns to slush and sloughs away, revealing her Third Form, which appears in her space. Her initiative doesn't change.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Auril has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day in This Form)
traits.description: If Auril fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Auril makes two melee attacks, each of which she may replace with her Ensoul Ice.

actions.name: Frostkiss, Ice Morningstar
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) cold damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away. On a missed attack, the weapon shatters, dealing 5 (2d4) Cold damage to the target and each creature within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Ensoul Ice
actions.description: Auril breaks an icicle from her body and hurls it to an unoccupied space she can see within 20 feet, where it transforms into an Ice Mephit that acts under her control directly after her in initiative and lasts for a minute.

actions.name: Glacial Spire
actions.description: Auril calls forth a 10-foot spike of ice from the ground in a space she can see within 90 feet. A creature in that space must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) Cold damage.

actions.name: Gale of the Long Night (Level 6 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Auril sends forth a blast of cold and clinging darkness in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or take 27 (8d8) Cold damage and be Blinded until the end of Auril's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success. A creature may expend three spell levels worth of spell slots or three unexpended hit dice to gain Advantage on this saving throw.

reactions.name: Frozen Palisade
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature entering her reach, Auril uses her Glacial Spire, targeting the creature's space. If the creature fails its save, its movement is reduced to 0 until the end of its turn.

reactions.name: Revoke Souls (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 105 Hit Points, Auril causes any number of Ice Mephits under her control to explode. Instead of their normal Death Burst, each creature within 20 feet of at least one mephit destroyed in this way must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Piercing damage, or half as much a success.

legendaryActions.name: Ice Growth
legendaryActions.description: Auril gains 5 Temporary Hit Points or extrudes a new Frostkiss, Ice Morningstar to replace a shattered one.

legendaryActions.name: Winter's Stillness
legendaryActions.description: One creature Auril can see within 30 feet gains 5 Temporary Hit Points. While a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, its movement speed is reduced by 10 feet and it can't expend any resources that return on a Short or Long Rest.

legendaryActions.name: Icefall Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Auril moves up to her speed and makes a melee attack at Advantage. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

name: Auril (Third Form)
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +1, Con +9, Int +7, Wis +12, Cha +9
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from Weapons that aren't Named
immunities: Cold, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned
senses: blindsight 120 ft. (blind beyond this radius), truesight 120 ft.

traits.name: Divine Resurrection
traits.description: When Auril drops to 0 Hit Points, her crystalline form shatters and her divine spark flares, then fades. Each creature that can see her within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma Saving Throw or drop to 0 Hit Points and be Blinded until it completes a Long Rest. At the next winter solstice, Auril reappears at full health in a cold, remote location of her choice.

traits.name: Unearthly Cold
traits.description: Auril's attacks and abilities ignore other creatures' resistance or immunity to cold.

traits.name: Frigid Aura
traits.description: At the start of each of her turns, each creature within 10 feet of her must expend 2 unexpended hit die, or gain a point of Exhaustion if it cannot.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Auril has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day in This Form)
traits.description: If Auril fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Auril uses her Polar Ray twice.

actions.name: Polar Ray
actions.description: Attack: +13 range 120 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Dazzling Gleam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 20 feet that can see Auril must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) radiant damage and be Blinded for the next minute. A Blinded creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Spell Refraction
reactions.description: As a reaction when she is forced to make saving throw against a spell, Auril may cast a copy of it, using the original caster's save DC. The original spell takes effect first.

reactions.name: Divine Brilliance (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 94 Hit Points, Auril makes a Polar Ray attack against each creature of her choice within range.

legendaryActions.name: Polar Ray
legendaryActions.description: Auril uses her Polar Ray.

legendaryActions.name: Impenetrable Facing
legendaryActions.description: Auril chooses one creature she can see. Until the end of her next turn, Auril reduces any piercing or Slashing damage dealt to her by that creature by 10.

legendaryActions.name: Winter's Triumph
legendaryActions.description: Auril draws a torrent of icy winds to herself. Each creature within 60 feet of her must succeed on a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled 5 feet toward her for each expended hit die it has.

name: Cerunnos, Master of the Wild Hunt
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +14, Con +12, Int +4, Wis +5, Cha +13
immunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from Weapons that aren't Named; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Restrained

traits.name: Woad-Clad
traits.description: Ranged attacks against Cerunnos made from more than 30 feet away hit only on a critical. If Cerunnos is drenched in holy water, this trait is suspended until he completes a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Moonlit Raed
traits.description: While lit by moonlight, the first time each turn Cerunnos leaves a creature's sight that creature must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw or lose all clear memories of him, recalling him only as a dim and distant dream.

traits.name: Archfey Resilience
traits.description: Cerunnos succeeds automatically on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know his name, and has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If Cerunnos would fail a saving throw, he may choose to succeed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Cerunnos makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Dubh SmÃ ladh, the Smoldering Cloud
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage and Cerunnos adds an additional effect of his choice: The target takes an additional 14 (4d6) lighting damage. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or be levitated up to 30 feet into the air until the beginning of Cerunnos' next turn. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw or switch places with a willing creature within 60 feet of it that Cerunnos can see.

actions.name: Wild Terror (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Cerunnos lets loose a wild cry that plants the frantic terror of a hounded beast. Each creature of his choice that can see or hear him must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened. A Frightened creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is polymorphed into a Hart for as long as it remains Frightened, or until it takes any damage.

reactions.name: Flush Quarry
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature fails at an attempt to Hide from Cerunnos, Cerunnos uses his Scouring Moonfire targeting it, if available.

reactions.name: Horn of the Wild Hunt (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 179 Hit Points, Cerunnos blows the Horn of the Wild hunt, summoning five Hounds of the Wild Hunt that act on his initiative to unoccupied spaces he can see.

legendaryActions.name: Scouring Moonfire
legendaryActions.description: One creature illuminated by moonlight that cerunnos can see must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) radiant damage. A flying or levitating creature makes this save at Disadvantage.

legendaryActions.name: Blood Hunt
legendaryActions.description: Up to two of Cerunnos' hound allies, or up to one of his non-hound allies, may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a melee weapon attack.

legendaryActions.name: Invective of the Thrice-Cursed (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 30 feet that Cerunnos can see must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 1d4 until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic, to a minimum of 1. A creature that dies with its Wisdom score reduced to 1 in this way is claimed as a rider of The Wild Hunt, and cannot be revived by any means short of a Wish spell.

name: Hyrsam, Prince of Fools
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +13, Con +13, Int +12, Wis +6, Cha +14

traits.name: Feinting Frolick
traits.description: Whenever Hyrsam is missed with an attack or succeeds on a saving throw, he gains Advantage on the first attack he makes before the end of his next turn.

traits.name: Archfey Resilience
traits.description: Hyrsam succeeds automatically on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know his name, and has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Strains of Creation
traits.description: While Hyrsam is not Deafened, he can end one condition or spell affecting him at the start of each of his turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Hyrsam makes two attacks, each of which he can replace with his Note of Discord, Benumb, or Call to Revel.

actions.name: Fennelstem Fiddlestick
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) force damage plus one of the following effects: The target must move half its Speed in a direction of Hyrsam's choice. The target takes 20 additional Psychic damage, then can choose to gain an equal number of Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Note of Discord (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Hyrsam can see within 120 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: 18 (4d8) Thunder damage plus 18 (4d8) Psychic damage and the creature is Dazed until the end of its next turn. Success: Half Damage. If Hyrsam is Concentrating, he can end Concentration as part of casting this spell to give the target Disadvantage on its saving throw.

actions.name: Benumb (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: Hyrsam touches a creature, banishing its cares. For one hour, the target ignores the effects of being Frightened, Poisoned or Paralyzed, and has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

actions.name: Call to Revel (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: With a wild whoop, Hyrsam calls down a cascade of ambrosia, granting each willing creature within 60 feet 20 Temporary Hit Points. While a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it has Advantage on attacks. When a creature loses the last of these Temporary Hit Points, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: The creature is Poisoned until it completes a Long Rest.

actions.name: Life from the Vine (Concentration, Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: Fruiting vines sprout up in a 30-foot Radius within 300 feet, making the area Difficult Terrain for one minute. Creatures in the area can use their Action or Bonus Action to restore 10 (3d6) Hit Points to themself or a creature within 5 feet. A creature targeted with this ability that died in the last minute is restored to life with 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Unname (Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: Hyrsam attempts to draw forth the name from a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: 69 (6d12 + 30) Psychic damage and creature's name is obliterated; each record and memory of it is forever destroyed. Success: Half damage. For 1 year, or until it is given a new name, the nameless cerature has Disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma Saving Throws.

bonusActions.name: Song of Mischief (Concentration)
bonusActions.description: Each creature in a 60-foot Emanation from Hyrsam uses a d10 in place of a d20 for any d20 Test it makes.

bonusActions.name: Song of Mirth (Concentration)
bonusActions.description: Each creature in a 60-foot Emanation from Hyrsam that has any Temporary Hit Points can Dash, Disengage, or Dodge as a Bonus Action.

bonusActions.name: Song of Mayhem (Concentration)
bonusActions.description: Each creature in a 60-foot Emanation from Hyrsam that has any Temporary Hit Points is Charmed by Hyrsam and treats all other creatures as hostile.

legendaryActions.name: Impulsive Rush
legendaryActions.description: Hyrsam takes the Dodge action, then can move up to half his Speed.

legendaryActions.name: Prancing Strike
legendaryActions.description: Hyrsam moves up to half his Speed, then makes a melee attack. If this attack had Advantage, the target is additionally knocked Prone on a hit.

legendaryActions.name: Incite Abandon
legendaryActions.description: Up to three creatures Hyrsam can see within 60 feet each must use their Reaction to make a melee attack against a random creature in their reach.

name: Neifon, Lord of Bats
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +13, Con +5, Int +6, Wis +11, Cha +10
immunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from Weapons that aren't Named; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Restrained

traits.name: Shadowflesh
traits.description: If Neifon is not in bright light, he may teleport up to 10 feet whenever he takes damage.

traits.name: Screeching Retinue
traits.description: Neifon is surrounded by a whirling torrent of semi-corporeal bats that continuously spill out from the shadows within 30 feet of him. Light sources in the area have their range reduced by half, and creatures have half cover against any ranged attack that passes through the area.

traits.name: Archfey Resilience
traits.description: Neifon succeeds automatically on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know his name, and has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If Neifon would fail a saving throw, he may choose to succeed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Neifon makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with his Lighteater Bite, and uses his Whispered Thunder, if available.

actions.name: Lighteater Bite (Bat form only)
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) piercing damage. On a hit or miss, each light source within 5 feet of the target is reduced by one level; from Bright Light to Dim Light, or from Dim Light to Darkness.

actions.name: Tymor Du, the Blackthumb (Humanoid form only)
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or lose an eye.

actions.name: Curling Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 21). A grappled creature hit by this attack takes an additional 7 (2d6) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Whispered Thunder (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Neifon sends out a precisely targeted pulse of subsonic energy that converges on a creature he can see within 60 feet, choosing one of the following effects: Shaking Eyes. The creature must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of Neifon's next turn. Quaking Heart. The creature must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of Neifon's next turn. Shattered Arms. The creature must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or have one nonartifact weapon or piece of armor it is carrying shatter. If the item is magical or named, this save is made at Advantage.

bonusActions.name: Shift Form
bonusActions.description: Neifon transforms into a form that resembles a Medium humanoid, or back into his true Large bat-like form. His statistics are the same in each form.

bonusActions.name: Bur-Bat
bonusActions.description: A bat soars out from Neifon's retinue and crashes into a creature he can see within 60 feet, then bursts into a gnarled burr of hooked spines. The creature must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Piercing damage and have the bur stick to it (remove DC 20).

bonusActions.name: Burst-Bat (Humanoid form only)
bonusActions.description: Neifon detonates each bur created by his Bur-Bat that is attached to a creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Fire damage and be pushed 10 feet in a direction of Neifon's choice for each bur attached to it.

reactions.name: Black Breath of the Earth (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction when Neifon is reduced below 148 Hit Points, up to six 50-foot long, 10-foot wide, 30-foot deep trenches split open in the earth within 300 feet of Neifon, disgorging a torrent of bats into the air for the next minute. A creature other than Neifon in the trench's space is immediately launched up to 50 feet in the air, then must make a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw, landing on a side of the trench of its choice on a success, or a randomly selected side on a failure.

legendaryActions.name: Bur-bat
legendaryActions.description: Neifon uses his Bur-bat.

legendaryActions.name: Traveler's Dust (Humanoid form only)
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of its next turn.	While Poisoned in this way, a creature takes 5 (1d10) Psychic damage for each 5 feet it moves through Dim Light or Darkness.

legendaryActions.name: Plunge into Night (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Neifon moves up to half his speed, then if he is in Darkness may teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space that is also in Darkness.

name: Abyssal Chicken
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -1, Wis -3, Cha -3
languages: Abyssal, Telepathy 60 ft. (Works Only With Creatures That Understand Abyssal)

traits.name: Bad Flier
traits.description: The chicken falls at the end of a turn if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed.

actions.name: Fanged Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Razor Talon
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. Then, if the target is Unconscious, the chicken can lay a barbed egg in the wound this turn as a Bonus Action.

reactions.name: Henpeck
reactions.description: When a creature within 5 feet of it receives magical healing, the abyssal chicken can make a Fanged Bite attack against it.

name: Swarm of Abyssal Chickens
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -1, Wis -3, Cha -3
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Damage from Attacks
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
languages: Abyssal, Telepathy 60 ft. (Works Only With Creatures That Understand Abyssal)

traits.name: Bad Flier
traits.description: The swarm falls at the end of a turn if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a small creature. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Fanged Bites
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 0 ft. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage, or Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its Hit Points or fewer.

actions.name: Razor Talons
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 0 ft. Hit: 12 (4d4 + 2) slashing damage, or Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage if the swarm has half of its Hit Points or fewer. Then, if the target is unconscious, the swarm can lay a barbed egg in the wound this turn as a Bonus Action.

reactions.name: Henpeck
reactions.description: When a creature in the swarm's space receives magical healing, the swarm can make a Fanged Bites attack against it.

name: Chicken Tree
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +4, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -1
languages: Abyssal, Telepathy 60 ft. (Works Only With Creatures That Understand Abyssal)

traits.name: Boiling Blood
traits.description: Whenever the tree takes any Slashing damage, the tree and one creature of its choice within 10 feet each take 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tree makes two attacks with its Meaty Slam, each of which it may replace with a use of its Spawn Chicken.

actions.name: Meaty Slam
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 15 ft. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone. A creature that fails by 5 or more is instead Stunned until the end of the tree's next turn.

actions.name: Spawn Chicken
actions.description: The tree loses 5 Hit Points as one of the fleshy sacs that hang from the its branches tears open in a shower of blood and amniotic fluid, spawning an Abyssal Chicken in the tree's space that acts on initiative count 0.

actions.name: Hurl Sac (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The tree hurls a sac of putrefied demonflesh at a point within 60 feet, where it showers the area in a 10-foot radius in foul gore. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 17 (5d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Horrid Scream
reactions.description: When the chicken tree takes 15 or more damage from a single source, a garbled, squawking scream issues forth from its wounds. Each abyssal chicken within 60 feet that can hear the tree may make a Razor Talon attack on its following turn as a Bonus Action.

name: Abyssal Scavenger
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +3, Int -4, Wis +1

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The scavenger has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Death Shriek
traits.description: When the scavenger drops to 0 Hit Points, each other scavenger within 15 ft. can make a melee attack as a reaction.

actions.name: Engulfing Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). A Medium or smaller creature that isn't grappled by another scavenger has its head engulfed in the scavenger's mouth; while grappled in this way the creature is Blinded and Choking.

actions.name: Frenzied Claw
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage, and each other scavenger within 30 feet can use its reaction to move up to 10 feet toward the target.

actions.name: Worry
actions.description: One creature grappled by both the scavenger and at least one of the scavenger's allies must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or fall prone and take 10 (3d6) Piercing damage, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Adapt Resistance
reactions.description: When the scavenger takes damage of a type it doesn't have resistance against, it can gain resistance to that damage type until the start of its next turn.

name: Adaru
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +5, Con +4, Int +6, Wis +4, Cha +4
languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Draconic, Infernal, Telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Liar's Guile
traits.description: The adaru can detect lies told by creatures within 30 feet of it by scent.

traits.name: Vent Evil
traits.description: The pores in an adaru's carapace constantly vent an vile miasma that warps the minds of all it touches. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the adaru must make a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature is Poisoned and Frightened until the start of its next turn if it is non-evil, or Charmed and under the adaru's control for the same duration if it is evil.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The adaru has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The adaru makes two attacks with its Skittering Coils, one of which it may replace with its Dripping Mandibles or the Dodge action.

actions.name: Dripping Mandibles
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Skittering Coils
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled in this way, a creature is restrained and must immediately answer any question asked of it.

reactions.name: Devour Lies
reactions.description: When a creature grappled by the adaru tells a lie, the adaru can attach its sucking organ to the creature's face. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage and lose any proficiency it has in Deception until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

name: Alkilith
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +8, Con +10, Int -2, Cha -2
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The alkilith can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the alkilith is mionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary slime or fungus.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The alkilith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The alkilith makes three melee attacks.

actions.name: Polluting Touch
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 1 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) acid damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Living Portal (Concentration)
actions.description: The alkilith begins to channel the essence of the Abyss through its body, becoming a portal to a distant corner of the Abyss. If the alkilith is still concentrating at the start of its next turn, a demon with maximum Hit Points equal to or less than the alkilith's current Hit Points is summoned to the nearest unoccupied space, and the alkilith loses half its current Hit Points.

actions.name: Fume (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The area in a 15 ft. radius around the alkilith becomes heavily obscured until the start of its next turn as it exudes toxic fumes. A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Foment Madness
reactions.description: When the alkilith loses concentration as a result of being hit with a melee attack, the alkilith can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw or have its proficiency bonus reduced by one for the next minute.

name: Babau
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +3, Wis +1, Cha +1
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Shadow Clones
traits.description: Whenever the babau teleports, it leaves behind a copy of itself with the following traits: The clone has 1 hit point and dies at the end of the babau's next turn. When the clone dies, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) Acid damage. When the babau moves, one of its clones can move the same distance.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The babau makes two attacks with its Flickering Claw, one of which it may replace with a use of its Murderous Abduction, if available.

actions.name: Flickering Claw
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage and the babau teleports up to 10 feet. The babau can have this attack originate from one of its clones or from itself.

actions.name: Murderous Abduction (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The babau and up to one creature within 5 feet of it each teleport up to 30 feet in the same direction. An unwilling and conscious creature can make a DC 13 Charisma Saving Throw, resisting the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Weakening Glare
reactions.description: When the babau is targeted with a melee attack, the babau can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or have the attack's damage reduced by half.

name: Babau Nightglimpse
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +3, Int +5, Wis +5, Cha +6
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Shadow Clones
traits.description: Whenever the babau or one of its clones teleports, it leaves behind a clone of itself with the following traits: The clone has 1 hit point and dies at the end of the babau's next turn. When the clone dies, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) Acid damage. When the babau moves, one of its clones can move the same distance.

traits.name: Spread Spirit (2/Day)
traits.description: If the babau fails a saving throw while it has two or more shadow clones active, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, each of those shadow clones dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The babau makes two attacks with its Flickering Claw, each of which it can replace Murderous Abduction, if available.

actions.name: Flickering Claw
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage and the babau (or the attacking clone) teleports up to 10 feet. The babau can have this attack originate from one of its clones or from itself.

actions.name: Murderous Abduction (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The babau and up to one creature within 5 feet of it each teleport up to 30 feet in the same direction. An unwilling and conscious creature can make a DC 14 Charisma Saving Throw, resisting the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Weakening Glare
reactions.description: When the babau is targeted with a melee attack, the babau can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or have the attack's damage reduced by half.

legendaryActions.name: Wispdash
legendaryActions.description: The babau teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 20 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Clone Command
legendaryActions.description: The babau impels one of its shadow clones can move up to 20 feet and make a Flickering Claw attack.

legendaryActions.name: Rend Magic (Costs 2 Actions, Level 3 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The controller of one spell or magical effect the babau can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or have the spell or effect end.

name: Balor Warmongerer
savingThrows: Str +14, Dex +2, Con +12, Int +5, Wis +9, Cha +12
resistances: Cold, Lightning; Attacks made without Advantage
immunities: Fire, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Poisoned

traits.name: Death Throes

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Invisible
traits.description: The caligrosto is Invisible. To creatures that ignore the effects of its invisibility, a weapon possessed by the caligrosto appears to be seething with coils of lightning-flecked mist.

traits.name: Blade Haunting
traits.description: A blade Possessed by the caligrosto grows in power, cumulatively gaining the following traits as the caligrosto consumes hit dice lost to its abilities, and resetting to 0 hit dice at dawn: 0 Hit Dice. As an action, the weapon's wielder may lose two unexpended hit dice, feeding the blade. 2 Hit Dice. The weapon deals an additional 1d6 Fire damage and scores a critical on a 19-20. 4 Hit Dice. The weapon's wielder gains 10 Temporary Hit Points whenever it reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points. 6 Hit Dice. While Incapacitated, the weapon's wielder ignores the effects of being Incapacitated and acts under the caligrosto's control. 8 Hit Dice. On each of the caligrosto's turns, it may move the blade up to the caligrosto's fly speed and make two attacks with it (+7, +4 to damage rolls).

traits.name: Masked Nature
traits.description: While the caligrosto is possessing a weapon, its creature type can't be detected by spells or magical effects.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The caligrosto can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Lifeblood Empowerment
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the caligrosto must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage and lose two unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 Hit Points if it cannot. While Possessing a weapon, the caligrosto may only target a creature that is wielding it with this ability.

actions.name: Spawn Blood Echo (1/Day)
actions.description: If the caligrosto has consumed at least six hit dice since the last dawn, it creates a Blood Echo under its control in an unoccupied space within 5 feet, and the blade it is possessing flies into the blood echo's grasp. While wielded by a Blood Echo, the effects of the caligrosto's Blade Haunting are represented in the Blood Echo's stat block and are not cumulative with it.

actions.name: Blade Possession (1/Day)
actions.description: The caligrosto enters a nonartifact weapon within 5 feet that deals piercing or Slashing damage and Possesses it until the caligrosto is expelled or the weapon is destroyed. If the weapon is magical, the caligrosto must immediately succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw or be expelled from the weapon. Once expelled from a weapon, the caligrosto can't enter that weapon again.

reactions.name: Brutal Triumph
reactions.description: When a weapon the caligrosto is possessing reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, the caligrosto can consume one of the creature's hit dice.

name: Cerebrilith
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +9, Int +10, Wis +4, Cha +7
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The cerebrilith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Thought-Taster
traits.description: If the cerebrilith runs its tongue across a creature's exposed brain, it learns each of that creature's deepest secrets.

traits.name: Independent Lobes
traits.description: The cerebrilith can concentrate on up to four separate effects simultaneously. If it fails a saving throw to maintain concentration, it loses concentration on each effect it is concentrating on.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cerebrilith attacks four times with its Brainrake Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Searing Probe or Thought Mine.

actions.name: Brainrake Claws
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. A creature killed by this damage has the upper part of its skull removed.

actions.name: Searing Probe (Concentration)
actions.description: The cerebrilith viciously delves into a creature's mind, telepathically relaying its secret weaknesses to the cerebrilith's allies. One creature the cerebrilith can see within 60 feet must make a DC 19 Intelligence Saving Throw. On a failed save, attacks made against the creature score a critical on an 17-20 for the next minute.

actions.name: Thought Mine (Concentration)
actions.description: The cerebrilith sets a bomb of psionic energy in the mind of a creature it can see within 120 feet, forcing it to make a DC 19 Intelligence Saving Throw. On a failure, the first time in the next minute that the creature casts a spell of 1st level or above or uses a psionic ability, it takes 44 (8d10) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Desecration Stride (Level 6 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: For the next minute, whenever the cerebrilith takes damage it may teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each other creature within 10 feet of that space takes 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Plane Shift (Level 7 Spell, 1/Day)
actions.description: The cerebrilith and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet of it teleport to another plane of existence.

bonusActions.name: Multilobe Psionics
bonusActions.description: The cerebrilith gains one of the following benefits for as long as it maintains concentration on it: Thought Backup. The cerebrilith has Advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration. Shadow in the Weave. A creature other than the cerebrilith that casts a spell of 1st level or higher while within 30 feet of the cerebrilith must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or take 3 (1d6) Psychic damage per level of the spell. Mindslice. The cerebrilith's melee attacks have a reach of 60 feet and deal Psychic damage instead of any other type. Psionic Mirage. Attacks made against the cerebrilith from more than 30 feet away are made at Disadvantage.

name: Chasme Plague Drone
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +2

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The chasme can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the chasme takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the chasme takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Plaguebearer Bites (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Piercing damage plus 2 Necrotic damage. If at least two other chasmes attacked with it, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be afflicted with Fading Ague.

reactions.name: Droning Chorus
reactions.description: When a creature the chasme can see within 30 feet makes a saving throw against another chasme's Drone, the chasme can force it to subtract one from its result.

reactions.name: Fading Ague
reactions.description: An infected creature takes on a slightly translucent pallor, which intensifies as the disease progresses. Whenever an infected creature drops to 0 HP, its Constitution score is reduced by 1d4 until the disease is cured. If the creature's Constitution is reduced to 0 it dies and a Specter rises from its corpse.

name: Chasme Tormentor
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +5, Con +3, Wis +5

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The chasme can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Drone
traits.description: The chasme produces a horrid magical droning sound. A non-chasme creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more chasmes that can hear them must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or deal only half damage with weapon attacks until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls asleep until it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The chasme has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage plus Hit: 24 (7d6) necrotic damage. On a critical hit, the target is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Dream Desecration
actions.description: One sleeping creature the Chasme can see within 15 feet takes 14 (4d6) nonlethal Psychic damage, then must make on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, this damage does not wake the creature from its sleep, and the chasme discovers one fact which the creature wishes to keep hidden from it.

actions.name: Demonic Abduction
actions.description: One demon of CR 5 or lower that the chasme has seen in the last 10 days must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma Saving Throw or teleport to switch positions with the chasme. A creature that succeeds on this save is immune to the effect for 24 hours.

name: Draegloth Heritor
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +4, Int +1

traits.name: Brutal Grace
traits.description: If the draegloth takes the Dash or Dodge action, until the end of the turn it may make a melee attack against any creature that makes an Opportunity Attack against it.

traits.name: Light-Enraged
traits.description: The first attack the draegloth makes each turn while in Bright Light has Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The draegloth makes three attacks with its Savage Claws.

actions.name: Savage Claws
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage. If this attack was made with Advantage, the target suffers one additional effect: The target is Grappled (escape DC 16). The target is pushed 5 feet away. The target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Glyph of Light's Bane (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: One creature grappled by the draegloth must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Fire damage and be Cursed for the next minute. While cursed in this way, the creature takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage plus 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage whenever it ends its turn illuminated by Bright Light

actions.name: Flaying Scream (Recharge 5-6, Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The draegloth's eyes blaze with abyssal flame as it holds a grappled creature aloft and screams at it. Each light the creature is carrying is doused, then the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Fire damage plus 27 (6d8) Thunder damage, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this damage has its skin peeled off and blown away in a spray of gore.

name: Draegloth Abomination
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +2, Con +5, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Web-Dweller
traits.description: The draegloth can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the draegloth knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Brutal Grace
traits.description: If the draegloth takes the Dash or Dodge action, until the end of the turn it may make a melee attack against any creature that makes an Opportunity Attack against it.

traits.name: Light-Enraged
traits.description: The first attack the draegloth makes each turn while in Bright Light has Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The draegloth makes four attacks with its Savage Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Flaying Scream or Snap Limb, if available.

actions.name: Savage Claws
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. If this attack was made with Advantage, the target suffers one additional effect: The target is Grappled (escape DC 18). The target is pushed 10 feet away. The target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Snap Limb (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft., one grappled creature. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature takes an additional 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage and loses the use of a limb of its choice until it completes a Long Rest.

actions.name: Flaying Scream (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The draegloth's eyes blaze with abyssal flame as it holds a grappled creature aloft and screams at it. Each light the creature is carrying is doused, then the creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Fire damage plus 27 (6d8) Thunder damage, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this damage has its skin peeled off and blown away in a spray of gore.

actions.name: Maddening Shadows (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Whispering darkness boils forth in a 20-foot radius from a point the draegloth can see within 60 feet, extinguishing all lights in the area. A creature other than the draegloth that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Psychic damage and be Frightened until the start of its next turn. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more falls prone, additionally.

bonusActions.name: Web Grab
bonusActions.description: One creature the draegloth can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or be dragged up to 30 feet toward the draegloth.

bonusActions.name: Exultation of Blood (Level 2 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The draegloth gains 5 Temporary Hit Points for each creature it hit with an attack this turn. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the draegloth's attacks have Advantage.

name: Draudnu
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +4, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +3
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Form of Madness
traits.description: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the draudnu and can see it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Poisoned until it takes any piercing or Slashing damage, as it feels something living swelling within it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The draudnu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Flesh Hooks
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 15 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 14 (4d6) acid damage. On a hit, the draudnu may lose 10 Hit Points and detach its head, pinning the target to an adjacent surface and Restraining it (escape DC 15). While its head is detached, the draudnu is Blinded. The head is an object and can be attacked (AC 15, 15 HP), and once detached the draudnu can't use this attack again until it regrows its head.

actions.name: Infested Birth (3/Day)
actions.description: One of the draudnu's pustules bursts in a spray of acid, then releases 3 (1d4 + 1) Ekolid Nymphs that act on the draudnu's initiative. Up to one creature within 5 feet of the draudnu must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Acid damage.

bonusActions.name: Mindfire Gaze
bonusActions.description: One creature Restrained by the draudnu's head must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

bonusActions.name: Regrow Head
bonusActions.description: If the draudnu has no head, it grows a new one, gaining 10 Temporary Hit Points.

name: Dretch Fodder
savingThrows: Con +1, Int -3, Wis -1, Cha -4

traits.name: Larvae Haze
traits.description: The dretch is surrounded by a cursed aura in which wounds become infested with dretch larvae. A non-dretch creature that takes any damage takes an additional 1 Piercing damage for each dretch within 5 feet of it. A creature killed within 5 feet of a dretch has a new dretch hatch from its corpse after 24 hours.

traits.name: Befoul Earth
traits.description: When the dretch dies, the ground within 10 feet of it is cursed and corrupted. Plants in the area wither and die, and magical healing that a creature in the area receives is reduced by half.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the dretch takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the dretch takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Broken-Tooth Bites (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +2 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage.

name: Dretch Agitator
savingThrows: Str +2, Con +2, Int -2, Wis -1, Cha -3

traits.name: Larvae Haze
traits.description: The dretch is surrounded by a cursed aura in which wounds become infested with dretch larvae. A non-dretch creature that takes any damage takes an additional 1 Piercing damage for each dretch within 5 feet of it. A creature killed within 5 feet of a dretch has a new dretch hatch from its corpse after 24 hours.

traits.name: Befoul Earth
traits.description: When the dretch dies, the ground within 10 feet of it is cursed and corrupted. Plants in the area wither and die, and magical healing that a creature in the area receives is reduced by half.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dretch makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Rotten Bite.

actions.name: Rotten Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Curling Claws
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Goading Shove
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the dretch must make a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and is pushed 5 feet, then may use its reaction to make a melee attack. On a successful save, the target must use its reaction to make an attack against the dretch. A creature may not voluntarily fail this saving throw.

reactions.name: Groveling Whinge
reactions.description: When a creature targets the dretch with an attack, the dretch can fall prone and force the attacker to make a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target for its attack, or else do half as much damage with it.

name: Dretch Horde
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +3, Int -3, Wis -1, Cha -4
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Damage from Attacks
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Devouring Haze
traits.description: The horde is surrounded by a cursed aura in which wounds become infested with dretch larvae. A non-dretch creature in the horde's space that takes any damage takes an additional 5 Piercing damage. A creature killed within 5 feet of the horde has a new dretch hatch from its corpse after 24 hours.

traits.name: Poisoned Path
traits.description: Whenever the horde takes 10 or more damage from a single source, the ground within 10 feet of it is cursed and corrupted. Plants in the area wither and die, and magical healing that a creature in the area receives is reduced by half.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The horde can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the horde can move through any opening large enough for a small creature. The horde can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Rotten Bites
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 0 ft. Hit: 24 (6d6 + 3) piercing damage, or Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage if the horde has fewer than half its Hit Points.

actions.name: Maddening Melee (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Each other creature in the horde's space must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet in a direction of the horde's choice. Then, each of those creatures may use its reaction to make a melee attack. If the horde has more than half its Hit Points, this save is made at Disadvantage.

name: Dybbuk (Bound)
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +2
immunities: All; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Lip Reader
traits.description: The dybbuk cannot hear, but understands statements spoken by a creature it can see whose mouth is not hidden.

traits.name: Dybbuk Box
traits.description: The dybbuk is bound to a holy artifact; a sealed container (AC 10, 15 HP, Immunity to Poison and Psychic Damage) that contains its power. If the artifact is destroyed, the dybbuk transforms into a Dybbuk (Unbound).

actions.name: Disturbing Behavior
actions.description: The dybbuk makes a creature under its control do something unnatural, such as levitate, vomit blood, twist its head all the way around, or cause a quadruped to move as a biped. Each nonfiend creature within 30 feet that can see it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the dybbuk's next turn.

actions.name: Corpse Dominion (1/Day)
actions.description: One corpse of either a humanoid or beast of CR 4 or lower within 500 feet of the box rises and acts under the dybbuk's control for the next hour. A corpse animated in this way gains the appearance of life, retains the statistics it had in life, and can't voluntarily harm a humanoid creature.

name: Dybbuk (Unbound)
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +2
resistances: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Imperceptible Glow
traits.description: While in Bright Light, the dybbuk can attempt to Hide as a Bonus Action, and may do so without obscurement.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The dybbuk can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The dybbuk's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

actions.name: Touch of Nightmares
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) psychic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence Saving Throw or be Frightened for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn) as it hallucinates being beset by tiny cackling horrors. The dybbuk may make this attack as a Bonus Action and with a reach of 60 feet against any creature Frightened in this way.

actions.name: Corpse Possession (1/Day)
actions.description: The dybbuk Possesses a beast or humanoid corpse in its space, transforming it into a Dybbuk Deadite until the dybbuk is expelled. When it does, the dybbuk may choose for the creature to gain the appearance of life, which lasts until it makes an attack. This Possession ends early if the Deadite is completely destroyed.

bonusActions.name: Evil Gust
bonusActions.description: One creature the dybbuk can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone and dragged up to 30 feet in a direction of the dybbuk's choice.

name: Dybbuk Deadite
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +3, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +2

traits.name: Abyssal Endurance
traits.description: The deadite cannot be killed while it is Possessed. If the deadite begins its turn with 0 Hit Points, it makes a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw, regaining 20 Hit Points on a success.

traits.name: Dismembering Weakness
traits.description: If the deadite takes any damage while at zero Hit Points, one of its body parts is severed. The deadite's speed is reduced by 10 feet and it makes one fewer attack with its multiattack for each part severed in this way. If the deadite's speed is reduced to 0, it is Incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The deadite makes five attacks with its Wild Swipes, one of which it may replace with its Reattach Limb.

actions.name: Wild Swipes
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Reattach Limb
actions.description: The deadite reattaches one of its severed body parts within 5 feet to itself.

bonusActions.name: Blood Geyser
bonusActions.description: The deadite emits a geyser of black blood in a 15-foot cone from its mouth or one of its wounds. Each creature in the area is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of the deadite's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Telepathic Lunge
bonusActions.description: One of the deadite's severed body parts flies up to 15 feet. Then, if it is in a creature's space, the body part becomes Attached to it (remove DC 15). If the body part was already Attached to a creature, instead the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or take 6 (1d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage and be dragged up to 15 feet by the body part.

name: Ekolid Nymph
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +1

traits.name: Wound Intrusion
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn in the space of one or more ekolid nymphs must make a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed saving throw, the creature takes 3 (1d6) Piercing damage and is infected with Ekolid Parasitism, and one ekolid nymph in its space is removed from play.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the ekolid takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the ekolid takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Lacerating Collision (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +0 reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 Piercing damage. This attack is made with Advantage if each creature that contributed to it moved at least 20 feet this turn.

actions.name: Cannibalize
actions.description: The ekolid kills and devours a Small or smaller creature with the Minion trait in its space. Then, if the ekolid has killed two or more creatures this way in the last minute, it may form a cocoon around itself, increasing its AC to 18 until the start of its next turn. At the start of its next turn, the ekolid emerges from its cocoon transformed as an Ekolid Carnifex with full Hit Points.

name: Ekolid Carnifex
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +3, Con +2, Wis +4, Cha +1

traits.name: Form of Madness
traits.description: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the ekolid and can see it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or automatically fail Intelligence checks and saving throws to maintain Concentration, as it feels parasites squirming within its flesh. A creature may repeat this saving throw as an Action, ending the effect and becoming immune to it for 24 hours on a success.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The ekolid has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ekolid makes five attacks with its Stinging Flurry.

actions.name: Stinging Flurry
actions.description: Attack: +1 reach 10 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Exultant Chitter (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the ekolid and is infected with Ekolid Parasitism takes 7 (2d6) Piercing damage, then must make a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the disease ends for the creature and it spawns an Ekolid Nymph in its space.

bonusActions.name: Implant Egg
bonusActions.description: One creature the ekolid hit with its Stinging Flurry this turn must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Ekolid Parasitism. A target hit with three or more Stinging Flurry attacks this turn makes this saving throw with Disadvantage.

bonusActions.name: Screeching Choir
bonusActions.description: The ekolid lets out a discordant wail. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it and is Concentrating must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or lose Concentration.

name: Ferrolith
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +3, Con +9, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +9
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison; Piercing and Slashing

traits.name: Corrosion Weakness
traits.description: If the ferrolith takes 10 or more Acid damage from a single source, it loses its resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The ferrolith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ferrolith makes three attacks with its Adamantine Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Compel.

actions.name: Adamantine Claws
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical on an 18-20.

actions.name: Compel
actions.description: One creature charmed by the ferrolith must use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a weapon attack.

actions.name: Enticing Charm (Concentration)
actions.description: One humanoid the ferrolith can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be magically Charmed and under the ferrolith's control. The Charmed creature repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success. When the ferrolith's charm ends on a creature, the creature takes 44 (8d10) Psychic damage and is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Razor Barrage (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The ferrolith flings razor-sharp flakes of rust from its wings in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 45 (10d8) Slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Gau Ding
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +10, Con +13, Int -1, Wis +13, Cha +12
immunities: Fire, Necrotic, Poison, and Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Careening Slosh
traits.description: If the Gau Ding moves at least 20 ft. in a straight line, then moves in an opposed direction, it begins to slosh. Until the end of its turn, each creature that it passes within 5 ft. of must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) fire and 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Dinner Bell
traits.description: A creature that misses the gau ding with a melee weapon attack is overcome with visions of itself being torn apart by hungry dogs. The attacker must succeed on a DC Wisdom Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Psychic damage and be Frightened until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Cauldron
traits.description: The top of the gau ding is a boiling cauldron of bones and broth. A creature that starts its turn in the cauldron takes 22 (5d8) fire and 22 (5d8) Necrotic damage. A creature killed by this damage can be disgorged as a Barrow Wight under the cauldron's control. When encountered, the gau ding has 7 (2d4+2) corpses in its cauldron.

traits.name: Affection Weakness
traits.description: As bonus action, a creature that did not attack the gau ding this turn may attempt a DC 20 Animal Handling check. On a success, the Gau Ding must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed for the next minute by the creature, or until the creature deals damage to it.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The gau ding can't be affected or detected by spells of 3rd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Spiritlinked Resistance
traits.description: If the gau ding fails a saving throw, it may consume one of the corpses contained within it to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gau ding makes two attacks with its snatching claws.

actions.name: Snatching Claws
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 15 ft. Hit: 14 (1d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 23). The gau ding has two arms capable of grappling.

actions.name: Snapping Jaws
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the gau ding bites off a hand or foot of the target.

actions.name: Bay
actions.description: The gau ding lets out a terrifying polyphonic howl as flames burst from its mouths and eyes and its cauldron bubbles and sputters. Each creature within 120 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened of the gau ding for the next minute and drop what it's holding. A Frightened creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Disgorge Animus (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Roll a d20. on a 1-10, the gau ding births a Barrow Wight from its cauldron. On an 11-17, it births a Deathlock Wight. On an 18-20, it births a Slaughter Wight.

reactions.name: Bones for the Broth
reactions.description: As a reaction to being missed with an attack of opportunity by a Frightened creature, the gau ding makes a snatch attack against the attacker.

reactions.name: Bloodied Birth
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 238 Hit Points, the Gau Ding immediately recharges and uses its Disgorge Animus twice.

legendaryActions.name: Spirit Breath
legendaryActions.description: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 20) by long, many-jointed spectral arms that extend from nearby surfaces. A flying creature has Advantage on this saving throw. A creature that starts its turn grappled in this way takes 11 (2d10) Psychic damage.

legendaryActions.name: Body Breath
legendaryActions.description: The gau ding emits a torrent of slimy, half-dissolved flesh from one of its mouths. Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 15 ft. away and take 21 (6d6) Bludgeoning damage. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone.

name: Ghour
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +1, Con +8, Int +5, Wis +4
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the ghour moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

traits.name: Desecrated Aura
traits.description: A creature that attempts to cast divine magic (such as a Cleric or Paladin spell) within 15 ft. of the ghour takes 11 (2d10) Psychic damage and is Poisoned until the end of the creature's following turn.

traits.name: Ferocity
traits.description: When the ghour is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it may use its multiattack before falling unconscious.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The ghour has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
traits.description: If the ghour fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ghour makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with Baphomet's Rage.

actions.name: Cleaving Greataxe
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) slashing damage. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, any excess damage can be applied to another creature within reach that has an AC equal to or below the initial attack roll.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Baphomet's Rage
actions.description: One creature within 60 ft. that the ghour can see must make a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature must use its reaction to move up to 20 feet in a direction of the ghour's choice. If it ends this movement within 5 ft. of one or more creatures, it must make a melee attack against one of them.

actions.name: Sickening Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 10 ft. wide, 30 ft. long line must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 45 (10d8) Poison damage and be Poisoned until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Gouging Toss
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature moving within 5 ft. of it, the ghour forces the creature to succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Maddened Roar (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 137 Hit Points, the ghour lets out an earsplitting scream. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the ghour's next turn and Deafened for the next minute.

name: Glabrezu Persecutor
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +3, Con +9, Int +4, Wis +3, Cha +7
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Brittle Carapace
traits.description: If the glabrezu takes 15 or more Bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 14 until it completes a Long Rest.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The glabrezu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The glabrezu makes two attacks with its Crushing Claws.

actions.name: Crusher Claws
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 17) and pulled up to 5 feet toward the glabrezu. If the target was already grappled by the glabrezu, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take an additional 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage and lose the use of a limb of its choice until it completes a Long Rest.

actions.name: Gut Punch
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Brutalize
bonusActions.description: The glabrezu makes two attacks with its Gut Punch against a grappled target.

bonusActions.name: Abyssal Abduction (Level 3 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The glabrezu and up to one creature grappled by it teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

name: Glabrezu Corruptor
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +3, Con +9, Int +5, Wis +3, Cha +8
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Aura of Disarray
traits.description: A creature that casts a spell targeting an area that contains the glabrezu must first make a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the spell's area of effect scatters 25 (2d4*5) feet in a direction of the glabrezu's choice before taking effect.

traits.name: Brittle Carapace
traits.description: If the glabrezu takes 15 or more Bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 14 until it completes a Long Rest.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The glabrezu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The glabrezu makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Seizer Claw.

actions.name: Seizer Claw
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16) and pulled up to 5 feet toward the glabrezu.

actions.name: Flickerbolt (Level 6 Spell)
