actions.description: Attack: +9 range 30 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) lightning damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage. Before or after making this attack, the glabrezu may teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Chaos Revels (Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: When a creature casts a spell targeting an area the glabrezu can see within 60 feet, the glabrezu can teleport to an unoccupied space in that area.

name: Glabrezu Sire of Woe
savingThrows: Str +11, Dex +3, Con +11, Int +5, Wis +3, Cha +9
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Aura of Disarray
traits.description: A creature that casts a spell targeting an area that contains the glabrezu must first make a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the spell's area of effect scatters 25 (2d4*5) feet in a direction of the glabrezu's choice before taking effect.

traits.name: Bioreinforced Carapace
traits.description: If the glabrezu takes 20 or more Bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 16 until it completes a Long Rest.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The glabrezu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (2/Day)
traits.description: If the glabrezu fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The glabrezu makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Crackling Frenzy, if available.

actions.name: Crusher Claws
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 19) and pulled up to 5 feet toward the glabrezu. If the target was already grappled by the glabrezu, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take an additional 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage and lose the use of a limb of its choice until it completes a Long Rest.

actions.name: Gut Punch
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d4 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Crackling Frenzy (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) lighting damage and be Stunned until the end of its next turn. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw instead gains 14 (4d6) Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the creature's melee attacks deal an additional 7 (2d6) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Corrupted Offering (Level 9 Spell, 1/Day)
actions.description: One nonfiend creature within 10 feet of the glabrezu must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed by the glabrezu and hostile to each nonfiend creature it can see for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). While Charmed in this way, the creature's Strength score permanently increases by 1, to a maximum of 22, whenever it reduces a humanoid former ally to 0 Hit Points.

reactions.name: Sow Chaos (1/Day, Level 7 Spell, Concentration)
reactions.description: When the glabrezu is reduced below 127 Hit Points, it can unleash a disorienting burst of chaotic psychic force in a 15-foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw or become Charmed by each other creature that failed this saving throw and hostile to each creature that did not for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). This save cannot be failed voluntarily.

legendaryActions.name: Brutalize
legendaryActions.description: The glabrezu makes two attacks with its Gut Punch against a grappled target.

legendaryActions.name: Profane Fate (Level 2 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: One creature the glabrezu can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed. Whenever a creature Cursed in this way that the glabrezu can see succeeds on a saving throw, the glabrezu can end the curse on that creature and cause the creature to fail instead.

legendaryActions.name: Abyssal Abduction (Level 3 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The glabrezu and up to one creature grappled by it teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Crackling Frenzy (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The glabrezu uses its Crackling Frenzy, if available.

name: Golothoma
savingThrows: Str +12, Dex +4, Con +11, Int -3, Wis +3, Cha +4

traits.name: Form of Madness
traits.description: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the golothoma and can see it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or believe itself to be the shadow of a greater creature cast from a distant realm. The affected creature is Frightened while in Bright Light or Darkness and can repeat this saving throw as an Action, ending the effect and becoming immune to it for 24 hours on a success.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The golothoma has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golothoma makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Corrosive Tar Strike.

actions.name: Perforating Barbs
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 15 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Corrosive Tar Strike
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 15 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 10 feet away and covered in acidic sludge. Until a creature takes an action to remove it, the target's movement is reduced by half and it takes 14 (4d6) Acid damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

bonusActions.name: Flatten Reality (Level 3 Spell, Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description: A line of distorted space, 150 feet long and 5 feet wide, extends from the golothoma's eye. Until the end of the golothoma's next turn, each creature in the area counts as being within 5 feet of each other creature in the area, and may teleport to any unoccupied space in the area as a Bonus Action.

name: Worm-Shadow
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +7, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha +4
immunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Worm-Bonded
traits.description: The worm-shadow is bonded to a golothoma, granting it the following traits: The worm-shadow is Attached to its golothoma and cannot move or be moved more than 5 feet away from it. If the worm-shadow starts its turn more than 5 feet away from the golothoma, it teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the golothoma and takes 11 (2d10) Force damage. While in Dim Light or Darkness, the worm-shadow may move any distance at any time with no action required. Whenever the worm-shadow would take any non-radiant damage, it may have the golothoma take that damage in its stead.

traits.name: Ephemeral Presence
traits.description: The worm-shadow can move through and occupy the space of other creatures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The worm-shadow makes two attacks with its Shadow Barbs.

actions.name: Shadow Barbs
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Shadow Feeding
actions.description: Thrashing umbral spines lash upward from the worm-shadow. Each creature of its choice within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Corpse Consumption
actions.description: Each corpse in the worm-shadow's space slips into it and is devoured utterly. The worm-shadow and its golothoma (if still alive) each regain 10 Hit Points for each corpse consumed in this way. If the worm-shadow devours its golothoma in this way, it regains all of its Hit Points and loses its Worm-Bonded trait.

name: Goristro Ram-Raider
savingThrows: Str +13, Dex +6, Con +13, Int +1, Wis +4, Cha +2
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Attacks made without Advantage

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the goristro may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the goristro. While climbing on the goristro, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the goristro, and the goristro has Disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

traits.name: Hard Faller
traits.description: The goristro has vulnerability to damage from falling. While the goristro is within 5 feet of a precipice at least 10 feet high, it has Disadvantage on saving throws against effects that would Frighten it.

traits.name: Panicked Fury
traits.description: While the goristro is Frightened, attacks against it are made at Advantage and it cannot distinguish friend from foe.

traits.name: Limited Magic Resistance
traits.description: The goristro has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects that deal non-Psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The goristro makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Ravenous Bite, and uses its Goring Charge, if available.

actions.name: Ravenous Bite
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the goristro gains resistance to all damage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Wrecking Fist
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away. This attack deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Hoof Stomp
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Goring Charge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The goristro moves up to 40 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any creature smaller than Large. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, the creature must succeed on a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or take 33 (6d10) Piercing damage and be pushed ahead of the goristro for the rest of this move, or move to the nearest unoccupied space outside the goristro's path on a success.

reactions.name: Sadistic Stomp
reactions.description: When a prone creature within 5 feet of it regains any Hit Points, the goristro can make a Hoof Stomp attack against it.

reactions.name: See Red (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the goristro is reduced below 156 Hit Points, the goristro can immediately recharge and use its Goring Charge.

name: Goristro Living Siege
savingThrows: Str +18, Dex +7, Con +16, Int +2, Wis +7, Cha +2
immunities: Poison, Attacks made without Advantage; Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Impossible Size
traits.description: The goristro occupies a 60-foot square area of ground and is 200 feet tall. It can occupy the space of any creature smaller than Gargantuan.

traits.name: Thick Skull
traits.description: While the goristro is not prone, it is immune to the effects of any mind-affecting spells or abilities not controlled by a creature on its head.

traits.name: Living Siege
traits.description: The goristro has palisaded fortifications built into its back, shoulders, and head, sufficient to serve as a fighting platform for up to 40 medium creatures. A creature adjacent to the goristro may spend 30 feet of movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the goristro's legs. A creature may attempt the same check to climb from the goristro's legs to its back, or from its back to its head. * Legs. While climbing on the goristro's legs, a creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw whenever the goristro uses its Stride or fall off. * Waist. While climbing on the goristro's waist, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the goristro. * Back. While climbing on the goristro's back, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the goristro and the goristro cannot target it. Head. While climbing on the goristro's head, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the goristro and on saving throws against its abilities. If a creature on the goristro's head scores a critical hit against it, the goristro falls prone at the end of its next turn.

traits.name: The Bigger They Are..
traits.description: If the goristro falls prone, it takes 70 (20d6) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Panicked Fury
traits.description: While the goristro is Frightened, attacks against it are made at Advantage and it cannot distinguish friend from foe.

traits.name: Limited Magic Resistance
traits.description: The goristro has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects that deal non-Psychic damage.

actions.name: Crater Fist
actions.description: The goristro swings its armored fist, striking a 10-foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must make a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw, taking 65 (10d10 + 10) Bludgeoning damage on a failure or moving to the nearest space outside the area on a success. A creature may use its reaction to gain Advantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Mountain Hurl
actions.description: The goristro hurls a Gargantuan building or similar object up to 300 feet at a point it can see. At the beginning of the goristro's next turn, it lands. Each creature within 15 feet of that point is knocked prone, and must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 49 (6d12 + 10) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature riding on the object has Advantage on this saving throw. A creature with at least 15 Passive Perception knows precisely where the strike will land.

actions.name: Titanic Stride
actions.description: The goristro takes a single step, moving up to 60 feet, or standing from prone and moving up to 30 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of where it ends this movement that is not climbing on it must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 26 (3d10 + 10) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Earthbreaker Leap (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The goristro leaps high into the sky. At the start of its next turn, it lands prone in a space within 120 feet. Each creature climbing on it must succeed on a DC 26 Strength Saving Throw or fall off, then each creature within 30 feet of it that is not climbing on it must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 34 (8d10) Bludgeoning damage plus 35 (10d6) Fire damage, be pushed up to 30 feet away, and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Stride
legendaryActions.description: The goristro uses its Titanic Stride.

legendaryActions.name: Brush Off
legendaryActions.description: The goristro attempts to dislodge a creature climbing on it. The creature must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 32 (5d12) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 30 feet away.

name: Grumblyn
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -1, Con +2, Int -2, Wis -1, Cha +2

traits.name: Lurking Presence
traits.description: Unless it is encircled with salt, the grumblyn is Invisible and Immune to any damage dealt by a creature that can't see it. When the grumblyn takes any action or damage, this effect is suppressed until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Whisper-Mimic
traits.description: The grumblyn can perfectly mimic the voice of any creature affected by its Sow Strife.

actions.name: Sullen Swipe
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. If the target is climbing and does not have a Climb Speed, it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or fall Prone.

actions.name: Curse of Curdling
actions.description: One creature the grumblyn can see must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed. Each potion the Cursed creature is carrying congeals, becoming undrinkable until this curse is removed.

reactions.name: Sow Strife
reactions.description: When a creature within 60 feet fails a check or Saving Throw, the grumblyn can force it to make a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, the target believes its failure was caused by a creature of the grumblyn's choice until the target is presented with irrefutable evidence to the contrary.

name: Guecubu Cackle-Fiend
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +3, Con +4, Wis +3, Cha +4

traits.name: Unholy Strength
traits.description: While restrained, the cackle-fiend has its Strength and Dexterity scores reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1, for each holy talisman draped over it.

traits.name: Sadistic Fixation
traits.description: The cackle-fiend's attacks deal no additional damage on a critical hit. Instead, on a critical hit the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or lose a limb of the target's choice.

actions.name: Rending Thrash
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away. A creature killed by this damage is rent limb from limb.

actions.name: Madness Overflowing (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Erratic bolts of crackling fire leap from the mouth and eyes of the fiend in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Fire damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage and be Frightened until the end of the cackle-fiend's next turn.

name: Guecubu Soul Haunt
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex +2, Con +2, Wis +3, Cha +4
resistances: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Lurking Presence
traits.description: Unless it is encircled with salt, the guecubu is Invisible, immune to any damage dealt by a creature that cannot see it, and can't be Grappled or forced to move.

traits.name: Guecubu Weaknesses
traits.description:
The guecubu has the following weaknesses. Salt-Warded. The guecubu cannot cross a line of salt unless it is Attached to or Possessing another creature. Blessing-Burned. When a creature the guecubu is possessing is targeted by a spell with a divine source, the creature and the guecubu each take 7 (2d6) radiant damage. Mirror-Trapped. A guecubu that is forced to move into the space of a Medium or larger mirror must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw or be imprisoned in the mirror until the mirror is broken.

	>

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The guecubu can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guecubu makes three attacks with its Frenetic Claw.

actions.name: Frenetic Claw
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft., one creature that can see the guecubu. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Clutch Back
actions.description: One humanoid creature in the guecubu's space must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma Saving Throw or have the Guecubu become Attached to it. On a successful save, the creature becomes immune to this ability for 24 hours. While the guecubu is Attached to a creature, it can mimic that creature's voice, and that creature can't see the guecubu by any means. If a creature the guecubu is attached to teleports, the guecubu teleports with it.

actions.name: Profane Sleep
actions.description: One Sleeping creature the guecubu is attached to must make a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature ignores the effects of being Incapacitated and acts under the Guecubu's control for the next hour. When the creature wakes or on a successful save, the creature becomes immune to this ability for 24 hours.

reactions.name: Cruelty's Reward
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the guecubu is attached to commits an act of cruelty, the guecubu increases the creature's Strength by 1, to a maximum of 25. Then, if the creature has a Strength score higher than 22, it must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma Saving Throw or become Possessed by the Guecubu and transform into a Guecubu Cackle-Fiend until the guecubu is expelled.

name: Haures
savingThrows: Str +13, Dex +8, Con +13, Int +1, Wis +6, Cha +2
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Web-Dweller
traits.description: The haures can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the haures knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Gleeful Carnage
traits.description: While adjacent to three or more hostile creatures, the haures has Advantage on attack rolls. If the haures takes or deals any damage, it treats all adjacent creatures as hostile until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The haures' long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The haures has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The haures makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Ravenous Bite. It may replace one of its attacks with either a use of its Web Grab or its Goring Charge, if available.

actions.name: Ravenous Bite
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the haures gains resistance to all damage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: War Pick
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. Creatures within 5 feet of the target must make a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw, taking half the attack's damage on a failed save.

actions.name: Web Grab
actions.description: Each creature in a 10 ft. radius centered on a point within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or be dragged up to 30 ft. toward the haures.

actions.name: Goring Charge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The haures moves up to 30 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, the creature must succeed on a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or take 33 (6d10) Piercing damage and be pushed ahead of the haures for the rest of this move.

actions.name: Quick Pick
actions.description: When a creature enters the haurus' reach, the haures can make a War Pick attack against it.

name: Hazvongel Cruorjay
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +5, Con +8, Int +1, Wis +7

traits.name: Wandering Eye
traits.description: The hazvongel has Disadvantage on attacks against any creature it hit with an attack on its previous turn.

traits.name: Fickle Resistance
traits.description: The hazvongel has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects that do not impose the Charmed condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hazvongel makes four attacks.

actions.name: Talon Stampede
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the hazvongel can knock the target Prone or Grapple it (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Bloodrot Barbs
actions.description: Attack: +10 range 60/120 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Blood Deluge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The hazvongel flies up to half its Speed, raining corrupted ichor from its wings. Each creature the hazvongel flies over in this way must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 47 (6d8 + 20) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: False Fall
reactions.description: Trigger: The hazvongel is hit with a Ranged Attack. Response: The hazvongel falls Prone. The first time a creature moves within 10 feet of it before the start of its next turn, the hazvongel can leap to its feet and make an attack with its Talon Stampede.

name: Hazvongel Gorelord
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +5, Con +4, Int +3, Wis +9, Cha +9

traits.name: Wandering Eye
traits.description: The hazvongel has Disadvantage on attacks against any creature it hit with an attack on its previous turn.

traits.name: Demonic Purge (3/Day)
traits.description: The hazvongel has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. At the start of each of its turns, it can end one spell or condition affecting it. If it does, it loses this Advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hazvongel makes four attacks, two of which can be with its Jagged Beak.

actions.name: Jagged Beak
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 5 (1d10) damage to a Prone target.

actions.name: Talon Stampede
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the hazvongel can knock the target Prone or Grapple it (escape DC 21).

actions.name: Bloodrot Barbs
actions.description: Attack: +13 range 60/120 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Blood Deluge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The hazvongel flies up to half its Speed, raining corrupted ichor from its wings. Each creature the hazvongel flies over in this way must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 47 (6d8 + 20) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: False Fall
reactions.description: Trigger: The hazvongel is hit with a Ranged Attack. Response: The hazvongel moves up to 10 feet and falls Prone. The first time a creature moves within 10 feet of it before the start of its next turn, the hazvongel can leap to its feet and make an attack with its Talon Stampede.

reactions.name: Murderous Shriek (1/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: The hazvongel becomes Bloodied. Response: For 1 minute, the hazvongel can make one additional melee attack with its Multiattack.

legendaryActions.name: Crimson Omen
legendaryActions.description: One Bloodied creature the hazvongel can see within 30 feet must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The creature gains a Doom Counter that lasts for 8 hours. Whenever the creature drops to 0 Hit Points, it immediately fails one Death Saving Throw for each Doom Counter that it has.

legendaryActions.name: Staggering Spray
legendaryActions.description: The hazvongel beats its wings, sending forth a gust of crimson mist in a 30-foot Cone. Each creature in the area loses its Reaction, then must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The creature is pushed up to 15 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Double Slam (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The hazvongel moves up to 15 feet, then makes two Jagged Beak attacks with Advantage.

name: Hezrou Goon
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +4, Int -3, Wis -1, Cha +1

traits.name: Lickspittle
traits.description: The hezrou follows the most recent verbal command it received since the start of its last turn. If the command was given by a non-demon, the hezrou can make a DC 11 Wisdom Saving Throw, suspending this effect until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the hezrou takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the hezrou takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Frenzied Snaps (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Piercing damage. If three or more hezrou contributed to this attack, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone and take an additional 4 Piercing damage.

name: Hezrou Toady
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +3, Con +8, Int -3, Wis +4, Cha +1
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Lickspittle
traits.description: The hezrou follows the most recent verbal command it received since the start of its last turn. If the command was given by a non-demon, the hezrou may make a DC 10 Wisdom Saving Throw to negate this effect until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hezrou has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hezrou makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Shrouding Snap.

actions.name: Shrouding Snap
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. If this attack reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, the hezrou may use its reaction to belch forth a cloud of Magical Darkness in a 10-foot radius around itself that lasts for a minute.

actions.name: Gloomletter Claws
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, or Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) necrotic damage if the hezrou is in Magical Darkness.

reactions.name: Sickening Ichor
reactions.description: When the hezrou takes any piercing or Slashing damage, it can magically cause a noxious gas to boil out from its spilt blood. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of the hezrou's next turn. If the hezrou has fewer than 69 Hit Points, a creature that fails this saving throw must use its reaction to move 10 feet directly away from it.

name: Hezrou Hollerer
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +3, Con +8, Int -1, Wis +5, Cha +3
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Deafened
traits.description: The hezrou is permanently Deafened. If cured by Lesser Restoration or similar magic, it loses this trait and gains the Lickspittle trait.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hezrou has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hezrou makes three attacks with its Chaos Slam, one of which it may replace with a use of its Guard Me! or its Get in Line!

actions.name: Chaos Slam
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage, then the hezrou and each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone. *Guard Me!* Until the start of its next turn, while it is next to another hezrou attacks against the hollerer are made at Disadvantage. *Get in Line!* Each other hezrou within 30 feet that can hear the hollerer must make a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, the hezrou's initiative is reduced by 5 if it is higher than the hollerer's.

reactions.name: Sickening Ichor
reactions.description: When the hezrou takes any piercing or Slashing damage, it can magically cause a noxious gas to boil out from its spilt blood. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of the hezrou's next turn. If the hezrou has fewer than 73 Hit Points, a creature that fails this saving throw must use its reaction to move 10 feet directly away from it.

name: Immolith
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha +4
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Fire, Necrotic, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Unstable Fusion
traits.description: If the immolith takes 20 or more damage from a single source, it must make a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, it dies and explodes. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The immolith makes four attacks with its Searing Slash, one of which it may replace with a use of its Manifest Soul or Cursed Flare, if available.

actions.name: Searing Slash
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Manifest Soul
actions.description: The immolith manifests a charred appendage from its body, mirroring that of a creature consumed by its Fuel for the Fire in the last minute, and makes a melee attack using that creature's statistics.

actions.name: Cursed Flare (Recharges when the immolith uses its Fuel for the Fire)
actions.description: Each creature within 15 feet of the immolith must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed. A creature cursed in this way loses any Resistance to Fire damage, and takes an additional 3 (1d6) Fire damage whenever it takes Fire damage.

reactions.name: Fuel for the Fire
reactions.description: When a demon within 30 feet is destroyed, the immolith can force it to make a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature's spirit is absorbed into the immolith and the immolith gains 20 Temporary Hit Points.

name: Living Nightmare
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +5, Con +2, Int -5, Wis +3, Cha +4

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the nightmare takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the nightmare takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

traits.name: Fear-Born
traits.description: The nightmare is immune to any damage dealt by a Frightened creature.

actions.name: Rend Psyche (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 Psychic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the nightmare's next turn. If at least three nightmares contributed to this attack, a creature that fails this saving throw is instead Frightened for the next minute, and repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Incubus Atonian
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +5, Con +4, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha +4
skills: Deception +6, Intimidation +8, Sleight Of Hand +5, Stealth +7
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a bonus action, the incubus transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid without a fly speed, or back to its true fiendish form. Its statistics are otherwise the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Crushing Terror
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn prone and in the incubus' space takes 11 (2d10) nonlethal Psychic damage and cannot speak, breathe or stand until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Night's Caress (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target falls asleep for the next minute. A sleeping creature wakes early if a creature takes an action to shake it awake, or if it takes any damage.

actions.name: Sink Into Earth (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature the incubus can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence Saving Throw or fall prone and be Blinded for the next minute. If the creature stands from prone, the effect ends and the creature takes 22 (4d10) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Steal Dreams (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: One Unconscious or Blinded creature within 5 feet must make a DC 14 Intelligence Saving Throw. On a failed save, the incubus learns one closely held secret of the creature's, and the creature takes 33 (6d10) nonlethal Psychic damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points in this way is Cursed. A creature cursed in this way cannot gain levels or otherwise advance through experience. When this curse ends, the creature gains any levels prevented by the curse.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.description: The incubus enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

name: Incubus Ephialtes
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +7, Con +6, Int +1, Wis +5, Cha +5
skills: Deception +8, Intimidation +11, Sleight Of Hand +7, Stealth +10
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a bonus action, the incubus transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid without a fly speed, or back to its true fiendish form. Its statistics are otherwise the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Crushing Terror
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn prone and in the incubus' space takes 11 (2d10) nonlethal Psychic damage and cannot speak, breathe or stand until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The incubus makes two attacks with its Night's Caress, one of which it may replace with a use of its Waking Dream or Incubate Fears, if available.

actions.name: Night's Caress (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target falls asleep for the next minute. A sleeping creature wakes early if a creature takes an action to shake it awake, or if it takes any damage.

actions.name: Waking Dream (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One Unconscious creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or rise under the incubus' control for the next hour, or until it regains consciousness, and can perceive and take actions as though conscious for the duration. Whenever the creature would wake, the incubus may make a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw. On a success, the creature remains Unconscious.

actions.name: Incubate Fears (Recharge 5-6, Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: The incubus draws forth and congeals the fears of a Frightened or Unconscious creature within 5 feet, conjuring a Living Nightmare that lasts a minute in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.description: The incubus enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

name: Jarrlak
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +5, Con +5, Int +6, Wis +4, Cha +1

traits.name: Bladed Berg
traits.description: If the jarrlak takes 15 or more Fire damage from a single source, its Icicle Gore does half as much Piercing damage until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Freezing Flesh
traits.description: If the jarrlak is doused in water, it gains 10 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the jarrlak is restrained.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The jarrlak has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The jarrlak makes three attacks with its Icicle Gore, one of which it may replace with a use of its Frostshatter Bite or Frozen Death, if available.

actions.name: Frostshatter Bite
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) piercing damage. A target affected by the jarrlak's Frozen Death drops to 0 Hit Points, then must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or shatter into pieces and die.

actions.name: Icicle Gore
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Frozen Death (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: One creature the Jarrlak can see within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be Petrified as it freezes solid (Save Ends at end of turn). This effect ends early if the creature takes any Fire damage.

reactions.name: Glacial Eruption (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the jarrlak is reduced below 111 Hit Points, it can raise a contiguous wall of ice composed of up to six 20-foot by 20-foot, 5-foot thick panels, bursting forth from the earth within 100 feet of it. When the wall appears, each creature in the wall's space is pushed to a side of its choice. Each panel of the wall is an object and can be attacked (AC 5, 50 HP, vulnerability to Fire damage).

name: Jovoc
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +3, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Aura of Spite
traits.description: Whenever the jovoc takes damage, each non-jovoc creature within 10 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The jovoc has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The jovoc makes three attacks with its Crimson Claws.

actions.name: Crimson Claws
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) poison damage. Instead of dealing damage, the jovoc may grapple the target. If this attack targets a jovoc, it hits automatically.

actions.name: Charflesh Immolation
actions.description: The jovoc sets itself on fire. Until a creature takes an action to douse it, at the beginning of each of its turns the jovoc and each creature grappled by it takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

reactions.name: Fake Out
reactions.description: As a reaction when the jovoc leaves a creature's reach without being hit with an Attack of Opportunity, the jovoc moves up to 10 feet toward the creature and makes an attack against it.

name: Laghathti
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +1, Con +4, Int -3, Wis +3, Cha +1
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Form of Madness
traits.description: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the laghathti and can see it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be convinced that is memories have been stolen and replaced. An affected creature can't count as a willing or friendly target for any spell or magical effect, and can repeat this save as an action, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Weight of Memory
traits.description: If the laghathti starts its turn outside the waters of the Styx, it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until it returns to the waters.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The laghathti has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The laghathti makes four attacks with its Spined Tentacles, one of which it may replace with either its Devour Memories or Regurgitate Memories.

actions.name: Spined Tentacles
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 15 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Devour Memories
actions.description: One creature grappled by the laghathti must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence Saving Throw or have its proficiency bonus reduced by 1d4 until it completes a Short or Long Rest. A creature that has its proficiency bonus reduced to 0 in this way loses all biographical memories and can't benefit from any feat until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

actions.name: Regurgitate Memories (Recharges when the laghathti uses its Devour Memories)
actions.description: One creature grappled by the laghathti must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, be Stunned until the end of the laghathti's next turn, and gain Disadvantage on Intelligence Saving Throws for the next minute.

reactions.name: Screeching Wail (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 106 Hit Points, the laghathti lets out an agonized telepathic wail that is echoed by the voices of each creature grappled by it. Each creature grappled by the laghathti must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or lose concentration and its breath, if it was holding either, and be Frightened until the end of its next turn.

name: Lilitu
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +5, Con +4, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +6
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the lilitu transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back to her true fiendish form. Her statistics are the same in each form.

traits.name: Curseborn
traits.description: If the lilitu is targeted with a Remove Curse spell, she takes 22 (4d10) Psychic damage and attacks against her are made at Advantage until the start of her next turn.

traits.name: Hate Beyond Death
traits.description: If the lilitu is destroyed and the community cursed by her remains, her spirit lingers and is eventually reborn as a child conceived in that community. After 13 (3d8) years, she regains her full demonic statistics and abilities.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The lilitu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
traits.description: If the lilitu fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lilitu makes three attacks, each of which she may replace with a use of her Frenzied Compulsion or Heretical Brand.

actions.name: Ashen Strike
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

actions.name: Tendrils of Anguish
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 15 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) psychic damage and the target is dragged up to 5 feet toward the lilitu.

actions.name: Frenzied Compulsion
actions.description: One creature that can hear the lilitu and is Charmed by her may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a weapon attack with Advantage. If it does not, the creature instead takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Heretical Brand
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet that is Charmed by the lilitu takes 10 (3d6) Fire damage, then must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed. While Cursed in this way, a creature's alignment becomes Chaotic Evil, it is Dominated by the lilitu, and it has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and Slashing damage dealt by nonmagical weapons. The creature repeats this saving throw whenever it regains Hit Points, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Seal of Misery (Recharge 5-6, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: The lilitu raises an opaque barrier of crimson light enclosing a 20-foot radius sphere centered on a point she can see within 60 feet. For the next hour, a creature that moves or is moved out of the area must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or take 27 (5d10) Necrotic damage and be pushed up to 20 feet toward the area's center, or take half as much damage on a success. If the sphere contains only a single creature that is not Incapacitated, the effect ends.

actions.name: Corruptive Emblem (1/Day, Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: The lilitu imbues an object with evil power that radiates palpably in a 30-foot radius. A creature with a Wisdom score of 13 or lower that starts its turn in the area and can see the object is Charmed by the lilitu until it takes any damage, or until the object is moved or destroyed (AC 20, 20 HP; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage). Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid this effect. If it does, it treats the object and each creature within 10 feet of it as Invisible.

legendaryActions.name: Frenzied Compulsion
legendaryActions.description: The lilitu uses her Frenzied Compulsion.

legendaryActions.name: Whisperstride
legendaryActions.description: The lilitu moves up to half her speed, then one creature within 5 feet of her must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed by her until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Drown in Blood (Costs 2 Actions, Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
legendaryActions.description: Blood wells up in the mouth and lungs of a creature the lilitu can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage and begin Choking for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

name: Manes Wretch
savingThrows: Dex -1, Con +1, Int -4, Wis -1, Cha -3

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the manes takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the manes takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

traits.name: Acidic Cloud
traits.description: When the manes dies, it dissolves into a cloud of acrid vapor, dealing 3 Acid damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Maddening Claws (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Slashing damage and the target has Disadvantage on attacks that don't target a manes on its following turn.

name: Manes Vilespawn
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex -1, Con +2, Int -4, Wis -1, Cha -3

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The manes makes two attacks with its Maddening Claws.

actions.name: Maddening Claws
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage and the target has Disadvantage on attacks that don't target a manes on its following turn.

actions.name: Panicked Charge (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The manes moves up to its speed, and may make a melee attack at Disadvantage against each creature it passes within 5 feet of with this movement.

reactions.name: Mindless Hate
reactions.description: When a creature falls prone within 5 feet of the manes, the manes must use make a Maddening Claws attack against it, if possible.

reactions.name: Consume Essence
reactions.description: When the manes kills a fiend of CR 2 or higher, it can attempt to absorb the fiend's essence, making a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The mob can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the mob can move through any opening large enough for a small creature. The mob can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Maddening Claws
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 0 ft. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) slashing damage, or Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage if the mob has fewer than half its Hit Points, and the target has Disadvantage on attacks that don't target a manes on its following turn.

actions.name: Terror Vines

legendaryActions.name: Forced Growth

legendaryActions.name: Terror Vines

name: Master of Cruelties
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +7, Int +8, Wis +7, Cha +9

traits.name: Feed on the Crowd
traits.description: Whenever a creature within 60 feet of the master dies, the master gains 15 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, its attacks have Advantage.

traits.name: Standout's Composure
traits.description: While at least one creature is Charmed or Frightened by the master, it has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and can end one spell or condition affecting it at the end of each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The master makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Ring of Fire or Cruel Predicament.

actions.name: Firebrand Fork
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage. This attack scores a Critical Hit on an 18-20 against a Frightened target.

actions.name: Ring of Fire (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A wall of flame surrounds a 20-foot radius Sphere within 100 feet of the master, providing Half Cover. Whenever a creature in the area takes any Fire damage, it takes an extra 7 (2d6) Fire damage. A creature that enters or exits this area for the first time on a turn must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 14 (4d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Cruel Predicament (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the master can see within 60 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 22 (4d10) Psychic damage and the creature is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage. Each of the target's allies within 15 feet of it can choose to take 11 (2d10) Psychic damage. If each such creature (at least one) chooses not to, the target has Disadvantage on this saving throw. If each such creature chooses to take this damage, the target has Advantage on it.

bonusActions.name: Shift Spotlight
bonusActions.description: One ally or enemy the master can see within 60 feet must use its Reaction, if available, to make a weapon attack.

bonusActions.name: Incite Bloodlust (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description: Each creature within 60 feet of the master must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: Until the end of the creature's next turn, it is hostile toward all creatures. Failure by 5 or More: The creature is also Charmed by the master for the same duration.

traits.name: Flailing Charge

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The molydeus has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the molydeus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Slavering Bite

actions.name: Crushing Grasp

legendaryActions.name: Cleaving Charge (Costs 2 Actions)

immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Poisoned

traits.name: Hateful Ichor
traits.description: A nonfiend creature that deals any piercing or Slashing damage to the myrmyxicus is covered in its blood. Until a creature takes an action to clear the blood, the affected creature takes 11 (2d10) Psychic damage whenever it ends its turn without dealing damage.

traits.name: Vulnerable Midsection
traits.description: If the myrmyxicus takes 30 or more piercing or Slashing damage from a single source, it must make a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw. traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The myrmyxicus has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)

actions.name: Lamprey Bite

actions.name: Blasphemous Scythes
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. This attack ignores enhancements to AC from spells or magic items. Damage from this attack bypasses Temporary Hit Points and can't be reduced in any way.

actions.name: Billowing Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A torrent of dense black vapor pours from the myrmyxicus' mouth in a 30-foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failes saving throw, a creature takes 28 (8d6) poison damage and is Poisoned for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn), or takes half as much damage on a success. While Poisoned in this way, a creature is Blinded and Choking.

actions.name: Chaos Immortal (1/Day, Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: One allied creature the myrmyxicus can see is wreathed in foul abyssal energies for the next minute, after which it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or be reduced to 0 Hit Points. For the next minute, its melee attacks deal an additional 11 (2d10) fire and 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage, and it does not fall unconscious when reduced to 0 Hit Points. The creature makes death saving throws while at 0 Hit Points, even if it ordinarily would not, and regains 10 Hit Points at the beginning of each of its turns.

bonusActions.name: Unholy Enthrallment (Level 4 Spell)
bonusActions.description: One fiend or undead creature grappled by the myrmyxicus must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma Saving Throw or be Dominated by the myrmyxicus. The creature repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

bonusActions.name: Shredling Infusion
bonusActions.description: One creature grappled by the myrmyxicus' Lamprey Bite must make a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature's Charisma score is reduced by 2 (1d4), to a minimum of 1, and numerous boils raise and burst from its body, expelling a Ruin Demon Caricature in its space. A creature that has its Charisma score reduced below 5 in this way counts as a fiend until the reduction ends.

legendaryActions.name: Blasphemous Scythe
legendaryActions.description: The myrmyxicus makes an attack with its Blasphemous Scythes.

legendaryActions.name: Breath of the Abyss (Level 2 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: One allied demon the myrmyxicus can see takes 15 Slashing damage and a gout of burning toxic fumes emerges from its wound in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Fire damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Tendrilous Slither (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The myrmyxicus moves up to its speed. Each creature whose space it moves within 5 feet of must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened and Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Lightsbane Assault (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 Necrotic damage. This attack can target an area of Bright Light in the demon's reach (AC 10, or equal to the spell caster's Save DC if the light is produced by a spell). An area of light hit with this attack has the radius it projects from its source reduced by 5 feet.

actions.name: Shadow Teleport
actions.description: The demon teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space of Dim Light or Darkness that it can see.

name: Shadow Demon Soulcarver
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +5, Con +2, Int +2, Wis +1, Cha +4

actions.name: Multattack

actions.name: Light-Rending Claws

reactions.name: Sudden Disappearance

actions.name: Skullcleaver Cragblade
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. This attack is made at Advantage against a grappled creature.

bonusActions.name: Aggressive Advance
bonusActions.description: The tanarukk moves up to its speed directly toward a hostile creature that it can see.

reactions.name: Fury Unleashed
reactions.description: When the tanarukk succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can erupt into flame and begin Burning (1d10). While it is Burning, the tanarukk's melee attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

name: Tanarukk Firespeaker
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +5, Con +10, Int +3, Wis +3, Cha -1

traits.name: Burning of Aeons
traits.description: Whenever the tanarukk takes Fire damage, it gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The tanarukk has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tanarukk makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Foaming Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or lose an ear.

actions.name: Fireburst Fist
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target suffers one of the following effects: If the target was not Burning, it begins Burning (1d10). If the target was Burning, an fiery explosion flares out from it in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Fire damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

bonusActions.name: Aggressive Advance
bonusActions.description: The tanarukk moves up to its speed directly toward a hostile creature that it can see.

reactions.name: Fury Unleashed
reactions.description: When the tanarukk succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can erupt into flame and begin Burning (1d10). While it is Burning, the tanarukk's melee attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

name: Uzollru
savingThrows: Str +12, Dex +5, Con +11, Int -2, Wis +11, Cha +5
resistances: Acid, Fire, Lightning; Attacks made without Advantage
immunities: Cold, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The uzollru has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Colossal Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the uzollru may spend its full movement to attempt to climb onto it with a successful a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. While climbing on the uzollru, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against it.

traits.name: Form of Madness
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the uzollru is staggered by the magnitude of its insignificance, and must make a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature loses all sense of self preservation. Until the start of its next turn, attacks against the affected creature have Advantage, and the creature cannot voluntarily move away from the uzollru. On a successful saving throw, a creature becomes immune to this effect for 1 hour.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the uzollru fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The uzollru makes two melee attacks; one with its Seizer Claw and one with its Crusher Claw.

actions.name: Seizer Claw
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 30 ft. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 20) and dragged up to 25 feet towards the uzollru. A creature grappled in this way takes Hit: 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Crusher Claw
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 10 ft. Hit: 51 (8d10 + 7) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or suffer Disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Feeder Tendrils
actions.description: The uzollru's feeder tendrils burrow into the body of a creature grappled by it, injecting digestive enzymes. The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 10 (3d6) until it completes a Short or Long Rest. The target's maximum Hit Points are not affected by this reduction, and it dies if this reduces its Constitution score to 0.

legendaryActions.name: Searing Gaze
legendaryActions.description: One creature affected by the uzollru's Form of Madness must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the uzollru's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Angle Armor Plating
legendaryActions.description: The uzollru chooses a direction, adding +5 to its AC against attacks made from that direction by creatures that are not climbing on it until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Sudden Revelation (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description:
One creature immune to the uzollru's Form of Madness must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn and lose any immunity it has to the uzollru's Form of Madness.




 Design Intent: Angles of Attack. The direction as indicated by the Angle Armor Plating legendary action behaves as a cone of arbitrary size extending from the center of the uzollru's space. The intent is that creatures trying to keep their distance should have difficulty repositioning to avoid it, but creatures that are close should be able to see and play around it without issue.

name: Vrock Kettler
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the vrock takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the vrock takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

traits.name: Winds of Conflict
traits.description: A non-vrock creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of 3 or more vrock kettlers must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or take 3 Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet toward the nearest non-vrock creature.

actions.name: Flocking Rake (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 Slashing damage. If at least two other vrocks added to this attack, attacks of opportunity the target makes this turn have Disadvantage.

name: Vrock Schemer
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +5, Con +4, Int -1, Wis +4, Cha +2
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Fleshgorger Rampage
traits.description: When the vrock reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack on its turn, the vrock gains 11 (2d10) Temporary Hit Points. If the creature was a demon, the vrock instead gains twice as many Temporary Hit Points and can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make an attack with its Serrated Beak.

traits.name: Inevitable Betrayal
traits.description: The vrock has Advantage on the first attack it makes each turn against an allied creature.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The vrock has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vrock makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Serrated Beak.

actions.name: Serrated Beak
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical on an 18-20.

actions.name: Gnarled Talons
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Stunning Screech (1/Day)
actions.description: The vrock emits a horrific screech. Each other creature within 20 feet of it that can hear it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the vrock's next turn.

reactions.name: Fiendripper Mites
reactions.description: When the vrock is hit with a melee attack, it can scatter a hail of venomous, biting parasites from its feathers, covering the attacker. Until a creature takes an action to remove them, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw at the beginning of each of its turns or take 5 (1d10) poison damage and be Poisoned until the start of its next turn.

name: Vrock Desecrator
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +7, Con +8, Int +1, Wis +7, Cha +3
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Fleshgorger Rampage
traits.description: When the vrock reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack on its turn, the vrock gains 11 (2d10) Temporary Hit Points. If the creature was a demon, the vrock instead gains twice as many Temporary Hit Points and can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make an attack with its Burning Beak.

traits.name: Inevitable Betrayal
traits.description: The vrock has Advantage on the first attack it makes each turn against an allied creature.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The vrock has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vrock makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Burning Beak.

actions.name: Burning Beak
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage. This attack scores a critical on an 18-20.

actions.name: Gnarled Talons
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Felloil Rain (Recharge 5-6, Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Each creature in a 5-foot radius column extending beneath the vrock is doused in a fine mist of glistening oil, and must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success. If an affected creature takes any Fire damage in the next minute, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage at the end of each of its turns.

actions.name: Wheel of Ruin (1/Day, Level 6 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The vrock conjures an abyssal storm that lasts for a minute and follows its movement as it flies. On each of the vrock's turns, it may call down demonic lightning as a bonus action. The vrock and each creature encircled by the movement the vrock took this turn must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Lightning damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Fiendripper Mites
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the vrock scatters a hail of venomous, biting parasites from its feathers, covering the attacker. Until a creature takes an action to remove them, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw and the beginning of each of its turns or take 1d10 poison damage and be Poisoned until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Stunning Screech (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 100 Hit Points, the vrock emits a horrific screech. Each other creature within 20 feet of it that can hear it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the vrock's next turn.

name: Wastrilith Krasis
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +4, Con +10, Int +4, Wis +1, Cha +2
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Corrupt Water
traits.description: At the start of each of the wastrilith's turns, exposed water within 30 feet of it is corrupted. Underwater, this effect lightly obscures the area until a current clears it away. A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be unable to distinguish friend from foe until the start of its next turn. On a success, a creature becomes immune to the effect for 24 hours.

traits.name: Villiform Teeth
traits.description: The wastrilith does not automatically release creatures grappled by its Bonescraper Bite when Incapacitated. A creature grappled in this way that attempts to escape takes 6 (1d12) Piercing damage, and a creature freed from this grapple by forced movement takes 13 (2d12) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The wastrilith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wastrilith uses its Grasping Spout and makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Bonescraper Bite.

actions.name: Bonescraper Bite
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Carcass Hooks
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Grasping Spout (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: The wastrilith launches a spout of water at one creature it can see within 60 feet, which must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or take 22 (4d8 + 4) Acid damage and be pulled up to 30 feet toward the wastrilith.

actions.name: Boiling Breath (Level 6 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The wastrilith exhales a torrent of boiling water in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 42 (12d6) Fire damage, or half as much damage on a success. Each Medium or smaller creature in the area is pushed up to 15 feet away.

actions.name: Oceanic Assault (1/Day, Level 7 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The wastrilith transforms an unoccupied 5-foot radius space filled with water that it can see within 30 feet into a Water Weird that lasts for a minute and acts on the wastrilith's initiative and under its control. On each of its turns for the next minute, the wastrilith may repeat this action, summoning an additional Water Weird. While the wastrilith has three or more summoned water weirds active at a time, it has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain concentration.

reactions.name: Rime Sphere (Level 5 Spell)
reactions.description: When the wastrilith is reduced below 111 Hit Points, it can raise a 30-foot radius spherical barrier of ice centered on a point it can see within 60 feet, pushing each creature in the barrier's space to a side of the creature's choice. The barrier can be damaged and destroyed (AC 10, 100 Hit Points, vulnerability to Fire damage), and whenever a creature deals 25 or more damage to the barrier in a turn it may open a breach large enough for a Medium creature to squeeze through at a point in the attack's reach or range.

name: Wastrilith Chthonian
savingThrows: Str +14, Dex +11, Con +13, Int -1, Wis +6, Cha +2
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Form of Madness
traits.description: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the wastrilith and can see it must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom Saving Throw or lose the ability to feel compassion or empathy. An affected creature cannot target a friendly creature with a spell or magical effect, and any friendly creature that attempts to cast healing magic within 10 feet of the affected creature must succeed on a Dexterity check contested by the affected creature or have the affected creature become the magic's new target. An affected creature can repeat this saving throw as an Action, ending the effect and becoming immune to it for 24 hours on a success.

traits.name: Villiform Teeth
traits.description: The wastrilith does not automatically release creatures grappled by its Bonescraper Bite when Incapacitated. A creature grappled in this way that attempts to escape takes 13 (2d12) Piercing damage, and a creature freed from this grapple by forced movement takes 26 (4d12) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The wastrilith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the wastrilith fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wastrilith makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Bonescraper Bite. It may replace any number of attacks with uses of its Gulp Down.

actions.name: Bonescraper Bite
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 20 ft. Hit: 46 (6d12 + 7) piercing damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 22).

actions.name: Carcass Hooks
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 15 ft. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gulp Down
actions.description: One creature grappled by the wastrilith takes 13 (2d12) Piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained for as long as it remains grappled. A restrained creature that fails this saving throw instead takes 26 (4d12) Piercing damage and becomes Swallowed for as long as it remains grappled.

actions.name: Polluted Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The wastrilith breathes forth a torrent of black bile in a 60-foot cone, heavily obscuring the area until the start of its next turn. Each creature swallowed by the wastrilith and each creature in the area when it appears must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Acid damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success. Each creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned in this way, a creature is Stunned.

legendaryActions.name: Gulp Down
legendaryActions.description: The wastrilith uses its Gulp Down.

legendaryActions.name: Pressure Pulse
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 15 feet of the wastrilith must succeed on a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away.

legendaryActions.name: Sinuous Slice (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The wastrilith moves up to half its swim speed and makes two attacks with its Carcass Hooks.

name: Whisper Demon
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +6, Con +3, Int +8, Wis +6, Cha +3
resistances: Acid, Fire, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Cold, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The demon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The demon's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

actions.name: Multitattack
actions.description: The demon makes two attacks with its maddening touch and uses its whispers of madness, if available.

actions.name: Maddening Touch
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 2) psychic damage and the target's Wisdom is reduced by 2 (1d4) until it completes a short or long rest. A creature reduced to 0 Wisdom in this way becomes hostile to all living creatures, including itself, until it recovers.

actions.name: Whispers of Madness (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each non-fiend, non-undead creature within 30 feet must make a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature uses its reaction to move up to make a melee attack against a living creature in range.

actions.name: Create Allip
actions.description: One unconscious humanoid creature within 10 ft. of the demon must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or make a melee attack against itself. If the attack hits, the creature dies and rises as an allip at the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Shadow Glide (Dim Light Only)
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking damage of a type it is resistant to, the wraith may teleport up to 60 feet and turn invisible until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

name: Yochlol
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +6, Con +4, Int +5, Wis +6, Cha +7
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The yochlol can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The yochlol has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack (Spider Form Only)
actions.description: The yochlol makes two attacks with its Venomous Bite.

actions.name: Venomous Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. (10 ft. in demon form), Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing in spider form damage plus Hit: 18 (5d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Demonweb Metamorphosis (Demon Form Only)
actions.description: The yochlol breathes a foul miasma into the lungs of a charmed creature within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 4 (1d8) for the next minute, to a minimum of 1. A creature whose Constitution is reduced to 1 in this way transforms into a Drider.

actions.name: Charm (Drow Form Only, Concentration)
actions.description: One humanoid the yochlol can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be magically Dominated by it.
