The Dominated creature repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success. When this effect ends on a creature, the creature takes 44 (8d10) Psychic damage and is immune to this yochlol's Charm for the next 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Compel
bonusActions.description: One creature charmed by the yochlol must use its reaction to move up to its speed and make a melee attack.

bonusActions.name: Shift Form
bonusActions.description: The yochlol transforms into a Medium or Large form that resembles a female drow, a giant spider, or back into its true demonic form. Its statistics are otherwise the same in each form.

reactions.name: Secret Mouth (Demon or Drow Form Only)
reactions.description: When the yochlol is missed with a melee attack, it can make a Venomous Bite attack against the attacker.

reactions.name: Toxic Dissolution (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the yochlol is reduced below 111 Hit Points, it can dissolve into a cloud of poisonous gas until the start of its next turn and move up to its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. A creature whose space it moves through in this way must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

name: Baphomet
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex +9, Con +15, Int +4, Wis +14, Cha +3
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Attacks made mithout Advantage
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Reckless Follow-Through
traits.description: At the beginning of Baphomet's turn, they can gain Advantage on all melee attacks until the beginning of their next turn. If one of these attacks misses, Baphomet falls prone and is Stunned until the beginning of their next turn.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: A creature within 5 feet of Baphomet may spend half of its movement to attempt to climb onto them with a successful DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. Attacks made against Baphomet by a creature climbing on them have Advantage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Baphomet has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Bestial Juggernaut
traits.description: At the beginning of Baphomet's turn, each effect that would Incapacitate them, immobilize them, or alter their form ends. If Baphomet is forced to make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma Saving Throw, attacks against them have Advantage until the beginning of their next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Baphomet makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with their Gore. If Baphomet has fewer than 262 Hit Points, they may make any of their attacks with their Gore.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 10 ft. Hit: 29 (3d12 + 10) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 25 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 11 (2d10) damage to a prone creature.

actions.name: Heartcleaver
actions.description:
Attack: +17 reach 15 ft. Hit: 24 (3d8 + 10) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target suffers one additional effect selected at random:
*

actions.name: 1. Curse of Brutality
actions.description:
The target must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed. While cursed, a creature's appearance becomes partialy bestial, and the creature cannot cast spells of 5th level or above.
*

actions.name: 2. Crush Bones
actions.description:
The target must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution Saving Throw or suffer Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws that use Strength until it completes a long rest.
*

actions.name: 3. Cleave Limb
actions.description:
The target must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution Saving Throw or lose a limb (target's choice).
*

actions.name: 4. Bisect
actions.description: The target must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution Saving Throw or die.

actions.name: Desecration Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Baphomet disgorges a torrent of unholy, bilious water in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 23 Constitution Saving Throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage plus 45 (10d8) Necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area becomes desecrated for the next hour. A non-fiend creature that starts its turn in the area takes 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.

reactions.name: Gouging Toss
reactions.description: When a creature moves within 10 feet of them, Baphomet forces the creature to succeed on a DC 25 Strength Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Bloodied Bellow (1/Day)
reactions.description: When Baphomet is reduced below 262 Hit Points for the first time, they let out an anguished bellow. Each other creature within 60 feet takes 36 (8d8) Thunder damage, or half as much if behind cover, and must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Plummet
legendaryActions.description: One flying creature that Baphomet can see within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone. If the creature would take damage from falling as a result of this, it takes twice as much damage.

legendaryActions.name: Raise Labyrinth
legendaryActions.description: Baphomet raises two contiguous 20-foot by 20-foot stone panels from the ground within 300 feet. As long as a pathway from one side of the wall to the other exists that Baphomet could traverse, the wall does not impede Baphomet's vision or movement. Each panel can be damaged and breached (AC 20; 30 HP; immunity to poison and Psychic damage), and crumbles if Baphomet moves through it.

legendaryActions.name: Thrashing Horns (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Up to two creatures on opposite sides of Baphomet must each succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 35 (8d8) Piercing damage and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

name: Demogorgon
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +10, Con +16, Int +5, Wis +11, Cha +15
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning. Attacks made without Advantage
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Double Actions
traits.description: Demogorgon rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them. If his mythic trait is active, he acts only on his lowest initiative.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to Demogorgon may spend half of its movement to attempt to climb onto him with a successful DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. A creature climbing on Demogorgon has Advantage on melee attacks against him.

traits.name: Indecision Weakness
traits.description: While three or more enemies are within his reach, Demogorgon has Disadvantage on attack rolls and attack rolls against him have Advantage.

traits.name: Engineered Resistance
traits.description: Demogorgon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and has resistance to damage from spells of 3rd level or below.

traits.name: Shed Weakness (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
traits.description: When Demogorgon is reduced to 0 Hit Points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, he resets to 336 Hit Points and tears off one of his heads, losing his Indecision Weakness and Gaze of Aarneul, and gaining a second action on each of his turns.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
traits.description: If Demogorgon fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Demogorgon makes two melee attacks, one of which he may replace with either his Gaze of Hethradiah or Gaze of Aameul, if available.

actions.name: Tentacle Thrash
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 15 ft. Hit: 35 (4d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 25). A creature that starts its turn grappled in this way must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Doll-Joint Malacia.

actions.name: Forked Tail Drain
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 20 ft. Hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) slashing damage and the target loses two unexpended hit dice, or takes an additional Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage if it can't.

actions.name: Gaze of Hethradiah
actions.description: One creature that Demogorgon can see within 120 feet must make a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, attacks against the creature score a critical on an 18-20 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Gaze of Aameul (Recharges when Demogorgon uses his Gaze of Hethradiah)
actions.description: One creature that Demogorgon can see within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to take an action of Demogorgon's choice.

actions.name: Into the Spiraling Depths (Level 8 Spell, Concentration, Recharge 6)
actions.description: An enormous spectral maw breaches forth through a planar rift. Each creature in a 15-foot radius centered on a point Demogorgon can see must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) Piercing damage and be abducted to the depths of Abysm. An abducted creature makes a DC 21 Charisma Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, returning to the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed on a success or taking 22 (4d10) Acid damage on a failure. A creature killed by this damage does not return.

reactions.name: Body Shield
reactions.description: When Demogorgon is targeted with an attack while grappling one or more creatures, he can add +4 to its AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, the attacker makes a new attack roll, targeting a grappled creature instead.

legendaryActions.name: Fling
legendaryActions.description: Demogorgon flings a creature grappled by him at a creature or surface within 40 feet. The thrown creature takes 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage. If the creature was thrown at another creature, the target must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity Saving Throw or take the same damage.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport
legendaryActions.description: Demogorgon teleports up to 30 feet to a location he can see, along with each creature he is grappling and each creature that is climbing on him.

legendaryActions.name: Deep Father's Mastery
legendaryActions.description: One friendly creature within 60 feet that has a swim speed may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make an attack.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Unshackled Brutality (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Demogorgon makes a melee attack with Advantage and can roll to recharge his Into the Spiraling Depths.

name: Fraz-Urb'luu
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +8, Con +14, Int +15, Wis +14, Cha +8
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Shroud of the Hidden Hand (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
traits.description: When Fraz-Urb'luu is reduced to 0 Hit Points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, he resets to 200 Hit Points. For the next hour, he becomes Invisible to creatures affected by his Lying Eyes trait and he can summon up to three creatures of CR 6 or below with his Illusory Fiend ability, instead of one.

traits.name: Lying Eyes
traits.description: Each creature within 60 feet of Fraz-Urb'luu that lacks Trusight can see only what he chooses for it to see. He cannot use this ability to obscure or otherwise conceal himself while his mythic trait is not active.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Fraz-Urb'luu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Ephemeral Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: When Fraz-Urb'luu is targeted with a spell or magical effect, he can choose to teleport to an unoccupied space he can see within 30 feet, revealing his previous position to be an illusory trick. If he does, he suffers no effects from the spell or magical effect.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Fraz-Urb'luu makes two attacks with his Phantasmal Fist, one of which he may replace with his Tail Thrash or a use of his Deceptive Charm.

actions.name: Phantasmal Fist
actions.description: Attack: +16 reach 30 ft. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) psychic damage and Fraz-Urb'luu teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target.

actions.name: Tail Thrash
actions.description: Attack: +16 reach 15 ft. Hit: 28 (3d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) psychic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 24 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away and knocked prone.

actions.name: Deceptive Charm
actions.description: One creature Fraz-Urb'luu can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed by him for the next minute, or until it takes any damage.

actions.name: Twisting Havoc (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature of Fraz-Urb'luu's choice affected by his Lying Eyes trait must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom Saving Throw or become Charmed by Fraz-Urb'luu and hostile to each other creature that failed this save until the end of his next turn.

reactions.name: Cruel Conciliation
reactions.description: When Fraz-Urb-Luu is missed with an attack, he can use his Deceptive Charm against the attacker.

legendaryActions.name: Phantasmal Fist
legendaryActions.description: Fraz-Urb'luu makes an attack with his Phantasmal Fist.

legendaryActions.name: Corrupt Memories
legendaryActions.description: One Charmed creature Fraz-Urb'luu can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom Saving Throw or have its Charisma score reduced by 4 (1d8), to a minimum of 1, for as long as it remains Charmed. A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 1 in this way believes itself to be a demon in Fraz-Urb'luu's service and remains Charmed until freed by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

legendaryActions.name: Illusory Fiend (Concentration)
legendaryActions.description: Fraz-Urb'luu shapes the raw energies of the Abyss into a semi-real demon of CR 6 or lower in an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet. The demon acts on initiative count 0 under Fraz-Urb'luu's control, and is destroyed if it begins its turn more than 60 feet away from him, or if he loses concentration.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Disjunctive Touch
legendaryActions.description: Fraz-Urb'luu ends one spell or destroys one magic item of Very Rare or lesser rarity within 5 feet. A creature wielding the magic item can make a DC 24 Dexterity Saving Throw, preventing its destruction on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Hollow the Heart (Costs 2 Actions, 1/Day)
legendaryActions.description: Fraz-Urb'luu plunges his claw into the chest of a creature within 10 feet, forcing it to make a DC 23 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, Fraz-Urb'luu rips the creature's still-beating heart from its chest. The creature becomes Dominated by Fraz-Urb'luu and dies if it ceases to be Dominated by him. On a successful save, the creature instead takes 55 (10d10) Piercing damage. A creature with no heart succeeds automatically on this saving throw.

name: Graz'zt
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +9, Con +12, Int +5, Wis +13, Cha +8
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Six-Fingered Subversion
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of Graz'zt that is Charmed by a creature other than him is instead Charmed by him for the same duration.

traits.name: Seductive Guile
traits.description:
A creature that fails a saving throw against a spell or ability Graz'zt controls can choose to succeed instead. If it does, the creature gains 30 Temporary Hit Points.
 While a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it is Dominated by Graz'zt, and cannot benefit from immunity to the Charmed or Dominated condition.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Graz'zt has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
traits.description: If Graz'zt fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Graz'zt makes two attacks with Bitter Bastard and uses either his Gift of Writhing Pain or Gift of Transcendent Pleasure.

actions.name: Bitter Bastard
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage and an arc of acid splashes forth in a 15-foot Cone centered on the target, dealing Hit: 9 (2d8) acid damage to each creature in the area.

actions.name: Gift of Writhing Pain (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Graz'zt can see within 60 feet falls prone and is wracked with agony for the next minute. At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) Psychic damage and be unable to stand until the start of its next turn, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Gift of Transcendent Pleasure (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Graz'zt can see within 60 is suffused in an aura of pure rapturous delight for the next minute. At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom Saving Throw or voluntarily fail all other saving throws and be unable to take reactions until the start of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends.

actions.name: Annihilating Despair (Concentration, Recharges when Graz'zt uses his Ambrosial Ecstasy)
actions.description: One creature Graz'zt can see within 60 feet becomes Invisible to him for the next minute. At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 77 (14d10) Psychic damage. If a creature is killed by this damage, each of its allies must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom Saving Throw or lose all memory of them until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

actions.name: Ambrosial Ecstasy (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Graz'zt gently touches a creature within 5 feet and shares with it a fragment of his power, forcing it to succeed on a DC 23 Constitution Saving Throw or be Cursed. A creature cursed in this way adds 1d4 to any attack roll or saving throw it makes while Charmed or Dominated by Graz'zt, and subtracts 1d4 from any such roll made while not Charmed or Dominated by him. A creature that has this curse removed by any means other than a Wish spell takes 22 (4d10) Psychic damage whenever it completes a Long Rest.

reactions.name: Exploit Opening
reactions.description: When he is missed with a melee attack, Graz'zt can move up to 10 feet and make an attack with Bitter Bastard.

reactions.name: Covetous Intercession (Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: When a creature Charmed or Dominated by him is targeted with an attack, Graz'zt can teleport to switch places with the target, and Graz'zt becomes the new target of the attack.

legendaryActions.name: Beguiling Invitation
legendaryActions.description: One creature Graz'zt can see within 60 feet can use its reaction to move up to its speed, then takes 5 (1d10) Psychic damage for each 5 feet away from him it ends this movement.

legendaryActions.name: Devour Magic
legendaryActions.description: Graz'zt ends one spell or magical effect within 60 feet, then gains Disadvantage on the next saving throw he makes in the next minute against magic controlled by that spell's caster.

legendaryActions.name: Mercurial Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Graz'zt teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a creature he can see, then makes two melee attacks against it.

name: Ooze Scion
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -3, Con +2, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing
immunities: Acid; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The ooze scion can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Formless Grace
traits.description: If the ooze scion would take half damage due to succeeding on a saving throw while within 120 feet of Juiblex, it takes no damage instead.

traits.name: Acrimony of the Faceless Lord
traits.description: A creature that takes Acid damage while within 5 feet of one or more ooze scions takes an additional 4 (1d8) Acid damage for each ooze scion within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the ooze scion can grapple the target (escape DC 13).

reactions.name: Mitotic Division
reactions.description: When the ooze scion takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can create another Ooze Scion that acts on Juiblex's initiative in the nearest unoccupied space with maximum Hit Points equal to the original ooze scion's current Hit Points.

name: Juiblex
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +7, Con +13, Int +5, Wis +12, Cha +3
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing
immunities: Acid, Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned, Unconscious

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Juiblex can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Corrosive Horror
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of Juiblex has the attack bonus of any metal or organic nonartifact weapons it is wielding and the AC bonus of any metal or organic nonartifact armor it is wearing reduced by a permanent and cumulative 1.

traits.name: Heart of Chaos
traits.description: Melee attacks made by creatures grappled by Juiblex ignore its damage resistances and score a critical on a 16-20.

traits.name: Alter Form
traits.description: At the end of each of its turns, Juiblex can choose a shape for its body. Its new form may be centered on any space its previous form occupied: Fetid Pool. Juiblex becomes a 30-foot radius shallow pool of slime that can enter and occupy the space of any other creature, and frees each creature grappled by it. A creature that starts its turn in Juiblex's space takes 9 (2d8) Acid damage. Flowing Prison. Juiblex becomes a 15-foot diameter vortex, then each creature in Juiblex's space must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 22) in Juiblex's space, or pushed into the nearest unoccupied space on a success. Creatures grappled by Juiblex are Choking and take 18 (4d8) Acid damage at the start of each of Juiblex's turns. Towering Slime. Juiblex becomes a 10-foot diameter tower that is up to 40 feet tall. Melee attacks it makes have a reach of 40 feet and deal an additional 11 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Juiblex has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (5/day)
traits.description: If Juiblex fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Juiblex makes three melee attacks.

actions.name: Corrosive Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 20 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 27 (6d8) acid damage and the creature is dragged up to 10 feet toward Juiblex's center, or is Grappled (escape DC 22) if it can't be.

actions.name: Heaving Mass
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 10 ft. Hit: 40 (6d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Caustic Jet (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Juiblex expels a jet of slime in a 90-foot long, 10-foot wide line. Each creature in the area is pushed 15 feet away and must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or take 95 (10d8 + 50) Acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Blinding Excretion
reactions.description: When Juiblex is hit with a melee attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of Juiblex's next turn.

reactions.name: Birth Scion
reactions.description: When Juiblex takes 50 or more damage in a turn, it can create an Ooze Scion that acts on Juiblex's initiative in an unoccupied space within 15 feet.

reactions.name: Foul Spawning (1/Day)
reactions.description: When Juiblex is reduced below 304 Hit Points, it can create six Ooze Scions that act on Juiblex's initiative in unoccupied spaces within 15 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Assimilate
legendaryActions.description: Each creature grappled by Juiblex must succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence Saving Throw or have its Proficiency Bonus reduced by 1 until it completes a Short or Long Rest, and have Juiblex learn one secret the creature wishes to keep hidden. If the creature was an ooze scion, it dies and Juiblex gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the ooze scion's current Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Seething Vitriol
legendaryActions.description: Juiblex loses 11 (1d20) Hit Points and rolls to recharge its Caustic Jet.

legendaryActions.name: Stolen Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Juiblex casts a spell of 6th level or below with a casting time of 1 action known by a creature affected by its Assimilate in the last minute.

legendaryActions.name: Wheels Within Wheels (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: If Juiblex has not taken a turn this round, it takes its turn. If it does, it does not take a turn on its initative this round.

name: Kerzit
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +9, Con +12, Int +2, Wis +10, Cha +4
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Keeper of the Black Lore
traits.description: Kerzit's spirit is bound to the Tome of the Black Heart. If he is destroyed, whenever a creature dies within 30 feet of the tome he may make a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw. On a success, a rift forms in the creature's body and Kerzit tears forth from it in a new body with half his Hit Points. For the next minute, Kerzit can't use Legendary Resistances or Legendary Actions.

traits.name: Quick Squeeze
traits.description: Kerzit may move through any space larger than his skull without squeezing.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Kerzit has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
traits.description: If Kerzit fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Kerzit makes three attacks, one of which may be with his Black-Toothed Bite.

actions.name: Black-Toothed Bite
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or be infecting with Aldinach's Vile Wasting.

actions.name: Wormlash
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strengh saving throw or be pulled up to 5 feet towards Kerzit and grappled (escape DC 20).

actions.name: Chitinous Blades
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Halving Draw (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature grappled by both of Kerzit's Wormlashes must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or take 65 (10d12) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage dies and is ripped in two.

bonusActions.name: Rending Flurry
bonusActions.description: Kerzit makes two attacks with his Chitinous Blades against a creature grappled by him. If both attacks hit, the creature begins Bleeding (2d10).

bonusActions.name: Blightning Strike (Level 3 Spell)
bonusActions.description: One creature Kerzit can see within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Lightning damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is unaffected by the first source of healing it recives before the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Maddened Slaver
reactions.description: When Kerzit ends his turn without reducing a creature to 0 Hit Points, he can work himself into a fury, building up a frothing, foul smelling slaver around his jaws. Until the end of his next turn, Kerzit's melee attacks have Advantage and his speed is doubled.

legendaryActions.name: Weirding Glint (Concentration)
legendaryActions.description: Kerzit creates an illusory terrain feature that fits within a 15-foot radius centered on a point he can see within 60 feet. The terrain lasts for a minute, and Kerzit may interact with the illusion as though it were real. A creature other than Kerzit physically interacting with the terrain reveals it to be an illusion.

legendaryActions.name: Ignite Dweomer
legendaryActions.description: One creature kerzit can see that is concentrating on a spell must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or burst into flames and begin Burning (1d10).

legendaryActions.name: Brutal Charge (Cost 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Kerzit moves up to his speed in a straight line, and may move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature. A creature whose space Kerzit enters for the first time on a turn in this way must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away and knocked prone.

name: Lolth, Queen of the Demonweb
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +16, Con +17, Int +7, Wis +11, Cha +7
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned, Unconscious

traits.name: Nexus of the Great Web
traits.description: Lolth knows the location, identity, and current Hit Points of any creature in contact with a spider's web, and cannot be Surprised. She can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: By the Dark Mother's Design
traits.description: Lolth does not roll initiative. Instead, if she has not yet taken a turn this round, Lolth may take her turn directly after any other creature's turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Lolth has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
traits.description: If Lolth fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Lolth makes three attacks with her Impaling Legs, one of which she may replace with a use of her Kiss of Lolth or Insidious Embrace.

actions.name: Kiss of Lolth
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 15 ft. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage and the target is Cursed. While Cursed in this way, a creature is Poisoned, loses any immunity to the Poisoned condition or poison damage, and takes 5 (1d10) poison damage at the end of each of its turns. This curse is suppressed for 24 hours by any effect that cures the Poisoned condition.

actions.name: Impaling Legs
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 15 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage and Lolth may either grapple the target (escape DC 23) or push it 10 feet away. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage immediately fails a death saving throw.

actions.name: Insidious Embrace
actions.description: One creature within 15 feet of Lolth must succeed on a DC 23 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 23) in a cocoon of silk. While restrained in this way, a creature is Blinded and has its Charisma score reduced by 5 (2d4) at the end of each of its turns, which lasts until it escapes. A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 0 in this way immediately emerges as a Chwidencha under Lolth's control.

actions.name: Darkfire Abyss (Level 9 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A burst of black fire erupts in a 15-foot radius centered on a point Lolth can see within 120 feet, leaving behind an area of magical darkness that lasts until dispelled. Each light in the area is extinguished, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 70 (20d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success. At the start of each of Lolth's turns, if a source of Bright Light is within 15 feet of the area its radius expands by 5 feet, then each light in the area is extinguished and creature in the area takes 17 (5d6) Fire damage.

reactions.name: Strands of the Demonweave (Level 5 Spell)
reactions.description: When a creature she can see within 60 feet casts a spell, Lolth can weave a portion of the expended magic into threads of binding silk. Any damage dealt by the spell is reduced by half, and the spell's caster must succeed on a DC 23 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 23) until it takes any damage.

reactions.name: Compelled Betrayal
reactions.description: When Lolth is targeted with a ranged attack, she causes the attack to swerve and instead target a creature in the attack's range affected by her Kiss of Lolth.

legendaryActions.name: Bounding Strike
legendaryActions.description: Lolth leaps up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space, then makes a Impaling Legs attack.

legendaryActions.name: Bide Time
legendaryActions.description: Lolth moves up to half her speed and gains 20 Temporary Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Lolth's Fickle Favor (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: One friendly creature Lolth can see can use its reaction to move up to its speed and make an attack. If the attack misses, the creature explodes in a torrent of venomous spiders. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Spider's Embrace (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Lolth teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space she can see, then forces one creature within 5 feet to make a DC 23 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Grappled (escape DC 23) and Lolth makes an attack against it with her kiss of Lolth.

name: Miska the Wolf Spider
savingThrows: Str +13, Dex +11, Con +13, Int +4, Wis +5, Cha +13

traits.name: Archon of Carnage
traits.description: Whenever Miska reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, each Demon within 60 feet that can see him gains Advantage on attacks and ignores the effects of the Charmed and Frightened conditions until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Spiderkind
traits.description: Miska can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings or across webs, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Ichor Unchained (5/Day)
traits.description: If Miska would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead. The first time each turn a creature hits Miska with a melee attack, it takes 3 (1d6) Acid damage for each remaining use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Miska makes four attacks, two of which can be with his Chaos Tether.

actions.name: Fork of Havoc
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage. A creature killed by this damage explodes, dealing 22 (4d10) Fire damage to each creature in a 15-foot Emanation from it.

actions.name: Chaos Tether (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +13 range 120 ft. Hit: 28 (6d8) force damage, then the target and Miska must each make a Charisma Saving Throw. The creature with the lower result teleports to the nearest unoccupied space to the creature with the higher result.

actions.name: Scatterspell Bombardment (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: Miska launches a cascade of shimmering orbs in a 60-foot Cone that detonate as they hit the ground, forcing each creature in the area to make three Dexterity Saving Throws: DC 21. Failure: For each failed saving throw, the creature takes 14 (4d6) damage of one type of Miska's choice; Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.

actions.name: Demon Warp (Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Miska can see within 60 feet other than himself gains 150 Temporary Hit Points; while it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the creature is transformed into a Glabrezu Persecutor and is hostile to all creatures. An unwilling target can make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 21. Success: The creature gains no Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Wound Reality (1/Day, Concentration, Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: Miska carves a ragged tear in the fabric of the planes in a 10-foot long, 2-foot wide Line within 15 feet. When Miska casts this spell and at the start of each of his turns, each creature within 60 feet of the tear takes 22 (4d10) Force damage and is dragged up to 20 feet toward it. A creature that ends this movement within 5 feet of the tear must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: The creature is dragged into the Astral Plane. The creature can repeat this saving throw as an action, returning through the tear on a success.

bonusActions.name: Gush Venom
bonusActions.description: Each creature Grappled by Miska takes 14 (4d6) Poison damage. Then, if the creature is Bloodied, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: The creature is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Devour Essence
bonusActions.description: Miska kills a Fiend of CR 10 or below and devours it, regaining Hit Points equal to the Hit Points lost in this way.

bonusActions.name: Roar Forth Chaos (Recharges when Bloodied)
bonusActions.description: If Miska's Wound Reality is active, 3 (2d4 - 2) Spyder Fiend Kakkus that act on Initiative 0 emerge from the tear created by it, appearing in the nearest unoccupied spaces.

legendaryActions.name: Insatiable Maw
legendaryActions.description: Miska snaps at a creature within 10 feet, forcing it to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: 10 (3d6) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 21).

legendaryActions.name: Skittering Stomp
legendaryActions.description: Miska moves up to half his Speed, then can force one creature within 5 feet of him to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage and the creature falls Prone.

legendaryActions.name: Howl to Ruin (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Each other creature in a 20-foot Emanation from Miska must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: 18 (4d8) Psychic damage and the creature is Frightened until the end of its next turn. While Frightened in this way, the creature's melee attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) Force damage on a hit.

name: Orcus
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +10, Con +15, Int +5, Wis +13, Cha +7

traits.name: Master of the Dead and Deathless
traits.description: The area in a 30-foot Emanation from Orcus seethes with the raw magic of death and undeath. At the start of each of Orcus' turns, up to four Undead creatures in the area with 0 Hit Points each regain 1 Hit Point, then each enemy in the area takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: The Shadow That Was (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
traits.description: When Orcus is reduced to 0 Hit Points, he doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead, he resets to 324 Hit Points and rises as a shade from his body, gaining Vulnerability to Radiant damage and losing his Magic Resistance.

traits.name: Reclaim Anima (5/Day)
traits.description: If Orcus fails a saving throw, he can drain the animating force from one Demon or Undead ally within 30 feet to succeed instead, reducing the ally to 0 Hit Points. Orcus gains a +1 bonus to saving throws against spells and magical effects for each remaining use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Orcus makes two Soulshredder Claw attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Wand of Orcus or Bloodlord's Contempt, if available.

actions.name: Soulshredder Claw
actions.description: Attack: +16 reach 10 ft. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage plus Hit: 22 (4d10) psychic damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 24). A creature killed by this damage can't be returned to life by any means short of a Wish spell.

actions.name: The Wand of Orcus
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 75 (10d10 + 20) necrotic damage plus one of the following effects: Vile Rupture. The creature must make a {{font-variant:small-caps **Constitution Saving**}} {{font-variant:small-caps **Throw:**}} DC 21. {{font-variant:small-caps **Failure:**}} One of the creature's eyes ruptures in a gout of vitreous fluid. Black Iron Bloodwell. The creature must make a {{font-variant:small-caps **Constitution**}} {{font-variant:small-caps **Saving**}} {{font-variant:small-caps **Throw:**}} DC 21. {{font-variant:small-caps **Failure:**}} The target loses half of its current Hit Points as blood evacuates from each of its orifices, then gains a point of Exhaustion if it has fewer than 10 Hit Points remaining. Curse of Living Bones. The creature is Cursed for 1 minute; if the creature dies while Cursed, a **Skeletal Liberator** that acts on Initiative 0 immediately tears free of its flesh. {{font-variant:small-caps **Charisma Saving Throw:**}} DC 21. {{font-variant:small-caps **Failure:**}}

actions.name: Bloodlord's Contempt (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature of Orcus' choice that he can see within 60 feet gains a Doom Counter that lasts for 1 hour, then must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: The creature takes 25 Necrotic damage for each Doom Counter it has. When a creature drops to 0 Hit Points, it immediately fails one Death Saving Throw for each Doom Counter it has.

reactions.name: Waste Not
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 10 feet that is affected by Orcus' Curse of Living Bones dies. Response: Orcus animates the creature's flesh and blood, creating a Bloodrot Ooze and a Skin Kite that act on Initiative 0.

legendaryActions.name: Spectral Call
legendaryActions.description: A Voidsoul Specter that lasts for one minute and acts on Initiative 0 spills forth from Orcus' wand, appearing in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of him.

legendaryActions.name: Spiteful Command
legendaryActions.description: One CR 10-or-lower Undead ally of Orcus' within 60 feet can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed and make a melee attack.

legendaryActions.name: Graveway Travel (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Orcus turns to dust and crumbles away, then bursts from the earth in an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of the space he departed must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: The creature is Blinded until the end of Orcus' next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: The Final Word (Level 10 Spell, Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Orcus and one other creature he can see within 60 feet must each make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: The target dies.

name: Pazuzu
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +18, Con +16, Int +6, Wis +4, Cha +16
immunities: Lightning, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks, Damage from falling; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Evangel of the Four Winds
traits.description: Creatures with a fly speed within 300 feet of Pazuzu may Dash or Disengage as a Bonus Action, and have Disadvantage on attacks made against him.

traits.name: Perfidious Aid
traits.description: When another creature that Pazuzu can see fails a saving throw, he may allow it to reroll the save, taking the second result. If it does, the creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage as a Mark of Corruption sears itself into the creature's flesh.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Pazuzu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Madness of the Lower Aerie (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
traits.description: When Pazuzu is reduced to 0 Hit Points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, he resets to 291 Hit Points and each creature with a Mark of Corruption explosively sprouts a number of ragged, bloody wings, losing half its current Hit Points and gaining a fly speed equal to its movement speed.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
traits.description: If Pazuzu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Pazuzu makes three attacks with his Spear of the Stolen Winds.

actions.name: Spear of the Stolen Winds
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 15 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage and the target suffers one of the following effects: Wind of Dreams. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or be launched up to 30 feet in any direction, and be magically unaffected by gravity until the start of its next turn. Wind of Awakening. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma Saving Throw or gain vulnerability to damage from falling until the end of the turn and have each spell and magical effect on it end.

actions.name: Heartrot Tail Sting
actions.description: One creature within 10 feet of Pazuzu must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution Saving Throw or take 54 (12d8) Necrotic damage plus 42 (12d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Pestilent Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Pazuzu exhales a plague of abyssal locusts in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area loses concentration, if it was holding it, and must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) Piercing damage plus 28 (8d6) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Devouring Rain (Recharges when Pazuzu uses his Pestilent Breath, Level 9 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: An acrid rain begins to fall in a 15-foot radius, 300-foot tall cylinder centered on a point Pazuzu can see within 300 feet. A creature that starts its turn in the area, or that enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or take 44 (8d10) Acid damage, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this damage melts and is disintegrated.

reactions.name: Feign Weakness (Recharges when Pazuzu voluntarily fails a saving throw)
reactions.description: When Pazuzu fails a saving throw, he can fall prone. If a creature enters his reach before the start of his next turn, Pazuzu may immediately stand from prone and make a melee attack against it.

reactions.name: Bloodied Corruption (1/Day, Level 6 Spell)
reactions.description: When Pazuzu's mythic trait becomes active, he can force one creature he can see with a Mark of Corruption to succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Dominated by him. The Dominated creature repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Favorable Currents
legendaryActions.description: One creature with a fly speed that Pazuzu can see can use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a melee attack.

legendaryActions.name: Traveling Storm
legendaryActions.description: Pazuzu moves the effect of his Devouring Rain up to 30 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Wind of Folly
legendaryActions.description: One creature Pazuzu can see must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 30 feet in any direction. A creature with a Mark of Corruption has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Wind of the Amorites (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Pazuzu moves up to his speed and uses his multiattack.

name: Yeenoghu
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +10, Con +13, Int +2, Wis +14, Cha +2
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning. Attacks made without Advantage
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Seething Fury
traits.description: When Yeenoghu has the Incapacitated condition end for him, he can immediately move up to his speed and take an action.

traits.name: Ravenous Beyond Reckoning
traits.description: When Yeenoghu reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points with his Unhinged Jaws, he gains 20 Temporary Hit Points and can begin to swallow the creature whole. Until the beginning of Yeenoghu's next turn, attacks against him have Advantage, and regurgitates the creature if a critical hit is struck against him. At the beginning of Yeenoghu's next turn, the target dies and is Swallowed, and cannot be retrieved while Yeenoghu lives.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: A creature within 5 feet of Yeenoghu may spend half of its movement to attempt to climb onto him with a successful DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. Attacks made against Yeenoghu by a creature climbing on them have Advantage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Yeenoghu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
traits.description: If Yeenoghu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Yeenoghu makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with his Unhinged Jaws.

actions.name: Unhinged Jaws
actions.description: Attack: +16 reach 5 ft. Hit: 31 (4d10 + 9) piercing damage and the creature is Grappled (escape DC 24). A creature already grappled in this way takes an additional 5 (1d10) Piercing damage.

actions.name: The Butcherflail
actions.description:
Attack: +16 reach 15 ft. Hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage and the target suffers one additional effect of Yeenoghu's choice:
*

actions.name: Hunger
actions.description:
The target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or lose three unexpended hit dice. If the target cannot, it instead takes a level of exhaustion.
*

actions.name: Pain
actions.description:
The target takes an additional 11 (2d10) Psychic damage.
*

actions.name: Terror
actions.description:
The target must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more is instead Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
*

actions.name: Decay
actions.description: If the target is wearing nonmagical armor, it suffers a permanent and cumulative -1 to the AC it offers.

actions.name: Path of The Lord of Ruin (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Yeenoghu moves up to his speed in a straight line and can move through the space of any construct of force and of any creature smaller than Huge. Each creature whose space he moves through in this way must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or and take 52 (8d12) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success. A creature that succeeds by 5 or more stops this movement from continuing past it.

reactions.name: Gorecall
reactions.description: When Yeenoghu is hit with a ranged attack, he can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled 20 feet toward him and knocked prone.

reactions.name: Deiphage Spawning (1/Day)
reactions.description: When Yeenoghu is reduced below 283 Hit Points, create six Gnoll Deathpleged within his body, which immediately chew their way out of his wounds and fall prone in the nearest unoccupied spaces. If he does, Yeenoghu loses 27 (6d8) Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Blood Feast
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 30 feet that has fewer than half of its Hit Points must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or be marked as prey. For the next minute, or until the creature regains any Hit Points, gnolls may use their Bonus action to make a Bite attack against it.

legendaryActions.name: Flesh Craze
legendaryActions.description: Up to three gnolls within 60 feet may each use their reaction to move up to their speed toward a creature of Yeenoghu's choice without provoking attacks of opportunity.

legendaryActions.name: Wake Bones
legendaryActions.description: One friendly gnoll within 60 feet becomes suffused with negative energy, taking 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage. If the target dies in the next minute, its flesh sloughs off and it immediately rises as a Witherling Death Shrieker.

name: Zuggtmoy
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +9, Con +11, Int +5, Wis +11, Cha +7
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Creeping Mycelia
traits.description: When a creature ends its turn within 10 feet of Zuggtmoy, she may extend a tendril of mycelia from the ground, forcing the creature to succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or be grappled in place (escape DC 21). While grappled in this way, a creature is Charmed by Zuggtmoy and takes 11 (2d10) poison damage at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Demonrot Toxin
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of Zuggtmoy must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or lose any Resistance or Immunity to poison or disease that it has for the next 24 hours and be unable to gain Resistance or Immunity to poison or disease until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Zuggtmoy has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
traits.description: If Zuggtmoy fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Zuggtmoy makes two attacks with her Queen's Caress, one of which she may replace with her Sprouting Doom or Rotted Regenesis.

actions.name: Queen's Caress
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) necrotic damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) poison damage and the target has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws until the end of Zuggtmoy's next turn.

actions.name: Sprouting Doom
actions.description: A roiling growth of multifarious fungus that lasts for a minute bursts forth in a 5-foot radius centered on a point Zuggtmoy can see within 120 feet. The area is difficult terrain for nonplant creatures, and a nonplant creature that starts its turn in the area takes 20 poison damage. This effect ends if the area is dealt 20 or more fire or radiant damage from a single source.

actions.name: Rotted Regenesis
actions.description: Zuggtmoy's body rapidly blackens and withers, then explodes in a cloud of spores. Each nonplant creature within 10 feet of her must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) poison damage, or half as much on a success. Zuggtmoy reappears in an unoccupied space affected by Sprouting Doom, forming a new body from the fungi there.

actions.name: Burrowing Sporeflood (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Zuggtmoy's torso distends and splits, expelling a torrent of flesh-burrowing spores in a 60-foot cone. Each nonplant creature in the area must make a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 35 (10d6) Piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) poison damage and is infected with Brittle Lung, or takes half as much damage on a successful save.

actions.name: Garden of Rot and Ruin (1/Day, Level 9 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Each area affected by Sprouting Doom within 120 feet of Zuggtmoy releases a cloud of hallucinogenic spores in a 30-foot radius centered on itself that lasts until the area is destroyed or Zuggtmoy loses concentration. The area is heavily obscured, and each nonplant creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the start of its next turn. While Poisoned in this way, a creature treats all creatures it is not Charmed by as hostile.

reactions.name: Rot Mother's Rebirth
reactions.description: When one or more creatures die within 60 feet of Zuggtmoy, she can raise each of them under her control with 20 Hit Points. The creatures' type becomes plant/undead.

reactions.name: Consumptive Bloom
reactions.description: When Zuggtmoy is targeted with an attack or spell, she can kill one friendly plant creature within 30 feet of her. If she does, she immediately uses her Rotted Regenesis.

legendaryActions.name: Sprouting Doom
legendaryActions.description: Zuggtmoy uses her Sprouting Doom.

legendaryActions.name: Feast on the Fallen
legendaryActions.description: A carpet of fungal growths spreads over one prone creature Zuggtmoy can see within 30 feet and takes root in its flesh. Until a creature clears them as an action, whenever the affected creature would receive any amount magical healing it instead receives half as much.

legendaryActions.name: Cultivator's Reap
legendaryActions.description: Zuggtmoy moves up to half her speed. If she ends this movement within 10 feet of a friendly plant creature, it loses half its current Hit Points and Zuggtmoy gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points lost.

legendaryActions.name: Breed Ruin (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Zuggtmoy creates a Deathbloom Sporocyte in an unoccupied space affected by Sprouting Doom.

name: White Abishai
savingThrows: Str +6, Con +7, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Dragonspawn Exultation
traits.description: When a dragon within 60 feet that the abishai can see uses a breath weapon, the abishai gains Advantage on melee attacks it makes until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The abishai has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The abishai makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Bloodchill Bite.

actions.name: Bloodchill Bite
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Frostsheathed Talonblade
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing plus Hit: 3 (1d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Brutal Claw
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage. A Medium or smaller target hit with this attack must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target gains the Prone condition.

bonusActions.name: Whirlwind of Carnage
bonusActions.description: If the abishai missed with a melee weapon attack this turn, it can make an attack using the same weapon against a different target.

bonusActions.name: Dragonshadow (Level 2 Spell<!-- Bonus Action -->)
bonusActions.description: *A fearsome shadow descends.* Each creature in a 15-foot radius centered on a point the abishai can see within 120 feet. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The creature uses its reaction to move half its Speed in a direction of the abishai's choice, or gains the Prone condition if it can't do so.

name: Black Abishai
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +6, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +6

traits.name: Dragonspawn Exultation
traits.description: When a dragon within 60 feet that the abishai can see uses a breath weapon, the abishai gains Advantage on melee attacks it makes until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The abishai has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The abishai makes four attacks, one of which can be with its Dragonglass Tailspine.

actions.name: Twinslash Talonblades
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. A creature hit with this attack for the second time in a turn must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target gains the Bleeding (1d6) condition.

actions.name: Dragonglass Tailspine
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing plus Hit: 9 (2d8) acid damage. Any hit with this attack against a creature the abishai was Hidden from becomes a critical.

bonusActions.name: Blackstride (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
bonusActions.description: The abishai creates a 5-foot radius zone of Magical Darkness centered on a space it can see within 60 feet, then can teleport to an unoccupied space within it. For the next minute, the abishai can repeat this effect at the beginning of each of its turns.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.description: If it is not illuminated by Bright Light, the abishai can attempt to Hide.

name: Green Abishai
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +3, Con +3, Int +7, Wis +1, Cha +8

traits.name: Dragonspawn Exultation
traits.description: When a dragon within 60 feet that the abishai can see uses a breath weapon, the abishai gains Advantage on melee attacks it makes until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Insidious Presence
traits.description: The abishai is Invisible to creatures that are Poisoned or Frightened.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The abishai has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The abishai makes three attacks with its Sickening Claw, one of which it can replace with its Soulfang Bite, Deadly Image, or Venomous End, if available.

actions.name: Soulfang Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 16 (3d10) poison damage. For the next minute, the target treats any immunity that it has to poison damage as resistance, and loses any immunity it has to the Poisoned condition.

actions.name: Sickening Claw
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage and the target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target is Poisoned for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Deadly Image (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The abishai creates an illusory creature or effect that fits within a 20-foot Cube and extends to all senses, appearing in a space it can see within 120 feet. Once on each of its turns, the abishai can move the effect up to 30 feet, then force one creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 18 (4d8) Psychic damage. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw, or that uses its action to disbelieve the illusion with a successful DC 16 Intelligence (Investigation) check, becomes immune to its effects and can see through it.

actions.name: Venomous End (Recharge 6, Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: The abishai magically strengthens the toxins afflicting a Poisoned creature it can see within 60 feet, dealing 50 Poison damage to it. A creature reduced below 50 Hit Points by this damage must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target gains the Paralyzed condition for as long as it remains Poisoned.

bonusActions.name: Incite Panic (Level 3 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The abishai whispers fears into the mind of a creature it can see within 60 feet, forcing it to succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target is Frightened by each creature of the abishai's choice until the end of the abishai's next turn. While Frightened in this way, a creature treats all creatures it can see as hostile.

bonusActions.name: Dragonsguise (Level 5 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The abishai touches a willing creature, transforming it into a humanoid form until dispelled. This effect ends early if the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points, or if it ends this effect as a Bonus Action.

name: Blue Abishai
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +8, Con +3, Int +12, Wis +12, Cha +4

traits.name: Dragonspawn Exultation
traits.description: When a dragon within 60 feet that the abishai can see uses a breath weapon, the abishai gains Advantage on melee attacks it makes until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The abishai has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The abishai makes two attacks with its Bluefire Claw or Crackling Doom, one of which it can replace with a use of its Weave Mirage or Lightning Cage.

actions.name: Bluefire Claw
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) Slashing plus Hit: 14 (4d6) lightning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Crackling Doom (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +12, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (8d8) Lightning damage. Additionally on a hit, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal Lightning damage until the end of the abishai's next turn.

actions.name: Weave Mirage (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The abishai cloaks itself in waves of shimmering air for 1 minute. Whenever a creature that can see the abishai makes an attack against it or casts a spell that targets it, the abishai can force it to make a Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The abishai is unaffected.

actions.name: Lightning Cage (Level 6 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description:
A sheet of continuous lightning rises to the sky, encasing a 20-foot radius Cylinder centered on a point the abishai can see for 1 minute. A creature in the wall's space when it appears, that enters the wall's space for the first time on a turn, or that ends its turn there must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 28 (8d6) Lightning damage and the creature is pushed up to 20 feet to a side of the abishai's choice.
 Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Devastation Cascade (Level 8 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The abishai calls down six lightning bolts in rapid sequence to strike at targets it can see within 300 feet. For each lightning bolt directed at it, a creature must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 29 (2d8 + 20) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Shimmering Escape
reactions.description: Trigger: The abishai is missed with an attack or unaffected by a spell that targeted it. Response: The abishai teleports up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

name: Red Abishai
savingThrows: Str +12, Dex +3, Con +10, Int +2, Wis +8, Cha +4

traits.name: Power of the Dragon Queen
traits.description: The commands of the abishai carry with them the authority of Tiamat. A chromatic dragon takes 55 (10d10) Psychic damage the first time each turn it willingly disobeys a command of the abishai, then must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition for 1 hour.

traits.name: Dragonspawn Exultation
traits.description: When a dragon within 60 feet that the abishai can see uses a breath weapon, the abishai gains Advantage on melee attacks it makes until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The abishai has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Terrorstrike Scepter
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning plus Hit: 9 (2d8) psychic damage. This attack scores a Critical Hit on an 18-20 against a Grappled or Frightened target.
