reactions.description: Trigger: Zariel makes a saving throw against a spell cast by a creature she can see. Response: Zariel voluntarily fails the saving throw, then can move up to half her Speed toward the spell's caster and make a melee attack against it. *Fury Unleashed (1/Day)*. *A mad scream of inchoate rage and flame rings out.* Trigger: Zariel becomes Bloodied. Response: For one minute, attacks made by and against Zariel have Advantage.

legendaryActions.name: Beacon of Hatred
legendaryActions.description: Zariel moves up to half her Speed and makes a melee attack, then up to one other Devil can use its Reaction to make a melee attack against the same target.

legendaryActions.name: Beacon of Contempt
legendaryActions.description: Zariel moves up to half her Speed and makes a melee attack. She can move through any creations of magical force with this movement, shattering them as she passes through.

legendaryActions.name: Beacon of Hellfire
legendaryActions.description: Zariel moves up to half her Speed and makes a melee attack, then up to two trenches created with her Earthgouger Claw erupt with flames. Each creature within 5 feet of one or more of them takes 16 (3d10) Fire damage.

name: Dispater, Lord of the Second
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +10, Con +12, Int +13, Wis +14, Cha +6
immunities: Fire, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Lord of the Second
traits.description: Dispater and Devils under his control ignore the effects of Disadvantage and can take two Reactions each round.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Dispater has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Infernal Mastery (5/Day)
traits.description: When Dispater would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed. If he does, he or one friendly Devil within 30 feet loses 25 Hit Points. If a Devil is killed in this way, Dispater immediately regains a use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Dispater makes two attacks with his Rod of the Banded Citadel, one of which he can replace with a use of his Rust-Wrought Ruin or Burning Tower Art.

actions.name: Rod of the Banded Citadel
actions.description:
Attack: +13 reach 5 ft., Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage. A creature hit with this attack for the second time on a turn must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 21.
Failure: The target is knocked Prone.
Failure by 5 or More: The target takes an additional 11 (2d10) Force damage and is Dazed until the end of its next turn. A Prone target has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Rust-Wrought Ruin (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description:
Dispater disintegrates one nonmagical metal object he can see within 60 feet into a flurry of razor flakes. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation from the target object must make a
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21.
Failure: 21 (6d6) Slashing damage and the target begins Bleeding (2d6).

actions.name: Burning Tower Art (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description:
A 100-foot tall, 10-foot radius Column of red-hot iron crashes down in a space within 300 feet; each creature in its space is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space, then must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21.
Failure: 36 (8d8) Bludgeoning plus 14 (4d6) Fire damage and the creature is knocked Prone.
Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Black Iron Bloom (Recharge 5-6, Level 9 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description:
*Veins of iron slither and spread, corrupting at a touch.* 30-foot Emanation from Dispater. A creature that starts its turn in the area must make a
Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21.
Failure: One of the creature's limbs of its choice turns to iron, suffering Limb Damage and counting as a nonmagical metal object for the spell's duration. If the creature can't have a limb turn to iron, it instead is Petrified until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reactions.name: Untouchable Defense
reactions.description:
Trigger: A creature Dispater can see ends its turn within 30 feet of him.
Response: Dispater teleports up to 15 feet directly away from it.

reactions.name: Prepared Contingency (Recharges when Dispater is Bloodied)
reactions.description:
Trigger: A creature within 500 feet takes any hostile action against Dispater.
Response: Dispater negates that action's effects, revealing a way in which he perfectly prepared in advance for that outcome.

legendaryActions.name: Obdurate Advance
legendaryActions.description:
One Column created with Dispater's Iron Tower Art moves up to 30 feet in a straight line. Each creature within 5 feet of where it ends this movement must make a
Strength Saving Throw: DC 21.
Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the Column.

legendaryActions.name: Weight of Evil
legendaryActions.description:
*Miseeds made manifest, a mounting weight.* One Prone creature Dispater can see within 60 feet.
Strength Saving Throw: DC 21.
Failure: 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage. A creature treats this save DC as 5 lower if it is Neutral-aligned, or as 10 lower if it is Good-aligned.

legendaryActions.name: Raise Rod (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Dispater raises his Rod of the Banded Citadel and gravity increases in a 15-foot Emanation around him, making the area Difficult Terrain until the start of his next turn. When a creature enters this area, Dispater can end this effect, then use his Reaction to move up to his Speed directly toward it and make two melee attacks against it.

name: Mammon, Lord of the Third
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +11, Con +16, Int +6, Wis +15, Cha +15

traits.name: Lord of the Third
traits.description: Whenever a creature reduces a Devil under Mammon's control to 0 Hit Points with a spell, GP equal to that Devil's maximum Hit Points teleport out of that creature's possession and into Mammon's vaults.

traits.name: Gospel of Mammon
traits.description: Whenever a creature within 60 feet of Mammon heals or grants Advantage to one of its allies, it takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. Whenever a creature in the area deals damage to one of its allies, it gains an equal amount of Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Infernal Mastery (5/Day)
traits.description: When Mammon would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed. If he does, he or one friendly Devil within 30 feet loses 25 Hit Points. If a Devil is killed in this way, Mammon immediately regains a use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Mammon makes two attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Dispossess or Blackglass Skewer.

actions.name: His Most Covetous Claw
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (3d10 + 9) force damage, plus an additional Hit: 3 (1d6) fire damage for each 1,000 GP worth of currency the target owns, to a maximum of 35 (10d6) additional Fire damage.

actions.name: Dispossess (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Mammon can see within 60 feet. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The target becomes unattuned to one magic item of its choice that it is attuned to. Failure by 5 or More: The target becomes unattuned to each magic item it is attuned to. Each item unattuned in this way teleports into Mammon's space.

actions.name: Blackglass Skewer (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: *A barbed spear of obsidian thrusts forth, gripping where it strikes.* One creature Mammon can see within 120 feet. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 69 (6d12 + 30) Piercing damage and Mammon can drag the target any distance toward him. Success: Half Damage.

actions.name: Blood Covenant (Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: Mammon touches a creature within 10 feet, Cursing it. Whenever the Cursed creature deals damage to Mammon, Mammon can deal twice as much Psychic damage to it. If he does, the creature can make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 23. Success: The curse ends.

actions.name: Bind in Gold (Recharge 5-6, Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: Molten gold swirls to engulf a creature Mammon can see within 60 feet, dealing 55 (10d10) Fire damage to it and forcing it to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The target is Restrained (escape DC 23). While Restrained in this way, a creature is Blinded, Suffocating, and Burning (5d10). A creature killed by this damage is Petrified.

reactions.name: Succumb to Plenty
reactions.description: Trigger: An enemy Mammon can see within 60 feet regains any Hit Points. Response: The creature regains twice as many Hit Points and is Charmed by Mammon until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Slithering Cringe
reactions.description: Trigger: Mammon takes 20 or more damage from a single source. Response: Mammon moves half his Speed directly away from the damage's source.

legendaryActions.name: Cruel Custom
legendaryActions.description: Mammon moves up to half his Speed and makes a melee attack. If this attack hits an ally of his, he regains a use of his Infernal Mastery.

legendaryActions.name: Wages of Sin
legendaryActions.description: Mammon or one Devil under his control within 5 feet takes 21 (6d6) Psychic damage, then immediately becomes attuned to a magic item Mammon is carrying.

legendaryActions.name: Miser's Due (2/Day)
legendaryActions.description: Mammon summons a Narzugon Oathchained that acts on his Initiative to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet. At the end of each of Mammon's turns, he can dismiss a narzugon summoned in this way to regain a use of this ability.

name: Levistus, Lord of the Fifth
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +15, Con +14, Int +8, Wis +15, Cha +16
immunities: Cold, Fire, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Lord of the Fifth
traits.description: Devils under Levistus' control are immune to Cold damage, and can burrow through ice at half their Speed.

traits.name: Curse of the Vault
traits.description: At the start of each of his turns, if Levistus has fewer than 100 Temporary Hit Points he gains 20 cumulative Temporary Hit Points as magical ice envelops him. While he has any of these Temporary Hit Points, he can't take Reactions. While he has 40 or more of these Temporary Hit Points, he is Restrained and can't cast spells or Concentrate.

traits.name: Prince of Betrayal
traits.description: Levistus has Advantage on attacks against a creature within 5 feet of either one of its allies or a creature Charmed or by him.

traits.name: Infernal Mastery (5/Day)
traits.description: When Levistus would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed. If he does, he or one friendly Devil within 30 feet loses 25 Hit Points. If a Devil is killed in this way, Levistus immediately regains a use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Levistus makes two melee attacks, one of which he may replace with a use of his Iced Earth.

actions.name: Frost-Fair Ã‰pée
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) piercing damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) cold damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. On a hit or miss, the target suffers one additional effect of Levistus Choice: Bladebeat. The creature's AC is reduced by 2 until the start of its next turn. Staccato Remise. The creature takes 13 (3d8) Piercing damage. Second Intent. The next attack Levistus makes against the same target before the start of his next turn has Advantage.

actions.name: Iced Earth (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Whenever another creature within 5 feet of Levistus is hit with a melee attack, it must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature falls Prone.

actions.name: Flesh to Ice (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Levistus can see within 60 feet. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 36 (8d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage freezes solid, becoming Petrified until it takes any Fire damage, or until it is cured with Greater Restoration or similar magic.

actions.name: Freeze the Blood (Recharge 5-6, Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: *Hate's cold knives scar the soul.* One creature Levistus can see within 60 feet. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature takes 5 (2d4) points of Exhaustion. Success: The creature takes half as many points of Exhaustion.

reactions.name: Passata Sotto
reactions.description: *A nimble dive, faster than thought.* Trigger: Levistus is targeted with a melee attack. Response: Levistus imposes Disadvantage on the attack. If the attack misses, he can make a melee attack as part of this Reaction.

reactions.name: Spell Parry
reactions.description: Trigger: Levistus is targeted with a spell. Response: Levistus makes a melee attack roll against the caster's spell save DC. On a success, Levistus is unaffected by the spell.

reactions.name: Bloodied Vigor (1/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: Levistus becomes Bloodied. Response: For 1 minute, Levistus gains two additional Legendary Actions on each of his turns.

legendaryActions.name: Graceful Advance
legendaryActions.description: Levistus moves up to half his Speed. Opportunity Attacks provoked by this movement have Disadvantage.

legendaryActions.name: Offer Aid
legendaryActions.description: One creature with 0 Hit Points within 5 feet of Levistus regains 20 Hit Points and stands from Prone, then must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature is Dominated until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Induce Paranoia
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 60 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature can't count as an ally or willing target for 1 minute.

legendaryActions.name: Spirited Exchange (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Levistus makes two attacks with his Frost-Fair Ã‰pée. If any of these attacks miss, one creature may use its reaction to make an Opportunity Attack against him.

legendaryActions.name: Suppress Curse (Costs 2 Actions, Concentration)
legendaryActions.description: Levistus suppresses the effect of one spell or magical effect within 30 feet for as long as he maintains Concentration.

name: Belial, Lord of the Fourth
savingThrows: Str +14, Dex +10, Con +13, Int +6, Wis +13, Cha +9

traits.name: Lord of the Fourth
traits.description: The first time each turn that an allied Devil within 30 feet dies, Belial gains one additional Legendary Action that he can use before the end of his next turn. If Fierna is reduced to 0 Hit Points, Belial gains one additional Legendary Action on each of his turns for the next hour.

traits.name: Infernal Mastery (3/Day)
traits.description: When Belial would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed. If he does, he or one friendly Devil within 30 feet loses 25 Hit Points. If a Devil is killed in this way, Belial immediately regains a use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Belial makes two attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Vicious Reap or Lava Geyser.

actions.name: Ishlech, the Blighted Pike
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 5 ft. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away, plus one of the following effects. Tremble. On a hit, the target takes an additional 10 Psychic damage. Wither. On a hit, if the target has no points of Exhaustion, it gains one point of Exhaustion. Sunder. On a hit or miss, the target's AC is reduced by 2 until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Vicious Reap
actions.description: Belial leaps up to 20 feet, then can force each creature in a 15-foot Cone extending from him to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: 22 (4d10) Slashing damage and the creature is pushed up to 15 feet away. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Lava Geyser (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: A torrent of lava spews up from the earth in a 60-foot high, 15-foot radius Column. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: 33 (6d10) Fire damage and the creature is knocked Prone. Success: Half damage. For the next minute, any creature that ends its turn on the ground in the area or steps onto it for the first time on a turn must make the same saving throw.

actions.name: Seal of Tyranny (1/Day, Level 9 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature Belial can see within 60 feet is Dominated by him. At the start of each of the creature's turns, it can make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: The creature takes 27 (6d8) Psychic damage, and Belial gains an equal number of Temporary Hit Points. Success: The effect ends for the creature.

reactions.name: Cling to Power
reactions.description: Trigger: Belial makes a saving throw to maintain Concentration. Response: Belial makes the saving throw with Advantage, then gains Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration until the start of his next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Blighted Strike
legendaryActions.description: Belial moves up to half his Speed and can make a melee attack.

legendaryActions.name: Insidious Shroud
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 60 feet gains the Invisible condition until the end of its next turn or until it takes any hostile action, then can move up to half its Speed.

legendaryActions.name: Unworthy Allotment (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Each allied Devil within 30 feet that has all of its Hit Points gains 15 Temporary Hit Points.

name: Fierna, Lord of the Fourth
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +14, Con +13, Int +6, Wis +13, Cha +16

traits.name: Lord of the Fourth
traits.description: The first time each turn that an allied Devil within 30 feet dies, Fierna gains one additional Legendary Action that she can use before the end of her next turn. If Belial is reduced to 0 Hit Points, Fierna gains one additional Legendary Action on each of her turns for the next hour.

traits.name: Infernal Mastery (3/Day)
traits.description: When Fierna would fail a saving throw, she can choose to succeed. If she does, she or one friendly Devil within 30 feet loses 25 Hit Points. If a Devil is killed in this way, Fierna immediately regains a use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Fierna makes three melee attacks, one of which she can replace with a use of her Wrack or Hurl Meteor.

actions.name: Glire, the Profane Flame
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage and Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage, plus one of the following effects: Slash. This attack gains a 15-foot reach. Sear. On a hit, the target begins Burning (1d10), or has its Burning Value increased by 1d10 if it was already Burning. Scar. If the target is Bloodied, its Hit Point maximum is reduced to half its normal amount.

actions.name: Wrack (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Fierna can see within 60 feet must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: The target falls Prone and can't stand on its following turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target additionally subtracts 1d4 from any d20 Tests it makes in the next minute.

actions.name: Hurl Meteor (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +16 range 150 ft. Hit: 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 35 (10d6) fire damage. Against a target at lower elevation than Fierna, this attack has Advantage and pushes the target up to 15 feet away on a hit.

actions.name: Marrowflame Candle (Recharge 5-6, Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Fierna can see within 60 feet must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: The target is Cursed. Whenever the Cursed creature takes any Fire damage, its Burning Value increases by 1d10. If the Burning condition would end for the Burning creature, it must repeat this saving throw. Failure: The Burning condition does not end.

reactions.name: Burning Emergence
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 60 feet takes any Fire damage. Response: Fierna teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it, then each creature in a 10-foot Emanation from her begins Burning (1d10).

legendaryActions.name: Cruel Edict
legendaryActions.description: Up to two allies of Fierna's that she can see within 60 feet each make one melee attack under her control. For each of these attacks that misses, the attacker takes 5 (1d10) Psychic damage and Fierna gains an equal number of Temporary Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Cinderspring Dance (Level 4 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: One creature Fierna can see within 120 feet teleports up to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of it, then it and each creature in a 5-foot Emanation from it takes 11 (2d10) Fire damage. An unwilling creature can make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 24. Success: The creature resists the effect.

legendaryActions.name: Clatter of the Damned (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Fierna conjures two Blazing Bones that act on her Initiative in unoccupied spaces she can see within 60 feet. While within 30 feet of her, they have Advantage on attacks against Burning targets.

name: Glasya, Lord of the Sixth
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +14, Con +13, Int +8, Wis +15, Cha +10
immunities: Fire, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Lord of the Sixth
traits.description: Allied Devils within 500 feet can't be Charmed or Frightened, and can use Glasya's bonus to Wisdom and Charisma Saving Throws, instead of their own.

traits.name: Intoxicating Presence
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of Glasya must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: The creature is Charmed until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Scornful Gaze
traits.description: Glasya learns the greatest desires, doubts, fears, and insecurities of any creature that meets her gaze.

traits.name: Infernal Mastery (5/Day)
traits.description: When Glasya would fail a saving throw, she can choose to succeed. If she does, she or one friendly Devil within 30 feet loses 25 Hit Points. If a Devil is killed in this way, Glasya immediately regains a use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Glasya makes two melee attacks, each of which she can replace with the Dash, Dodge, or Hide action.

actions.name: Nettle
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage plus Hit: 27 (6d8) poison damage and Hit: 33 (6d10) psychic damage.

actions.name: Vile Embrace
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 5 ft. Hit: Glasya becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 22). While she is Attached to a creature Charmed by her, the creature is additionally Dominated.

actions.name: Word of Dismissal (Level 8 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature Glasya can see within 60 feet must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: The creature is banished to the outer void until the end of its next turn, at which point it returns to the nearest unoccupied space to the one it departed. A creature that starts its turn in the outer void takes 105 (10d10 + 50) Force damage. A creature killed by this damage is rent asunder, cast across the void, and does not return.

actions.name: Name Champion (Recharge 5-6, Level 9 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Glasya attempts to infuse a creature Charmed by her with vast infernal power, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: The creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Success: The creature is Dominated by Glasya for as long as she maintains Concentration, and acts on her Initiative in addition to its own. A creature with a Wisdom score of 1 succeeds automatically on this saving throw.

reactions.name: Torn Loyalty
reactions.description: Trigger: Glasya is targeted with a spell or attack. Response: One creature within 5 feet that is Charmed by her becomes the target of the spell or attack.

reactions.name: Bloodied Naming (1/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: Glasya becomes Bloodied. Response: Glasya can roll to recharge her Name Champion, then immediately use it, if available.

legendaryActions.name: Innocent Request
legendaryActions.description: One creature Charmed by Glasya's Intoxicating Presence moves up to half its Speed and makes a melee weapon attack under her control.

legendaryActions.name: Beguiling Whisper
legendaryActions.description: One creature Glasya is Attached to must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: The creature's Wisdom score is reduced by 3 (1d6) until it completes a Short or Long rest, to a minimum of 1.

legendaryActions.name: Infernal Dispatch
legendaryActions.description: Glasya teleports one ally or creature Charmed by her that she can see to an unoccupied space within 60 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Parting Caress (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Glasya moves up to half her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature she passes within 5 feet of as part of this movement takes 22 (4d10) Psychic damage if she ends this movement more than 5 feet from it.

name: Baalzebul, Lord of the Seventh
savingThrows: Str +17, Dex +2, Con +15, Int +13, Wis +7, Cha +16
immunities: Fire, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Lord of the Seventh
traits.description: Devils under Baalzebul's control rupture upon death, releasing a cloud of biting flies that deals 7 (2d6) Piercing damage to each creature in a 5-foot Emanation.

traits.name: Perfection Profaned
traits.description: Whenever Baalzebul takes any Radiant damage, he takes an additional 11 (2d10) Psychic damage and gains Disadvantage on Intelligence and Wisdom Saving Throws until the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Infernal Mastery (5/Day)
traits.description:
When Baalzebul would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.

If he does, one friendly Devil within 30 feet loses 25 Hit Points. If a Devil is killed in this way, Baalzebul immediately regains a use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Baalzebul makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Defiler's Slime or Pollute Spirit.

actions.name: Putrid Slam
actions.description:
Attack: +17 reach 10 ft. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 13 (3d8) poison damage.

If Baalzebul doesn't have any Temporary Hit Points, a creature hit with this attack has the Restrained condition (escape DC 25) until Baalzebul moves or makes another attack.

actions.name: Defiler's Slime (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: *A wave of rotten discharge boils forth.* Each creature in a 15-foot Emanation. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: 18 (4d8) Acid damage plus 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage. Success: Half Damage Failure by 5 or More: The target is drenched in slime; until a creature clears the slime as an Action, the creature's Speed is halved and it has the Poisoned condition.

actions.name: Pollute Spirit (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: *Sin crawls through the heart, bearing foul fruits.* One creature within 60 feet. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: The target is Cursed. While Cursed in this way, the creature can't benefit from Immunity to Poison damage, the Poisoned condition or disease, and it has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws.

actions.name: Maggot Feast (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: *Fat white worms spill from every wound.* Each creature of Baalzebul's choice in a 60-foot Emanation. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: 44 (8d10) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. A creature that fails this saving throw while it is Bloodied, Poisoned, or afflicted with disease additionally has the Dazed condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Heart of Pestilence (Recharge 5-6, Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet must make three Constitution Saving Throws: DC 24. Failure: For each saving throw it failed, the target suffers one of the following effects of Baalzebul's choice. 38 (7d10) Poison damage and the creature has the Poisoned condition until cured. 38 (7d10) Necrotic damage and the creature is infected with Filth Fever. The creature loses 38 (7d10) Hit Points and begins Bleeding (2d10).

reactions.name: Boil Rupture (Recharges when Bloodied)
reactions.description: Trigger: Baalzebul takes 50 or more damage from a single source. Response: One of his cysts ruptures, releasing an Ayperobos Swarm that acts on his Initiative into his space.

reactions.name: Hero's Downfall
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature deals Radiant damage to Baalzebul while he has any Temporary Hit Points. Response: Baalzebul deals an equal amount of Radiant damage to the creature.

legendaryActions.name: Grotesque Lurch
legendaryActions.description: Baalzebul moves up to his Speed and can make a Putrid Slam attack. He can move through spaces as small as 5 feet wide with this movement without Squeezing.

legendaryActions.name: Chains of Filth
legendaryActions.description: Baalzebul chooses up to three creatures within 500 feet that are either willing, infected with a disease, or have the Poisoned condition, teleporting each target to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of him.

legendaryActions.name: Divine Mockery
legendaryActions.description: Baalzebul gains 30 Temporary Hit Points. While he has any of these Temporary Hit Points, he is shape-shifted into a Large Angel with a 100-foot Fly speed, attacks against him have Disadvantage, and any damage he deals with an attack becomes Radiant damage.

name: Mephistopheles, Lord of the Eighth
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +6, Con +6, Int +18, Wis +17, Cha +16
immunities: Cold, Fire, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Lord of the Eighth
traits.description: Devils under Mephistopheles' control have a +8 bonus to saving throws they make to resist Counterspell and similar effects, and to resist spells cast by him and his allies.

traits.name: Magics Unbound
traits.description: The first time each turn that a creature succeeds on a saving throw against a Hellfire spell Mephistopheles controls, it rebounds upon him, forcing him to make a saving throw against the same effect.

traits.name: Infernal Mastery (5/Day)
traits.description: When Mephistopheles would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed. If he does, he or one friendly Devil within 30 feet loses 25 Hit Points. If a Devil is killed in this way, Mephistopheles immediately regains a use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Mephistopheles makes two attacks with his Cold-Iron Ranseur, each of which he can replace with his Hurl Meteor.

actions.name: Cold-Iron Ranseur
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 10 ft. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) slashing damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) cold damage. A creation of magical force struck by this attack shatters and is dispelled.

actions.name: Hurl Meteor (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +18 range 150 ft. Hit: 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 35 (10d6) fire damage. Against a target at lower elevation, this attack has Advantage and pushes the target up to 15 feet on a hit.

actions.name: Hellfire Cascade (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: *Hellfire boils from the sky, raining down in great clinging droplets.* Each creature in a 30-foot radius, 500-foot high Column within 500 feet. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 26. Failure: 44 (8d10) Fire damage (ignores Resistance and Immunity). Success: Half damage. Failure by 10 or More: The creature begins Burning (2d10, ignores Resistance and Immunity).

actions.name: Glacier Surge (Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: *A mountain of ice bursts from the earth, tearing ahead with terrifying speed.* Each creature in a 20-foot wide, 100-foot long Line extending from Mephistopheles is pushed up to 30 feet away and must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 26. Failure: 62 (4d10 + 40) Cold damage. Success: Half damage. Nonmagical structures and unattended objects in the area are destroyed.

actions.name: Hellfire Baptism (Level 9 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot radius Sphere within 150 feet takes 80 Fire damage (ignores Resistance and Immunity). Each creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage can make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 26. Success: The creature regains 36 (8d8) Hit Points and has Advantage on attacks and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Coldblood Quickening (1/Day)
actions.description: Mephistopheles draws two frost-rimed larva from his throat and tosses them to unoccupied spaces within 60 feet, where each immediately grows into a Gelugon Coldblood that acts on his Initiative.

reactions.name: Alter Odds
reactions.description: *A seed of grace, nurtured in the soil of doom.* Trigger: A creature makes a saving throw against an effect that Mephistopheles or one of his allies controls. Response: The creature adds 1d10 to its result. If the creature fails regardless, Mephistopheles gains 25 Temporary Hit Points.

reactions.name: Fuel for the Fires
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 30 feet dies. Response: Mephistopheles' save DC increases by 1 for the next minute, to a maximum of 30.

legendaryActions.name: Dark One's Ways (Level 5 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: Mephistopheles chooses an unoccupied space within 60 feet, teleporting either himself or one of his allies within 500 feet to that space.

legendaryActions.name: Litany of Smoldering Cinder (Level 1 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 30 feet that is Burning has its Burning Value increase by 1d10. Each creature in the area that stopped Burning in the last minute begins Burning (1d10).

legendaryActions.name: Mage's Blind (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
legendaryActions.description: Mephistopheles secretly chooses a school of magic. The first time in the next minute that an enemy within 60 feet casts a spell of that school, it must make a Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 26. Failure: Mephistopheles gains control of the spell and can choose new targets for it.

legendaryActions.name: Savage Surge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Mephistopheles moves up to half his Speed, then can make three attacks with his Cold-Iron Ranseur against a single target.

name: Asmodeus, Lord of the Ninth
savingThrows: Str +19, Dex +5, Con +19, Int +16, Wis +10, Cha +19
immunities: Cold, Fire, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Lord of the Ninth
traits.description: Creatures within 500 feet of Asmodeus act on an Initiative that he chooses for them, instead of rolling. At Initiative count 0 of each round, he can choose a new Initiative for each creature in the area.

traits.name: The Eyes of Hell
traits.description: Asmodeus telepathically learns the details of every act of callousness, deception, or cruelty ever committed by a creature that meets his gaze.

traits.name: Infernal Mastery
traits.description: When Asmodeus would fail a saving throw, he can choose to succeed. If he does, he or one allied Devil of his choice within 30 feet loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Asmodeus makes two Ruby Rod attacks.

actions.name: Ruby Rod
actions.description: Attack: +19 reach 10 ft. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) force damage plus one of the following effects of the target's choice that it has not yet chosen this turn: Resistance. The creature takes 18 (4d8) additional Psychic damage. Sacrifice. One non-Artifact, non-consumable magic item of the creature's choice that it is carrying disintegrates. Service. The creature is Dominated until the end of its next turn. Submission. The creature kneels, falling Prone.

actions.name: Clothe in Terrors (Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: *The mask slips, offering a terrible glimpse of the true face of evil.* Each creature of Asmodeus' choice in a 60-foot Emanation that can see him is Frightened until the end of its next turn, then each Frightened creature in the area takes 67 (6d8 + 40) nonlethal Psychic damage and falls Prone.

actions.name: Make Low (Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Asmodeus can see within 60 feet. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 27. Failure: The creature is Cursed, shape-shifting into a small and wormlike form. While Cursed in this way, the creature becomes Tiny, its Speed and any damage dealt by it are halved, and it has Vulnerability to all damage.

actions.name: Burn Asunder (Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Asmodeus can see within 60 feet. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 27. Failure: 49 (9d10) Fire damage plus 49 (9d10) Force damage. Failure by 5 or More: This spell deals maximum damage to the creature, instead of rolling. Success: Half damage. A creature killed by this damage is destroyed, body and soul, and can't be restored to life by any means short of a Wish spell.

bonusActions.name: Perfect Order (Level 9 Spell)
bonusActions.description: Magic locks up in a 10-foot Emanation from Asmodeus; Each spell and magical effect in the area that he does not control is suppressed until the end of his next turn.

bonusActions.name: The Chain, Unbroken
bonusActions.description: Asmodeus summons Devils or Hell Hounds of total CR 10 or less to unoccupied spaces within 120 feet, most typically Dogai, Hell Hounds, Narzugons, or Merregons.

bonusActions.name: Unchallengeable Authority (Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.description:
Time freezes until the end of Asmodeus' turn, passing only by his leave, with the following effects: He can spend any amount of time speaking or observing. He can use an unlimited amount of movement. Other creatures within 60 feet can perceive this frozen time, but are Paralyzed.

This effect ends if Asmodeus moves more than 30 feet from where he started his turn.

reactions.name: Repay in Wrath
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature Asmodeus can see stands from Prone. Response: Asmodeus teleports the creature to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of him, then makes two attacks against it.

reactions.name: Infinite Abhorrence (Level 9 Spell)
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature Asmodeus can see within 60 feet casts a spell of Level 1 or above. Response: The creature loses the ability to cast that spell until cured with a Wish spell or similar magic.

legendaryActions.name: Mandate of Baator
legendaryActions.description: Asmodeus or a creature he can see can move up their Speed and take an Action.

actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage and the target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target is Dazed, Poisoned, and Burning (1d10) for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). A creature that this effect ends for is afflicted with Stinghollow Stupefaction.

actions.name: Amberbile Slather
actions.description: The advespa spits a thick, foamy bile onto a creature Grappled by it, which rapidly hardens into a brittle golden crust, Restraining the creature (escape DC 12) until it takes any Bludgeoning damage. A creature restrained in this way is unaffected by gravity and is Levitated 15 feet into the air whenever a creature within 30 feet of it casts a spell of 1st level or above.

name: Advespa Broodregent
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +7, Con +6, Int +3, Wis +5, Cha +2

traits.name: Vengeful Resonance
traits.description: The advespa has Advantage on the first attack it makes each turn against a creature that killed a friendly advespa in the last minute.

traits.name: Frost Torpor
traits.description: If the advespa takes any Cold damage, it is Dazed and gains Vulnerability to Cold damage until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Hellwasp Hatchery
traits.description: If the advespa dies, at the start of its next turn 10 Advespa Handmaidens emerge from its corpse. For each 20 damage dealt to its corpse, 5 fewer advespas emerge.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The advespa makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Hellwasp Whipsting.

actions.name: Speartallon Lunge
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage. A Dazed or Incapacitated creature hit with this attack is Grappled (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Hellwasp Whipsting
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage and the target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target is Dazed, Poisoned, and Burning (1d10) for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). A creature that this effect ends for is afflicted with Stinghollow Stupefaction.

bonusActions.name: Implant Larva (Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.description: Immediately after hitting a Dazed or Incapacitated creature with its Hellwasp Whipsting, the advespa can deposit a wriggling larva in the wound (AC 12, 1 HP, remove DC 14). Until the larva is removed, the target suffers the following effects: The target stabilizes automatically while at 0 Hit Points. Whenever the target fails a Constitution Saving Throw, it is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Ironwing Flit
legendaryActions.description: The advespa flies up to 20 feet, then can use its Reaction to regain one expended Legendary Action.

legendaryActions.name: Amberbile Drain
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 300 feet that is Restrained by an advespa's Amberbile Slather must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature loses an unexpended spell slot of its choice, then Levitates 15 feet into the air. A creature that can't lose a spell slot is instead Dazed until the end its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Surrogate Broodcall (Recharges when a creature fails its saving throw against the advespa's Amberbile Drain)
legendaryActions.description: One intact corpse of an Advespa Malagyne or of a creature implanted with hellwasp larvae within 60 feet bursts open, and from it crawls 2 (1d4) Advespa Handmaidens.

name: Armanite Headbreaker
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Aerial Charge
traits.description: If the armanite dashes, it gains a fly speed equal to its movement speed until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the armanite takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the armanite takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Storm of Hooves (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 Bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 3 damage if the armanite is flying.

reactions.name: Stampede
reactions.description: When a friendly creature it can see within 10 feet takes the Dash action, the armanite can take the Dash action, moving in the same direction if possible.

name: Armanite Bloodwether
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +4, Con +5, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Magic Resistance

actions.name: Wicked Claws
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the armanite may grapple the target (escape DC 16)

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The armanite may make this attack as a bonus action if it is flying.

actions.name: Serrated Tail
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Quick Kick
reactions.description: When a creature makes an attack against the armanite that benefits from flanking it, the armanite can make a Hooves attack against it.

reactions.name: Stampede
reactions.description: When a friendly creature it can see within 10 feet takes the Dash action, the armanite can take the Dash action, moving in the same direction if possible.

name: Armanite Lancer
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +4, Con +5, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +2

traits.name: Aerial Charge
traits.description: If the armanite dashes, it gains a fly speed equal to its movement speed until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The armanite has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Crackling Longspear
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) lightning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. The armanite may make this attack as a bonus action if it is flying.

actions.name: Serrated Tail
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tempestuous Impulse (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: For the next minute, the armanite gains the ability to Dash as a bonus action and its attacks deal an additional 7 (2d6) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Lancing Spark (Recharge 5-6, Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: The armanite looses a bolt of lightning in a line 60 feet long and 10 feet wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) Lightning damage, or half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Quick Kick
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature making an attack against the armanite that benefits from flanking it, the armanite makes a Hooves attack.

name: Ayperobos Swarm
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +4, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +2, Cha +4
immunities: Fire, Poison; Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, can move through any opening large enough for a single ayperobos, and can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The swarm makes three attacks with its Shred to Ribbons, one of which it can replace with its Plaguefog Shiver.

actions.name: Shred to Ribbons
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 0 ft. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) slashing damage, or Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage if the swarm has fewer than half its Hit Points.

actions.name: Plaguefog Shivver
actions.description: An pestilent fog rolls off the swarm, forcing each creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Devil Chills.

bonusActions.name: Latch On
bonusActions.description: The swarm converges on a creature in its space, forcing to target to succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or have the swarm become Attached to it.

bonusActions.name: Swarm Within
bonusActions.description: The swarm turns incorporeal and dives into a creature it is Attached to, forcing it to succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or be Possessed by the swarm (Save Ends at end of turn). Whenever the Possessed creature takes any damage, the swarm takes an equal amount of Psychic damage.

name: Barghest
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha +2
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: Abyssal, Common, Goblin, Infernal, telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The barghest can use a bonus action to polymorph into a Small goblin or back into its true form. Other than its size and speed, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. The barghest reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Fire Banishment
traits.description: The barghest treats any areas of open flames at least 10 feet wide as one-way portals to Gehenna. A barghest that starts its turn in a burning area must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw or be drawn through.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.description: If the barghest moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the barghest can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The barghest makes two claw attacks and uses its teleport.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the barghest can grapple the target (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Worry
actions.description: One creature grappled by both the barghest and at least one of the barghest's allies must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 35 (10d6) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Teleport (spell, 4th level)
actions.description: The barghest and up to one creature that is riding it or grappled by it magically teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

name: Cambion Advocate
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +4, Con +6, Int +5, Wis +1, Cha +6
resistances: Cold, Fire, Poison; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical, Nonsilvered Sources

traits.name: Dark Heart
traits.description: Unless bound with blessed salt and silver, the cambion can magically conceal its fiendish traits at will, and its nature cannot be detected by magic.

traits.name: Unfated (1/Day)
traits.description: At the end of the cambion's turn, it can end one condition affecting it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cambion makes two attacks with its Balefire Blade or Hurl Flame

actions.name: Balefire Blade
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) Fire or Necrotic damage (cambion's choice).

actions.name: Hurl Flame (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 150 ft., Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage. On a Critical Hit, the target begins Burning (1d10).

actions.name: Infernal Animus (Level 4 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: *Hate boils up, wild and bitter.* The cambion cloaks one creature it can see within 30 feet in a vile aura. Each creature of the cambion's choice in a 30-foot Emanation from the target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature becomes hostile to the target and indifferent to all other creatures until the end of the cambion's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Trickster's Guile (Concentration)
bonusActions.description: One creature the cambion touches is Dazed until the end of the cambion's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Suborn Will
bonusActions.description: The cambion touches a Dazed creature, forcing it to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature is Dominated by the cambion. The Dominated creature can repeat this saving throw when it takes damage or when a creature uses an Action to attempt to free it, ending the effect on a success.

name: Cambion Evangel
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +4, Con +8, Int +6, Wis +3, Cha +8
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical, Nonsilvered Sources

traits.name: Dark Heart
traits.description: Unless bound with blessed salt and silver, the cambion can magically conceal its fiendish traits at will, and its nature cannot be detected by magic.

traits.name: Unfated (3/Day)
traits.description: At the end of each of the cambion's turns, it can end one condition affecting it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cambion makes two attacks with its Rootfang Longspear, one of which it can replace with a use of its Brimstone Barrage or Infernal Animus.

actions.name: Rootfang Longspear
actions.description:
Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.


If the target would regain any Hit Points before the start of its next turn, it instead regains half as many.

actions.name: Brimstone Barrage (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: *Clinging fire rains forth, spitting and spluttering.* Each creature in a 30-foot cone. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 16 (3d10) Fire damage and the creature begins Burning (1d10). Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Infernal Animus (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: *Hate boils up, wild and bitter.* The cambion cloaks one creature it can see within 30 feet in a vile aura. Failure: The creature becomes hostile to the target and indifferent to all other creatures until the end of the cambion's next turn.

actions.name: Calamitous Rite (1/Day, Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: A storm of astral chaos tears through reality in an instant, lashing unpredictably in a 40-foot Emanation from the cambion. Roll a d20 for each other creature in the area. On a roll of 1-10, the creature takes 33 (6d10) Force damage and is pushed up to 30 feet away.

bonusActions.name: Trickster's Guile (Concentration)
bonusActions.description: One creature the cambion touches is Dazed until the end of the cambion's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Suborn Will
