The Dominated creature can repeat this saving throw when it takes damage or when a creature uses an Action to attempt to free it, ending the effect on a success.

bonusActions.name: Devilish Transposition (Level 2 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The cambion teleports to switch places with an ally within 60 feet, or teleports two allies it can see within 60 feet to switch place with each other.

legendaryActions.name: Twirling Slash
legendaryActions.description: Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 9 (2d8) Slashing damage and the creature is pushed 5 feet away. Before or after using this ability, the cambion can move up to half its Speed.

legendaryActions.name: Insidious Influence
legendaryActions.description: One creature Dazed or Dominated by the cambion uses its Reaction, if available, to move up to half its Speed and make a melee attack under the cambion's control.

legendaryActions.name: Scales of Malice
legendaryActions.description: *Torment slithers forth, carving treason's path.* The cambion deals 18 (4d8) Psychic damage to one creature it can see within 30 feet. The target can choose to deal 13 (3d8) Psychic damage to one of its allies within 30 feet of it; if it does, it gains Resistance to this damage.

name: Hell Hound Mongrel
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Predatory Bearing
traits.description: The hound's attacks have Advantage against any creature that has no allies within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Furnaceheart Flare
traits.description: When the hound fails a saving throw against an effect that incapacitates it, flames erupt from it in a 10-foot Emanation, dealing 3 (1d6) Fire damage to each creature in the area.

actions.name: Blistering Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage. A Burning target hit with this attack gains the Prone condition.

actions.name: Breath of the Fleshfires (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: *Unnatural flames spill forth from the hound's maw, hungry for flesh.* Each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 10 (3d6) Fire damage and the target has the Burning (1d10) condition. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Rekindle Hatred (1/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: The hound takes 20 or more damage from a single source. Response: The hound gains 20 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the hound has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

name: Ashbred Hell Hound
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +6, Int -2, Wis +6, Cha -2

traits.name: Predatory Bearing
traits.description: The hound's attacks have Advantage against any creature that has no allies within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Furnaceheart Flare
traits.description: When the hound fails a saving throw against an effect that incapacitates it, flames erupt from it in a 10-foot Emanation, dealing 3 (1d6) Fire damage to each creature in the area.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hound makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Soot-Tongued Howl.

actions.name: Blistering Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage. A Burning target hit with this attack gains the Prone condition.

actions.name: Soot-Tongued Howl
actions.description: *A discordant howl fills flames with evil vigor.* Each Burning creature within 30 feet has its Burning Value increase by 1d10, to a maximum of 3d10, then each other creature within 5 feet of it gains the Burning (1d10) condition.

actions.name: Breath of the Fleshfires (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: *Unnatural flames spill forth from the hound's maw, hungry for flesh.* Each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 21 (6d6) Fire damage and the target has the Burning (1d10) condition. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Fiery Pursuit
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature teleports to a space the hound can see within 30 feet. Response: The hound moves up to half its Speed directly toward the creature, then can make a Blistering Bite attack against it.

reactions.name: Rekindle Hatred (1/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: The hound takes 20 or more damage from a single source. Response: The hound gains 20 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the hound has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

name: Hell Hound Warpack
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -2
immunities: Fire; Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Predatory Bearing
traits.description: The warpack's attacks have Advantage against any creature that has no allies within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The warpack can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any opening large enough for a single hell hound.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The warpack makes up to two attacks, each of which must be against a different target.

actions.name: Pack Harry
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage, or half as much damage if the warpack is Bloodied.

actions.name: Rip to Shreds
actions.description:
One creature Grappled by the warpack. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 64 (4d6 + 50) Piercing damage. Success: Half damage.

A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points due to failing this saving throw must immediately make three Death Saving Throws.

bonusActions.name: Tear Down
bonusActions.description: Each creature the warpack hit with an attack this turn. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The creature has the Grappled (escape DC 17) and Prone conditions.

bonusActions.name: Fleshfire Ignition
bonusActions.description: Up to two creatures within 15 feet of the warpack. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 10 (3d6) Fire damage and the target has the Burning (1d10) condition. Success: Half damage.

name: Cerberian Hell Hound
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +8, Con +9, Int -1, Wis +9, Cha +6

traits.name: Predatory Bearing
traits.description: The hound's attacks have Advantage against any creature that has no allies within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Furnaceheart Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description:
When the hound would fail a saving throw while it is Bloodied, it can choose to succeed.

If it does, flames erupt from it in a 10-foot Emanation, dealing 7 (2d6) Fire damage to each creature in the area.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hound makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Breath of the Fleshfires, if available.

actions.name: Hellish Maw
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage. A Burning target hit with this attack gains the Prone condition.

actions.name: Breath of the Fleshfires (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: *Unnatural flames spill forth from the hound's maw, hungry for flesh.* Each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 21 (6d6) Fire damage and the target has the Burning (1d10) condition. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Snarling Retort
reactions.description: Trigger: The hound is hit with a melee attack. Response: The hound moves up to 10 feet, then can make a Hellish Maw attack.

reactions.name: Soulguard's Claim
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature the hound can see within 60 feet teleports. Response: The creature must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The creature instead teleports to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of the hound.

reactions.name: Soot-Tongued Chorus (1/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: The hound becomes Bloodied. Response: Each Burning creature within 60 feet has its Burning Value become 3d10, then each other creature within 5 feet of it gains the Burning (1d10) condition.

name: Gathra
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex -1, Con +9, Int -3, Wis +7, Cha +8

traits.name: Stampede
traits.description: When the gathra moves, each other gathra within 5 feet of it can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed with the gathra. If one or more other gathra do so, the gathra has Advantage on attacks it makes this turn.

traits.name: Scything Charge
traits.description: If the gathra moves at least 20 feet directly toward a Medium or smaller creature, it can move through that creature’s space. A creature whose space the gathra enters in this way must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The creature falls Prone. Success: The creature moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

actions.name: Twingore Thrash
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) piercing damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. The gathra can make this attack as a Bonus Action against a Prone target.

reactions.name: Bellow
reactions.description: *Eyes flare with red light; a thunderous bellow of warning.* Trigger: The gathra succeeds on a saving throw against a spell. Response: The spell's caster is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Eye of Spite
reactions.description: Trigger: A Frightened creature the gathra can see within 30 feet casts a spell. Response: One of the gathra's eyes bursts in a shower of blood, and the spell's caster must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The caster drops to 0 Hit Points.

name: Gribble
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -3

traits.name: Shiverhex Vector
traits.description: The gribble shakes uncontrollably, giving it Disadvantage on the first d20 test it makes on each of its turns. Whenever a creature with this trait is hit with a melee attack, the attacker gains this trait for 1 hour.

traits.name: Frail Frame
traits.description: Whenever the gribble takes any damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the damage's source and falls Prone.

actions.name: Spindly Grippers
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: The gribble becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 12). A creature the gribble is Attached to in this way has its Speed reduced by 10 feet.

actions.name: Gnaw Laces
actions.description: One creature wearing Light or Medium Armor that the gribble is Attached to has the AC provided by its armor reduced by 1 until it completes a Short or Long Rest. The creature can use its Reaction, if available, to prevent this effect.

actions.name: Maddening Yap (Recharge 4-6, Concentration)
actions.description: The gribble lets out a breathless stream of shrill, grating barks in a 20-foot Emanation until the start of its next turn. Each non-gribble creature that starts its turn in the area takes 5 (2d4) Psychic damage.

name: Howler
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -4, Wis +5, Cha -2
resistances: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The Howler has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The Howler has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Howler's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Quill Defense
traits.description: Any creature that strikes a howler with a non-reach melee weapon, unarmed strike, or natural weapon takes 1d4 points of Piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The howler makes two attacks with its rending bite.

actions.name: Rending Bite
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, plus Hit: 22 (4d10) psychic damage if the target is frightened. This attack ignores damage resistance.

actions.name: Cursed Quills
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC16 Dexterity save or a cursed quill breaks off in its flesh, causing the target to subtract 1d4 from the result whenever it makes an attack or save. The quills may be removed as an action with a successful DC 16 medicine check, or by taking an additional 1d6 damage per quill removed.

actions.name: Mind-Breaking Howl (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The howler emits a keening howl in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area that isn't deafened must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be frightened until the end of the howler's next turn. While a creature is frightened in this way, its speed is halved, and it is incapacitated. A target that successfully saves is immune to the Mind-Breaking Howl of all howlers for the next 24 hours.

reactions.name: Present Quills
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the howler may make an attack with its cursed quills.

name: Juvenile Ixitxachitl
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +3, Con +1, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Confounding Circling
traits.description: While adjacent to two or more ixitxachitl, a creature has Disadvantage on attacks of opportunity that target one of them.

traits.name: Segmented Brain
traits.description: The ixitxachitl may continue to make attacks of opportunity with its whiptail barb for up to a minute after being incapacitated or killed.

actions.name: Sluggish Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and the target's movement is reduced by 5 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Whiptail Barb
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) poison damage.

name: Vampiric Ixitxachitl
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +1, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Confounding Circling
traits.description: While adjacent to two or more ixitxachitl, a creature has Disadvantage on attacks of opportunity that target one of them.

traits.name: Segmented Brain
traits.description: The ixitxachitl may continue to make attacks of opportunity with its whiptail barb for up to a minute after being incapacitated or killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ixitxachitl makes two attacks; one with its vampiric bite and one with its whiptail sting.

actions.name: Vampiric Bite
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or lose one unexpended hit die. If the target expends a hit die in this way, the ixitxachitl gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Whiptail Sting
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) poison damage.

reactions.name: Bleed for the Deep Father
reactions.description: When a creature within 5 feet dies or fails a death saving throw, the ixitxachitl can create a searing symbol above the creature's body that lasts until the end of the ixitxachitl's next turn. Each non-fiend creature within 30 feet that can see the symbol must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the ixitxachitl's next turn.

name: Merrow Seareaver
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +2, Int -1, Cha -1

traits.name: Galvanic Spasm
traits.description: If the merrow takes any Lightning damage, it loses its Reaction, or is Dazed until the end of its next turn if it can't.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The merrow makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Harpoon Skewer.

actions.name: Drowner's Claw
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the merrow can Grapple the target (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Harpoon Skewer
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is dragged up to 15 feet toward the Merrow.

bonusActions.name: Spiral Dive
bonusActions.description: The merrow swims up to half its Speed directly downward, then each creature Grappled by it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature is Poisoned until the end of the Merrow's next turn, and loses its breath if it was holding it.

bonusActions.name: Primeval Surge
bonusActions.description: If the merrow is submerged at the surface of a body of water, it can leap up to 20 feet out of the water. It can make up to one of the attacks granted by its Multiattack as part of this leap.

name: Merrow Shipbreaker
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +1, Con +6, Int -1, Cha -1
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Attacks made without Advantage

traits.name: Galvanic Spasm
traits.description: If the merrow takes any Lightning damage, it loses its Reaction, or is Dazed until the end of its next turn if it can't.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: Attacks made against the merrow by a creature Attached to it have Advantage, and the merrow has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures Attached to it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The merrow makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Anchor Flail.

actions.name: Razorfin Claw
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Anchor-Flail Crash
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 20 ft. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away. This attack has Disadvantage against a target within 10 feet of the merrow.

actions.name: Raise Breaker (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The merrow lashes its tail through water, sending a wave roiling forth in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the area must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away if it is Large or smaller. Success: Half damage. A creature with at least Half Cover has Advantage on this saving throw and takes no damage on a success.

bonusActions.name: Primeval Surge
bonusActions.description: If the merrow is submerged at the surface of a body of water, it can leap up to 20 feet out of the water. It can make up to one of the attacks granted by its Multiattack as part of this leap.

name: Nightmare Cursebearer
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Wis +1, Cha +2
languages: Understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

traits.name: Embrace of Flames
traits.description: A creature riding the nightmare has resistance to Fire damage.

traits.name: Mourning Haunt
traits.description: The nightmare appears in the dreams of those who have recently lost a close companion, Cursing those who choose to mount the nightmare in their dreams. A creature Cursed in this way is plagued by terrible dreams, and the nightmare takes form on the Material Plane after 1d10 days, appearing to the creature at a moment when it is alone. If this Curse is removed, the nightmare vanishes, returning to the Ethereal Plane.

actions.name: Hellshod Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) fire damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

actions.name: Leech Sorrow (1/Day)
actions.description: One creature Cursed by the nightmare takes 9 (2d8) Psychic damage, then both that creature and the nightmare gain an equal number of Temporary Hit Points.

reactions.name: Gift of Wounds
reactions.description: When the nightmare is hit with an attack, it can force a creature Cursed by its Mourning Haunt ability to make a DC 12 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the nightmare takes half as much damage from the attack and the creature takes the same amount.

reactions.name: Ashen Demise
reactions.description: When the nightmare is reduced to 0 Hit Points, its flesh turns to toxic ash and bursts in a 15-foot radius, leaving only charred bones behind. Each creature in the area when it appears must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and begin Choking until the end of its next turn.

name: Nightmare Hellsteed
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Wis +1, Cha +2
languages: Understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

traits.name: Embrace of Flames
traits.description: A creature riding the nightmare has resistance to Fire damage.

actions.name: Hellshod Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

actions.name: Burning Trail (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The nightmare moves up to 60 feet in a straight line, leaving a trail of hellfire behind it. Each creature in its path must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success. Until the beginning of the nightmare's next turn, a creature that starts its turn in the affected area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 16 (3d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Ember-Way Break
actions.description: The nightmare lunges against the barrier between the Ethereal and Material plane, taking 11 (2d10) Force damage and tearing open a ragged portal large enough for it to pass through that seals itself shut after a minute.

reactions.name: Offer Service
reactions.description: When the nightmare is reduced to 0 Hit Points, before falling unconscious it can kneel and offer its service to a creature it can see. If the creature accepts, the creature loses half its current Hit Points and the nightmare regains an equal amount of Hit Points.

reactions.name: Burn Out
reactions.description: When the nightmare is reduced to 0 Hit Points, before falling unconscious the nightmare can begin to shake and squeal, its flesh cracking with flame. At the beginning of the nightmare's next turn, it dies and explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Fire damage.

name: Crypt-Back Cauchemar
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex +3, Con +4, Int +3, Wis +3, Cha +10
immunities: Fire, Necrotic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered, Turned; Charmed, Frightened
languages: Understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

traits.name: Embrace of Flames
traits.description: A creature riding the cauchemar has resistance to Fire damage.

traits.name: Bearer of the Dead
traits.description: The cauchemar may carry any number of dead and undead creatures without difficulty. A dead creature the cauchemar touches is drawn onto its back and grappled there (escape DC 18).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.description: If the cauchemar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cauchemar makes three attacks with its Hellshod Hooves, one of which it may replace with a use of its Viperous Bite or Burning Trail, if available.

actions.name: Viperous Bite
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 14 (4d6) poison damage. Unless it is first magically revived, a creature killed by this damage returns as a Questing Revenant at the next new moon, and is consumed with thoughts of vengeance toward a creature that recently wronged it.

actions.name: Hellshod Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

actions.name: Burning Trail (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The cauchemar moves up to 60 feet in a straight line, leaving a trail of hellfire behind it. Each creature in its path must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success. Until the beginning of the cauchemar's next turn, a creature that starts its turn in the affected area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 16 (3d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hellfire Revival
actions.description: The cauchemar wreaths one of the corpses carried on its back in necromantic flames, burning away its flesh and animating it for the next minute as a Blazing Bones that acts on the cauchemar's turn and under its control. The cauchemar can have up to three corpses animated in this way at a time.

actions.name: Haunting Squeal (Recharges when the cauchemar uses its Ember-Way Break)
actions.description: The cauchemar rears up and lets out a hollow squeal, conjuring forth a tide of vengeful spirits. Each creature within 60 feet of a portal created by the cauchemar's Ember-Way Break must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or take 22 (5d8) Necrotic damage and be dragged up to 15 feet toward the nearest such portal. Each creature dragged into a portal's space in this way is carried through to the Ethereal Plane and ages 1d4 x 10% of its natural lifespan until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reactions.name: Fleshmad Frenzy
reactions.description: When the nightmare reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points with a Viperous Bite attack, it can make another Viperous Bite attack against the same target.

reactions.name: Burn Out
reactions.description: When the cauchemar is reduced to 0 Hit Points, before falling unconscious it begins to shake and squeal, its flesh cracking with flame. At the beginning of the cauchemar's next turn, it dies and explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Fire damage plus 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage.

legendaryActions.name: Brimstone Fume
legendaryActions.description: Foul wisps of ash and shadow spill from the cauchemar's flesh, creating a 15-foot radius area of magical darkness centered on it that lasts until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Snort Flame
legendaryActions.description: The cauchemar snorts a gout of flame in a 15-foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

legendaryActions.name: Ember-Way Break
legendaryActions.description: The cauchemar moves up to half its speed, then may lunge against the barrier between the Ethereal and Material plane, taking 11 (2d10) Force damage and tearing open a ragged portal large enough for it to pass through that seals itself shut after a minute.

name: Nupperibo Blind-Eye
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +1, Int -4, Wis -1, Cha -5

traits.name: Black-Hearted Burst
traits.description: When the nupperibo is killed by any non-Radiant damage, the darkness filling it spills forth in a 5-foot Emanation, filling the area with Magical Darkness for one minute. This Magical Darkness dissipates if illuminated by Bright Light produced by a spell of Level 1 or above, or if cleared by a strong wind.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the nupperibo takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the nupperibo takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its Hit Point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Blind Lurch (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Bludgeoning damage. If three or more nupperibos contributed to this attack, the target is Grappled by one of them (escape DC 13). While Grappled by two or more nupperibos in this way, the creature is Choking.

name: Nupperibo Woundpack
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +1, Int -4, Wis -1, Cha -5
immunities: Fire, Poison; Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Darkness Overflowing
traits.description: When the woundpack takes 10 or more non-Radiant damage from a single source, its space is shrouded in Magical Darkness for one minute. This Magical Darkness dissipates if illuminated by Bright Light produced by a spell of Level 1 or above, or if cleared by a strong wind.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The woundpack can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and can move through any opening large enough for a single nupperibo. The woundpack can’t regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Broken Blades
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 0 ft. Hit: 30 (6d8 + 3) slashing damage, or half as much if the woundpack is Bloodied. On a miss, this attack instead hits the woundpack.

actions.name: Lurching Jostle
actions.description: Each creature in the woundpack’s space. Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage and the creature is Grappled (escape DC 14) until the end of the woundpack's next turn.

actions.name: Whispered Names
actions.description: The woundpack takes 18 (4d8) Psychic damage, then each non-Fiend creature in its space must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: A secret name of The Invincible Tyrant passes through the creature’s mind, dealing 18 (4d8) Psychic damage to it. Failure by 5 or More: The creature can choose to remember the name. If it does, it takes twice as much psychic damage and is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

name: Nupperibo Hellspawn
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +7, Con +8, Int +1, Wis +7, Cha +2

traits.name: Seeping Darkness
traits.description: At the end of each of the nupperibo’s turns, the area in a 10-foot Emanation from it is filled with Magical Darkness that lasts for 1 minute. This Magical Darkness dissipates if illuminated by Bright Light produced by a spell of Level 1 or above, or if cleared by a strong wind.

traits.name: Burgeoning Rupture (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
traits.description: When the nupperibo is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn’t die or fall Unconscious. Instead, it resets to 104 Hit Points and ruptures, hatching forth as a mature Baatorian. In this form, the nupperibo regains 30 Hit Points at the beginning of each of its turns if it is in Magical Darkness.

traits.name: Devouring Resistance (1/Day)
traits.description: If the nupperibo fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, any Magical Darkness within 10 feet of it dissipates.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nupperibo makes three attacks with its Hellflesh Tendril.

actions.name: Hellflesh Tendril
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) acid damage. A creature hit with two or more of these attacks in a turn is Grappled until the start of the nupperibo’s next turn (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Voice of Baator (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The nupperibo speaks an horrid word in the true voice of The Hells, forcing each other creature in a 30-foot Emanation that can hear it to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 9 (2d8) Psychic damage and the creature is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Flee to the Shadow
legendaryActions.description: The nupperibo moves up to half its Speed. Then, if it is in area of Magical Darkness, it can attempt to Hide.

legendaryActions.name: Hellflesh Slither
legendaryActions.description: The nupperibo moves up to half its Speed, then can make two attacks with its Hellflesh Tendril.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Devour Fiend
legendaryActions.description: *Flesh stretches and splits, straining to engulf and consume.* One creature Grappled by the nupperibo. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 22 (5d8) Acid damage Success: Half damage. If the nupperibo kills a Fiend in this way, the fiend’s spirit is wholly destroyed and the nupperibo gains 20 Temporary Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Rapture of Slime
legendaryActions.description: Acrid sludge congeals around each creature in an area of Magical Darkness created by the nupperibo, dealing 9 (2d8) Acid damage.

name: 'Rakshasa' Body Double
savingThrows: Dex +3, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +3

traits.name: Double Deception
traits.description: The 'rakshasa' is wearing a sophisticated yet mundane rakshasa disguise, cloaked in an illusory humanoid appearance that it may activate or deactivate as a Bonus Action. A creature that can see through the illusion may discern this fact with a DC 18 Wisdom (Perception) check.

traits.name: Incendiary Failsafe
traits.description: If the 'rakshasa' is killed, its corpse bursts into flames. Unless they are extinguished, the corpse becomes unrecognizable after 1d4 rounds.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The 'rakshasa' uses its Shouted Command twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Craven Retreat.

actions.name: Shouted Command
actions.description: One creature the rakshasa can see within 60 feet may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a melee attack.

actions.name: Craven Retreat
actions.description: The 'rakshasa' drops Prone, then may Dash or Disengage.

actions.name: Sow Chaos (1/Day)
actions.description: The 'rakshasa' hurls a container of volatile alchemical substances up to 30 feet to a point it can see, where it bursts and fills a 20-foot radius with sickly yellow fumes. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn) While Poisoned in this way, a creature can't distinguish friend from foe, and must use its reaction to make a melee attack against any creature that enters its reach.

reactions.name: Feign Death
reactions.description: When the 'rakshasa' takes any damage, it can appear to die, falling prone and slowing its heart rate. A creature may discern that it is still alive as an action with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

name: Rakshasa Rukh
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +4, Int +1, Wis +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 1st level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Sinister Heart
traits.description: Any hit scored against the rakshasa by a magical weapon that deals Piercing damage and is wielded by a Good-aligned creature becomes a critical. If the rakshasa is reduced to 0 Hit Points in this way, it is permanently killed and can't reform in the Abyss.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rakshasa makes three attacks with its Curseblade Khanda.

actions.name: Curseblade Khanda
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage, and the target is Cursed. A creature Cursed in this way that would add any magical bonus to an attack, saving throw, or damage roll instead subtracts the same amount.

actions.name: Gathra-Horn War Bow
actions.description: Attack: +7 range:special, Hit: 10 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 14 (4d6) lightning damage. This attack can target any creature the rakshasa can see. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Master of Appearances
bonusActions.description: The rakshasa assumes the illusory appearance and voice of any humanoid creature it has seen.

reactions.name: Deceptive Feint
reactions.description: When the rakshasa misses with a melee attack, it can make another melee attack against a different target in its reach.

name: Rakshasa Naztharune
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +4, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +5
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Sinister Heart
traits.description: Any hit scored against the rakshasa by a magical weapon that deals Piercing damage and is wielded by a Good-aligned creature becomes a critical. If the rakshasa is reduced to 0 Hit Points in this way, it is permanently killed and can't reform in the Abyss.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rakshasa makes two attacks with its Reversed Claws.

actions.name: Reversed Claws
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage, and the target is Cursed. A creature Cursed in this way that would add any magical bonus to an attack, saving throw, or damage roll instead subtracts the same amount.

actions.name: Death-Reservoir Dagger (1/Day)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature drops to 0 Hit Points and makes all saving throws with Disadvantage for the next minute. On a success, the creature takes 35 (10d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Fiendish Insight
actions.description: One player whose character the rakshasa can see must declare what action the character will take on their following turn, then that character must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma (Deception) check or have the rakshasa learn that information.

bonusActions.name: Master of Appearances
bonusActions.description: The rakshasa assumes the illusory appearance and voice of any humanoid creature it has seen.

bonusActions.name: Disappearing Act (Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.description: The rakshasa becomes Invisible until the start of its next turn, or until it takes any damage.

reactions.name: Saw it Coming (Recharges when the rakshasa uses its Fiendish Insight)
reactions.description: When a creature it can see begins to take an action, the rakshasa can move up to its speed and take an action or a bonus action.

reactions.name: Alone (1/Day)
reactions.description: When a creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the rakshasa, the rakshasa can throw a fistful of red powder in its eyes. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). While Poisoned in this way, a creature cannot distinguish friend from foe.

name: Rakshasa Ak'Chazar
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +10, Int +5, Wis +3, Cha +4
immunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Eternal Servitude
traits.description: A living creature that dies while under the rakshasa's control rises at the start of its next turn under the rakshasa's control with 30 Hit Points. The creature's type becomes undead and its alignment becomes lawful evil, but its statistics otherwise remain unchanged and it retains its memories.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Sinister Heart
traits.description: Any hit scored against the rakshasa by a magical weapon that deals Piercing damage and is wielded by a Good-aligned creature becomes a critical. If the rakshasa is reduced to 0 Hit Points in this way, it is permanently killed and can't reform in the Abyss.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rakshasa makes two attacks with its Reversed Claws and uses its Fiendish Insight.

actions.name: Reversed Claws
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, and the target is Cursed. A creature Cursed in this way that would add any magical bonus to an attack, saving throw, or damage roll instead subtracts the same amount.

actions.name: Fiendish Insight
actions.description: One player whose character the rakshasa can see must declare what action the character will take on their following turn, then that character must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma (Deception) check or have the rakshasa learn that information.

actions.name: Twist the Heart (Recharge 5-6, Level 7 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 44 (8d10) psychic damage and the target must make a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature is Dominated by the rakshasa for the next hour, and repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success. While Dominated in this way, the creature takes 5 (1d10) Psychic damage whenever it deals damage to or is dealt damage by a former ally.

bonusActions.name: Master of Appearances
bonusActions.description: The rakshasa assumes the illusory appearance and voice of any humanoid creature it has seen.

bonusActions.name: Sneering Command
bonusActions.description: Up to two creatures the rakshasa can see within 60 feet may each use their reaction to move up to half their speed and make a melee attack.

reactions.name: Saw it Coming (Recharges when the rakshasa uses its Fiendish Insight)
reactions.description: When a creature it can see begins to take an action, the rakshasa can move up to its speed and take an action or a bonus action.

reactions.name: Deceptive Demise (Level 4 Spell, 1/Day)
reactions.description: When the rakshasa takes any damage, it can teleport up to 30 feet to a location it can see, turn Invisible until the start of its next turn, and can attempt to Hide. A corpse-like duplicate of the rakshasa is left in its place, which dissolves into mist at the end of the rakshasa's next turn, or if it takes any damage.

name: Rakshasa Rajah
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +4, Con +11, Int +6, Wis +10, Cha +6
immunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Master of Treachery
traits.description: The rakshasa can sense the presence and nature of conflict between creatures it can see.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Sinister Heart

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (1/Day)
traits.description: If the rakshasa fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rakshasa makes two attacks with its Reversed Claws and uses its Mastermind's Insight, if available.

actions.name: Reversed Claws
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, and the target is Cursed. A creature Cursed in this way that would add any magical bonus to an attack, saving throw, or damage roll instead subtracts the same amount.

actions.name: Sudden Spoiling (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the rakshasa can see within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or take 49 (11d8) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. If this spell was cast as a reaction on the target's turn, the target is additionally Stunned until the end of the rakshasa's next turn.

actions.name: Mastermind's Insight (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description:
Each player whose character the rakshasa can see must declare what action the character will take on their following turn, then each of those characters must succeed on a DC 24 Charisma (Deception) check or have the rakshasa learn that information. :

*Displace Soul (1/Day, Level 9 Spell, Concentration.)* One creature within 5 feet of the rakshasa must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw or fall Unconscious as its soul is forced out of its body and into the Border Ethereal (Save Ends at end of turn). The affected creature can still see, hear, and speak faintly across the barrier. A creature that fails three consecutive saving throws against this effect is trapped outside its body until returned by a Wish spell or similar magic.

bonusActions.name: Master of Appearances
bonusActions.description: The rakshasa assumes the illusory appearance and voice of any humanoid creature it has seen.

bonusActions.name: Wreath With Flame (Level 3 Spell)
bonusActions.description: Until the end of the rakshasa's turn, its melee attacks deal an additional 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

bonusActions.name: Sneering Command
bonusActions.description: Up to two creatures the rakshasa can see within 60 feet may each use their reaction to move up to half their speed and make a melee attack.

reactions.name: Saw it Coming (Recharges when the rakshasa uses its Mastermind's Insight)
reactions.description: When a creature it can see begins to take an action, the rakshasa can move up to its speed and takes an action or a bonus action.

reactions.name: Deceptive Demise (Level 4 Spell, 2/Day)
reactions.description: When the rakshasa takes any damage, it can teleport up to 30 feet to a location it can see, turn Invisible until the start of its next turn, and can attempt to Hide. A corpse-like duplicate of the rakshasa is left in its place, which dissolves into mist at the end of the rakshasa's next turn, or if it takes any damage.

name: Shadow Mastiff Umbra
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -3
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing while not in Bright Light

traits.name: Ghostlight Hunter
traits.description: The mastiff can see into the Border Ethereal and can detect by scent the number and direction of each source of Bright Light within 1 mile.

actions.name: Fearsome Jaws
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) psychic damage. A Frightened target hit with this attack gains the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) or the Prone condition (mastiff's choice).

actions.name: Blackening Bay
actions.description: A dreadful howl emerges from the mastiff in a 30-foot Emanation; each source of Bright Light in the area that is nonmagical or produced by a cantrip is snuffed out. Then, each creature of its choice in the area that isn't illuminated by Bright Light must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn). Success by 5 or More: The target is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

bonusActions.name: Swirling Shadow
bonusActions.description: If the mastiff isn't in Bright Light, it can teleport to an unoccupied space of Dim Light or Darkness that it can see within 30 feet.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Blend
bonusActions.description: If the mastiff isn't in Bright Light, it can gain the Invisible condition until it makes an attack or is illuminated by Bright Light.

name: Shadow Mastiff Alpha
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +3, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +2
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing while not in Bright Light

traits.name: Ghostlight Hunter
traits.description: The mastiff can see into the Border Ethereal and can detect by scent the number and direction of each source of Bright Light within 1 mile.

traits.name: Shadowpack Alpha
traits.description: Whenever the mastiff takes a Bonus Action, each other shadow mastiff within 30 feet of it can use its Reaction to take a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mastiff makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Blackening Bay.

actions.name: Fearsome Jaws
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) psychic damage. A Frightened target hit with this attack gains the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) or the Prone condition (mastiff's choice).

actions.name: Blackening Bay
actions.description: A dreadful howl emerges from the mastiff in a 30-foot Emanation; each source of Bright Light in the area that is nonmagical or produced by a cantrip is snuffed out. Then, each creature of its choice in the area that isn't illuminated by Bright Light must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn). Success by 5 or More: The target is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

bonusActions.name: Swirling Shadow
bonusActions.description: If the mastiff isn't in Bright Light, it can teleport to an unoccupied space of Dim Light or Darkness that it can see within 30 feet.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Blend
bonusActions.description: If the mastiff isn't in Bright Light, it can gain the Invisible condition until it makes an attack or is illuminated by Bright Light.

name: Shadow Mastiff Howlpack
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -3
immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Ghostlight Hunter
traits.description: The howlpack can see into the Border Ethereal and can detect by scent the number and direction of each source of Bright Light within 1 mile.

traits.name: Stumbling Terror
traits.description: A Frightened creature that starts its turn in the Howlpack's space must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target gains the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) and the Prone condition.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The howlpack can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any opening large enough for a single shadow mastiff.

actions.name: Jaws from the Dark
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 0 ft. Hit: 31 (8d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 14 (4d6) psychic damage, or half as much damage if the howlpack is Bloodied.

actions.name: Blackening Chorus (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A dreadful howl emerges from the howlpack in a 60-foot Emanation; each source of Bright Light in the area that is nonmagical or produced by a spell of Level 2 or below is snuffed out. Then, each creature of its choice in the area that isn't illuminated by Bright Light must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn). Success by 5 or More: The target is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

bonusActions.name: Swirling Shadow
bonusActions.description: If the howlpack isn't in Bright Light, it can teleport to a space of Dim Light or Darkness that it can see within 30 feet, along with each creature Grappled by it.

reactions.name: Cringing Slink
reactions.description: When the howlpack becomes illuminated by Bright Light, it must use its Reaction, if available, to move up to 15 feet directly away from the light's source.

name: Shoosuva
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +6, Int -2, Wis +5, Cha +4
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; and Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Rampage
traits.description: When the shoosuva reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points on its turn, the shoosuva can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

traits.name: Opportunist
traits.description: The shoosuva has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature unless that creature hit it with a melee attack since the end of the shoosuva's last turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shoosuva makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail stinger.

actions.name: Latching Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 4) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 15 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned for the next minute. While Poisoned in this way, the target has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws and repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Crush Bones
actions.description: One creature grappled by the shoosuva takes 52 (8d12) Piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or suffer Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

name: Vargouille
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -3, Wis -2, Cha -4
languages: Understands Abyssal, Common and Infernal, but is unable to speak

traits.name: Screeching Flock
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of three or more vargouilles must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the start of its next turn, or become immune to this ability for 24 hours on a success.

traits.name: Poor Vision
traits.description: The swarm has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. As an action, a creature may attempt a DC 8 Charisma (Deception) check to convince the vargouille that something inedible is edible.

actions.name: Locking Bite
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft., *Hit* 5 (1d6 + 2) plus 10 (3d6) poison damage and the vargouille becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 12).

actions.name: Cursed Kiss
actions.description: The vargouille kisses an incapacitated creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 12 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed. While Cursed in this way, a creature loses 1 point of Charisma for each hour it spends in dim light or darkness. A creature that has its Charisma reduced to 0 in this way has its head tear free of its body and sprout wings, becoming a vargouille.

actions.name: Manic Shrieking (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The vargouille unleashes a piercing shriek in a 15-foot cone, forcing each creature in the area that can hear it to succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Psychic damage. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is Stunned until the end of the Vargouille's next turn. A Frightened creature makes this saving throw with Disadvantage.

name: Vargouille Swarm
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -3, Wis -2, Cha -4
immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
languages: Understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but is unable to speak

traits.name: Screeching Flock
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 60 ft. of the swarm must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to this ability for 24 hours.

traits.name: Poor Vision
traits.description: The swarm has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. As an action, a creature may attempt a DC 8 Charisma (Deception) check to convince the swarm that something inedible is edible.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a small creature. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Locking Bite
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft., *Hit* 16 (4d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison if the swarm has half of its Hit Points or fewer, and the swarm attaches to the target. While attached, the swarm can't attack another target, and may free itself as an Action or Bonus Action.

actions.name: Manic Shrieking (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The swarm unleashes a cacophony of piercing shrieks, forcing each creature within 20 feet that can hear it to succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is Stunned until the end of the Vargouille's next turn. A Frightened creature makes this saving throw with Disadvantage.

bonusActions.name: Cursed Kiss
bonusActions.description: The swarm showers an incapacitated creature in its space with kisses, forcing it to succeed on a DC 12 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed. While Cursed in this way, a creature loses 1 point of Charisma for each hour it spends in dim light or darkness. A creature that has its Charisma reduced to 0 in this way has its head tear free of its body and sprout wings, becoming a vargouille.

name: Cyclops Sentry
savingThrows: Str +6, Con +5, Int -1, Wis -2

traits.name: Evil Eye
traits.description: Whenever an enemy the cyclops can see within 60 feet makes a saving throw, it subtracts 1d4 from its result. While the cyclops is Blinded, it subtracts 1d4 from any saving throw it makes.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: Attacks made against the cyclops by a creature Attached to it have Advantage, and the cyclops has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures Attached to it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cyclops makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Cast Stone.

actions.name: Flared Greatcrook
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled until the end of the cyclops' turn.

actions.name: Cast Stone
actions.description: The cyclops throws a rock (or a creature Grappled by it) at a target within 40 feet, forcing it to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked Prone. Success: Half damage. If the cyclops threw a creature in this way, that creature must also make this saving throw.

actions.name: Titan Leap
actions.description: The cyclops leaps up to 30 feet, then each creature in a 10-foot Emanation from it must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 22 (5d8) Thunder damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

name: Cyclops Fatesmith
savingThrows: Str +6, Con +9, Int +3, Wis +8

traits.name: Evil Eye
traits.description: Whenever an enemy the cyclops can see within 60 feet makes a saving throw, it subtracts 1d4 from its result. While the cyclops is Blinded, it subtracts 1d4 from any saving throw it makes.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: Attacks made against the cyclops by a creature Attached to it have Advantage, and the cyclops has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures Attached to it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cyclops makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Catastrophe Looms.

actions.name: Sunclothed Fist
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) radiant damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Catastrophe Looms (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: The cyclops cries out an ominous decree, forcing one creature it can see within 60 feet to make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The creature is Cursed. When the Cursed creature would take any damage due to failing a saving throw, it instead takes twice as much damage and the curse ends.

actions.name: Dawn Flare (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Searing light cascades upon a creature the cyclops can see within 60 feet, forcing it to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 44 (8d10) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage. A creature that takes 50 or more Radiant damage from this spell additionally begins Burning (1d6).

bonusActions.name: Future Sight (Level 2 Spell)
bonusActions.description:
The cyclops chooses a creature it can see within 60 feet and rolls 2d20, choosing one of the results.
The next time that creature makes a d20 Test, it uses that result instead of rolling.

name: Cyclops Seared-One
savingThrows: Str +12, Dex +1, Con +5, Int +3, Wis +7, Cha +9

traits.name: Evil Eye
traits.description: Whenever an enemy the cyclops can see within 60 feet makes a saving throw, it subtracts 1d4 from its result. While the cyclops is Blinded, it subtracts 1d4 from any saving throw it makes.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: Attacks made against the cyclops by a creature Attached to it have Advantage, and the cyclops has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures Attached to it.

traits.name: Seared One's Fury (3/Day)
traits.description: When the cyclops starts its turn Restrained or Incapacitated, it can choose one of the following effects. The cyclops and each other creature in a 15-foot Emanation from it each take 11 (2d10) Psychic damage. The cyclops gains Advantage on all saving throws until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cyclops makes two attacks with its Fateforged Maul, one of which it can replace with a use of its Transfix with Power.

actions.name: Fateforged Maul
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 10 ft. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet. On a Critical Hit, the target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target drops to 0 Hit Points if it has fewer than 20 Hit Points.

actions.name: Transfix with Power (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Up to two creatures the cyclops can see within 60 feet must each make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 14 (4d6) Lightning damage and the creature is Restrained (escape DC 17) until the end of the cyclops' next turn.

actions.name: Brightfire Bolt (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +9 range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) lightning damage plus Hit: 22 (4d10) radiant damage. On a miss, the cyclops can make a second attack roll against another target that is directly behind the first.

actions.name: Crush of Aeons (Recharge 5-6, Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: *The weight of endless stone bears down from all sides.* One creature the cyclops can see within 60 feet must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 27 (5d10) Bludgeoning damage plus 17 (5d6) Fire damage and the target's Size is decreased by one category until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic. Success: Half damage. While a creature's Size is reduced in this way, it deals half as much damage with attacks that use Strength.

bonusActions.name: Gather Charge (Concentration)
bonusActions.description: On the cyclops' following turn, its attacks deal an additional 11 (2d10) Lightning damage on a hit.

bonusActions.name: Future Sight (Level 2 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The cyclops chooses a creature it can see within 60 feet and rolls 2d20, choosing one of the results. The first time that creature would make a d20 Test before the start of the cyclops' next turn, it uses that result instead of rolling.

legendaryActions.name: Maul Crash
legendaryActions.description: The cyclops moves up to half its Speed and makes a Fateforged Maul attack.

legendaryActions.name: Shockwave Stomp
legendaryActions.description: The cyclops stomps, sending forth a shockwave in a 15-foot Cone. Each creature in the area must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 13 (3d8) Thunder damage and the creature is pushed up to 10 feet away.

name: Ettin Backbreaker
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -2, Cha -1

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.description: The ettin has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Double Actions
traits.description: The ettin rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

actions.name: Calloused Fist
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A prone creature hit with this attack is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Sweeping Lunge
actions.description: The ettin spreads its arms and moves up to its speed, forcing each Medium or smaller creature in its path to succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Death Hug
actions.description: Each creature grappled by the ettin must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is released from the grapple, falls prone, and is unable to stand for the next minute.

reactions.name: Smash Flat
reactions.description: When a creature misses the ettin with a melee attack, the ettin can force it to succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or take 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

name: Ettin Wrath Chanter
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex -1, Con +4, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.description: The ettin has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and knocked Unconscious.

traits.name: Double Actions
traits.description: The ettin rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

actions.name: Bonechopper Hack-Axe
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. If the ettin's Rage Song is active, this attack scores a critical on a 19-20.

actions.name: Wicked Club
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the ettin's Rage Song is active, the target is additionally pushed up to 10 feet away on a hit.

actions.name: Rage Song (Concentration)
actions.description: The ettin begins a magical chant, recounting millenia of grievances and evoking uncontrollable rage in all who hear it. Attacks made by creatures within 30 feet of the ettin deal an additional die of damage, and have Disadvantage if the attacker doesn't speak Giant, Goblin, or Orc.

reactions.name: Lash Out
reactions.description: When the ettin succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can move up to half its speed toward the spell caster or make a melee attack against it.

reactions.name: Invoke Fury
reactions.description: When the ettin is targeted with an attack by a creature affected by its Rage Song, it can force the attacker to make a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target or lose the attack. If the creature fails this saving throw by 5 or more, the ettin chooses the new target.

name: Ettin Vessel Twin
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex -1, Con +9, Int +1, Wis +6, Cha +8

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.description: The ettin has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and knocked Unconscious.

traits.name: Double Actions
traits.description: The ettin rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

traits.name: Demon-Packed Vessel
traits.description: The ettin counts as Possessed for the purposes of spells and magical effects. If an effect would end this condition, the ettin instead dies and explodes in a shower of gore. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Force damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Thick-Fingered Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Soulfouled Runebrick
actions.description: Attack: +10 range 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) psychic damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.

actions.name: Curse of Cracking Bones
actions.description: One creature grappled by the ettin must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed until it fails a death saving throw. While Cursed in this way, a creature has vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Hatesick Bond (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: When a creature targets the ettin with a ranged attack, the ettin can deal 7 (2d6) poison damage to it. If the attack hits, the ettin takes an equal amount of poison damage.

reactions.name: Vessel Unsealed (Concentration, 1/Day)
reactions.description: When the ettin is reduced below 111 Hit Points, evil flames begin to spill from its eyes and mouth as the demons trapped within the ettin try to claw their way out. At the beginning of each of its turns, the ettin takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage, then can use its action to summon a Manes Vilespawn to an unoccupied space it can see within 15 feet.

name: Fomorian Glour
savingThrows: Str +6, Con +5, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha -2

traits.name: Hexborn
traits.description: Attacks against the fomorian score a Critical Hit on a 19-20. Whenever a Critical Hit is scored against the fomorian, it is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: Attacks made against the fomorian by a creature Attached to it have Advantage, and the fomorian has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures Attached to it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fomorian makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Thundering Stomp or Warp-Hex Glare.

actions.name: Twistroot Club
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet. A target with one or more points of Exhaustion is additionally knocked Prone on a hit.

actions.name: Thundering Crush
actions.description: Each creature in a 15-foot Cone must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 13 (3d8) Thunder damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away. Success: Half damage. A Prone creature has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Warp-Hex Glare (Recharges when Bloodied)
actions.description: One creature the fomorian can see within 60 feet must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 21 (6d6) Psychic damage and the target gains a point of Exhaustion that lasts for 1 minute. Success: The fomorian and the target each take 10 Psychic damage.

name: Fomorian Deepcrawler
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +3, Con +5, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha -2

traits.name: Crawler
traits.description: While it is Prone, the fomorian's movement is not slowed, it ignores the effects of Disadvantage, and it can climb difficult surfaces without a check.

traits.name: Hexborn
traits.description: Attacks against the fomorian score a Critical Hit on a 19-20. Whenever a Critical Hit is scored against the fomorian, it is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: Attacks made against the fomorian by a creature Attached to it have Advantage, and the fomorian has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures Attached to it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fomorian makes three melee attacks, one of which it can replace a use of its Quernstone Bolas or Crawl-Hex Glare.

actions.name: Hideous Fist
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the fomorian can Grapple the target (escape DC 18) if it does not have a creature Grappled. A creature Grappled in this way takes this attack's damage on a hit, even if it is not the attack's target.

actions.name: Quernstone Bolas
actions.description: Attack: +10 range 40/120 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked Prone. If this attack exceeded the target's AC by 5 or more, the target is additionally Restrained (escape DC 18) until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Crawl-Hex Glare (Recharges when Bloodied)
actions.description: One creature the fomorian can see within 60 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 31 (6d6 + 10) Psychic damage and the target falls Prone. Success: The fomorian and the target each take 10 Psychic damage. A Prone creature that fails this saving throw is additionally Cursed for 1 hour; whenever the Cursed creature stands from Prone, it takes 10 Psychic damage.

name: Fomorian Woundsage
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +1, Con +5, Int +1, Wis +6, Cha +8

traits.name: Hexborn
traits.description: Attacks against the fomorian score a Critical Hit on a 19-20. Whenever a Critical Hit is scored against the fomorian, it is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: Attacks made against the fomorian by a creature Attached to it have Advantage, and the fomorian has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures Attached to it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fomorian makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Plague of Thorns.

actions.name: Sistrum Warstaff

reactions.name: Predictive Sway (Level 1 Spell)

*Shadow and caster, dragged into deeper darkness* One creature the drow can see within 60 feet. Strength Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The target is dragged up to 20 feet in a direction of the drow's choice.

Then, if the target is not in Bright Light, it has the Restrained condition (escape DC 18) until it is illuminated by Bright Light.

name: Drow Matron Mother
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +4, Con +10, Int +3, Wis +11, Cha +12

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: The drow has Disadvantage on d20 tests made to attack or perceive a target while either the drow or its target are in Sunlight.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: The drow has Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

traits.name: Ruthless Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If the drow fails a saving throw, it can force an ally within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 19 Charisma Saving Throw or suffer the effects of the saving throw in their stead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The drow makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Poison Thoughts or Insidious Pulse, if available.

actions.name: Matron's Lash-Scepter
actions.description:
Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 4) force damage and the target gains a Venom Counter that lasts for an hour.

Whenever the creature fails a saving throw to resist or end the Poisoned condition, it takes Hit: 3 (1d6) poison damage for each Venom Counter it has. A creature with 3 or more Venom Counters can't benefit from Immunity to Poison Damage or the Poisoned Condition.

actions.name: Poison Thoughts (Level 6 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: *The delirium of sickness gives way to the clarity of submission.* One Poisoned creature that the drow can see within 60 feet has the Poisoned condition end for it, then must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: the target is Dominated by the drow for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). Success: the target is Charmed by the drow until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Insidious Pulse (Recharge 5-6, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: *Foes stagger as one before a single ruined heartbeat.* Each creature of the drow's choice in a 30-foot Emanation from it. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: 21 (6d6) Poison damage and the creature has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Mass Unraveling (1/Day, Level 8 Spell)
actions.description:
The drow furrows the weave, disrupting magic in a 300-foot long, 15-foot wide Line within 500 feet.

Each spell effect in the area of Level 7 or below ends. Each other magical item or effect in the area is suppressed until the end of the drow's next turn.

actions.name: Fatal Flaw (1/Day, Level 9 Spell)
actions.description:
The drow touches a creature and each of its deepest fears, wounds, and weaknesses unfolds before the drow.

For 1 hour, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws against effects the drow controls, and any attack the drow hits the target with becomes a Critical Hit.

bonusActions.name: Her Eye is Upon You
bonusActions.description:
The drow draws Lolth's attention to an ally she can see within 60 feet, granting it Advantage on the first d20 Test it makes before the end of its next turn.

If the affected d20 Test fails, the ally takes 20 Psychic damage and is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Demonic Compulsion
bonusActions.description: One allied Demon or Charmed creature that the drow can see within 30 feet can use its Reaction to make a melee attack.

reactions.name: Lolth's Scorn
reactions.description:
Trigger: An ally the drow can see within 60 feet becomes Incapacitated or dies. Response: The ally explodes in a 15-foot Emanation of venomous spiders.

Each creature in the area. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: 14 (4d6) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage Success: Half damage

reactions.name: Handmaiden Anointment (1/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: The drow is Bloodied. Response: Each corpse in a 30-foot Emanation from the drow turns to sludge, then the drow summons a Yochlol ally in an unoccupied space in the area.

legendaryActions.name: Preservation of Lolth
legendaryActions.description:
The drow or a friendly creature she can see within 30 feet is warded by dark power.

The next time an enemy targets the warded creature with an attack or spell before the beginning of the drow's next turn, it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: The hostile creature must choose a different target, or have its attack or spell fail.

legendaryActions.name: Shadowslip (Level 2 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The drow teleports to an unoccupied space within 40 feet. This spell fails if the drow or its destination is illuminated by Bright Light.

legendaryActions.name: Power Word: Suffer (Costs 2 Actions, Level 5 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The drow speaks a word of Power, targeting a creature it can see within 60 feet. The target takes 25 Psychic damage and has the Dazed condition until the end of its next turn. This damage can't reduce a creature below 1 Hit Point.
