actions.description: The dwarf glares warily around. Until the start of its next turn, the dwarf regains its reaction at the beginning of each turn.

actions.name: Recite the Ancient Grudges (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature recorded in the grudgekeeper's grudgeledger within 30 feet that can hear the grudgekeeper must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the grudgekeeper's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is instead Paralyzed for the same duration.

name: Dwarf Runescribe
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +3, Con +5, Int +7, Wis +9, Cha +3

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: The dwarf has Advantage on saving throws against poison.

traits.name: Runewarded
traits.description: The dwarf has resistance to damage dealt by a creature more than 15 feet away from it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dwarf makes three attacks with its Foeborer Awl, one of which it may replace with a use of its Complete Rune.

actions.name: Foeborer Awl
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft., one target Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage and the target gains one runemark that lasts for a minute.

actions.name: Complete Rune (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the dwarf can see within 30 feet that has at least three runemarks takes 22 (4d10) radiant damage, then must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw or lose all runemarks and be cursed, gaining one effect of the dwarf's choice: Rune of Weakness. The creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength. Rune of Dishonor. Whenever the creature takes 20 or more damage from a single source, it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn. Rune of Ignominy. Each other creature has Advantage on saving throws against spells the creature casts.

actions.name: Iron Within, Iron Without (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Until the beginning of the runescribe's next turn, each other dwarf within 30 feet of it gains resistance to all damage.

reactions.name: Venerate the Ancestors (Level 4 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction when a friendly dwarf the runescribe can see dies, the runescribe thunderously recites that dwarf's name and lineage. Each other dwarf within 10 feet of the fallen dwarf gains 15 Temporary Hit Points. While a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, its melee attacks deal an additional 9 (2d8) Thunder damage.

name: Ermordenung
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +5, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +7

traits.name: Conspicuous Comfort
traits.description: The ermordenung has Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to conceal hostile intent.

traits.name: Entrancing Visage
traits.description: A creature that can see the ermordenung has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive anything other than the ermordenung.

traits.name: Kiss of Death
traits.description: If a charmed or willing creature kisses the ermordenung, the ermordenung makes a toxic touch attack against it at Advantage. If the attack hits, it deals maximum damage, instead of rolling.

actions.name: Toxic Touch
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 28 (8d6) poison damage. This attack treats creatures with Natural Armor or Unarmored Defense as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.).

actions.name: Effortless Charm (concentration)
actions.description: If the ermordenung spends at least 1 minute interacting with a creature, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed by it. The ermordenung may charm any number of creatures in this way, but each of these effects ends if it loses concentration.

actions.name: Entreat
actions.description: One creature charmed by the ermordenung moves up to its speed and makes an attack against a target of the ermordenung's choice. A creature compelled to attack one of its allies may then make a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw, ending the Charm on a success.

reactions.name: Feign Victimhood
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the ermordenung falls prone. The attacker must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or forget why they attacked the ermordenung for the next mintue.

name: Fey'ri Reveler
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +3, Con +3, Int +1, Cha +3

traits.name: Dread Revels
traits.description: The fey'ri has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are Frightened.

traits.name: Demonblooded
traits.description: The fey'ri has Advantage on saving throws against effects that deal Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the fe'ri takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the fe'ri takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Thorned Dagger (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Piercing damage.

actions.name: Contaminated Volley (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +8 range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 Piercing damage plus 2 poison damage. If three or more fey'ri contributed to this attack, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or contract Walking Sepsis.

actions.name: Ecstatic Cull
actions.description: The fey'ri makes a Thorned Dagger attack against a friendly creature with fewer than 25 Hit Points. On a hit, the target dies and each creature of the fey'ri's choice within 30 feet that can see it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the fey'ri's next turn.

name: Fey'ri Marauder
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Dread Revels
traits.description: The fey'ri has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are Frightened.

traits.name: Demonblooded
traits.description: The fey'ri has Advantage on saving throws against effects that deal Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fey'ri makes two attacks.

actions.name: Bladehoof Kick
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical on an 18-20 against a prone creature, or one the fey'ri's Wicked Warhook is attached to.

actions.name: Wicked Warhook
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 15 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage and the hook attaches to the target (remove DC 14). While the hook is attached to a creature, the fey'ri cannot make attacks with this weapon, may spend 10 feet of its movement drag the creature up to 5 feet toward it, and may detach the hook as a Bonus Action. The attached creature cannot move away from the fey'ri, and takes 2 Piercing damage for every 5 feet it is dragged in this way.

actions.name: Rain of Fire (Recharge 5-6, Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Three bolts of fire flare from the sky, each exploding in a 5-foot radius centered on a point within 90 feet that the fey'ri can see. Each flammable object in the area ignites, and each creature not beneath cover in the area of one or more of the explosions must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

reactions.name: Jink
reactions.description: As a reaction when the fey'ri is hit with a ranged attack while at least 10 feet in the air, the fey'ri halves the attack's damage.

name: Fey'ri Skin Dancer
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +7, Con +7, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +4

traits.name: Dread Revels
traits.description: The fey'ri has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are Frightened.

traits.name: Demonblooded
traits.description: The fey'ri has Advantage on saving throws against effects that deal Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fey'ri makes two attacks with its Fleshbond Spike, one of which it may replace with a use of its Skin Dance, if available.

actions.name: Fleshbond Spike
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage and the spike embeds in the creature and bonds to its flesh. Whenever the creature takes an action or bonus action, it takes 1 Piercing damage for each spike embedded in it. A creature may remove one of these spines as an action, taking 5 Slashing damage for each spike removed.

actions.name: Disfigure (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and the creature must make a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 9 (2d8) Slashing damage as a handprint of skin peels off of it, suffering Disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks until cured by Lesser Restoration or similar magic.

actions.name: Skin Dance (Recharge 5-6, Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: The fey'ri assumes the appearance of a humanoid creature it can see within 60 feet, then teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. While the fey'ri is within 5 feet of the creature it is mimicking, a creature with a Passive Insight of 14 or lower that attempts to target one of them with an attack or spell instead selects one of them at random as the target.

name: Fey'ri Bloodwright
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +4, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +5

traits.name: Dread Revels
traits.description: The fey'ri has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are Frightened.

traits.name: Demonblooded
traits.description: The fey'ri has Advantage on saving throws against effects that deal Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fey'ri makes three attacks with its Demonic Lash, one of which it may replace with a use of its Bloodflame Spear, if available.

actions.name: Demonic Lash (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 15 ft. Hit: 5 (2d4) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage. A target hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the fey'ri's next turn.

actions.name: Bloodflame Spear (Level 3 Spell, Recharge 5-6, Spell)
actions.description: The fey'ri dashes up to 15 feet in a straight line, then a line of solid fire extends from its palm in a 15-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Fire damage plus 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and be pushed 15 feet away, or take half as much damage on a successs. If the fey'ri has fewer than half its Hit Points, each affected creature subtracts 1d4 from the result of its saving throw.

actions.name: Sanguine Cyclone (1/Day, Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The fey'ri conjures forth a raging whirlwind of blood in a 15-foot radius centered on a point it can see within 150 feet that lasts for a minute. The area is difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or lose one unexpended hit die, or drop to 0 Hit Points if it cannot. Whenever a creature loses a hit die in this way, the whirlwind's radius grows by 5 feet, then each creature in its area takes 3 (1d6) Slashing damage.

name: Daemonfey Progenitor
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +11, Int +7, Wis +7, Cha +5

traits.name: Backstabber
traits.description: Attacks of opportunity made by the daemonfey score a critical on an 18-20.

traits.name: Dread Revels
traits.description: The daemonfey has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are Frightened.

traits.name: Demonblooded
traits.description: The fey'ri has Advantage on saving throws against effects that deal Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The daemonfey makes four attacks; two with each of its Swordbreaker Cinquedas.

actions.name: Swordbreaker Cinquedas
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the weapon's blades are fanned out, instead of dealing damage the daemonfey may force the target to succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or have one object it is carrying flung 15 feet away.

actions.name: Gore Inversion (1/Day, Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: One Unconscious or Paralyzed creature the daemonfey can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or die and be turned inside out in a spray of gore. Each creature of the daemonfey's choice within 60 feet that can see the target is Frightened until the end of the daemonfey's next turn.

actions.name: Conjure Hunt (1/Day, Level 7 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The daemonfey conjures two Yeth Hounds that last for a minute in unoccupied spaces it can see within 60 feet. The yeth hounds act on its initiative and under its control. If the daemonfey's concentration ends, the yeth hounds dissolve into smoke.

bonusActions.name: Fan Blades
bonusActions.description: The daemonfey fans two additional blades out from one of its Swordbreaker Cinquedas. Until it furls the blades as a bonus action, the daemonfey adds 1 to its AC and has Disadvantage with attacks made with that weapon.

bonusActions.name: Flickering Advance (Recharge 5-6, Level 3 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The daemonfey begins to move with magically empowered speed until the start of its next turn, or until it is hit with an attack. The daemonfey's speed is doubled, attacks against it are made at Disadvantage, and whenever it is missed with an attack it may teleport up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Blade Blossom
reactions.description: As a reaction when the daemonfey scores a critical hit with one of its Swordbreaker Cinquedas, it uses its Fan Blades bonus action, dealing 18 (4d8) additional Slashing damage to the target.

reactions.name: Song of Defense (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking damage, the daemonfey reduces that damage by 25.

name: Firenewt Warrior
savingThrows: Dex +1, Con +1, Int -2, Cha -1

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The firenewt can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Cold Blooded
traits.description: If the firenewt takes Cold damage, it cannot make more than one attack on its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The firenewt makes two attacks with its scimitar.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Regrow Limb
actions.description: The firenewt regrows one missing limb, which bursts out in a gout of scalding steam. The firenewt regains the use of its limb, and each creature in a 15 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Fire damage and be unable to speak or breathe until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Drop Limb
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking 6 or more damage, the firenewt drops one of its limbs, reducing the damage taken to 5. A firenewt that drops an arm loses the use of either its scimitar or shield. A firenewt that drops a leg reduces its maximum speed by half.

name: Formian Worker
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +2, Con +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the formian takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the formian takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

traits.name: Spiracle Breathing
traits.description: The formian has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws against inhaled toxins.

traits.name: Hive Mind
traits.description:
Formians within 50 miles of their queen are in constant communication. If one is aware of a
particular danger, they all are.

actions.name: Mandibles (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 Piercing damage.

actions.name: Make Whole
actions.description: The formian repairs a single breach in a structure or vehicle no more than 3 ft. across, filling the space with its body. While using this ability, the formian is restrained.

reactions.name: Hive Frenzy
reactions.description: When another formian within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the formian can move up to 10 feet toward it.

name: Formian Soldier
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +2, Wis +1

traits.name: Spiracle Breathing

traits.name: Hive Mind
traits.description:
Formians within 50 miles of their queen are in constant communication. If one is aware of a
particular danger, they all are.

actions.description: The formian makes three melee attacks, one of which may either be with its mandibles or sting.

actions.name: Mandibles
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Drillmark Spear
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 +3) piercing damage. A creature hit twice by this attack in a turn must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: One prone creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 17 (5d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Hive Frenzy
reactions.description: When another formian within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the formian can move up to 10 feet toward it.

name: Formian Observer
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +4, Wis +4, Cha +5

traits.name: Spiracle Breathing
traits.description: The formian has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws against inhaled toxins.

traits.name: Hive Mind
traits.description:
Formians within 50 miles of their queen are in constant communication. If one is aware of a
particular danger, they all are.

actions.name: Mandibles
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Seek Weakness
actions.description: The observer forces a creature within 30 ft. that it can see to succeed on a DC 15 Charisma (Deception) check or grant all formians Advantage on attacks that target it until the end of the oberver's next turn.

actions.name: Evaluate Remains
actions.description: The observer dissects the corpse of a formian that was killed by a weapon attack in the last minute. The formian gains resistance to damage from that weapon for the next hour, or until it uses this ability again.

reactions.name: Critical Observation
reactions.description: As a reaction to a friendly formian it can see succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the formian marks the event. For the next 24 hours, each formian that shares a queen with the observer has Advantage on saving throws against that spell or magical effect.

name: Formian Winged Warrior
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +2, Wis +1

traits.name: Spiracle Breathing
traits.description: The formian has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws against inhaled toxins.

traits.name: Hive Mind
traits.description:
Formians within 50 miles of their queen are in constant communication. If one is aware of a
particular danger, they all are.

actions.description: The formian makes three attacks, one of which may be with its mandibles.

actions.name: Mandibles
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Drillmark Spear
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 +3) piercing damage. A creature hit twice by this attack in a turn must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Tail Spines
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 100/200 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and the spine embeds in the target's flesh. The target's speed is reduced by 5 ft. for each spine embedded in it. As an action, a creature may remove all of the spines embedded in it, either by making a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check, or by taking 4 (1d8) Slashing damage per spine removed.

reactions.name: Hive Frenzy
reactions.description: When another formian within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the formian can move up to 10 feet toward it.

name: Formian Armadon
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +4, Wis +1

traits.description: The formian has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws against inhaled toxins.

traits.name: Hive Mind
traits.description:
Formians within 50 miles of their queen are in constant communication. If one is aware of a
particular danger, they all are.

traits.name: Brittle Exoskeleton
traits.description: If the formian takes 15 or more Bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 14 until it completes a short or long rest.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.description: When the formian dies, it explodes in a burst of acid. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Acid damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The formian makes two attacks, one of which may be with its mandibles.

actions.name: Mandibles
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 14 (4d6) poison damage. This attack scores a critical on a 19-20 against a grappled creature.

actions.name: Grasping Claws
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). A creature grappled by both claws is restrained.

actions.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The formian sprays acid in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) Acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Hive Frenzy
reactions.description: When another formian within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the formian can move up to 10 feet toward it.

name: Giff Lance Corporal
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Honourable Fealty
traits.description: While the giff is within 60 feet of a giff of higher CR, it may reroll up to two damage dice on each of its turns. If it does so, it must use the new roll.

traits.name: Null Hide
traits.description: The giff has resistance to damage from spells of second level or below. It cannot use or be targeted by magic items.

traits.name: Danger Close
traits.description: The Giff lives for the music of battle. It has resistance to damage from magical or nonmagical effects that affect a sphere or cube. If the giff fails a saving throw against such an effect, its next attack is made at Advantage.

actions.name: Cavalry Saber
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Flintlock Pistols
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 30/90 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage. The giff has a brace of eight pistols, each of which may fire once before requiring a short rest to fire again. *Pack More Powder!* The giff overstuffs its musket with powder. The next shot the giff fires with it deals 6 (1d12) additional damage, to a maximum of 13 (2d12) additional damage.

actions.name: Musket (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 40/120 ft. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage. If this attack deals 20 or more damage, the wielder takes half as much damage as Fire damage.

actions.name: Juggernaut Charge
actions.description: The giff attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes 1d8 damage for each 10 feet it was pushed.

name: Giff Leftenant
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +4, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Honourable Fealty
traits.description: While the giff is within 60 feet of a giff of higher CR, it may reroll up to two damage dice on each of its turns. If it does so, it must use the new roll.

traits.name: Null Hide
traits.description: The giff has resistance to damage from spells of third level or below. It cannot use or be targeted by magic items.

traits.name: Danger Close
traits.description: The Giff lives for the music of battle. It has resistance to damage from magical or nonmagical effects that affect a sphere or cube. If the giff fails a saving throw against such an effect, its next attack is made at Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Giff uses its Impact Grenade twice. It may replace one of these with a use of its Juggernaut Charge.

actions.name: Impact Grenade
actions.description: The giff throws a grenade up to 60 feet. Each creature within 15 feet of the grenade's detonation must make a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw, taking 14 (4d6) Piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that succeeds on this save by 5 or more and has a free hand may use its reaction to catch the grenade, preventing its detonation. A giff leftenant typically carries eight grenades at a time.

actions.name: Juggernaut Charge
actions.description: The giff attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes 1d8 damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

reactions.name: Aim, You Buffoons!
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a friendly creature miss with an attack, the Giff berates its allies. Each friendly creature that can hear it gains Advantage on the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

name: Githyanki Raider
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +3, Wis +3

traits.name: Iron Mind
traits.description: The githyanki has Advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws. If the githyanki starts its turn with the Charmed condition, it and the creature it is Charmed by each take 3 (1d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The githyanki makes two attacks with its Far-Silver Falchion.

actions.name: Far-Silver Falchion
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage plus Hit: 4 (1d8) psychic damage. *Critical Hit:* If the target is affected by the Astral Projection spell, the githyanki can sever its silver cord.

actions.name: Comet Shard (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +3 range 150 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) radiant damage. If this attack was made with Advantage, it deals an extra 11 (2d10) Force damage on a hit.

bonusActions.name: Wellspring Leap (2nd-Order Power)
bonusActions.description: The githyanki leaps up to 30 feet. Opportunity Attacks provoked by this movement have Disadvantage.

name: Githyanki Ardent
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +4, Int +5, Wis +3

traits.name: Iron Mind
traits.description: The githyanki has Advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws. If the githyanki starts its turn with the Charmed condition, it and the creature it is Charmed by each take 3 (1d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Comet Shard (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +3 range 150 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) radiant damage. If this attack was made with Advantage, it deals an extra 11 (2d10) Force damage on a hit.

actions.name: Psyforce Crescent (3rd-Order Power)
actions.description: The githyanki hurls a whirling blade of psychic energy down a 30-foot long, 5-foot wide Line, forcing each creature in the area to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 17 (5d6) Psychic damage. Failure by 5 or More: The creature is Dazed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Static Surge (3rd-Order Power)
actions.description: Psychic energies crackle and spark in a 10-foot Emanation within 60 feet, forcing each creature in the area to make an Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The first time each turn that the creature takes or deals any Psychic damage, it takes 4 (1d8) Lightning damage (Save Ends at end of turn).

bonusActions.name: Kinetic Shield (2nd-Order Power, Concentration)
bonusActions.description: The githyanki gains a +2 bonus to its AC.

bonusActions.name: Target Matrix (Level 1 Spell, Concentration)
bonusActions.description: An illusory array of guidemarks appear in the air around a creature the githyanki can see within 120 feet. Until the end of the githyanki's next turn, or until the target moves at least 10 feet, all Ranged attacks have Advantage against it.

name: Githyanki Star-Seer
savingThrows: Con +5, Int +7, Wis +6, Cha +2

traits.name: Iron Mind
traits.description: The githyanki has Advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws. If the githyanki starts its turn with the Charmed condition, it and the creature it is Charmed by each take 3 (1d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Hammer Sanity (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: *Melee Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) psychic damage. traits.name: Supreme Manifestation (1/Day, Mythic Trait)
traits.description:
When the githzerai is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall Unconscious. Instead, it resets to 204 Hit Points and reshapes the world around it in a 30-foot Emanation for 1 minute, with the following effects: Creatures of the githzerai's choice can't leave the area, and the area counts as Difficult Terrain for them. Nothing outside the area can affect anything within it. If the githzerai would miss with an attack against a creature in the area, it instead hits.

If the githzerai leaves the area or is Incapacitated, the effect ends.

When a new goblin crowns itself, each other goblin in a 30-foot Emanation gains Advantage on attacks and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Noble Shriek
legendaryActions.description:
The goblin shouts a flurry of nonsensical and conflicting commands at up to two goblins within 30 feet that can hear it.

 Each of the targets can use its Reaction to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The target does one of the following, chosen at random. Success: The target can choose one of the following effects.

 1. The target can make a weapon attack.
 2. The target can use an item or make a skill check.
 3. The target moves half its speed directly away from the nearest enemy.
 4. The target falls prone, bowing deeply.

reactions.name: Trade Up

actions.name: Riot Prism (Recharge 5-6, Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description:
The goblin touches an allied goblin, splitting it into dozens of alternate versions of itself and transforming it into one of the following swarms, chosen at random:
1. Goblin Highsticker Gang
2. Goblin Snoop Gang
3. Goblin Blackfinger Gang
4. Goblin Hacker Gang

When the spell ends, or if the swarm is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it returns to its original form and Hit Points.

reactions.name: Crowd-Duck
reactions.description: Trigger: An enemy targets the goblin with an attack or spell while the goblin is within 5 feet of one or more other goblins. Response: The enemy must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The enemy must choose a new target or have its attack or spell fail.

reactions.name: Powder Trap
reactions.description:
Trigger: An ally within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Response: The ally explodes in a 10-foot radius Emanation.

Each creature in the area. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 14 (4d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

legendaryActions.name: Pile In (Costs 2 Actions)

traits.description: If the shadar-kai ends its turn without dealing or receiving damage, its AC is reduced by 2 until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Veil of Shadows
traits.description: The shadar-kai is invisible while in dim light or darkness.

traits.name: Shadow Weft
traits.description: A shadar-kai within 30 ft. that hits with a melee attack increases its movement by 5 and doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity until the end of its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shadar-kai makes two attacks with its blade and uses its Gloom Cage, if available.

actions.name: Blackened Blade
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage and Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, and the creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded while in Bright Light for the next minute. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Gloom Cage (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Up to two creatures within 30 ft. in dim light or darkness must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or be Restrained (escape DC 15) as wisps of darkness tether it in place for the next minute, or until it is exposed to bright light.

name: Shadar-Kai Gloom Weaver
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +5, Con +8, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +4

traits.name: Pain Focus
traits.description: While it has fewer than 96 Hit Points, the shadar-kai may dash or make a melee attack as a bonus action.

traits.name: Creeping Apathy
traits.description: If the shadar-kai ends its turn without dealing or receiving damage, its AC is reduced by 1 until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Umbral Weapon
traits.description: The shadar-kai treats its spear as arbitrarily long (up to 120 ft.), as long as the attack doesn't pass through or into any areas of bright light.

traits.name: Armor of Years
traits.description: A creature that hits the gloom weaver with a melee attack takes 25 Necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or age 1d4 x 5 years. This trait is then disrupted until the end of its next turn. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shadar-kai makes two attacks with its darkspear.

actions.name: Darkspear
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be disoriented, making attacks at Disadvantage until the end of its next turn. Additionally, a creature that fail this save falls prone if it misses with a melee attack on its next turn.

reactions.name: Shadow Jaunt
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking damage, the shadar-kai magically teleports up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Both the space it teleports from and to must be in dim light or darkness. Until the start of its next turn, the shadar-kai has resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and Slashing damage.

name: Shadar-Kai Blacksoul
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +6, Con +3, Int +1, Wis +6, Cha +9

traits.name: Pain Focus
traits.description: While it has fewer than 103 Hit Points, the shadar-kai may dash or make a melee attack as a bonus action.

traits.name: Creeping Apathy
traits.description: If the shadar-kai ends its turn without dealing or receiving damage, its AC is reduced by 2 until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Deep Shadow
traits.description: Areas of dim light or darkness within 15 ft. of the shadar-kai count as difficult terrain for creatures of its choice. Hostile creatures that start their turn in the area, or enter the area for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shadar-kai makes two attacks with its Corrupting Blackfire and uses either its Curse of Beshadowed Mind or Curse of the Bloody Tongue.

actions.name: Corrupting Blackfire
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 15 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage and Hit: 5 (1d10) necrotic damage and catch fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes Hit: 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and can't benefit from healing magic.

actions.name: Curse of Beshadowed Mind
actions.description: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, the range of the creature's darkvision, if it has it, is reduced to 10 ft., and the creature has Disadvantage on Dexterity and Wisdom Saving Throws while in bright light

actions.name: Curse of the Bloody Tongue
actions.description: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, whenever the creature attempts to speak or cast a spell it must first succeed on a DC 16 Consitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe this turn.

reactions.name: Snuff
reactions.description: As a reaction to a source of light entering the radius of its Deep Shadow trait, the shadar-kai extinguishes it.

name: Shadovar Shadowcaster
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +2, Int +2, Wis +1

traits.name: Shadow-Arcanist
traits.description: Checks made to detect, dispel or negate magic cast by the Shadovar have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Shadovar makes two attacks with its Shadows' Siphon, one of which it can replace with a use of its Bleak Snare or Repulse Light.

actions.name: Shadows' Siphon (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 100 ft. Hit: 13 (3d8) necrotic damage. If the target is not illuminated by Bright Light, it additionally gains Disadvantage on the first Strength-based d20 roll it makes before the end of the Shadovar's next turn.

actions.name: Bleak Snare (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the Shadovar can see within 60 feet has its shadow drawn into deeper darkness, forcing the target to make a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, the target is dragged up to 20 feet. If it ends this movement in Dim Light or Darkness, the target is restrained in place (escape DC 12) until illuminated by Bright Light.

actions.name: Repulse Light (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: A torrent of shadows stream forth from the Shadovar in a 30-foot cone, pushing each light source in the area up to 30 feet away, or extinguishing it if it can't be pushed. A creature carrying an affected light source can make a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw, resisting the effect on a success.

actions.name: Sculpt Shadows (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Shadovar creates 3 (1d4 + 1) Shadow Stalkers in unoccupied spaces of Darkness it can see within 30 feet. The shadows act on the Shadovar's turn and under its control, and disappear after 1 minute or if it uses this ability again.

name: Shadovar Gloom-Adept
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +5, Int +6, Wis +1

traits.name: Shadow-Arcanist
traits.description: Checks made to detect, identify, dispel or negate magic cast by the Shadovar have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Glimpse of True Nothing (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The Shadovar opens the mind of a creature it can see to the infinite void that envelops the aberration of existence, forcing it to succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened and Dazed until the end of its next turn. On a successful saving throw or when the spell ends for it, the target takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more is unaffected by the spell.

actions.name: Glyph of Unmaking (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: The Shadovar scribes a glyph of roiling shadow in the air at a point it can see within 60 feet. Each creature in a 5-foot radius centered on it must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma Saving Throw or take 27 (5d10) Force damage, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this damage turns to shadow and melts away, disintegrating entirely.

actions.name: Shadow Hollow (1/Day, Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The Shadovar transforms a 15-foot cubic segment of an object it can see within 60 feet to an illusory version of itself. The transformed segment acts as empty space. When this effect ends, each creature and object in the space is ejected to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 5 (1d10) Force damage.

actions.name: Shadowself Alliance (1/Day, Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The Shadovar animates its own shadow, creating a Shadow Puppeteer that acts on the Shadovar's turn and under its control.

name: Shadovar Evincar
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +7, Con +2, Int +6, Wis +1

traits.name: Shadow-Arcanist
traits.description: Checks made to detect, identify, dispel or negate magic cast by the Shadovar have Disadvantage.

traits.name: On Wings of Black
traits.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the Shadovar has a fly speed equal to its movement speed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Shadovar makes two attacks with its Nightsinger's Rapier, one of which it can replace with a use of its Darkvault or Sculpt Shadows, if available.

actions.name: Nightsinger's Rapier
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus Hit: 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. A creature hit for the second time on a turn with this attack has one light it is carrying extinguished.

actions.name: Darkvault (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The shadows in a 60-foot radius around the Shadovar deepen to utmost black. Each region of Darkness within the affected area becomes Magical Darkness, and can't be illuminated by nonmagical sources or by cantrips.

actions.name: Sculpt Shadows (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Shadovar creates 3 (1d4 + 1) Shadow Stalkers in unoccupied spaces of Darkness it can see within 30 feet. The shadows act on the Shadovar's turn and under its control, and disappear after 1 minute or if it uses this ability again.

reactions.name: Shroudstep Vindication (Level 2 Spell)
reactions.description: When the Shadovar is hit with an attack by a creature it can see within 30 feet, it can teleport to an unoccupied space of Dim Light or Darkness within 5 feet of the attacker and make a melee weapon attack against it. If the vindicator teleports 10 feet or fewer in this way, this attack has Advantage.

name: Shadovar High Depriver
savingThrows: Dex +3, Con +7, Int +8, Wis +8, Cha +3

traits.name: Shadow-Arcanist
traits.description: Checks made to detect, identify, dispel or negate magic cast by the Shadovar have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Veil of Deprivation
traits.description: When a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the Shadovar, the Shadovar can force it to succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed, or become immune to this effect for 24 hours on a success. A creature Cursed in this way recovers no resources other than Hit Points upon completing a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Nurtured Spite (3/Day)
traits.description: When the Shadovar succeeds on a saving throw to end an ongoing condition, it can immediately take an action.

actions.name: Reave Spirit (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +8 range 60 ft. Hit: 27 (6d8) psychic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or lose attunement to one magic item it is attuned to (target's choice).

actions.name: Smothering Gloom (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Darkness pours into the mouth and nose of a creature in Dim Light or Darkness that the Shadovar can see within 60 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or begin Choking. When the creature ends its turn in Bright Light, it can repeat this saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Banish Hope (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A wave of overwhelming despair washes forth from the Shadovar in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or fall prone and be Dazed for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Shadowstuff Mockery (Level 6 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The Shadovar conjures a semi-real Darkweaver that acts on its turn and under its control in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet. While concentrating on this spell, the Shadovar takes 5 Psychic damage at the beginning of each of its turns and can't voluntarily end its concentration.

actions.name: Umbral Oubliette (Recharge 5-6, Level 8 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature the Shadovar can see within 60 feet sinks into its shadow, falling into the great nothing that lies beneath and before everything. The creature takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage at the beginning of each of its turns, and can use its action to attempt to claw its way out (escape DC 16), ending the effect on a success. When it does, a creature within 5 feet of the space it departed can use its reaction to give the creature Advantage on its check.

reactions.name: Embrace Loss (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: When the Shadovar would make a saving throw, it can choose to fail. If it does, it gains 15 Temporary Hit Points that last until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Shadow Slip
legendaryActions.description: The Shadovar teleports up to 30 feet to a location it can see that is not in Bright Light.

legendaryActions.name: Stain the Soul (Level 3 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: One creature the Shadovar can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened of each source of Bright Light it can see until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Reave Spirit (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The Shadovar makes an attack with its Reave Spirit.

name: Sun Elf Outrider
savingThrows: Dex +3, Con +2, Int +2, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Mastercraft Tack
traits.description: While mounted, the elf's mount acts on its initiative, instead of rolling its own, and can disengage as a bonus action.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: The elf has Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the elf to sleep.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the elf takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the elf takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Storied Cullblade (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 Slashing damage. If this attack targeted a fey creature, it deals an additional 2 damage.

actions.name: New Sun's Glory (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +5 range 30 ft. Hit: 5 radiant damage. If at least three elves contributed to this group attack, the next attack against the target is made with Advantage. :

name: Sun Elf Loremaster
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +3, Con +3, Int +4, Wis +2, Cha +2

traits.name: Keeper of the Old Lore
traits.description: The elf and each of its allies within 30 feet score a critical hit on a 19-20 against non-elves.

traits.name: Heritor of Corellon
traits.description: While in sunlight, spell attack rolls made by the elf are made at Advantage.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: The elf has Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the elf to sleep.

actions.name: Multitattack
actions.description: The elf makes two attacks with its Branchgold Stave.

actions.name: Branchgold Stave
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) radiant damage and the target is teleported up to 10 feet to an unoccupied location the elf can see.

actions.name: Memory Torrent (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +7 range 60 ft. Hit: 16 (3d10) psychic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence Saving Throw or be Blinded and Deafened until the end of the elf's next turn as it relives a long-past memory.

actions.name: Ancient Valor's Echoes (Level 4 Spell, Recharge 5-6, Concentration)
actions.description: The loremaster summons 5 spectral Sun Elf Outriders in unoccupied spaces it can see within 30 feet that act initiative count 0 under the loremaster's control.

reactions.name: Consign to Myth (Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the elf can see within 60 feet drops to 0 Hit Points, the elf banishes it to a harmless demiplane where it immediately stabilizes. As an action, the creature may attempt a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw, returning to the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed on a success.

name: Sun Elf Spellblade
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +4, Con +7, Int +8, Wis +6

traits.name: Heritor of Corellon
traits.description: While in sunlight, spell attack rolls made by the elf are made at Advantage.it.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: The elf has Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spellblade makes three attacks; two with its Strike-Saga Blade and one with its Gilt-Chain Whip, and uses its Flickering Advance if available.

actions.name: Strike-Saga Blade
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) lightning damage. On a critical hit, a flash of electricity issues forth in a 15-foot cone centered on the target. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) lighting damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Gilt-Chain Whip
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Flickering Advance (Recharge 5-6, Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The spellblade begins to move with magically empowered speed until the start of its next turn, or until it is hit with an attack. The spellblade's speed is doubled, attacks against it are made at Disadvantage, and whenever it is missed with an attack it may teleport up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Song of Defense (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking damage, the spellblade reduces that damage by 25.

reactions.name: Sheltering Wind (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being targeted with a melee attack, the spellblade forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away and have its attack miss.

name: Sun Elf High Mage
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +3, Con +10, Int +11, Wis +9, Cha +7

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: The elf has Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the elf to sleep.

traits.name: Heritor of Corellon
traits.description: While in sunlight, spell attack rolls made by the elf are made at Advantage.

traits.name: Perfected Form
traits.description: The elf's spells cannot be affected or detected by magic of a lower level.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elf makes two attacks with its Gleaming Zephyr.

actions.name: Gleaming Zephyr (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +11 range 60 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) radiant damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet in a direction of the elf's choice.

actions.name: Knell of Despair (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Each creature of the elf's choice within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or fall prone and be unable to stand on its following turn.

actions.name: Scouring Bloom (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: The elf causes whirling petals of light to unfurl in a 20-foot radius centered on a point it can see within 300 feet in an effect that lasts a minute. A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or take 33 (6d10) radiant damage and be Blinded until the start of its next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Couragous Surge (Recharge 5-6, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: Each creature of the elf's choice within 60 feet of it gains 10 Temporary Hit Points. While a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it has Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws and its attacks deal an additional 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Ancestral Shelter (1/Day, Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: The elf raises a spectral barrier that extends a distance of the elf's choice, is centered on itself, and lasts for an hour. The barrier blocks all incoming spells and ranged attacks, though creatures may pass through without resistance, and whenever the barrier takes damage the elf must make a saving throw to maintain concentration as if it had taken the same damage.

actions.name: Create Mythal (1/Year, Level 10 Spell)
actions.description: The elf creates an extraordinary, long-lasting change to the way magic behaves in a 5 mile radius centered on a point it can see, then must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma Saving Throw or die. A creature that dies in this way cannot be resurrected by any means.

reactions.name: Step Outside Time (Level 4 Spell, 3/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction when the sun elf would fail a saving throw, it instead teleports to a harmless demiplane and suffers none of the saving throw's effects. After 1d4 turns, the elf teleports back to the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed.

name: Troglodyte Warrior
savingThrows: Str +2, Con +2, Int -2, Cha -2

traits.name: Chameleon Skin
traits.description: The troglodyte has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide from creatures more than 30 feet away.

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Any creature other than a troglodyte that starts its turn within 5 feet of the troglodyte must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all troglodytes for 1 hour.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the troglodyte has Disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troglodyte makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage and the target can't benefit from magical healing until the start of the troglodyte's next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the troglodyte can grapple the target (escape DC 12).

name: Troglodyte Mauler
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +2, Int -2, Cha -1

traits.name: Chameleon Skin
traits.description: The troglodyte has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide from creatures more than 30 feet away.

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Any creature other than a troglodyte that starts its turn within 5 feet of the troglodyte must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all troglodytes for 1 hour.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the troglodyte has Disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troglodyte makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and the target can't benefit from magical healing until the start of the troglodyte's next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the troglodyte can grapple the target (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Blood Shot (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The troglodyte releases a gout of blood from one of its eyes. One creature within 15 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take take 14 (4d6) poison damage and be Poisoned until the end of the troglodyte's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Puff Up
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 ft. of the troglodyte, the troglodyte gulps air, making itself appear larger. The creature must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom Saving Throw or fall prone.

name: Warforged Soldier
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +3, Wis +2

traits.name: Single Minded Focus
traits.description: When initiative is rolled, the warforged marks a creature as its target. The first attack the warforged makes each turn against that creature is made at Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The warforged makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Grapplebolt Launcher.

actions.name: Retractable Armblade
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Grapplebolt Launcher
actions.description: Attack: +3 range 40/80 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage and the bolt embeds itself in the target. Until a creature removes the bolt as an action with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check, the target cannot move away from the warforged, the warforged can't attack with this weapon, and the warforged may spend 5 feet of its movement to drag the creature 5 feet towards it.

reactions.name: Rapid Assessment
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature marked as the warforged's target begins to cast a spell, the warforged moves up to half its speed or makes a melee attack against it.

name: Warforged Greenshadow
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +3

traits.name: Single Minded Focus
traits.description: When initiative is rolled, the warforged marks a creature as its target. The first attack the warforged makes each turn against that creature is made at Advantage.

traits.name: Light-Bending Alloy
traits.description: The greenshadow is invisible to creatures more than 30 feet away from it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The warforged makes three attacks with its Greenshadow Armbow.

actions.name: Battlefist
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Greenshadow Armbow
actions.description: Attack: +5 range 100/400 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Rapid Assessment
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature marked as the warforged's target begins to cast a spell, the warforged moves up to half its speed or makes a melee attack against it.

name: Psyforged
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +3, Wis +2

traits.name: Single Minded Focus
traits.description: When initiative is rolled, the warforged marks a creature as its target. The first attack the warforged makes each turn against that creature is made at Advantage.

traits.name: Deep Crystal Resonance
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the psyforged gains one of the following benefits until it uses this ability again. * Dazeglow. A creature hit by one of the psyforged's melee attacks must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence Saving Throw or be unable to make more than one attack on its following turn. Deceleration Field A creature hit by one of the psyforged's melee attacks loses its reaction and moves at half its speed until the beginning of the psyforged's next turn. Inertial Armor. The psyforged gains +2 AC.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The psyforged makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Augmented Battlefist
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: Inflict Distress
actions.description: One creature the psyforged can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Psychic damage and be Frightened and unable to concentrate until the beginning of the psyforged's next turn.

reactions.name: Recall Agony
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature within 30 feet that is marked as the psyforged's target takes any damage, the psyforged forces it to succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence Saving Throw or take the same amount of Psychic damage.

reactions.name: Rapid Assessment
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature marked as the psyforged's target begins to cast a spell, the warforged moves up to half its speed or makes a melee attack against it.

name: Warforged Juggernaut
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +1, Con +8, Wis +3, Cha +2

traits.name: Single Minded Focus
traits.description: When initiative is rolled, the warforged marks a creature as its target. The first attack the warforged makes each turn against that creature is made at Advantage.

traits.name: Constructed Perfection
traits.description: The warforged has Advantage on saving throws against any effect that would incapacitate it, and any critical hit against it becomes a normal hit.

traits.name: Bladed Body
traits.description: If the juggernaut moves at least 20 feet in a straight line on its turn, each creature within 5 feet of where it ends its turn takes 7 (2d6) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
