actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage. If the target is grappled, the yurian may shear through part of its armor, reducing the AC offered by it by a permanent and cumulative 1.

reactions.name: Molt
reactions.description: As a reaction to failing a saving throw, the yurian bursts from its shell, reducing its AC to 9 and ending all conditions on itself, then moves up to half its speed. This reduction lasts until it completes a Short or Long Rest, and it make take this reaction even while incapacitated.

name: Yurian Brack-Dredger
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex -1, Con +5, Int +1, Wis +2

traits.name: Indifferent Disposition
traits.description: The yurian always counts as a willing target for any spell.

traits.name: Ductile Carapace
traits.description: Whenever the yurian takes any Bludgeoning damage,, its AC is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 9, until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yurian makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Seizer Claw
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15) and dragged up to 5 feet towards the yurian.

actions.name: Crusher Claw
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or suffer Disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a Short or Long rest.

actions.name: Feeding Frenzy (Recharge 5-6, Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the yurian can see within 30 feet is swarmed by spectral piranhas for the next minute. At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it takes 5 (1d10) Piercing damage, or 11 (2d10) Piercing damage if it is underwater. A creature killed by this damaged is reduced to a skeleton.

reactions.name: Scuttle
reactions.description: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the yurian moves up to 10 feet. If this movement puts the yurian out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the yurian is unaffected.

reactions.name: Molt
reactions.description: As a reaction to failing a saving throw, the yurian bursts from its shell, reducing its AC to 9 and ending all conditions on itself, then moves up to half its speed. This reduction lasts until it completes a Short or Long Rest, and it make take this reaction even while incapacitated.

name: Jackalwere
savingThrows: Dex +2, Int +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The jackalwere can use its action to polymorph into a specific Medium human or a jackal-humanoid hybrid, or back into its true form (that of a Small jackal). Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The jackalwere has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The jackalwere has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the jackalwere's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sleep Gaze
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more jackalweres that can see it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom Saving Throw or fall asleep for the next minute. A creature wakes early if it takes damage, or if another creature uses its action to wake it. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the jackalwere until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Vicious Scimitar
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. On a critical hit, this attack deals an additional 7 damage.

name: Rolywere
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +1, Con +2, Wis +3, Cha +2
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a bonus action, the rolywere can transform into a Small pillbug-humanoid hybrid, or back into its Small pillbug form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its pillbug form if it dies.

traits.name: Moist Underside
traits.description: The rolywere can breathe only while its torso is slightly damp. While in a dry environment, the rolywere must dampen its chest at least once every twelve hours to maintain its moisture.

traits.name: Rolystone Bearer
traits.description: The rolywere can tell, by touch, how long a plant or creature has been dead.

actions.name: Prickly Antennae
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage and the rolywere learns what organic items the target is carying, what it ate for its last meal, and if it is afflicted with any disease.

actions.name: Curl Up
actions.description: The rolywere curls its body into a small ball, gaining the following effects until it uses an action to uncurl: The rolywere's AC is increased to 16 Attacks of opportunity against the rolywere and checks made to grapple it are made at Disadvantage. The rolywere can't take actions other than to Dash or uncurl.

reactions.name: Anxious Scrunch
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature ends its movement within 15 feet of the rolywere, the rolywere uses its Curl Up ability.

name: Wereape
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex -1, Con +5, Int -1, Wis -1, Cha -2
resistances: Attacks made without Advantage; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the wereape can transform into a Huge ape-giant hybrid or into a Huge ape, or back into its true form, which is giant. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the wereape can gain Advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have Advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Juggernaut Leap
traits.description: The wereape's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start. If the wereape jumps at least 20 feet, it may land in the space of any large or smaller creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone. On a successful save, is instead pushed 5 feet out of the wereape's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the wereape may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the wereape. While climbing on the wereape, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the wereape, and the wereape has Disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

traits.name: Cursed Resilience
traits.description: When the wereape is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 Hit Points, it is killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wereape makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Brutal Shove, if available.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tree Trunk
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 5 feet away. Creatures within 5 feet of the target must make a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw, taking half the attack's damage on a failed save.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Attack: +9 range 30/120 ft. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Body Slam
actions.description: The wereape throws itself prone in a 15-foot square. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Bludgeoning damage. A creature that is climbing on the wereape has Disadvantage on the save, and takes maximum damage if it fails. A creature that succeeds takes half damage, but may use its reaction to move up to ten feet, taking no damage if it ends this movement outside the area of effect. The wereape can't stand from prone this turn.

actions.name: Brutal Shove (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Up to two creatures within 15 feet of the giant and 15 feet of each other must make a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 20 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet away. A creature may fall prone as a reaction to gain Advantage on this save.

reactions.name: Kick Away
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the wereape, the wereape forces it to succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone, pushed 10 feet away, and lose concentration if it was holding it.

name: Werebadger
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +3, Wis +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the werebadger can transform into a badger-humanoid hybrid, into a Large badger, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Poppy Weakness
traits.description: If hit with a weapon coated in poppy oil, the werebadger must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be forced to revert to its humanoid form and be Poisoned for the next minute. While Poisoned, the werebadger cannot use its shapechanger trait.

traits.name: Ornery
traits.description: If the werebadger drops to 0 Hit Points, it makes a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. On a success, it gains 1 hit point. The werebadger makes this save at Advantage if at least one hostile creature is adjacent to it.

traits.name: Cursed Resilience
traits.description: When the werebadger is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 Hit Points, it is killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The werebadger makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Snarling Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Scything Shovelclaws (Badger or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (3d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Loosen Skin
reactions.description: As a reaction when the werebadger would make an attack with Disadvantage due to being restrained, it instead makes an attack at Advantage.

reactions.name: Relentless Assault
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature attempting to leave its reach, the werebadger makes a claw attack. If the attack hits, the target is grappled.

name: Werebear
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +3, Wis +1, Cha +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the werebear can transform into a Large bear-humanoid hybrid, into a Large bear, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The werebear has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Concussive Strength
traits.description: A creature knocked prone by the werebear must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

traits.name: Cursed Resilience
traits.description: When the werebear is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 Hit Points, it is killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The werebear makes two attacks with its claws and one with its bite.

actions.name: Ripping Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Claws
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage and the target suffers one additional effect of the werebear's choice. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 15) and restrained. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone. The target must succeeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or have one item it is holding knocked out of its grip and flung 10 feet away.

name: Wereboar
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +2, Cha -1

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the wereboar can transform into a boar-humanoid hybrid, into a Large boar, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Frantic Charge
traits.description: When the wereboar takes the Dash action, it may make one melee attack as a Bonus Action. If this attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Cursed Resilience
traits.description: When the wereboar is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 Hit Points, it is killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wereboar makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its Tusk Gore.

actions.name: Ploughsledge Maul (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Bristling Fist (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Tusk Gore (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. A prone target takes an additional 7 (2d6) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Foaming Defiance (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking damage that would reduce it to 0 Hit Points, the wereboar makes a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw. On a success, the wereboar is instead reduced to 1 hit point. If triggered by Piercing damage or a critical hit, this saving throw is made at Disadvantage.

name: Werecrocodile
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +3
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the werecrocodile can transform into a Large crocodile-humanoid hybrid, into a Large crocodile, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Grapple Vulnerability
traits.description: While in hybrid or crocodile form, the werecrocodile can be grappled by a creature up to two sizes smaller than it.

traits.name: Cursed Resilience
traits.description: When the werecrocodile is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 Hit Points, it is killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The werecrocodile makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Vicegrip Bite (Hybrid or Crocodile Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the crocodile can't bite another target.

actions.name: Khopesh (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage and the creature gains no benefit from wielding a shield until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Tail Lash (Hybrid or Crocodile Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft., one target not grappled by the werecrocodile. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Death Roll (Crocodile Form Only, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A creature grappled by the crocodile must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 45 (10d8) Slashing damage and be Stunned until the end of the crocodile's next turn, or half as much damage on a success. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this ability loses a limb (werecrocodile's choice). The werecrocodile may not use this ability if it is grappled.

name: Wererat
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +1, Cha -1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the wererat can transform into a rat-humanoid hybrid, into a Large rat, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Quick Squeeze
traits.description: The wererat may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

traits.name: Cursed Resilience
traits.description: When the wererat is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 Hit Points, it is killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wererat makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Gnawing Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Scrabbling Claws (Rat or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage and the target must succeed on on a DC 11 Constituton saving throw or be infected with Filth Fever.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Wereraven
savingThrows: Dex +2, Int +2, Wis +1, Cha +2
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the wereraven can transform into a raven-humanoid hybrid, into a Tiny raven, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Aerobat
traits.description: At the beginning of each other creature's turn, the wereraven may move up to 10 feet without provoking attacks of upportunity.

traits.name: Cursed Resilience
traits.description: When the wereraven is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 Hit Points, it is killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wereraven makes two attacks.

actions.name: Gouging Peck (Raven or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage in raven form, or Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage in hybrid form. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be blinded in one eye until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

actions.name: Shortsword (Human or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow (Human or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Croaked Omen (1/Day)
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet that can hear the raven must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed until it completes a Long Rest. While cursed in this way, a creature has Disadvantage on Death saving throws and on saving throws against being Frightened.

name: Wereserpent
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +1, Int +2
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the wereserpent can transform into a serpent-humanoid hybrid, into a Large snake, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Cursed Resilience
traits.description: When the wereserpent is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 Hit Points, it is killed.

traits.name: Braille
traits.description: While in hybrid or snake form, the wereserpent's eyes are covered by transparent scales that protect them from harm. It has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, and Advantage on saving throws to avoid being Blinded.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wereserpent makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Venomous Bite (Hybrid or Snake Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Recurve Longbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 150/600 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Constrict (Hybrid or Snake Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained.

reactions.name: Crush (Hybrid or Snake Form Only)
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature the wereserpent has grappled with its Constrict ability speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the wereserpent crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature cannot breathe until the grapple ends and immediately begins to suffocate.

name: Wereshark
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha -1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.description: The wereshark has Advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.

traits.name: Electrosensitive
traits.description: If the wereshark takes 10 or more Lightning damage from a single source, it has Disadvantage on attacks until the end of its following turn.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the wereshark can transform into a shark-humanoid hybrid, into a shark, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Cursed Resilience
traits.description: When the wereshark is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 Hit Points, it is killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wereshark makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Serrated Bite
actions.description:
Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed.

At the beginning of each of its turns, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or lose 2 (1d4) Hit Points, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Claw (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Tail Slam (Shark Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away from the wereshark.

actions.name: Ram (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The wereshark moves at least 20 feet in a straight line towards a creature that does not have all its Hit Points and makes a bite attack against it. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be stunned until the end of the wereshark's next turn.

reactions.name: Circle (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 56 Hit Points, the wereshark moves up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity and recharges its Ram. Each creature of its choice within 30 feet that has fewer than 20 Hit Points must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn.

name: Mawtouched Wereshark
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +7, Con +10, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +9
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.description: The wereshark has Advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.

traits.name: Electrosensitive
traits.description: If the wereshark takes 10 or more Lightning damage from a single source, it has Disadvantage on attacks until the end of its following turn.

traits.name: Vessel of the Maw's Will (Mythic Trait, 1/day)
traits.description: When the wereshark is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it gains 161 Temporary Hit Points and transforms into a Huge two-headed shark, gains a fourth legendary action each round, and it immediately regains all spent legendary actions.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the wereshark fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wereshark makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its bite if in humanoid form, or two with its bite and one with its tail slam if in shark form.

actions.name: Serrated Bite
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of its turns, the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or lose 5 (2d4) Hit Points, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Claw (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 15 ft. Hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 19).

actions.name: Tail Slam (Shark Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 15 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the wereshark.

actions.name: Bloodletting Breath (Shark Form Only, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The wereshark exhales two 60-foot long, 10-foot wide streams of corrupted water. Each creature in one or more of those lines must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw, losing 42 (10d6) Hit Points on a failed save, or losing half as many Hit Points on a successful one. A creature with more than half its maximum Hit Points makes this save at Advantage.

legendaryActions.name: Circle
legendaryActions.description: The wereshark moves up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. Each creature of its choice within 50 feet that has fewer than 20 Hit Points must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Hungering Current
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled 15 ft. toward the wereshark. A creature with fewer than half of its maximum Hit Points is instead pulled 30 ft. on a failed save.

legendaryActions.name: Ram (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The wereshark moves at least 20 feet in a straight line towards a creature that does not have all its Hit Points and makes a bite attack against it. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be stunned until the end of the wereshark's next turn.

name: Weretiger
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +3, Wis +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the weretiger can transform into a tiger-humanoid hybrid, into a tiger, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Stalking Pounce
traits.description: If the weretiger is hidden from each hostile creature, it may Dash as a Bonus Action. A creature the weretiger hits with a claw attack on the same turn must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Cursed Resilience
traits.description: When the weretiger is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 Hit Points, it is killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The weretiger makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Throat-Ripper Bite.

actions.name: Throat-Ripper Bite (Hybrid or Tiger Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16). A creature already grappled by the weretiger takes an additional Hit: 9 (2d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Retractable Claws
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Daunting Roar (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description: As a Bonus Action, the weretiger lets out a menacing roar. Each hostile creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or become Frightened of the weretiger until the end of the weretiger's next turn.

name: Werewolf
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +2
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the werewolf can transform into a wolf-humanoid hybrid, into a wolf, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The werewolf has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Cursed Resilience
traits.description: When the werewolf is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to Dash. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 Hit Points, it is killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The werewolf makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Cursed Bite.

actions.name: Cursed Bite (Hybrid or Wolf Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hunting Spear (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 10 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw Rake
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Werewolf Pack Leader
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +6, Con +7, Cha +5
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the werewolf can transform into a wolf-humanoid hybrid, into a wolf, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell

traits.name: Cursed Resilience

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The pack leader has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pack Leader
traits.description: Other werewolves have Advantage on attacks against creatures adjacent to the pack leader.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The werewolf makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Cursed Bite.

actions.name: Cursed Bite (Hybrid or Wolf Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw Rake
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dread Howl (Recharge 5-6, Hybrid or Wolf Form Only)
actions.description: The werewolf emits a keening howl in a 30-foot radius. Each non-allied creature in the area that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the werewolf's next turn. A creature Frightened in this way must take the Dash action and move away from the werewolf by the safest available route on its turn, unless there is nowhere to move.

reactions.name: Rapid Retaliation
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the werewolf moves up to half its speed. If it ends this move adjacent to the attacker, it may make a bite attack against it as part of this reaction.

name: Alkada
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex -1, Int -2, Wis -3, Cha -3
languages: Understands Common but can't speak it.

traits.name: Suction Feet
traits.description: The alkada can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. While doing so, it makes a loud popping noise with each step.

traits.name: Slippery Mind
traits.description: The alkada is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.description: When the alkada dies, beams of psionic energy lance out in every direction. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The alkada makes 9 attacks with its noodle hooks.

actions.name: Noodle Hooks
actions.description: Attack: +1 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d8 - 1) piercing damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 9). If a creature escapes this grapple, the alkada loses 5 (2d4) Hit Points and makes one fewer attack with its multiattack until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Flap Arms
actions.description: The alkada frantically flaps its arms, generating a small field of antimagic around itself. Until the start of its next turn, the alkada can't be affected or detected by spells or magical effects.

reactions.name: Flailing Magic
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking damage while not flapping its arms, the alkada forces each creature within 10 ft. of it to roll on the Wild Magic Surge table (PHB p. 104)

name: Alp Fleetling
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +9, Con +3, Int +2, Cha +6

traits.name: Crushing Weight
traits.description: Prone creatures in the alp's space are Choking and can't stand.

traits.name: Uncanny Speed
traits.description: Opportunity Attacks made against the alp have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The alp makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Unbreathing Shriek.

actions.name: Nightmare Bite
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) poison damage. A sleeping creature hit with this attack for the first time in a day does not wake, and gains no benefit from its rest.

actions.name: Claw Rake
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) slashing damage. If this attack hits a creature twice in one turn, the alp can knock the target Prone or Grapple it (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Unbreathing Shriek (Recharge 5-6, Concentration)
actions.description: A continuous screech rips forth from the alp in a 30-foot Cone until the start of its next turn. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution {{font-variant:small-cap Saving Throw:}} DC 14. Failure: 9 (2d8) Thunder damage and the creature is pushed up to 15 feet away. The area counts as Difficult Terrain, and creatures in the area are Dazed.

bonusActions.name: Unnatural Lunge
bonusActions.description: The alp leaps up half its Speed. Then, if it is in at least Half Cover, it can attempt to Hide.

bonusActions.name: Blood Feast
bonusActions.description: Immediately after hitting a creature with its Nightmare Bite, the alp can drain the target's blood, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target loses 1 unexpended Hit Die, or drops to 0 Hit Points if it can't.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: The alp shape-shifts, gaining a Humanoid appearance and losing its Fly Speed, or returning to its true batlike form. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged.

name: Alp Phantom

traits.name: Uncanny Speed
traits.description: Opportunity Attacks made against the alp have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Blood Purge (2/Day)
traits.description: At the end of the alp's turn, it can end one condition affecting it or regain 15 Hit Points. Whenever the alp drains one or more Hit Dice with its Blood Feast, it regains a use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The alp makes two attacks, then can use its Unbreathing Shriek, if available.

actions.name: Nightmare Bite
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage. A sleeping creature hit with this attack for the first time in a day does not wake, and gains no benefit from its rest.

actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage. If this attack hits a creature twice in one turn, the alp can knock the target Prone or Grapple it (escape DC 14).

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: The alp shape-shifts, gaining a Humanoid appearance and losing its Fly Speed, or returning to its true batlike form. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged.

reactions.name: Nimble Shift
reactions.description: Trigger: The alp is targeted with an attack. Response: The attack gains Disadvantage and the alp can move up to 10 feet.

reactions.name: Frenzied Slash
reactions.description: Trigger: A Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of the alp stands from Prone. Response: The alp makes a Claw Rake attack against it. If the attack hits, the target is knocked Prone.

name: Ankheg Nymph
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -5, Cha -2

traits.name: Half-Formed Exoskeleton
traits.description: Attacks with weapons that deal Bludgeoning damage are made at Advantage against the ankheg.

traits.name: Acid Burst
traits.description: When the ankheg is killed, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 1 Acid damage.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the ankheg takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the ankheg takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Gnawing Mass (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 damage. If at least three ankhegs contributed to this group attack and the target is wearing leather or cloth armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers.

name: Adult Ankheg
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +1, Int -5, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Brittle Exoskeleton
traits.description: If the ankheg takes 10 or more Bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 11 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Burrowing Terror
traits.description: If the ankheg starts its turn buried underground, it has Advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its turn.

actions.name: Fleshmelter Mandibles
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) acid damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). While grappled in this way, a creature takes 3 (1d6) Acid damage at the end of each of its turns.

actions.name: Spined Claw Strike
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 3 (1d4) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be knocked prone and Stunned until the end of the ankheg's next turn.

actions.name: Acid Drench (Recharge 6)
actions.description: If the ankheg has no creature grappled, it spits steaming acid in a 30-foot long, 5-foot wide line. Each creature in that line must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Acid damage, or half as much on a success. If the ankheg has a creature grappled, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 17 (5d6) Acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Seething Vitriol (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking 10 or more Fire damage in a turn, the ankheg immediately recharges its Acid Drench.

name: Ankheg Clutchmother
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +7, Int -3, Wis +4, Cha +6

traits.name: Burrowing Terror
traits.description: If the ankheg starts its turn buried underground, it has Advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its turn.

traits.name: Clutchmother
traits.description: When the ankheg dies, 10 Ankheg Nymphs that act on its turn burst from its corpse at the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ankheg makes two attacks with its Spined Claw Strike, one of which it may replace with its Fleshmelter Mandibles or its Burial Store.

actions.name: Fleshmelter Mandibles
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) acid damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16). While grappled in this way, a creature takes 7 (2d6) Acid damage at the end of each of its turns.

actions.name: Spined Claw Strike
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 5 (2d4) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be knocked prone and Stunned until the end of the ankheg's next turn.

actions.name: Burial Store
actions.description: The ankheg rapidly excavates a 5-foot deep hole, shoves a creature it has grappled in it, then buries it (escape DC 16). While buried, a creature is Blinded, restrained, and can't speak or breathe.

actions.name: Acid Drench (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The ankheg spits steaming acid in a 40-foot long, 10-foot wide line. Each creature in that line must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Acid damage, or half as much on a success. A creature grappled by the Ankheg fails this save automatically.

reactions.name: Seething Vitriol
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking 10 or more Fire damage in a turn, the ankheg immediately recharges its Acid Drench.

name: Ankheg Mockery Drone
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +4, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -2
languages: Speaks common but doesn't understand it

traits.name: Flesh Suit
traits.description: The mockery drone is ensconced in a perfect disguise of flesh, indistinguishable from a normal humanoid. While disguised, the ankheg Scything Barbs and Brittle exoskeleton traits are inactive, its AC is 11, and it cannot use its Spiral Constriction. It may emerge from its disguise as a Bonus Action on its turn.

traits.name: Brittle Exoskeleton
traits.description: If the ankheg takes 10 or more Bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced by 3, to a minimum of 11, until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Scything Barbs
traits.description: Whenever the ankheg moves into a space for the first time on a turn, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 5 Slashing damage.

actions.name: Acid Spit
actions.description: Attack: +8 range 30 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) acid damage.

actions.name: Spiral Constriction
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: The ankheg enters the target's space and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16). While it has a target grappled in this way, the ankheg's speed is 0 and whenever it takes damage, the grappled creature takes an equal amount of Slashing damage.

actions.name: Terrifying Chatter
actions.description: The ankheg cheefully speaks an incomprehensible stream of inane and nonsensical chatter. Each creature that is concentrating on a spell that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or lose concentration.

reactions.name: Punishing Barbs
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature failing at an attempt to escape its grapple, the ankheg forces it to succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Piercing damage and be Stunned until the end of the ankheg's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

name: Ankheg Mockery Monarch
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +3, Con +9, Int +1, Wis +6, Cha -2
languages: Any language spoken by a creature it has eaten

traits.name: Burrowing Terror
traits.description: If the ankheg starts its turn buried underground, it has Advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its turn.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The ankheg can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The ankheg has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regurgitative Reflex (3/Day)
traits.description: If the ankheg would fail a saving throw while it has at least one creature swallowed, it may choose to succeed instead. If it does, it immediately regurgitates each swallowed creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ankheg makes three attacks with its Sickle-Claw Strike, one of which it may replace with its Cavernous Maw or a use of its Acid Nectar, if available.

actions.name: Cavernous Maw
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) acid damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Sickle-Claw Strike
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take half the attack's damage.

actions.name: Acid Nectar (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The ankheg releases any creatures it has grappled and regurgitates a glob of resinous, honey-like nectar in a 30-foot cone. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a non-ankheg creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 36 (8d8) Acid damage, then must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or be restrained until the start of its next turn (escape DC 17).

bonusActions.name: Swallow Whole
bonusActions.description: One creature grappled by the ankheg must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or be swallowed. While swallowed, the creature is Blinded and restrained, and its attacks bypass the ankheg's resistances. If the ankheg takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the ankheg regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

bonusActions.name: Mockery Drone Spawning
bonusActions.description: Each creature swallowed by the ankheg must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Acid damage, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this damage has its skull and spine disolved and replaced with a Ankheg Mockery Drone, then is immediately regurgitated by the ankheg.

reactions.name: Seething Vitriol
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking 10 or more Fire damage in a turn, the ankheg immediately recharges its Acid Nectar.

reactions.name: Spell Turning
reactions.description: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell that targets only it, the ankheg avoids all effects from the spell and instead causes the spell to target the caster.

name: Arrowhawk Fledgeling
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +4, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Aerobat
traits.description: At the beginning of each creature's turn, the arrowhawk moves up to 10 feet without provoking attacks of upportunity.

traits.name: Ram Ventilation
traits.description: The arrowhawk requires constant air flowing over its wings to survive. If the arrowhawk ends its turn without moving, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or drop to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The arrowhawk makes two attacks, each of which it may replace with the Dash or Disengage actions.

actions.name: Jagged Beak
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed, losing 1d4 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. This effect ends when a creature succeeds on a DC 12 medicine check to stanch the wound as an action, or when the bleeding creature receives magical healing.

reactions.name: Snap Roll
reactions.description: As a reaction when the arrowhawk is hit with an attack, it forces the attacker to reroll the attack with Disadvantage. If the attack hits regardless, the arrowhawk immediately falls up to 30 feet.

name: Arrowhawk Yearling
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +5, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Aerobat
traits.description: At the beginning of each creature's turn, the arrowhawk moves up to 10 feet without provoking attacks of upportunity.

traits.description: The arrowhawk requires constant air flowing over its wings to survive. If the arrowhawk ends its turn without moving, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or drop to 0 Hit Points.

actions.description: The arrowhawk makes two attacks, each of which it may replace with the Dash or Disengage actions.

actions.name: Jagged Beak
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed, losing 2 (1d4) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. This effect ends when a creature succeeds on a DC 12 medicine check to stanch the wound as an action, or when the bleeding creature receives magical healing.

actions.name: Lightning Ray (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Attack: +8 range 120 ft. Hit: 28 (8d6) lightning damage. If the arrowhawk took the Dash action this turn, this attack is made at Advantage.

reactions.name: Snap Roll
reactions.description: As a reaction when the arrowhawk is hit with an attack, it forces the attacker to reroll the attack with Disadvantage. If the attack hits regardless, the arrowhawk immediately falls up to 30 feet.

name: Arrowhawk Elder
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +6, Con +4, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +2

traits.name: Aerobat
traits.description: At the beginning of each creature's turn, the arrowhawk moves up to 15 feet without provoking attacks of upportunity.

traits.name: Ram Ventilation
traits.description: The arrowhawk requires constant air flowing over its wings to survive. If the arrowhawk ends its turn without moving, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or drop to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The arrowhawk makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Lightning Ray. It may replace any number of its attacks with the Dash or Disengage actions.

actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed, losing 2 (1d4) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. This effect ends when a creature succeeds on a DC 12 medicine check to stanch the wound as an action, or when the bleeding creature receives magical healing.

actions.description: Attack: +7 range 120 ft. Hit: 28 (8d6) lightning damage. If the arrowhawk took the Dash action this turn, this attack is made at Advantage.

reactions.name: Snap Roll
reactions.description: As a reaction when the arrowhawk is hit with an attack, it forces the attacker to reroll the attack with Disadvantage. If the attack hits regardless, the arrowhawk immediately falls up to 30 feet.

reactions.name: Charged Screech (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 77 Hit Points, the arrowhawk lets at a screech that fills the air with static charge. Each Arrowhawk Yearling within 60 feet immediately recharges its Lightning Ray, if available.

name: Astral Dreadnought (Sightless)
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex -2, Con +7, Int -3, Wis +7, Cha +4
immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Stunned

traits.name: Astral Brace
traits.description: The dreadnought cannot be banished or teleported out of the Astral Plane. A creature that hits the dreadnought with a melee weapon attack is pushed 15 feet away from it, unless it is grappling or Attached to the dreadnought.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: Attacks made against the dreadnought by a creature Attached to it have Advantage, and the dreadnought has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures Attached to it.

traits.name: Sightless Socket
traits.description: The dreadnought is Blinded and can't be cured by any means.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the dreadnought fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Timeless Maw
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 15 ft. Hit: 61 (8d12 + 9) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the dreadnought can force the target to succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or be drawn into the dreadnought's donjon. On a success, the target can prop the dreadnought's mouth open for a moment, allowing up to one creature within the donjon to use its reaction to escape.

actions.name: Cordcutter Claw
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 30 ft. Hit: 36 (5d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 22). On a critical hit, a target affected by the Astral Projection spell must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or die.

legendaryActions.name: Claw Crush
legendaryActions.description: One creature or object grappled by the dreadnought must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or take 38 (7d10) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Distortion Pulse
legendaryActions.description: A bubble of distorted space ripples out from the dreadnought in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) Psychic damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away.

legendaryActions.name: Inverting Escape
legendaryActions.description: The dreadnought disgorges each creature in its donjon, then can make a DC 22 Constitution check, swallowing itself and disappearing down the length of its body and into its donjon on a success. After 1 hour, the dreadnought reappears in a random unoccupied space in the Astral Plane.

name: Astral Dreadnought (Intact)
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +5, Con +7, Int -3, Wis +9, Cha +4
immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Stunned

traits.name: Astral Brace

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: Attacks made against the dreadnought by a creature Attached to it have Advantage, and the dreadnought has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures Attached to it.

traits.name: Keeper of the Gate (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
traits.description: If the dreadnought is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it resets to 210 Hit Points and opens its eye wide, revealing the endless, star-filled void within. For the next hour, a creature that deals 25 or more damage to the dreadnought with a melee weapon attack can make a DC 22 Strength check, gouging out the dreadnought's eye and Blinding it on a success.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the dreadnought fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dreadnought makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Timeless Maw.

actions.name: Timeless Maw
actions.description: Attack: +16 reach 15 ft. Hit: 61 (8d12 + 9) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the dreadnought can force the target to succeed on a DC 24 Strength Saving Throw or be drawn into the dreadnought's donjon. On a success, the target can prop the dreadnought's mouth open for a moment, allowing up to one creature within the donjon to use its reaction to escape.

actions.name: Cordcutter Claw
actions.description: Attack: +16 reach 30 ft. Hit: 36 (5d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 24). On a critical hit, a target affected by the Astral Projection spell must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution Saving Throw or die.

reactions.name: Spell Rupture
reactions.description: When a creature the dreadnought can see within 120 feet casts a spell, the dreadnought can scatter the magic, forcing the creature to make a DC 19 saving throw using its spellcasting attribute. On a failure, the spell fails and its magical force explodes in a 15-foot radius centered on a point between the creature and the dreadnought, dealing 11 (2d10) Force damage to each creature in the area.

legendaryActions.name: Cordcutter Claw
legendaryActions.description: The dreadnought makes an attack with its Cordcutter Claw.

legendaryActions.name: Claw Crush
legendaryActions.description: One creature or object grappled by the dreadnought must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution Saving Throw or take 38 (7d10) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Distortion Pulse
legendaryActions.description: A bubble of distorted space ripples out from the dreadnought in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 22 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) Psychic damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away.

legendaryActions.name: Conduit Shift
legendaryActions.description: The dreadnought psychically impels an astral conduit it can see within 120 feet, dragging it up to 60 feet toward the dreadnought. Each creature in the 10-foot wide space it passes through must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma Saving Throw (target's choice) or be teleported to one of the planes the conduit connects to.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Endless Gaze
legendaryActions.description: The dreadnought extends its starry gaze, forcing each creature it can see in a 120-foot cone to succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or be Dazed until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Inverting Escape
legendaryActions.description: The dreadnought disgorges each creature in its donjon, then can make a DC 22 Constitution check, swallowing itself and disappearing down the length of its body and into its donjon on a success. After 1 hour, the dreadnought reappears in a random unoccupied space in the Astral Plane.

name: Banderhobb Filch
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Wis +1, Cha -1
languages: Common and the languages of its creator but cant speak

traits.name: Resonant Connection
traits.description: If the banderhobb has even a tiny piece of a creature or an object in its possession, such as a lock of hair or a splinter of wood, it knows the most direct route to that creature or object if it is within 1 mile of the banderhobb.

traits.name: Shadow Diver
traits.description: The banderhobb treats areas of dim light or darkness as arbitrarily deep, interconnected pools of water. It can be faintly seen and targeted while submerged in these shadow-pools, though other creatures cannot ordinarily pass into them unless carried by a banderhobb.

traits.name: Shadow Squeezer
traits.description: As a bonus action, the banderhobb may attempt a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check to squeeze through a shadow between 1 inch and 2 ft. in diameter, using its Shadow Diver trait. If it fails by fewer than 5, it is still able to squeeze through, but leaves its People Sack behind.

traits.name: People Sack
traits.description: The banderhobb carries a magical burlap sack with the following properties: The sack is an extradimensional space that can hold up to 4 Medium creatures. The weight and appearance of the sack are not affected by the creatures in it. A creature that starts its turn in the sack must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or fall asleep until a creature takes an action to wake it. The sack has AC 15, 20 Hit Points, and vulnerability to Slashing damage. If ruptured, each creature in the sack appears within 5 ft. of the banderhobb. If the banderhobb is submerged in a shadow pool, the creatures appear at the surface of the nearest entrance.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The banderhobb makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage and the target is grappled. *Into the Sack!* One creature the banderhobb is grappling or hidden from must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or be thrown into the banderhobb's People Sack.

name: Banderhobb Abductor
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +1, Con +5, Wis +2, Cha -1
languages: Common and the languages of its creator but cant speak

traits.name: Resonant Connection
traits.description: If the banderhobb has even a tiny piece of a creature or an object in its possession, such as a lock of hair or a splinter of wood, it knows the most direct route to that creature or object if it is within 1 mile of the banderhobb.

traits.name: Shadow Diver
traits.description: The banderhobb treats areas of dim light or darkness as arbitrarily deep, interconnected pools of water. It can be faintly seen and targeted while submerged in these shadow-pools, though other creatures cannot ordinarily pass into them unless carried by a banderhobb.

traits.name: Extradimensional Gullet
traits.description: Creatures swallowed by the banderhobb are teleported to a demiplane roughly 10 ft. in diameter with walls that appear to be covered in giant humanoid faces made of the banderhob's flesh; it has following attributes: A creature that starts its turn in the demiplane takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. The walls of the demiplane have AC 20 and 30 Hit Points. If ruptured, each creature in the demiplane appears within 10 ft. of the banderhob. If the banderhobb is submerged in a shadow pool, the creatures appear at the surface of the nearest entrance. If ruptured, the banderhobb's gullet is restored on a short or long rest.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (5d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC: 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the banderhobb can't use its bite attack or tongue attack on another target.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 15 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the target must make a DC: 15 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled to a space within 5 feet of the banderhobb, which can use a bonus action to make a bite attack against the target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The banderhobb makes a bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed creature is teleported to the banderhobb's extradimensional gullet.

name: Venom-Eye Basilisk
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -1, Int -4, Wis -1, Cha -2

traits.name: Venomous Gaze
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more venom-eye basilisks takes 1 poison damage for each of those basilisks it can see, then must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the start of its next turn. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid this effect, treating the basilisk as Invisible until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the basilisk takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the basilisk takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Snapping Bites (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Piercing damage.

name: Wilt-Eye Basilisk
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -1, Con +2, Int -4, Wis -1, Cha -2

traits.name: Wilting Gaze
traits.description: When a creature that can see the basilisk (or its reflection) starts its turn within 30 feet of it, the basilisk can force it to succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or deals only half damage with weapon attacks until the start of its next turn. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid this effect, treating the basilisk as Invisible until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Drooling Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Wither
actions.description: One creature affected by the basilisk's wilting gaze must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points in this way has Disadvantage on death saving throws for the next minute.

reactions.name: Darting Snap
reactions.description: When a creature that is averting its eyes from the basilisk misses it with a melee attack, the basilisk can make a Drooling Bite attack against it.

name: True Basilisk
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -4, Wis -1, Cha -2

traits.name: Ossifying Gaze
traits.description: When a creature that can see the basilisk (or its reflection) starts its turn within 30 feet of it, the basilisk can force it to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be restrained until the start of its next turn as its flesh begins to turn to stone. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid this effect, treating the basilisk as Invisible until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Gravelchewer Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage. This attack ignores any resistance to Piercing damage.

actions.name: Petrify
actions.description: One creature affected by the basilisk's Ossifying Gaze must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be Petrified for the next 24 hours. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is Petrified until cured with a Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reactions.name: Darting Snap
reactions.description: When a creature that is averting its eyes from the basilisk misses it with a melee attack, the basilisk can make a Gravelchewer Bite attack against it.

name: Abyssal Basilisk
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +8, Con +8, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha -2
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Ossifying Gaze
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the basilisk that can see it (or its reflection) must make a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained until the start of its next turn. At the start of its turn, a creature that isn't Surprised can avert its gaze, treating the basilisk as Invisible until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The basilisk can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The marilith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The basilisk makes three attacks with its Claw Swipe, one of which it may replace with its Stonecrushing Bite or its Petrify.

actions.name: Stonecrushing Bite
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) poison damage. If the target is petrified, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or lose a limb of its choice.

actions.name: Claw Swipe
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone, and must immediately make a saving throw against the basilisk's Ossifying Gaze.

actions.name: Petrify
actions.description: One creature affected by the basilisk's ossifying gaze must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be petrified until cured with a Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reactions.name: Darting Snap
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature that is averting its eyes missing the basilisk with a melee attack, the basilisk may make a bite attack against the attacker.

name: Behir Stormsteed
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +3, Con +4, Int -2, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Stormsteed
traits.description: A creature mounted on the behir may choose to act on the behir's initiative, rather than its own.

traits.name: Sparking Wounds
traits.description: If the behir has fewer than 53 Hit Points, a creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the behir takes 4 (1d8) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the behir may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the behir. While climbing on the behir, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the behir.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The behir makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The behir exhales a line of lightning that is 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw, taking 33 (6d10) Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Rip-Claw Retort
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with an attack of opportunity, the behir forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Slashing damage.

name: Behir
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +3, Con +4, Int -2, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Lighting Reflexes
traits.description: The behir does not roll initiative. Instead, it takes its turn on both initiative count 20 and initiative count 10.

traits.name: Sparking Wounds
traits.description: If the behir has fewer than 84 Hit Points, a creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the behir takes 4 (1d8) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the behir may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the behir. While climbing on the behir, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the behir.

traits.name: Restless
traits.description: If the behir ends its turn without moving at least 25 feet, attacks against it are made at Advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends.

actions.description: The behir exhales a line of lightning that is 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw, taking 55 (10d10) Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The behir makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, it takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns, and its attacks bypass the behir's resistances. A behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time. If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the behir. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +9, Con +8, Int +3, Wis +6, Cha +9

traits.name: Uncanny Speed
traits.description: Opportunity Attacks made against the bruxa have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Vital Craving
traits.description: While any Humanoid creatures within 30 feet of the bruxa are Bleeding or Bloodied, creatures other than those can attempt to Hide from it as a Bonus Action.

actions.description: The bruxa makes three melee attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Unbreathing Shriek or Eldritch Melody.

actions.name: Crimson Claws
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. A creature hit with this attack for the second time in a turn begins Bleeding (1d6).

actions.name: Eldritch Melody (Concentration)
actions.description: A shrill and haunting song rings forth from the bruxa in a 30-foot Emanation; at the start of each of the bruxa's turns, each creature in the area must make a Constitution {{font-variant:small-cap Saving Throw:}} DC 17. Failure: The creature is Dazed and Poisoned until the end of its next turn, or until it takes any damage.

actions.description: A continuous screech rips forth from the bruxa in a 30-foot Cone until the start of its next turn. The area counts as Difficult Terrain, and creatures in the area are Dazed.

bonusActions.name: Intruder's Veil
bonusActions.description: The bruxa becomes invisible and gains the Invisible condition until the end of its next turn; this effect ends early if it takes an action or takes any damage.

bonusActions.name: Blood Feast
bonusActions.description: Immediately after hitting a creature with its Fanged Bite, the bruxa can drain the target's blood, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target loses 2 unexpended Hit Dice, or drops to 0 Hit Points if it can't.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: The bruxa shape-shifts, gaining a Humanoid appearance and losing its Fly Speed, or returning to its true batlike form. Its statistics otherwise are unchanged.

reactions.name: Mist Rush
reactions.description: Trigger: The bruxa loses Concentration. Response: The bruxa turns briefly to mist and moves up to 20 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then returns to its corporeal form.

reactions.name: Curl Up
reactions.description:

name: Bulette Earthsteed
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -5, Cha -3

traits.name: Earthsteed
traits.description: The bulette can form a magical bond to a creature over the course of a long rest, which lasts until it uses this ability again. A bonded creature can ride the bulette while it burrows, and while riding gains tremorsense out to a range of 30 feet. A creature riding a burrowing bulette cannot speak or breathe.

traits.name: Shock Attack
traits.description: If the bulette starts its turn underground, creatures without tremorsense may not take reactions on its turn while within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Snapping Maw
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage. The bulette may make this attack as a bonus action against a prone creature.

name: Bulette Gohlbrorn
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +4, Int -1

traits.name: Bonefin Display
traits.description: While burrowing just beneath the surface, the bulette's bony dorsal fin is visible and can be targeted. A creature that can see three or more fins protruding above the surface in this way at the start of its turn must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Shock Attack
traits.description: If the bulette starts its turn underground, creatures without tremorsense may not take reactions on its turn while within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Burrowing Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage. The bulette may make this attack as a bonus action against a prone or restrained creature.

actions.name: Spew Stones (Recharges when the bulette burrows underground)
actions.description: Attack: +5 range 20 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Create Pitfall
actions.description: While burrowing, the bulette excavates a 5-foot wide pocket of earth above it and just beneath the surface, leaving a thin skin untouched above that collapses when significant weight is placed on it. A Medium or larger creature in this space or that that enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or sink partially into the earth and be restrained in place until it spends its full movement to extract itself. While restrained in this way, a creature can be targeted with melee attacks by creatures burrowing beneath the surface.
