traits.name: Shock Attack
traits.description: If the bulette starts its turn underground, creatures without tremorsense may not take reactions on its turn while within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Perfect Armor
traits.description: If the bulette would take more than 10 damage from a single source, it takes 10 damage instead. Necrotic damage and damage from critical hits ignores this trait.

actions.name: Axiomatic Maw
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 22 (4d10) force damage. A non-lawful creature hit with this attack is Poisoned until the beginning of the bulette's next turn. While Poisoned in this way, a creature treats any roll it makes above a 10 as a 10.

actions.name: Unstoppable Ram (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The bulette moves up to its speed in a straight line. Each creature in its path is pushed ahead of it, then must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 20 additional feet. A creature pushed in this way takes 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) Force damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

actions.name: Platonic Rejection (Recharges when the bulette succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect)
actions.description: The bulette releases the magic stored in its carapace in a burst of cosmic force. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or take 27 (5d10) Force damage and be pushed 10 feet away from the bulette.

name: Bulette Pitweevil
savingThrows: Str +11, Dex +1, Con +5, Int -2, Wis +8, Cha +2
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Pain Sense
traits.description: Whenever a living creature within 1 mile of bulette takes damage, the bulette learns its exact location and current Hit Points.

traits.name: Shock Attack
traits.description: If the bulette starts its turn underground, creatures without tremorsense may not take reactions on its turn while within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The bulette has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bulette makes two attacks with its Engulfing Maw, one of which it may replace with a use of its Erupt or Deadly Leap, if available

actions.name: Tormenting Maw
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 45 (6d12 + 6) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 19).

actions.name: Erupt
actions.description: The bulette moves up to its burrow speed directly upward, bursting from underground in a thrashing flurry of debris, pushing each creature in its space to the nearest unoccupied space. Then, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Deadly Leap
actions.description: The bulette leaps up to 30 feet and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each creature whose space the bulette lands in must succeed on a DC 19 Strength or Dexterity Saving Throw (target's choice) or take 21 (6d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage and be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: One Large or smaller creature grappled by the bulette is Swallowed by it (escape DC 19). While Swallowed, the creature takes 28 (8d6) Acid damage at the beginning of each of its turns and one item of its choice that it is carrying is dissolved.

name: Godeater Bulette
savingThrows: Str +14, Dex +2, Con +14, Int -2, Wis +4, Cha +6
immunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Apex Tunneler
traits.description: The bulette can burrow through solid rock or metal at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake. The bulette may spend half its movement to shatter a Wall of Force or similar creation of magical force within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Shock Attack
traits.description: If the bulette starts its turn underground, creatures without tremorsense may not take reactions on its turn while within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Godflesh Devourer
traits.description: The bulette has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects with a divine origin, such as those cast by clerics or paladins.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (2/Day)
traits.description: If the bulette fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Godeater Maw
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 10 ft. Hit: 39 (5d12 + 7) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 20). The bulette may make this attack as a bonus action against a prone creature.

actions.name: Seismic Scrutiny
actions.description: The bulette directs its mind's eye toward a 30-foot radius location on the Astral, Ethereal, or Material plane, learning the number and type of creatures in the area. The earth in the area begins to shake, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone and be unable to stand on its following turn.

actions.name: Planequake Eruption (Recharges when the bulette uses its Seismic Scrutiny)
actions.description: The bulette chews a hole that remains open until the start of its next turn to a location chosen with its Seismic Scrutiny, bursting forth in a spray of shattered fragments of reality. Each creature within 30 feet of the bulette when it emerges is pushed up to 15 feet away, then each creature still within 30 feet of it must succeed DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Thunder damage plus 22 (4d10) Force damage, or half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Deadly Leap (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The bulette leaps up to 30 feet and can land in the space of any Large or smaller creature. Each creature whose space the bulette lands in must succeed on a DC 17 Strength or Dexterity Saving Throw (target's choice) or take 28 (8d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage and be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reactions.name: Dweomersense
reactions.description: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell of 4th level or above, the bulette may move up to its burrow speed. If it is no longer a valid target for the spell, the spell caster must choose a new target or lose the spell.

legendaryActions.name: Earthen Dive
legendaryActions.description: The bulette moves up to half its burrow speed directly downward.

legendaryActions.name: Gather Strength
legendaryActions.description: The earth within 5 feet of the bulette becomes difficult terrain and the bulette gains 20 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the bulette's attacks are made at Advantage.

legendaryActions.name: Lateral Rend (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The bulette shakes a grappled creature back and forth, forcing it to succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or take 26 (4d12) Slashing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is Stunned until the end of the bulette's next turn.

name: Carbuncle
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex -2, Con +1, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Calming Presence
traits.description: Each creature within 5 ft. of the carbuncle has Advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration or to resist an effect that would Frighten it.

traits.name: Head Gem
traits.description: The carbuncle has a worthless translucent horny growth in its forehead that resembles a large ruby or garnet. A creature that pries it off with a successful DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or contract Leprosy.

actions.name: Disarming Lick
actions.description: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed by the carbuncle until the end of its next turn, or until the creature is hit with an attack. Attack rolls against a creature Charmed in this way are made at Advantage.

reactions.name: End Life
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature targeting the carbuncle with an attack or harmful spell, the carbuncle keels over and dies. The attacker may choose a new target.

reactions.name: Feign Death
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature targeting the carbuncle with an attack or harmful spell, the carbuncle keels over and appears to die. A creature may attempt a DC 13 Wisdom (Medicine) or Wisdom (Insight) check as a Bonus Action to determine it is faking. The attacker may choose a new target.

name: Carrion Crawler Corpseward
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +3, Int -5, Wis +1, Cha -3

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Soft Underbelly
traits.description: While the crawler has a creature Grappled, any attack made against the crawler that exceeds its AC by 5 or more scores a Critical Hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The crawler makes two attacks.

actions.name: Gnashing Maw
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Numbing Tendrils
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (2d4) poison damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 12). While Grappled in this way, the creature is Dazed and Poisoned.

actions.name: Putrescent Injection
actions.description: One creature Grappled by the crawler. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the end of the crawler's next turn. Failure by 5: The creature contracts Filth Fever.

name: Carrion Crawler Broodmaster
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +1, Con +6, Int -5, Wis +2, Cha -3

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Soft Underbelly
traits.description: While the crawler has a creature Grappled, any attack made against the crawler that exceeds its AC by 5 or more scores a Critical Hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The crawler makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Putrescent Injection.

actions.name: Bonegrinder Maw
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Numbing Tendrils
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). While Grappled in this way, the creature is Dazed and Poisoned.

actions.name: Putrescent Injection
actions.description: One creature Grappled by the crawler. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the end of the crawler's next turn. Failure by 5: The creature contracts Filth Fever.

reactions.name: Ravenous Thrash
reactions.description: Trigger: The crawler is hit with a melee attack while it has a creature Grappled. Response: The crawler pushes the attacker 5 feet, then can move up to half its Speed.

name: Catoblepas Harbinger
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +4, Con +8, Int -4, Wis +5, Cha +2

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Any creature other than a catoblepas that starts its turn within 10 feet of the catoblepas must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of any catoblepas for 1 hour.

traits.name: Harbinger of Tragedy
traits.description: A creature that sees a catoblepas must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed, becoming immune to this curse for the next 24 hours on a success. A creature cursed in this way dies after two failed death Saving Throws, rather than three.

actions.name: Whipneck Gore
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

actions.name: Tail Club
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be knocked prone. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is unable to stand or swim for the next minute.

actions.name: Final Glance (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or suffer vulnerability to all damage for the next minute. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more instead suffers vulnerability to all damage until it completes a long rest.

name: Catoblepas Tragedian
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex +5, Con +11, Int -4, Wis +6, Cha +3

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Any creature other than a catoblepas that starts its turn within 10 feet of the catoblepas must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of any catoblepas for 1 hour.

traits.name: Harbinger of Tragedy
traits.description: A creature that sees a catoblepas must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed, becoming immmune to this curse for the next 24 hours on a success. A creature cursed in this way dies after two failed death Saving Throws, rather than three.

traits.name: Inevitable Call
traits.description: At the beginning of each of the catoblepas' turns, each creature within 100 ft. that does not have all of its Hit Points is dragged 15 ft. toward it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Catoblepas makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Final Glance, if available.

actions.name: Whipneck Gore
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 28 (5d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

actions.name: Tail Club
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 23 (5d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be knocked prone. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is unable to stand or swim for the next minute.

actions.name: Final Glance (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or suffer vulnerability to all damage for the next minute. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more instead suffers vulnerability to all damage until it completes a long rest.

reactions.name: Withering Gaze (1/day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 82 Hit Points, the catoblepas forces one creature it can see within 30 feet to make a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw, taking 36 (8d8) Necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target dies if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this ray.

name: Cave Fisher
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -4, Cha -4

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Flammable Blood
traits.description: If the cave fisher takes Fire damage while below 30 Hit Points, it catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, it takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage at the start of each of its turns, and deals an additional 5 (1d10) Fire damage with its melee attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cave fisher makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft., Hits: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned for 1 minute. A Poisoned creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Adhesive Filament
actions.description: The cave fisher extrudes a sticky filament up to 60 ft. A creature that touches this filament is Grappled (escape DC 13). The filament can be attacked (AC 15; 5 Hit Points; immunity to poison and Psychic damage), but a weapon that fails to sever it becomes stuck to it, requiring an action and a successful DC 13 Strength check to pull free. Destroying the filament causes no damage to the cave fisher, which can extrude a replacement filament on its next turn.

actions.name: Reel
actions.description: One Medium or smaller creature grappled by the cave fisher's filament becomes restrained must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled up to 60 ft. toward the cave fisher.

reactions.name: Angler's Set
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature becoming grappled by or failing an attempt to escape its filament, the cave fisher uses its Reel.

name: Century Worm
savingThrows: Str +9, Con +12, Int -2, Wis +8, Cha -1
resistances: Weapon attacks not made from inside it

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Earth Quaker
traits.description: When the worm burrows 30 feet or fewer below the surface, 10-foot wide, 10-foot deep fissures open at the surface above where it passes. Creatures in the space where a fissure opens must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone in the trench. On a success, a creature may use its reaction to move up to 10 feet to avoid falling in.

traits.name: Worm Keening
traits.description: At the beginning of the worm's turn, each creature within 30 feet of the worm takes 18 (4d8) Thunder damage and is deafened. Structures in the area instead take maximum damage.

traits.name: Shock Sensitivity
traits.description: If the worm, or the ground within 30 feet of it is subjected to Lightning damage, it cannot use its Terror From the Deep or Swallow Earth actions on its next turn, and must use all of its movement to surface.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the worm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The worm attacks twice with its Spit Bile.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 10 ft. Hit: 31 (4d10 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is Blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm. If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Spit Bile
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 30 ft. Hit: 27 (6d8) acid damage. Additionally on a hit, if the target is wearing nonmagical armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

actions.name: Swallow Earth
actions.description: While burrowing no more than 20 feet beneath the surface, the worm begins to swallow the earth above it. A 5-foot radius pit appears on the surface above the worm; each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall in and have the worm immediately make a bite attack against it, or move to the nearest adjacent space on a success.

actions.name: Terror From the Deep (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The worm moves up to its burrow speed, then bursts from underground thrashing in a flurry of debris. Each creature in a 15-foot radius must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 35 (10d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half damage on a success. As a bonus action, the worm may make a bite attack against a creature that failed this saving throw.

legendaryActions.name: Writhing Dive
legendaryActions.description: The century worm moves up to half its burrow speed. Each creature that makes an attack of opportunity provoked by this movement must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall into the tunnel left in its wake.

legendaryActions.name: Bile Surge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Each creature swallowed by the century worm must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (5d8) Acid damage. On the worm's following turn, attacks it makes with its Spit Bile are at Advantage.

legendaryActions.name: Wriggling Progeny (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Each creature swallowed by the century worm must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or have its Constitution modifier reduced by 1d6, to a minimum of 1. A creature that has its Constitution modifier reduced to 1 in this way takes 28 (8d6) Piercing damage and has a century worm larva burrow into its body and attach to its spine, then is ejected from the century worm. While it has a larva burrowed in it, a creature is Charmed by the worm and must use its action to dash each turn until it finds soft earth in which to dig a hole and bury itself alive.

name: Chimera
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +4, Int -4, Wis +2
languages: Understands Draconic but can't speak it

traits.name: Three Heads
traits.description: The chimera has three reactions each round. Whenever it takes 20 or more damage from a single source it must make a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or lose one of its reactions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chimera makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. When its fire breath is available, it can use the breath in place of its bite.

actions.name: Gnashing Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d8) fire damage

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The dragon head exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw, taking 31 (7d8) Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Headbutt
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the chimera may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the chimera's next turn.

reactions.name: Rake
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the chimera may make a claws attack against it.

reactions.name: Roar
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the chimera may let out a terrifying roar. Each creature within 60 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or become frightened of the chimera until the end of its next turn.

name: Greater Chimera
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +7, Con +10, Int -2, Wis +7, Cha +5

traits.name: Three Heads
traits.description: The chimera has three reactions each round. Whenever it takes 20 or more damage from a single source it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or lose one of its reactions.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the chimera fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chimera makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. When its fire breath is available, it can use the breath in place of its bite.

actions.name: Gnashing Bite
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d8) fire damage

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage and the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The dragon head exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw, taking 45 (10d8) Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Headbutt
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the chimera may force the attacker to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage and be Stunned until the end of the chimera's next turn.

reactions.name: Rake
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the chimera may make a claws attack against it. If the attack hits, the target is knocked prone.

reactions.name: Roar
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the chimera may let out a terrifying roar. Each creature within 60 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw or become Frightened of the chimera until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Claw Attack
legendaryActions.description: The chimera makes a claw attack.

legendaryActions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The chimera beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the chimera must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

name: Chitine Swarmer
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Web-Dweller
traits.description: The chitine can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the chitine knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Swarmer
traits.description: If at least two other friendly chitine are within 10 ft., the chitine may attempt to Grapple or Shove a creature as a bonus action.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the chitine has Disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chitine makes two attacks with its daggers.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One grappled and prone creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained in place by webbing (escape DC 14). A creature that succeeds by 5 or more is no longer grappled and may use its reaction to stand.

reactions.name: Shank
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature grappled by the chitine missing it with an attack, the chitine uses its multiattack.

name: Chitine Web-Weaver
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +3, Con +2, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Web-Dweller
traits.description: The chitine can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the chitine knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the chitine has Disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Pitfall
traits.description: Over the course of an hour, the chitine can construct a covering of web and debris that makes a pit up to 20 feet across indistinguishable from natural terrain. The first time a creature not able to safely traverse webs steps on it, the covering collapses and the creature falls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chitine makes two attacks.

actions.name: Web Shot
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target's movement is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Wall of Webs
actions.description: The chitine raises an opaque wall of webs on a solid surface it can see within 60 feet of it. The wall is 5 ft. thick and up to 15 ft. long and 15 ft. high. When the wall appears, each creature in its space is pushed to a side of its choice. Each 15-foot section of wall can be damaged and breached (AC 5; 20 HP; vulnerability to Fire damage; immunity to poison and Psychic damage). A creature that hits the web with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 13).

reactions.name: Web Labyrinth
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 30 ft. of the chitine, the chitine uses its Wall of Webs ability.

name: Choldrith Favored One
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +3, Con +1, Wis +2

traits.name: Web-Dweller
traits.description: The choldrith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the choldrith knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the choldrith has Disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The choldrith makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft., Hits: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage. A grappled or restrained target takes an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

actions.name: Legs
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft., Hits: 7 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Web
actions.description: The choldrith launches webbing in a 10-foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or be restrained by webbing (escape DC 13). The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; 5 HP; vulnerability to Fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and Psychic damage).

actions.name: Black Rain (Level 3 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Inky black poison rains down in a 20 ft. radius centered on a point within 120 ft. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Poison damage, or half as much on a success. Lights in the area are extinguished.

bonusActions.name: Bind
bonusActions.description: The choldrith uses its webbing to restrain a grappled or prone target (escape DC 12).

reactions.name: The Queen's Will
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a friendly chitine or drow within 60 ft. miss with an attack or fail a saving throw, the choldrith deals 5 (1d10) Psychic damage to it. The target may reroll the attack or saving throw.

name: Choldrith Arachnomancer
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +8, Con +8, Int +2, Wis +4, Cha +7

traits.name: Web-Dweller
traits.description: The choldrith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the choldrith knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the choldrith has Disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The choldrith makes four melee attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft., Hits: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage. A grappled or restrained target takes an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

actions.name: Legs
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft., Hits: 7 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Web
actions.description: The choldrith launches webbing in a 10-foot radius cetered on a point within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or be restrained by webbing (escape DC 16). The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; HP 15; vulnerability to Fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and Psychic damage).

actions.name: Black Rain (Recharge 5-6, Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Inky black poison rains down in a 20 ft. radius centered on a point within 120 ft. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Poison damage, or half as much on a success. Lights in the area are extinguished.

actions.name: Creeping Ruin (1/Day, Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: A mass of tiny spiders begins to swarm around the choldrith in a 15 ft. radius. A hostile creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 10 poison damage, or half as much on a success. The spell lasts 8 hours, or until it has dealt a total of 100 damage.

bonusActions.name: Bind
bonusActions.description: The choldrith uses its webbing to restrain a grappled or prone target (escape DC 15).

reactions.name: The Queen's Will (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a friendly chitine or drow within 60 ft. miss with an attack or fail a saving throw, the choldrith deals 5 (1d10) Psychic damage to it. The target may reroll the attack or saving throw.

reactions.name: Lolth's Favor (1/day, Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a friendly chitine or drow within 60 feet die, the choldrith causes the friendly creature to explode in a torrent of venomous spiders. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

name: Chwidencha
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +7, Con +6, Int -2, Wis +3, Cha +4

traits.name: Web-Dweller
traits.description: The chwidencha can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the chwidencha knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Burrowing Ambusher
traits.description: The chwidencha has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide while at least partially buried in loam or dark soil.

traits.name: Fruitless Devotion
traits.description: If a creature the chwidencha can see uses its action to brandish a holy symbol of Lolth, the chwidencha must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed and Frightened by it until the beginning of the creature's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chwidencha makes six attacks, or makes two attacks and uses its Nettling Bristles, if available.

actions.name: Leg Barbs
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the Chwidencha may grapple the target.

actions.name: Scuttling Overrun
actions.description: The chwidencha moves up to half its speed, and may move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. A creature whose space it enters for the first time on a turn must succeeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or fall prone and be Frightened for the next minute. While Frightened in this way, a creature can stand from prone only as an action, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Nettling Bristles (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The chwidencha scrapes off some of its barbed bristles, ejecting them in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Piercing damage and be Blinded until it takes an action to clear its eyes, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Buried Horror
reactions.description: AWhen a creature the chwidencha is hidden from enters its reach, the chwidencha can use its Scuttling Overrun or make four attacks with its Leg Barbs.

name: Cistern Fiend
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +8, Con +8, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Filter Feeder
traits.description: A body of water in which a cistern fiend resides is extraordinarily clean and free of impurities.

traits.name: Translucent Body
traits.description: While submerged, the cistern fiend has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. While out of water, attacks that deal Piercing damage score a critical against it on a 19-20. On a critical hit, one swallowed creature is freed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fiend makes three attacks with its filtration tendrils; one of which it may replace with a use of either its bite or its filter blood ability.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 15 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is grappled, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is Restrained (escape DC 17), and takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the fiend's turns.

actions.name: Filtration Tendrils
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Filter Blood
actions.description: One creature grappled by the fiend must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 4 (1d8) as the fiend's filtration tendrils burrow into its body and turn its blood to water. The target dies if this reduces its Constitution to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

reactions.name: Bluff Strike
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature entering the fiend's reach, it may force the creature to succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be forced to immediately move 10 ft. away from the fiend, if it can.

name: Cockatrice Kinglet
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +1, Con +1, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -3

traits.name: Strugglesome Flight
traits.description: The cockatrice falls 10 feet at the end of each of its turns if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its fly speed.

traits.name: Crow-Blinded
traits.description: If the cockatrice hears a rooster crow within 300 feet of it, it takes 5 (1d10) Psychic damage and gains the Blinded condition for 1 minute.

actions.name: Scar-Giver Spur
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage. Wounds left by this attack always leave scars.

bonusActions.name: Leaden Gaze
bonusActions.description: *Flesh stiffens and palor drains before the cockatrice's gaze.* One creature the cockatrice can see within 30 feet. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target turns to lead and has the Petrified condition.

bonusActions.name: Buffeting Flutter
bonusActions.description: One creature grappling the cockatrice.Strength Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The creature is pushed 5 feet away and has the Prone condition.

name: Cockatrice Retinue
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -3
immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Strugglesome Flight
traits.description: The retinue falls 10 feet at the end of each of its turns if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its fly speed.

traits.name: Crow-Blinded
traits.description: If the retinue hears a rooster crow within 300 feet of it, it takes 22 (4d10) Psychic damage and gains the Blinded condition for 1 minute.

actions.name: Scar-Mark Mob
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (6d6 + 2) slashing damage, or half as much if the retinue is Bloodied. Wounds left by this attack always leave scars.

actions.name: Killing Clarion (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: *A chorus of strangled, hacking huffs heralds a foul, black mist.* Each non-cockatrice creature in a 10-foot Emanation. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 5 (1d10) Poison damage and the creature has the Choking condition until the end of the cockatrice's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Myriad Glare
bonusActions.description: *A mob of crimson eyes burns with deadly fury.* Each creature of the swarm's choice that it can see in a 30-foot Emanation. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target turns to lead and has the Petrified condition.

bonusActions.name: Buffeting Tide
bonusActions.description: Each other creature in the swarm's space.Strength Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage and the creature has the Prone condition.

name: Cockatrice Dragonhen
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +6, Con +1, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha +3

traits.name: Strugglesome Flight
traits.description: The cockatrice falls 10 feet at the end of each of its turns if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its fly speed.

traits.name: Crow-Blinded
traits.description: If the cockatrice hears a rooster crow within 300 feet of it, it takes 5 (1d10) Psychic damage and gains the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Roost-Warden's Resistance (1/Day)
traits.description:
If the cockatrice fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Whenever a friendly cockatrice the cockatrice can see within 30 feet is killed, the cockatrice regains a use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cockatrice makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Jagged Beak.

actions.name: Jagged Beak
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sprinting Slash
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. Before making this attack, the cockatrice can move up to half its Speed directly toward the target.

actions.name: Blightrattle Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description:
Each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 10 (3d6) Poison damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

Any uncovered gold in the area turns to lead, and any creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage has Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws until it regains all of its Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Cruel Slash
legendaryActions.description: The cockatrice makes Sprinting Slash attack against a Prone or Restrained target.

legendaryActions.name: Lash Tail
legendaryActions.description: One Medium or smaller creature within 10 feet. Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage, then the target is pushed up to 10 feet away and has the Prone condition.

legendaryActions.name: Leaden Gaze
legendaryActions.description: *Flesh stiffens and palor drains before the cockatrice's gaze.* One creature the cockatrice can see within 30 feet. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target turns to lead and has the Petrified condition.

name: Crag Cat
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +3, Int +2, Wis -3, Cha -1

traits.name: Nondetection
traits.description: The cat cannot be targeted or detected by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

traits.name: Righting Reflex
traits.description: The cat takes no fall damage if it falls from a height of 30 ft. or greater.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.description: If the cat moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the cat can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The cat has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Spell Turning
reactions.description: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell of 7th level or lower that targets only it, the cat avoids all effects from the spell and instead causes the spell to target the caster.

reactions.name: Bat Away
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the cat forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or have one object it is holding knocked out of its hands and 15 ft. away.

name: Darkmantle
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +1, Int -4, Cha -3

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.description: The darkmantle can't use its blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the darkmantle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a cave formation such as a stalactite or stalagmite.

actions.name: Crush
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16). While grappled, the target is Blinded and can't breathe, and the darkmantle has Advantage on attacks against it and cannot bite another target. If this attack was made with Advantage, the creature loses its breath if it was holding it.

reactions.name: Darkness Aura (1/day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking damage, the darkmantle exudes a 15-foot radius of magical darkness that moves with it, and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts until the next time the darkmantle takes damage.

name: Leapgall Decapus
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -3, Cha -2

traits.name: Unstructured Form
traits.description: While on the ground, the decapus has Disadvantage on any D20 Test that uses Strength or Dexterity.

traits.name: Suckered Clutch
traits.description: If the decapus or a creature Grappled by it would be pushed any distance, it is pushed 10 feet fewer.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The decapus makes four attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Swinging Lunge.

actions.name: Tentacle Flail
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Swinging Lunge
actions.description: If the decapus is hanging from a branch or similar surface, it leaps up to 20 feet.

reactions.name: Anchor Hook
reactions.description: Trigger: The decapus hits a creature with a Tentacle Flail attack for the second time in a turn. Response: The target is Grappled (escape DC 12). While Grappled in this way, the creature is Restrained.

reactions.name: Dragging Thrash
reactions.description: Trigger: The decapus uses its Swinging Lunge while it has a creature Grappled. Response: The Grappled creature takes 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage and is Dazed until the end of its next turn.

name: Disenchanter
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -3
immunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Magic Sense
traits.description: The disenchanter can pinpoint, by scent, the location of each magic item and active spell within 60 feet of it.

traits.name: Swaying Stride
traits.description: If the disenchanter moves at least 30 ft. in a straight line on its turn, it may Dodge as a Bonus Action this turn.

traits.name: Translucent Scales
traits.description: Attacks that deal radiant damage are made at Advantage against the disenchanter.

actions.name: Plodding Stomp
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A prone creature takes an additional Hit: 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tail Club
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be knocked prone. A creature that fails by 5 or more cannot stand or breathe until the end of the disenchanter's next turn.

actions.name: Prehensile Tongue
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 15 ft., one target creature or object. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, the target is Grappled (escape DC 15), and each spell affecting the target ends. Spells cast by a creature grappled in this way fail.

actions.name: Disenchant
actions.description: The disenchanter begins to consume the magic of one magic item of Very Rare or lesser quality that is held by the disenchanter or a creature it has grappled. If the disenchanter is still holding the object or creature at the start of its next turn, the item is destroyed.

name: Displacer Beast Kitten
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +1, Con +1, Int -3, Cha -2

traits.name: Canopy Stalker
traits.description: The kitten has Advantage on checks made to hide from creatures whose eyeline it is above.

traits.name: Teleportation Weakness
traits.description: The displacer beast is Stunned until the end of it is next turn whenever a creature teleports within 30 feet of it.

traits.name: Minor Displacement
traits.description: The kitten magically disrupts the light around it, making it appear slightly blurry. Checks to determine what the kitten is carrying in its mouth or tentacles are made at Disadvantage.

actions.name: Hexapod Biscuits
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 10 ft., one prone or willing target. Hit: 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tendril Pad Swipe
actions.description: One creature the kitten can see within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity Saving Throw or have one object weighing 1 pound or less that it is carrying stolen by the kitten.

actions.name: Distracting Blink
actions.description: The kitten affixes its gaze on a creature it can see within 15 feet and slowly blinks. The creature must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to take reactions until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Strained Displacement
reactions.description: As a reaction when the kitten is hit with an attack of opportunity, it causes the attack to miss then falls unconscious until the start of its next turn.

name: Displacer Beast Shadowcat
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Canopy Stalker
traits.description: The displacer beast has Advantage on checks made to hide from creatures whose eyeline it is above.

traits.name: Teleportation Weakness
traits.description: The displacer beast takes 9 (2d8) Psychic damage whenever a creature teleports within 30 feet of it.

traits.name: Displacement
traits.description: While the displacer beast is not grappled or incapacitated and it has not been hit with an attack since the end of its last turn, it has the following effects: Attacks against it are made at Disadvantage. When making a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the displacer beast treats any unmodified roll of a 11-20 as a success, and takes no damage on a successful save.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The displacer beast makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Spinal Bite.

actions.name: Spinal Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. Any hit with this attack against a target that is both prone and grappled becomes a critical.

actions.name: Hexapod Claws
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. A prone target hit with two or more of these attacks in a turn is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Tendril Pads
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.description: If the displacer beast is in dim light or darkness, it attempts to Hide.

bonusActions.name: Lithe Pounce
bonusActions.description: The displacer beast leaps up to 15 feet, then may force one creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

name: Displacer Beast Prideleader
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Canopy Stalker
traits.description: The displacer beast has Advantage on checks made to hide from creatures whose eyeline it is above.

traits.name: Teleportation Weakness
traits.description: The displacer beast takes 9 (2d8) Psychic damage whenever a creature teleports within 30 feet of it.

traits.name: Displacement
traits.description: While the displacer beast is not grappled or incapacitated and it has not been hit with an attack since the end of its last turn, it has the following effects: Attacks against it are made at Disadvantage. When making a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the displacer beast treats any unmodified roll of a 11-20 as a success, and takes no damage on a successful save.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The displacer beast makes four attacks, one of which may be with its Spinal Bite.

actions.name: Spinal Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. Any hit with this attack against a target that is both prone and grappled becomes a critical.

actions.name: Hexapod Claws
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. A prone target hit with two or more of these attacks in a turn is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Tendril Pads
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.description: If the displacer beast is in dim light or darkness, it attempts to Hide.

bonusActions.name: Lithe Pounce
bonusActions.description: The displacer beast leaps up to 15 feet, then may force one creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Slinking Retreat
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the displacer beast, the displacer beast moves up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

name: Displacer Beast Coeurl
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +8, Int +7, Wis +6

traits.name: Canopy Stalker
traits.description: The coeurl has Advantage on checks made to hide from creatures whose eyeline it is above.

traits.name: Teleportation Weakness
traits.description: The coeurl takes 9 (2d8) Psychic damage whenever a creature teleports within 30 feet of it

traits.name: Feline Fluidity
traits.description: The coeurl can squeeze through any space larger than its skull.

traits.name: Displacement
traits.description: While the coeurl is not grappled or incapacitated and it has not been hit with an attack since the end of its last turn, it has the following effects: Attacks against it are made at Disadvantage. When making a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the coeurl treats any unmodified roll of a 11-20 as a success, and takes no damage on a successful save.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (2/Day)
traits.description: If the coeurl fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The coeurl makes four attacks, one of which may be with its Spinal Bite.

actions.name: Spinal Bite
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage. Any hit with this attack against a target that is both prone and grappled becomes a critical.

actions.name: Hexapod Claws
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. A target hit with two or more of these attacks in a turn is Grappled (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Tendril Pads
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or have one melee weapon it is wielding wrenched from its grasp. If the coeurl is wielding weapons in both its tentacles, it can't use this attack.

actions.name: Displacement Expansion (1/Day, Concentration)
actions.description: The coeurl's eyes flash with green light as it warps the light around it, creating several shifting, warped duplicates of each creature and object in the area. For the next minute, creatures within 30 feet of the coeurl that rely on sight have Disadvantage on checks and saving throws that use Wisdom. A creature that attempts to move into or through the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone.

bonusActions.name: Stolen Weapon
bonusActions.description: The coeurl makes an attack with a stolen weapon wielded in its tentacles, using the weapon's statistics (+9, +4 to damage).

bonusActions.name: Terrorize
bonusActions.description: The coeurl reveals itself to any number of creatures it can see within 30 feet that it is hidden from. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the coeurl's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Devour Id
bonusActions.description: One Frightened or Unconscious creature within 5 feet of the coeurl must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Psychic damage and gain immunity to the Frightened condition for the next minute.

reactions.name: Slinking Retreat
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the coeurl, the coeurl moves up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

legendaryActions.name: Lithe Pounce
legendaryActions.description: The coeurl leaps up to 20 feet, then may force one creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

legendaryActions.name: Shadowy Vault
legendaryActions.description: The coeurl leaps up to 20 feet. If it ends this movement in dim light or darkness, it may immediately attempt to hide, and may do so without obscurement.

legendaryActions.name: False Retreat
legendaryActions.description: The coeurl magically produces an illusion of it leaping up to 20, then makes an attack with its Hexapod Claws against a creature in range, or two attacks if the target attempted to make an attack of opportunity against the illusion.

name: Dolgrim
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha -1

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.description: The dolgrim has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Double Actions
traits.description: The dolgrim rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: The dolgrim can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Crossbow
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 80/320 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Flail (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The dolgrim makes three weapon attacks at Disadvantage.

reactions.name: Slippery
reactions.description: If an attack misses the dolgrim, it can move up to 5 feet as a reaction without provoking attacks of opportunity.

name: Doppelganger
savingThrows: Dex +4, Con +2, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.description: The doppelganger has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.description: If the doppelganger surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage from the attack.

traits.name: Mind Reader
traits.description: The doppelganger can magically read the surface thoughts of creatures within 60 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The doppelganger makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a creature taking an action, the doppelganger may memorize that action. On its next turn, it may take that action. If the action included a weapon, the doppelganger grows an appendage to mimic it. If the action was to cast a spell, the doppelganger cast it innately without a spell slot, using the mimicked creature's attack bonus and save DC.

name: Doppelganger Assassin
savingThrows: Dex +4, Con +6, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.description: The doppelganger has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

traits.name: Exploit Weakness
traits.description: Attack rolls the doppelganger makes with Advantage deal an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

traits.name: Mind Reader
traits.description: The doppelganger can magically read the surface thoughts of creatures within 60 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The doppelganger makes two slam attacks and uses its perfect replica ability.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.description: A creature within 5 feet of the doppelganger must make a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature is stunned until the end of the doppelganger's next turn, and the doppleganger takes on its appearance. While the doppelganger is adjacent to a stunned creature whose appearance it is mimicking, attack rolls directed at it have a 50% chance of hitting the copied creature instead. A creature that fails this save becomes immune to the effect for 24 hours.

actions.name: Cloud Mind (concentration)
actions.description: The doppelganger becomes invisible to creatures within 15 feet of it for the next hour, or until it makes an attack or casts a spell.

name: Drider Outcast
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +4, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Light-Blind
traits.description: If the drider ends its turn in Bright Light or takes any Radiant damage, it has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Web-Dweller
traits.description: The drider can climb difficult surfaces without penalty, including upside-down and across webs, and it knows the position of any creature in contact with a web it is touching.

traits.name: Deathwish
traits.description: While the drider is Bloodied, it has Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition and can take one additional Reaction each round.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The drider makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with its Split-Jaw Embrace.

actions.name: Rotten Silkblade
actions.description:
Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) poison damage.

On a roll of 1, the blade snaps and becomes unusable.

actions.name: Grasping Legs
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Split-Jaw Embrace
actions.description: One creature grappled by the drider. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 17 (5d6) Poison damage and the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of Turn) Failure by 5 or More: The target has the Paralyzed condition for as long as it remains Poisoned.

reactions.name: Lunging Strike
reactions.description: Trigger: The drider is missed with a melee attack. Response: The drider makes a melee attack against the attacker with Disadvantage.

name: Drider Deephaunt
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +4, Con +4, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +1

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Grasping Legs
actions.description:
Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). Attack: +7 range 120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage and the target is wreathed in writhing shadows for one minute, or until it is illuminated by Bright Light.

Whenever the wreathed creature is hit with an attack, it takes an additional Hit: 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Split-Jaw Embrace
actions.description: One creature grappled by the drider. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 17 (5d6) Poison damage and the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of Turn) Failure by 5 or More: The target has the Paralyzed condition for as long as it remains Poisoned.

actions.name: Bleak Snare (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description:
*Shadow and caster, dragged into deeper darkness* One creature the drider can see within 60 feet. Strength Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target is dragged up to 20 feet in a direction of the drider's choice.

Then, if the target is not in Bright Light, it has the Restrained condition (escape DC 15) until it is illuminated by Bright Light.

bonusActions.name: Douse (Level 1 Spell)
bonusActions.description:
The drow dims one light source it can see within 60 feet, reducing Bright Light to Dim Light or reducing Dim Light to Darkness.

This spell does not reveal the drow's location to any creature it is Invisible to. Lights produced by spells of Level 2 or higher are unaffected.

bonusActions.name: Shadowslip (Level 2 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The drow teleports to an unoccupied space within 40 feet. This spell fails if the drow or its destination is illuminated by Bright Light.

bonusActions.name: Death Leap (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description:
The drider jumps up to 60 feet, and can land in the space of up to one Huge or smaller creature.

A creature whose space the drider lands in must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The creature has the Prone and Stunned conditions until the start of the drider's next turn. Success: The drider instead lands in the nearest unoccupied space.

reactions.name: Lunging Strike
reactions.description: Trigger: The drider is missed with a melee attack. Response: The drider makes a melee attack against the attacker with Disadvantage.

reactions.name: Silken Bonds
reactions.description:
Trigger: A creature becomes Incapacitated within 10 feet of the drider. Response: The drider wraps the creature in webs, Restraining it (Escape DC 16).

As part of this reaction, the drider can attach the creature to its back.

reactions.name: Shadowy Skitter
reactions.description: Trigger: The drider is forced to make a Dexterity Saving Throw while in Dim Light or Darkness.Response: The drider gains Advantage on the saving throw. On a success, it takes no damage and can move half its Speed.

name: Ettercap
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Spiderkind
traits.description: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the ettercap knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Spider Trainer
traits.description: Whenever a friendly spider within 30 feet makes an attack roll or a saving throw, it can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the result.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ettercap makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with either its Bite or Silken Noose, if available.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus Hit: 4 (1d8) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Silken Noose (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is restrained by webbing (escape DC 11). While restrained in this way, the ettercap may drag the restrained creature 15 feet toward it at the beginning of each of the ettercap's turns.

name: Froghemoth
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex +1, Con +9, Int -4, Wis +5, Cha +1

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The froghemoth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Shock Susceptibility
traits.description: If the froghemoth takes Lightning damage, it suffers several effects until the end of its next turn: its speed is halved, it takes a -2 penality to AC and Dexterity Saving Throws, it can't use reactions or Multiattack, and on its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, not both.

traits.name: Toxic Secretions
traits.description: A creature that makes an attack that benefits from flanking the froghemoth must make a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The froghemoth makes two attacks with its tentacles and one with its bite. It can replace its bite with a use of its Tongue or Lob Mucous

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 20 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16) if it is a Huge or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the froghemoth can't use this tentacle on another target. The froghemoth has four tentacles.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage, and the target is swallowed if it is a Medium or smaller creature. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the froghemoth, and takes Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the froghemoth's turns. The froghemoth's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the froghemoth takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the froghemoth must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the froghemoth. If the froghemoth dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.description: The froghemoth targets one Medium or smaller creature that it can see within 20 feet of it. The target must make a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the froghemoth, and the froghemoth can make a bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Lob Mucous
actions.description: The froghemoth expels a large glob of mucous, covering a 20-foot radius area within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer several effects until the end of its next turn: its speed is halved, it takes a -2 penality to AC and Dexterity Saving Throws, it can't use reactions or Multiattack, and on its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, not both. A creature in the froghemoth's gullet when it uses this ability may attempt a DC 16 Athletics or Acrobatics check. On a success, the creature is launched out with mucous and must immediately save against it.

reactions.name: Fling
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack by a grappled creature, the froghemoth may throw the creature up to 40 feet away. The creature must make a Dexterity Saving Throw, taking 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Reel
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack by a grappled creature, the froghemoth may pull the creature up to 20 feet straight towards it.

reactions.name: Slam
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature casting a spell that targets the froghemoth, the froghemoth may lift the creature and slam it into the ground. The creature must make a DC 16 constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. If the creature was concentrating on a spell, it makes its save to maintain concentration at Disadvantage.

traits.name: Keen Scent
traits.description: The girallon has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on scent, and can detect the presence of creatures up to 120 ft. away.

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.description: As a bonus action, the girallon can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

traits.name: Bowl Over
traits.description: If the girallon moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The girallon makes five attacks: one with its bite and four with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the girallon can grapple the target (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: The girallon slams two grappled creatures into each other. The creatures must each succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the girallon's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

traits.description: If the gorgon moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Reckless Follow-Through
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the gorgon can gain Advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage. A petrified target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or shatter.

actions.name: White-Iron Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The gorgon may make this attack as a Bonus Action against a prone creature.

actions.name: Thrashing Horns
actions.description: Two creatures on opposite sides of the gorgon must each succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 19 (3d12) Piercing damage and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Petrifying Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The gorgon exhales petrifying gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is restrained until the end of the gorgon's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, ending the effect on a success. On a failure, the target is Petrified until freed by the Greater Restoration spell or other similar magic.

name: Polukranos, World Eater
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +7, Con +12, Int -1, Wis +9, Cha +8
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.description: Polukranos has five heads. Whenever Polukranos takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, Polukranos dies. traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.description: For each head Polukranos has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction.

traits.name: Gargantuan Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to Polukranos may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 21 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto Polukranos. While climbing on Polukranos, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against it.

traits.name: Shed Head
traits.description: When Polukranos fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect it may choose to succeed instead. If it does, one of its heads dies and tears away from the main body.

traits.name: Escape from the Underworld (Mythic Trait; 1/Day)
traits.description: If Polukranos is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it resets to 198 Hit Points, its creature type becomes undead, and any creature hit with an attack by Polukranos must expend two unexpended hit dice or else take an additional 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Polukranos makes as many bite attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a swallow.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 15 ft. Hit: 13 (1d12 + 8) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 22) and pulled up to 10 ft. towards Polukranos. While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

actions.name: Swallow
