One swallowed creature is freed whenever Polukranos loses a head.

legendaryActions.name: Trampling Charge
legendaryActions.description: Polukranos moves up to half its speed. Creatures in its path must succeed on a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone. On a success, the creature may use its reaction to move up to 10 ft. to an unoccupied space out of Polukranos' path.

legendaryActions.name: Eat Head
legendaryActions.description: Polukranos eats one of its shed heads, gaining 10 Temporary Hit Points. While it has these Temporary Hit Points, it has Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws.

legendaryActions.name: Worry (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: One creature grappled by at least two of Polukranos' heads must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution throw or take 55 (10d10) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at Disadvantage if it is grappled by three or more of Polukranos' heads. A creature killed by this damage is ripped into pieces.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Unchained (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Until the start of its next turn, whenever Polukranos is hit with an attack by a creature within its reach, it may move up to 10 ft. and make an attack as a reaction.

name: Kamadan
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -4, Wis +2

traits.name: Righting Reflex
traits.description: The kamadan takes only 1 point of Bludgeoning damage per 10 feet fallen.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The kamadan makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Serpent Mane.

actions.name: Rending Swipe
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. A Prone target hit with this attack takes an extra 3 (1d6) Slashing damage and is Grappled (escape DC 13) until the end of the kamadan's next turn.

actions.name: Serpent Mane
actions.description: The kamadan's serpents lash out, forcing a creature within 5 feet to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 21 (6d6) Poison damage. Success: Half damage. The kamadan can take this action even while Incapacitated.

bonusActions.name: Prowling Pounce
bonusActions.description: The kamadan leaps up to 20 feet, then can force one creature within 5 feet to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The target is knocked Prone. If the target is Dazed or the kamadan started its turn with the Invisible condition, the target has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

bonusActions.name: Lethargy Breath (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description: The kamadan breathes a soporific gas in a 30-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The creature is Dazed for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn), or falls Unconscious until the end of its next turn if it was already Dazed.

name: Polar Kraken
savingThrows: Str +11, Dex +5, Con +10, Int +9, Wis +9, Cha +5
immunities: Lightning, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks; Frightened, Paralyzed
languages: Understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, And Primordial But Can't Speak, Telepathy 120 Ft.

traits.name: Transparent
traits.description: If the kraken has not eaten in the last week, it is invisible to creatures more than 30 feet away from it, and can attempt to Hide as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Freezing Grip
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn grappled by the kraken loses two unexpended hit dice. If it cannot, it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be Paralyzed until the beginnning of its next turn.

traits.name: Boneless
traits.description: The kraken can move through a space as narrow as 10 feet wide without squeezing, and its movement is not hindered by its Razor Lattice.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The kraken makes three attacks with its Tentacle Lash, each of which it can replace a use of its Fling.

actions.name: Tentacle Lash
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 30 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Fling
actions.description: The kraken flings an object or creature grappled by it up to 60 feet. If the creature collides with a creature or surface, it takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet fewer than 60 that it traveled. A creature hit by the projectile must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 10 feet away and take the same amount of damage.

actions.name: Cavernous Maw
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft., one Huge or smaller target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) cold damage and the target is swallowed. While swallowed, the creature's attacks bypass the kraken's damage resistances and it takes 21 (6d6) Cold damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns. If it takes 40 damage or more in a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

actions.name: Razor Lattice (Level 6 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The kraken freezes the water in a 30-foot radius centered on a point it can see into an open latice of razor-sharp crystals, which last for a minute. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature pushed or flung into or through it takes an additional 10 (3d6) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Freeze Breath (Level 2 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the kraken can see within 60 feet attempts to cast a spell, the kraken forces the creature to make a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature must use a spell slot of one level higher to cast the spell, or have the spell fail.

legendaryActions.name: Tentacle Lash or Fling
legendaryActions.description: The kraken makes an attack with its Tentacle Lash or uses its Fling.

legendaryActions.name: Glacier Shard (Level 4 Spell, Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The kraken conjures a 10-foot radius shard of ice at a point it can see within 120 feet, which rockets to the surface, moving 15 feet toward the surface at the beginning of each creature's turn. Whenever it moves, each creature whose space it enters must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed 15 feet toward the surface, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Shatter Lattice (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The kraken shatters the matrix of crystals created by its razor lattice. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (4d6) Slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) Cold damage, or half as much damage on a success.

name: The Kraken (From Surface)
savingThrows: Str +17, Dex +7, Con +14, Int +13, Wis +11, Cha +5
immunities: Lightning, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks; Frightened, Paralyzed
languages: Understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, And Primordial But Can't Speak, Telepathy 120 Ft.

traits.name: Tentacles
traits.description:
The kraken has 10 tentacles, each of which behaves as a separate creature that acts on the kraken's initiative and have the following properties:
*

traits.name: Length
traits.description:
Each tentacle is 100 feet long.
*

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.description:
Each tentacle has AC 18 and 75 Hit Points. When reduced to 0 Hit Points, the tentacle drops anything it is grappling and retreats to the kraken's body.
*

traits.name: Resistances and Immunities
traits.description:
Each tentacle has Immunity to Lightning damage and Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks
*

traits.name: Movement
traits.description:
Each tentacle has a speed of 15 feet.
*

traits.name: Senses
traits.description:
Each tentacle has blindsight 5 ft. (blind beyond that radius).
*

traits.name: Grappling
traits.description: The tentacle may grapple one creature or object each turn (escape DC 18). A creature may make a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw to avoid this grapple. A tentacle may grapple multiple creatures or objects. If the tentacle crosses the full deck of a ship or encounters a mast, it may grapple the ship.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

traits.name: Eternal Titan
traits.description: When the kraken is reduced to 0 HP, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it cannot take actions other than to dash unless it is in its lair. While at 0 HP and in its lair, it can killed by collapsing its lair with an Earthquake spell or equivalent magic.

actions.name: Surface
actions.description: The kraken surfaces, creating an enormous tidal wave. Each creature without cover must make a DC 18 Dexterity save or take 11 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed overboard. A creature that is not surprised may use its reaction to clutch onto something sturdy and gain Advantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Clutch
actions.description: The kraken grips a ship, reducing its movement to 0. While it has a ship clutched in this way, it is has full cover from creatures on the ship.

actions.name: Crush
actions.description: Each creature and object the kraken's tentacles have grappled takes 20 (3d6 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. A ship grappled by two or more tentacles must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw (a typical sailing ship has +3 to this roll) or begin to split.

actions.name: Capsize
actions.description: The kraken capsizes a ship that has begun to split. Each creature on board or grappled by the tentacles must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall into the kraken's mouth and be swallowed as the ship is ripped apart.

actions.name: Submerge
actions.description: The kraken descends up to 60 feet, leaving a massive whirlpool in its wake that lasts for a minute, 250 feet wide and 25 feet deep. A creature or object that starts its turn in the vortex must make a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled 20 feet towards the vortex's center, take 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage, and be unable to move away from the vortex's center until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Tentacle Whirlwind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot radius around the kraken must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 91 (26d6) Bludgeoning damage and be shoved 20 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Tentacle Lash or Fling
legendaryActions.description: The kraken makes an attack with its Tentacle Lash or uses its Fling.

legendaryActions.name: Blanket
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 50 feet of the kraken must make a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or be grappled by one of its tentacles.

legendaryActions.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The kraken expels a cloud of toxic ink, heavily obscuring the area in a 60-foot radius centered on itself until the end of its next turn. Each other creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.

name: Astral Kraken
savingThrows: Str +17, Dex +2, Con +18, Int +6, Wis +4, Cha +14
immunities: Psychic, Attacks made without Advantage; Frightened, Paralyzed
languages: Deep Speech, Telepathy (can communicate with any creature on the same plane of existence)

traits.name: Tentacles from Beyond
traits.description: Each creature that the kraken can see is treated as within its reach as space stretches and warps before its attacks.

traits.name: Incomprehensible Horror
traits.description: A creature that can see the kraken and is not afflicted with any sort of madness or reduction to its Wisdom score is Frightened.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

traits.name: Madness Titan
traits.description: When the kraken is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, the kraken chews a hole through reality and teleports to the far realm at the start of its following turn. A creature that starts its turn within 500 feet of this screaming wound in space must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to make a melee attack against itself or its ship.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The kraken makes three attacks with its Tentacle Lash and uses its Absorb Psyche.

actions.name: Tentacle Lash
actions.description: Attack: +18 reach 30 ft. Hit: 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 22 (4d10) psychic damage, and if the kraken is within 30 feet of the target, the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 26).

actions.name: Absorb Psyche
actions.description: Each creature grappled by the kraken must succeed on a DC 23 Charisma Saving Throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 (2d4), to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Long Rest. A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way is Charmed by the kraken and hostile to all other creatures, though it endeavors to conceal this fact if possible.

actions.name: Blot Out the Stars (Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The kraken warps space, twisting until the kraken entirely envelops a 100-foot radius sphere centered on a point it can see within 50 feet, surrounding it in a blanket of black eyes and roiling flesh. A creature in the sphere cannot leave by any means short of a Wish, its attacks bypass the kraken's damage resistances, and it takes 33 (6d10) Psychic damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns. Each creature within 10 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be disoriented, making attacks at Disadvantage until the end of its next turn. Additionally, a creature that fails this save falls prone if it misses with a melee attack on its following turn.

A creature with its heart removed in this way cannot gain class levels until its heart is returned or replaced, and dies if its heart is destroyed. reactions.name: Thrash

The spider magically shifts from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

resistances: Weapon attacks not made from inside it

traits.name: Tunneler

traits.name: Earth Quaker
traits.description: When the worm burrows 30 feet or fewer below the surface, 10-foot wide, 10-foot deep fissures open at the surface above where it passes. Creatures in the space where a fissure opens must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone in the trench, or move to the nearest unoccupied space outside the area on a success.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the worm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

traits.name: Shock Sensitivity
traits.description: If the worm, or the ground within 30 feet of it is subjected to Lightning damage, it cannot use its Terror From the Deep action on its next turn, and must use all of its movement to surface.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The worm makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and it takes Hit: 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns. If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw, taking Hit: 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

As a bonus action, the worm may make a bite attack against a creature that failed this save.

actions.description: The remorhaz winds itself into a tight coil, venting scalding steam in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Fire damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success. Until the start of its next turn, the remorhaz is restrained, its Heated Chitin trait is disabled, and its space is Heavily Obscured unless cleared by a strong wind.

actions.name: Terror From the Deep (1/Day)
actions.description: The remorhaz moves up to its burrow speed, then bursts from underground, thrashing in a flurry of debris. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 35 (10d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

name: Roc Hatchling
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +1, Int -4, Cha -1

traits.name: Newly Fledged
traits.description: At the end of each of its turns, if the roc is airborne it must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity Saving Throw or gain the Prone condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The roc makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Cheeping Bob.

actions.name: Greedy Peck
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Cheeping Bob
actions.description: The roc hops up to 10 feet, then screeches in a 5-foot Emanation; each creature in the area must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The target uses its Reaction to drop anything it is wielding and cover its ears, or takes 4 (1d8) Thunder damage and gains the Prone condition if it can't.

name: Roc Fledgling
savingThrows: Str +7, Con +4, Int -4, Cha -1

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: Attacks made against the roc by a creature Attached to it have Advantage, and the roc has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures Attached to it.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the roc fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The roc makes two attacks with its Talon Gouge, one of which it can replace with its Cruel Beak if it is not flying.

actions.name: Cruel Beak
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) piercing damage. An Incapacitated target, or one reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack, gains the Swallowed condition if it is Huge or smaller. At the beginning of each of the roc's turns, the Swallowed creature takes 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Talon Gouge
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19). A creature that escapes from this grapple can choose to become Attached to the roc.

actions.name: Calamitous Stoop (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The roc tucks its wings and dives up to its speed, then can make a Talon Gouge attack with Advantage. On a hit, the target has the Prone condition and must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target has the Stunned condition for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

reactions.name: Mantling Shroud
reactions.description: Trigger: The roc reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack. Response: Until the beginning of the roc's next turn, the creature has Total Cover against effects originating outside the roc's space and the roc's Speed becomes 0.

name: Thunderwing Roc
savingThrows: Str +9, Con +5, Int -4, Wis +5, Cha +4

traits.name: Titanic Flight
traits.description: Attacks made against the roc by a creature Attached to it have Advantage, and the roc has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures Attached to it. If the roc lands, its Fly speed becomes 0. This effect ends if the roc falls at least 40 feet, or if it begins flying using its Wingbeat Gale.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the roc fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The roc makes two attacks with its Talon Gouge, one of which it can replace with its Cruel Beak if it is not flying.

actions.name: Cruel Beak
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 15 ft. Hit: 22 (2d12 + 9) piercing damage. An Incapacitated target, or one reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack, has the Swallowed condition. At the beginning of each of the roc's turns, the Swallowed creature takes 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Talon Gouge
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 20 ft. Hit: 31 (5d8 + 9) piercing damage and the target has the Prone and Grappled conditions (escape DC 17). A creature that escapes from this grapple can choose to become Attached to the roc.

actions.name: Calamitous Stoop (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The roc tucks its wings and dives up to its Speed, then can make a Talon Gouge attack with Advantage. On a hit, the target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target has the Stunned condition for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

reactions.name: Mantling Shroud
reactions.description: Trigger: The roc reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack. Response: Until the beginning of the roc's next turn, the creature has Total Cover against effects originating outside the roc's space and the roc's Speed becomes 0.

reactions.name: Defiant Scream (1/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: The roc is Bloodied. Response: Each creature in a 300-foot Emanation from the roc. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The creature has the Dazed and Deafened conditions until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Fluttering Peck
legendaryActions.description: If the roc isn't flying, it can leap up to 20 feet, then make a Cruel Beak attack.

legendaryActions.name: Wingbeat Gale
legendaryActions.description: The roc makes a DC 20 Strength check. On a success, it can fly up to 40 feet, then each creature in a 40-foot Emanation from it must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target has the Prone condition. A creature Attached to the roc has Advantage on this saving throw.

name: Roper
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +3, Cha -2
resistances: Lightning; Piercing from Nonmagical Attacks Made With Ranged Weapons

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the roper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation, such as a stalagmite.

traits.name: Grasping Tendrils
traits.description: The roper can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 Hit Points; immunity to poison and Psychic damage). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the roper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The roper makes six attacks, one of which may be with its ravening maw, and uses its Reel.

actions.name: Ravening Maw
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage. This attack is made with Advantage against a grappled creature. On a critical hit, the target is Frightened until the end of the roper's next turn.

actions.name: Tendril Snare
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 50 ft. Hit: The target is Grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Wrench
actions.description: One creature grappled by at least two tendrils must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much damage on a success. A creature that succeeds on this save by 5 or more may use its reaction to attempt to escape the grapples.

actions.name: Reel
actions.description: The roper pulls each creature grappled by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

name: Storoper
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +4, Int -2, Wis +3, Cha -2
resistances: Piercing from Nonmagical Attacks Made With Ranged Weapons

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the storoper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation, such as a stalagmite.

traits.name: Grasping Tendrils
traits.description: The storoper can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 Hit Points). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the storoper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The storoper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The storoper makes six attacks, up to one of which may be with its stonetooth bite, and uses its whipping reel, if available.

actions.name: Stonetooth Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 26 (4d10 + 4) piercing damage. This attack is made with Advantage against a grappled creature.

actions.name: Numbing Tendril
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 50 ft. Hit: The target is Grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target subtracts 1d6 from its Dexterity score for each tendril attached to it. A creature reduced to 0 Dexterity in this way is Paralyzed and has its skin take on a stony grey pallor until it is freed.

actions.name: Wrench
actions.description: One creature grappled by at least two tendrils must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much damage on a success. A creature that succeeds on this save by 5 or more may use its reaction to attempt to escape the grapples.

actions.name: Whipping Reel (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature grappled by the storoper must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage and be moved up to 30 ft. in a direction of the storoper's choice, or take half as much damage on a success

name: Prismatic Roper
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +3, Int -3, Wis +6, Cha +7

traits.name: Grasping Tendrils
traits.description: The roper can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 Hit Points). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the roper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Mesmeric Display
traits.description: A creature that can see the roper has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive anything other than the roper, and on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to perceive hostile intent in the roper if it has not yet attacked.

traits.name: Dweomer Scintilation
traits.description: Whenever the roper makes a saving throw against a spell or magical effect that does not deal damage, each creature within 30 ft. that can see the roper must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be stunned until the end of the roper's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The roper makes six attacks and uses its vision drain.

actions.name: Mindlink Tendril
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 40 ft. Hit: *Hit:* Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) poison damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) psychic damage. A medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 15) and can hear the surface thoughts of each other creature grappled by the roper. Whenever a grappled creature casts a spell, each other creature grappled by the roper takes 5 (1d10) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Vision Drain
actions.description: Each creature grappled by the roper must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or have the range of its Darkvision reduced by 15 ft. until it completes a Long Rest. A creature without Darkvision is instead Blinded while in Dim Light until it completes a Long Rest.

actions.name: Nervebore Jolt (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature grappled by the roper must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 35 (10d6) Piercing damage plus 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, or half the piercing and none of the Psychic damage on a success.

name: Roving Mauler Thumper
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Poor Turner
traits.description: When the mauler begins moving on its turn, it must continue at least 20 feet in the same direction before turning, and may make a turn of no more than 90 degrees. If this movement is arrested due to impacting a solid surface, the mauler immediately ends its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mauler makes three attacks, each of which must be against a different target.

actions.name: Cartwheel Slash
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone and the mauler can immediately make a second attack against it.

reactions.name: Ramped Leap
reactions.description: When the mauler moves at least 10 feet directly toward a prone creature and then enters its space, the mauler can deal 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage to it and jump up to 15 feet in the same direction.

name: Roving Mauler Wheelie-King
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +2, Int -4, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Poor Turner
traits.description: When the mauler begins moving on its turn, it must continue at least 20 feet in the same direction before turning, and may make a turn of no more than 90 degrees. If this movement is arrested due to impacting a solid surface, the mauler immediately ends its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mauler makes four attacks, each of which must be against a different target, or makes two attacks and uses its Tumblethump Charge.

actions.name: Cartwheel Slash
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone and the mauler can immediately make a second attack against it.

actions.name: Tumblethump Charge
actions.description: The roving mauler uses all of its remaining movement speed to move in a straight line. Each Large or smaller creature in its path must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reactions.name: Ramped Leap
reactions.description: When the mauler moves at least 10 feet directly toward a prone creature and then enters its space, the mauler can deal 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage to it and jump up to 15 feet in the same direction.

reactions.name: Double-Barrel Roar
reactions.description: When a creature grapples the mauler or makes a melee attack against it that benefits from flanking it, the mauler can let out a terrifying, polyphonic roar. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or jump 5 feet directly away from the mauler and fall prone.

name: Rust Monster
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +1, Con +1, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Iron Scent
traits.description: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.

traits.name: Rust Metal
traits.description: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the rust monster corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the rust monster is destroyed after dealing damage.

traits.name: Oxide Armor
traits.description: Whenever the Rust Monster takes any acid or Lightning damage, its AC is reduced by 2 until the end of its next turn. Whenever the Rust Monster takes any Fire damage, its AC is improved by 2 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Antennae
actions.description: The rust monster corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object it can see within 5 feet of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 11 Dexterity Saving Throw to avoid the rust monster's touch. If the object touched is either metal armor or a metal shield being worn or carried, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held metal weapon, it rusts as described in the Rust Metal trait.

actions.name: Rust Monsters as Plot Hooks
actions.description: The lair of a rust monster glutton might contain a half-corroded magic weapon, prompting the party to seek out a great weaponsmith who can restore the weapon to its full glory.

name: Rust Monster Glutton
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +1, Con +8, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Iron Scent
traits.description: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 60 feet of it.

traits.name: Rust Metal
traits.description: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the rust monster corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the rust monster is destroyed after dealing damage.

traits.name: Oxide Armor
traits.description: Whenever the Rust Monster takes any acid or Lightning damage, its AC is reduced by 2 until the end of its next turn. Whenever the Rust Monster takes any Fire damage, its AC is improved by 2 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rust monster uses its antennae once and makes two attacks with its bite. It may use its disrupt magic ability in place of its antennae.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held metal weapon, it rusts as described in the Rust Metal trait.

actions.name: Disrupt Magic (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The rust monster temporarily disrupts the magic of a nonartifact magic item within 5 feet. For the next minute, the item's magic is suppressed, and the item behaves as if it were nonmagical.

name: Rust Monster Annihilator
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +10, Con +11, Int +3, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Dust Drinker
traits.description: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature within 1 mile that has been damaged by the antennae of it or another rust monster annihilator. A creature may shed this scent only by means of a Regenerate spell or similar magic.

traits.name: Annihilating Wake
traits.description: The rust monster can burrow through any nonmagical, nonliving material at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Disintigrating Touch
traits.description: Any nonmagical weapon that hits the rust monster disintigrates after dealing damage. A creature that hits the rust monster with an unarmed attack must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 5 (1d10) Force damage.

traits.name: Clinging Dust Armor
traits.description: Whenever the rust monster uses its Shed Detritus ability, its AC decreases by 1 to a minimum of 15. Whenever the rust monster hits a creature or object with its annihilating antennae its AC increases by 1 to a maximum of 20. If the rust monster takes any Lightning damage, its AC is reduced to 15.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The rust monster has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rust monster makes two attacks with its annihilating antennae, one of which it may replace with a use of its Disrupt Magic, if available.

actions.name: Annihilating Antennae
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft., one target creature, object, or construct of magical force. Hit: 36 (6d10 + 3) force damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage disintigrates. A nonmagical object or construct of magical force hit with this attack disintigrates. If the target is a nonmagical object that is worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw to avoid the rust monster's touch.

actions.name: Disrupt Magic (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The rust monster temporarily disrupts the magic of a nonartifact magic item within 5 feet. For the next minute, the item's magic is suppressed, and the item behaves as if it were nonmagical.

reactions.name: Shed Detritus
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking damage, the rust monster shakes loose the dust that clings to it. Each creature within 5 ft. of it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of the rust monster's next turn.

name: Grey Scavver
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -5, Cha -5

traits.name: Instinctive Hibernation
traits.description: Whenever the scavver takes Cold damage, if it has fewer than 10 Hit Points remaining it falls asleep for the next minute.

traits.name: Electrosensitive
traits.description: If the scavver takes any Lightning damage, it has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Poor Memory
traits.description: The scavver cannot clearly recollect events that happened more than 6 seconds ago

actions.name: Frenzied Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. This attack is made at Advantage against a creature that is missing any of its Hit Points.

reactions.name: Regroup
reactions.description: As a reaction when it is reduced below 10 Hit Points, the scavver moves up to its speed away from the source of the damage without provoking attacks of opportunity.

name: Brown Scavver
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -5, Cha -5

traits.name: Instinctive Hibernation
traits.description: Whenever the scavver takes Cold damage, if it has fewer than 10 Hit Points remaining it falls asleep for the next minute.

traits.name: Electrosensitive
traits.description: If the scavver takes any Lightning damage, it has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Swallowing Reflex
traits.description: A creature may throw an object into the scavver's mouth with a successful improvised attack roll against the scavver's AC. If it does, the scavver swallows the object, counting as a willing creature for any effects of the swallowed object.

actions.name: Gulp
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or be swallowed by the scavver (escape DC 13). While swallowed, a creature is Blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the scavver, and takes 13 (3d8) poison damage at the start of each of the scavver's turns.

actions.name: Broadside Slam
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Vent Gullet
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature it has swallowed escapes, the scavver vents the poisonous gas from its gullet. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Night Scavver
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -5, Cha -5

traits.name: Instinctive Hibernation
traits.description: Whenever the scavver takes Cold damage, if it has fewer than 10 Hit Points remaining it falls asleep for the next minute.

traits.name: Electrosensitive
traits.description: If the scavver takes any Lightning damage, it has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Obdurate
traits.description: If forced to move from a space, the night scavver always returns to the space it was moved from on its following turn, or to the nearest unoccupied space it can reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16). This attack is made at Advantage against a creature that is missing any of its Hit Points.

actions.name: Broadside Slam
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away. If the target is a ship, each creature on board must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone.

reactions.name: Push Back
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature fails at an attempt to shove the scavver, the scavver forces the creature to succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away.

name: Void Scavver
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +3, Con +4, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -3

traits.name: Instinctive Hibernation
traits.description: Whenever the scavver takes Cold damage, if it has fewer than 10 Hit Points remaining it falls asleep for the next minute.

traits.name: Electrosensitive
traits.description: If the scavver takes any Lightning damage, it has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scavver makes two attacks with its Broadside Slam and uses its Fear Gaze, if available.

actions.name: Swallowing Bite
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 45 (6d12 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or be swallowed by the scavver (escape DC 17). While swallowed, a creature is Blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the scavver, and takes 11 (2d10) Acid damage at the start of each of the scavver's turns.

actions.name: Broadside Slam
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away. If the target is a ship, each creature on board must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 10 feet away and fall prone.

actions.name: Fear Gaze (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet the scavver can see must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the scavver's next turn.

reactions.name: Hypercompetitive
reactions.description: If the void scavver is within 10 feet of a hostile creature and another scavver ends its movement within 10 ft. of the void scavver, the void scavver must use its reaction to make a broadside slame attack against it.

name: Sharktopus
savingThrows: Str +6, Con +5, Int -5, Wis +1, Cha -3

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: While out of water, the sharktopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Underwater Camouflage
traits.description: The sharktopus has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and Deception (Charisma) checks made to impersonate natural terrain or another aquatic creature.

traits.name: Test Bite
traits.description: If the sharktopus starts its turn with no hostile creatures within 5 ft. of it, it may Dash or Disengage as a bonus action this turn.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.description: The sharktopus has Advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sharktopus makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite. It may replace one attack with a use of its Fling.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of its turns, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or lose 5 (2d4) Hit Points, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is Grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is Restrained.

actions.name: Fling
actions.description: Each creature grappled by the sharktopus is thrown up to 30 feet. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take the same damage.

actions.name: Blanket (Recharge 5-6, underwater only)
actions.description: Each creature in a 15 ft. radius sphere must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 17) and pulled up to 5 ft. toward the sharktopus. Until this grapple ends, the target is Restrained. A creature without a swim speed makes this save at Disadvantage.

reactions.name: Circle
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 64 Hit Points, the sharktopus moves up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. Each creature of its choice within 50 ft. that has fewer than 20 Hit Points must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Ink Cloud (1/day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 87 Hit Points while underwater, the sharktopus exudes a 20-foot-radius cloud of ink around itself. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the sharktopus can use the Dash or Hide action as a bonus action.

name: Shunned
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Spidersac Incubator
traits.description: If the shunned takes 10 or more radiant damage from a single source or ends its turn in Sunlight, it loses a use of its Disgorge Spiders.

traits.name: Fruitless Devotion
traits.description: If a creature the shunned can see uses its action to brandish a holy symbol of Lolth, the shunned must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed and Frightened by it until the beginning of the creature's next turn.

actions.name: Lurching Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) poison damage. A creature reduced to 10 or fewer Hit Points by this damage falls Unconscious until the end of the shunned's next turn.

actions.name: Disgorge Spiders (3/Day, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The shunned loses 5 Hit Points as one of its growths bursts, disgorging a Swarm of Spiders in a space within 5 feet that acts on the shunned's turn and under its control for the next minute.

reactions.name: Blacken Magic (Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: When a spell or magical effect targets an area the shunned can see within 30 feet, it can fill that area with Magical Darkness for the spell's duration.

reactions.name: Sickening Wail (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the shunned takes any radiant damage, it can loose a horrid wail. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of the shunned's next turn.

name: Skiurid Scurrier
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +3, Con -1, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -3

traits.name: Zig-Zag
traits.description: The first time each turn that a creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the skiurid, it may move up to 10 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity.

traits.name: Skittish
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of the skiurid that is hidden from it must make a new stealth check at the beginning of each of its turns to remain hidden from it.

actions.name: Shadow Gnaw
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. If the skurid is in dim light or darkness, it may teleport up to 20 feet before or after making this attack.

actions.name: Scolding Alarm
actions.description: The skiurid chirps forth a complex alarm signal. Each creature that the squirrel can see ceases to be hidden from any creature that can hear the squirrel.

actions.name: Apocrine Shadowglyph (1/Day)
actions.description: The skiurid rubs its cheeks on a surface, magically leaving a faintly visible mark upon it. Nonmagical lights and lights produced by spells of 2nd level or below within 30 feet of this glyph produce only dim light, and the light they produce extends no further than 15 feet form its source.

name: Skiurid Swarm
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +4, Con +2, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -3
immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny skiurid.

traits.name: Umbral Aura
traits.description: Nonmagical lights and lights produced by spells of 2nd level or below within 30 feet of the swarm produce only dim light, and the light they produce extends no further than 15 feet form its source.

traits.name: Skittish
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of the swarm that is hidden from it must make a new stealth check at the beginning of each of its turns to remain hidden from it.

actions.name: Strip Flesh
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 30 (12d4) piercing damage, or Hit: 15 (6d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its Hit Points or fewer.

actions.name: Skeletonize
actions.description: One creature with 0 Hit Points in the swarm's space must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or die and have its flesh stripped away, leaving only a skeleton. On a successful save, the creature fails one death save.

reactions.name: Shadow Scamper
reactions.description: As a reaction when the swarm takes damage while in dim light or darkness, it teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

name: Skiurid Sovereign
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +9, Con +6, Wis +6, Cha +1

traits.name: Lost in the Mob
traits.description: If the sovereign starts its turn within 10 feet of one or more other skiurids, it becomes hidden from each creature with a Passive Perception lower than 20 until the start of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.description: If the sovereign is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sovereign makes four attacks with its Shadow Gnaw.

actions.name: Shadow Gnaw
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d4 + 6) piercing damage. If the skurid is in dim light or darkness, it may teleport up to 20 feet before or after making this attack.

actions.name: Rite of the Nugget-Keeper
actions.description: One creature the sovereign can see must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 2 (1d4) Necrotic damage for each sciurid scurrier within 5 feet of it, plus 10 (4d4) Necrotic damage for each skiurrid swarm within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Echoing Chitter
actions.description: The sovereign fills the air with sourceless, menacing chittering and red eyes gleam from every shadow. Each creature of the sovereign's choice within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Skittering Shadows
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the skiurid can see makes an attack of opportunity, the skiurid forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or instead make an attack against a creature of the skiurid's choice.

name: Sphinx of Wonder
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +3, Con +1, Int +2, Wis +1, Cha +4

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The sphinx has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Careful Study
traits.description: Whenever the sphinx uses the Help action to give Advantage on an attack, the sphinx learns one of the target's Resistances, Vulnerabilities, or Immunities, if it has any.

actions.name: Shining Slash
actions.description: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Tangle Legs
actions.description: One Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The creature falls Prone. Success: The sphinx takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Burst of Ingenuity (2/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: The sphinx or another creature within 30 feet makes an ability check or a saving throw. Response: The sphinx adds 2 to the roll.

name: Sphinx Magi
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +4, Wis +4, Cha +4

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.description: While it is not Bloodied, the sphinx automatically succeeds on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sphinx makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Asylum Field.

actions.name: Exalted Claw
actions.description: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Force damage. This attack ignores the effects of Disadvantage.

actions.name: Unveiling Ray (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +7 range 120 ft. Hit: 21 (6d6) radiant damage and each spell of Level 2 or below affecting the target ends. This attack does not suffer Disadvantage for targeting Invisible creatures, and ignores spell-based bonuses to AC.

actions.name: Asylum Field (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Protective glyphs swirl around the sphinx in a 15-foot Emanation. Creatures in the area have Advantage on saving throws against any effect that targets an area, and take no damage on a successful saving throw against such an effect.

bonusActions.name: Foresee
bonusActions.description: The sphinx gains Advantage on the next d20 Test it makes before the start of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Thunderous Rejection (Level 3 Spell)
bonusActions.description: Each creature of the sphinx�s choice in a 15-foot Emanation from it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 16 (3d10) Thunder damage and the creature is pushed up to 20 feet away. Success: Half damage.

name: Sphinx Gatekeeper
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +8, Int +9, Wis +9, Cha +5

traits.name: Sphinx's Insight
traits.description: Whenever a creature succeeds on a saving throw against one of the sphinx's abilities, the sphinx learns one of its most deeply held secrets or treasured memories.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.description: While it is not Bloodied, the sphinx automatically succeeds on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

traits.name: Unwavering Vigil (3/Day)
traits.description: At the start of each of the sphinx's turns, it can end one spell or condition affecting it. The save DC of the sphinx's abilities increases by 1 for each expended use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sphinx makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Twine Fates or Riddle of Gate and Key.

actions.name: Twine Fates (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature the sphinx can see within 60 feet must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The creature is Cursed. Whenever the sphinx would take any damage, the sphinx takes half as much, and the Cursed creature takes an equal amount of Psychic damage.

actions.name: Riddle of Gate and Key (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The sphinx raises an invisible wall of force, enclosing the area in a 20-foot Emanation from it. When a creature attempts to pass through the wall or affect a target on the other side of the wall for the first time on a turn, the sphinx can force it to make an Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The attempt fails and the creature is Stunned until the start of its next turn. Success: For one minute, the creature becomes immune to this effect, and other creatures have Advantage on saving throws against this effect.

legendaryActions.name: Test of Valor
legendaryActions.description: The sphinx briefly appears as a personalized terror to each creature that can see it, forcing each creature of its choice within 30 feet to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 16 (3d10) Psychic damage and the creature is Frightened until the end of the sphinx's next turn, or until the sphinx is hit with a melee attack.

legendaryActions.name: Test of Reflex
legendaryActions.description: The sphinx marks a number of unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of it equal to the number of creatures in the area. Until the start of the sphinx's next turn, a creature that ends its turn outside one of those spaces must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 18 (4d8) Radiant Damage

legendaryActions.name: Test of Resolve
legendaryActions.description: Roll 1d100 in secret. Each creature within 60 feet of the sphinx can sacrifice any number of Hit Points. If the total amount sacrificed is less than the number rolled, each creature of the sphinx's choice in the area must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The creature is Stunned until the end of the sphinx's next turn.

name: Sphinx Chronarch
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +6, Con +11, Int +12, Wis +12, Cha +4

traits.name: Sphinx�s Insight
traits.description: Whenever a creature succeeds on a saving throw against one of the sphinx�s abilities, the sphinx learns one of its most deeply held secrets or treasured memories.

actions.description: The sphinx makes two attacks and uses its Riddle of Wrath Returned or Riddle of Time Eclipsed.
