actions.name: Bolt from Beyond (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +12 range 120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) psychic damage and the target is pushed 5 feet in a direction of the sphinx's choice. This attack hits its target automatically, so long as it does not have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Riddle of Wrath Returned (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Up to three creatures the sphinx can see within 60 feet must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: Until the end of the creature�s next turn, whenever it deals damage it takes an equal amount of damage.

actions.name: Riddle of Time Eclipsed (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: The sphinx erodes a future moment. Whenever a creature within 60 feet starts its turn, the sphinx can roll a d4. On a roll of 1, the creature ends its turn and this effect ends.

actions.name: Splice Timeline (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: The sphinx conjures a nearly-identical copy of a creature within 60 feet, which immediately takes a turn under the sphinx's control then disappears. The copy can't cast spells of Level 6 or above. An unwilling target can make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 20. Success: The copy takes no action. Success by 5 or More: The copy instead takes an action under the target's control.

actions.name: Future-Sieve (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: Roll 3d20 and mark the result of each. For 1 minute, whenever a creature within 30 feet rolls one of those numbers on a d20 Test, the sphinx can change the result either to a 20 or a 1. Each result can be used only once in this way. This effect ends early if the sphinx casts this spell again.

reactions.name: Posibility Vault (Level 2 Spell)
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 30 feet rolls with Advantage or Disadvantage. Response: Make note of the target's discarded d20 result. The next time that creature makes a d20 Test, it uses the discarded result, instead of rolling.

legendaryActions.name: Exalted Bound
legendaryActions.description: The sphinx leaps up to 20 feet, then can make an attack with its Exalted Claw.

legendaryActions.name: Thunderous Rejection (Level 3 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: Each creature of the sphinx�s choice in a 15-foot Emanation from it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 16 (3d10) Thunder damage and the creature is pushed up to 20 feet away. Success: Half damage.

legendaryActions.name: Glyph of Recurrence (Level 3 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The sphinx casts a spell of Level 3 or below that it saw a creature within 60 feet cast since the end of its last turn (Save DC 20, +12 to Hit).

legendaryActions.name: Burden of Years (Level 5 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: One creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The creature gains 1 level of Exhaustion, then appears to age 10% of its natural lifespan for as long as it has any levels of Exhaustion.

name: Stench Kow
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex -1, Con +4, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -4

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.description: If the kow moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the kow can make one attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the kow must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Reckless Thrash
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the kow can gain Advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it falls prone and is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

name: Stirge Harrier
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex +3, Int -4, Wis -1, Cha -2

traits.name: Breath Sight
traits.description: A creature that does not need to breathe is Invisible to the stirge, and a creature that holds its breath has Advantage on checks made to hide from the stirge.

traits.name: Weakness Seeker
traits.description: The stirge's attacks have Advantage against creatures afflicted with a disease.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the stirge takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the stirge takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Pierce Vein (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 Piercing damage and the stirge becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 13).

actions.name: Draw Blood
actions.description: One creature the stirge is Attached to loses 2 Hit Points. Then, if the creature has lost 6 or more Hit Points in this way this turn, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Redding Ague.

name: Stirge Skullpiercer
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +4, Con +2, Int -4, Wis -1, Cha -2

traits.name: Breath Sight
traits.description: A creature that does not need to breathe is Invisible to the stirge, and a creature that holds its breath has Advantage on checks made to hide from the stirge.

traits.name: Weakness Seeker
traits.description: The stirge's attacks have Advantage against creatures afflicted with a disease.

actions.name: Pierce Vein
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage and the stirge becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 14).

actions.name: Draw Blood
actions.description: One creature the stirge is Attached to loses 5 Hit Points, then must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Redding Ague.

actions.name: Essence Transfusion (Recharges when the stirge uses its Draw Blood)
actions.description: The stirge revitalizes itself or a creature it is attached to with stored blood, restoring 5 Hit Points.

reactions.name: Pierce Skull
reactions.description: When a humanoid creature the stirge is Attached to drops to 0 Hit Points, the stirge can repositions itself, piercing the creature's head and gaining control of its body. The creature is not Incapacitated while at 0 Hit Points, and fails death saving throws automatically. On each of the creature's turns, it moves under the stirge's control and takes the Attack action against a target of the stirge's choice.

name: Stirge Hive Tender
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +3, Int -4, Wis -1, Cha -2

traits.name: Skull Symbiote
traits.description: The hive tender's skull is fused with and houses a parasitic monstrosity, which can be targeted with attacks (AC 16, HP 40, vulnerability to Fire damage). If the parasite dies, the hive tender dies.

traits.name: Weakness Seeker
traits.description: The hive tender's attacks have Advantage against creatures afflicted with a disease.

actions.name: Lunging Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, the hive tender moves up to 5 feet toward the target, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13)

actions.name: Needle's Kiss (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: If the hive tender's proboscis is extended, it slams its head repeatedly into a creature grappled by it. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Piercing damage and be infected with Redding Ague, or take half as much damage on a success.

bonusActions.name: Extend Proboscis
bonusActions.description: A needle-like proboscis extends from the hive tender's mouth until it retracts it as a bonus action. While extended, attacks against the hive tender's Skull Symbiote are made with Advantage.

name: Stirge Queen
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +6, Con +5, Int -2, Wis -1, Cha +5

traits.name: Breath Sight
traits.description: A creature that does not need to breathe is Invisible to the stirge queen, and a creature that holds its breath has Advantage on checks made to hide from the stirge queen.

traits.name: Weakness-Seeker
traits.description: The stirge queen has Advantage on attacks that target creatures afflicted with a disease.

traits.name: Miasmatic Hemorrhaging
traits.description: A non-stirge creature that has fewer than half its Hit Points and starts its turn within 30 feet of the stirge queen must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or begin Bleeding (1d4, Save Ends at end of turn). *Legendary Resistance (1/Day)* If the stirge queen fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The stirge queen makes two attacks with her Pinning Talons.

actions.name: Pinning Talons
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the stirge queen can knock the target prone and grapple it until she moves (escape DC 15). *Blood Spear:* *Ranged Spell Attack:* +6, range 30 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Plague Blood Torrent (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The stirge queen spews forth a torrent of contaminated blood in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 17 (5d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with Redding Ague.

reactions.name: Awaken Their Hunger (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the stirge queen is reduced below 62 Hit Points, she can let out a frantic hypersonic signal. Each other stirge within 30 feet that can hear her can use its reaction to make a melee attack.

legendaryActions.name: Fend Off
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 5 feet away and knocked prone.

legendaryActions.name: Feed Your Queen
legendaryActions.description: The stirge queen consumes one stirge in her reach that has fed in the last minute, killing it and gaining 14 (4d6) Temporary Hit Points.

name: Strigoi Pariah
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +4, Con +3, Wis +5

traits.name: Weakness-Seeker
traits.description: The strigoi has Advantage on attacks that target creatures afflicted with a disease.

traits.name: Bursting Flock
traits.description: When the strigoi dies, 7 (2d6) Stirge Harriers burst from its corpse.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The strigoi makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Dripping Talons
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) acid damage. Instead of dealing damage, the strigoi may grapple the target (escape DC 13)

actions.name: Malformed Proboscis
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, plus one additional effect of the strigoi's choice: Liquefying Regurgitation. The target takes an additional 7 (2d6) Acid damage and gains vulnerability to the next source of Necrotic damage it takes before the end of the strigoi's next turn. * Drain Innards. The target takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage and the strigoi regains an equal number of Hit Points. A creature killed by this damage has its bones and soft tissues liquefied and extracted, leaving only its skin behind.

reactions.name: Hacking Birth
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature takes 15 or more Necrotic damage from the strigoi's Drain Innards, the strigoi releases each creature grappled by it and violently coughs up a Stirge Harrier in the nearest unoccupied space.

name: Strigoi Patrician
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +7, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +7, Cha +3

traits.name: Weakness-Seeker
traits.description: The strigoi has Advantage on attacks that target creatures afflicted with a disease.

traits.name: Bursting Flock
traits.description: When the strigoi dies, 10 (3d6) Stirge Harriers burst from its corpse.

traits.name: Lord of the Swarm
traits.description: Stirges within 120 feet of the strigoi may use its attack bonus, rather than their own.

traits.name: Oppressive Mastery
traits.description: If the strigoi fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect that targets it, it can choose to cause that effect to target a stirge within 15 feet of it instead. Then, if the strigoi has used this ability two or more times since its last long rest, it must succeed on a DC 10 Charisma Saving Throw or have each stirge that can see it become hostile to it and indifferent to each other creature for the next minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The strigoi makes three attacks, up to two of which may be with its Malformed Proboscis.

actions.name: Dripping Talons
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) acid damage. Instead of dealing damage, the strigoi may grapple the target (escape DC 15)

actions.name: Malformed Proboscis
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage, plus one additional effect of the strigoi's choice: Liquefying Regurgitation. The target takes an additional 7 (2d6) Acid damage and gains vulnerability to the next source of Necrotic damage it takes before the end of the strigoi's next turn. * Drain Innards. The target takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage and the strigoi regains an equal number of Hit Points. A creature killed by this damage has its bones and soft tissues liquefied and extracted, leaving only its skin behind.

reactions.name: Hacking Birth
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature takes 15 or more Necrotic damage from the strigoi's Drain Innards, the strigoi releases each creature grappled by it and violently coughs up a Stirge Harrier in the nearest unoccupied space.

legendaryActions.name: Precipitous Drop
legendaryActions.description: The strigoi flies up to half its speed, then may drop each creature grappled by it.

legendaryActions.name: Incite Frenzy
legendaryActions.description: The strigoi chooses a creature it can see that has one or more stirges attached to it. Each stirge not attached to that creature within 120 feet of the strigoi may use its reaction to move up to half its speed toward that creature or make an attack against it.

legendaryActions.name: Bloodsucker's Command
legendaryActions.description: Up to 3 Stirge Harriers or Stirge Skullpiercers within 120 feet of the strigoi may each use their reactions to use their Draw Blood ability.

name: Tarrasque
savingThrows: Str +19, Con +19, Int +5, Wis +9, Cha +9
immunities: Fire, Poison, Attacks made without Advantage; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned

traits.name: Titanic Stature
traits.description: The tarrasque's body is divided into several connected zones; a creature Attached to a zone has Advantage on attacks that target the tarrasque, can't be targeted with the tarrasque's Titan Strike, and can use its full movement to make a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Athletics) check, climbing to an adjacent zone on a success. Legs. A creature that starts its turn on the tarrasque's legs must make a {{font-variant:small-caps **Strength Saving Throw:**}} DC 18. {{font-variant:small-caps **Failure:**}} The creature has the Prone condition. Carapace. A creature on the tarrasque's carapace has Advantage on saving throws imposed by the tarrasque. Head. When a creature makes a saving throw against the tarrasque's Anathema Maw, a creature on its head can use its Reaction to add 1d10 to the target's result.

traits.name: Eternal Threat
traits.description:
If the tarrasque would die or fall Unconscious, it does not. Instead, the tarrasque can't regain Hit Points and can't take actions other than its Lurching Stride for 1 month.

While this effect is active, the tarrasque can Burrow without disturbing the material it moves through, and a creature within 30 feet of it can kill it with a Wish spell.

traits.name: Slow to Wrath
traits.description: The tarrasque can take one additional Legendary Action each round for each 200 Hit Points it is missing.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Anathema Maw
actions.description: *The beast's jaws gape, shimmering-hot breath rising within.* One creature Grappled by the tarrasque. Strength or Dexterity Saving Throw (target's choice): DC 27. Failure: The target has the Swallowed condition (see "Inside the Tarrasque). Success: The target escapes the tarrasque's Grapple.

actions.name: Titan Strike
actions.description:
*A titanic claw looms overhead, slamming down with unimaginable power.* One creature within 20 feet of the tarrasque takes 76 (4d12 + 50) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition.

Then, each other creature in a 10-foot Emanation from it must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 27. Failure: 26 (4d12) Bludgeoning damage. Failure by 10 or More: 20 additional Bludgeoning damage and the creature is pushed up to 15 feet away from the target.

actions.name: Engine of Annihilation
actions.description:
The tarrasque smashes a building, terrain feature, or similar object within 20 feet of it into rubble, which rains down in a 30-foot Emanation from the target.

Each other creature in the area must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 27. Failure: 36 (8d8) Bludgeoning damage. Failure by 5 or More: The creature additionally is buried in rubble and has the Restrained condition (escape DC 18). While Restrained in this way, a creature has the Blinded and Choking conditions.

bonusActions.name: Lurching Stride
bonusActions.description: The tarrasque's Speed and Burrow Speed increase by a cumulative 20 feet for 1 minute. This effect ends early if the tarrasque ends its turn without moving its full Speed in a straight line.

bonusActions.name: All the World Trembles
bonusActions.description: *A pulse of primordial terror ripples out, shaking the very air.* Each creature in a 300-foot Emanation. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 27. Failure: The creature has the Frightened condition until the start of the tarrasque's next turn. Failure by 10 or More: The target additionally has its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of the Tarrasque's next turn. Success: The creature becomes immune to this effect for 24 hours.

reactions.name: Reaction
reactions.description: Trigger: The tarrasque is targeted with a spell that targets only it from more than 60 feet away. Response: The tarrasque changes the spell's target to a random creature it can see within 60 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Lurching Rush
legendaryActions.description: The tarrasque uses its Lurching Stride, then can move up to half its Speed.

legendaryActions.name: Primordial Claw
legendaryActions.description: The tarrasque uses its Titan Strike, or can give one creature within 20 feet the Grappled condition.

legendaryActions.name: Boneshatter Roar (Recharge 4-6, Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: *Ears bleed and bones crack before the tarrasque's mighty roar.* Each creature in a 1-mile cone. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 27. Failure: 123 (6d20 + 60) Thunder damage. Failure by 15 or More: The creature additionally has the Deafened condition until cured. Success: Half damage.

name: Tlincalli Telsonite
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Dune-Eater
traits.description: The tlincalli ignores the effects of up to 3 points of exhaustion and cannot be forced to expend hit dice or have its maximum Hit Points reduced.

traits.name: Brittle Barb
traits.description: If the tlincalli is dealt a critical hit with a weapon that deals Bludgeoning damage, it can't make attacks with its Tail Stinger until it completes a Short or Long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tlincalli makes three attacks with its Shellcracker Pryblade, one of which it may replace with its Ironbur Meteor Hammer.

actions.name: Pryblade
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage. This attack is made at Advantage against a creature with Natural Armor.

actions.name: Ironbur Meteor Hammer
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 15 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 22 (4d10) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Wandering Eye Neurotoxemia.

reactions.name: Tarsal Stomp
reactions.description: When a Medium or smaller creature within 15 feet falls prone, the tlincalli can move up to 10 feet toward the creature and force it to make a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 7 (2d6) Piercing damage and is Grappled (escape DC 14) until the tlincalli moves.

name: Tlincalli Sand Sentinel
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +5, Int -2, Wis +2, Cha -2

traits.name: Dune-Eater
traits.description: The tlincalli ignores the effects of up to 3 points of exhaustion and cannot be forced to expend hit dice or have its maximum Hit Points reduced.

traits.name: Brittle Barb
traits.description: If the tlincalli is dealt a critical hit with a weapon that deals Bludgeoning damage, it can't make attacks with its Tail Stinger until it completes a Short or Long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tlincalli makes two attacks with its Limbtaker Greatscythe, one of which it may replace with a use of its Tail Stinger.

actions.name: Limbtaker Greatscythe
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or lose a limb.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 22 (4d10) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Wandering Eye Neurotoxemia.

actions.name: Reaping Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 10 feet of the tlincalli must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 39 (6d12) Slashing damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away. A creature may use its reaction to drop prone and gain Advantage on this saving throw.

reactions.name: Tarsal Stomp
reactions.description: When a Medium or smaller creature within 15 feet falls prone, the tlincalli can move up to 10 feet toward the creature and force it to make a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and is Grappled (escape DC 16) until the tlincalli moves.

name: Tlincalli Sunwalker
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +9, Int +7, Wis +10, Cha +2

traits.name: Dune-Eater
traits.description: The tlincalli ignores the effects of up to 3 points of exhaustion and cannot be forced to expend hit dice or have its maximum Hit Points reduced.

traits.name: Brittle Barb
traits.description: If the tlincalli is dealt a critical hit with a weapon that deals Bludgeoning damage, it can't make attacks with its Tail Stinger until it completes a Short or Long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tlincalli makes two attacks with its Thousand-Needles Strike, one of which it may replace with a use of its Tail Stinger.

actions.name: Thousand-Needles Strike
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (8d4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 22 (4d10) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Wandering Eye Neurotoxemia.

actions.name: Flensing Sandblast (Level 7 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A continuous, tearing wind issues forth from the tlincalli's hand, whipping sands forward in a 30-foot cone. A creature that starts or ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Slashing damage, be pushed 10 feet away, and be Blinded until the start of its next turn. As a Bonus Action on its turn, the tlincalli may change the direction of the cone.

actions.name: Vent Noonsun (1/Day)
actions.description: The tlincalli expels stored sunlight from its exoskeleton, flaring with light and heat. Each other creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Fire damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage, or half as much on a success. For the next minute, the tlincalli gains vulnerability to fire and radiant damage.

bonusActions.name: Bolthole Burial
bonusActions.description: One creature the tlincalli can see within 60 feet is teleported up to 10 feet directly downward through loose sand or earth to a snug cavity magically excavated for it. An unwilling creature may make a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw, avoiding the effect on a success. A creature may dig the buried creature out as an action with a successful DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check.

reactions.name: Shimmering Lure
reactions.description: When a friendly creature the Tlincalli can see moves or teleports, the tlincalli can cause that creature to become Invisible and Hidden until the end of the creature's next turn, or until it makes an attack. An illusory replica of that creature that lasts for a minute appears in the space vacated by it. If the replica takes any damage, it explodes in a burst of light, dealing 5 (1d10) radiant damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.

name: Tomb Scarab
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +2, Int -5, Cha -4

traits.name: Lie Dormant
traits.description: The tomb scarab can go an indefinite period of time without food or water, so long as it has somewhere dry and dark to hibernate.

actions.name: Tunneling Bite
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or have the scarab tunnel under its flesh. At the start of each of its turns, the creature takes 3 (1d6) Piercing damage per scarab infesting it. Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the target's next turn deals 1 Fire damage to the target and kills the tomb scarab. After this time, the tomb scarab can only be extricated with a DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check, dealing 3 (1d6) points of Piercing damage to the afflicted creature as it is removed. Any effect that cures disease destroys all tomb scarabs infesting the target.

name: Swarm of Tomb Scarabs
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex +3, Int -5, Cha -4
immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Lie Dormant
traits.description: The tomb scarab can go an indefinite period of time without food or water, so long as it has somewhere dry and dark to hibernate.

traits.name: Horrid Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny scarab. A creature whose space the swarm enters for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone. On a successful saving throw, the creature can move up to half its speed as a reaction.

actions.name: Tunneling Bites
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or have 1d4 scarabs tunnel under its flesh. At the start of each of its turns, the creature takes 3 (1d6) Piercing damage per scarab infesting it. Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the target's next turn deals 1 Fire damage to the target and kills these tomb scarabs. After this time, these tomb scarabs can only be extricated with a DC 13 Wisdom (Medicine) check, dealing 3 (1d6) points of Piercing damage to the afflicted creature as it is removed. Any effect that cures disease destroys all tomb scarabs infesting the target.

name: Tomb Spider Broodswarm
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +1, Int -2, Cha -1

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The broodswarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the broodswarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The broodswarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Web-Dweller
traits.description: The broodswarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the broodswarm knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Tomb Tainted
traits.description: If the broodswarm would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing and instead loses an equal number of Hit Points.

actions.name: Flurry of Bites
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 0 ft., *Hit* 6 (2d4 + 1) Piercing damage, or 3 (1d4 +1) Piercing damage if the swarm has fewer than half its Hit Points.

actions.name: Scuttle
actions.description: When the broodswarm would make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can move up to 10 feet. If this movement puts the broodswarm out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the broodswarm is unaffected.

name: Web Mummy
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex -2, Con +3, Int -4, Wis -2, Cha -3

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the mummy takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the mummy takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The mummy can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Tomb Spider Hatchery
traits.description: When the web mummy's Hit Points are reduced to 0 by a damage type other than fire or radiant, a Tomb Spider Broodling Swarm emerges in its space.

actions.name: Adhesive Grasp (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Bludgeoning damage and the mummy sticks to the target (escape DC 12). While stuck, the mummy moves with the target, and the target has its movement speed reduced by 10 for each mummy stuck to it.

reactions.name: Broodrage
reactions.description: When the tomb spider that created the mummy is killed, the mummy can a melee attack with Advantage. If the attack hits, it deals an additional 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage and the mummy dies.

name: Tomb Spider
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +7, Con +8, Int -4, Wis +3, Cha +4

traits.name: Web-Dweller
traits.description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Tomb Tainted
traits.description: If the spider would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing and instead loses an equal number of Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spider makes three attacks, one of which may be with its tainted bite.

actions.name: Tainted Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of the spider's next turn. If a creature Poisoned in this way would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing and instead loses an equal number of Hit Points.

actions.name: Legs
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft., Hits: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Web (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The spider launches webbing in a 10-foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or be restrained by webbing (escape DC 15). The webbing can attacked and destroyed (AC 10; HP 5).

bonusActions.name: Bind
bonusActions.description: The spider uses its webbing to restrain a prone or grappled creature within 5 feet (escape DC 15). If the target is Medium or smaller, the spider may then attach the creature to its back as part of this action.

name: Tomb Spider Husk
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +6, Con +9, Int +3, Wis +3, Cha +5
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Unconscious

traits.name: Web-Dweller
traits.description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Swarm-Filled
traits.description: The husk has Advantage on saving throws against effects that target it. If the husk fails a saving throw against a damaging effect that did not target it, the effect deals maximum damage to it.

traits.name: Husk Marionette
traits.description: The husk may move up to 10 feet or make an attack with its jerking legs at the end of each enemy creature's turn in combat.

actions.name: Jerking Legs
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft., Hits: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Infest Host
actions.description: Innumerable spiders attempt to burrow into and lair within a creature grappled by the husk, forcing it to make a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature's Constitution score is reduced by 2d4, to a miniumum of 1, until it completes a Long Rest. A creature that has its Constitution score reduced to 1 in this way contracts Necrohive Parasitosis.

actions.name: Flood of Spiders (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A wave of spiders flows from every crevice of the husk, carpeting the ground around it. The husk loses up to 25 Hit Points, then each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take an amount of poison damage equal to the Hit Points lost, or half that much on a success.

reactions.name: Scuttling Young
reactions.description: As a reaction when the husk takes piercing or Slashing damage, a torrent of angry spiders spill forth from the wound, producing one of the following effects: Web Repair. The husk gains 15 Temporary Hit Points. Chittering Vengeance. One creature within 5 feet of the husk must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

reactions.name: Abandon Husk (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction when the husk is forced to make a saving throw while it has fewer than 50 Hit Points, it recharges and immediately uses its Flood of Spiders.

name: Tsuchinoko
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Tumbling Movement
traits.description: Whenever the tsuchinoko moves 5 feet using its movement speed, it can jump up to 10 feet in a different direction without spending additional movement.

actions.name: Lockvenom Strike
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage and the target is Cursed until the end of its next turn. The Cursed creature's body straightens and stiffens; while the creature is not prone, it has Disadvantage on attacks against creatures smaller than it and can move only by hopping.

actions.name: Body Bash
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target takes Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage, plus 1 additional Bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet the tsuchinoko moved directly towards the target this turn.

reactions.name: Stiffened Slip
reactions.description: When a creature affected by the tsuchinoko's Lockvenom Strike enters a space, the tsuchinoko can cause it to tumble end-over-end. The target continues moving up to 30 feet in the same direction, then falls prone and takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet it moved in this way.

reactions.name: Swallow Tail
reactions.description: When the tsuchinoko misses with its Lockvenom Strike or targets an empty space, it can swallow its tail, rolling into a hoop shape. Until it ends this effect as a Bonus Action, it can't use its Lockvenom Strike and gains the following effects. Its speed is doubled when moving downhill. It can jump in any direction using its Tumbling Movement.

name: Umber Hulk Nymph
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -3

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the nymph takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the nymph takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The nymph can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed, leaving a 2 foot wide tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Screechclaw Scrape (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 Slashing damage. If three or more nymphs contributed to this attack, any creature within 10 feet of the target that is Concentrating must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or lose Concentration.

name: Umber Hulk Rumbler
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +1, Con +3, Int -1

traits.name: Confounding Gaze
traits.description: When a creature that can see the hulk starts its turn within 30 feet of it, the hulk can force it to make a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature must use half its movement to move in a direction of the umber hulk's choice Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid this effect, treating the hulk as Invisible until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The hulk can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed, leaving a 5-foot wide tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hulk makes three attacks, one of which it can be with its Mandible Clash.

actions.name: Mandible Clash
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stonecutter Claws
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage (ignores resistance).

reactions.name: Disorienting Lurch
reactions.description: When a creature that can see the hulk makes an attack against it, the hulk can impose Disadvantage on the attack. If the attack misses, the attacker falls prone.

name: Deepshadow Hulk
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +4, Con +3, Cha +1

traits.name: Lightscour Gaze
traits.description: When a creature that can see the hulk and is within 30 feet of it starts its turn illuminated by Bright Light, the hulk can cause it to take 9 (2d8) radiant damage. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid this effect, treating the hulk as Invisible until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Umbra-Carver
traits.description: While not illuminated by Bright Light, the hulk can burrow through any nonmagical substance without disturbing it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The umber hulk makes three attacks with its Shadowscoop Claws, one of which it can replace with its Darksteel Mandibles or Umbral Lurch.

actions.name: Darksteel Mandibles
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. Instead of dealing the attack's Necrotic damage, the hulk can diminish one light source carried by the target, from Bright Light to Dim Light, or from Dim Light to Darkness.

actions.name: Shadowscoop Claws
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. On a hit or miss, if the hulk isn't illuminated by Bright Light it can teleport up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Umbral Jolt
actions.description: The hulk briefly links two spaces it can see within 30 feet that aren't illuminated by Bright Light. Each creature in one of those spaces must succeed a DC 14 Charisma Saving Throw or teleport to the other space and fall prone. A creature that would teleport into an occupied space in this way instead takes 22 (4d10) Force damage.

name: Bloomscythe Hulk
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex +2, Con +8, Int -1, Wis +5, Cha +2

traits.name: Carnage Gaze
traits.description: When a creature that can see the hulk starts its turn within 30 feet of it, the hulk can force it to make a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature becomes hostile to all creatures and gains Advantage on melee attacks until the start of its next turn. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid this effect, treating the hulk as Invisible until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The hulk can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed, leaving a 10-foot wide tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Rot-Mad Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: When the hulk would fail a saving throw against an effect that doesn't deal fire or radiant damage, it can choose to succeed instead. Whenever the hulk takes 20 or more fire or radiant damage from a single source, it loses a use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hulk makes two attacks, one of which it can be with its Bloomscythe Mandibles.

actions.name: Bloomscythe Mandibles
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) force damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 18). A creature grappled in this way is restrained and takes 5 (1d10) poison damage at the end of each of its turns.

actions.name: Frenetic Claws
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage. If the target can see the hulk, it must use its reaction to move half its speed in a direction of the hulk's choice, or take 3 (1d6) Psychic damage if it can't.

reactions.name: Disorienting Lurch
reactions.description: When a creature that can see the hulk makes an attack against it, the hulk can impose Disadvantage on the attack. If the attack misses, the attacker falls prone.

reactions.name: Bend Spellpath
reactions.description: When a creature within 30 feet that can see the hulk casts a spell of 3rd level or above, the hulk can force it to make a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, the hulk can choose new targets for the spell.

legendaryActions.name: Bloodroot Spores
legendaryActions.description: The hulk deals 5 Slashing damage to itself, then each other creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Acid damage.

legendaryActions.name: Glimmering Dart
legendaryActions.description: The hulk moves up to half its speed, then can force one creature it can see within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or be unable to avert its gaze on its following turn.

legendaryActions.name: Frenetic Rush (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The hulk moves up to half its speed and can make two attacks with its Frenetic Claws.

name: Winter Wolf Rimefang
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Predatory Bearing
traits.description: The wolf's attacks have Advantage against any creature that has no allies within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Warmth-Weary
traits.description: If the wolf takes 10 or more Fire or Radiant damage from a single source, it gains a level of Exhaustion that lasts for 1 minute.

actions.name: Freezing Snap
actions.description:
Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) cold damage.

A target hit with this attack while within 5 feet of one or more other winter wolves gains the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) or the Prone condition (wolf's choice).

actions.name: Worry
actions.description: The wolf tugs and tears at a creature Grappled both by it and by one of the wolf's allies. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 21 (6d6) Piercing damage. Success: Half damage.

reactions.description: Trigger: A hostile creature moves within 5 feet of the wolf. Response: The wolf leaps up to 10 feet directly away from it. Opportunity Attacks provoked by this movement have Disadvantage.

Each creature in a 20-foot Cone. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 22 (5d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

Each creature in a 15-foot Emanation from the Windpack. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

Then, each creature in the area that died since the end of the anchorite's last turn is returned to life with 1 hit point.

Whenever the Cursed creature is dealt damage, it takes an additional 2 (1d4) Necrotic damage. At the start of each of the exarch's turns, it gains 5 Temporary Hit Points for each creature Cursed in this way within 30 feet.

traits.name: Filth Intrusion
traits.description: The exarch can choose for any spell it casts that normally deals Poison damage to instead deal Necrotic damage, and vice versa.

traits.name: Purging Physick (3/Day)
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the exarch can end one Spell or Condition affecting it. If it does, it loses one saving throw proficiency of its choice until it completes a Long Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The exarch makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Sickening Exhaust.

actions.name: Harrow Rod
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Canker Bolt (Cantrip)
actions.description: Attack: +12 range 60 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) necrotic damage. This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage to a Bloodied or Poisoned target.

actions.name: Sickening Exhaust (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A foul plume of smoke billows within a creature the exarch can see within 30 feet, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The creature is Poisoned for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn). The first time each turn that the Poisoned creature speaks or casts a spell with a verbal component, it takes 14 (4d6) Poison damage and is Blinded until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Insect Plague (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Biting locusts fill a 20-foot radius Sphere within 300 feet. Each creature in the area when it appears, that enters it for the first time on a turn, or that ends its turn there must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 22 (4d10) Piercing damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Venomous End (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: One Poisoned creature the exarch can see within 60 feet takes 50 Poison damage. Then, if the target has fewer than 50 Hit Points remaining it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The target is Paralyzed for as long as it remains Poisoned.

actions.name: Maggot Feast (1/Day, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: *Fat white worms spill from every wound.* Each creature of the exarch's choice in a 60-foot Emanation from it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 44 (8d10) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. A creature that fails this saving throw while it is Bloodied, Diseased, or Poisoned additionally becomes Dazed until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Cursed Contagion
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature affected by the exarch's Curse of Pestilence is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Response: Each creature of the exarch's choice within a 20-foot Emanation from the creature is afflicted by the exarch's Curse of Pestilence.

reactions.name: Plague Reservoir
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 30 feet of at least three other creatures afflicted with a Curse of Pestilence makes a Constitution Saving Throw against an effect the exarch controls. Response: The creature gains Disadvantage on the saving throw.

legendaryActions.name: Canker Burst
legendaryActions.description: The exarch makes two attacks with its Canker Bolt.

legendaryActions.name: Thrumming Symphony
legendaryActions.description: The exarch moves the effect of its Insect Plague up to 15 feet. Each creature whose space the effect enters in this way must save against it.

legendaryActions.name: Vector-Spread (Level 2 Spell)

legendaryActions.description: The chosen or an ally it can see within 30 feet gains 10 Temporary Hit Points, then can repeat a saving throw against an effect on it that ends on a successful saving throw. The chosen can take this action even while Incapacitated.

savingThrows: Str +11, Dex +8, Con +10, Int +3, Wis +9, Cha +5

traits.description: The exarch has Advantage on saving throws against effects that it or its allies control.

traits.name: Infernal Wrath
traits.description: The exarch's spell attacks score a Critical Hit on a 19-20. Once per turn when the exarch scores a Critical Hit, it can force one creature it can see within 60 feet to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: The target is Frightened until the end of the chosen's next turn.

traits.name: Grinding Advance
traits.description: Whenever the exarch hits a creature with an attack, the next attack that one of its allies makes against that target before the start of the chosen's next turn has Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The exarch makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Dedication of Flame or Waygate Assault, if available.

actions.name: Hellfire Slash (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) fire damage (ignores Resistance). On a Critical Hit, the exarch can immediately make an additional attack against a different target in its reach.

actions.name: Siege-Thunder Salvo (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +11 range 100 ft. Hit: 22 (5d8) thunder damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away. This attack deals maximum damage to a target made of inorganic material (such as stone, metal or crystal).

actions.name: Dedication of Flame (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The exarch or one willing creature it can see within 30 feet erupts in a torrent of shining flames; the target and each creature in a 15-foot Emanation from it must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: 10 (3d6) Fire damage plus 13 (3d8) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Waygate Assault (Recharge 5-6, Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: The exarch forges a magical gateway to a point it can see within 400 feet, teleporting each willing creature of its choice within 20 feet to an unoccupied space within 20 feet of the chosen point. Then, each creature teleported in this way can use its reaction to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Light of War Eternal (1/Day, Level 8 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The exarch begins to glow with a terrible divine fury in a 30-foot Emanation. For 10 minutes, whenever an ally of the exarch's is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the exarch can restore 1 Hit Point to it and allow it to stand from Prone.

reactions.name: Unflinching Resolve
reactions.description: Trigger: The exarch makes a saving throw against a spell cast by a creature it can see. Response: The exarch voluntarily fails the saving throw, then can move up to its Speed and make an attack with its Hellfire Slash before suffering the spell's effects.

reactions.name: Infernal Reserves (Recharges when Bloodied)
reactions.description: Trigger: A non-minion ally the exarch can see is reduced to 0 Hit points. Response: The exarch summons up to 5 Barbazu Shelltakers to unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the ally.

legendaryActions.name: Into the Fray

savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +5, Con +2, Int +7, Wis +6, Cha +1

traits.description: The diviner has Advantage on checks and saving throws to detect or resist traps and illusions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The diviner makes two attacks with its Fateful Blow, one of which it can replace with a use of its Catastrophe Looms.

actions.name: Fateful Blow
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A Cursed or Frightened creature target hit with this attack takes an additional 4 (1d8) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Catastrophe Looms (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: The diviner cries out an ominous decree, forcing one creature it can see within 60 feet to succeed on a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed. When the Cursed creature would take any damage due to failing a saving throw, it instead takes twice as much damage and the curse ends.

actions.name: Thought-Knot Severance (Level 5 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The diviner forces a creature it can see within 60 feet to succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) Psychic damage and be Dazed until the end of the diviner's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success. A target that is Concentrating on a spell has Disadvantage on this saving throw, and is additionally Stunned until the end of the diviner's next turn on a failure.

bonusActions.name: As Revealed
bonusActions.description: The diviner produces one of the following effects, corresponding to a roll noted with its Mark Omen since the end of its last turn. Auspicious (Success). The diviner has Advantage on the first attack it makes this turn. Foreboding (Failure). One creature the diviner can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the diviner's next turn. Unsteady (Odd). Until the end of its turn, the diviner's attacks deal an additional 7 Psychic damage for each roll of 1 on their damage dice. Steadfast (Even). The diviner rolls to recharge its Thought-Knot Convolution.

reactions.name: Mark Omen
reactions.description: When a creature the diviner can see within 30 feet makes an attack or saving throw, the diviner can minutely study the results. Make a note of whether the roll succeeded or failed, and whether the result was odd or even.

actions.name: Penetrating Gaze (Level 3 Spell)

The diviner produces one of the following effects, corresponding to a roll noted with its Mark Omen since the end of its last turn.
*

bonusActions.name: Hale (Max)
bonusActions.description:
The diviner makes an attack with its Omenspray Razor, dealing an additional 4 (1d8) Slashing damage on a hit for each maximum damage value noted.
*

bonusActions.name: Feeble (No Max)
bonusActions.description:
Creatures within 60 feet of the diviner have Disadvantage on saving throws to end ongoing conditions until the beginning of the diviner's next turn.
*

bonusActions.name: Sluggish (Odd)
bonusActions.description:
One Bleeding creature the diviner can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Dazed for as long as it remains Bleeding.
*

bonusActions.description: One Bleeding creature the diviner can see within 30 feet has its Bleeding value increased by 2d4.

legendaryActions.name: Visceral Insight
legendaryActions.description: The diviner moves up to half its speed, then can make an attack with its Omenspray Razor. If this attack was against an intact corpse that died in the last minute, the diviner regains one expended use of its Forewarned Dooms.

legendaryActions.name: Arterial Catharsis
legendaryActions.description: One Bleeding creature the Haruspex can see loses Hit Points equal to its Bleeding value.

legendaryActions.name: Grim Prognosis
legendaryActions.description: One Bleeding creature the Haruspex can see must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be unaffected by the first source of healing it receives in the next minute.

name: Diviner Starsage
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +8, Int +10, Wis +3, Cha +9

traits.name: Forewarned Dooms (3/Day)
traits.description: When the diviner fails a saving throw or is hit with an attack, it can succeed or cause the attack to miss. While it has any remaining uses of this ability, the diviner ignores the effects of being Frightened.

actions.description: Attack: +10 range 100 ft. Hit: 5 (1d10) force damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) radiant damage. This attack has Advantage against a flying or levitating target.

actions.name: Laughter of the Stars
actions.description: Roll a d20 and note its result. Until the end of the diviner's next turn, whenever a creature it can see within 60 feet makes an attack or saving throw, the diviner can force it to use the noted roll, instead of rolling.

actions.name: Distant Watchers' Draw (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The diviner alters gravity for creatures in a 15-foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet, forcing each to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or float 10 feet into the air and begin Levitating for the next minute. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or falling up to 30 feet in a direction of the diviner's choice on a failure.

actions.name: Almagest Downpour (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Helical motes of starlight condense around the diviner, growing each moment in intensity. At the start of its next turn, the diviner can use its action to make up to two Starlight Skewer attacks against each creature of its choice within range.

actions.name: Knowledge of the Hour (Recharge 5-6, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the diviner can see within 60 feet is Cursed, suffering the following effects: While it has fewer than 100 Hit Points, the Cursed creature is Frightened. At the end of each of its turns, the Cursed creature must succeed on a DC 11 unmodified d20 roll or take 55 (10d10) Force damage and have the curse end.

bonusActions.name: As Prefigured
bonusActions.description: The diviner produces one of the following effects, corresponding to a movement noted with its Mark Omen since the end of its last turn. Ascending (Toward). One creature the diviner can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or be launched 30 feet into the air and Levitate there until the end of the turn. Descending (Away). The diviner teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. Opposing (Even). The diviner randomly selects a hostile creature within 60 feet; until the end of its turn, the diviner's attacks against that target deal an additional 5 (1d10) Force damage on a hit. Occluding (Odd). The diviner makes a contested Charisma check against a creature it can see within 60 feet. Until the beginning of the diviner's next turn, the victor has Advantage on attacks against the loser.

reactions.name: Mark Omen
reactions.description: When a creature the diviner can see within 30 feet ends its turn, the diviner can reflect upon its movements. Make a note of whether the creature moved toward or away from the diviner, and whether it moved an odd or even number of feet that turn.

legendaryActions.name: Starlight Drift
legendaryActions.description: The diviner makes an attack with its Starlight Skewer or moves up to half its fly speed. If the diviner is Concentrating on a spell, it can instead do both.

legendaryActions.name: Consult the Heavens
legendaryActions.description: The diviner makes a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check, regaining a use of its Forewarned Dooms on a success. While illuminated by Bright Light, the diviner makes this check with Disadvantage.

legendaryActions.name: Mend Moment
legendaryActions.description: Each creature the diviner can see within 60 feet teleports up to 5 feet to an unoccupied space the diviner can see.

traits.name: Fate's Indenture (1/Day, Mythic Trait)
traits.description: When the diviner is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it resets to 187 Hit Points, regains each expended use of its Forewarned Dooms, and is Blinded for the next hour.

actions.description: Attack: +12 range 120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) psychic damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet in a direction of the diviner's choice. This attack hits its target automatically if it was not made with Disadvantage.

On a success, the spell ends and the target gains Advantage on each attack and saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: As Foreseen
bonusActions.description: The diviner produces one of the following effects, corresponding to a roll noted with its Mark Omen since the end of its last turn. Doom Avoided (20). One creature within 60 feet gains a Doom Counter that lasts for a year; when reduced to 0 Hit Points, the creature fails one Death Saving Throw for each Doom Counter it has. Doom's Advent (1). Each creature within 60 feet that has one or more Doom Counters must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened, then one randomly selected creature that failed this saving throw is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

legendaryActions.description: The diviner moves up to half its speed and can make an attack with its Fatemaker's Distaff. If this attack would have Disadvantage, it instead has Advantage.

legendaryActions.name: Clew-Cast Catastrophe
legendaryActions.description: The diviner uses its Catastrophe Looms, targeting a randomly selected creature within range.

legendaryActions.name: Thread Fate's Needle
legendaryActions.description: The next time the diviner would take half damage due to succeeding on a saving throw before the end of its next turn, it instead takes no damage.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Oracular Vapors (Costs 2 Actions)
