actions.description: One creature the enchanter can see within 60 feet that is Charmed by it may use its reaction to move up to its speed and take an Action.

actions.name: Power Word
actions.description: The enchanter speaks a word of power, targeting a creature it can see within 60 feet, then must make a Constitution Saving Throw with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level or be unable to speak or cast spells until the end of its next turn. Burn (Level 5 Spell). The target taks 28 (8d6) Fire damage. Serve (Level 6 Spell). If the target has fewer than 100 Hit Points, it is Charmed by the enchanter and acts under the enchanter's control. Whenever the creature takes damage, it may make a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw, freeing itself on a success. Blind (Level 7 Spell). If the target has fewer than 100 Hit Points, it is Blinded until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic. Break (1/Day, Level 8 Spell). One magic item of Very Rare or lesser rarity that the creature is carrying becomes inert and crumbles to dust. Kill (1/Day, Level 9 Spell). If the target has fewer than 100 Hit Points, it dies.

reactions.name: Bleed for Your Master
reactions.description: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack, the enchanter forces a creature within 10 feet that is Charmed by it to succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw or become the new target of the attack.

reactions.name: Thunderous Oration (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction when the enchanter is reduced below 137 Hit Points, it shouts out a booming imprecation. Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Thunder damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Word of Command
legendaryActions.description: The enchanter uses its Word of Command.

legendaryActions.name: Soulbound Swap (Level 2 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The enchanter and up to one Medium creature within 60 feet that is Charmed by it teleport to trade places with one another.

legendaryActions.name: Stilling Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The enchanter takes a deep breath, gaining Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws made against its Power Word ability, or to maintain concentration, until the end of its following turn.

name: Evoker Fulminant
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +6, Con +2, Int +6, Wis +3, Cha +1

traits.name: Crackling Fury
traits.description: Lightning damage the evoker deals ignores damage resistance.

traits.name: Countershock (3/Day)
traits.description: When the evoker would be affected by a spell, it can make an Arcana check against the spellcaster's spell save DC. On a success, the evoker is unaffected by the spell and the spellcaster takes 3 (1d6) Lightning damage for each point the evoker succeeded by.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The evoker makes two attacks with its Static Surge, one of which it can replace with a use of its Transfix with Power or Amplifire Outburst.

actions.name: Static Surge (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d10) lightning damage. A creature dealt 20 or more damage in this way is pushed up to 15 feet away and Dazed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Transfix with Power (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: A web of electricity envelops a creature the evoker can see within 60 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Lightning damage and be restrained until the end of the evoker's next turn (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Amplifire Outburst (Recharge 5-6, Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 100 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) lightning damage. If this attack was made with Advantage, each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take half the attack's damage.

actions.name: Beacon of Destruction (1/Day, Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The evoker charges the air around it with raw magical energy; for the next minute, whenever a creature within 15 feet of the evoker casts a spell that targets one or more creatures, it can target an additional creature.

name: Evoker Wrath-Hammer
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +7, Con +3, Int +8, Wis +5, Cha +1

traits.name: Forceful Casting
traits.description: Whenever the evoker makes a spell attack, it is pushed up to 5 feet away from the spell's target, or takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage if it can't be.

traits.name: Countershock (3/Day)
traits.description: When the evoker would be affected by a spell, it can make an Arcana check against the spellcaster's spell save DC. On a success, the evoker is unaffected by the spell and the spellcaster takes 3 (1d6) Lightning damage for each point the evoker succeeded by.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The evoker makes four attacks with its Force Barrage, or makes two attacks and uses its Arcane Anvilweight or Wreath of Blades.

actions.name: Force Barrage
actions.description: Attack: +8 range 150 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage and the next attack the evoker makes against the target this turn has Advantage.

actions.name: Arcane Anvilweight (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A dense mass of shimmering, translucent force slams down up a creature the evoker can see within 100 feet, forcing it to make a DC 16 Dexterity or Strength Saving Throw (target's choice). On a failure, the target takes 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone and restrained (escape DC 16). On a success, the target takes half as much damage.

actions.name: Wreath of Blades (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Razor-sharp blades of hardened magic whirl through the air in a 10-foot radius centered on the evoker. A creature that starts its turn in the area, or that enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Woven Path
legendaryActions.description: The evoker moves up to half its speed, creating a path of force beneath it as it goes that lasts until the end of its next turn. The evoker can treat surfaces such as air or water as solid ground with this movement.

legendaryActions.name: Force Barrage
legendaryActions.description: The evoker makes two attacks with its Force Barrage.

name: Evoker Blast-Adept
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +9, Con +3, Int +10, Wis +6, Cha +1

traits.name: Spellshaper
traits.description: When the evoker casts a spell that affects an area, it can choose for any number of affected creatures to have Advantage on saving throws they make against it, and to take no damage from the spell on a success.

traits.name: Countershock (3/Day)
traits.description: When the evoker would be affected by a spell, it can make an Arcana check against the spellcaster's spell save DC. On a success, the evoker is unaffected by the spell and the spellcaster takes 3 (1d6) Lightning damage for each point the evoker succeeded by.

traits.name: Contingent Renewal (1/Day, Mythic Trait)
traits.description: When the evoker is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it resets to 127 Hit Points and regrows any missing body parts. For the next minute, the evoker regains 15 Hit Points at the beginning of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Blast Touch (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Fire blooms from the evoker's palm, exploding in a 10-foot radius centered on a point within 5 feet. The evoker and each other creature in the area is pushed 10 feet away, then must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Fire damage plus 9 (2d8) Thunder damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is knocked prone, additionally.

actions.name: Amplifire Outburst (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 100 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) lightning damage. If this attack was made with Advantage, each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take half the attack's damage.

actions.name: Render to the Flame (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Flames rise to engulf up to six creatures within a 20-foot radius centered on a point the evoker can see within 60 feet, forcing each to make a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failure, a creature begins Burning (2d10). While Burning in this way, attacks against the creature have Advantage.

actions.name: Scatterspell Bombardment (Level 5 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The evoker launches a cascade of shimmering orbs in a 60-foot cone that detonate as they hit the ground, forcing each creature in the area to make three DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throws. For each failed saving throw, a creature takes 10 (3d6) damage of one type of the evoker's choice; acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

legendaryActions.name: Protective Measures
legendaryActions.description: The evoker gains 5 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the evoker has resistance to damage from its own spells.

legendaryActions.name: Blast Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The evoker moves up to half its speed and uses its Blast Touch.

legendaryActions.name: Glyph Mine (Level 3 Spell, Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: A bright glyph flares on the ground in an unoccupied 5-foot radius space the evoker can see within 60 feet. The first time a creature enters that space in the next minute, the glyph explodes in a 10-foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Thunder damage, or half as much on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Charge Spell
legendaryActions.description: Magical power condenses in the air around the evoker, cumulatively adding one additional damage die to each damage roll the evoker makes on its following turn.

name: Evoker Cremation Sage
savingThrows: Dex +13, Con +12, Int +14, Wis +10, Cha +1

traits.name: Eternity Burns
traits.description: Fire damage the evoker ignores damage resistance, and treats immunity to Fire damage as resistance. A creature killed by this damage burns to ash.

traits.name: Spellshaper
traits.description: When the evoker casts a spell that affects an area, it can choose for any number of affected creatures to have Advantage on their saving throws, and to take no damage from the spell on a success.

traits.name: Countershock (3/Day)
traits.description: When the evoker would be affected by a spell, it can make an Arcana check against the spellcaster's spell save DC. On a success, the evoker is unaffected by the spell and the spellcaster takes 3 (1d6) Lightning damage for each point the evoker succeeded by.

traits.name: Contingent Renewal (1/Day, Mythic Trait)
traits.description: When the evoker is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it resets to Hit Points and regrows any missing body parts. For the next minute, the evoker regains 15 Hit Points at the beginning of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The evoker makes three attacks with its Starfire Lance, one of which it can replace with a use of its Lava Geyser.

actions.name: Starfire Lance (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +14 range 150 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage plus Hit: 27 (6d8) radiant damage. This attack ignores all cover from any nonmagical, nonliving material, disintegrating through it without resistance and leaving a 2 inch wide hole in its wake.

actions.name: Lava Geyser (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: A torrent of lava spews up from the earth in a 60-foot high, 15-foot radius column, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 33 (6d10) Fire damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success. For the next minute, a creature that ends its turn on the ground in the area or steps onto it for the first time on a turn must make the same saving throw.

actions.name: Annihilation Shrine (1/Day, Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: The evoker raises a Large, monolithic shard of black crystal (AC 20; 100 HP) from the earth centered on a point it can see, amplifying nearby magic. For the next hour, evocation spells cast within 30 feet of the shard have their range multiplied by 10 and their radius doubled.

actions.name: The Sky, Consumed (1/Day, Level 9 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A point of fire appears in the sky above the evoker, growing second by second as it hurtles toward earth. Each creature and object within 500 feet of the evoker immediately begins Burning (1d10). At the start of the evoker's next turn, the fire strikes it. The evoker and each creature within 500 feet of it must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 98 (28d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Burning Leap
legendaryActions.description: The evoker leaps up to 20 feet, dealing 5 (1d10) Fire damage to each creature within 5 feet of where it departed or landed.

legendaryActions.name: Furnace Shield
legendaryActions.description: The evoker calls forth a 10-foot square, 6 inch thick opaque curtain of fire that lasts until the start of its next turn in an unoccupied space it can see. Nonmagical ammunition that passes through this curtain disintegrates. A creature that passes through it for the first time on a turn takes 14 (4d6) Fire damage.

legendaryActions.name: Forgefires of Creation (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The evoker uses its Starfire Lance or Lava Geyser. If the evoker's mythic trait is active, this costs only a single legendary action.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Apotheosis of Flame (Costs 2 Actions, 1/Day, Level 9 Spell, Concentration)
legendaryActions.description: White-hot flames engulf the evoker for the next minute, causing the following effects: The evoker gains a 60-foot fly (hover) speed. When the evoker would take any Fire damage, it takes no damage and instead gains an equal number of Temporary Hit Points. The first time each turn that the evoker takes any damage, flames explode outward from it, forcing the evoker and each creature within 20 feet to succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Fellsaw Axe-Mad
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -2

traits.name: Minion
traits.description:
If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes
no damage.

traits.name: Axe-Mad
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the axe-mad can move up to its speed toward a plant or plant creature that it can see.

traits.name: Bark-Breaker
traits.description: If the axe mad moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a logging axe attack on the same turn, the attack ignores the target's damage resistances.

actions.name: Logging Axe (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 Slashing damage. This attack deals an an additional 1 Slashing damage to a prone target.

reactions.name: Savage Demise
reactions.description: When the axe-mad drops to 0 Hit Points, it may use its reaction to make a single attack before falling unconscious.

name: Fellsaw Branchbreaker
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -3, Wis -2, Cha -2

traits.name: Juggernaut
traits.description: The branchbreaker may attempt to shove a creature as a Bonus Action. If it moves 20 feet before attempting to shove a creature, the branchbreaker has Advantage on the contested check, and on a success the target is knocked prone and pushed 10 feet back.

traits.name: Spell Resistant Hide
traits.description: The branchbreaker has resistance to damage from spells of third level or below.

actions.name: Polesaw
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 15 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. This attack is made at Disadvantage gainst a creature within 5 ft.

actions.name: Juggernaut Charge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The branchbreaker attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes 4 (1d8) damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

name: Fellsaw Wagedriver
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex -1, Con +4, Int -2, Wis +2, Cha +2

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.description: The wagedriver has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Double Actions
traits.description: The wagedriver rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

traits.name: Coercive
traits.description: While the wagedriver is conscious, allied creatures that can see it will not flee or surrender.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ettin uses its Rage song and makes one melee attack.

actions.name: Weighted Lash
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Work Song
actions.description: Until the end of the wagedriver's next turn, melee weapon attacks made by all creatures within 30 feet deal an additional 4 (1d8) damage. Whenever a creature affected by the work song rolls a 1 to hit with an attack, the attacker makes a new attack roll, targeting itself.

reactions.name: Kick Away
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the forces, the wagedriver forces it to succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or be pushed 10 feet away and lose concentration, if it was holding it.

reactions.name: Lead From the Rear
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the wagedriver causes the attack to instead hit an allied creature within 5 ft.

name: Fellsaw Blightcaster
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +3, Cha -1

traits.name: Respirator
traits.description: The blightcaster is immune to damage from inhaled toxins while it wears its respirator. If the blightcaster suffers a critical hit, its respirator breaks.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: The blightcaster has Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws against magic.

actions.name: Sprayer Bash
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

actions.name: Blight Torrent (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The blightcaster spews a toxic, defoliating fog from its hand sprayer in a 30 ft. cone that heavily obscures its area and lasts until the end of the blightcaster's next turn. Nonmagical plants in the area wither and die. A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. A plant creature makes this saving throw with Disadvantage, and takes maximum damage on a failed save.

actions.name: Pump
actions.description: The blightcaster rolls to recharge its Blight Torrent.

name: Fellsaw Pharmacist
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +3, Int +4, Cha +2

traits.name: High Tolerance
traits.description: If the pharmacist is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Constitution Saving Throw to take only half damage, the pharmacist instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: The gnome has Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws against magic.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pharmacist makes two attacks, either of which it may replace with a use of its Ignite Weapon.

actions.name: Rifle Bash
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Dart Rifle
actions.description:
Attack: +7 range 80/320 ft. Hit: The target suffers one effect of the pharmacist's choice. Stimulant Dart. The target gains Advantage on all melee attack rolls and attack rolls against it have Advantage until the end of the pharmacist's next turn. Motivator Dart. The target becomes immune to the Frightened and Charmed conditions for the next minute. Blight Dart. The target takes 9 (2d8) poison and 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.
*

actions.name: Strikebreaker Dart (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: If the target dies in the next minute, it explodes. Each creature within 20 ft. of it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) poison and 14 (4d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Ignite Weapon
actions.description: The pharmacist smears a volitile grease on the weapon of one creature within 5 ft., which then ignites. For the next minute, melee attacks made with the weapon deal an additional 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

name: Frost Witch
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +6, Wis +7, Cha +1

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.description: The witch can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

traits.name: Biting Cold
traits.description: A creature that takes any Cold damage while within 10 feet of one or more frost witches takes an additional 4 (1d8) Cold damage for each frost witch within 10 feet of it.

traits.name: Frozen Magic
traits.description: If the frost witch takes any Fire damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or be unable to cast spells until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The witch makes two attacks with its hoarfrost cudgel, one of which it may replace with a use of its Snow Blindness.

actions.name: Hoarfrost Cudgel
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Snow Blindness (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +7 range 60 ft. Hit: 22 (5d8) cold damage and the target is blind beyond a 15-foot radius until the end of the witch's next turn.

actions.name: Icy Blast (Recharge 5-6, Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: The witch sends forth a tide of flash-freezing water in a 30-foot line that is ten feet wide, turning the area into difficult terrain. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Cold damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more is restrained by ice until the end of the witch's next turn (escape DC 15).

reactions.name: Freeze Weapon (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description:
As a reaction to being hit by a melee attack
with a metal weapon, the witch forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Cold damage and drop its weapon. If the creature attempts to pick the weapon up this turn, it must repeat the save.

reactions.name: Armor of Winter (1/Day, Level 5 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction when the witch is reduced below 59 Hit Points, the witch gains 59 Temporary Hit Points as crystals of jagged ice spiderweb across its body in shapes hinting at murals of death and dormancy. While it has these Temporary Hit Points, the witch has vulnerability to Fire damage and a creature that hits the witch with a melee attack takes 9 (2d8) Cold damage.

name: Gladiator
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +5, Con +6, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: The gladiator has Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened.

traits.name: Favor of the Crowd
traits.description: If it has an audience, whenever the gladiator scores a critical hit or reduces an opponent to 0 Hit Points it gains the favor of the crowd. While it has the favor of the crowd, it gains the following benefits: The gladiator scores a critical on a roll of 18, 19, or 20. The gladiator has Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects. If the gladiator starts its turn with 0 Hit Points, it regains 10 Hit Points and loses the favor of the crowd.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gladiator makes three attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Rile, if available.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Rile (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The gladiator attempts a DC 15 Charisma (Performance) check. On a success, the gladiator gains the favor of the crowd.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The gladiator adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the gladiator must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Guard Roundsman
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +1, Con +1

traits.name: Watchful Eye
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of one or more creatures with this trait that it is Hidden from must make a new Dexterity (Stealth) check to remain Hidden at the beginning of each of its turns.

traits.name: Fresh-Faced
traits.description: While the guard has all of its Hit Points, it has Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened.

actions.name: Weighted Gauntlet
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Zealous Tackle
actions.description: The guard lunges at a humanoid creature within 5 feet, falling prone. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity or Strength Saving Throw (target's choice) or be knocked prone and grappled (escape DC 11).

bonusActions.name: Sound Alarm
bonusActions.description:
The guard raises a hue and cry, alerting each other guard within 300 feet that can hear it. Each round at initiative count 0, roll a d4 for each guard alerted in this way. On a roll of 1, the guard enters the combat.


 Design Intent: Nonmagical Summoning. As with any non-mechanized means of calling for aid, the guard's Sound Alarm ability is not accounted for in the monster's CR. Rather, you should take the guards that could be called upon into account in your encounter design, because they very likely will be. Entering Combat. A guard "enters the combat", when they move close enough that the players become aware of their location, at which point they roll initiative.
This point will depend upon sightlines and cover, but ideally should be somewhere between 30-60 feet away from the player characters so the players can react.

name: Guard Clasper
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +1

traits.name: Watchful Eye
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of one or more creatures with this trait that it is Hidden from must make a new Dexterity (Stealth) check to remain Hidden at the beginning of each of its turns.

actions.name: Pronged Catchpole
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 10 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away. A humanoid creature that can't be pushed is instead grappled (escape DC 12) until the guard moves or takes another action.

actions.name: Clasp in Irons
actions.description: The guard forces a grappled or prone humanoid creature within 5 feet to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or have one of its hands manacled. A creature that already has a hand manacled and fails this saving throw is restrained in place or loses the use of its hands (guard's choice) until the manacles are removed. A creature can break these manacles with a successful DC 20 Strength check, or can pick their lock with a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Thieves' Tools) check.

bonusActions.name: Hot Pursuit
bonusActions.description: If the guard saw a creature Dash or Disengage since the end of its last turn, the guard can move up to half its speed.

bonusActions.name: Sound Alarm
bonusActions.description: The guard raises a hue and cry, alerting each other guard within 300 feet that can hear it. Each round at initiative count 0, roll a d4 for each guard alerted in this way. On a roll of 1, the guard enters the combat.

name: Guard Stalwart
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +2, Wis +1

traits.name: Watchful Eye
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of one or more creatures with this trait that it is Hidden from must make a new Dexterity (Stealth) check to remain Hidden at the beginning of each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guard makes two attacks with its Gatewarden's Pike or Pinbolt Crossbow.

actions.name: Gatewarden's Pike
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning or Slashing damage.

actions.name: Pinbolt Crossbow
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 80/320 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is pinned to a nearby surface, reducing its speed by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Sweep Legs
bonusActions.description: The guard forces one creature it hit with a melee attack this turn to succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Sound Alarm
bonusActions.description: The guard raises a hue and cry, alerting each other guard within 300 feet that can hear it. Each round at initiative count 0, roll a d4 for each guard alerted in this way. On a roll of 1, the guard enters the combat.

name: Guard Thief-Taker
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +3, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +2

traits.name: Watchful Eye
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of one or more creatures with this trait that it is Hidden from must make a new Dexterity (Stealth) check to remain Hidden at the beginning of each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guard makes two attacks with its Pocket Sap, one of which it can replace with a use of its Snapclaw Nipper.

actions.name: Pocket Sap
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit against a humanoid target, the target is knocked prone and must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the guard's next turn.

actions.name: Snapclaw Nipper
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target is Grappled (escape DC 14) as one of its wrists is clamped. The grappled creature has Disadvantage on attacks that use that limb, and takes 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage whenever it takes an Action or Bonus Action.

actions.name: Wrench Wrist
actions.description: The guard forces a creature grappled with its Snapclaw Nipper to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 17 (5d6) Bludgeoning damage and drop an item it is wielding, or take half as much damage on a success. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points in this way loses the use of one arm until it completes a Long Rest.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.description: The guard takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

bonusActions.name: Sound Alarm
bonusActions.description: The guard raises a hue and cry, alerting each other guard within 300 feet that can hear it. Each round at initiative count 0, roll a d4 for each guard alerted in this way. On a roll of 1, the guard enters the combat.

name: Guard Crowdbreaker
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +3, Wis +1

traits.name: Watchful Eye
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of one or more creatures with this trait that it is Hidden from must make a new Dexterity (Stealth) check to remain Hidden at the beginning of each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guard makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Tower Shield Ram.

actions.name: Hawthorne Witch-Club
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus up to one of the following effects: Fear (1/Day). The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to move half its speed away from the guard. Pain (1/Day). The target takes an additional 7 (2d6) Lightning damage. Compliance (1/Day). The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or fall prone and be unable to stand on its following turn.

actions.name: Tower Shield Ram
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the guard moved at least 10 feet directly toward the target before making this attack, the target takes an additional 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

bonusActions.name: Sound Alarm
bonusActions.description: The guard raises a hue and cry, alerting each other guard within 300 feet that can hear it. Each round at initiative count 0, roll a d4 for each guard alerted in this way. On a roll of 1, the guard enters the combat.

name: Guard Brigade
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +1, Con +1
immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Watchful Eye
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of one or more creatures with this trait that it is Hidden from must make a new Dexterity (Stealth) check to remain Hidden at the beginning of each of its turns.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The brigade can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, it can move through any opening large enough for a single guard, and it can't regain Hit Points.

actions.name: Brigade Beating
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 0 ft. Hit: 12 (4d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the brigade has more than half its Hit Points, it can additionally force the target to succeed on a DC 11 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 11)

bonusActions.name: Sound Alarm
bonusActions.description: The brigade raises a hue and cry, alerting each other guard within 300 feet that can hear it. Each round at initiative count 0, roll a d4 for each guard alerted in this way. On a roll of 1, the guard enters the combat.

name: Guard Arbiter-Captain
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +5, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +5, Cha +3

traits.name: Watchful Eye
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of one or more creatures with this trait that it is Hidden from must make a new Dexterity (Stealth) check to remain Hidden at the beginning of each of its turns.

traits.name: Authoritative Cast
traits.description: A nonguard humanoid that makes a Charisma (Deception) check or Wisdom Saving Throw within 30 feet of the guard subtracts 1d4 from its result.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guard makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Blade Bind.

actions.name: Captain's Blade
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Steel Bash
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. This attack has Advantage against an Unarmored or Lightly Armored target.

actions.name: Blade Bind
actions.description: The guard locks blades with a creature within 5 feet, imposing Disadvantage on attacks made with one weapon it is wielding until one of the following conditions is met: The guard makes an attack with its Captain's Blade. The creature hits the guard with a melee attack. Either creature moves away from the other.

actions.name: Demand Order (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The guard shouts a command that rings with all the power of their office. Each creature of the guard's choice that can hear it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or have Disadvantage on attacks and be unable to Concentrate until the end of the guard's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Constraining Command
bonusActions.description: The guard points at a creature it can see and demands it be stopped. Up to two creatures within 5 feet of the target can each use their reaction to attempt to Grapple or Shove it.

bonusActions.name: Sound Alarm
bonusActions.description: The guard raises a hue and cry, alerting each other guard within 300 feet that can hear it. Each round at initiative count 0, roll a d4 for each guard alerted in this way. On a roll of 1, the guard enters the combat.

name: Guard Inquisitor-Exorcist
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +8, Int +2, Wis +7, Cha +6

traits.name: Watchful Eye
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of one or more creatures with this trait that it is Hidden from must make a new Dexterity (Stealth) check to remain Hidden at the beginning of each of its turns.

traits.name: Magewarden
traits.description: The guard has Advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guard makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with its Bulwark Bolster, if available.

actions.name: Silencer's Grasp (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack. +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). A creature grappled in this way that casts a spell must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or have the spell fail, ending the grapple on a success.

actions.name: Hammerhand Blow (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack. +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 16 (3d10) Force damage. A target affected by one or more spells that increase its AC takes an additional 5 (1d10) Force damage and has one such spell end.

actions.name: Scour Conduit (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack. +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 28 (8d6) nonlethal radiant damage. Each other creature that controls a magical effect affecting the target such as a contract, curse, spirit possession, or spell takes the same amount of damage, then can choose to end the effect.

actions.name: Bulwark Bolster (Recharge 5-6, Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Up to four friendly creatures the guard can see each gain 5 Temporary Hit Points. While a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it has Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Confinement Ring (1/Day, Concentration, Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: A 10-foot radius circle of luminous runes shimmers into existence at a point the guard can see within 60 feet (AC 15, 40 HP, immunity to poison and psychic). The circle provides total cover and blocks exit by nonmagical means, but freely allows creatures to enter. While the circle has all of its Hit Points, it additionally blocks teleportation and ethereal travel.

bonusActions.name: Sound Alarm
bonusActions.description: The guard raises a hue and cry, alerting each other guard within 300 feet that can hear it. Each round at initiative count 0, roll a d4 for each guard alerted in this way. On a roll of 1, the guard enters the combat.

name: Guard Lawmaster
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +9, Con +9, Int +3, Wis +7, Cha +10

traits.name: Watchful Eye
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of one or more creatures with this trait that it is Hidden from must make a new Dexterity (Stealth) check to remain Hidden at the beginning of each of its turns.

traits.name: Pillar of Order
traits.description: Hostile creatures within 15 feet of the guard have Disadvantage on attacks that target creatures other than it.

traits.name: Lawkeeper's Fervor (2/Day)
traits.description: When the guard or another creature within 30 feet fails a saving throw, the guard can choose for it to succeed. The first time each turn that the guard sees a friendly creature reduced to 0 Hit Points, it regains a use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guard makes two attacks with its Spiritbreaker Greatgavel, one of which it can replace with a use of its Suppression Field.

actions.name: Spiritbreaker Greatgavel
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus one of the following effects: The target takes 11 (2d10) Force damage. The target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Suppression Field (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A field of irresistible force blooms in a 15-foot radius centered on a point the guard can see within 100 feet, dragging creatures to the ground. Each creature in the area when it appears must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone and restrained (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Confinement Ring (Recharge 5-6, Level 6 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A 10-foot radius circle of luminous runes shimmers into existence at a point the guard can see within 60 feet (AC 18, 40 HP, immunity to poison and psychic). The circle provides total cover and blocks exit by nonmagical means, but freely allows creatures to enter. While the circle has all of its Hit Points, it additionally blocks teleportation and ethereal travel.

actions.name: Mark of Exile (1/Day, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the guard can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed. The Cursed creature takes 22 (4d10) radiant damage whenever it starts its turn where the guard can see it. This damage can't reduce a creature below 1 hit point.

bonusActions.name: Sound Alarm
bonusActions.description: The guard raises a hue and cry, alerting each other guard within 300 feet that can hear it. Each round at initiative count 0, roll a d4 for each guard alerted in this way. On a roll of 1, the guard enters the combat.

bonusActions.name: Constraining Command
bonusActions.description: The guard points at a creature it can see and demands it be stopped. Up to two creatures within 5 feet of the target can each use their reaction to attempt to Grapple or Shove it.

bonusActions.name: Enforced Appearance (Level 3 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The guard targets an unoccupied space within 5 feet that a creature teleported out of in the last hour, wrenching the lingering magic. The creature must make a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or be teleported back into that space, or become immune to this effect for one hour on a success.

reactions.name: Irresistible Force
reactions.description: When the guard deals 20 or more Bludgeoning damage with melee attack, it can knock the target prone and force it to succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Mana Tithe (Level 5 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: One creature the guard can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or be forced to expend one spell level worth of spell slots for each point it failed by. A creature that can't is instead Dazed until the end of its next turn on a failure.

legendaryActions.name: Manifest Law (Level 4 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The guard attempts to bind the magic of a creature it can see within 60 feet, forcing it to make a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, the guard can choose a spell level, learning each spell of that level that the creature can cast, then can choose one spell revealed in this way; the target cannot cast that spell for the next minute.

legendaryActions.name: Spiritshatter Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The guard moves up to half its speed and can make an attack with its Spiritbreaker Greatgavel. A Frightened creature hit with this attack becomes Turned for as long as it remains Frightened.

name: Knight-Skirmisher
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +4, Con +3, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Chivalric Aid
traits.description: The first attack made each turn by one of the knight's allies against an enemy within 5 feet of the knight has Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The knight makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with the Dash or Disengage action.

actions.name: Light Falchion
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. On a Critical Hit, the target must make aConstitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target drops one object it is holding.

actions.name: Flying Knee
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the knight moved at least 15 feet toward the target directly before making this attack, it deals an additional 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet on a hit.

reactions.name: Masked Grasp
reactions.description: Trigger: The knight misses with a melee attack. Response: The knight forces the target to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target is Grappled (escape DC 14).

reactions.name: Running Reap
reactions.description: Trigger: The knight leaves the reach of a creature without being hit with an Opportunity Attack. Response: The knight forces the creature to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature falls Prone.

name: Knight-Bulwark
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +3, Con +6, Wis +2, Cha +4

traits.name: Adamant Stance
traits.description: The knight has Advantage on saving throws to resist being knocked Prone or moved against its will.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The knight makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Gut Kick.

actions.name: Long-Axe
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gut Kick
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away. Then, if the target has fewer than 20 Hit Points, it is Dazed until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Demoralize
reactions.description: Trigger: The knight is hit with a melee attack. Response: The knight reduces the attack's damage by 11 (2d10). If this reduces the attack's damage to 0, the attacker becomes Frightened until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Heavy Check
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature moves within 5 feet of the knight for the first time on a turn. Response: The knight forces the creature to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature falls Prone.

name: Knight-Juggernaut
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +2, Con +7, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Dauntless
traits.description: The knight's Speed can't be reduced by effects other than the Grappled or Restrained conditions, and it has Resistance to damage from Opportunity Attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The knight makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Plough Through.

actions.name: Breaker Mace
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. On a Critical Hit, the target is Dazed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Shield Punch
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away. This attack has Advantage against targets Grappled by the knight.

actions.name: Plough Through
actions.description: The knight moves up to half its Speed and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature with this movement. A creature whose space the knight enters in this way is pushed ahead of it.

reactions.name: Counterstrike
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 5 feet misses the knight with a melee attack. Response: The knight makes an attack against the creature with its Shield Punch.

reactions.name: Hand-Off
reactions.description: Trigger: The knight pushes a creature at least 5 feet. Response: One of the knight's allies within 5 feet of the creature can use its Reaction to attempt to Grapple the creature.

name: Knight-Devastator
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +4, Con +6, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Demanding Presence
traits.description: Enemies within 10 feet of the knight have Disadvantage on attacks that do not target it. Creatures immune to the Frightened condition ignore this effect.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The knight makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Wind Up.

actions.name: Carcass-Splitter Greatcleaver
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +X, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) Slashing damage. If this attack exceeds the target's AC by 5 or more, it deals an additional 6 (1d12) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Wind Up
actions.description: The knight chooses a creature within 10 feet, preparing a massive strike; the next attack the knight makes against the target this turn has Advantage. If the target is Grappled, all of the knight's attacks against that target have Advantage until the grapple ends.

reactions.name: Sunder Armor
reactions.description: Trigger: The knight scores a Critical Hit against a creature wearing armor or a shield. Response: The AC provided by the target's armor is reduced cumulatively by 2 until repaired.

name: Knight-Captain
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +5, Con +6, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +2

traits.name: Commander's Aura
traits.description: While the knight is not Incapacitated, its allies within 30 feet add 1d4 to the result of any Strength or Dexterity-based d20 Tests they make.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The knight makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Field Command.

actions.name: Bearded Battleaxe
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the knight can Grapple the target (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Shield Punch
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away. This attack has Advantage against targets Grappled by the knight.

reactions.name: Hook Limb
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature misses the knight with a melee attack. Response: The knight entangles the creature's weapon. Until the creature leaves the knight's reach, it has Disadvantage on attacks made with that weapon.

reactions.name: Snap-Down
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature fails an attempt to escape the knight's grapple. Response: The knight knocks the creature Prone.

legendaryActions.name: Bearded Battleaxe
legendaryActions.description: The knight makes an attack with its Bearded Battleaxe

legendaryActions.name: Call Target
legendaryActions.description: The knight chooses a creature it can see within 30 feet; until the end of the knight's next turn, the first attack made against that creature each turn has Advantage.

legendaryActions.name: Field Command
legendaryActions.description: One of the knight's allies within 30 feet can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed and make a melee attack.

legendaryActions.name: Regroup
legendaryActions.description: Each of the knight's allies within 30 feet can regain its Reaction or move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: Kraken Priest
savingThrows: Str +1, Con +3, Wis +2, Cha +2
resistances: Lightning, Thunder, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The priest can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Brinewarded
traits.description:
Aquatic creatures with an Intelligence score
of 3 or less are indifferent to the priest.

traits.name: Kraken Host (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
traits.description: When the priest is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it resets to 90 Hit Points and explosively sprouts eight bloody tentacles from its back, becoming size Large and gaining a climb speed equal to its movement speed.

actions.name: Thunderous Touch (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description:
Attack: +5 reach 5 ft., one
creature. Hit: 27 (5d10) thunder damage and the target is pushed 15 ft. away. A creature pushed into a wood or plaster wall less than a foot thick is pushed through the wall.

actions.name: Whelm (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: A wave of water crashes out from the priest. Each creature in a 30 ft. long, 10 ft. wide line must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Call The Storm (Level 3 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The priest chooses three points within 60 ft. Each creature within 5 ft. of one or more of those points must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Briny Dissolution
legendaryActions.description: The priest dissolves into a puddle of water, reforming at a location it can see within 20 ft.

legendaryActions.name: Voice of Eons
legendaryActions.description: The priest telepathic utters a thunderous imprecation. One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is knocked prone, additionally.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Tentacle Lash
legendaryActions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14).

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Fling
legendaryActions.description: One grappled creature is flung up to 30 ft. and knocked prone. If the creature hits a solid surface, it takes 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage.

name: Necromancer Skulldigger
savingThrows: Dex +6, Con +4, Int +7, Wis +6, Cha +3

traits.name: Graveway Traveler
traits.description: Once on its turn, the necromancer can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into a Large or larger area of loose earth and emerge from any area of loose earth within 60 feet, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second space.

traits.name: Ossuary Call
traits.description: Friendly skeletons within 30 feet of the necromancer may use its attack bonus in place of their own.

traits.name: Dread Revels
traits.description: The necromancer has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are Frightened.

actions.name: Clutch of Terror (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 15 ft. Hit: 33 (6d10) necrotic damage and the target is dragged 10 feet toward the necromancer, then must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened for the next minute. A Frightened creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Corrupt Marrow (Level 4 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 15-foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is Paralyzed until the end of the necromancer's next turn.

reactions.name: Shield of Bones (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: When the necromancer or a friendly undead creature is targeted with a ranged attack, the necromancer can raise a shield of bones and earth, granting the target 3/4 cover against ranged attacks until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: To Dust (Level 3 Spell, 1/Day)
reactions.description: When the necromancer is reduced below 68 Hit Points, it can cause any number of skeletons or skeletal corpses within 60 feet to explode in a cloud of shrapnel and choking dust. Each creature within 10 feet of one or more exploding skeletons must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Piercing damage and be unable to speak or breathe until the end of the necromancer's next turn.

name: Necromancer Gravebreaker
savingThrows: Str +2, Con +7, Int +7, Wis +6, Cha +1

traits.name: Graveway Traveler
traits.description: Once on its turn, the necromancer can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into a Large or larger area of loose earth and emerge from any area of loose earth within 60 feet, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second space.

traits.name: Rot Shepherd
traits.description: Friendly zombies within 30 feet of the necromancer may attempt to Grapple or Shove a creature as a bonus action.

traits.name: Dread Revels
traits.description: The necromancer has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are Frightened.

traits.name: Reclaim Anima (3/Day)
traits.description: If the necromancer fails a saving throw, it can drain the animating force from one undead creature it controls to succeed instead, reducing the creature to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Grasping Grave (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 15 ft. Hit: 33 (6d10) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Panickfog (Level 4 Spell, Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A dense fog descends in a 30 ft. radius around the necromancer, heavily obscuring the area for the next minute. A creature that starts its turn in the fog or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the necromancer's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more uses all of its remaining movement to move in a random direction.

reactions.name: Corpus Potency (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: When the necromancer or a friendly zombie within 30 feet makes a Constitution Saving Throw, the necromancer can grant the target Advantage on the saving throw. If the saving throw was against a damaging effect, the target takes no damage on a successful saving throw.

reactions.name: Reanimate (Level 5 Spell, 1/Day)
reactions.description: When the necromancer is reduced below 95 Hit Points, it can animate up to six humanoid corpses within 60 feet. Each corpse rises as a Zombie Rotter with 1 hit point that acts on the necromancer's initiative and under the its control for the next minute.

legendaryActions.name: Scent of the Living
legendaryActions.description: Up to two undead within 30 ft. of the necromancer may each move up to 15 feet toward the nearest hostile creature to them.

legendaryActions.name: Drag to Earth
legendaryActions.description: One zombie within 30 feet of the necromancer may attempt to shove a creature within range.

legendaryActions.name: The Graveless Dead (3/Day, Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The necromancer chooses an unoccupied space within 30 feet. At the beginning of the necromancer's following turn, a Zombie Rotter under the necromancer's control that acts on the necromancer's initiative unearths itself in that space.

name: Necromancer Ghoulcaller
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +6, Con +4, Int +9, Wis +7, Cha +2

traits.name: Graveway Traveler
traits.description: Once on its turn, the necromancer can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into a Large or larger area of loose earth and emerge from any area of loose earth within 60 feet, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second space.

traits.name: Eternal Tide
traits.description: At the beginning of the necromancer's turn, one ghoul or ghast within 60 feet that died since the end of the necromancer's last turn returns to undeath with 1 hit point and acts on the necromancer's initiative, rather than its own.

traits.name: Dread Revels
traits.description: The necromancer has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are Frightened.

traits.name: Reclaim Anima (3/Day)
traits.description: If the necromancer fails a saving throw, it can drain the animating force from one undead creature it controls to succeed instead, reducing the creature to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The necromancer makes two attacks with its Grave Bolt.

actions.name: Grave Bolt (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +9 range 120 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) necrotic damage and the target is afflicted with clinging shadows for the next minute, reducing any sources of bright light within 5 feet of it to dim light.

actions.name: Wrench Heart (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet that the necromancer can see feels a spectral hand sink into its chest and grip its heart. At the beginning of each of the creature's turns it takes 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the start of its next turn, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Filth Harvest (Level 5 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature that is Paralyzed, Poisoned, or infected with Ghoul Fever must make a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 44 (8d10) Necrotic damage and the necromancer gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the half the damage dealt.

reactions.name: Necromiasma (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: When a creature the necromancer can see within 30 feet fails a Constitution save by 5 or more, the necromancer can corrupt the wound, making the creature unaffected by the first source of healing it receives before the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Death Throes

name: Necromancer Wraithbinder

traits.name: Graveway Traveler
traits.description: Once on its turn, the necromancer can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into a Large or larger area of loose earth and emerge from any area of loose earth within 60 feet, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second space.

traits.name: Dread Revels
traits.description: The necromancer has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are Frightened.

traits.name: Ghostly Chill

traits.name: Reclaim Anima (3/Day)
traits.description: If the necromancer fails a saving throw, it can drain the animating force from one undead creature it controls to succeed instead, reducing the creature to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The necromancer uses its Grave Bolt four times.

actions.description: Attack: +11 range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) necrotic damage and the target is afflicted with clinging shadows for the next minute, reducing any sources of bright light within 5 feet of it to dim light.

actions.description: One creature within 60 feet that the necromancer can see feels a spectral hand sink into its chest and grip its heart. actions.name: Ghastly Scourge (Level 6 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 20 ft. Hit: 93 (6d10 + 60) necrotic damage. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, it immediately fails one death save.

reactions.description: When a creature reduces the necromancer below 88 Hit Points, the necromancer can attempt to crush the creature's heart within its chest. The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or drop to 0 Hit Points. A creature with no unexpended hit dice makes this saving throw at Disadvantage.

legendaryActions.name: Scent of the Living
legendaryActions.description: Up to two undead within 30 feet of the necromancer may each move up to 20 feet toward the nearest hostile creature to them.

legendaryActions.name: Lay Bare

legendaryActions.name: Bind Wraith
legendaryActions.description: One humanoid creature that died in the last minute rises as a Wisp Wraith under the necromancer's control that acts on the necromancer's initiative.

actions.name: Court Smallsword
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Call to Service

reactions.name: Deft Parry

reactions.name: Bon Mot

bonusActions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ancestral Blade

reactions.description: When the noble would be hit with a melee attack, it can add +5 to its AC against the triggering attack. The next attack made against the noble before the start of its next turn has Advantage.

reactions.name: Procession of Ancient Right (Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: When the noble rolls initiative, it can force each creature of his choice within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw or have their initiative reduced by 5, to a minimum of 0.

reactions.name: Fealty's Clarion (1/Day, Level 8 Spell)
reactions.description: When the noble is reduced below 103 Hit Points, it can summon two Oathsworn Acolytes in unoccupied spaces it can see within 30 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Gilded Scepter
legendaryActions.description: The noble makes an attack with its Gilded Scepter.

Up to two friendly humanoid creatures the noble can see can each use their reaction to move up to half their speed and make a melee attack.

Spellbound by the masquerade/ Caught inside a trance/ And blinded to the strings they tie/ That force you to dance/ Drowning in their crimson wine/ It permeates your soul/ Manifest the tempo of your mind/ Caught in the dance of control.

reactions.name: Spells as Abilities
reactions.description: I don't think a stat block should ever require you to reference another book/document, so I've chosen to turn all spells into spell-like abilities, at least in presentation. I've included spell levels for all spells of 1st level or higher for the purposes of counterspelling. A spellcaster will typically not need every one of their spell slots for a 3-6 round combat, so many have fewer here. They also won't need a bunch of RP spells prepared for a combat encounter, which is what stat blocks are for after all. Minute resource tracking is for players. The DM has too much going on to have to worry about that.

In that respect, many of these stat blocks are decidedly un-optimal, since I prioritize casting a greater variety of spells that will make for memorable moments that feel right for the classes. reactions.name: Paladins are Complex
reactions.description: Something I discovered putting this project together is that of all the classes, Paladins are the most irreducible. Which is to say, on any given turn in combat they have the most viable options for how to use their Action, Bonus Action, and Reaction. I really didn't expect that, to be honest. Even more so, if you take into account Find Greater Steed.

reactions.name: Find Greater Steed
reactions.description: A high level paladin should always be riding something cool. Give them whatever CR 2 creature fits thematically to ride, then have it act on their turn. If you were already going to be using a more powerful monster in the encounter, have them riding that instead and have them act on the same turn in initiative.

actions.name: Ranger Spells
actions.description: Hunters Mark is fine, but its real value past level 5 is in conserving spell slots. Zephyr Strike is more generally useful for the kinds of situations a Ranger facing your party is going to have to deal with. Ranger spells in general are really good, but at higher levels they either can't justify their complexity or they get severely outclassed by the raw power of just attacking. This is why the Ranger Legend only has a single spell prepared.

traits.name: Stunning Strike (1/Turn, Costs 1 Focus Point)
traits.description: The monk forces one creature it hit with an Unarmed Strike this turn to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The target has the Stunned Condition until the start of the monk's next turn. Success: The target's Speed is halved until the start of the monk's next turn and the next attack against it has Advantage.

traits.name: Disciplined Survivor (Costs 1 Focus Point)
traits.description: When the monk fails a saving throw, it can reroll it, taking the second result.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: When the monk makes a Dexterity Saving Throw while it isn't Incapacitated, it takes no damage on a successful saving throw, and only half damage on a failure.

traits.name: Self-Restoration
traits.description: When the monk ends its turn while Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned, it can end one of those conditions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The monk makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Quivvering Palm.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description:
Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) Bludgeoning or Force damage (monk's choice). The monk can make this attack as a Bonus Action.

If this attack was made as part of the monk's Flurry of Blows, it can add one of the following effects on a *Hit:* Addle. The target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn. Push. The target must make a {{font-variant:small-caps **Strength Saving Throw:**}} DC 18. {{font-variant:small-caps **Failure:**}} The target is pushed up to 15 feet away. Topple. The target must make a {{font-variant:small-caps **Dexterity Saving Throw:**}} DC 18. {{font-variant:small-caps **Failure:**}} The target has the Prone condition.

On a Critical Hit, attack rolls against the target have Advantage until the start of the monk's next turn.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Attack: +9 range 80/320 ft. ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Quivvering Palm (Costs 4 Focus Points)
actions.description: One creature the monk hit with an Unarmed Strike in the last hour, and that it hasn't targeted with this ability since doing so, must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 65 (10d12) Force damage. Success: Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Flurry of Blows (Costs 1 Focus Point)
bonusActions.description: The monk makes three Unarmed Strike attacks.

bonusActions.name: Patient Defense
bonusActions.description: The monk Disengages, then can spend 1 Focus Point to gain 11 (2d10) Temporary Hit Points and Dodge, additionally.

bonusActions.name: Step of the Wind
bonusActions.description: The monk Dashes, then can spend 1 Focus Point to Disengage and move one willing Large or smaller creature within 5 feet with it this turn, additionally. Whenever the monk takes a Bonus Action other than this one, it can use this ability with no action required.

bonusActions.name: Wholeness of Body (4/Day)
bonusActions.description: The monk regains 10 (1d12 + 4) Hit Points.

reactions.name: Deflect Attack
reactions.description:
Trigger: The monk is hit with an attack. Response: The triggering attack's damage is reduced by 27 (1d12 + 21).

If this reduces the attack's damage to 0, the monk can spend a Focus Point to redirect it, forcing one creature the attack could target to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 18 (2d12 + 5) damage of a type dealt by the attack.
