name: Elminster, Chosen of Mystra
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +4, Con +14, Int +15, Wis +13, Cha +3
skills: Arcana +23, History +15, Insight +13, Nature +15, Perception +13, Religion +15
resistances: Damage from Spells; Nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing

traits.name: Sage's Escape
traits.description: When elminster drops to 0 Hit Points or dies, his body, mind, and soul separate and each independently teleport to a hidden refuge in a secluded demiplane, where they recombine and are immediately restored to 1 hit point.

traits.name: Mystic Clarity
traits.description: If Elminster has at least 115 Hit Points, his attacks score a critical on an 18-20.

traits.name: Weave Anchor
traits.description: Antimagic fields have no effect within 120 ft. of Elminster. His spells and magic items created by him cannot be dispelled, disabled or destroyed by any spell. He requires no verbal or somatic components to cast spells, and makes saving throws to maintain concentration at Advantage.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: Elminster can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless he wishes to be. He has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If Elminster fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Elminster makes two attacks, each of which he may replace with a use of his spellfire barrage.

actions.name: Thunderstrike Longsword
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage plus Hit: 14 (4d6) thunder damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away. If elminster strikes a construct of force with this attack, the construct's creator must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or have it shatter.

actions.name: Silverfire Barrage
actions.description: Elminster unleashes a swarm of magical missiles that strike a creature within 120 feet, dealing 27 (5d8 + 5) Force damage. A creature may halve this damage with the Shield spell.

actions.name: Sculpt the Weave
actions.description: Elminster casts any spell of 5th level or below.

actions.name: Silverfire Nova (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Elminster channels raw, unfiltered magic directly from the weave into a concentrated sphere and hurls it, where it explodes in a 60 ft. radius centered on a point within 300 feet. Each nonmagical object and surface that is not worn or carried disintegrates, leaving a circular crater. Each creature in the area regains all of its expended spell slots, then must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 88 (16d10) Force damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage disintegrates.

actions.name: Shapechange (1/Day, Level 9 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Elminster changes his form into that of any creature of his CR 20 or lower, adopting the new form's statistics, other than its Hit Points, retaining his own traits and actions, and gaining Temporary Hit Points equal to the new form's maximum Hit Points. When he loses these Temporary Hit Points, he reverts to his normal human form.

reactions.name: Reactive Metamagic
reactions.description: As a reaction to dealing damage of a type a target is resistant to, elminster changes the damage type to his choice of acid, fire, cold, lightning, or thunder.

reactions.name: Sage's Spelltweak (Level 6 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 60 feet, Elminster may make an Intelligence check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, gaining control of the spell and choosing a new target for the spell on a success. If the spell requires concentration, Elminster must concentrate to maintain it. *Desperate Wish (1/Day, Level 9 Spell.)* As a reaction to being reduced below 115 Hit Points, elminster casts any spell of 8th level or below.

legendaryActions.name: Temporal Undoing
legendaryActions.description: If Elminster has not used this ability since the end of his previous turn, he teleports to the location he started his previous turn and gains 50 Temporary Hit Points. If the space is occupied, he instead teleports to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 5 (1d10) Force damage.

legendaryActions.name: Staff of Spheres (Level 4 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: Elminster conjures up to four spheres of silvery ablative magic that orbit him, to a maximum of four, increasing his AC by 5 while any of them remain. Whenever he is missed with an attack, one of the spheres is destroyed.

legendaryActions.name: Burning Arc (Costs 2 Actions, Level 5 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Worldwalk Gate (Costs 2 Actions, Level 9 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: Elminster opens a 15 ft. wide portal to another plane of existence centered on a point he can see within 30 ft. that lasts for one minute.

name: Halaster Blackcloak
savingThrows: Dex +4, Con +12, Int +14, Wis +11, Cha +4
resistances: Damage from Spells; Nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing
languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, Elvish, Infernal, Undercommon

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: If Halaster dies in Undermountain, he revives after 1d10 days, with all his Hit Points and any missing body parts restored. His new body appears in a random safe location in Undermountain.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Halaster has Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Sharpen Focus (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
traits.description: When Halaster is reduced to 0 Hit Points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, he resets to 212 Hit Points. For the next minute, Halaster gains two additional legendary actions on each of his turns and has Advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If Halaster fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Halaster makes three attacks with his Twisting Drakebolt, each of which he may replace with a use of his Flying Portal or Half-Forgotten Spell.

actions.name: Twisting Drakebolt
actions.description: Attack: +14 range 100 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage plus Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage. This attack ignores half and three-quarters cover, and can target creature behind full cover.

actions.name: Flying Portal (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: Halaster creates a 10-foot wide flat portal that lasts for a minute in an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet. Any creature or ranged attack that enters one of these portals emerges from another of Halaster's choice.

actions.name: Half Forgotten Spell
actions.description: Roll a d20, subtracting 1 for each legendary resistance that Halaster has expended. Halaster casts the corresponding spell on the Half-Forgotten Spells table. On a result of 0 or lower, nothing happens. On a result of 20, he may choose any spell on the list to cast.

actions.name: Blast with Madness (Level 9 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Halaster opens his mind and releases a fragment of the eldritch knowledge imprisoned there, becoming a window to the Far Realm for a fraction of an instant. Each creature within 30 feet that can see or hear Halaster must succeed on a DC 22 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 63 (6d20) Psychic damage and have its proficiency bonus reduced by 2 until it completes a Short or Long rest, or take half as much damage on a success. A creature that has its proficiency bonus reduced to 0 in this way is afflicted with an effect from the Indefinite Madness table (DMG p. 258) until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reactions.name: Delay Spell (Level 5 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature Halaster can see casts a spell, Halaster delays the spell's effect until the end of his next turn. The spell's caster must maintain concentration on the spell until then or have the spell fail.

reactions.name: Emergency Clone (Level 9 Spell, Recharges when Halaster's Mythic Trait Activates)
reactions.description: As a reaction when Halaster is targeted with an attack or spell, he creates an imperfect copy of himself in an unoccupied space within 5 feet that becomes the new target of the attack or spell. The copy rolls its own initiative, has 100 Hit Points, and doesn't have legendary actions or resistances, but otherwise uses his statistics. At the start of each of his turns, Halaster must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom Saving Throw or become mutually hostile with the copy until the start of his next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Move Portal (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Halaster moves one of the portals created with his Flying Portal up to 30 feet. Each creature whose space the portal moves through is teleported to the nearest unoccupied space to another Flying Portal of Halaster's choice. An unwilling creature may make a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw, resisting the effect on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Half-Forgotten Spell
legendaryActions.description: Halaster uses his Half-Forgotten Spell ability.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Hasten Spell
legendaryActions.description: Halaster reduces the duration of an active spell effect within 30 feet by 1d4 minutes. If this reduces the effect's duration to 0, the effect ends. *One of the Classics! (Costs 2 Actions)* Halaster casts any spell of 6th level or below.

name: Iggwilv, the Witch-Queen
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +12, Int +15, Wis +12, Cha +13

traits.name: Dark Glamour
traits.description: Creatures that can see Iggwilv can't benefit from Immunity to the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Coven Craft
traits.description: While at least two allies with this trait are within 30 feet of Iggwilv, her Attack Rolls have Advantage and creatures have Disadvantage on any saving throw they make against effects she controls.

traits.name: Witch-Queen's Mastery (5/Day)
traits.description: When Iggwilv would fail a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. For each remaining use of this ability, Iggwilv adds +1 to her saving throws to maintain Concentration.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Iggwilv uses her Mind Weevil three times, one of which she can replace with a use of her Demoniac Imbrual or Profane Dismissal.

actions.name: Mind Weevil (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Iggwilv forces one creature she can see within 90 feet to make an Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 27 (5d10) Psychic damage and the creature is Dazed until the end of her next turn. While Dazed in this way, the creature takes 11 (2d10) Psychic damage whenever it casts a spell or makes a d20 Test using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma.

actions.name: Demoniac Imbrual (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: One Incapacitated creature within 60 feet must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature is Possessed by a demonic spirit for as long as it remains Incapacitated. While Possessed, the creature ignores the effects of any Incapacitating condition or effect, is Charmed by Iggwilv, and is hostile to all other creatures.

actions.name: Profane Dismissal (Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: Iggwilv forces a creature she can see to make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 33 (6d10) Fire damage plus 33 (6d10) Force damage and the target is Banished to the Abyss until the end of Iggwilv's next turn, at which point it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed.

actions.name: Cauldron Tide (Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: Bubbling sludge surges forth from Iggwilv in a 60-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 28 (8d6) Force damage plus 28 (8d6) Poison damage. Failure by 5 or More: The creature is Incapacitated and Shape-Shifted into a Tiny toad until the end of its next turn, or until it takes any damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Abyssal Apocalypse (Level 9 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Iggwilv calls forth a legion of gnashing demonic spirits that swarm about her in a 60-foot Emanation. Whenever a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn in the area, Iggwilv can force it to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 45 (10d8) damage of one of the following types, chosen at random: Cold, Fire, Force, or Lightning. Success: Half damage. When this spell ends, Iggwilv must make a saving throw against it.

actions.name: Imprisonment (Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: Iggwilv raises a runed gemstone toward a creature within 60 feet affected by her Scribe Likeness, forcing it to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature shrinks to 1-inch tall and is trapped within the stone and Incapacitated.

reactions.name: Still Ichor (Level 5 Spell)
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature hits Iggwilv with a melee attack. Response: The creature must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature is Frightened and Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Yaga's Remand (Level 7 Spell)
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature Iggwilv can see within 60 feet casts a spell. Response: The spell fails. This spell can't be countered or otherwise prevented.

legendaryActions.name: Umbral Surge
legendaryActions.description: Iggwilv teleports to an unoccupied space within 30 feet, then can use her Mind Weevil or Demoniac Imbrual.

legendaryActions.name: Hideous Laughter (Level 1 Spell, Concentration)
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 90 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature falls Prone and is Incapacitated for 1 minute. It repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Contest of Wills
legendaryActions.description: Iggwilv psychically assails a creature within 60 feet, forcing it to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature is Dominated by Iggwilv until the end of its next turn. Success: Iggwilv is Charmed by the creature until the end of her next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Scribe Likeness (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Iggwilv summons magical vellum and quill, rapidly creating a sketch of a creature she can see within 30 feet (AC 24, 1 HP).

name: Lord Soth
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +7, Con +13, Int +1, Wis +10, Cha +12
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Turned; Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

traits.name: Profane Resistance
traits.description:
Soth has Advantage on saving throws against spells
and other magical effects, except against those with a divine source.

traits.name: Deathless March
traits.description: While Soth is not Incapacitated, Undead allies of CR 11 or lower within 60 feet of him have Advantage on attacks and saving throws.

traits.name: Grave Purge
traits.description: If Soth would fail a saving throw while he isn't Dazed, he can choose to succeed. If he does, he is Dazed until the end of his next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Soth makes three attacks, or makes one attack and uses his Fear Eternal.

actions.name: Dreadblade
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. While this weapon is intact, creatures killed by it can't be returned to life.

actions.name: Forsaken Brand
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) fire damage and the target begins Burning (1d10). If the Burning creature would regain any Hit Points, it instead regains 1 Hit Point and the condition ends.

actions.name: Fear Eternal (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Soth can see within 60 feet takes 41 (6d6 + 20) Psychic damage, then must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The target is Frightened (Save Ends at end of turn). Failure by 5 or More: The target is Frightened indefinitely.

actions.name: Cataclysm's Flame (Recharge 5-6, Level 9 Spell),
actions.description: Black flames erupt in a 20-foot radius Sphere within 150 feet, forcing each creature in the area to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 35 (10d6) Force damage plus 35 (10d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. Then, each Humanoid corpse in the area has its skeleton tear free of its flesh, arising as a Blazing Bones that is hostile to all living creatures and acts on Soth's initiative.

actions.name: Power Word Rise (1/Day, Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: Soth speaks a terrible command, exerting command of death itself in a 60-foot Emanation and choosing two of the following: Each Humanoid corpse in the area arises under Soth's control as an Undead creature of CR 1 or below with full Hit Points and can stand from Prone. Each Undead corpse in the area returns to undeath with 25 Hit Points and can stand from Prone. Each Undead creature in the area regains 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Choir of Death (1/Day, Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: Wailing specters swarm a creature Soth can see within 60 feet; the creature takes 50 Cold damage plus 50 Necrotic damage, then must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The creature dies. A creature with 1 or more Hit Points has Advantage on this saving throw.

bonusActions.name: No Escape
bonusActions.description: Up to two Humanoid creatures Soth can see within 150 feet are each dragged up to 30 feet toward him, then must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The creature falls Prone.

bonusActions.name: Arcane Decay (Level 5 Spell)
bonusActions.description: Antimagical energies surge from Soth in a 30-foot Emanation, forcing each creature of his choice in the area to make a Constitution Saving {{ Throw:}} DC 20. Failure: One spell of his choice affecting the target, or that it is concentrating on, ends for it. Failure by 5 or More: Each such spell ends for the target.

reactions.name: Turn Aside
reactions.description: Trigger: Soth would be hit with an attack. Response: Soth adds +6 to his AC against the triggering attack.

reactions.name: Overpower
reactions.description: Trigger: Soth misses with a melee attack. Response: Soth makes a melee attack against the same target with Advantage.

legendaryActions.name: Black Command
legendaryActions.description: Up to three Undead allies of Soth's within 60 feet can each use their Reaction to make a weapon attack.

legendaryActions.name: Gauntlet Strike
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 5 feet must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: The creature is knocked Prone and Dazed until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Shadow Onslaught (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Soth teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, then can make two attacks if he is not illuminated by Bright Light.

name: Mordenkainen
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +2, Con +10, Int +13, Wis +10, Cha +5
resistances: Damage from Spells; Nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Mordenkainen has Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Arbiter of the Balance (Mythic Trait, 2/Day)
traits.description: When Mordenkainen is reduced to 0 Hit Points, he doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, he resets to 157 Hit Points and each condition affecting him ends. For the next hour, his Mordenkainen's Balanced Blade grows in size and deals a cumulative additional 5 (1d10) Force damage on a hit.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Mordenkainen fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Mordenkainen makes two attacks with his Mordenkainen's Balanced Blade.

actions.name: Mordenkainen's Balanced Blade
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 33 (5d10 + 6) force damage. A creation of magical force hit with this weapon explodes, forcing each creature within 15 feet of it to succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Force damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Mordenkainen's Arcing Fingertips (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: A bolt of lightning leaps from each of Mordenkainen's splayed fingertips, forcing up to ten creatures of his choice in a 90-foot cone to make a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw. A target takes 28 (8d6) Lightning damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Mordenkainen's Involuntary Wizardry (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Mordenkainen calls forth a magical spasm from a creature he can see within range, forcing it to succeed on a DC 21 Charisma Saving Throw or use its highest level unexpended spell slot to cast Magic Missile at that level. The missiles produced by it are divided evenly between other creatures within 30 feet of the target, with any extras hitting the creature that produced them.

actions.name: Mordenkainen's Ultimate Cogitation (Level 8 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Mordenkainen casts any wizard spell of 6th level or lower that has a casting time of 1 action.

reactions.name: Mordenkainen's Instant Opposition (Level 7 Spell)
reactions.description: When a creature Mordenkainen can see within 60 feet casts a spell, Mordenkainen can attempt to neutralize it with a tailored blend of opposing cosmic energies. The spell caster must succeed on a DC 21 Intelligence Saving Throw or have its spell fail. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more instead has its spell rebound upon it. If the spell targets one or more creatures, it instead targets only the spell caster. If the spell targets an area, it instead targets an area centered on the spell caster.

reactions.name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Phantoms (2/Day, Level 6 Spell, Concentration)
reactions.description: When Mordenkainen's Mythic trait becomes active, he can sculpt raw magical force into two Faithful Phantoms. Each Faithful Phantom appears in an unoccupied space Mordenkainen can see within 15 feet and acts under his control on initiative 0.

legendaryActions.name: Magician's Step
legendaryActions.description: Mordenkainen moves up to half his speed. Then, if no hostile creature within 30 feet can clearly see him, he can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space.

legendaryActions.name: Dancing Slash
legendaryActions.description: Mordenkainen's sword flies up to 30 feet and makes a Mordenkainen's Balanced Blade attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. At the beginning of Mordenkainen's turn, it returns to his hand.

legendaryActions.name: Hasty Ward (Concentration)
legendaryActions.description: Mordenkainen quickly improvises a protective spell, chosen at random from the Hasty Ward table.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Mordenkainen's Focused Disjunction (1/Round, Level 9 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: Mordenkainen attempts to sunder a spell or nonartifact magic item he can see within 60 feet. A creature concentrating on the spell or attuned to the magic item can make a DC 21 Charisma Saving Throw, preventing its destruction on a success.

name: Faithful Phantom
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Int -1, Cha -2

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.description: The phantom can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane.

traits.name: Harmonic Alignment
traits.description: When the phantom is created, its creator attunes its natural frequencies to one of Chaos, Law, Good, or Evil. While within 30 feet of a Faithful Phantom of a different alignment, the phantom is immune to all damage other than Force.

actions.name: Aligned Strike
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 Force damage. This attack can target creatures in the Border Ethereal

actions.name: Opposition Conduit
actions.description: Opposing energies lash between the phantom and another Faithful Phantom within 30 feet of it in a 5-foot wide line. Each creature in the area that shares an alignment with one or more of the phantoms must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 19) until the beginning of the phantom's next turn.

name: Orlassk
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +4, Con +15, Int +12, Wis +14, Cha +9
immunities: Poison, Psychic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Angelic Countenance
traits.description: Orlassk appears as a preturnaturally beautiful humanoid, in a form appealing to the preferences of the individual observer.

traits.name: Shroud of Madness
traits.description: Orlassk's attention breaks the minds of mortals. A creature targeted by an attack or ability of his takes 15 pychic damage and is Frightened until the start of his next turn as it briefly aprehends the smallness of its own existence in geological time.

traits.name: Armor of Flesh
traits.description: If Orlassk takes 20 or more Fire damage in a turn, his AC is reduced by 5 and he has vulnerability to radiant damage until the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
traits.description: If Orlassk fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Orlassk makes two attacks with his Fleshchisel Symbiont and uses his Doomed Revlation.

actions.name: Chiselfinger Symbiont
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (4d4 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 22 (4d10) force damage. If the target is affected by Orlassk's Torment of Stone, it must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma Saving Throw or have its Charisma score reduced by 1d4, to a minimum of one, until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

actions.name: Unveil Form
actions.description: Orlassk strikes a precise blow to a creature within 5 feet with a Charisma score of 1, shattering its exterior and revealing its new form. The creature is transformed into an aberration of the same size or smaller and of CR 9 or lower until cured by a Wish spell or similar magic. It retains its Hit Points and mental statistics, and acts under Orlassk's control.

actions.name: Doomed Revelation
actions.description: One creature Orlassk can see regains its highest level expended spell slot, then must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom Saving Throw or act under Orlassk's control on its following turn. A creature immune to the Frightened condition makes this saving throw at Advantage.

actions.name: Torment of Stone (Recharge 5-6, Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: Each creature Orlassk can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed. A creature cursed in this way must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw at the start of each of its turns or take 22 (4d10) Psychic damage and have its movement reduced by 10 until this curse ends. A creature that has its movement speed reduced to 10 or lower in this way is Blinded and can't speak or breathe, as liquid stone wells up from its mouth, nose, and eyes. A creature that has its movement reduced to 0 in this way is Petrified.

reactions.name: Inexorable Embrace
reactions.description: As a reaction when a flying creature targets him with an attack or spell, Orlassk causes the creature to lose its fly speed until the end of the turn.

reactions.name: Shatterstep
reactions.description: As a reaction when Orlassk is hit with a melee attack while within 30 feet of a Petrified creature or Stone Cursed, he shatters into shards of jagged stone. Each creature within 10 feet of him must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (4d6) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success. The nearest Petrified creature or Stone Cursed immediately transforms into Orlassk as he takes over its body.

legendaryActions.name: The Flesh Endures
legendaryActions.description: Orlassk gains resistance to the next source of damage he is dealt before the start of his next turn.

legendaryActions.name: The Stone Yet Lives
legendaryActions.description: One Petrified creature Orlassk can see within 30 feet becomes a Stone Cursed under his control for the next minute. It retains its current Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Gravel Speech
legendaryActions.description: Gnashing mouths of stone open beneath the feet of a creature and the rattling voice of the earth spills forth. The creature takes 13 (3d8) Thunder damage, then if it is not flying must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Piercing damage and fall prone.

legendaryActions.name: Craftmark of Corruption (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Orlassk teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a Frightened creature he can see and makes a Fleshchisel Symbiont attack against it.

name: Solodovnika, Witch-Maw of the Bleakwood
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +14, Con +13, Int +3, Wis +11, Cha +14
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from Weapons that aren't Named; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Oppressive Fog
traits.description: The area within 5 miles of Solodovnika is filled with a heavy, shifting fog. Creatures other than her treat anything greater than 20 feet away as heavily obscured.

traits.name: Feast of Terror (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
traits.description: When Solodovnika is reduced to 0 Hit Points, she doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, she resets to 252 Hit Points and her chest splits open, revealing the roiling void within. For the next hour, a Frightened creature that ends its turn within 60 feet of Solodovnika must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or lose two unexpended hit dice, or gain a point of exhaustion if it cannot. For each hit die lost in this way, Solodovnika regains 10 Hit Points.

traits.name: Unliving Hair
traits.description: Solodovnika can have up to six locks of hair active at a time. Each lock can be attacked (AC 17; 20 HP). Destroying a lock deals no damage to Solodovnika, who can extrude any number of replacement locks on her turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If Solodovnika would fail a saving throw, she may choose to succeed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Solodovnika makes makes three melee attacks, or makes one attack and uses her Terror Unbound, if available.

actions.name: Erdblack Claws
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of Solodovnika's next turn.

actions.name: Slithering Locks
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 20 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target suffers one additional effect of Solodovnika's choice. Bind. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 22). Snare. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving or be knocked prone. Reel. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or be dragged up to 20 feet directly toward Solodovinka. Wick. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma Saving Throw or have one spell affecting it end.

actions.name: Terror Unbound (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature that has seen Solodovnika in the last minute becomes Frightened until the end of her next turn, then must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly away from her, or take 44 (8d10) Psychic damage if it cannot.

actions.name: Horrific Lament (1/Day, Concentration)
actions.description: Each Frightened creature within 60 feet of Solodovnika begins to uncontrollably weep acrid black tears, becoming Poisoned for the next minute. At the end of each affected creature's turn, it must make a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw, taking 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage and being Blinded until the end of its next turn on a failure, or ending the effect for itself on a success.

reactions.name: Wraithdrift
reactions.description: When she is hit with an attack, Solodovnika can turn briefly insubstantial, gaining resistance to the attack's damage and moving up to her fly speed.

reactions.name: Bloodied Terror (1/Day)
reactions.description: When her mythic trait becomes active, Solodovnika can recharge and immediately use her Terror Unbound.

legendaryActions.name: Slithering Locks
legendaryActions.description: Solodovnika makes an attack with her Slithering Locks.

legendaryActions.name: Strangle
legendaryActions.description: One creature grappled by Solodovnika must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or be unable to speak or breathe for as long as it remains grappled.

legendaryActions.name: Elude
legendaryActions.description: Solodovnika moves up to her fly speed and regains her reaction.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Consuming Void (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: One grappled creature within 5 feet of Solodovnika must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or be forced into the endless void within her (escape DC 22). A creature in the void can take no actions other than to attempt to escape, and loses 2 unexpended hit dice at the end of each of its turns, or dies if it cannot.

name: Strahd, the Scholar
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +12, Con +4, Int +5, Wis +9, Cha +12
languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Giant, Infernal

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.description: While in Sunlight, Strahd has Disadvantage on attack rolls, and takes 20 Radiant damage at the start of his turn.

traits.name: Vampiric Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Strahd fails a saving throw while not in Sunlight, he can choose to succeed instead. Uses of this ability are shared between his phases. At the start of each of Strahd's turns, he regains 10 Hit Points for each remaining use of this ability if he hasn't taken any Radiant damage since the end of his last turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Strahd makes two attacks with his Cinder Flurry, one of which he can replace with a use of his Pestilent Touch, Cruor Call, or Blightning Strike, if available.

actions.name: Cinder Flurry (Cantrip)
actions.description: Attack: +12 range 100 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage. If the target is Burning, this attack has Advantage and deals an additional 7 (2d6) Fire damage on a hit.

actions.name: Pestilent Touch (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature Strahd touches is wracked with fever, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 17 (5d6) Poison damage and the target is Poisoned for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn). While Poisoned in this way, the creature subtracts 1d6 from any D20 Tests that use Strength or Dexterity.

actions.name: Cruor Call (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: One creature within 15 feet must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage and the target loses three unexpended Hit Dice, or drops to 0 Hit Points if it can't. Success: Half damage. A Bleeding or Bloodied creature has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Blightning Strike (Recharge 5-6, Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: A bolt of baleful red lightning strikes from above, forcing one creature Strahd can see within 120 feet to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 14 (4d6) Lightning damage plus 16 (3d10) Necrotic Damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is unaffected by the first source of healing it receives before the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Lacerating Rain (1/Day, Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: Jagged blades of crystalized blood rain down in a 15-foot radius Cylinder within 300 feet. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 31 (7d8) Slashing damage and the creature begins Bleeding (2d10). Success: Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Geistwind
bonusActions.description: Strahd lashes out with telekinetic force toward a target he can see within 30 feet, choosing one of the following effects: Strahd flings a Small or Tiny object within range up to 30 feet. A creature wearing or wielding the object can make a {{font-variant:small-caps **Strength Saving Throw:**}} DC 20. {{font-variant:small-caps **Success:**}} The creature resists the effect. One creature within range must make a {{font-variant:small-caps **Strength Saving**}} {{font-variant:small-caps **Throw:**}} DC 20. {{font-variant:small-caps **Failure:**}} The creature is pushed up to 15 feet in a direction of Strahd's choice and falls Prone. One creature within range must make a {{font-variant:small-caps **Constitution Saving** }} {{font-variant:small-caps **Throw:**}} DC 20. {{font-variant:small-caps **Failure:**}} The creature Levitates 5 feet into the air and is Restrained until the end of Strahd's next turn.

reactions.name: Screeching Flurry
reactions.description: Trigger: Strahd takes any damage. Response: Strahd shape-shifts briefly into a cloud of bats and flies up to 20 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then returns to his usual form.

reactions.name: Bloodfire Ignition (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 30 feet takes any Piercing or Slashing damage, or starts its turn with the Bleeding condition. Response: The creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. Then, if the creature is Bloodied, it begins Burning (1d10).

reactions.name: Fog Burst (1/Day, Concentration)
reactions.description:
Trigger: Strahd becomes Bloodied. Response: A tide of fog bursts violently from him in a 20-foot Emanation, with the following effects. Each other creature in the area is pushed up to 10 feet away. Strahd can immediately attempt to Hide, then moves up to half his Speed. For 1 minute, creatures other than Strahd treat the area as Heavily Obscured.


}}

name: Strahd, the Conqueror
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +12, Con +4, Int +5, Wis +9, Cha +12
languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Giant, Infernal

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.description: While in Sunlight, Strahd has Disadvantage on attack rolls, and takes 20 Radiant damage at the start of his turn.

traits.name: Vampiric Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Strahd fails a saving throw while not in Sunlight, he can choose to succeed instead. Uses of this ability are shared between his phases. At the start of each of Strahd's turns, he regains 10 Hit Points for each remaining use of this ability if he hasn't taken any Radiant damage since the end of his last turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Strahd makes two attacks, each of which he can replace with a use of his Grind Underfoot.

actions.name: Profaner's Blade
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Clawed Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 20).

actions.name: Grind Underfoot
actions.description: One Prone creature in Strahd's space takes 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage, then must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The target is Dazed until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Crush Throat (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature Grappled by Strahd must make a Strength or Constitution Saving Throw (Target's Choice): DC 20. Failure: 55 (10d10) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points in this way begins Suffocating. Whenever the creature would regain any Hit Points, it can choose to instead end the condition.

bonusActions.name: Bleak Snare (Level 2 Spell)
bonusActions.description: One creature Strahd can see within 60 feet has its shadow drawn into deeper darkness, forcing the target to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The target is dragged up to 20 feet. If it ends this movement in Dim Light or Darkness, the target is Restrained in place (escape DC 20) until illuminated by Bright Light.

bonusActions.name: Thunderous Rejection
bonusActions.description: Strahd strikes the ground, sending a shockwave out in a 15-foot Emanation. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 9 (2d8) Thunder damage and the creature is pushed up to 20 feet away. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Catch Blade
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature makes a melee attack against Strahd. Response: Strahd increases his AC against that attack by 5. If the attack misses, Strahd can immediately make a melee attack against the attacker.

reactions.name: Screeching Flurry
reactions.description: Trigger: Strahd takes any damage. Response: Strahd shape-shifts briefly into a cloud of bats and flies up to 20 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then returns to his usual form.

legendaryActions.name: Blade Dash
legendaryActions.description: Strahd moves up to his Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can make an attack with his Profaner's Blade.

legendaryActions.name: Snarling Shadows
legendaryActions.description: Slavering jaws snap forth from the shadows, forcing one creature Strahd can see within 60 feet to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 14 (4d6) Piercing damage and the target falls Prone.

name: Strahd, the Blood-Cursed
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +12, Con +4, Int +5, Wis +9, Cha +12
languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Giant, Infernal

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.description: While in Sunlight, Strahd has Disadvantage on attack rolls, and takes 20 Radiant damage at the start of his turn.

traits.name: Vampiric Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Strahd fails a saving throw while not in Sunlight, he can choose to succeed instead. Uses of this ability are shared between his phases. At the start of each of Strahd's turns, he regains 10 Hit Points for each remaining use of this ability if he hasn't taken any Radiant damage since the end of his last turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Strahd makes three attacks with his Clawed Grasp, one of which he can replace with a use of his Blood Drain.

actions.name: Clawed Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 20).

actions.name: Blood Drain
actions.description: One Grappled, Restrained, Incapacitated, or willing creature within 5 feet takes 10 Piercing damage, then must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage and the target loses three unexpended Hit Dice, or drops to 0 Hit Points if it can't. If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points with this ability, Strahd regains a use of his Vampiric Resistance.

bonusActions.name: Crimson Charm (Concentration)
bonusActions.description: One creature within 30 feet that can see Strahd must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The creature is Charmed by Strahd and his allies for 24 hours. Failure by 5 or More: The creature is Dominated by Strahd for as long as it remains Charmed and retains no memory of the time it spent Charmed. The creature repeats this save whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success. After one minute, Strahd can maintain this effect without requiring Concentration.

bonusActions.name: Specter of Death
bonusActions.description: A dread shadow falls over a creature within 60 feet, forcing it to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The target is Frightened and Dazed until the end of its next turn, or until it is illuminated by Sunlight.

reactions.name: Hurl Husk
reactions.description: Trigger: Strahd reduces a creature Grappled by him to 0 Hit Points. Response: Strahd throws the creature up to 30 feet and it fails a Death Save.

reactions.name: Screeching Flurry
reactions.description: Trigger: Strahd takes any damage. Response: Strahd shape-shifts briefly into a cloud of bats and flies up to 20 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then returns to his usual form.

legendaryActions.name: Ravenous Rush
legendaryActions.description: Strahd moves up to his Speed, then can force a creature within 5 feet to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The creature falls Prone and Strahd can immediately make a Clawed Grasp attack against it.

legendaryActions.name: Feed
legendaryActions.description: Strahd uses his Blood Drain. Then, if the target fails its saving throw, Strahd gains 10 Temporary Hit Points for each remaining use of his Vampiric Resistance.

legendaryActions.name: Seal Compact (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Strahd loses one use of his Vampiric Resistance, then one Humanoid corpse within 5 feet that was killed by Strahd in the last hour rises as a Vampire Spawn Starveling under his control.

name: Vlaakith CLVII
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +12, Int +13, Wis +9, Cha +10
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Turned; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned

traits.name: Sealed Soul
traits.description: If Vlaakith's phylactery is intact, when destroyed she gains a new body in 1d10 days, reappearing within 5 feet of her phylactery with full Hit Points.

traits.name: Vengeful Purge
traits.description: At the start of each of Vlaakith's turns, she can end one spell or condition affecting her. If she does, her attacks this turn have Advantage if they target the creature that imposed that effect, and Disadvantage otherwise.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Vlaakith makes two attacks, one of which she can replace with a use of her Voidflare.

actions.name: Farsilver Relicblade
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 25 (3d10 + 4) force damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage. *Critical Hit:* If the target is affected by the Astral Projection spell, Vlaakith can sever its silver cord.

actions.name: Starfire Lance (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +13 range 150 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage plus Hit: 27 (6d8) radiant damage. This attack ignores all cover from any nonmagical, nonliving material, disintegrating through it without resistance and leaving a 2-inch wide hole in its wake.

actions.name: Voidflare (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: A flash of raw voidstuff emerges in 15-foot Emanation within 60 feet. Each creature in the area is dragged to the unoccupied space closest to the area's center, then must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: 16 (3d10) Force damage plus 16 (3d10) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Necropulse Salvo (Recharge 5-6, Level 9 Spell)
actions.description: The veil is rent and three torrents of negative energy spill forth in 20-foot Cones emerging from points within 120 feet. For each such area a creature is in, it must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: 35 (10d6) Necrotic damage and the target falls Prone. Success: Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Transfer Hardship (Concentration)
bonusActions.description: Vlaakith forges a psychic bond to an ally within 30 feet; whenever she would take damage, she instead takes half as much damage and the ally takes the same amount.

bonusActions.name: Warp Space (Concentration)
bonusActions.description: Ranged attacks against Vlaakith have Disadvantage, and the area in a 10-foot Emanation around her is Difficult Terrain for creatures of her choice.

bonusActions.name: Shadow in the Weave (Concentration)
bonusActions.description: When a creature within 30 feet of Vlaakith casts a spell, she can deal 16 (3d10) Psychic damage to it, then this effect ends.

reactions.name: Rancorburst (Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: Trigger: Vlaakith's loses Concentration due to taking damage. Response: Each creature within 15 feet of her must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: The creature is pushed up to 15 feet away and is Dazed until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Banishing Lash (Level 6 Spell, Concentration)
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 60 feet fails a saving throw against a spell by 10 or more. Response: The creature takes 22 (4d10) Force damage and is Banished to the depths of the astral void until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Twist Spell (Level 6 Spell)
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature Vlaakith can see within 60 feet begins to cast a spell. Response: The creature must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: The spell's caster takes 3 (1d6) Psychic damage per level of the spell, and Vlaakith can choose new targets for the spell.

legendaryActions.name: Refocus Wrath
legendaryActions.description: Vlaakith uses her Share Pain, Warp Space, or Shadow in the Weave.

legendaryActions.name: Devour the Faithful
legendaryActions.description: One willing gith ally of Vlaakith's within 60 feet dies, then Vlaakith gains 40 Temporary Hit Points. While she has any of these Temporary Hit Points, Vlaakith has Advantage on all Saving Throws.

legendaryActions.name: Astral Vortex
legendaryActions.description: Vlaakith teleports up to four creatures within 60 feet to unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of her. An unwilling target can make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 21. Success: The target resists this effect.

legendaryActions.name: Scything Advance (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Vlaakith moves up to her Speed, then can make two attacks with her Farsilver Relicblade.

name: Black Pudding Grimer
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -3, Con +3, Int -5, Wis -2, Cha -5
immunities: Acid, Cold; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Oozing Mass
traits.description: The pudding can climb difficult surfaces, can move through 1-inch wide spaces without squeezing, and can occupy another creature's space and vice-versa.

traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.description: Any Nonmagical weapon that hits the pudding with an attack takes a cumulative -1 penalty to attack rolls after dealing damage, which lasts until the weapon is repaired.

actions.name: Steelrot Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) acid damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). If a target hit with this attack is wearing Nonmagical armor, that armor takes a cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers, which lasts until the armor is repaired.

actions.name: Predigest (Large Size Only)
actions.description: The pudding spews acid at a creature within 20 feet, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 22 (5d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage does not reset failed Death Saving Throws for one minute.

reactions.name: Mitotic Split
reactions.description: Trigger: The pudding becomes Bloodied, or takes any Lightning or Slashing damage. Response: The pudding begins to divide. At the start of its next turn, if the pudding has at least 10 Hit Points it splits into two new Black Pudding Grimers, each of which is size Medium, has half the original's Hit Points, and acts on the original's Initiative.

name: Black Pudding Bogmaw
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex -3, Con +4, Int -5, Wis -2, Cha -5
immunities: Acid, Cold; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Oozing Mass
traits.description: The pudding can climb difficult surfaces, can move through 1-inch wide spaces without squeezing, and can occupy another creature's space and vice-versa.

traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.description: Any Nonmagical weapon that hits the pudding with an attack takes a cumulative -1 penalty to attack rolls after dealing damage, which lasts until the weapon is repaired.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pudding makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Predigest or Engulf.

actions.name: Steelrot Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 15 ft. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) acid damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 17). If a target hit with this attack is wearing Nonmagical armor, that armor takes a cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers, which lasts until the armor is repaired.

actions.name: Predigest
actions.description: The pudding spews acid at a creature within 20 feet, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 27 (6d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage does not reset failed Death Saving Throws for one minute.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: One creature Grappled by the pudding must make Strength Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The creature is Swallowed (escape DC 17). While Swallowed, the creature is Restrained and takes 14 (4d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

reactions.name: Budding Split
reactions.description: Trigger: The pudding becomes Bloodied, or takes any Lightning or Slashing damage. Response: The pudding begins to divide. At the start of its next turn, if the pudding has at least 50 Hit Points it loses 25 Hit Points and creates a Black Pudding Grimer that acts on its Initiative in the nearest unoccupied space.

name: Black Pudding Malaphage
savingThrows: Str +11, Dex +2, Con +11, Wis -2, Cha +8
immunities: Acid, Cold; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Oozing Mass
