traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.description: Any weapon that hits the pudding with an attack takes a cumulative -1 penalty to attack rolls after dealing damage. This penalty lasts 1 minute for magical weapons, or until repaired for Nonmagical weapons.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the pudding fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pudding makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Predigest or Engulf.

actions.name: Steelrot Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 15 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) acid damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 19). If a target hit with this attack is wearing armor, that armor takes a cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. This penalty lasts 1 minute for magical armor, or until the armor is repaired for Nonmagical armor.

actions.name: Sludge Snare
actions.description: Attack: +11 range 30/60 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) acid damage and the target's Speed is reduced by half until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Predigest
actions.description: The pudding spews acid at a creature within 20 feet, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: 27 (6d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage does not reset failed Death Saving Throws for one minute.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: One creature Grappled by the pudding must make Strength Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: The creature is Swallowed (escape DC 19). While Swallowed, the creature is Restrained and takes 14 (4d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

reactions.name: Budding Split
reactions.description: Trigger: The pudding becomes Bloodied, or takes any Lightning or Slashing damage. Response: The pudding begins to divide. At the start of its next turn, if the pudding has at least 50 Hit Points it loses 25 Hit Points and creates a Black Pudding Grimer that acts on its Initiative in the nearest unoccupied space.

legendaryActions.name: Lurch
legendaryActions.description: The pudding moves up to 10 feet, then can make an attack with its Steelrot Pseudopod.

legendaryActions.name: Gurgling Churn
legendaryActions.description: Each creature Swallowed by the pudding takes 14 (4d6) Acid damage.

legendaryActions.name: Calcify Plaque
legendaryActions.description: The pudding solidifies an armored exterior; until the start of its next turn, or until a Critical Hit is scored against the pudding, its AC becomes 20.

name: Bloodrot Ooze
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -2, Con +4, Int -5, Wis +1, Cha -5
immunities: Acid, Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Coagulate
traits.description: If the ooze takes any Cold damage, is affected by healing magic, or gains any Temporary Hit Points it coagulates until the end of its next turn. While coagulated, the ooze may not use its amorphous trait, has its movement speed reduced by 10, and it deals an additional 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage with its melee attacks.

traits.name: Blood Siphon
traits.description: Whenever a creature grappled by one or more bloodrot oozes takes any Necrotic damage, one bloodrot ooze grappling it gains an equal number of Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ooze makes two attacks with its blood tendril.

actions.name: Blood Tendril
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 4 (1d8) acid damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Exsanguinate (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature grappled by the ooze must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage as its blood wells up from its pores and orifices, or half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.description: When the ooze starts its turn with at least 15 Temporary Hit Points, it loses all Temporary Hit Points and spawns a new Bloodrot Ooze in the nearest unoccupied space with Hit Points equal to the Temporary Hit Points lost.

name: Blood Amniote
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +4, Int -5, Wis +2, Cha -5
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The amniote can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Coagulate
traits.description: If the amniote takes any Cold damage, is affected by healing magic, or gains any Temporary Hit Points it coagulates until the end of its next turn. While coagulated, the amniote may not use its amorphous trait, has its movement speed reduced by 10, and it deals an additional 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage with its melee attacks.

traits.name: Blood Siphon
traits.description: Whenever one or more creatures grappled by the amniote take any Necrotic damage, the amniote gains an equal number of Temporary Hit Points. If it gains Temporary Hit Points while it already has Temporary Hit Points, the amniote adds them together, to a maximum of 30.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The amniote makes four attacks with its rupturing tendrils.

actions.name: Rupturing Tendrils
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 15 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is dragged up to 10 ft. toward the amniote and grappled (escape DC 15). A creature grappled by the amniote takes Hit: 5 (1d10) necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns.

actions.name: Blood Call (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Up to two creatures grappled by the ooze must each succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage as its blood wells up from its pores and orifices, or half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.description: When the amniote starts its turn with at least 20 Temporary Hit Points, it loses all Temporary Hit Points and spawns a new Blood Amniote in the nearest unoccupied space with Hit Points equal to the Temporary Hit Points lost.

reactions.name: Engulf
reactions.description: When a Medium or smaller creature the amniote has grappled falls Unconscious, the amniote pulls the creature into its space. While in the amniote's space, a creature cannot stabilize.

name: Necrichor
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Con +6, Int +6, Wis +4
resistances: Acid, Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing
immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description:
The necrichor can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an
ability check.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: Unless its lifeless remains are splashed with holy water or interred in a location under the effects of the hallow spell, the destroyed necrichor re-forms in 1d1O days, regaining all its hits points and appearing in an unoccupied space adjacent to any living creature that has been affected by its blood puppeteering ability.

traits.name: Coagulate
traits.description: If the necrichor takes any Cold damage, is affected by healing magic, or gains any Temporary Hit Points it coagulates until the end of its next turn. While coagulated, the necrichor may not use its spider climb trait, has its movement speed reduced by 10, and it deals an additional 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage with its melee attacks.

traits.name: Blood Siphon
traits.description: Whenever a creature the necrichor is attached to takes any Necrotic damage, the necrichor gains an equal number of Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The necrichor makes two attacks with its ichor tendril, one or both of which it may replace with a use of its wrench blood.

actions.name: Ichor Tendril
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be forced to expend two of its hit dice. A creature that cannot is instead Paralyzed until the start of the necrichor's next turn.

actions.name: Wrench Blood
actions.description: One creature the necrichor can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage and be pulled up to 15 feet toward the necrichor, or take half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Blood Puppeteering (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet that does not have all of its Hit Points must make a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the necrichor enters the target's space and attaches itself to the target. While attached, the necrichor takes only half the damage dealt to it and the target takes the remaining damage. While the necrichor is attached to a creature, the necrichor can't use its multiattack and the creature acts under the necrichor's control. An affected creature repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, expelling the necrichor into an unoccupied adjacent space on a success.

reactions.name: Lose Cohesion
reactions.description: When the necrichor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, any creatures it is Attached to are freed and the necrichor moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

reactions.name: Bloody Retribution
reactions.description: When it succeeds on a saving throw, the necrichor can cause a creature it is Attached to to make a melee attack against itself.

name: Blob of Annihilation
savingThrows: Str +15, Dex +2, Con +16, Wis +3
immunities: Acid, Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Destruction Incarnate
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn Swallowed by the blob or Restrained by its Lob Glob takes 22 (4d10) Force damage. An object or creature destroyed by this damage disintegrates entirely.

traits.name: Astral Implosion
traits.description: If the blob is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it implodes in a shower of slime, scattering each creature and object in its space throughout the Astral Sea. An unwilling creature can make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 23. Success:. The creature is not ejected into the Astral Sea.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the blob fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The blob makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Lob Glob or Annihilation Tide.

actions.name: Titanic Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 30 ft. Hit: 29 (2d20 + 8) Bludgeoning plus Hit: 21 (2d20) force damage. Then, each other creature within 10 feet of the target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The creature takes half the attack's damage and is pushed 5 feet away from the target.

actions.name: Lob Glob
actions.description: One creature the blob can sense within 600 feet must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: 22 (4d10) Force damage and the creature is Restrained (escape DC 23) in a transparent globule of slime.

actions.name: Annihilation Tide
actions.description: The blob moves up to its Speed, and can move through occupied spaces; each creature or object whose space the blob enters in this way is Swallowed (escape DC 23). When the creature is Swallowed and at the end of each of its turns, it can make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 23. Success: The creature escapes into the nearest unoccupied space.

reactions.name: Bulge Rupture
reactions.description: Trigger: The blob is hit with a melee attack while it has any Temporary Hit Points. Response: The blob loses any remaining Temporary Hit Points, then the attacker takes Force damage equal to the Temporary Hit Points lost in this way.

reactions.name: Yawning Embrace
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature misses the blob with a melee attack. Response: The creature is Swallowed by the blob, per its Annihilation Tide. Then, up to one creature Swallowed by the blob can use its Reaction to attempt to escape it.

legendaryActions.name: Lob Glob
legendaryActions.description: The blob uses its Lob Glob.

legendaryActions.name: Reconstitute
legendaryActions.description: Each creature Restrained by the blob's Lob Glob is dragged up to 60 feet toward the blob. A creature dragged within 5 feet of the blob in this way is Swallowed by it.

legendaryActions.name: Entropic Surge
legendaryActions.description: Each creature Swallowed by the blob takes 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage, then the blob gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half the total damage dealt.

name: Bloodbloater Swarm
savingThrows: Dex +1, Con +3, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature or object's space and vice versa. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Bloodsight
traits.description: A creature that has all of its Hit Points may attempt to hide from the swarm without obscurement.

actions.name: Bloating Drain
actions.description: One creature in the swarm's space must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or lose 10 (4d4) Hit Points, or half as much on a success. If the target loses 11 or more Hit Points in this way, it loses an unexpended hit die, and the swarm loses 5 Hit Points as some of the bloodbloaters burst from consuming too much blood.

reactions.name: Amorphous Invasion
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature leaves its space, the swarm forces the creature to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or have the swarm slither into its clothing and armor. Until a creature removes the swarm as an Action with a successful DC 13 Strength check, the swarm moves with the target and has 3/4 cover against all attacks.

name: Bone Ooze
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex -5, Con +7, Int -5, Wis -3, Cha -5
immunities: Acid; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Partially Amorphous
traits.description: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide, though it must squeeze to do so.

traits.name: Rolling Graveyard
traits.description:
If the bone ooze takes at least 15 Necrotic damage from a single source, the ooze and each creature engulfed by it lose 10 (3d6) Hit Points as the skeletons within it briefly reanimate and thrash around.
If the ooze is killed by this damage, 1d8 skeletons reanimate and erupt from the ooze, appearing in the nearest unoccupied space.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ooze makes three pseudopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Engulf.

actions.name: Osteokinetic Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 15 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) acid damage. A target with bones is dragged 10 ft. toward the ooze.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: Up to two creatures creatures within 5 ft. must each succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be dragged into the ooze's space and grappled (escape DC 20). While grappled in this way, a creature is Blinded and takes 18 (4d8) Acid damage at the beginning of each of the ooze's turns.

actions.name: Bone Meld (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature grappled in the ooze must make a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 (10d8) Slashing damage and has its Constitution score reduced by 5 (2d4) until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic as some of its bones are drawn out through its skin, or takes no damage and half as much reduction on a success. A creature killed by this damage has its skeleton torn out and its flesh ejected from the ooze.

name: Gelatinous Cub
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex -4, Con +3, Int -5, Wis -2, Cha -5
immunities: Acid; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Perfect Transparency
traits.description: If the cub has not moved or taken an action in the last minute and has no objects Swallowed, it is Invisible to creatures with a Passive Perception lower than 13.

actions.name: Membranous Extension
actions.description: Attack: +0 reach 5 ft. Hit: The cub presses itself against the target. At the end of the target's next turn, it takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage if it is within 5 feet of the cub.

actions.name: Engulf Object
actions.description: The cub Swallows a Tiny object within 5 feet that is unattended or carried by an Incapacitated creature. A creature can retrieve the Swallowed object as an Action with a successful DC 10 Constitution (Athletics) check, taking 3 (1d6) Acid damage on a success or failure.

reactions.name: Suction Bond
reactions.description: When a creature would leave the cub's reach, the cub can become Attached to the creature (remove DC 10) until the beginning of the cub's next turn.

name: Gelatinous Cube
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -4, Con +7, Int -5, Wis -2, Cha -5
immunities: Acid; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Perfect Transparency
traits.description: If the cube has not moved or taken an action in the last minute and has no creatures Swallowed, it is Invisible to creatures with a Passive Perception lower than 15. A Medium or smaller creature that attempts to enter the cube's space is Swallowed by it.

traits.name: Gushing Collapse
traits.description: When the cube is reduced to 0 Hit Points, its membrane ruptures, spilling forth a torrent of cytoplasm. Each creature within 5 feet of the cube takes 3 (1d6) Acid damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Glistening Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. This attack has Advantage against a target with a Passive Perception lower than 15.

actions.name: Quivering Lurch (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The cube lunges up to 15 feet, and can enter the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each creature whose space the cube enters in this way must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or be Swallowed (escape DC 12), or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success. A creature Swallowed by the cube takes 14 (4d6) Acid damage at the beginning of each of the cube's turns.

reactions.name: Wobbly Dispersion
reactions.description: When the cube is hit with an attack by a creature not Swallowed by it, it can make a Constitution Saving Throw with DC equal to the attack's damage, reducing the attack's damage to 1 on a success.

reactions.name: Vacuole Encasement
reactions.description: When a creature fails an attempt to free a creature Swallowed by the cube by 5 or more, the cube can Swallow it.

name: Crusher Cube
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -4, Con +5, Int -5, Wis -2, Cha -5
immunities: Acid; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Perfect Transparency
traits.description: If the cube has not moved or taken an action in the last minute and has no creatures Swallowed, it is Invisible to creatures with a Passive Perception lower than 16. A Medium or smaller creature that attempts to enter the cube's space is Swallowed by it.

traits.name: Rolling Cube
traits.description: The cube moves only by rolling in 10-foot increments in cardinal directions, and can enter the space of any Medium or smaller creature. A creature whose space the cube enters takes 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage, then is pushed 10 feet away if possible, or knocked prone and restrained (escape DC 14) until the cube moves if it can't be.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cube makes two attacks with its Spined Axopod, one of which it can replace with a use of its Split Valves.

actions.name: Spined Axopod
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage. This attack has Advantage against a target with a Passive Perception lower than 16.

actions.name: Split Valves
actions.description: The cube's armor splits as it attempts to absorb a creature restrained beneath it. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be Swallowed (escape DC 14). On a successful saving throw, the creature can make an Opportunity Attack against the cube. A creature Swallowed by the cube takes 14 (4d6) Acid damage at the beginning of each of the cube's turns.

reactions.name: Crushing Clunk
reactions.description: When the cube takes 10 or more damage from an attack, it can move exactly 10 feet directly away from the attacker, if possible.

name: Corruptive Cube
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -4, Con +6, Int -5, Wis -1, Cha -3
immunities: Acid; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Gushing Collapse
traits.description: When the cube is reduced to 0 Hit Points, its membrane ruptures, spilling forth a torrent of cytoplasm. Each creature within 15 feet of the cube takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage and is pushed up to 20 feet away.

traits.name: Rippling Reserves
traits.description: If the cube has fewer than 107 Hit Points, it can take two Bonus Actions on each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cube makes two attacks with its Snaking Pseudopod, one of which it can replace with a use of its Waste Jet.

actions.name: Snaking Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 30 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pulled up to 5 feet toward the cube. Then, if the creature is Large or smaller and within 5 feet of the cube it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or be Swallowed (escape DC 17). A creature Swallowed by the cube takes 21 (6d6) Acid damage at the beginning of each of the cube's turns.

actions.name: Waste Jet
actions.description: A jet of indigestible detritus spurt from the cube in a 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) Acid damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Neurophage Intrusion (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature Swallowed by the cube must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Acid damage and be infected with Jelly-Brains.

bonusActions.name: Cyst Armor
bonusActions.description: The cube hardens its exterior membrane, gaining 20 Temporary Hit Points. While the cube has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it gains the following effects: Creatures not Swallowed by the cube treat its AC as 21. The cube cannot Swallow creatures, move, or use Reactions. The escape DC for creatures Swallowed by the cube increases to 21.

bonusActions.name: Cytoplasm Bulge
bonusActions.description: The cube targets a 30-foot cone extending from itself, concentrating its mass on that side, and ends its turn. At the start of its next turn, the cube can make a Snaking Pseudopod attack against each creature in the cone.

reactions.name: Wobbly Dispersion
reactions.description: When the cube is hit with an attack by a creature not Swallowed by it, it can make a Constitution Saving Throw with DC equal to the attack's damage, reducing the attack's damage to 1 on a success.

reactions.name: Vacuole Encasement
reactions.description: When a creature fails an attempt to free a creature Swallowed by the cube by 5 or more, the cube can Swallow it.

name: Gray Ooze Crevasse-Crawler
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex -2, Con +3, Int -5, Wis -2, Cha -4
immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Shape Memory
traits.description: If the ooze takes any Lightning damage, it is Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Shifting Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) acid damage plus one effect of the ooze's choice: Soften Armor. One piece of nonmagical metal armor the target is wearing softens and sags, offering no AC bonus until the end of the ooze's next turn. Soften Weapon. One nonmagical metal weapon the target is wielding becomes springy and pliable, counting as an Improvised weapon until the end of the ooze's next turn.

actions.name: Chaos Meld
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet that is wearing or wielding an item affected by the ooze's Shifting Pseudopod must make a DC 11 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, the item liquefies and the ooze absorbs it, gaining 5 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the ooze's AC is increased to 16.

actions.name: Cryptic Mimicry
actions.description: The ooze mimics the texture of nearby surfaces, becoming indistinguishable from them until it moves or is illuminated by a source of Bright Light within 10 feet of it.

name: Gray Ooze Quagmire
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -2, Con +4, Int -5, Wis -2, Cha -4
immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Shape Memory
traits.description: If the ooze takes any Lightning damage, it is Paralyzed until the start of its next turn and each creature Swallowed by it is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: False Floor
traits.description: When a creature steps onto the ooze or fails an attempt to free a creature grappled by the ooze, the ooze can grapple it (escape DC 14). A creature that fails an attempt to escape this grapple has Disadvantage on its next attempt to escape.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ooze makes two attacks with its Shifting Pseudopod.

actions.name: Shifting Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) acid damage plus Hit: 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage and the target suffers one effect of the ooze's choice: Soften Armor. One piece of nonmagical metal armor the target is wearing softens and sags, offering no AC bonus until the end of the ooze's next turn. Soften Weapon. One nonmagical metal weapon the target is wielding becomes springy and pliable, counting as an Improvised Weapon until the end of the ooze's next turn.

actions.name: Chaos Meld
actions.description: Each creature within 10 feet of the ooze that is wearing or wielding an item affected by the ooze's Shifting Pseudopod must make a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, the item liquefies and the ooze absorbs it, gaining 5 Temporary Hit Points per item absorbed. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the ooze's AC is increased to 16.

actions.name: Cryptic Mimicry
actions.description: The ooze mimics the texture and hue of nearby surfaces, becoming indistinguishable from them until it moves or is illuminated by a source of Bright Light within 10 feet of it.

reactions.name: Inexorable Draw
reactions.description: When a creature grappled by the ooze takes an action, the ooze can draw it deeper in, restraining it for as long as it remains grappled. If the creature was already restrained, it is instead Swallowed by the ooze and begins Choking for as long as it remains grappled.

reactions.name: Vengeful Conduit
reactions.description: When the quagmire takes any Lightning damage, before being Paralyzed by its Shape Memory trait it can deal an equal amount of Lightning damage to each creature grappled by it.

name: Hungry Fog
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex -3, Con +4, Int -5, Wis +1, Cha -5
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Enveloping Fog
traits.description: The fog can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any space that air can pass through without squeezing. A living creature that starts its turn in the fog must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or suffer Disadvantage on attack rolls and have its movement speed halved until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Wind Vulnerability
traits.description: If exposed to strong winds, the fog must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be dispersed and disappear reappearing in a space within 15 feet feet of where it was dispersed at the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Numbing Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +1 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 (1d6 + -2) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Necrotic Pulse
actions.description: Each creature within 10 ft. of the fog must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Fill Lungs
actions.description: One creature in the fog's space must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw be unable to speak or breathe for the next minute. The creature may end this effect as an action with a successful DC 15 Constitution (Medicine) check to cough the fog out, or another creature may remove the fog with a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

actions.name: Swirling Visages (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature that can see the fog must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed by the fog until the end of the fog's next turn. While Charmed in this way, a creature must use all of its movement to approach the fog by the most direct route.

reactions.name: Dweomer Feast
reactions.description: When a creature within 5 feet of it casts a spell of 1st level or above, the fog can force the spell caster to succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or lose its highest level unexpended spell slot. If the target loses a spell slot of 5th level or higher in this way, the fog may immediately use its Necrotic Pulse.

name: Drink Mimic
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +1, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a container of liquid or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: False Appearance (Drink Form Only)
traits.description: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary container of liquid. If it is disguised as a potion, a simple taste test indicates that it is the potion it is pretending to be, though an Identify spell reveals its true nature.

traits.name: Foe Climber
traits.description: The mimic may spend half its movement to attempt a contested Strength (Athletics) check against a Medium or larger creature within 5 feet. On a success, the mimic climbs onto the creature. While climbing on a creature, the mimic has Advantage on attack rolls against it, and the creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against the mimic.

actions.name: Acrid Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus Hit: 4 (1d8) acid damage.

actions.name: Invade Mouth
actions.description: The mimic attempts to force its way into the mouth of a Medium creature it is climbing on. The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or drink the mimic.

reactions.name: Throat Lodge
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature drinking it, the drink mimic leaps into the creatures throat and lodges there. Until the mimic is removed, the creature cannot speak or breathe and takes 4 (1d8) acid damge at the start of each of its turns, and the mimic has total cover from outside effects. As an action, an affected creature may attempt a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw, expelling the mimic into the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

name: Object Mimic
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Medium object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
traits.description: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

actions.name: Ravening Maw
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 4 (1d8) acid damage. This attack is made at Advantage against a creature grappled by the mimic.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Sudden Lunge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The mimic jumps up to 20 feet and may land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature. A creature whose space the mimic lands in must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone and grappled (escape DC 13). A creature grappled in this way is Blinded, can't speak or breathe, and takes 9 (2d8) acid damge at the start of each of its turns.

reactions.name: Adhesive Secretion
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature touches the mimic or hits it with an unarmed attack, the mimic grapples the creature (escape DC 13).

reactions.name: Blinding Spray
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 46 Hit Points, the mimic launches a spray of blinding acid. Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 4 (1d8) Acid damage and be Blinded until the end of the mimic's next turn.

name: Blade Mimic
savingThrows: Dex +4, Con +2, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Small bladed weapon or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: False Appearance (Weapon Form Only)
traits.description: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary weapon. Attacks made with the mimic deal an additional 3 (1d6) Acid damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mimic makes two attacks with its Corrosive Slash, one of which it may replace with a use of its Gnaw Palm or Tumbling Advance.

actions.name: Gnaw Palm
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 0 ft., one target that is holding the mimic. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Corrosive Slash
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Tumbling Advance
actions.description: The mimic moves up to its speed, tumbling end-over-end. Until the start of its next turn, melee attacks are made at Disadvantage against it, and a creature that misses the mimic with a melee attack takes 4 (1d8) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Adhesive Grip
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature holding the mimic attempts to drop it, the mimic adheres to it. As an action, the creature may attempt a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check, dropping the mimic on a success.

reactions.name: Wobbling Riposte
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature misses with a melee attack that uses the mimic as a weapon, the mimic makes a Corrosive Slash attack against it.

name: Creature Mimic
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Small creature or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: False Appearance (Creature Form Only)
traits.description: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary creature.

actions.name: Outsize Maw
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 4 (1d8) acid damage and the mimic attaches itself to the creature (remove DC 13).

actions.name: Puppy Eyes (Creature Form Only)
actions.description: The mimic gazes endearingly at a humanoid creature within 30 feet that can see it. The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its action to pet the mimic on its following turn. A creature that knows the mimic's true nature makes this save at Advantage.

actions.name: Invade Space (Amorphous Form Only)
actions.description: One humanoid creature the mimic is attached to must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or have the mimic enter its clothing or armor. While the mimic is in the creature's attire, it has three quarters cover against outside effects, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws, and an attack that misses the mimic makes a new attack roll, targeting the creature. At the end of each of its turns, the affected creature makes a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw, dislodging the mimic in the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reactions.name: Secret Mouth
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature misses the mimic with a melee attack or attempts to touch it, the mimic makes a Outsize Maw attack against it.

name: Furnishing Mimic
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Large object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
traits.description: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mimic makes two Psuedopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Ravening Maw or its Engulf ability.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Ravening Maw
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) acid damage. This attack is made at Advantage against a creature grappled by the mimic.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: One Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be engulfed in the mimic's space. A grappled creature makes this save at Disadvantage. While engulfed, a creature is Blinded and takes 18 (4d8) Acid damage at the start of each of the mimic's turns.

reactions.name: Adhesive Secretion
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature touches the mimic or hits it with an unarmed attack, the mimic grapples the creature (escape DC 15).

reactions.name: Blinding Spray
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 68 Hit Points, the mimic launches a spray of blinding acid. Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Acid damage and be Blinded until the end of the mimic's next turn.

name: Dragon Mimic
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Large dragon or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Gas Bladders
traits.description: Whenever the mimic takes any Piercing damage, its fly speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. If its fly speed is reduced to 0 in this way, the mimic becomes size Medium and makes one fewer attack with its Multiattack until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: False Appearance (Dragon Form Only)
traits.description: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary dragon.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mimic makes three Clawed Pseudopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Outsize Maw or Gurgling Roar.

actions.name: Outsize Maw
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) acid damage. This attack is made at Advantage against a grappled creature.

actions.name: Clawed Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Gurgling Roar
actions.description: Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the mimic must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn. A creature that knows the mimics true nature has Advantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Acid Glob (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The mimic spits forth a piece of itself at a point it can see within 30 feet. The mimic loses 10 Hit Points, and each creature within 5 feet of that point must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 36 (8d8) Acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Secret Mouth
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature misses the mimic with a melee attack or attempts to touch it, the mimic makes a Outsize Maw attack against it.

name: Ship Mimic
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex -1, Con +8, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Huge vehicle or structure or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: False Appearance (Vehicle or Structure Form Only)
traits.description: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary vehicle or structure.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.description: The mimic has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

traits.name: Explorable
traits.description: The mimic may allow other creatures to enter or exit its space without hinderance. It may suspend this property as a Bonus action. If the mimic takes 30 or more damge in a turn, each creature trapped inside it may use its reaction to attempt a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw, escaping into an unoccupied adjacent space on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mimic makes three Psuedopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Engulfing Maw. It makes one fewer attack for each mimic under its control.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the mimic may grapple the target (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Engulfing Maw
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft., one target not in the mimic's space. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) acid damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled into the mimic's space.

actions.name: Digest (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in the mimic's space must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Acid damage, or half as much on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Treasure Lure
legendaryActions.description: The mimic offers a glimpse of fantastic treasure deep within it. One nonhostile creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed for the next minute. While Charmed, a creature uses its turn to try to try to enter the mimic's space and convince others to do the same. This effect ends early if the creature takes any damage.

legendaryActions.name: Blinding Spray
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 20 feet of the mimic must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of the mimic's next turn. While the mimic is submerged, this ability can only target creatures in the mimic's space.

legendaryActions.name: Absorb Vestige
legendaryActions.description: The mimic absorbs a friendly ooze in its space, destroying it and gaining 30 Temporary Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Spawn Mimic (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Part of the mimic splits off, becoming an Object Mimic under the ship mimic's control for the next hour, after which it withers and dies. The ship mimic loses 30 Hit Points.

name: House Hunter Mimic
savingThrows: Str +12, Dex +5, Con +12, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha -1
immunities: Acid; Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, Prone, Stunned

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Gargantuan vehicle or structure or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: False Appearance (Vehicle or Structure Form Only)
traits.description: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary vehicle or structure.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.description: The mimic has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

traits.name: Explorable
traits.description: The mimic may allow other creatures to enter or exit its space without hinderance. It may suspend this property as a bonus action. If the mimic takes 30 or more damge in a turn, each creature trapped inside it may use its reaction to attempt a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw, escaping into an unoccupied adjacent space on a success.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the mimic fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mimic makes five Psuedopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Ravening Maw. It makes one fewer attack for each mimic under its control.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 15 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the mimic may grapple the target (escape DC 19).

actions.name: Ravening Maw
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft., one target not in the mimic's space. Hit: 18 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 13 (3d8) acid damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled into the mimic's space.

actions.name: Digest (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in the mimic's space must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or take 45 (10d8) Acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Bloodied Roil (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 174 Hit Points, the mimic writhes and shakes. Each creature in the mimic's space must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone and be grappled (escape DC 19) in place.

legendaryActions.name: Blinding Spray
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 20 ft. of the mimic must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of the mimic's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Slam Door
legendaryActions.description: The mimic raises a barrier between two interior portions of its body, seperating creatures on either side of it from each other. The barrier is an object and can be destroyed (AC 17; 20 HP; Immunity to Acid damge)

legendaryActions.name: Absorb Vestige
legendaryActions.description: The mimic absorbs a friendly ooze in its space, gaining 30 Temporary Hit Points. The ooze is destroyed.

legendaryActions.name: Spawn Mimic (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Part of the mimic splits off, becoming an Object Mimic under the house hunter mimic's control for the next hour, after which it withers and dies. The house hunter mimic loses 30 Hit Points.

name: Oblex Outgrowth
savingThrows: Dex +5, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +2

traits.name: Oozing Mass
traits.description: The oblex can climb difficult surfaces, can move through 1-inch wide spaces without squeezing, and can occupy another creature's space and vice-versa.

traits.name: Fire Aversion
traits.description: Whenever the oblex takes any Fire damage, it gains Disadvantage on the first d20 Test it makes before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Skitterspine
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 2 (1d4) psychic damage.

actions.name: Infest Host
actions.description: The oblex begins to fuse with the intact corpse of a Small or Medium creature within 5 feet; after 1 minute, the oblex becomes an Oblex Neophyte mimicking the creature's appearance.

name: Oblex Neophyte
savingThrows: Dex +5, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Rapid Metamorphosis
traits.description: If the oblex completes a Long Rest, it transforms into an Oblex Intruder.

traits.name: Fire Aversion
traits.description: Whenever the oblex takes any Fire damage, it gains Disadvantage on the first d20 Test it makes before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Tendril Lash
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Acid Gout
actions.description: The oblex spews digestive fluids in a 15-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 9 (2d8) Acid Damage. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Secret Mouth
reactions.description: Trigger: The oblex is missed with a melee attack. Response: The oblex deals 5 (1d10) Piercing damage to the attacker.

name: Oblex Intruder
savingThrows: Dex +7, Con +3, Int +4, Wis +4, Cha +2

traits.name: Mimicked Skin
traits.description: The oblex perfectly resembles the creature it was created in mimicry of, and shares that creature's memories.

traits.name: Fire Aversion
traits.description: Whenever the oblex takes any Fire damage, it gains Disadvantage on the first d20 Test it makes before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oblex makes three attacks, or makes one attack and uses its Devour Mind.

actions.name: Morphbud Strike
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage.

actions.name: Scavenged Spell
actions.description: The oblex casts a spell of Level 3 or below known by the creature it was created in mimicry of (+4, DC 12); once it does so, it can't cast that spell again in this way.

actions.name: Devour Mind
actions.description: The oblex drains the memories of a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make an Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 16 (3d10) Psychic damage and the creature is Cursed for 1 hour. While Cursed, the creature's Proficiency Bonus is reduced by 1. The oblex gains a +1 bonus to any d20 Test it makes for each such Cursed creature within 30 feet of it.

reactions.name: Secret Mouth
reactions.description: Trigger: The oblex is missed with a melee attack. Response: The oblex deals 5 (1d10) Piercing damage to the attacker.

reactions.name: Abandon Host
reactions.description: Trigger: The oblex takes any non-Fire damage. Response: The oblex dies and a piece of it tears free, becoming an Oblex Outgrowth, which can immediately move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: Oblex Synapsoid
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +5, Int +10, Wis +4, Cha +8

traits.name: Oozing Mass
traits.description: The oblex can climb difficult surfaces, can move through 1-inch wide spaces without squeezing, and can occupy another creature's space and vice-versa.

traits.name: Fire Aversion
traits.description: Whenever the oblex takes any Fire damage, it gains Disadvantage on the first d20 Test it makes before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Malevolent Locus
traits.description: Other oblexes within 60 feet of the oblex share its Initiative and use its Save DC (18) in place of their own.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oblex makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Devour Mind, Feedback Screech, or Eldritch Fixation.

actions.name: Synaptic Tendril
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 15 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) psychic damage. If the target is Charmed, it takes an additional 11 (2d10) Psychic damage and the condition ends for it.

actions.name: Scavenged Spell
actions.description: The oblex casts a spell of Level 5 or below known by a creature affected by its Devour Mind (+10, DC 18). Once it does so, it can't cast that spell again in this way until it completes a Long Rest.

actions.name: Devour Mind
actions.description: The oblex drains the memories of a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make an Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 22 (4d10) Psychic damage and the creature is Cursed for 24 hours. While Cursed, the creature's Proficiency Bonus is reduced by 1. The oblex gains a +1 bonus to any d20 Test it makes for each such Cursed creature within 30 feet of it.

actions.name: Feedback Screech
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet that is Cursed by an oblex's Devour Mind ability must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn, or until it is hit with an attack.

actions.name: Eldritch Fixation (Concentration)
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 16 (3d10) Psychic damage and the creature is Charmed by the oblex (Save Ends at end of turn). While Charmed in this way, a creature must use all of its movement to approach the oblex.

reactions.name: Secret Mouth
reactions.description: Trigger: The oblex is missed with a melee attack. Response: The oblex deals 11 (2d10) Piercing damage to the attacker.

legendaryActions.name: Shrieking Lurch
legendaryActions.description: The oblex moves up to 10 feet, then makes a Synaptic Tendril attack or uses its Devour Mind.

legendaryActions.name: Psychoport Bond (Concentration)
legendaryActions.description: The oblex forges a mental link to a creature within 120 feet. At the start of each of that creature's turns, it must make an Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The oblex teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

legendaryActions.name: Sulphureous Impersonation
legendaryActions.description: The oblex loses 20 Hit Points and births an Oblex Neophyte in an unoccupied space within 5 feet, mimicking a creature affected by its Devour Mind.

name: Ochre Jelly Plurible
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex -2, Con +1, Int -4, Wis -2, Cha -5
immunities: Lightning, Slashing; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Oozing Mass
traits.description: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. It can occupy another creature's space and vice-versa.

traits.name: Spider Climb

actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 30 ft. Hit: 2 Piercing damage.

actions.name: Splinterblast
actions.description: The blight creaks and groans, then bursts, spraying splinters in a 5-foot radius. The blight dies, and each creature in the the area must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 3 Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Chain Burst
reactions.description: When the blight is dealt any damage by a friendly creature or killed by its Slivered Claws, it can use its Splinterblast before falling unconscious.

name: Twig Blight
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +1, Con +1, Int -3, Wis -1, Cha -4

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a dead shrub.

traits.name: Shallow Roots
traits.description: If the blight is forced to move or is knocked prone, it dies.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the blight takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the blight takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Snaptwig Shoots (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 Piercing damage. If three or more blights contributed to this attack, the target is Grappled (escape DC 12). Whenever a creature grappled in this way takes an action, it takes 2 Piercing damage, then can attempt to escape (no action required).

name: Amber Blight
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -3, Wis -1, Cha -4

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a gnarled amber deposit.

traits.name: Shallow Roots
traits.description: If the blight is forced to move or is knocked prone, it dies.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the blight takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the blight takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Resinous Clutches (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 Bludgeoning damage. If three or more blights contributed to this attack, one of them becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 14), and remains Attached even when dead until it is removed or dealt any Fire damage. A creature subtracts 1 from its attack rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws for each blight Attached to it in this way.

actions.name: Trap Blood
actions.description: The blight collects and seals a drop of blood from a creature within 5 feet that doesn't have all of its Hit Points, preserving it.

reactions.name: Amber Cursebond
reactions.description: When a creature the blight can see within 30 feet whose blood it has collected makes a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the blight can become Petrified. If it does, the creature gains Disadvantage on the triggering saving throw.

name: Needle Blight
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +1, Con +1, Int -2, Wis -1, Cha -4

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a spiny stump.

traits.name: Root-Bound
traits.description: The blight has Advantage on saving throws to resist being moved or knocked prone. Whenever it is forced to move or is knocked prone, the blight loses 9 (2d8) Hit Points.

actions.name: Longspine Claws
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Barbed Needles
actions.description: Attack: +3 range 30/60 ft. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) piercing damage and the needles become embedded in the target (remove DC 11). Until the needles are removed, the target's speed is reduced by 5 and it takes 1 Piercing damage whenever it takes an action.

reactions.name: Prickly Retort
reactions.description: When the blight is hit with a melee attack, it can deal 3 Piercing damage to the attacker. If the triggering attack was an unarmed attack or one with a natural weapon, the attacker takes an additional 2 Piercing damage.

name: Vine Blight
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -1, Con +2, Int -3, Cha -4

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a tangle of vines.

traits.name: Root-Bound
traits.description: The blight has Advantage on saving throws to resist being moved or knocked prone. Whenever it is forced to move or is knocked prone, the blight loses 9 (2d8) Hit Points.

actions.name: Constricting Embrace
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the blight enters the target's space and grapples it (escape DC 12). While it has a creature grappled in this way, the blight and the grappled creature are each restrained.

actions.name: Bloodquest Rootlets
actions.description: Threadlike roots grow out from the blight, forcing a creature grappled by it to succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or have the roots enter its wounds. Until the grapple ends or the creature receives any magical healing, at the beginning of each of its turns the creature loses 5 (2d4) Hit Points and the blight regains an equal amount of Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Tanglegrowth (Recharges when the blight regains Hit Points)
bonusActions.description: A burst of growth roils out from the blight, carpeting the area in a 15-foot radius in dense roots and vines. The area is difficult terrain for nonplant creatures, and a creature that enters a space in the area for the first time in a turn must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone.

name: Thicket Blight
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +2, Cha -3

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a tangle of brambles.

traits.name: Root-Bound
traits.description: The blight has Advantage on saving throws to resist being moved or knocked prone. Whenever it is forced to move or is knocked prone, the blight loses 11 (2d10) Hit Points.

traits.name: Bramble-Clad
traits.description: A creature that hits the blight with a melee attack for the first time on a turn takes 3 Piercing damage. Whenever the blight takes 10 or more fire or Slashing damage from a single source, the damage dealt by this trait is reduced by 1 until it completes a long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The blight makes two attacks with its Blooming Dart, one of which it can replace with a use of its Thorny Thrash.

actions.name: Blooming Dart
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 40 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Thorny Thrash
actions.description: The blight shudders and thrashes, forcing each creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Slashing damage and be pushed 5 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Blightpollen Alarm
reactions.description: When a creature the blight can see deals any Fire damage, the blight can release an agitating pollen in a 60-foot radius. Each plant creature in the area gains Advantage on the first attack it makes against that creature in the next minute.

name: Tree Blight
savingThrows: Str +6, Con +5, Int -3, Cha -4

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a dead tree.

traits.name: Root-Bound
traits.description: The blight has Advantage on saving throws to resist being moved or knocked prone. Whenever it is forced to move or is knocked prone, the blight loses 13 (2d12) Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The blight makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Lob Blight.

actions.name: Blood-Blackened Branch
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 15 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. A grappled creature is not pushed and instead takes an additional 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Grasping Roots
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 15 ft. Hit: The target is Grappled (escape DC 15) by the root, which has its own Hit Points and can be destroyed (AC 15, 6 HP). A creature grappled in this way takes 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

actions.name: Lob Blight
actions.description: The blight flings a willing Medium or smaller creature within 10 feet up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space the blight can see. The flung creature takes 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage, does not fall prone, and can immediately use its reaction to make a melee attack.

reactions.name: Toppling Vengeance
reactions.description: When the blight drops to 0 Hit Points, it can fall onto a creature within 15 feet before dying. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone and be restrained under the blight's corpse (escape DC 17), or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

name: Podling Half-Made
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -1, Int -1, Wis -1, Cha -1
languages: Deep Speech, the languages known by the creature it is mimicking.

traits.name: Of One Mind
traits.description: The podling dies and collapses into a slurry if the plant that created it dies or dismisses it (no action required).

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the podling takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the podling takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Thrashing Tackle (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 Bludgeoning damage. If three or more podlings contributed to this attack, instead of dealing they can force the target to succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone.

name: Podling Infiltrator
savingThrows: Str +2, Con +2
languages: Deep Speech, the languages known by the creature it is mimicking.

traits.name: Imperfect Mimicry
traits.description: The podling is a physical copy of a creature digested by a bodytaker plant, and has that creature's memories. Creatures proficient in Insight can detect that any strong emotional responses from the podling are insincere.

traits.name: Of One Mind
traits.description: The podling dies and collapses into a slurry if the plant that created it dies or dismisses it (no action required).

actions.name: Flailing Lunge
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the podling can grapple the target (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Slithering Strands
actions.description: Tendrilous roots snake from the podling to a creature grappled by it, forcing the creature to succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Sleeping Strands.

actions.name: Inhuman Screech
actions.description: The podling points at a creature it can see within 30 feet and lets out an awful scream. Each podling within 500 feet learns the creature's location and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the podling's next turn.

name: Podling Mob
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +2
immunities: Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The mob can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any opening large enough for a medium creature. The mob can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Of One Mind
traits.description: Each podling in the mob dies and collapses into a slurry if the plant that created it dies or dismisses it (no action required).

actions.name: Impassive Brutality
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) slashing damage, or Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage if the mob has fewer than half its Hit Points. Instead of dealing damage, the mob can grapple the target (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Pacifying Pressure
actions.description: The mob exerts an overwhelming psionic pressure to conform, forcing one creature it can see within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to take hostile actions for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). This effect ends early if the mob or its allies deals any damage to the creature.

bonusActions.name: Slithering Strands
bonusActions.description: Tendrilous roots snake from one podling to a creature grappled by the mob, forcing the creature to succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Sleeping Strands.

bonusActions.name: Inhuman Chorus
bonusActions.description: The mob points at a creature it can see within 30 feet and lets out a chorus of awful screams. Each podling within 500 feet learns the creature's location, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Turned until the end of the mob's next turn.

name: Bodytaker Plant
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -2, Con +5, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +4

traits.name: Podling Link
traits.description: The plant can telepathically command each podling within 10 miles of it. Podlings in the area act on the plant's initiative, instead of their own.

traits.name: Harmonious Growth
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of the plant can use its action to perform music, making a DC 16 Charisma (Performance) check. On a success, the creature can either cause the plant to gain 13 (3d8) Temporary Hit Points, or deal an equal amount of Thunder damage to it.

traits.name: Seeds of Return
traits.description: When the plant dies, it returns to life in the place where it died after 1d12 months unless the ground where it took root is sown with salt or soaked in poison.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The plant makes three attacks with its Capture Vine.

actions.name: Capture Vine
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 20 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). A creature grappled by two or more of these vines is restrained.

actions.name: Gestation Pod
actions.description: The plant forces once Large or smaller creature restrained by it to succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be Swallowed (escape DC 15). At the beginning of each of the plant's turns, each nonplant creature Swallowed by it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Sleeping Strands. Podlings Swallowed by the plant can escape without a check, by spending half their movement.

bonusActions.name: Podling Fruition
bonusActions.description: The plant spawns an incomplete copy of a creature Swallowed by it or one within 10 miles that is infected with Sleeping Strands, spawning a Podling Infiltrator in its Gestation Pod.

name: Corpse Flower
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +5, Int -2, Wis +2, Cha -4

traits.name: Corpses
traits.description: When first encountered, a corpse flower contains the corpses of 1d6 + 3 humanoids. A corpse flower can hold the remains of up to nine dead humanoids. At the beginning of each of its turns, the corpse flower gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the number of corpses it contains.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The corpse flower can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Stench of Death
traits.description: Each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the corpse flower or of a zombie under its control must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the start of its next turn. While Poisoned in this way, the creature's movement speed is halved and attacks against the creature are made at Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The corpse flower makes three tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and Hit: 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Harvest
actions.description: The corpse flower stuffs a grappled creature into itself. A living creature in the corpse flower is Restrained (escape DC 16), and takes 55 (10d10) Necrotic damage at the beginning of each of the corpse flower's turns. Corpses in the corpse flower can be used with its corpses trait.

reactions.name: Disgorge Zombie
reactions.description: When the corpse flower takes damage of a type that isn't fire or radiant, it can disgorge one of its corpses in an unoccupied space within 10 feet, which rises immediately as a Zombie Rotter that acts on initiative count 0 under the corpse flower's control.

name: Gravesnag
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex -1, Con +5, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +1

traits.name: Spirit Tether
traits.description: The gravesnag begins life tied to the manitou that created it with a faintly perceptible tether of spectral energy, which is Invisible to any creature with a Passive Perception of 19 or lower. If the gravesnag begins its turn more than 30 feet away from its creator or if the tether is targeted with Dispel Magic or a similar effect, the tether snaps and gravesnag is Incapacitated for 1 hour, and is freed from the manitou's control.

traits.name: Slithering Vines
traits.description: The gravesnag may enter and move through the space of any creature or any space wide enough for a single vine without squeezing.

actions.name: Strangleroot Slam
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If this attack was made with Advantage, the gravesnag can immediately use its Tangled Lunge against the same target.

actions.name: Tangled Lunge
actions.description: The gravesnag lurches up to 15 feet, then can force one creature in its space to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 15). A creature restrained by two or more gravenags is additionally Choking. A creature restrained by three or more gravesnags is Blinded and has total cover from outside effects.

actions.name: Rending Twist
actions.description: One creature that is grappled or restrained by both the gravesnag and at least one other creature or effect must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this damage is torn in half.

name: Gulthias Tree
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex -1, Con +5, Int -2, Wis +3, Cha +1
resistances: Attacks made without Advantage, Bludgeoning, Piercing

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the gulthias tree may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the treant. While climbing on the gulthias tree, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the it.

traits.name: Wooden Body
traits.description: If the gulthias tree takes Fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the gulthias tree and all creatures climbing on it take 5 (1d10) Fire damage at the start of each of the treant's turns, and all attacks against the gulthias tree are made at Advantage. While on fire, the gulthias tree's melee attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gulthias tree makes two attacks with its earthshaking slam, one of which it may replace with a use of its Vile Birth or Grasping Roots, if availale.

actions.name: Earthshaking Slam
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 20 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked prone. Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must make a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw, taking half the attack's damage and falling prone on a failed save.

actions.name: Vile Birth
actions.description: The Gulthias Tree spawns 3 (1d4 + 1) Twig Blights that appear within 5 ft. of it.

actions.name: Grasping Roots (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 15 feet of the treant must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or take 20 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, grappled and restrained until the end of the gulthias tree's next turn (escape DC 19). A creature that was already prone makes this save at Disadvantage.

legendaryActions.name: Stakes From The Earth
legendaryActions.description: Wooden stakes rise from the earth in two 5-ft. radius areas. The areas become difficult terrain, and when a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 7 (2d6) Piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

legendaryActions.name: Frightful Keening
legendaryActions.description:
Blood oozes from the gulthias tree as it releases a low keening moan. Each creature of the tree's choice in a 120 ft. radius must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the gulthias tree's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more ages 1d20 years. *Blood Drain (costs 2 actions)* Black tendrils worm out of the tree's roots in a 50-foot radius, piercing into flesh.

Each prone creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage and lose two unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 Hit Points if it cant.

The tree gains 5 Temporary Hit Points for each hit die lost in this way. A creature killed by this damage rises at the next dusk as a Vampire Spawn Starveling.

name: Jammer Leech
savingThrows: Dex -5, Con +3, Int -5, Cha -5

traits.name: Matched Materials
traits.description: A leech that has been attached to a surface for at least 24 hours is indistinguishable from the surface around it to creatures more than 30 feet away.

traits.name: Spelljammer Overload
traits.description: If the leech is reduced to 0 Hit Points while attached to a ship with a spelljamming helm, a creature attached to that helm must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned for 1 minute.

actions.name: Spiked Tentacle
actions.description: Attack: +2 reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Latch
actions.description: The leech attaches itself to a ship's hull in its space, dealing 2 (1d4) Piercing damage to the ship (ignoring the ship's damage threshold). This damage can't be repaired until the leech is scraped off the hull. As an action, an adjacent creature can attempt a DC 18 Strength check to try to scrape it off.

reactions.name: Spell Skimmer
reactions.description: As a reaction when a vessel it is attached to accelerates to cruising speed, the leech forces the spelljammer to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or lose its lowest level unexpended spell slot.

reactions.name: Magical Discharge (1/Day)
reactions.description: When it takes damage, the leech can discharge a bolt of stolen magical energy. One creature the leech can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Force damage for each spell level absorbed with the leech's Spell Skimmer ability in the last day.

name: Kelp Angler
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -2, Cha +1

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the angler remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a clump of kelp.

traits.name: Lodewarp Aura
traits.description: The angler distorts magnetic fields in a 500-foot radius around it, imposing Disadvantage on any checks made to navigate using a compass and on Ranged Weapon Attacks that use metal projectiles in the area.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The angler makes three attacks with its Dredge Fronds.

actions.name: Dredge Fronds
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 15 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pulled into the angler's space. A creature in the angler's space moves with it, and may spend 15 feet of movement and take 7 (2d6) poison damage to push its way out, escaping into the nearest unoccupied space.

actions.name: Holdfast Latch
actions.description: The angler anchors itself to a vehicle within 5 feet of it, becoming Attached to it (remove DC 17). While the angler is attached to it, a vehicle cannot move more than 10 feet in a turn.

bonusActions.name: Inflate Bladders
bonusActions.description: The angler briefly inflates the spined pneumatocysts lining its fronds, immediately rising up to 20 feet towards the water's surface if it is submerged. Each creature in its space must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage and be restrained (escape DC 17) until the beginning of the angler's next turn. If the angler is Attached to a vehicle, it lists wildly, pushing each unsecured creature and object up to 15 feet towards the vehicle's edge.

bonusActions.name: Explosive Regrowth (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description: The angler grows several new fronds, regaining 30 Hit Points.

reactions.name: Still Seas (Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction when the angler would make a saving throw against a wave, current, or similar aquatic phenomenon, the angler magically disperses the effect, rendering it harmless.

reactions.name: Scatter Magic (Level 4 Spell)
reactions.description: As a reaction when the angler would make a saving throw against a spell that targets only it, the angler causes the spell to additionally target each creature within 10 feet of it. The spell's Save DC is reduced by 1 for each additional creature the spell targets in this way.

name: Marshbellow
