savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -4, Cha -2

traits.name: Campfire Scenting
traits.description: The marshbellow can detect, by scent, the direction and size of each fire and each creature with a spell or ability that can deal Fire damage within 20 miles.

traits.name: Springy Hide
traits.description: A creature that hits the marshbellow with a melee attack that deals Bludgeoning damage must make a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature is pushed 15 feet away or has its weapon flung 15 feet from its grasp (attacker's choice).

actions.name: Soft-Toothed Snap
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target is Grappled (escape DC 12). A creature grappled in this way automatically fails saving throws against the marshbellow's Stickyspore Snarl.

actions.name: Squidgy Ram
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away. If the marshbellow is size Medium, the target is pushed an additional 5 feet.

actions.name: Stickyspore Snarl
actions.description: The marshbellow coughs out a glob of gluey spores in a 5-foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and be restrained (escape DC 12). If the marshbellow's Puff Up is active, this ability instead affects a 15-foot cone, and deals an additional 3 (1d6) Fire damage on a failed saving throw.

reactions.name: Puff Up
reactions.description: When the marshbellow takes any Fire damage, it can grow to size Medium for the next minute, or until it uses its Stickyspore Snarl.

name: Myconid Sprot
savingThrows: Str -1, Int -1, Cha -3

traits.name: Rapport Spores
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the myconid gains Telepathy to a range of 30 feet for 1 hour. It can use this only to communicate with myconids or with other affected creatures.

traits.name: Sun-Sickened
traits.description: If the myconid ends its turn in Sunlight or takes any Radiant damage, it has Disadvantage on D20 tests until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Tottering Cap-Butt
actions.description: Attack: +2 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target subtracts 1d4 from the first Constitution Saving Throw it makes in the next minute.

actions.name: Rotting Root
actions.description: One Restrained or Unconscious creature in the myconid's space. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The myconid becomes Attached to the target (remove DC 10). While the myconid is Attached in this way, the creature is Poisoned.

name: Myconid Scavenger
savingThrows: Con +1, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Rapport Spores
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the myconid gains Telepathy to a range of 30 feet for 1 hour. It can use this only to communicate with myconids or with other affected creatures.

traits.name: Sun-Sickened
traits.description: If the myconid ends its turn in Sunlight or takes any Radiant damage, it has Disadvantage on D20 tests until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spongy Hammerfist
actions.description: Attack: +2 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target is pushed up to 5 feet away.

actions.name: Scavenge Anima
actions.description: One creature the myconid touches. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The target loses one unexpended Hit Die, or gains the Unconscious condition if it cannot, and the myconid gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

reactions.name: Shudderspore Rain
reactions.description: Trigger: The myconid hits a creature or is hit with a melee attack. Response: Each creature in a 5-foot Emanation takes 5 (2d4) Poison damage.

name: Myconid Moldfarmer
savingThrows: Str +1, Con +2, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Rapport Spores
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the myconid gains Telepathy to a range of 30 feet for 1 hour. It can use this only to communicate with myconids or with other affected creatures.

traits.name: Sun-Sickened
traits.description: If the myconid ends its turn in Sunlight or takes any Radiant damage, it has Disadvantage on D20 tests until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Greenfinger Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 11).

actions.name: Mark Spore-Host
actions.description: One creature Grappled by the myconid. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn). While Poisoned in this way, myconids have Advantage on attacks that target it.

actions.name: Speed Decay
actions.description: *Seeds of death sprout in the living.* One Poisoned creature the myconid can see within 30 feet. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Shudderspore Rain
reactions.description: Trigger: The myconid hits a creature or is hit with a melee attack. Response: Each creature in a 5-foot Emanation takes 5 (2d4) Poison damage.

name: Myconid Sovereign
savingThrows: Str +2, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +2

traits.name: Rapport Spores
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the myconid gains Telepathy to a range of 30 feet for 1 hour. It can use this only to communicate with myconids or with other affected creatures.

traits.name: Sun-Sickened
traits.description: If the myconid ends its turn in Sunlight or takes any Radiant damage, it has Disadvantage on D20 tests until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Contaminator Bond
actions.description:
Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage.

A creature hit with this attack takes Hit: 5 (1d10) psychic damage the first time it deals any damage in the next minute.

actions.name: Pacifying Touch
actions.description: *A dusting of spores; a sudden compulsion to leave in peace.* One creature the myconid touches. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Dazed condition and can't take hostile actions for 1 hour, or until it takes any damage.

actions.name: Sporesong (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Each friendly myconid within 60 feet can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed. A myconid that has any Temporary Hit Points can additionally make a melee attack as part of this reaction.

actions.name: Circle's Roots (1/Day)
actions.description: Each friendly myconid in a 1,000-foot Emanation from the myconid gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

reactions.name: Shudderspore Rain
reactions.description: Trigger: The myconid hits a creature or is hit with a melee attack. Response: Each creature in a 5-foot Emanation takes 5 (2d4) Poison damage.

reactions.name: Gather Growths (1/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: The myconid is Bloodied. Response: The myconid teleports up to four friendly myconids or other fungi within 1,000 feet to unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of it.

name: Plague Brush
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex -2, Con +6, Int -4, Wis -2, Cha -3

traits.name: Poor Turner
traits.description: The plague brush must move at least 10 feet in a straight line before turning, unless it hits a solid surface. It cannot make turns sharper than 45 degrees.

traits.name: Mostly Air
traits.description: Any critical hit agains the plague brush becomes a normal hit. A natural roll of 1-7 always misses the plague brush.

traits.name: Woody Body
traits.description: If the plague brush takes Fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the plague brush and all creatures grappled by it take 5 (1d10) Fire damage at the start of each of the plague brush's turns. Whenever the plague brush takes Fire damage, each creature grappled by it may use its reaction to attempt to escape.

traits.name: Scoop
traits.description: The plague brush may move through the space of any Huge or smaller creature or object. A creature whose space the plague brush moves through must succeed on a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 21) and restrained. Unsecured objects are grappled automatically.

actions.name: Shed Spores
actions.description: Each creature grappled by the plague brush must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage and 13 (3d8) poison damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with Greensickness.

name: Rotroots
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -2, Con +4, Int -5, Cha -1

traits.name: Fiendlight Pattern
traits.description: The flowers of the rotroots display a dancing pattern of colors visible only to fiends and those under the effects of the Detect Magic spell. A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the rotroots that can see this pattern must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or use all of its movement to approach the rotroots.

traits.name: Corpsebed Fertilizer
traits.description: When first encountered, the roots of the rotroots are entwined among 4 (1d4 + 2) grappled fiendish corpses. While it has at least two corpses remaining among its roots, the rotroots has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Weaponized Cadavers
traits.description: The rotroots can't make attacks unless it has at least one corpse or creature grappled with its roots. A corpse used to make an attack is destroyed on a roll of 1. A creature used to make an attack takes the attack's damage on a hit or miss.

actions.name: Corpse-Club Bash (requires a corpse or grappled creature)
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 15 ft. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flesh (requires a corpse or grappled creature)
actions.description: Attack: +8 range 20/60 ft. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A creature thrown with this attack falls prone in the nearest unoccupied space to the target.

actions.name: Crawling Root Snare
actions.description: One creature within 15 feet of the rotroots must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone, dragged up to 10 feet toward the rotroots, and grappled (escape DC 16). While grappled in this way, a creature takes 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns.

bonusActions.name: Devour Corpse
bonusActions.description:
The rotroots consumes one fiendish corpse entwined in its roots, which immediately softens and liquefies, produceing one effect of its choice:
*

bonusActions.name: Nourishing Rot
bonusActions.description:
The rotroots regains 10 Hit Points, and each other creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take an equal amount of Necrotic damage.
*

bonusActions.name: Deathlurch
bonusActions.description: Each other corpse entwined in the roots spasms and lurches, moving the rotroots up to 10 feet per remaining corpse.

name: Flesh Mound
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -3, Cha -3

traits.name: Innocent Heart
traits.description: Walter's infant corpse lies at the center of the flesh mound, crying and afraid. Walter is part of the flesh mound, but has the following properties: A creature with at least 15 Passive Perception, or a creature engulfed by the flesh mound, can discern his location. Attacks against Walter are made at Disadvantage. Attacks against Walter deal double damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is Grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boring Tendrils
actions.description: One creature grappled by the mound must make a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw as the shambling mound attempts to bore roots through its flesh. On a failed save, the creature takes 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage, and its HP maximum is reduced by the same amount.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mound can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

reactions.name: Grasping Hide
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the flesh mound can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled.

name: Shambling Mound
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -3, Cha -3

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to Lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is Grappled (escape DC 14), and the shambling mound uses its Engulf on it.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boring Roots
actions.description: One creature grappled by the mound must make a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw as the shambling mound attempts to bore roots through its flesh. On a failed save, the creature takes 27 (6d8) Necrotic damage, and its HP maximum is reduced by the same amount.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mound can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

reactions.name: Entangling Hide
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the shambling mound can force the attacker to make a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or be grappled.

name: Stormrage Shambler
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -3

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the shambler is subjected to Lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt. The shambler cannot trigger this with its own abilities.

traits.name: Lightning Aura
traits.description: A creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the shambler takes 1d6 Lightning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is Grappled (escape DC 15), and the shambling mound uses its Engulf on it.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Lightning Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 15-foot cone must succeed on a DC 15 dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) Lightning damage, or half as much on a success. A grappled creature makes this save at Disadvantage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it.

reactions.name: Entangling Hide
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the shambling mound can force the attacker to make a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or be grappled.

name: Deathbloom Sporocyte
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +2, Int -3, Wis -2, Cha -3

traits.name: Corpse Drainer
traits.description: If the sporocyte starts its turn within 5 ft. of one or more dead or unconscious creatures, it gains 5 (1d10) Temporary Hit Points and each creature in the area takes an equal amount of Necrotic damage. On a roll of 10, a random corpse within 5 ft. of the sporocyte dissolves.

actions.name: Rotting Slam
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage immediately fails a Death saving throw.

actions.name: Unfurl Mycelia
actions.description: The sporocyte spreads a carpet of mycelia over a 15 ft. square centered on itself. While unfurled, the sporocyte's movement speed is 0, the affected area is difficult terrain, and if the sporocyte would gain Temporary Hit Points, it instead gains twice as many Temporary Hit Points. The sporocyte may retract its mycelia as a bonus action.

reactions.name: Spore Gout (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the sporocyte releases a torrent of spores in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Russet Mold Contagion.

name: Germinator Sporocyte
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +4, Int -1, Wis -2, Cha -3

traits.name: Cyclospore Anima
traits.description: At the beginning of each of the sporocyte's turns, one creature the sporocyte can see within 60 ft. gains 11 (2d10) Temporary Hit Points. While it has these Temporary Hit Points, a creature has Disadvantage on Constitution and Death saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sporocyte makes two attacks with its fecund slam.

actions.name: Fecund Slam
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next Constitution Saving Throw it makes before the end of the sporocyte's next turn.

actions.name: Pallid Rooting (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the sporocyte can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned for the next minute. A creature Poisoned in this way repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 28 (8d6) Piercing damage and being restrained (escape DC 15) until the end of its next turn on a failure.

reactions.name: Spore Gout (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the sporocyte releases a torrent of spores in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Russet Mold Contagion.

name: Splinterbough Treant
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex -1, Con +5, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +1

traits.name: Deadwood Core
traits.description: Whenever the treant deals Bludgeoning damage with a melee attack, it loses an equal amount of Hit Points. The treant cannot recover Hit Points by any means.

traits.name: Wooden Body
traits.description: If the treant takes any Fire damage, it begins Burning (1d10). While it is Burning, attacks against the treant are made at Advantage, the treant's melee attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Splintering Swing
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Slivered Shrapnel
reactions.description: When the treant is hit with a melee attack that deals Slashing damage, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of the treant's next turn.

reactions.name: Toppling Vengeance
reactions.description: When the treant drops to 0 Hit Points, it can fall onto a creature within 10 feet before dying. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone and be restrained under the treant's corpse (escape DC 15), or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

name: Brasswood Treant
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex -1, Con +5, Wis +3, Cha +2
resistances: Fire, Radiant; Bludgeoning and Piercing from Attacks made without Advantage

traits.name: Sun-Soaked
traits.description: In bright sunlight, the treant gleams as though made of precious metals, reflecting glaring light in a 10-foot radius. A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the treant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the treant. While climbing on the treant, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the treant, and the treant has Disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The treant makes two attacks with its Earthshaking Slam, one of which it may replace with a use of its Sundrip.

actions.name: Earthshaking Slam
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Sundrip
actions.description: One creature within 20 feet of the treant must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or be coated in a drop of sunsap. Until a creature takes an action to remove it, the creature takes 9 (2d8) radiant damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

actions.name: Grasping Roots (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 15 feet of the treant must succceed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or take 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone and restrained (escape DC 16) until the end of the treant's next turn. A creature that was already prone makes this save at Disadvantage.

reactions.name: Kindled Lifeblood
reactions.description: When the treant takes any fire or radiant damage, it can use its Sundrip.

name: Stronghollow Treant
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +4, Int +3, Wis +5, Cha +3
resistances: Bludgeoning and Piercing from Attacks made without Advantage

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the treant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check, climbing onto it on a success. A creature climbing on the treant has Advantage on melee attacks against the treant, and the treant has Disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

traits.name: Greenweald Vitality
traits.description: At the end of each of its turns, nomagical fires within 10 feet of the treant are doused and each condition affecting it ends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The treant makes two attacks with its Earthshaking Slam and uses its Sprite Mischief.

actions.name: Earthshaking Slam
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Sprite Mischief
actions.description:
The sprites that lair in the treant scamper invisibly, targeting a creature within 30 feet of the treant with one of the following effects:
*

actions.name: Trick Trinket
actions.description:
The target must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or become unattuned from one magic item is carrying.
*

actions.name: Slip from Mind
actions.description:
The target must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence Saving Throw or forget the last spell it cast until it completes a short or long rest.
*

actions.name: Distracting Tickle
actions.description: The creature has Disadvantage on the first attack it makes on its following turn.

actions.name: Safeguard Soul (1/Day)
actions.description: The treant secures a portion of the life essence of a willing fey creature within 5 feet inside of its trunk. Whenever the creature takes damage, it reduces that damage by 10, and the treant loses Hit Points equal to the damage prevented. When the treant dies, each creature whose essence it carries must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw or take 2d6 points of Exhaustion, or half as much on a success.

name: Grovetender Treant
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex -1, Con +5, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +1
resistances: Bludgeoning and Piercing from Attacks made without Advantage

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the treant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

traits.name: Rootspeech
traits.description: While in its home forest, the treant knows the number, type, and approximate location of each creature within 10 miles of it.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the treant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check, climbing onto it on a success. A creature climbing on the treant has Advantage on melee attacks against the treant, and the treant has Disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

traits.name: Wooden Body
traits.description: If the treant takes any Fire damage, it and each creature climbing on it begin Burning (1d10). While it is Burning, attacks against the treant are made at Advantage, the treant's melee attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Sweeping Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 18). Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take half the attack's damage and be pushed up to 5 feet away.

actions.name: Earthshaking Slam
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Hurl Stone (Requires a stone or other large object)
actions.description: Attack: +10 range 60/240 ft. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Hurl Creature (Requires a grappled creature)
bonusActions.description: Attack: +10 range 60/240 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the thrown creature takes the attack's damage.

bonusActions.name: Grasping Roots (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description: Each creature within 15 feet of the treant must succceed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or take 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone and restrained (escape DC 18) until the end of the treant's next turn. A creature that was already prone makes this save at Disadvantage.

reactions.name: Forest Allies
reactions.description: When a creature within 10 feet of a mundane tree hits the treant with a ranged attack, the treant can magically impel the tree to make an Earthshaking Slam attack against the attacker, using the treant's statistics.

name: Ironmaw Treant
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex -1, Con +10, Wis +2, Cha +7
resistances: Cold, Fire, Lightning, Bludgeoning and Piercing from Attacks made without Advantage

traits.name: Dolorous Aura
traits.description: The area in a 1 mile radius around the treant is dull and drained of color and vibrancy. A creature that completes a Short or Long Rest in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or gain a point of Exhaustion.

traits.name: Bladeridge Bark
traits.description: A creature that climbs onto the treant or makes a saving throw to avoid falling off takes 9 (2d8) Slashing damage.

traits.name: Locust-Thorn Limbs
traits.description: The treant has four limbs (AC 20; 40 HP), each of which can grapple a single creature. Destroying a limb deals no damage to the treant, which regrows all lost limbs when it completes a long rest.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the treant may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check, climbing onto it on a success. A creature climbing on the treant has Advantage on melee attacks against the treant, and the treant has Disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The treant makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Bladeridge Bite.

actions.name: Bladeridge Bite
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage. and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be Swallowed (escape DC 18). A creature Swallowed in this way takes 9 (2d8) Slashing damage whenever it takes an action, and may attempt to escape as a reaction whenever the treant uses this attack.

actions.name: Locust-Thorn Whip
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 30 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 18). A creature grappled in this way loses 5 Hit Points and is dragged up to 30 feet toward the treant at the start of each of its turns.

bonusActions.name: Ironplum Bushel Fling
bonusActions.description: The treant hurls a cluster of ironplums at a point it can see within 60 feet, rolling a d4 to determine the effect * 1. Unripe. The ironplums scatter in a 15-foot cone emanating from the point of impact. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. 2-3. Ripe. The ironplums shatter explosively in a 15-foot radius spray of shrapnel. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Fire damage plus 14 (4d6) Piercing damage. 4. Overripe. The ironplums burst, exuding a foul stench reminiscent of carrion in a 15-foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of the treant's next turn.

name: Widowmaker Treant
savingThrows: Str +12, Dex -1, Con +11, Int +3, Wis +11, Cha +2
resistances: Bludgeoning and Piercing from Attacks made without Advantage

traits.name: Rootspeech
traits.description: While in its home forest, the treant knows the number, type, and approximate location of each creature within 10 miles of it.

traits.name: Flammable Crown
traits.description: If the treant takes 20 or more Fire damage from a source that could reach its lower canopy (40 feet above the ground), it begins Burning (1d10). If the treant was already Burning, the Burning damage increases by 1d10. While it is Burning, attacks against the treant are made at Advantage, and the treant's melee attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

traits.name: Bark Titan
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the treant may spend half its movmeent to attempt a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check, climbing 15 feet up the treant on a success. While climbing on the treant at least 40 feet above the ground, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the treant, and the treant can't target the creature with its Timber Stomp.

traits.name: Strength of Ages
traits.description: If the treant fails a saving throw against any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, alter its form, or reduce its speed, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The treant makes two attacks with its Timber Stomp, each of which it may replace with a use of its Drop Widowmaker.

actions.name: Timber Stomp
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 15 ft. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, plus an additional Hit: 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage if the target was prone. On a hit or miss, the target and each other creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Drop Widowmaker
actions.description: The treant drops an enormous seedcone from one of its high branches. One creature within 20 feet of the treant must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Sonorous Growth (Recharge 6, Concentration)
actions.description: The treant begins a slow and groaning chant in old treeish. When the treant uses this ability and at the beginning of each of its turns for the next minute, it may cause a size Huge nonmagical tree to burst from the earth at a point it can see within 120 feet. Each creature in the tree's space is pushed 80 feet into the air, then may make a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw to catch hold of the tree's canopy and avoid falling.

bonusActions.name: Crumple Iron
bonusActions.description: One creature wearing nonmagical metal armor that the treant hit with two Timber Stomp attacks this turn must make a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature's armor takes a permanent and cumulative penalty to the AC it offers equal to amount the creature failed by. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 in this way is destroyed.

bonusActions.name: Tear Stone
bonusActions.description: The treant smashes through a barrier of nonmagical stone or softer material of up to 15 feet thick. Each creature on the other side of the barrier within 20 feet of the treant takes 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Chittering Throng
bonusActions.description: A mass of angry squirrels swarms over the treant's branches, forcing each creature climbing on the treant to succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or fall off.

reactions.name: The Boughs Shake
reactions.description: When the treant takes 15 or more damage from a single source, it can use its Drop Widowmaker.

name: Vegepygmy Scavenger
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -2, Cha -2

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.description: The vegepygmy has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

traits.name: Spore Burst
traits.description: When the vegepygmy dies, it releases a cloud of infectious spores. Each non-plant creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Russet Mold Contagion.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Russet Mold Contagion
actions.description: An infected creature has vulnerability to Acid and Radiant damage. Upon completing a long rest, the creature's AC is reduced by 2 until this disease is cured; to a minimum of 10 if the creature is not wearing heavy armor, or to 14 if it is.

name: Vegepygmy Hunter
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.description: The vegepygmy has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

traits.name: Vegepygmy Fission
traits.description: When the vegepygmy dies, a vegepygmy scavenger that acts on its initiative emerges from the corpse at the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vegepygmy makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Braining Sling
actions.description: Attack: +5 range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the beginning of the target's next turn.

name: Vegepygmy Thorn Doctor
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +3, Con +3, Wis +3, Cha -2

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.description: The vegepygmy has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

traits.name: Vegepygmy Fission
traits.description: When the vegepygmy dies, two vegepygmy scavengers that act on its initiative emerges from the corpse at the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vegepygmy makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Livewood Spear
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Rampant Growth
actions.description: A 10 ft. radius of ground centered on a point within 60 ft. becomes difficult terrain. Non-plant creatures in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone. Plant creatures in the area regain 7 (2d6) Hit Points.

actions.name: Lashing Vine (Level 4 Spell, concentration)
actions.description: The vegepygmy conjures a thorny vine that sprouts from the ground in space within 30 ft. One creature within 30 ft. of the vine must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Piercing damage and be pulled 20 feet directly toward the vine. The vegepygmy can direct the vine to lash out at the same creature or another one as a bonus action each turn.

name: Vegepygmy Chieftain
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +3, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha -2

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.description: The vegepygmy has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

traits.name: Vegepygmy Fission
traits.description: When the vegepygmy dies, three vegepygmy scavengers that act on its initiative emerges from the corpse at the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Moldy Fury
traits.description: Allied vegepygmies within 30 ft. can make a ranged or melee attack each turn as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vegepygmy makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Mucid Command, if available.

actions.name: Livewood Spear
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Mucid Command (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each other friendly plant creature within 15 ft. may use its reaction to make a melee attack.

reactions.name: Chest Tendril Lash
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the vegepygmy forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 ft. away.

reactions.name: Recolonize (1/day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 60 Hit Points, the vegepygmy releases a cloud of infectious spores. Each non-plant creature within 15 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Russet Mold Contagion.

name: Wood Woad
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +3, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Ancestral Memory
traits.description: The wood woad remembers each wrong and trespass its home forest has ever suffered. It can recognize those who have wronged the forest and their descendants, but has difficulty distinguishing between the two.

traits.name: Tree Stride
traits.description: Once on its turn, the wood wad can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

traits.name: Nourishing Roots
traits.description: If the wood woad ends its turn without spending more than half of its movement, it gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Wooden Body
traits.description: If the wood woad takes Fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the wood woad takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wood woad makes two attacks with its cudgel, one of which it may replace with a use of its Nature's Judgement, if available.

actions.name: Cudgel
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Nature's Judgement (Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One humanoid creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be Restrained for the next minute. A creature proficient in Nature checks makes this save at Advantage. While restrained, the creature takes 5 (2d4) Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns, and the nearest Fey or Plant creature friendly to the wood woad recovers the same amount of Hit Points. A creature can repeat this save as an action, ending the effect on a success.

name: Allip
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2, Int +6, Wis +1, Cha +3
resistances: Acid, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Cold, Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The allip can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Depths of Madness
traits.description: A creature that attempts to read the allip's mind has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws for the next minute.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The allip's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

actions.name: Maddening Touch
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) psychic damage and the target's Wisdom score is reduced by 2 (1d4) for the next minute, to a minimum of 1. A creature whose Wisdom score is reduced to 1 in this way becomes hostile to all living creatures, including itself, until it recovers.

actions.name: Whispers of Madness (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each non-fiend, non-undead creature within 30 feet must make a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature uses its reaction to move up half its speed toward and make a melee attack against a living creature in range.

reactions.name: Shadow Glide
reactions.description: When the allip takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can teleport up to 60 feet to a location it can see and turns invisible until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

name: Angel of Decay
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +2, Con +9, Wis +7, Cha +7
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Festering Presence
traits.description: If the angel has at least 105 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Festering Necrosis.

traits.name: Parasitic Presence
traits.description: If the angel has 105 HP or fewer, it regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn for each corpse and each creature within 60 feet infected with Festering Necrosis.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The angel has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The angel makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its foul unraveling, if available.

actions.name: Rotting Touch
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 15 ft. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) slashing damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. This attack scores a critical on a 16-20 against a creature with fewer than 100 Hit Points.

actions.name: Foul Unraveling (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The angel lashes out with tendrils of vile corruption, making a rotting touch attack against each creature within 15 feet On a hit, a creature is dragged up to 10 feet towards the angel and grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained until the end of the angel's turn.

reactions.name: Wave of Decay (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the angel is reduced below 105 Hit Points, it unleashes a wave of negative energy. Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Anglerwisp
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex +6, Con +2, Int -1, Wis +2
resistances: Acid, Cold, Fire; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing
immunities: Lighting, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Spectral Threat
traits.description: The anglerwisp sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot Emanation, at the edges of which lurks a giant illusory maw. Unless illuminated by another source of Bright Light or Immune to the Frightened condition, creatures in the area have Disadvantage on attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The anglerwisp makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Phantom Maw.

actions.name: Crackling Lure
actions.description: Attack: +9 range 30 ft. Hit: 13 (3d8) lightning damage and the target is dragged up to 15 feet toward the anglerwisp.

actions.name: Phantom Maw
actions.description: Each creature in a 20-foot Emanation from the anglerwisp must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 5 (1d10) Force damage and the creature is Restrained by spectral tendrils of light (escape DC 17). While Restrained in this way, a creature moves with the anglerwisp.

bonusActions.name: Life Harvest
bonusActions.description: One creature Restrained by the anglerwisp must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The creature loses 3 (1d6) unexpended Hit Dice, or takes 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage if it can't. The anglerwisp gains 5 Temporary Hit Points for each Hit Die lost in this way.

bonusActions.name: Border Lurk (Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.description: The anglerwisp releases each creature Restrained by it and enters the Border Ethereal, where it remains until the start of its next turn. While there, it remains faintly visible on the Material Plane and can be targeted, but has Immunity to any non-Force damage.

name: Archivist Grim
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +4, Int +9, Wis +7, Cha +7
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Turned; Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Poisoned, Prone, Unconscious
languages: The languages it knew in life, Telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Chained Vigil
traits.description: If the grim is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it becomes Incapacitated but is not destroyed unless its bones are exhumed and reburied.

traits.name: Stifling Aura
traits.description: The grim projects magical silence in a 30-foot Emanation. Creatures in the area have Advantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The grim makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Scribe's Mastery.

actions.name: Inkwrought Bonds
actions.description: Attack: +9 range 30 ft. Hit: 27 (6d8) poison damage and the target is Restrained until the end of its next turn (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Scribe's Mastery
actions.description: The grim unbinds the magic of a scroll within 60 feet, casting the spell contained within (+9, Save DC 17). If the scroll is carried by a creature, the grim casts a randomly selected scroll carried by the creature.

actions.name: Consign to Myth (Recharge 5-6, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the grim touches must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target disappears into a book within 15 feet of it (Save Ends at end of turn) and gains the benefit of a Short Rest. After three failed saving throws, the creature stops repeating the saving throw. The spell ends if the book is opened or destroyed.

reactions.name: Fictive Twist (Level 2 Spell)
reactions.description:
Trigger: A creature the grim can see within 60 feet casts a spell. Response: The spell's effect becomes an illusion, with the following effects. Any damage the spell deals becomes Psychic damage. Any saving throw the spell forces a creature to make becomes an Intelligence Saving Throw.




}}

name: Atropal Godling
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -3, Con +11, Int +7, Wis +9, Cha +5
immunities: Cold, Necrotic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Weapons; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned
languages: Understands Celestial but utters only obscene nonsense

traits.name: Aura of Unmaking
traits.description: Creatures within 30 ft. of the atropal make death saving throws at Disadvantage. A creature in the area with no unexpended hit dice that rolls a 1 on a death saving throw fades out of existence and cannot be returned to life by any means other than a Wish spell.

traits.name: Quelling Aura
traits.description: The area in a 1 mile radius around the atropal is warded from the influence of the divine. Deities cannot sense or communicate with creatures in the area, divine interventions in the area fail except on a roll of 00, and cleric and paladin spell slots count as one level lower in the area.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The atropal can't be affected or detected by spells of 1st level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Anti-Life Nature
traits.description: If the atropal would receive magical healing, it instead must succeed a Constitution Saving Throw against the spellcaster's save DC or take an equal amount of radiant damage. If the atropal takes any radiant damage, attacks made against the atropal have Advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The atropal makes two attacks with its life suppressing touch.

actions.name: Life Suppressing Touch
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 26 (4d10 + 4) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or have its hit point maximum reduced to its current Hit Points until it completes a short or long rest.

actions.name: Wretched Squall
actions.description: Each living creature within 60 ft. of the atropal must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Thunder damage and be deafened until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more is additionally unable to perform the verbal components of spells until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Necrotizing Beam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 90 ft. long, 10 ft. wide line from the atropal must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 55 (10d10) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more loses 1d10 unexpended hit dice, then drops to 0 Hit Points if it has no unexpended hit dice remaining.

legendaryActions.name: Shroud of Death
legendaryActions.description: One creature the atropal can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed for the next minute. Whenever the cursed creature takes damage, it takes an additional 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage. This curse ends early if the target receives magical healing.

legendaryActions.name: The Dead Yet Live
legendaryActions.description: One undead creature within 30 ft. that was destroyed since the end of the atropal's last turn returns to undeath with 22 (4d10) Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Atropos Burst (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The atropal releases a burst of negative energy centered on a dead or unconscious creature within 60 ft. Each living creature within 15 ft. of the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Atropal Scion
savingThrows: Str +12, Dex -1, Con +14, Int +7, Wis +11, Cha +14
immunities: Cold, Necrotic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Weapons; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Aura of Unmaking
traits.description: Creatures within 30 ft. of the atropal that make death saving throws roll three dice and take the lowest result. A creature in the area with no unexpended hit dice that rolls a 1 on a death saving throw fades out of existence and cannot be returned to life by any means other than a Wish spell.

traits.name: Quelling Aura
traits.description: The area in a 1 mile radius around the atropal is warded from the influence of the divine. Deities cannot sense or communicate with creatures in the area, divine interventions in the area fail except on a roll of 00, and cleric and paladin spell slots count as two levels lower in the area.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The atropal can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the atropal may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the atropal. While climbing on the atropal, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the atropal.

traits.name: Anti-Life Nature
traits.description: If the atropal would receive magical healing, it instead must succeed a Constitution Saving Throw against the spellcaster's save DC or take an equal amount of radiant damage. If the atropal takes any radiant damage, attacks made against the atropal have Advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Implacable (5/day)
traits.description: If the atropal fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The atropal makes two attacks with its life suppressing touch, one of which it may replace with its end magic or its death gaze.

actions.name: Life Suppressing Touch
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 15 ft. Hit: 38 (6d10 + 5) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or have its hit point maximum reduced to its current Hit Points until it completes a short or long rest. This attack is made at Advantage against a creature climbing on the atropal.

actions.name: End Magic
actions.description: One creature within 60 ft. that the atropal can see must make a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, the atropal ends each spell and magical effect affecting the creature, each spell it is concentrating on, and destroys one nonartifact magical item the creature is carrying.

actions.name: Death Gaze
actions.description: One creature within 120 ft. that the atropal can see must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or drop to 0 Hit Points. A creature under the effects of Protection from Evil and Good or Death Ward has Advantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Necrotizing Beam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 300 ft. long, 15 ft. wide line from the atropal must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or take 105 (10d10 + 50) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more loses 1d20 unexpended hit dice, then drops to 0 Hit Points if it has no unexpended hit dice remaining.

reactions.name: Spawn Godling (2/Day)
reactions.description: When the atropal takes 100 or more damage in a single turn, a piece of it rips off and rapidly grows into a Atropal Godling with no legendary actions that acts on initiative count 0.

legendaryActions.name: Shroud of Death
legendaryActions.description: One creature the atropal can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed for the next minute. Whenever the cursed creature takes damage, it takes an additional 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. This curse ends early if the target receives magical healing.

legendaryActions.name: The Dead Yet Live
legendaryActions.description: One undead creature within 30 ft. that was destroyed since the end of the atropal's last turn returns to undeath with 33 (6d10) Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Atropos Burst (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The atropal releases a burst of negative energy centered on a dead or unconscious creature within 60 ft. Each living creature within 15 ft. of the target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Avatar of Death
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +3, Int +3, Wis +3, Cha +3
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Turned; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Inevitable
traits.description: The avatar knows the exact positon of its creator, and can't be hidden from by any means.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The avatar can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Creeping Return
traits.description: When the avatar is reduced to 0 Hit Points it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions and silently leaves. Whenever its summoner attempts to rest while it has no unexpended hit dice, roll a D100. On a roll of 5 or below, the avatar is summoned once more.

actions.name: Touch of the Inevitable
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet has its Charisma score reduced by 3 (1d6) for the next minute, then the avatar teleports at least 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 0 in this way dies and can't be restored to life by any means.

name: Baigujing
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +3, Wis +1, Cha +3
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Exhaustion, Poisoned
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Voice of Two Mouths
traits.description: When the baigujing speaks a lie, each creature not Charmed by the baigujing instead hears its surface thoughts.

actions.name: Sainted Drain
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft., one creature Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) necrotic damage. A cleric or paladin hit with this attack must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or lose two unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 Hit Points if it can't.

actions.name: Bitter Offering
actions.description: The baigujing hands a piece of food to a creature within 5 feet. A creature Charmed by the baigujing cannot voluntarily relinquish the food and must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw at the beginning of each of its turns or eat it, taking 28 (8d6) poison damage. If the food is dropped, it transforms into a Ruby-Headed Centipede under the baigujing's control.

actions.name: Bones of Jade, Flesh of Snow (Concentration)
actions.description: The baigujing takes on a humanoid form that lasts until it deals any damage. While transformed, humanoid creatures not proficient in Insight are Charmed by the baigujing.

reactions.name: False Death
reactions.description: When the baigujing takes any damage while transformed with its Bones of Jade, Flesh of Snow, it can abandon its body, leaving behind a corpse. The baigujing immediately reforms in an unoccupied space of its choice within 500 feet.

name: Banedead Vassal
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +2, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Undying Legion
traits.description: Creatures with this trait share a single Initiative, instead of rolling individually. While it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures with this trait, the banedead has Resistance to all damage types other than Force and Radiant.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The banedead makes two attacks.

actions.name: Merciless Slash
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points with this attack immediately fails one Death Saving Throw.

actions.name: Iron Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). A creature Grappled in this way subtracts 1d4 from any Attack Roll or Saving Throw that it makes.

name: Banedead Direguard
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +3, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Undying Legion
traits.description: Creatures with this trait share a single Initiative, instead of rolling individually. While it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures with this trait, the banedead has Resistance to all damage types other than Force and Radiant.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The banedead makes two attacks.

actions.name: Merciless Slash
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points with this attack immediately fails one Death Saving Throw.

actions.name: Iron Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). A creature Grappled in this way subtracts 1d4 from any Attack Roll or Saving Throw that it makes.

bonusActions.name: Invocation of the Black Hand (Level 2 Spell)
bonusActions.description: Spectral claws clutch at each creature that the banedead dealt damage to this turn, forcing each of them to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature is Frightened and Restrained until the end of the banedead's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Tyrant's Might (Level 2 Spell, Concentration)
bonusActions.description: At the end of each of its turns, the banedead gains 5 Temporary Hit Points. If the banedead hits a creature with an attack, it loses all of these Temporary Hit Points, and the attack deals extra Force damage equal to the Temporary Hit Points lost.

name: Banedead Dreadmaster
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +1, Con +6, Wis +6, Cha +4

traits.name: Undying Legion
traits.description: Creatures with this trait share a single Initiative, instead of rolling individually. While it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures with this trait, the banedead has Resistance to all damage types other than Force and Radiant.

traits.name: Grave Purge (2/Day)
traits.description: At the start of each of the banedead’s turns, it can end one condition or spell affecting it. If it does, it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The banedead makes two attacks.

actions.name: Dreadmaster's Poleaxe
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. If at least two of the banedead's allies are within 30 feet of it, this attack has Advantage.

actions.name: Iron Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16). A creature Grappled in this way subtracts 1d4 from any Attack Roll or Saving Throw that it makes.

actions.name: Sunder Arms (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the banedead can see within 30 feet must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 36 (8d8) Thunder damage and one weapon or spell focus carried by the creature flies 30 (1d6 x 10) feet in a direction of the banedead's choice. Success: Half damage. Nonmagical weapons affected by this spell shatter and are destroyed.

bonusActions.name: Invocation of the Black Hand (Level 2 Spell)
bonusActions.description: Spectral claws clutch at each creature that the banedead dealt damage to this turn, forcing each of them to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature is Frightened and Restrained until the end of the banedead's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Tyrant's Might (Level 2 Spell, Concentration)
bonusActions.description: At the end of each of its turns, the banedead gains 5 Temporary Hit Points. If the banedead hits a creature with an attack, it loses all of these Temporary Hit Points, and the attack deals extra Force damage equal to the Temporary Hit Points lost.

legendaryActions.name: Dread Assault
legendaryActions.description: The banedead moves up to its Speed and can make a melee attack.

legendaryActions.name: No Escape
legendaryActions.description: One Humanoid creature the banedead can see within 150 feet is dragged up to 30 feet toward the banedead, then must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature falls Prone.

legendaryActions.name: Ironlight Glare (Level 2 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: One Frightened creature the banedead can see within 60 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target is Paralyzed until the start of its next turn, or until it takes any damage.

name: Banshee
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +1, Int +1, Cha +3
immunities: Cold, Necrotic, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
languages: Any languages it knew in life

traits.name: Ill Omen
traits.description: When initiative is rolled, the banshee forces one creature it can see to succeed on DC 13 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature subtracts 1d8 from the result of any Wisdom Saving Throws it makes.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The banshee can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Weightless
traits.description: Whenever the banshee takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the damage's source.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The banshee's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

traits.name: Unfinished Business
traits.description: When the banshee is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions, though it can still communicate. After 24 hours, the banshee recovers all of its Hit Points. While at 0 Hit Points, the banshee can be destroyed any of the following ways: Resolving its unifinished business. Subjecting it to the same conditions that killed it. Performing funeral rites for it with the Ceremony spell.

actions.name: Corrupting Touch
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (4d6 + 1) necrotic damage and plants within 10 feet of the target wither and die.

actions.name: Horrifying Visage
actions.description: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the banshee that can see her must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of Turn), or become immune to this effect for 24 hours on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more has its face twist into a permanent rictus of terror until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

name: Baykok Witherskin
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +2, Cha +3
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Drum-Tight Skin
traits.description: If the baykok takes 15 or more Slashing damage from a single source, its skin tears away and it gains Vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Spurned by Death
traits.description: If the baykok is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it is Immobile and Incapacitated but does not die. The baykok can regain Hit Points only if all of its bones are gathered together and it is targeted with the Ceremony spell or similar magic.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The baykok makes three attacks.

actions.name: Cedarstock War-Club
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Nonlethal Bludgeoning damage. A creature reduced below 10 Hit Points by this damage is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Ghost-Shot
actions.description: Attack: +7 range 80/320 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. This attack has Advantage against any creature without the ability to see invisible objects.

bonusActions.name: Grasp the Wind
bonusActions.description: The baykok flies up to 20 feet. Oppoturnity Attacks provoked by this movement have Disadvantage.

bonusActions.name: Leave Unwhole
bonusActions.description: The baykok touches an Incapacitated creature, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature's flesh briefly parts, allowing the baykok to extract and devour one of its organs, replacing it with a stone. Success: The creature becomes immune to this effect for 24 hours. Until cured with Regenerate or similar magic, the creature gains no benefit from resting.

name: Beholder Zombie
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -4, Wis +2, Cha -3
languages: Understands Deep Speech and Undercommon but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If the beholder starts its turn with 0 Hit Points, it makes a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw, unless it was dealt radiant damage or a critical hit since the end of its last turn. On a success, the beholder regains 1 hit point. A zombie with 0 Hit Points is killed instantly if it is attacked.

traits.name: Rotting Eyestalks
traits.description: Attacks that deal Slashing damage score a critical hit on an 18-20 against the beholder. When the beholder is dealt a critical hit, the beholder must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or lose the use of an eye ray of the attacker's choice.

actions.name: Befouling Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Moan of the Undreaming (Recharge 6)
actions.description: A fetid gasp escapes the beholder's mouth, carried from beyond this world. Each creature within 20 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage plus 11 (2d10) Psychic damage and be Frightened until the end of the beholder's next turn.

reactions.name: What Dreams May Come
reactions.description: When the beholder is forced to make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma Saving Throw, it may create a Gazer in an unoccupied space it can see within 15 feet.

reactions.name: Clouded Rays
reactions.description: When a creature the beholder can see ends its movement within 30 feet of the beholder, the beholder forces it to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or suffer one of the following effects * 1. Wasting Ray. The target's Dexterity score is reduced by a cumulative 7 (2d6), to a minimum of 1 (Save Ends at end of turn). A creature reduced to 1 Dexterity in this way is Paralyzed. * 2. Flickering Panic Ray. The target is Blinded until the end of its next turn. While Blinded in this way, a creature cannot distinguish friend from foe. * 3. Stumbling Ray. The target takes 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage and falls prone. * 4. Flaying Ray. A portion of the target's skin begins to disintegrate, taking 16 (3d10) Force damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points in this way gains vulnerability to all damage until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

name: Blackwing
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +4, Wis +2, Cha +2

traits.name: Terror Dive
traits.description: If the blackwing is flying and dives at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the blackwing's next turn.

traits.name: Empty Bones
traits.description: If the blackwing takes 15 or more Bludgeoning damage from a single source, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or lose its fly speed until it completes a Short or Long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The blackwing makes two attacks with its Abductor Talons, one of which it may replace with its Throatripper Beak or Wail of Despair, if available.

actions.name: Throatripper Beak
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 11 (1d10) necrotic damage. If the target is grappled, it additionally begins to bleed profusely. At the end of each of its turns, the target loses 4 (1d8) Hit Points and must make a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw, with Advantage if it received any magical healing since the end of its last turn, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Abductor Talons
actions.description: Talons. *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). The blackwing may make this attack as a Bonus Action against a Frightened creature.

actions.name: Wail of Despair (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The blackwing lets out a terrible cry. Each living creature within 60 feet that can hear it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws it makes before the end of the blackwing's next turn.

name: Bodak
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha +1
resistances: Cold, Fire, Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Death Gaze
traits.description: The bodak's eyes reflect the horror that frightened it to death. A creature not immune to the Frightened condition that starts its turn within 30 feet of the bodak and can see its eyes must succeed a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) Psychic damage. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more instead drops to 0 Hit Points. The bodak is forced to close its eyes while in sunlight, disabling this trait.

traits.name: Aura of Annihilation
traits.description: Creatures within 30 feet of the bodak fail death Saving Throws automatically, and cannot be stabilized without regaining at least one Hit Point. A creature that dies in this aura rises as a bodak after 24 hours.

traits.name: Fear is Where It Lives
traits.description: The bodak is always Frightened. If another effect would subject the bodak to the Frightened condition, it instead gains 18 (4d8) Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Soul Drain
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the bodak must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage and be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, it instead drops to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Share Horror (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The bodak opens its mind to those around it. Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed and Frightened by the bodak until the end of its next turn. While charmed in this way, a creature cannot avert its eyes.

name: Bodak Mind Killer
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +8, Con +7, Int +4, Wis +6, Cha +1
resistances: Cold, Fire, Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Death Gaze
traits.description: The bodak's eyes reflect the horror that frightened it to death. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the bodak and can see its eyes must succeed a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Psychic damage. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more instead drops to 0 Hit Points. A creature that is immune to the frightened condition makes this save at Advantage. The bodak is forced to close its eyes while in sunlight, disabling this trait.

traits.name: Aura of Annihilation
traits.description: Creatures within 30 feet of the bodak fail death Saving Throws automatically, cannot be stabilized without regaining at least one Hit Point. Additionally, creatures of the bodak's choice that start their turn in the aura take 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage. A creature that dies in this aura rises as a bodak after 24 hours.

traits.name: Fear is Where It Lives
traits.description: The bodak is always Frightened. If another effect would subject the bodak to the Frightened condition, it instead gains 36 (8d8) Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bodak uses its Soul Drain twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Share Horror, if available.

actions.name: Soul Drain
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the bodak must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage and be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, it instead drops to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Share Horror (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The bodak opens its mind to those around it. Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed and Frightened by the bodak until the end of its next turn. While Charmed in this way, a creature cannot avert its eyes.

reactions.name: Consume Spirit (Concentration)
reactions.description: When a creature drops to 0 Hit Points within 5 feet of it, the bodak can grapple the creature and begins to draw the creature's soul out from its body. At the beginning of the bodak's next turn, if the creature is still Unconscious and grappled, the creature dies and cannot be resurrected by any means short of a Wish spell, as the bodak devours its spirit.

name: Boneclaw
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +7, Con +6, Int +2, Wis +5, Cha -1
resistances: Cold, Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing while in Dim Light or Darkness
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: While its master lives, a destroyed boneclaw gains a new body in 1d10 hours, with all its Hit Points. The new body appears within 1 mile of the boneclaw's master.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.description: While in dim light or darkness, the boneclaw can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The boneclaw makes two attacks with its Ghastly Claws, each of which it may replace with a use of its Douse or Shadowsink, if available.

actions.name: Ghastly Claws
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 15 ft. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the boneclaw and grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Douse
actions.description: The boneclaw reduces a source of Bright Light you can see within 60 feet to Dim Light, or extinguishes a source of Dim Light it can see in the area. If the boneclaw is hidden, this action does not reveal its position.

actions.name: Shadowsink (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: If the boneclaw is in Dim Light or Darkness, the shadows around it deepen to a pure black and it sinks through to the world of shadow, emerging at another location in Dim Light or Darkness within 60 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of the boneclaw must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma Saving Throw or be drawn through this passage behind it, taking 32 (5d12) Necrotic damage and emerging in the nearest unoccupied space to the boneclaw. A grappled creature makes this saving throw at Disadvantage.

name: Boneclaw Night Terror
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex +8, Con +9, Int +8, Wis +6, Cha -1
resistances: Cold, Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing while in Dim Light or Darkness
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: While its master lives, a destroyed boneclaw gains a new body in 1d10 hours, with all its Hit Points. The new body appears within 1 mile of the boneclaw's master.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The boneclaw can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the boneclaw can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Shadewarded (3/Day)
traits.description: If the boneclaw fails a saving throw while in Dim Light or Darkness, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The boneclaw makes two attacks with its Ghastly Claws, each of which it may replace with a use of its Douse or Shadowsink, if available.

actions.name: Ghastly Claws
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 15 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the boneclaw and grappled (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Douse
actions.description: The boneclaw reduces a source of Bright Light it can see within 60 feet to Dim Light, or extinguishes a source of Dim Light it can see in the area. If the boneclaw is hidden, this action does not reveal its position.

actions.name: Shadowsink (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: If the boneclaw is in Dim Light or Darkness, the shadows around it deepen to a pure black and it sinks through to the world of shadow, emerging at another location in Dim Light or Darkness within 60 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of the boneclaw must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or be drawn through this passage behind it, taking 32 (5d12) Necrotic damage and emerging in the nearest unoccupied space to the boneclaw. A grappled creature makes this saving throw at Disadvantage.

reactions.name: Shadow Snatch
