reactions.description: When a creature the boneclaw is hidden from enters its reach, the boneclaw can make an attack with its Ghastly Claws against it. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the boneclaw's next turn and Hidden from any creature the boneclaw is hidden from. If the boneclaw is hidden, this attack does not reveal its location.

legendaryActions.name: Douse
legendaryActions.description: The boneclaw uses its Douse ability. It may take this Legendary Action even while incapacitated.

legendaryActions.name: Change Orientation
legendaryActions.description: The boneclaw changes the orientation of gravity toward an surface it can see within 30 feet for itself and for any creatures grappled by it.

legendaryActions.name: Claw Skewer
legendaryActions.description: If the boneclaw is not in bright light, it extends a finger through the nearby shadows. One creature the boneclaw can see within 15 feet of an area of dim light or darkness must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Piercing damage. If the boneclaw is hidden, this action does not reveal its position.

name: Bonedrinker
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha -1

traits.name: Bone-Scent Ravening
traits.description: While within 30 ft. of a living creature with bones, the bonedrinker may Dash as a Bonus Action, and melee attacks made against it by creatures it is not grappling are made at Advantage.

traits.name: Weeping Sores
traits.description: The bonedrinker is covered in sores that weep a clear fluid, and develops more for each day it goes without feeding.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bonedrinker makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its bonesoftening bite or its drink bones.

actions.name: Bonsoftening Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or have its bones soften for the next minute, reducing the creature's speed by half.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). The bonedrinker has two tentacles, each of which may grapple a single creature.

actions.name: Drink Bones
actions.description: One creature with softened bones and grappled by the bonedrinker must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 5 (2d4). A creature that has its Constitution reduced to 0 in this way collapses into a pile of loose flesh and dies.

name: Boneless
savingThrows: Str +1, Con +1, Int -4, Wis -2, Cha -3
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Poisoned

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.description: While it is wrapped around a creature, the boneless takes only half the damage dealt to it by creatures it is not grappling, and the creature grappled by the boneless takes the other half.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The boneless can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Clinging Slam
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage and the boneless wraps itself around the target (escape DC 11). While the boneless is wrapped around it, a creature cannot speak or breathe, and the boneless moves with the target.

actions.name: Throttle
actions.description: One creature the boneless is wrapped around must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or have the air driven from its lungs and begin to suffocate.

name: Squirming Skull
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -5, Wis -1, Cha -3

traits.name: Bonesense
traits.description: The skull can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet, and does not suffer Disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it can't see.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the skull takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the skull takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Squirming Snap
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 Piercing damage.

actions.name: Reattach
actions.description: The skull attaches itself to a hydra within 5 feet of it, becoming one of the hydra's heads. The hydra regains 15 Hit Points and must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the start of its next turn.

name: Bone Hydra
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +6, Con +8, Int -3, Wis -1, Cha -3
resistances: Piercing and Slashing from Attacks made without Advantage

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.description: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has Advantage on saving throws against being Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and knocked Unconscious. Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage from a single source, it loses a head. If none of this damage was Bludgeoning damage, a Squirming Skull that acts on the hydra's turn appears in the nearest unoccupied space to it.

traits.name: Bonesense
traits.description: The head can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet, and does not suffer Disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it can't see.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.description: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hydra makes as many Snapping Skull attacks as it has heads.

actions.name: Snapping Skull
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 17). The hydra cannot use this attack if it has no heads.

actions.name: Skeletal Slam
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the hydra's next turn.

actions.name: Worry
actions.description: One creature grappled by at least two of the hydra's heads must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution throw or take 55 (10d10) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save with Disadvantage if it is grappled by three or more heads.

name: Boneyard
savingThrows: Str +12, Dex +2, Con +10, Int -1, Wis +9, Cha -1

traits.name: Ossuary Call
traits.description: Skeletal Undead within 30 feet of the boneyard may use its attack bonus (+12) in place of their own.

traits.name: Bone Feast
traits.description: The boneyard draws forth and absorbs nearby bones; corpses and skeletal Undead whose space the boneyard enters are destroyed. The boneyard regains 10 Hit Points for each creature or corpse destroyed in this way.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the boneyard fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The boneyard makes four attacks, or makes two attacks and uses its Corrupt Marrow.

actions.name: Ghastly Thrash
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 20). If the boneyard uses its Clattering Torrent or Restless Return, each creature Grappled in this way is released.

actions.name: Corrupt Marrow (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: The boneyard sings to the bones of the living, forcing each creature in a 15-foot radius Sphere within 60 feet to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: The creature is Paralyzed until the end of the Boneyard's next turn.

actions.name: Clattering Torrent (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The boneyard churns, flying up to its Speed; each creature whose space it enters this way for the first time on a turn must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage and the creature is knocked Prone. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Restless Return
reactions.description: Trigger: The boneyard takes 20 or more non-Radiant damage from a single source. Response: For each 10 damage the boneyard took, it can spawn one Skeleton Warrior that acts on initiative 0 in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

name: Caller in Darkness
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +4, Con +5, Wis +5, Cha +7
immunities: Cold, Necrotic, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
languages: Understands up to six languages, but can only scream

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The caller can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The caller's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

traits.name: Spirit Void
traits.description: Spirits drawn into the caller are subsumed within it, and are destroyed if it is destroyed. A spirit destroyed in this way can't be revived by any means short of a wish spell. If the caller in darkness would receive any magical healing, it instead receives no healing and must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or release the spirit most recently absorbed into it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The caller uses its withering touch four times, one of which it may replace with a use of its Soul Calling.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Soul Calling
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet with 0 Hit Points must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw or have its Charisma score reduced by 2 (1d4) for the next minute. A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 0 in this way dies and has its soul drawn into and absorbed by the caller.

actions.name: Soulstorm (Concentration)
actions.description: The caller turns invisible until the start of its next turn, and each Large or smaller unattended object within 60 feet begins to levitate and thrash about. A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Visage of Shared Misery (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the caller that can see it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the caller's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls prone and loses Hit Points equal to half its maximum as a screaming fragment of the creature's soul tears itself free and is absorbed into the caller.

reactions.name: Drifting Apparition
reactions.description: When the caller is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

reactions.name: Draw Forth
reactions.description: When a creature within 30 feet fails a death save, the caller can use its Soul Calling, targeting that creature.

name: Coach-A-Bower
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +2, Wis +1, Cha +2
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Grim Portent
traits.description: A creature that sees or hears the coach-a-bower for the first time must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma savin throw or gain a Doom Counter that lasts for a minute. If the creature drops to 0 Hit Points, it immediately fails one Death Save for each Doom Counter it has.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The coach-a-bower uses its careening charge twice, one of which it may replace with its Chiming of the Hollow Vault, if available.

actions.name: Careening Charge
actions.description: The coach-a-bower moves up to 20 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any creature smaller than Huge. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed ahead of the coach-a-bower for the rest of this move, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

actions.name: Chiming of the Hollow Vault (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each living creature with zero Hit Points within 60 feet of the cart must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or begin to levitate until it regains any Hit Points. A creature levitating in this way moves 10 feet toward the coach-a-bower at the beginning of each of the creature's turns. If it ends this movement in the coach-a-bower's space, the creature is sealed into a coffin in coach and restrained (escape DC 14). If the coach-a-bower already has a creature restrained in this way, the effect instead ends, draping the creature's body across the coffin and increasing the escape DC by 2 instead.

reactions.name: Douse in Blood
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature attempts to hit the coach-a-bower with a melee attack, a bucketful of blood is flung from the shadowy interior of the coach. The attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or have its attack miss and suffer Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against being Frightened in the next minute.

name: Coldlight Walker
savingThrows: Str +2, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +3, Cha -1
immunities: Cold, Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Thawing Permafrost
traits.description: If the walker takes any Fire damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or lose its damage resistances and gain the ability to Dash as a Bonus Action for the next minute.

traits.name: Blinding Light
traits.description: The walker sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. As a bonus action, the walker can force one creature in its bright light to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of the walker's next turn.

traits.name: Icy Doom
traits.description: A creature killed by the walker freezes for 9 days, during which time it can't be thawed, animated or raised from the dead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The walker makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) cold damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Cold Ray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet that the walker can see must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 49 (9d10) Cold damage, or half as much on a success. A grappled creature makes this save at Disadvantage.

reactions.name: Chill Weapon
reactions.description:
When the walker is hit by a melee attack
with a metal weapon, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Cold damage and drop its weapon. If the creature attempts to pick the weapon up this turn, it must repeat this saving throw.

name: Crawling Apocalypse
savingThrows: Str +7, Con +9, Int +2, Wis +8, Cha +9
immunities: Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned

traits.name: Binding Seals
traits.description: Whenever the apocalypse takes 20 or more Fire damage from a single source, it may attempt a DC 25 Charisma Saving Throw. On a success, its bursts its binding seals. The apocalypse loses its vulnerability to Fire damage, its attacks are made at Advantage, and it loses 11 (2d10) Hit Points whenever it makes an attack.

traits.name: Titanic Scale
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the malukant may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 15 Dexterity (Athletics) or Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the apocalypse's tentacles. A creature may attempt the same check to climb from the apocalypse's tentacles to its body, or from its body to its head. *

traits.name: Tentacles
traits.description: While climbing on the apocalypse's tentacles, a creature has Advantage on attacks against it. Whenever the apocalypse makes an attack or uses its Rotting Tentacle Sweep, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall off. *

traits.name: Body
traits.description: While climbing on the apocalypse's body, a creature has Advantage on attacks against it, and can't be affected by the apocalypse's Rotting Tentacle Sweep. *

traits.name: Head
traits.description: While climbing on the apocalypse's head, a creature has Advantage on attacks against it, can't be affected by the apocalypse's Rotting Tentacle Sweep, and its attacks against the apocalypse score a critical on an 18-20.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The apocalypse has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the apocalypse fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The apocalypse makes two attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its Rotting Tentacle Sweep or its Despairing Glare.

actions.name: Crushing Slam
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 30 ft. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 15 feet away and knocked prone. Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take half the attack's damage be pushed 10 feet away.

actions.name: Hurl Creature (Requires a grappled creature)
actions.description: Attack: +11 range 30/60 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the thrown creature takes the attack's damage.

actions.name: Rotting Tentacle Sweep
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage and be grappled (escape DC 19). A creature that ends its turn grappled in this way must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or contract Mummy Rot. A creature that succeeds on this save by 5 or more may use its reaction to attempt to climb onto the apocalypse's tentacles.

actions.name: Despairing Glare
actions.description: The apocalypse inflicts a portion of its anguish and resentment upon a creature it can see within 120 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Psychic damage and subtract 1d6 from the next saving throw it makes in the next minute. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more falls prone and cannot stand, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Breath of Ages (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 60-foot cone must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or lose 1d10 unexpended hit dice, or gain a point of exhaustion and age 11 (2d10) years if it cannot. The aging effect can be reversed with a Greater Restoration spell.

name: Crawling Claw
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +2, Int -3, Cha -3

traits.name: Murderous Intent
traits.description: The claw may pick up and wield unattended weapons and improvised weapons without the Heavy or Two-Handed trait. It is proficient with all such weapons.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning or Slashing damage (claw's choice).

actions.name: Grab
actions.description: One Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Strength Saving Throw or have the claw become Attached to it (remove DC 11). When a creature the claw is Attached to in this way makes an attack roll, it rolls a d4 and subtracts it from the total.

actions.name: Squick
actions.description: One creature the claw is Attached to must make a DC 11 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the claw until the end of the claw's next turn, and must use its action to try to kill or remove the claw.

reactions.name: Skittering Shift
reactions.description: When the claw targeted with an attack while grabbing a creature, it may move up to 5 feet. If this movement makes it an invalid target for the attack, the attack instead targets the creature the claw was grabbing.

name: Swarm of Crawling Claws
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Int -3, Cha -3
immunities: Poison, Turned; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Awful Fingers
traits.description: A creature in the swarm's space has Disadvantage on checks to maintain Concentration and must make a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw to maintain Concentration at the end of each of its turns.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny crawling claw. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Tide of Claws
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 0 ft. ., up to four creatures in the swarm's space. Hit: 12 (4d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage if the swarm has half of its Hit Points or fewer, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled and restrained (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Squick
actions.description: One creature grappled by the swarm must make a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is Frightened of the swarm until the end of the swarm's next turn, and must use its action to try to kill or escape the swarm.

name: Giant Crawling Claw
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -3, Cha -3
languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak

traits.name: Delicate Joints
traits.description: If the claw takes 10 or more Bludgeoning damage from a single source, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or fall prone and release any creatures it has grappled.

actions.name: Giant Flick
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Grasping Pounce
actions.description: The claw leaps toward a Medium or smaller creature within 20 feet and attempts to grasp it. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone and grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Crush
actions.description: One creature grappled by the claw must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Scuttle
reactions.description: When the claw would make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can move up to 10 feet. If this movement puts the claw out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the claw is unaffected.

name: Death Knight Aspirant
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +4, Con +4, Wis +5, Cha +3

traits.name: Profane Resistance
traits.description:
The knight has Advantage on saving throws against spells
and other magical effects, except against those with a divine source.

traits.name: Deathless March
traits.description: While the knight is not incapacitated, Undead allies of CR 4 or lower within 60 feet of it have Advantage on attacks and saving throws.

traits.name: Grave Purge (2/Day)
traits.description: At the start of each of the knight's turns, it can end one condition or spell affecting it. If it does, it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The knight makes three attacks.

actions.name: Dreadblade
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. While this weapon is intact, creatures killed by it can't be returned to life.

actions.name: Necroflame Torrent
actions.description: Black flames spew forth in a 30-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 14 (4d6) Fire damage plus 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Destructive Wave (1/Day, Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Each creature of the knight's choice in a 30-foot Emanation must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 17 (5d6) Thunder damage plus 17 (5d6) Necrotic damage Success: Half damage.

bonusActions.name: No Escape
bonusActions.description: One Humanoid creature the knight can see within 150 feet is dragged up to 30 feet toward the knight, then must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature falls Prone.

bonusActions.name: Grim Steed
bonusActions.description: The knight conjures and mounts a spectral steed (100 ft. Speed; uses the knight's defenses; dies if it takes 15 or more damage from a single source).

bonusActions.name: Shatter Magic (Level 5 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The knight attempts to end a spell within 60 feet, forcing its controller to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The spell ends and its controller takes 5 (1d10) Force damage per level of the spell.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Trigger: The knight would be hit with a melee attack. Response: The knight adds +4 to its AC against the triggering attack.

name: Death Knight Gravelord
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +6, Con +11, Int +1, Wis +6, Cha +4

traits.name: Profane Resistance
traits.description:
The knight has Advantage on saving throws against spells
and other magical effects, except against those with a divine source.

traits.name: Deathless March
traits.description: While the knight is not incapacitated, Undead allies of CR 8 or lower within 60 feet of it have Advantage on attacks and saving throws.

traits.name: Grave Purge (3/Day)
traits.description: At the start of each of the knight's turns, it can end one condition or spell affecting it. If it does, it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The knight makes three attacks, or makes one attack and uses its Seal of Death's Gate.

actions.name: Dreadblade
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. While this weapon is intact, creatures killed by it can't be returned to life.

actions.name: Seal of Death's Gate (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the knight can see within 60 feet must make a Constitution Saving {{ Throw:}} DC 18. Failure: 36 (8d8) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage has its Hit Point Maximum reduced to 1 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Necroflame Explosion (Level 6 Spell),
actions.description: Black flames erupt in a 20-foot radius Sphere within 150 feet, forcing each creature in the area to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 21 (6d6) Fire damage plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

bonusActions.name: No Escape
bonusActions.description: One Humanoid creature the knight can see within 150 feet is dragged up to 30 feet toward the knight, then must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The creature falls Prone.

bonusActions.name: Tyrant's Glare
bonusActions.description: One creature the knight can see within 60 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The creature is Frightened until the end of the knight's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Shatter Magic (Level 5 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The knight attempts to end a spell within 60 feet, forcing its controller to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The spell ends and its controller takes 5 (1d10) Force damage per level of the spell.

bonusActions.name: Grim Steed
bonusActions.description: The knight conjures and mounts a spectral steed (100 ft. Speed; uses the knight's defenses; dies if it takes 15 or more damage from a single source).

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Trigger: The knight would be hit with a melee attack. Response: The knight adds +6 to its AC against the triggering attack.

reactions.name: Overpower
reactions.description: Trigger: The knight misses with a melee attack. Response: The knight makes a melee attack against the same target with Advantage.

legendaryActions.name: Black Command
legendaryActions.description: Up to two Undead allies of the knight within 60 feet can each use their Reaction to make a melee attack.

legendaryActions.name: Gauntlet Strike
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 5 feet must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: The creature is knocked Prone and Dazed until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Battle Rush (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The knight moves up to its (or its mount's) Speed, then can make two attacks. If it takes any damage during this movement, it regains its Reaction.

name: Defacer
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +2, Int -1, Wis -2, Cha +3
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The defacer can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the defacer doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

traits.name: Frightful Keening
traits.description: The faces that whirl around a defacer's featureless head constantly wail and scream, a terrible sound that travels through solid rock and stone as easily as air. Creatures within 300 ft. of the defacer that can hear it have Disadvantage on saving throws against being Frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The defacer makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Claw of Horrid Countenance
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (4d6 + 3) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma Saving Throw or have its face replaced with the screaming, ghostly face of one of the defacer's previous victims. Until the end of the defacer's next turn, the target cannot see, speak, or breathe.

actions.name: Steal Face (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or take 44 (8d10) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this damage has its face stolen, as its features melt off and slide away leaving only blank flesh behind until the defacer is slain. A faceless creature can still breath and speak, though it is difficult to tell how.

reactions.name: Screaming Chorus
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the defacer forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the defacer's next turn.

name: Demilich Derelict
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +5, Con +5, Wis +6, Cha +10
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Weapons, Turned; Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.description: If the demilich is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Weightless Careening
traits.description: Whenever the demilich takes damage from a source it is not resistant to, it is pushed 30 feet away from the source. If it hits a wall or object, it bounces.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.description: If the demilich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: The demilich targets up to three creatures that it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be forced to expend a number of hit dice equal to the amount it failed by. A creature that cannot instead drops to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Howl (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The demilich emits a bloodcurdling howl. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the howl must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or drop to 0 Hit Points. On a successful save, the creature is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Mindlost Cackle
reactions.description: When the demilich succeeds on a saving throw against a spell, it can force the spellcaster to succeed on a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or lose its highest level unexpended spell slot.

legendaryActions.name: Chatter
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 30 feet that is concentrating and can hear the demilich must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or lose concentration.

legendaryActions.name: Choking Dust
legendaryActions.description: The area within 10 feet of the demilich becomes heavily obscured until the end of its next turn. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be unable to speak or breathe until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Wither
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 60 feet that the demilich can see takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

name: Demilich Ascetic
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +5, Con +11, Int +12, Wis +9, Cha +12
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Weapons, Turned; Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.description: If the demilich is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Paralyzing Aura
traits.description: A creature that damages the demilich with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or be Paralyzed until the end of the demilich's next turn, or until the creature takes damage.

traits.name: Magemind's Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the demilich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If the demilich was concentrating, it loses concentration.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The demilich uses its Baleful Telekinesis four times.

actions.name: Baleful Telekinesis
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet that the demilich can see must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be moved 30 feet. If this movement carries the creature into a wall or other solid surface, the target takes 33 (6d10) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Wrench Heart (Level 7 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet that the demilich can see feels a spectral hand sink into its chest and grip its heart. At the beginning of each of the creature's turns it takes 45 (10d8) Necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Disintegrate (Level 6 Spell, (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 80 (10d6 + 45) Force damage, or half as much on a success. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, they are disintegrated.

reactions.name: Shield (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: When the demilich is targeted with an attack, it may add 5 to its AC until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Spelldrain Cackle
reactions.description: When a creature the demilich can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the demilich forces the spellcaster to succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw or have the spell fail, then lose its highest level unexpended spell slot.

reactions.name: Howl (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the demilich is reduced below 154 Hit Points, it emits a bloodcurdling howl. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the howl must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or drop to 0 Hit Points. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more immediately fails two death saving throws.

legendaryActions.name: Life Drain
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or be forced to expend a number of hit dice equal to the amount it failed by. A creature that cannot instead drops to 0 Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Chatter
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 30 feet that is concentrating and can hear the demilich must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or lose concentration.

legendaryActions.name: Choking Dust
legendaryActions.description: The area within 10 feet of the demilich becomes heavily obscured until the end of its next turn. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or be unable to speak or breathe until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Wither
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 60 feet that the demilich can see takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

name: Devourer
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +1, Con +5, Int +1, Cha +3

traits.name: Corpsechurn Incubator
traits.description: At the start of the devourer's turn, each creature restrained in its Ribcage Embrace takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. A humanoid creature with at least 5 hit dice that dies while restrained in this way rises immediately as an Abyssal Ghoul that acts directly after the devourer.

traits.name: Avatar of Hunger
traits.description: At the end of the devourer's turn, up to three undead creatures of CR 5 or below that it passed within 5 feet of it on its turn may use their reactions to move up to half their speed toward the nearest creature and make a melee attack.

traits.name: Death's Aid
traits.description: When the devourer fails a saving throw, it may kill any number of friendly undead creatures of CR 5 or below it can see within 60 feet. It adds +2 to its saving throw for each creature killed in this way.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devourer makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Ribcage Embrace, if available.

actions.name: Rotclaw Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus Hit: 13 (3d8) necrotic damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). This attack scores a critical on an 18-20 against a creature with fewer than 50 Hit Points.

actions.name: Ribcage Embrace
actions.description: One creature grappled by either the devourer or a ghoul within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Piercing damage and be shoved into the devourer's ribcage and restrained there (escape DC 18). Each other creature restrained in the devourer's ribcage may use its reaction to attempt to escape, succeeding automatically if it is undead.

actions.name: Raise the Horde (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each humanoid corpse within 60 feet of the devourer that has been dead for no longer than 1 year rises as a Horde Ghoul that acts directly after the devourer.

reactions.name: Blasphemous Abrogation
reactions.description: When a creature the devourer can see within 60 feet casts a spell or produces a magical effect with a divine source, the devourer forces that creature to make a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failure, the spell or effect is negated and the creature takes 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage.

reactions.name: Favored of the Deathlord (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the devourer is reduced below 90 Hit Points, the devourer may reduce any number of friendly undead it can see within 60 feet to 0 Hit Points, regaining Hit Points equal to the total Hit Points lost in this way.

name: Ancient Black Dracolich
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +9, Con +14, Int +3, Wis +9, Cha +11

traits.name: Sensitivity Aura
traits.description:
Attacks against creatures
within 15 feet of the dracolich that do not have acid resistance or immunity score a critical on a roll of 18-20.

traits.name: Soul Vessel
traits.description: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed dracolich's soul returns to its phylactery. If a phylactery containing a dracolich's soul is placed upon a dragon's corpse for 1d10 days, the dracolich's soul inhabits the new body.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the dracolich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dracolich uses its Frightful Presence and makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Acid Bite
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 15 ft. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) acid damage. If the target is wearing metal armor or a metal shield, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed.

actions.name: Paralyzing Claw
actions.description: Attack: +15 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is Stunned, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or become Paralyzed until the end of the dracolich's turn.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the dracolich's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). On a successful saving throw or when the effect ends for it, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Salt Breath (Recharges when the dracolich uses its Flesh Melting Breath)
actions.description: The dracolich exhales a hail of white salt in a 90-foot cone that crusts over creatures in the area, smelling strongly of chlorine. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw or gain vulnerability to Acid damage for the next minute. A creature with resistance or immunity to Acid damage instead cannot benefit from that resistance or immunity for the next minute.

actions.name: Flesh Melting Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The dracolich exhales acid in a 90-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw, taking 67 (15d8) Acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more suffers deformities, gaining Disadvantage on ability checks, saving throws, and attacks based on Strength or Dexterity until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reactions.name: Wilting Glare
reactions.description: When the dracolich is hit with an attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the dracolich's next turn.

reactions.name: Cruel Jest
reactions.description: When a creature attempts to leave the dracolich's reach, the dracolich can force it to succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or be dragged 10 feet back towards the dracolich. If the creature fails this save by 5 or more, the dracolich regains its reaction.

legendaryActions.name: Vomit Swarm
legendaryActions.description: The dracolich disgorges a Swarm of Scorpions into an unoccupied space within 15 feet of it that acts on Initiative count 0 under the dracolich's control.

legendaryActions.name: Mire
legendaryActions.description: The dracolich softens the earth within 10 feet of it until the start of its next turn. A creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or begin to sink into the earth. Until the end of its next turn, the sinking creature has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws, has a -2 penalty to its AC, and can't make more than a single attack in a turn.

legendaryActions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The dracolich beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dracolich must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 16 (2d6 + 9) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dracolich can then fly up to half its speed.

name: Ancient Blue Dracolich
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +7, Con +15, Int +4, Wis +10, Cha +12

traits.name: Building Charge
traits.description: When the dracolich rolls to recharge its Breath Weapons, each creature within 10 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) Lightning damage. If it successfully recharges its Breath Weapons, each of those creatures takes an additional (2d6) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Soul Vessel
traits.description: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed dracolich's soul returns to its phylactery. If a phylactery containing a dracolich's soul is placed upon a dragon's corpse for 1d10 days, the dracolich's soul inhabits the new body.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the dracolich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dracolich uses its Frightful Presence and makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +16 reach 15 ft. Hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Claw
actions.description: Attack: +16 reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d6 + 9) slashing damage. If the target was Stunned, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or become Paralyzed until the end of the dracolich's turn.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the dracolich's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). On a successful saving throw or when the effect ends for it, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The dracolich uses one of the following breath weapons.

actions.name: Animating Lightning Breath
actions.description: The dracolich exhales lightning in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 23 Dexterity Saving Throw, taking 88 (16d10) Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each corpse in the affected area rises at the beginning of the dracolich's next turn as a Flesh Golem under the dracolich's control. A creature with 0 Hit Points that would take damage from this ability instead regains 1 hit point.

actions.name: Desiccation Breath
actions.description: The dracolich inhales, draining the moisture from a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that cone must make a DC 23 Constitution Saving Throw, taking 81 (18d8) Necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is unaffected by the next source of healing it would receive in the next minute. Each potion in the affected area turns to sand.

reactions.name: Wilting Glare
reactions.description: When the dracolich is hit with an attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the dracolich's next turn.

reactions.name: Discharge
reactions.description: When the dracolich succeeds on a saving throw against a spell, the dracolich can force the spell's caster to take 5 (1d10) Lightning damage per level of the spell.

legendaryActions.name: Ionic Attunement
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 60 feet must succeed a DC 23 Constitution Saving Throw or lose any resistance to Lightning damage that it has for the next minute and suffer Disadvantage on the next Dexterity Saving Throw it makes in that time.

legendaryActions.name: Gather Charge
legendaryActions.description: The dracolich moves up to half its speed. If it is hit with an attack in the course of this movement, it may immediately roll to recharge its Breath Weapons. The dracolich may move through creations of magical force such as those created by the Wall of Force spell with this movement, destroying them.

legendaryActions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The dracolich beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dracolich must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 16 (2d6 + 9) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dracolich can then fly up to half its flying speed.

name: Ancient Green Dracolich
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +8, Con +14, Int +5, Wis +10, Cha +11

traits.name: Forest Walk
traits.description: The dracolich's movement is not impeded by natural or magical foliage.

traits.name: Fouling Aura
traits.description: A creature that imbibes a potion within 30 feet of the dracolich takes 14 (4d6) poison damage, in addition to the potion's other effects. The poison damage occurs before any other effects.

traits.name: Soul Vessel
traits.description: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed dracolich's soul returns to its phylactery. If a phylactery containing a dracolich's soul is placed upon a dragon's corpse for 1d10 days, the dracolich's soul inhabits the new body.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the dracolich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dracolich uses its Frightful Presence and makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 15 ft. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. If the target is resistant or immune to poison damage or the Poisoned condition, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or lose its resistance or immunity. A creature immune to Poison damage makes this saving throw at Advantage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Claw
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage. If the target was Stunned, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or be Paralyzed until the end of the dracolich's turn.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 15 ft. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 15 feet away.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the dracolich's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). On a successful saving throw or when the effect ends for it, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Entangling Breath (Recharges when the dracolich uses its Miasma Breath)
actions.description: The dracolich exhales a flurry of blackened seeds in a 90-foot cone, causing barbed vines to burst from the earth. Each creature in the area when it appears must make a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained. Until the dracolich uses this ability again, the area is difficult terrain and whenever a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 18 (4d8) Piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

actions.name: Miasma Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The dracolich exhales a poisonous cloud in a 90-foot cone that lasts until th ened of its next turn, heavily obscuring the area. A creature in the area when it appears or that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw or take 77 (22d6) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or falls immediately prone, retching.

reactions.name: Adapt Camouflage
reactions.description: When the dracolich is hit with a ranged attack, it can cloak itself in illusory magics to match its surroundings. Until the end of its next turn, the dracolich becomes Invisible to creatures more than 30 feet away from it.

reactions.name: Savage
reactions.description: When a creature the dracolich can see within 20 feet resists or negates a source of poison damage, the dracolich can move up to half its speed toward and make a bite attack against the creature.

reactions.name: Murderous Glare (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the dracolich is reduced below 100 Hit Points, the dracolich unleashes a torrent of negative energy at a creature it can see within 60 feet. If the creature has fewer than 100 Hit Points, it dies.

legendaryActions.name: Blinding Spit
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of the dracolich's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Snatch
legendaryActions.description: The dracolich moves up to 15 feet and makes a Paralyzing Claw attack against a creature that it is hidden from. If the attack hits, the target is grappled, Stunned, and hidden from its allies until the start of its next turn. If the dracolich was hidden, this attack does not automatically reveal its position.

legendaryActions.name: Slink Away (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The dracolich moves up to half its fly speed. Attacks of opportunity provoked by this movement are made at Disadvantage. If it ends this movement in cover, it may immediately attempt to hide.

name: Ancient Red Dracolich
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex +8, Con +17, Int +4, Wis +10, Cha +14

traits.name: Searing Aura
traits.description: When a creature without fire resistance or immunity starts its turn within 10 feet of the dracolich, it catches fire and begins Burning (1d10).

traits.name: Soul Vessel
traits.description: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed dracolich's soul returns to its phylactery. If a phylactery containing a dracolich's soul is placed upon a dragon's corpse for 1d10 days, the dracolich's soul inhabits the new body.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the dracolich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dracolich uses its Frightful Presence and makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 15 ft. Hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Claw
actions.description: Attack: +17 reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage. If the target was Stunned, it must make a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or become Paralyzed until the end of the dracolich's turn.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
