On a successful saving throw or when the effect ends for it, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Breath of Dying Flames (Recharges when the dracolich uses its Necrofire Wake)
actions.description: The dracolich breathes malicious intent into all flames in a 90-foot cone, extinguishing them and summoning a Belker that lasts for a minute and acts on initiative count 20 in the space of each creature in the area that was on fire.

actions.name: Necrofire Wake (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The dracolich moves up to its fly speed, and a 15-foot wide section of the ground it passes over erupts in a wall of black flames that lasts until the end of the dracolich's next turn as it strafes with its breath. A creature that starts its turn in the wall's area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 91 (26d6) Fire damage, or half as much damage on a success. A creature in the wall that would receive any healing instead takes an equal amount of Necrotic damage.

reactions.name: Wilting Glare
reactions.description: When the dracolich is hit with an attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the dracolich's next turn.

reactions.name: Billowing Wings
reactions.description: When the dracolich takes 30 or more damage from a single source, it may shroud itself in smoke, heavily obscuring the area in a 40-foot radius until the end of its next turn, then immediately move up to half its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Manipulate Flames
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 90 feet of the dracolich and within 30 feet of a flame must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 5 (1d10) Fire damage and catch fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

legendaryActions.name: Inhale (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The dracolich rolls to recharge its necrofire wake.

legendaryActions.name: Tail Sweep (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 15 feet of the dracolich must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 16 (2d6 + 9) Bludgeoning damage, be knocked prone, and pushed up to 15 feet away from the dracolich.

name: Ancient White Dracolich
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +6, Con +14, Int +4, Wis +7, Cha +8

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.description: The dracolich can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

traits.name: Black Ice Aura
traits.description: The area in a 10-foot radius around the dracolich is difficult terrain. A creature that enters it for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone.

traits.name: Soul Vessel
traits.description: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed dracolich's soul returns to its phylactery. If a phylactery containing a dracolich's soul is placed upon a dragon's corpse for 1d10 days, the dracolich's soul inhabits the new body.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the dracolich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dracolich uses its Frightful Presence and makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 15 ft. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Claw
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is stunned, it must make a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or become paralyzed until the end of the dracolich's turn.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 15 ft. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 15 feet away from the dracolich.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the dracolich's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). On a successful saving throw or when the effect ends for it, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Ice Tomb Breath (Recharges when the dracolich uses its Blizzard Breath)
actions.description: The dracolich exhales a burst of ice in a 90-foot cone that clings to living creatures, sapping their vitality. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or gain 45 (10d8) Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, a creature is restrained and must make a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw at the beginning of each of its turns. On a failed save, a creature loses two unexpended hit dice, or drops to 0 Hit Points if it cannot.

actions.name: Blizzard Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The dracolich exhales a blast of ice and thrashing winds in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 22 Constitution Saving Throw, taking 72 (16d8) Cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the end of the dracolich's next turn, the area is difficult terrain and heavily obscured.

reactions.name: Sudden Pounce
reactions.description: When a creature within 80 feet of the dracolich ends its turn further away from the dracolich than it started, the dracolich can move up to its speed toward the creature and make a claw attack against it. If the target is Frightened, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the dracolich's next turn.

reactions.name: Consume Vitality
reactions.description: When the dracolich succeeds on a saving throw against a spell, it can force the spellcaster to make a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the spell caster loses two unexpended hit dice and the dracolich regains 18 (1d20 + 8) Hit Points for each hit die lost this way. If the spell caster can't expend any hit dice, it instead drops to 0 Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Raise Hackles
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or lose any immunity it has to the dracolich's Frightful Presence or the Frightened condition.

legendaryActions.name: Terrorize
legendaryActions.description: One Frightened creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. On the creature's next turn, it must use its full movement to run away from the dracolich.

legendaryActions.name: Uttercold
legendaryActions.description: The dracolich draws on its deepest reserves. Until the end of its next turn, Cold damage the dracolich deals ignores damage resistance, and the dracolich loses one of its legendary resistances.

name: Dread
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -2, Wis -1, Cha -3
languages: Understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Unliving Warrior
traits.description: The dread has proficiency with all weapons.

traits.name: Habitual Height
traits.description: The dread can fly only so long as it is within 5 ft. of a solid surface.

traits.name: Bonesense
traits.description: The dread can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 ft. of it, and does not suffer Disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

actions.name: Dread Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the creature is Grappled (escape DC 12). A creature grappled in this way cannot speak or breathe, and must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw at the start of each of its turns or be Frightened until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Throttle
actions.description: One creature grappled by the dread must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 13 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage and lose its breath, if it was holding it, or take half as much damage on a failure.

reactions.name: Wrest Weapon
reactions.description: When it is missed with a melee weapon attack by a creature it has grappled, the dread can force the creature to make a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, the grapple ends and the dread pulls the attacker's weapon from from its hands.

name: Dullahan
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +7, Wis +2, Cha +3
resistances: Cold, Lightning, Poison; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from weapons that aren't Gilded or Named

traits.name: Dark Rider
traits.description: While riding a creature, the dullahan acts on its mount's initiative, rather than rolling its own, and it scores a critical hit on a roll of 17-20 on attacks made against a creature that is Frightened.

traits.name: Repelled by Gold
traits.description: The dullahan has Disadvantage on attacks that target a creature brandishing a gold object. If a creature flings gold toward it, the dullahan must succeed on DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to move up to half its speed away from the creature.

traits.name: Portended Resilience (3/Day)
traits.description: If the dullahan fails a saving throw on the night of a solstice, equinox, or feast-day, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dullahan makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Headtaker Blade
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. On a critical hit, the target is nonlethally decapitated and has its head roll 20 feet in a random direction. A decapitated creature is Blinded and has its movement speed reduced by half while more than 5 feet from its head, and can reattach its head as an Action. A creature that remains headless for a minute dies.

actions.name: Spine Whip
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or lose an eye if it can see the dullahan.

actions.name: Fearsome Gaze
actions.description: Each creature that can see the dullahan must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the beginning of the dullahan's next turn. A creature with one or more Doom Counters makes this save at Disadvantage.

actions.name: Plane Shift (Level 7 Spell, 1/Day)
actions.description: The dullahan and its mount teleport to another plane of existence.

reactions.name: Wrathful Parry
reactions.description: As a reaction when it is targeted with an attack, the dullahan adds 4 to its AC against that attack. If the attack misses and the dullahan has fewer than half its Hit Points, the dullahan may make a melee attack as part of this reaction.

reactions.name: Headless Wail (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction when the dullahan is reduced below 106 Hit Points, the dullahan releases an echoing shriek from its headless stump. Each creature that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or drop anything it's holding and be Frightened until the end of the dullahan's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Spine Whip
legendaryActions.description: The dullahan makes an attack with its spine whip.

legendaryActions.name: Go Where the Devil Drives
legendaryActions.description: The dullahan or its mount moves up to its speed in a straight line, telekinetically flinging aside all obstacles before it to clear its path. A creature in its path makes a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw, taking 5 (1d10) Fire damage and being pushed to the nearest unoccupied space out of the dullahan's path on a success, or halting the dullahan's passage on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Speak Name (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The dullahan speaks the name of a creature within 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw or gain a Doom Counter that lasts a minute. If the creature drops to 0 Hit Points, it immediately fails one Death Save for each Doom Counter it has. A creature with three or more Doom Counters that is killed by the dullahan can't be restored to life by any means short of a Wish spell.

name: Drowned Conscript
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +3, Con +1, Cha +1
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the conscript takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the conscript takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

traits.name: Damned Conscript
traits.description: If the crewmate's captain is destroyed, the conscript is reduced to 0 Hit Points at the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The crewmate can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The crewmate's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

actions.name: Cadaverous Blades (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Slashing damage.

actions.name: Ghastly Pangs
actions.description: The conscript moves up to its speed in a straight line without provoking Opportunity Attacks, dealing 3 Necrotic damage to each Frightened creature whose space it moves through in this way.

name: Drowned Crewmate
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +3, Con +2, Cha +1
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Damned Crew
traits.description: If the crewmate's captain is destroyed, it gains one point of Exhaustion at the beginning of each of its turns.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The crewmate can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The crewmate's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

actions.name: Ghostlit Pike
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Ghastly Glare (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: One creature the crewmate can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the crewmate's next turn. An already Frightened creature that fails this saving throw additionally takes 22 (4d10) Psychic damage.

reactions.name: Drifting Apparition
reactions.description: When the crewmate is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

reactions.name: Mariners' Curse (1/Day)
reactions.description: When an Unconscious creature the crewmate can see within 30 feet awakens, the crewmate can force it to succeed on a DC 12 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed with a random effect from the Mariners' Curses table until it steps upon dry land.

name: Drowned Captain
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +4, Con +4, Int +2, Cha +4
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Damned Resistance
traits.description: If the captain is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it can reduce one friendly Drowned Crewmate it can see within 30 feet to 0 Hit Points. If it does, the captain is instead reduced to 1 hit point and can end all Conditions affecting it.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The crewmate can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The captain's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

traits.name: Cursed Return
traits.description: When the captain is killed, each living creature within 60 feet is Cursed with a random effect from the Mariners' Curses table until it steps upon dry land. If each of those creatures dies or has its curse removed, the captain and its crew are restored to undeath at the next full moon in the ocean where they first died.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The captain makes two attacks with its Moonglare Cutlass, one of which it can replace with a use of its Blood-Thick Chill.

actions.name: Moonglare Cutlass
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. This attack has Advantage if its target is at least Dimly Lit by moonlight.

actions.name: Blood-Thick Chill
actions.description: One creature the captain can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the captain's next turn. An already Frightened creature that fails this saving throw additionally takes 27 (6d8) Cold damage and is Dazed for the same duration.

reactions.name: Drifting Apparition
reactions.description: When the captain is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

reactions.name: Press-Gang
reactions.description: When a Cursed living creature the captain can see within 30 feet dies, it can immediately raise the creature as a Drowned Crewmate. At the beginning of each of the raised creature's turns, it must succeed on a DC 10 Charisma Saving Throw or be Dominated by the captain until the start of its next turn. After three failed saving throws, this Domination lasts until dispelled.

legendaryActions.name: Deny Rest
legendaryActions.description: The captain restores one Drowned Conscript or Drowned Crewmate within 60 feet that died in the last minute to undeath with 11 Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Wicked Whispers
legendaryActions.description: The captain echoes forth a profane and tyrannous command, dealing 7 (2d6) Psychic damage to a creature within 30 feet that can hear it. If the target is undead, it can use its reaction either to make a melee attack or turn to mist and disappear, reappearing at the start of its next turn in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of where it departed.

legendaryActions.name: Moonglare Slash (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The captain moves up to 15 feet and makes an attack with its Moonglare Cutlass.

name: Ephemeral Swarm
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +1, Int -4, Cha -3
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature or object's space and vice versa. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The swarm's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

traits.name: Foul Tide
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space or affected by its Invade Body must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the start of its following turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more is infected with Wraithplague.

actions.name: Gnaw From Within
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 0 ft. Hit: 25 (10d4) necrotic damage and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature begins to retch blood, and cannot speak or breathe until the end of the swarm's next turn.

actions.name: Invade Body
actions.description: One creature in the swarm's space must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma Saving Throw or have the swarm pour into its body through its mouth and any open wounds, disappearing. At the end of each of the creature's turns, it repeats this saving throw, ejecting the swarm and causing it to reappear within 5 feet of the creature on a success, or having its Constitution score reduced by 1d4, to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Short or Long Rest on a failure.

name: Eye of Fear and Flame
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +2, Con +8, Int +4, Wis +7, Cha +8

traits.name: Keeper of the Ashen Covenant
traits.description: If a humanoid creature that the eye can see within 60 feet would die, it instead regains half its maximum Hit Points, its creature type becomes undead, and it acts under the eye's control.

traits.name: Deathpact
traits.description: When a living creature makes a deal with the eye, the eye may seal it with powerful necrotic magics. The first time that either creature acts in a manner directly counter to the terms of the deal, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or die.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The eye makes two attacks with its Flameharrow's Touch and uses either its Eye of Fear or Eye of Flame.

actions.name: Flameharrow's Touch
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. If the target was Frightened, it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or act under the eye's control on its following turn.

actions.name: Eye of Fear
actions.description: One creature the eye can see within 90 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Psychic damage and be Frightened until the end of the eye's next turn. While Frightened in this way, a creature's movement speed is halved and it has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

actions.name: Eye of Flame
actions.description: One creature the eye can see within 90 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Fire damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage and be Burning (1d10). If the target was Frightened, each creature within 10 feet of it must make this saving throw.

reactions.name: Invocation of the Bloodlord (Level 2 Spell)
reactions.description: When a friendly creature drops to 0 Hit Points, the eye can prevent it from falling unconscious until the end of the target's next turn.

reactions.name: Deadfire Escape (Level 5 Spell, 1/Day)
reactions.description: When the eye is reduced to 0 Hit Points, before falling unconscious, it can teleport to Thanatos. Each creature within 10 feet of the space the eye departed must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Fire damage.

name: Fear Moth Swarm
savingThrows: Dex +4, Con +2, Int -4, Wis +2, Cha +4
immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Returning Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a small creature. At the beginning of the swarmes turn, it and each other undead creature in the swarm's space regains 5 Hit Points.

actions.name: Sweeping Mass
actions.description: The swarm moves up to half its speed. Each creature whose space it moves through takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone if it is Medium or smaller.

actions.name: Wave of Fear (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each living creature within 20 feet that can see the swarm must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the swarm's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is additionally Stunned until the end of the swarm's next turn.

reactions.name: Fill Mouth
reactions.description: When a creature in the swarm's space attempts to speak or otherwise opens its mouth, dozens of moths pour into its mouth. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or begin Choking until it clears them as an action.

name: Flameskull
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +3, Con +2, Int +3
immunities: Cold, Fire, Poison; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The flameskull sheds either dim light in a 15-foot radius, or bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. It can switch between the options as an action.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: If the flameskull is destroyed, it regains all its Hit Points in 1 hour unless holy water is sprinkled on its remains or a Dispel Magic or Remove Curse spell is cast on them.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The flameskull has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Spontaneous Combustion (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: One creature within 40 feet that the flameskull can see must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Fire damage and ignite. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage at the end of each of its turns.

actions.name: Fireburst (Level 1 Spell)
actions.description: One burning creature within 20 feet erupts in an explosion of flame. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

reactions.name: Screaming Flame (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: When the flameskull is targeted with a melee attack, it screams a gout of flame at the attacker, forcing it to succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Fire damage and make its attack with Disadvantage.

name: Gashadokuro
savingThrows: Str +9, Con +6, Int -2, Wis +4, Cha -3
resistances: Necrotic; Piercing and Slashing from attacks made without Advantage

traits.name: Bone Titan
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the gashadokuro may spend half its movement to attempt to climb onto the gashadokuro's legs, or to climb between any two connected segments, with a successful DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check. *

traits.name: Legs
traits.description:
Whenever the gashadokuro moves on its turn, each creature climbing on its legs must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or fall off.
*

traits.name: Arms
traits.description:
Whenever the gashadokuro uses its Claw Sweep, each creature climbing on its arms must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or fall off.
*

traits.name: Ribs
traits.description:
A creature climbing on the gashadokuro's ribs has Advantage on melee attacks against the gashadokuro.
*

traits.name: Skull
traits.description: A creature climbing on the gashadokuro's skull has Advantage on melee attacks against the gashadokuro. If a creature on the gashadokuro's head scores a critical hit against it, the gashadokuro falls prone and takes 35 (8d6) Bludgeoning damage at the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Sustained by Rage
traits.description: The gashadokuro does not die or fall unconscious when reduced to 0 Hit Points. Instead, it falls prone at the end of its next turn, cannot stand, and deals half as much damage with its attacks and abilities. Whenever the gashadokuro takes any radiant damage or starts its turn in sunlight, it loses one unexpended hit die, or dies if it cannot.

traits.name: Ravenous Resistance (Costs 3 Hit Dice)
traits.description: If the gashadokuro fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Clattering Snap (Costs 2 Hit Dice)
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 15 ft., one grappled target. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be decapitated. On a successful saving throw, the target takes 64 (10d10 + 9) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Titanclaw Sweep (Costs 2 Hit Dice)
actions.description: The gashadokuro sweeps its bony claws in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area that is not climbing on the gashadokuro must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 30 (6d6 + 9) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. The gashadokuro may additionally grapple up one creature that failed this saving throw (escape DC 17). Each other creature that fails this saving throw is pushed up to 15 feet away. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw by 5 or more can use its reaction to climb onto the gashadokuro's arms.

reactions.name: Crush of Bones
reactions.description: When a creature climbing on the gashadokuro's ribs deals damage to it, the gashadokuro can force it to succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Bludgeoning damage and be restrained (escape DC 17) until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Roadstalker's Chatter (Concentration)
legendaryActions.description: The gashadokuro becomes Invisible to creatures more than 15 feet away from it until it takes another action. A creature the gashadokuro can see hears a sourceless clatter of bone on bone whenever the gashadokuro moves.

legendaryActions.name: Mekurabe Gaze (Concentration)
legendaryActions.description: The gashadokuro fixes its hollow gaze upon a creature that can see it within 60 feet, which can choose to either meet the gashadokuro's gaze or look away. * A creature that looks away takes 11 (2d10) Psychic damage, is Frightened, and has its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. * A creature that meets the gashadokuro's gaze must Concentrate on doing so, and while concentrating has Advantage on saving throws against the gashadokuro's abilities. If the creature loses concentration before the gashadokuro does, its eyes blacken and it is Blinded until cured by Remove Curse or similar magic.

name: Gaunt
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -4, Cha +2

traits.name: Rattle
traits.description: A creature that hits the gaunt with a melee attack that deals Bludgeoning damage must succeed a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.description: If the gaunt moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The gaunt may make this attack as a bonus action against a prone creature.

actions.name: Grave Chill
actions.description: Each creature within 10 feet that is not riding the gaunt must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or suffer one of the following effects of the gaunt's choice until the end of the gaunt's next turn. Leaden Steps. The target's speed is reduced by 10 feet. Numbed Fingers. The first attack the target makes before the end of the gaunt's following turn is made at Disadvantage. If the attack misses, the creature drops its weapon if it is wielding one. Chattering Teeth. If the creature casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action, the spell does not take effect until the end of the gaunt's next turn.

reactions.name: Quick Kick
reactions.description: When a creature makes an attack against the gaunt that benefits from flanking it, the gaunt can make an Hooves attack against the attacker.

name: Horde Ghoul
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +2, Int -2, Cha -2

traits.name: Snatcher
traits.description: It does not cost the ghoul extra movement to drag a Medium or smaller creature Grappled by it.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the ghoul takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the ghoul takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its Hit Point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Ravenous Bite (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Piercing damage.

actions.name: Corpseclaw Grasp (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target is Grappled (escape DC 13) by each of the ghouls that contributed to this attack. A creature that ends its turn Grappled in this way takes 2 Piercing damage for each ghoul Grappling it.

name: Carrion Ghoul
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +2, Int -2, Cha -2

traits.name: Snatcher

traits.name: Fevered Blood

actions.name: Fleshripper Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Death Grip
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 12). A creature that ends its turn Grappled in this way must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

name: Ghast Ravener
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +2, Cha -1

traits.description: When the ghast is reduced to 0 Hit Points, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation from it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 7 (2d6) Poison damage and the creature is infected with Ghoul Fever.

traits.name: Unholy Defiance
traits.description: The ghast and each other ghoul in a 30-foot Emanation from it has Advantage on saving throws to resist being Frightened or Turned.

actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Death Grip
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). A creature that ends its turn Grappled in this way must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Claw Apart
actions.description: One creature that is Grappled both by the ghast and by one of the ghast's allies must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 22 (5d8) Slashing damage. Success: Half damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage immediately fails a Death Saving Throw.

bonusActions.name: Snatcher's Sprint
bonusActions.description: The ghast moves up to its Speed; until the end of its turn it doesn't need to spend extra movement to drag a Medium or smaller creature Grappled by it.

bonusActions.name: Grave Stench
bonusActions.description: The ghast breathes a cloud of putrid fumes in a 15-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The creature is Poisoned for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn). Success: The creature becomes immune to this ability for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Icy Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) cold damage.

actions.name: Sodden Grip
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Pry Mouth
actions.description: One creature Grappled by the ghoul must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage and the creature loses its breath, if it was holding it. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Murky Dive
reactions.description: Trigger: The ghoul takes any damage while submerged. Response: The ghoul moves up to half its Swim Speed, then can attempt to Hide if no enemy is within 30 feet of it.

name: Abyssal Ghoul
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha -2

traits.name: Fevered Blood

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ghoul makes two attacks with its Death Grip, one of which it can replace with a use of its Slavering Bite or Devour the Fallen.

actions.name: Slavering Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Death Grip
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). A creature that ends its turn Grappled in this way must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Devour the Fallen
actions.description: The ghoul tears into a humanoid corpse within 5 feet, gaining 10 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it has Advantage on all d20 Tests.

reactions.name: Manic Thrash
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature Grappled by the ghoul begins to cast a spell. Response: The creature must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The spell fails.

name: Butcher Ghoul
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +6, Con +4, Int -2, Cha -2

traits.name: Icon of Hunger
traits.description: The ghoul and each of its ghoul allies in a 30-foot Emanation from it have Advantage on melee attacks against targets infected with Ghoul Fever.

traits.name: Fevered Blood
traits.description: When the ghoul is reduced to 0 Hit Points, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation from it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature is infected with Ghoul Fever.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ghoul makes two attacks with its Death Grip.

actions.name: Death Grip
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). A creature that ends its turn Grappled in this way must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Carcass-Splitter
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) slashing damage. If this attack exceeds the target’s AC by 5 or more, it deals an extra 6 (1d12) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Living Feast
actions.description: One creature Grappled by the ghoul must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 28 (8d6) Piercing damage. Success: Half damage. This effect deals maximum damage to a Paralyzed target, instead of rolling.

name: Ghast Gravecaller
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +6, Int +3, Wis +3

traits.description: When the ghast is reduced to 0 Hit Points, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation from it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 7 (2d6) Poison damage and the creature is infected with Ghoul Fever.

traits.name: Unholy Defiance
traits.description: The ghast and each other ghoul in a 30-foot Emanation from it has Advantage on saving throws to resist being Frightened or Turned.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ghast makes three attacks with its Death Grip, one of which it can replace with its Slavering Bite, Devour the Fallen, or Call to Feast.

actions.name: Slavering Bite
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Death Grip
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). A creature that ends its turn Grappled in this way must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Devour the Fallen
actions.description: The ghast tears into a humanoid corpse within 5 feet, gaining 10 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it has Advantage on all d20 Tests.

actions.name: Call to Feast (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: The ghast targets a creature it can see within 30 feet, awakening bloodlust against it. Each creature within 5 feet of the target can use its Reaction to make a melee attack against the target.

actions.name: Litany of Flesh Devoured (Recharge 5-6, Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: The ghast begins a dread chant of torment, forcing each creature of its choice in a 30-foot Emanation from it to make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The next time the creature takes any damage, it takes an equal amount of Psychic damage. Failure by 5 or More: The creature additionally gains a point of Exhaustion.

bonusActions.name: Snatcher's Sprint

bonusActions.name: Grave Stench

Failure: The creature is Poisoned for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn). Success: The creature becomes immune to this ability for 24 hours.

reactions.name: Manic Thrash

reactions.name: Uneasy Grave
reactions.description: Trigger: An allied ghoul within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Response: The ally regains 10 Hit Points.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The ghost's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

traits.name: Agonizing Attachment
traits.description: Whenever 100 gp or more of its horde is destroyed in a turn, the ghost takes 25 Psychic damage.

traits.name: Creeping Whisper
traits.description: The ghost is invisible. Whenever it takes an action other than its Telekinetic Thrash, it becomes visible for 1 minute.

traits.name: Hordebound
traits.description: If the ghost is destroyed while its horde contains less treasure than it did at the moment of its original death, the ghost returns to undeath and regains all of its Hit Points after 9 (2d8) hours, appearing within 60 feet of its horde. If the ghost's horde is restored to its original value, the ghost curls up atop the horde and vanishes, along with its horde.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ghost makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Spectral Bite.

actions.name: Spectral Bite
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 15 ft. Hit: 30 (6d8 + 3) cold damage damage and the target's speed is halved until the start of the dragon's next turn.

actions.name: Covetous Claws
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage and the target must make a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, the ghost snatches one magic item or coinpouch the creature is carrying and flings it up to 30 feet towards the ghost's horde. If the ghost's Hoard Possession is active, it gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Telekinetic Thrash (Recharges when the ghost uses its Terrormist Breath)

actions.name: Terrormist Breath (Recharge 5-6)

A creature that fails by 5 or more has its speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. A living creature that ends its turn in the area ages by 10% of its natural lifespan until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

When the ghost is reduced below 163 Hit Points, the ghost draws its hoard into itself, forming a body of treasure. immunities: Poison, Necrotic, Turned; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Stunned, Unconscious

traits.name: Omenfog Harbinger
traits.description: Air within 1,000 is filled with a freezing and malevolent fog, Heavily Obscuring all vision beyond a range of 30 feet. Creatures in the fog subtract 1d4 from saving throws they make against being Frightened or against effects that deal Cold damage.

traits.name: Ghostfire Wreath
traits.description: The ship is cloaked in dim, blue flames, and is visible as a faint glow from up to 120 feet away, even when Heavily Obscured by fog or water.

traits.name: Liquid Grave
traits.description: Frightened creatures within 120 feet of the ship must Concentrate to hold their breath.

traits.name: Sunlit Decay
traits.description: While illuminated by sunlight, the ghost ship loses its damage resistances and damage threshold, and can't take reactions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ship makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Dread Ram.

actions.name: Dread Ram
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft., one Large or larger target. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or take Hit: 88 (16d10) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. If this does not reduce the target to 0 Hit Points, the ship takes half the attack's damage.

actions.name: Hangman's Rigging
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 20 ft. Hit: The target is grappled and suspended 10 feet above the ship's deck (escape DC 20) until the rope is cut (AC 10, 5 hit point). A creature grappled in this way is Choking and takes 17 (5d6) Bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

actions.name: Encrusted Cannonade (Above Water Only)
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 120 ft. Hit: 44 (8d10) bludgeoning damage. Whenever the ship misses with this attack, it gains a cumulative +1 to hit with this attack for the next minute, to a total maximum bonus of +12.

actions.name: Bleakrime Gust (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The ship and each creature on it turn briefly to mist, then the ship moves up to its speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each living creature it moves through in this way must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Cold damage plus 16 (3d10) Psychic damage and be Frightened until the end of its next turn, or take half as much damage on a success. A creature can't be reduced below 1 hit point by this damage.

actions.name: 9 Fathoms Tread (1/Day)
actions.description: The ship binds itself to a vehicle directly above it within 60 feet, Cursing it until the vehicle moves more than 60 feet away from it. At the beginning of each of its turns, the Cursed vehicle must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or have the ship control its movement until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Leaden Plunge
reactions.description: When the ship is targeted with an attack, it can dive 30 feet directly downward, adding +5 to its AC against the triggering attack. If it does, the ship can't take actions on its following turn.

name: Ghostly Legionnaire
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +4, Wis +1, Cha +2
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned, Unconscious
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Echo of History
traits.description: The legionnaire's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored. If a creature correctly identifies and speaks the legionnaire's origin, it loses this trait and its damage immunities until the next dawn.

traits.name: Soul Link
traits.description: When initiative is rolled, each legionnaire that rolls initiative pools its Hit Points into a single sum. Damage to a legionnaire deducts from that total. When the shared sum of Hit Points reaches zero, each legionnaire that pooled its Hit Points dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The legionnaire makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its terror grip.

actions.name: Spectral Blade
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Terror Grip
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Psychic damage and be Frightened until the beginning of the legionnaire's next turn. A creature Frightened in this way has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws.

actions.name: Battle Visions (1/Day)
actions.description:
One creature within 5 feet must make a DC
15 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature becomes indifferent to undead creatures and hostile to all living creatures as it hallucinates a long-forgotten battlefield. The creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 9 (2d8) Psychic damage on a failure or ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on this save has Advantage on Intelligence (History) checks to determine the legionnaire's origin.

name: Poltergeist
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -2, Wis -2, Cha +3
resistances: Damage other than the type that killed it
immunities: Cold, Necrotic, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The poltergeist can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.description: The poltergeist is invisible. While invisible, the poltergeist can attempt to Hide as a Bonus Action. If fine particles of silver are scattered in its space, it loses this invisibility for the next minute.

traits.name: Unfinished Business
traits.description: When the poltergeist is reduced to 0 HP, it does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, it ceases to be invisible and loses the ability to take actions, though it can still communicate. After 1d4 hours, the poltergeist recovers all of its Hit Points. While at 0 Hit Points, the poltergeist can be destroyed any of the following ways: Resolving its unfinished business. Subjecting it to the same conditions that killed it. Interring its remains with the Ceremony spell.

actions.name: Telekinetic Thrust
actions.description: The poltergeist hurls a creature or object weighing up to 150 lbs. up to 30 feet. An unwilling creature makes a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw, resisting the effect on a success. If a thrown creature strikes a solid object surface, the creature takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Telekinetic Thrash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success. The poltergeist ceases to be invisible until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Drifting Apparition
reactions.description: When the poltergeist is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: Trap Haunt
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +1, Wis +1, Cha +3
resistances: Damage other than the type that killed it
immunities: Cold, Necrotic, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
languages: The languages it knew in life, but only while calm

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The haunt can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons

traits.name: Unfinished Business

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Horrifying Visage (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each living creature within 60 feet of the haunt that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Psychic damage and be Frightened until the end of the haunt's next turn,or take half as much damage on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more also ages by 1d4 x 10% of its natural lifespan until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reactions.name: Drifting Apparition
reactions.description: When the haunt is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

reactions.name: Possession (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the haunt is reduced below 37 Hit Points, it can force one creature it can see within 15 feet to succeed on a DC 13 Charisma Saving Throw or be Possessed until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

name: Tormenting Ghost
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +3, Con +2, Int +6, Wis +7, Cha +9
resistances: Damage other than the type that killed it
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ghost uses its Withering Touch twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Etherealization.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Etherealization
actions.description: The ghost or a creature within 5 feet of it magically shifts into the Border Ethereal from the Material Plane, or vice versa. At the end of each of its turns, an unwilling creature makes a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw, returning to the material plane on a success. Creatures in the Border Ethereal can be seen from the Material Plane and vice versa, but can't affect or be affected by creatures on the Material Plane.

actions.name: Horrifying Visage (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each living creature within 60 feet of the ghost that can see it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Psychic damage and be Frightened until the end of the ghost's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success. reactions.name: Drifting Apparition

reactions.name: Consuming Possession (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the ghost is reduced below 62 Hit Points, it can force one creature it can see within 15 feet to succeed on a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw or be Possessed. While Possessed in this way, a creature has its Charisma score reduced by 1d4, to a minimum of 1, at the beginning of each of its turns, and repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, expelling the ghost on a success. This reduction lasts until the creature completes a Short or Long Rest.

name: Huecuva
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +3, Int +1, Wis +7, Cha +5
immunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Poisoned

traits.name: Revealed by Moonlight
traits.description: The huecuva appears as it did in life, though any clothes it wears darken to black over the course of a day. The touch of moonlight strips away its flesh, revealing its true undead nature. While in moonlight, the huecuva loses its damage immunities and gains vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage from Magical Attacks.

traits.name: Profaner of Blessings
traits.description: Whenever a living creature within 30 feet of one or more huecuvas would add a bonus to its attack or saving throw due to a spell or magical effect, it instead subtracts that amount.

traits.name: Turning Resistance
traits.description: The huecuva has Advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The huecuva makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Mocking Benediction.

actions.name: Bony Gouge
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Huecuva Blight.

actions.name: Mocking Benediction (Concentration)
actions.description: Up to three creatures the huecuva can see receive its blessing, adding 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws they make for the next minute. An unwilling creature makes a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw, resisting the effect on a success. Whenever a creature affected by this blessing fails a saving throw, it takes 1d10 Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Litany of Forsaken Vows (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The huecuva begins a wretched chant that corrupts a mortal's connection to the divine. Each creature of the huecuva's choice within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw or be cursed. Whenever the cursed creature receives magical healing, it gains the same amount of Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the creature is hostile to all living creatures.

name: Homebound Jiangshi
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -4, Con +3, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -1
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks That Aren't Peachwood
languages: Understands the languages it knew in life but cannot speak them

traits.name: Hopping Movement
traits.description: When initiative is rolled, the jiangshi selects a cardinal direction to face. The jiangshi may move only in the direction it is facing, and may spend 5 feet of movement to turn up to 90 degrees or to stand from prone.

traits.name: Graceless Rigor
traits.description: If the jiangshi is hit with a melee attack from a direction it is not facing, it is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Breath Sight
traits.description: A creature that is holding its breath may attempt to hide from the jiangshi without obscurement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The jiangshi makes two attacks with its Stiff Slam.

actions.name: Stiff Slam
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft., one creature in the direction the jiangshi is facing. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.

actions.name: Lurching Lunge
actions.description: The jiangshi leaps at a creature within 15 feet, landing in its space and forcing it to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone and grappled (escape DC 12). On a successful saving throw, the jiangshi instead falls prone in the creature's space.

reactions.name: Whip Around
reactions.description: When a creature the jiangshi is not facing misses it with a melee attack, the jiangshi turns to face it and makes a Stiff Slam attack.

name: Rogue Jiangshi
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex -1, Con +4, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha +1

languages: Jiangshi, understands the languages it knew in life but cannot speak them

Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus one of the following effects: The target is Grappled (escape DC 15). The target is pushed up to 5 feet away. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Drain Vitality
actions.description: The jiangshi draws the life force out from the forehead of a creature grappled by it. The creature takes 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage, then must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw or lose two unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 Hit Points if it cannot.

actions.description: The jiangshi's long, prehensile tongue slithers into the mouth of an unconscious creature within 5 feet and a foul green vapor pours down it, forcing the creature to succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Cursed. legendaryActions.name: Hop
legendaryActions.description:
The jiangshi moves up to 5 feet, turns up to 90 degrees, or stands from prone.




 Mythic Origins. In West Hunan and other regions of China, those who died far from home in work or war would often be carried to their native villages for burial by a pair of ganshiren (corpse-handlers), who would carry them hanging from bamboo poles. These ganshiren would travel at night to avoid distressing those they passed and limit decomposition, ringing a bell to announce their presence and clear the path so none need look upon the bouncing corpses they carried.


 Qing Beaurocrat Costumes. The jiangshi (stiff corpses) would be dressed in their finest clothes to preserve a measure of dignity in altogether undignified circumstances; when Hong Kong film studios began adapting the jiangshi to the screen, the popularity of Qing period dramas meant they already had a ready supply of often heavily worn Qing bureaucrat costumes, so that became the default formalwear of the jiangshi, similarly to how Victorian dress became the default for western vampires.

legendaryActions.name: Break Restraints (Costs 4 Actions)

name: Kender Vampire
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +4, Int +2, Wis +5, Cha +8
skills: Deception +8, Perception +5, Sleight Of Hand +5, Stealth +2
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Spirit Form
traits.description:
As an Action, the vampire can send its spirit forth from its body. While in this form, the vampire is invisible, can pass through creatures and objects, can't make attacks, and dies if it takes any radiant damage or is hit with its own hoopak.
	>
	>When it drops to 0 Hit Points or is Turned, the vampire assumes this form instead of suffering any other effects. At dusk, if the spirit is in its coffin, the spirit gains a new body and its old body turns to ash.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.description: The vampire has the following flaws *

traits.name: Charmed by Hospitality
traits.description: While in the home of a creature that invited it in, the vampire can take no hostile action. *

traits.name: Theft Compulsion
traits.description: If the vampire thinks itself hidden, it is compelled to steal whatever unique and portable trinkets it sees. If it is carrying more than 100 lbs of stolen goods, its movement is reduced by 10 and its attacks are made at Disadvantage. *

traits.name: Stiff Joints
traits.description: The vampire has Disadvantage on saving throws to resist being knocked prone, and must spend its full movement to stand from prone.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The vampire has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vampire makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with its Telekinetic Thrash, if available.

actions.name: Spirit-Drain Claws
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). A creature that starts its turn grappled in this way must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or lose two unexpended hit dice, or be Paralyzed until the start of its next turn if it cannot.

actions.name: Unholy Hoopak
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. or range 30/120, Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) necrotic damage. This attack has Advantage against a Large or larger creature.

actions.name: Telekinetic Thrash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature of the vampire's choice within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Decay Weapon
