reactions.name: Hideous Laughter
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 76 Hit Points, the vampire throws back its head and lets out a disturbing cackle. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the vampire must make a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature believes the vampire to be an illusion, and believes one of its allies to be the true vampire in disguise. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Eldritch Lich
savingThrows: Dex +3, Con +3, Int +9, Wis +7, Cha +1
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Turned; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned

traits.name: Far Realm Parasite
traits.description: The lich's body harbors a far realm parasite which safeguards its consciousness. If the lich is incapacitated, the parasite can be extracted with a successful DC 16 Strength (Medicine) check, at which point it can be attacked and damaged (AC 14; 50 HP). If the lich starts its turn with 0 Hit Points, its body implodes and the parasite Plane Shifts (Level 7 Spell) to the Far Realm, creating a new body for the lich in 1d10 days.

traits.name: Impossible Angles
traits.description: The space in a 10-foot radius around the lich is difficult terrain for non-aberrations, as the lich's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries, additionally causing the following effects: A non-aberration creature that starts its turn in the area, or enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 1d10 Psychic damage and be Poisoned until the start of its next turn. Ranged attacks made by non-aberrations that pass through the area are made at Disadvantage.

traits.name: Magemind's Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If the lich was concentrating, it loses concentration.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lich uses its Touch of the Far Realm twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Unspeakable Insight or Fold Space.

actions.name: Touch of the Far Realm
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and the creature's Wisdom score is reduced by 1d4, to a minimum of 1, until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

actions.name: Fold Space (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The lich teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, then each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the lich's next turn.

actions.name: Unspeakable Insight (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: One creature within 120 feet that the lich can see must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or gain 20 Temporary Hit Points. While a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, its Intelligence score increased by 5, to a maximum of 25. At the end of its turn, a creature loses all of these Temporary Hit Points and takes Psychic damage equal to twice the Temporary Hit Points lost.

actions.name: Foetid Fusation (Recharge 5-6, Level 8 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Each creature within 60 feet of the lich's choice must make a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw. Each creature that failed has its initiative reduced to 0, then teleports to an unoccupied space that the lich can see within 60 feet. The lich may teleport any two creatures that failed this save into the same space, fusing them together into a single malformed body for the next minute. While fused, creatures act on the same turn, and only one of them may use movement, use a bonus action, or take reactions in a turn. Whenever one of them takes damage, the other takes the same damage. One of the fused creatures may repeat this saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect and moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reactions.name: Psychic Rebound (Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: When the lich takes damage from an attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence Saving Throw or take an equal amount of Psychic damage.

reactions.name: Batrachian Metamorphosis (1/Day, Level 9 Spell)
reactions.description: When the lich is reduced below 83 Hit Points, it can force one creature it can see within 30 feet to make a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature's flesh begins to roll in upon itself as the creature's body slowly turns itself inside out, gaining vulnerability to all damage and Disadvantage on all attacks and saving throws. An affected creature makes a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect after three successes, or transforming into a Gibbering Mouther under the DM's control after three failures until cured by a Wish spell or similar magic.

legendaryActions.name: Fold Space
legendaryActions.description: The lich uses its Fold Space.

legendaryActions.name: Unbearable Glimpse
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 10 feet of the lich must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to move its full speed directly away from it.

legendaryActions.name: Detestable Clarion (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The lich telepathically broadcasts a discordant melody that brings reality into unbearable focus. Each creature within 120 feet with a Wisdom score lower than 10 must use its reaction to make a melee attack against itself.

name: Fungal Lich
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +10, Int +3, Wis +11, Cha +10
immunities: Poison, Necrotic, Turned; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned

traits.name: Sickening Aura
traits.description: Whenever the lich is hit with an attack, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of the creature's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with Brittle Lung.

traits.name: Spore Seeding
traits.description: When the lich is destroyed, it begins to release spores. Unless the lich's body and the surrounding area are cleansed with fire or acid within the next minute, the spores drift far and wide, taking root in a fresh corpse and raising it as a new body for the lich after 1d10 days.

traits.name: Magemind's Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If the lich was concentrating, it loses concentration.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lich makes two attacks and uses its Sprouting Doom.

actions.name: Horrid Growth
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (6d6) poison damage and fungal growths root the creature in place, grappling it to the nearest surface (escape DC 19).

actions.name: Demonrot Barbs
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 60 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) piercing damage and the target suffers one effect of the lich's choice: The creature loses any resistance or immunity to Poison damage or the Poisoned condition for the next minute. One spell effect on the creature ends. The creature has Disadvantage on the next Constitution Saving Throw it makes in the next minute.

actions.name: Sprouting Doom
actions.description: A roiling growth of multifarious fungus that lasts for a minute bursts forth in a 5-foot radius centered on a point the lich can see within 120 feet. The area is difficult terrain for nonplant creatures, and a nonplant creature that starts its turn in the area takes 20 poison damage. This effect ends if the area is dealt 20 or more fire or radiant damage from a single source.

actions.name: Sudden Wasting (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the lich may expend any number of hit dice to heal itself (without adding its Constitution modifier), then the lich may force it to succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or take 88 (16d10) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. If the target is killed by this damage, its flesh rots away into a putrid slurry, and the lich immediately uses its Sprouting Doom centered on the creature's corpse.

reactions.name: Mycellia Snare
reactions.description: When a creature ends its turn within 15 feet of an area affected by Sprouting Doom, the lich can force it to succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone and be dragged up to 15 feet towards the area.

reactions.name: Brainrot (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the lich is reduced below 94 Hit Points, it can force one creature it can see within 60 feet to make a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes hostile to all creatures for the next minute, then dies. This effect can be removed by any effect that cures disease.

legendaryActions.name: Horrid Growth
legendaryActions.description: The lich uses its Horrid Growth against a creature in its reach, or against one it can see in an area affected by Sprouting Doom.

legendaryActions.name: Parasitic Ruin
legendaryActions.description: One creature grappled by the lich's Horrid Growth takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. A creature that takes 15 or more damage from a use of this ability becomes restrained for as long as it remains grappled.

legendaryActions.name: Sporeflight (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The lich transforms into a cloud of spores and moves up to its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. It can pass through the spaces of other creatures with this movement, and each creature the lich moves through must make a saving throw against its Sickening Aura.

name: Frostlich
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +10, Int +10, Wis +7, Cha +2
immunities: Cold, Poison, Turned; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

traits.name: Cryonic Return
traits.description: If the frostlich is destroyed, its spirit possesses the corpse of a humanoid creature trapped in its Glacier Tomb after 1d10 days, consuming the creature's soul in the process.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.description: The frostlich can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

traits.name: Black Ice Aura
traits.description: The area in a 10-foot radius around the frostlich is difficult terrain. A creature that enters it for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone.

traits.name: Magemind's Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If the lich was concentrating, it loses concentration.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The frostlich uses its Ice Needle Hail twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Bleak Aurora or Glacier Tomb, if available.

actions.name: Frostbite Touch
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 35 (10d6) cold damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be afflicted with Frostbite.

actions.name: Ice Needle Hail (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Needles of glittering ice rain down in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-tall cylinder centered on a point the frostlich can see within 120 feet. Each creature in the area takes 10 Cold damage, then must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Bleak Aurora (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Dull, shifting lights fill the air in a 40-foot radius centered on a point within 120 feet the frostlich can see, flaring brightly when they contact magic. Ranged attacks that pass through the area are made at Disadvantage, and a creature that casts a spell in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Glacier Tomb (Level 7 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet that the frostlich can see must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or gain 40 Temporary Hit Points as translucent ice begins to encase it, or half as much on a success. While a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it suffers the following effects: It is restrained and has vulnerability to Fire damage. It cannot speak or breathe. It cannot rest or die. It must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns or have its Strength and Dexterity scores reduced by 7 (2d6), to a minimum of one, until it is released.

reactions.name: Numbing Torpor
reactions.description: When the frostlich is hit by a melee attack with a metal weapon, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or drop its weapon. If the attacker picks up the weapon this turn, the frostlich can make a melee attack against it.

reactions.name: Freeze the Blood (1/Day, Level 9 Spell)
reactions.description: When the frostlich is reduced below 107 Hit Points, it can force one creature it can see within 60 feet to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 5 (2d4) points of exhaustion, or half as many on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Polar Burst
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 10 feet of the frostlich must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Cold damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

legendaryActions.name: Sapping Cold
legendaryActions.description: One creature the frostlich can see must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or be unable to gain Advantage on any roll for the next minute.

legendaryActions.name: Bitter Stride (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The frostlich teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see and makes an attack with its Frostbite Touch.

name: Archlich
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +10, Int +9, Wis +11, Cha +4
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks, Turned; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

traits.name: Fated Escape
traits.description: A destroyed archlich's remains Teleport (Level 7 Spell) away to the location its essence is hidden. If it is able to teleport and its essence is undisturbed, a destroyed archlich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its Hit Points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the essence.

traits.name: Soporific Aura
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of the archlich that hits it with an attack must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or fall asleep until the end of the archlich's next turn, or until the creature takes any damage.

traits.name: Magemind's Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the archlich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If the archlich was concentrating, it loses concentration.

actions.name: Transporting Touch (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d10) force damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma Saving Throw or be teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the archlich can see.

actions.name: Spiritual Arsenal (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 60 ft., any number of creatures. Hit: 13 (3d8) radiant damage. The archlich may repeat this attack as a Bonus Action on each of its turns for the next minute.

actions.name: Blessed Unrest (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: The archlich impels the soul of one sleeping creature it can see within 5 feet to depart from its body, forcing it to make a DC 19 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature remains sleeping until woken, its body rises under the archlich's control for as long as it is asleep, and it repeats this saving throw whenever it would wake, remaining asleep on a failure.

actions.name: Turn the Living
actions.description: The archlich forces each living creature of its choice within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Turned for the next minute, or until it takes any damage.

reactions.name: Misdirection (Level 4 Spell)
reactions.description: When a creature the archlich can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the archlich and one of its illusory copies within 60 feet teleport to switch places. If the spell targeted the archlich, its new target becomes the copy.

reactions.name: Hallowed Balance (1/Day, Level 9 Spell)
reactions.description: When the archlich is reduced below 86 Hit Points, each creature of its choice that it can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or lose half its current Hit Points. The archlich may restore a number of Hit Points up to the total amount lost this way, divided as it chooses between creatures in range.

legendaryActions.name: Transporting Touch
legendaryActions.description: The archlich makes an attack with its Transporting Touch.

legendaryActions.name: Projected Likeness
legendaryActions.description: The archlich creates an illusory copy of itself in its space, then moves up to half its speed. The copy lasts for a minute and uses the archlich's statistics but dissipates if it takes any damage. The archlich can see and hear through this copy, may move each of them up to 30 feet on its turn, and when the archlich casts a spell it may do so through one of its copies.

legendaryActions.name: Bring Low (Level 3 Spell, Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: One creature the archlich can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 22 (5d8) radiant damage, or 36 (8d8) radiant damage if it has more than half its Hit Points.

name: Arcane Lich
savingThrows: Dex +3, Con +11, Int +12, Wis +9, Cha +3
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks, Turned; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its Hit Points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

traits.name: Paralyzing Aura
traits.description: A creature that hits the lich with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or be Paralyzed until the end of the lich's next turn, or until the creature takes any damage.

traits.name: Magemind's Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If the lich was concentrating, it loses concentration.

actions.name: Wilting Ray
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 60 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Freezing Claw
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (6d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Fireball (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: An explosion of arcane flame erupts in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within 120 feet that the lich can see. Each creature in the area must succeed on a 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Dimension Door (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: The lich and up to one willing creature within 5 feet teleport up to 500 feet.

actions.name: Immolation (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature the lich can see within 90 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Fire damage and catch fire, or take half as much damage on a success. A burning creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 14 (4d6) Fire damage on a failure, or ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Finger of Death (Recharge 5-6, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: The lich extends its finger toward a creature it can see within 60 feet and the creature is engulfed in a sickly green light. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or take 62 (7d8 + 30) Necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this damage rises at the beginning of the lich's next turn as a Zombie Rotter under the lich's control.

actions.name: Disintegrate (1/Day, Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet that the lich can see must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 75 (10d6 + 40) Force damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage turns to dust.

reactions.name: Shield (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: When the lich is targeted with an attack, it can add +5 to its AC until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Counterspell (Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: When a creature the lich can see within 60 feet begins to cast a spell, the lich can make an Intelligence check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, causing the spell to fail on a success. If the spell is 3rd level or below, the lich succeeds automatically. *Murderous Glare (1/Day, Level 9 Spell.)* When the lich becomes Bloodied, it can unleash a torrent of negative energy at a creature it can see within 60 feet. If the creature has fewer than 100 Hit Points, it dies.

legendaryActions.name: Wilting Ray
legendaryActions.description: The lich uses its Wilting ray

legendaryActions.name: Freezing Claw
legendaryActions.description: The lich uses its Freezing Claw.

legendaryActions.name: Shadow Walk
legendaryActions.description: The Lich teleports up to 30 feet to a location it can see. *Drain Magic (Costs 2 Actions)* The lich ends a spell of 3rd level or lower affecting a target it can see within 60 feet.

name: Baelnorn
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +5, Con +11, Int +11, Wis +13, Cha +2
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks, Turned; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

traits.name: Norn Rejuvenation
traits.description: If the baelnorn is destroyed, one of its descendants can perform a ritual in which they invite the baelnorn's spirit to assume their body. The descendant remains for a time as a passenger in its former body, and can pass into death at will.

traits.name: Entangling Aura
traits.description: A creature that hits the lich with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 21 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 21) until the end of the lich's next turn as vines burst forth from the nearest surface to entangle it.

traits.name: Water Walk
traits.description: The baelnorn can walk across any liquid surface as if it was solid ground.

traits.name: Magemind's Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the baelnorn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If the baelnorn was concentrating, it loses concentration.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The baelnorn uses its Lignify and makes three attacks with its Wraithblade, one of which it may replace with a use of its Forced Growth or Splinterburst.

actions.name: Wraithblade
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) necrotic damage. This attack treats the target as unarmored (An unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier).

actions.name: Lignify (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: One creature within 120 feet the baelnorn can see must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or have its flesh begin to turn to wood, gaining the Plant type in addition to its other creature types, plus one additional effect of the baelnorn's choice until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic: The creature's movement speed is reduced by half and it cannot fly. The creature can't take bonus actions or reactions. The creature gains vulnerability to Fire damage. The creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage whenever it deals Fire damage.

actions.name: Forced Growth (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The lich causes a tree 15 feet across and up to 100 feet tall to burst forth from the ground at a point it can see within 120 feet. Each creature in the tree's space when it appears and each flying creature within 20 feet of it must make a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (4d10) Bludgeoning damage and is launched to the tree's top. A creature that failed this save by 5 or fewer may use its reaction to grasp a branch and avoid falling.

actions.name: Splinterburst (5th Level Spell, Recharges when the baelnorn uses its Forced Growth)
actions.description: One tree the baelnorn can see within 60 feet explodes in a hail of massive splinters. Each creature within 15 feet of the tree must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Briar Shield
reactions.description: When the baelnorn is targeted with an attack, it can conjure a barrier of thorny vines, gaining 20 Temporary Hit Points that last until the start of its next turn. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, a creature that hits it with a melee attack takes 5 Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Withering Wail (1/Day, Level 9 Spell)
reactions.description: When the baelnorn is reduced below 112 Hit Points, it can sing out a cruel and keening note. Each plant within 60 feet withers and blackens, and each plant creature in the area must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or drop to 0 Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Zephyr Step
legendaryActions.description: The baelnorn gains a fly speed equal to its movement speed until the start of its next turn and moves up to half its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Hollowheart Harvest
legendaryActions.description: One plant creature or elf the baelnorn can see within 5 feet loses up to 3 unexpended hit dice. The baelnorn regains 1d8 Hit Points for each hit die lost in this way.

legendaryActions.name: Deadwood Awakening (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The baelnorn reanimates the wooden portion of a weapon or shield it can see, transforming it into a Vine Blight that acts on the baelnorn's turn under its control. If the weapon was magical, it transforms back after the vine blight is destroyed, and cannot be affected by this ability again.

legendaryActions.name: Wraithstorm Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The baelnorn moves up to its speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and makes two attacks with its Wraithblade. It may pass through solid objects and creatures with this movement.

name: Mohrg Glistener
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +4, Int -2, Wis -1, Cha -3
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Rootless Flesh
traits.description: If the mohrg would receive any magical healing, it recived no healing and instead dies.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the mohrg takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the mohrg takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its Hit Point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Gruesome Lunge (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 Slashing damage. If three or more mohrgs contributed to this attack, the target takes an extra 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage and is Grappled (escape DC 17).

name: Mohrg Gorehive
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +7, Wis +2, Cha -3
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Bonesense
traits.description: The mohrg can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it.

traits.name: Twined Anima
traits.description: If the mohrg would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing, and instead instead can't use its Visceral Intrusion until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mohrg makes two attacks with its Clawing Grasp.

actions.name: Clawing Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). A Bloodied creature that is Grappled in this way is additionally Frightened.

actions.name: Visceral Intrusion
actions.description: The mohrg spears its clawed entrails into a Grappled or Incapacitated creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 55 (10d10) Piercing damage and the target is Choking until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage. A creature killed by this damage rises on its following turn as a Zombie Rotter under the mohrg's control.

reactions.name: Deadly Caress
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 5 feet misses the mohrg with an attack. Response: The creature must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the end of the morhg's next turn.

name: Mohrg Horde
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +4, Int -2, Wis -1, Cha -3
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Bonesense
traits.description: The mohrg can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The horde can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, it can move through any opening large enough for a single mohrg, and it can’t regain Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mohrg makes up to one Clawing Grasp attack against each creature in its space. Then, if the swarm isn't Bloodied, it can use its Visceral Intrusion.

actions.name: Clawing Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 27 (5d10) necrotic damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 18). A Bloodied creature that is Grappled in this way is additionally Frightened.

actions.name: Visceral Intrusion
actions.description: The mohrg spears its clawed entrails into a Grappled or Incapacitated creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 55 (10d10) Piercing damage and the target is Choking until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage. A creature killed by this damage rises on its following turn as a Zombie Rotter under the mohrg's control.

reactions.name: Deadly Caress
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 5 feet misses the horde with an attack. Response: The creature must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the end of the horde's next turn.

name: Mummy Retainer
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -2, Con +1, Int -2, Cha +1
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: To Dust
traits.description: A creature that reduces the mummy to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be unable to speak or breathe until the end of its next turn as the mummy bursts into a spray of dust and sand.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the mummy takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the mummy takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

actions.name: Trembling Grasp (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 Bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 12). At the start of each of the creature's turns, it takes 1 Necrotic damage for each Mummy Retainer grappling it.

name: Mummy Guardian
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -1, Con +2, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Final Curse
traits.description: A creature that reduces the mummy to 0 Hit Points must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma Saving Throw or suffer a curse of wilting. While cursed in this way, any magical healing the creature receives is reduced by half.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mummy attacks once with its Rotting Fist and uses its Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 4 (1d6) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Mummy Rot.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.description: One creature the mummy can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally Paralyzed for the same duration.

reactions.name: Warding Hex
reactions.description: When the mummy is hit with a melee attack, it can deal 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage to the creature.

name: Salt Mummy
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -1, Con +7, Int +2, Wis +3, Cha +2
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Water Weakness
traits.description: If the mummy is doused in water, it takes 7 (2d6) Acid damage and is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Final Curse
traits.description: A creature that reduces the mummy to 0 Hit Points must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma Saving Throw or suffer a curse of wilting. While cursed in this way, any magical healing the creature receives is reduced by half.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mummy makes two attacks with its Desiccating Slam and uses its Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Desiccating Slam
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. On a critical hit, the target gains a point of Exhaustion that lasts for a minute.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.description: One creature the mummy can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally Paralyzed fr the same duration.

reactions.name: Warding Hex
reactions.description: When the mummy is hit with a melee attack, it can deal 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage to the creature.

name: Mummy Lord
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +9, Int +5, Wis +9, Cha +8
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Warding Hex
traits.description: A creature within 30 feet of the mummy that hits it with an attack must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage and be Stunned until the end of the mummy's next turn.

traits.name: Final Curse
traits.description: A creature that reduces the mummy to 0 Hit Points must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or suffer a curse of wilting. While cursed in this way, any magical healing the creature receives is reduced by half.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The mummy lord has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: A destroyed mummy lord gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, regaining all its Hit Points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the mummy lord's heart.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mummy makes two attacks with its Rotting Fist and uses its Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with Mummy Rot.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.description: One creature the mummy can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally Paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies and mummy lords for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Plague Chant (Level 6 Spell, Recharges when the mummy uses its Grave Terror)
actions.description: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +9, reach 90 ft., Hit 28 (8d6) Necrotic damage. If this attack hits, the plague chant leaps to another creature within 15 feet of the previous target. The mummy lord makes a new attack roll against the new target, which could cause this ability to leap again. A creature can be targeted no more than once with each casting of this spell.

actions.name: Grave Terror (Level 8 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature the mummy lord can see within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 99 (18d10) Psychic damage and be dragged up to 15 feet toward the mummy, or take half as much damage on a success. A creature that isn't Frightened may use its reaction to move 15 feet directly away from the mummy. If it does, it gains Advantage on this saving throw.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.description: The mummy lord makes one attack with its rotting fist or uses its Dreadful Glare.

legendaryActions.name: Whirlwind of Sand
legendaryActions.description: The mummy lord magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 60 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity, and reverts to its normal form.

legendaryActions.name: Blinding Dust
legendaryActions.description: Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around the mummy lord. Each creature within 5 feet of the mummy lord must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The mummy lord utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the mummy lord that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded and Stunned until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.

name: Necromite Hollow
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +2, Int +3

traits.name: One With Death
traits.description: When the necromite is reduced to 0 Hit Points, each other Undead creature in a 10-foot Emanation from it regains 10 Hit Points.

traits.name: Bonesense
traits.description: The necromite can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it.

actions.name: Death's Head Flail
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Gravefrost (Cantrip)
actions.description: A creeping chill envelops a creature the necromite can see within 60 feet, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 5 (2d4) Cold damage plus an extra 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage if the target is Bloodied.

reactions.name: Death Throes (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description:
Trigger: One of the necromite's allies within 30 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Response: The ally can use its Reaction to make one melee attack before falling Unconscious.

traits.name: Reclaim Anima (1/Day)

actions.name: Doom Slice (Level 2 Spell)

name: Nightwing
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +9, Con +10, Int -1, Wis +4, Cha -1
resistances: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Attacks made without Advantage
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Annihilating Aura
traits.description: A living creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the nightwing must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Light Eater
traits.description: The area in a 1 mile radius around the nightwing is illuminated with dim light. Nonmagical sources of bright light are instantly extinguished in this area, as are areas of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower. Celestial bodies appear to be eclipsed. If the nightwing starts its turn in Bright Light, it takes 25 radiant damage.

traits.name: Darkness Made Flesh
traits.description: If the nightwing would receive magical healing, it instead must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the spellcaster's save DC or take an equal amount of radiant damage, or half as much on a success. On a success or failure, attacks made against the nightwing have Advantage until the start of its next turn and the nightwing becomes momentarily insubstantial, dropping each creature it is grappling and forcing each creature climbing on it to succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall off.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the nightwing fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nightwing makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Insubstantiate or Writhing Wake, if available.

actions.name: Shadow Talons
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Rain of Rot
actions.description: Attack: +10 range 120 ft., one target directly below the nightwing. Hit: 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. A creature Grappled by the nightwing has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Insubstantiate
actions.description: The nightshade turns to shadow until it makes an attack. While in this form, corporeal creatures climbing on it fall through it, its speed is doubled, and it can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Writhing Wake (Recharges when the Nightwing uses its Death Scream)
actions.description: The nightwing moves up to its fly speed, and the shadows in a 15-foot wide section of the ground it passes over darken and begin to writhe, coalescing into four Shadows that appear in unoccupied spaces, act on the nightwing's turn, and last for a minute.

actions.name: Death Scream (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The nightwing lets forth a horrid scream that melts flesh and shatters bones. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Necrotic damage plus 18 (4d8) Thunder damage, or half as much damage on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more has blood well up from its eyes, ears and nose, and is Blinded until it takes an action to clear its eyes or receives any magical healing.

reactions.name: Swooping Doom (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the nightwing is reduced below 116 Hit Points, it can use its Insubstantiate and dive up to 80 feet. Each creature it passes within 30 feet of with this movement must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or be afflicted with a Curse of Doom. While Cursed in this way, the creature acquires a Doom Counter each time it takes Necrotic damage. If the creature drops to 0 Hit Points while cursed, it immediately fails one death saving throw for each Doom Counter it has.

name: Nightcrawler
savingThrows: Str +14, Con +13, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -1
resistances: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Attacks made without Advantage
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Annihilating Aura
traits.description: A living creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the nightcrawler must make a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, or 21 (6d6) if it inside the nightcrawler.

traits.name: Light Eater
traits.description: The area in a 1 mile radius around the nightcrawler is illuminated with dim light. Nonmagical sources of bright light are instantly extinguished in this area, as are areas of light created by a spell of 3rd level or lower. Celestial bodies appear to be eclipsed. If the nightcrawler starts its turn in Bright Light, it takes 25 radiant damage.

traits.name: Anti-Life Nature
traits.description: If the nightcrawler would receive magical healing, it instead must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the spellcaster's save DC or take an equal amount of radiant damage, or half as much on a success. On a success or failure, attacks made against the nightcrawler have Advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The nightcrawler can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Gargantuan Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the nightcrawler may spend its full movement to attempt a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the nightcrawler. While climbing on the nightcrawler, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the nightcrawler.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the nightcrawler fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nightcrawler attacks twice with its Utterblack Bile.

actions.name: Corpsechurn Maw
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 10 ft. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained, and its attacks bypass the nightcrawler's damage resistances. If the nightcrawler takes 20 or more radiant damage from a single source, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the nightcrawler. If the nightcrawler dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Utterblack Bile
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 30 ft. Hit: 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and the target is coated in inky black bile. Until a creature takes an action to clear it, if the creature casts a spell, the spell doesn't take effect until the start of its following turn.

actions.name: Terror From the Deep (Recharges when the Nightcrawler uses its Rotting Regurgitation)
actions.description: The nightcrawler moves up to its burrow speed, then bursts from underground thrashing in a flurry of debris. Each creature in a 15-foot radius must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or half damage on a success. As a Bonus Action, the nightcrawler may make a bite attack against a creature that failed this saving throw.

actions.name: Rotting Regurgitation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A tide of corpses spews forth from the nightcrawler in a 30-foot cone. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or take 22 (5d8) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success. At initiative count 0, 10 (3d6) of the corpses rise as Zombie Rotters.

name: Nightwalker
savingThrows: Str +12, Dex +10, Con +13, Int -1, Wis -2, Cha -1
resistances: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Attacks made without Advantage
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Annihilating Aura
traits.description: A living creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the nightwing must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage and grant the nightwalker Advantage on attack rolls against it until the start of the creature's next turn.

traits.name: Light Eater
traits.description: The area in a 1 mile radius around the nightwalker is illuminated with dim light. Nonmagical sources of bright light are instantly extinguished in this area, as are areas of light created by a spell of 4th level or lower. Celestial bodies appear to be eclipsed. If the nightwalker starts its turn in Bright Light, it takes 25 radiant damage.

traits.name: Anti-Life Nature
traits.description: If the nightwalker would receive magical healing, it instead must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against the spellcaster's save DC or take an equal amount of radiant damage, or half as much on a success. On a success or failure, attacks made against the nightwalker have Advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the nightwalker may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the nightwalker. While climbing on the nightwalker, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the nightwalker.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nightwalker makes two attacks with its enervating focus, one of which it may replace with a use of its Finger of Doom, if available.

actions.name: Enervating Focus
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 15 ft. Hit: 28 (5d8 + 6) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by the same amount until it finishes a Long Rest.

actions.name: Drown in Death (Concentration)
actions.description: One creature within 120 feet that is in Dim Light or Darkness must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall into its shadow (escape DC 21). A creature that fails this save by 5 or more cannot hold its breath. While in its shadow, a creature is Blinded, cannot breathe, and takes 45 (10d8) Necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns. A creature that ends its turn in its shadow while afflicted with a Curse of Doom ceases to exist and can't be revived by any means short of a Wish spell.

actions.name: Finger of Doom (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The nightwalker points at one creature it can see within 300 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma Saving Throw or be afflicted with a Curse of Doom. While cursed in this way, the creature acquires a Doom counter each time it takes Necrotic damage. If the creature drops to 0 Hit Points while cursed, it immediately fails one Death Save for each Doom counter it has.

name: Ogre Zombie Fleshsiege
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -2, Con +4, Int -4, Wis -2, Cha -3
languages: Understands Common and Giant but can't speak

traits.name: Gatebreaker
traits.description: The zombie deals double damage to objects and structures. If it reduces a Medium or larger object to 0 Hit Points, each creature in a 15-foot cone extending from the object takes 3 (1d6) Slashing damage from shrapnel.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If the zombie starts its turn with 0 Hit Points, it makes a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw, unless it was dealt radiant damage or a critical hit since the end of its last turn. On a success, the zombie regains 1 hit point. .

actions.name: Manthresher Morningstar
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target is pushed 10 feet away, knocked prone, and cannot stand for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn.)

actions.name: Crushing Stomp
actions.description: One prone creature within 5 feet of the ogre must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage and be grappled (escape DC 14) until the ogre moves. A creature wearing metal armor that fails this saving throw has its armor deform. Until it doffs its armor, the creature is Choking and may use a Bonus Action to ignore this effect until the end of its turn.

reactions.name: Stumbling Sweep
reactions.description: As a reaction when the zombie misses with a melee attack, it may make a second attack at Disadvantage against another target in its reach. If the second attack misses, the zombie falls prone.

name: Quell
savingThrows: Str -2, Con +2, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +2
resistances: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Turned; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The quell's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

traits.name: Quelling Field
traits.description: If the quell is not in sunlight, the quell and each creature within 15 feet of it have Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects with a divine source, such as those cast by clerics or paladins, and resistance to damage dealt by such magic.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The quell makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Bitter Glare.

actions.name: Wispy Clutch
actions.description: Attack: +2 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) piercing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) necrotic damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 8). A creature may attempt to escape this grapple as a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Bitter Glare
actions.description: One creature the quell can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Psychic damage as it experiences the true alienness and amorality that belies the gods' benevolent demeanor. A cleric or paladin targeted with this ability has Advantage on saving throws against this effect, but vulnerability to the damage dealt by it.

reactions.name: Intercession
reactions.description: When a creature the quell can see within 60 feet casts a spell or produces a magical effect with a divine source, the quell can force the creature to succeed on a DC 12 Charisma Saving Throw or have the spell or magical effect fail.

name: Ragewind
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +5, Con +4, Int +7, Wis +7, Cha +7
immunities: Necrotic, Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Storm of Blades
traits.description: The ragewind may enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. A creature that starts its turn in the ragewind's space, or whose space the ragewind enters for the first time in a turn, must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Slashing damage and be carried aloft and restrained within the ragewind (escape DC 19).

traits.name: Weapon Trove
traits.description: Whenever the ragewind misses a creature with a melee weapon attack, the creature may use its reaction to attempt a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature wrests the weapon from the ragewind's grasp.

traits.name: Conductive Array
traits.description: Attacks that deal Lightning damage have Advantage against the ragewind, and it has Disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal Lightning damage.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the ragewind fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ragewind makes six attacks, no more than two of which may be with the same weapon.

actions.name: Ragetouched Geistblade
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage and the target must make a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature must attack the ragewind on its following turn or else take Hit: 5 (1d10) psychic damage.

actions.name: Shieldcleaver Axe, +2
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the AC bonus granted by the target's armor or shield is permanently and cumulatively reduced by 2.

actions.name: Bladeshaving Shrapnel
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the beginning of the ragewind's next turn.

actions.name: Cannonball (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the Ragewind's next turn.

actions.name: Chipped Sword Flurry
actions.description: Each creature in the ragewind's space must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Thieving Wind
reactions.description: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the ragewind forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or have its weapon wrenched away. The ragewind may wield any weapon dropped in this way as though it were both proficient with and attuned to the weapon.

name: Red Echo Stalker
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +3, Con +2, Wis +1, Cha +2
immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Bhaal's Red Blessing
traits.description: The echo's attacks deal maximum damage, instead of rolling, to targets that have 20 or fewer Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The echo makes four attacks.

actions.name: Wraithblade
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) force damage. This attack treats all targets as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier).

bonusActions.name: Death Haunt (Concentration)
bonusActions.description: The echo chooses an enemy it can see.
