actions.name: Bonecrusher Maul
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take half the attack's damage.

actions.name: Claw Snatch
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Ragdoll Smash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The skeleton repeatedly slams a Grappled creature into the ground, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 36 (8d8) Bludgeoning damage and the creature is Dazed until the end of the skeleton's next turn. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Hate the Living
reactions.description: Trigger: An Undead ally the skeleton can see is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Response: The skeleton moves up half its Speed toward the nearest living enemy.

name: Skin Kite
savingThrows: Dex +3, Con +1, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -2
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Poisoned

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.description: While it is wrapped around a creature, the skin kite takes only half the damage dealt to it by creatures it is not grappling, and the creature grappled by the skin kite takes the other half.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The skin kite can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Clinging Slam
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the skin kite wraps itself around the target (escape DC 13). While the skin kite is wrapped around it, a creature cannot speak or breathe, and the skin kite moves with the target.

actions.name: Steal Skin
actions.description: One creature the skin kite is wrapped around must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving score or have its Charisma score reduced by 1d4, to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Long Rest. The skin kite gains a cumulative 5 Temporary Hit Points for each point of Charisma lost in this way. A creature reduced to 1 Charisma in this way immediately drops to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Launch Kite
actions.description: The skin kite tears itself in two, losing all of its Temporary Hit Points and creating a new skin kite in an adjacent space with maximum Hit Points equal to the Temporary Hit Points lost.

name: Skulk Breath-Echo
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +3, Wis -2, Cha -5

traits.name: Unperson Invisibility
traits.description: The skulk is Invisible to humanoids over the age of 10 unless viewed through a reflective surface. When seen, it appears as a drab echo of the last person it killed.

actions.name: Lash Out
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, the skulk becomes faintly visible until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Stolen Whispers
actions.description: The skulk whispers a haunting echo of final moments it has witnessed, audible only to creatures within 10 feet of it. Each such creature has Disadvantage on the first saving throw it makes against being Frightened in the next hour.

reactions.name: Trackless Disappearance
reactions.description: When the skulk ends its turn without dealing damage, it can move up to half its speed and attempt to Hide.

name: Skulk Creakwight
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +4, Con +2, Wis -2, Cha -5

traits.name: Unperson Invisibility
traits.description: The skulk is Invisible to humanoids over the age of 10 unless viewed through a reflective surface. When seen, it appears as a drab echo of the last person it killed.

actions.name: Creeping Claws
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, the skulk becomes faintly visible until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Carve Wall
actions.description: The skulk drags its claws along a surface within 5 feet of it, leaving ragged scars and forcing each creature within 15 feet that can't see the skulk to make a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, a creature is Frightened until the end of its next turn and drops any weapons or spell foci that it is wielding.

reactions.name: Trackless Disappearance
reactions.description: When the skulk ends its turn without dealing damage, it can move up to half its speed and attempt to Hide.

name: Skull Lord
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +8, Con +3, Int +8, Wis +7, Cha +4
resistances: Cold, Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing, from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned, Stunned, Unconscious
languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Triple Skulls
traits.description:
The skull lord has three skulls, each of which anchor one of its abilities. A creature that reduces the skull lord to 0 Hit Points chooses one of its remaining skulls to destroy. Then, if the skull lord has any skulls remaining, it regains all of its Hit Points.
*

traits.name: Skull of Death's Tranquility
traits.description:
While it has this skull, the skull lord and its undead allies within 30 ft. make attacks and saving throws against magical effects at Advantage, and take no damage on a successful Constitution save.
*

traits.name: Skull of Bonechilling Fear
traits.description:
While it has this skull, a living creature that starts its turn within 15 ft. of the Skull lord must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the start of its next turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more is instead Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.
*

traits.name: Skull of the Grave Master
traits.description: While it has this skull, at the start of each of the skull lord's turns one destroyed undead creature of CR 3 or below within 30 feet is returned to undeath with full Hit Points.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the skull lord fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The skull lord casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action and makes two bone staff attacks.

actions.name: Bone Staff
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Clutch of Terror (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 20 ft. Hit: 33 (6d10) necrotic damage and the target is dragged up to 15 feet toward the skull lord, then must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Corrupt Marrow (Level 5 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 15-foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is Paralyzed until the end of the skull lord's next turn.

actions.name: Finger of Death (1/Day, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the skull lord can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 62 (7d8+30) Necrotic damage, or half damage on a success. A humanoid creature killed by this damage rises as a Zombie Rotter under the skull lord's control at the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Shield of Bones (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: When the skull lord or a friendly undead creature is targeted with a ranged attack, the skull lord can raise a shield of bones and earth, granting the target 3/4 cover against ranged attacks until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Heartstop (1/Day, Level 8 Spell)
reactions.description: When a creature destroys its second-to-last skull, the skull lord can attempt to crush the creature's heart within its chest. The creature must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or drop to 0 Hit Points. A creature with no unexpended hit dice makes this saving throw at Disadvantage.

legendaryActions.name: Grave Step
legendaryActions.description: The skull lord moves up to half its speed. A creature that hits the skull lord with an attack of opportunity provoked by this movement takes 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

legendaryActions.name: Death's Command
legendaryActions.description: If the skull lord still has its Skull of Death's Tranquility, one friendly undead creature of CR 3 or below within 30 feet may use its reaction to make a melee attack.

legendaryActions.name: Bonechilling Fear
legendaryActions.description: One creature Frightened by the skull lord's Skull of Bonechilling Fear must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Cold damage and 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.

legendaryActions.name: Gravelord's Excavation
legendaryActions.description: The skull lord excavates a grave 10 ft. long, 10 ft. deep, and 5 ft. wide centered on a point within 30 ft. Each creature standing in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall in, moving to the nearest unoccupied space outside the area on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Bone Staff (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The skull lord makes an attack with its bone staff.

name: The Wretched
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +1, Con -1, Int -3, Wis -2, Cha -3

traits.name: Minion
traits.description:
If the wretched takes damage from an attack or as the result
of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the
wretched takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage
equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes
no damage.

traits.name: Swarming Overrun
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of three or more of the wretched must succeed on DC 10 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone. A creature within 5 ft. of five or more of the wretched makes this saving throw at Disadvantage, and cannot stand from prone this turn if it fails.

actions.name: Latching Bite (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Piercing damage and the wretched attaches to the target. While attached, the wretched can't attack, and at the start of each of the wretched's turns, the target takes 5 Necrotic damage. The wretched can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement.

name: The Lost
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -2, Wis -2, Cha -3
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing while in Dim Light or Darkness

traits.name: Disorienting Wail
traits.description: Creatures within 500 ft. of the lost that can hear it wailing have Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws that use Wisdom as their vision blurs and sounds become distorted and unintelligible.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lost makes five attacks with its arm spikes and uses its embedding embrace. It makes one fewer attack for each arm spike that is grappling a creature.

actions.name: Arm Spike
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). A creature grappled by three or more of the lost's arms is restrained. The lost has five arm spikes, but may grapple only a single creature at a time, and cannot release a creature voluntarily.

actions.name: Embedding Embrace
actions.description: One creature grappled by the lost takes 7 (2d6) Piercing damage for each arm grappling it and must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the beginning of the lost's next turn. If a creature succeeds on this saving throw by 5 or more the lost is Stunned until the end of its next turn and releases any creature grappled by it.

reactions.name: Psychic Flood
reactions.description: When the lost takes any damage while it has a creature grappled, it can force the grappled creature to succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or take an equal amount of Psychic damage.

name: The Lonely
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +3, Int -2, Cha -2
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing while in Dim Light or Darkness

traits.name: Psychic Leech
traits.description: At the start of each of the lonely's turns, each creature either grappled by it or within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Thrives on Company
traits.description: The lonely has Advantage on attack rolls while it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures. The first time each turn that a creature leaves the lonely's reach, the lonely takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lonely makes two attacks with its Harpoon Arms, each of which it may replace with a use of its Sorrowful Embrace.

actions.name: Harpoon Arms
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 30 ft. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). The lonely's harpoon arms can be attacked (AC 16; 15 Hit Points). Destroying an arm deals no damage to the lonely, which can grow a replacement on its next turn.

actions.name: Sorrowful Embrace
actions.description: Each creature grappled by the lonely takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage and is pulled up to 15 feet towards it.

actions.name: Branching Barbs (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The lonely causes its harpoon arms to grow branching barbs of jagged bone. Each creature grappled by it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Wretched Sobbing
reactions.description: When a creature attempts to leave its reach, the lonely can let out a wretched sob. Each creature within 60 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to move away from the lonely until the beginning of the lonely's next turn.

name: The Hungry
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +3, Int -2, Cha -2
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing while in Dim Light or Darkness

traits.name: Life Hunger
traits.description: If a creature the hungry can see regains Hit Points, the hungry gains Advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. The hungry has Disadvantage on attack rolls made against creatures with no unexpended hit dice.

traits.name: Ruinous Consumption
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn grappled by the hungry must make a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, a creature loses 2d4 unexpended hit dice, then drops to 0 Hit Points if it has no unexpended hit dice remaining. The hungry gains 5 Temporary Hit Points for each hit die expended in this way.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hungry makes two attacks with its Claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage and the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 16). While grappling a creature, the hungry can't attack another creature with its claws.

actions.name: Swallow Whole
actions.description: The hungry begins to swallow a Large or smaller creature that is incapacitated and grappled by it. At the beginning of the hungry's next turn, the target is swallowed and its body is destroyed, and the hungry regains 30 Hit Points. This action is disrupted if the hungry takes any radiant damage, suffers a critical hit, is knocked prone, or is incapacitated, or if the creature it is swallowing regains any Hit Points.

reactions.name: Wave of Exhaustion (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the hungry is reduced below 83 Hit Points, it can force each creature within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or fall prone and be unable to stand on its following turn.

name: The Angry
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +4, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha -2
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing while in Dim Light or Darkness

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.description: The angry has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Pacifism Weakness
traits.description: If a creature within 15 feet of the angry that is not incapacitated ends its turn without taking any hostile action, the angry takes 19 (3d12) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Rising Fury
traits.description: Whenever the angry takes damage from a source other than its Pacifism Weakness, its fury increases by one level. Whenever the angry deals damage, its fury decreases by one level. * 0. Seething. The angry has Disadvantage on attacks made against creatures other than itself. 1. Enraged. The angry's attacks have Advantage. 2. Maddened. The angry's attacks have Advantage. On a hit, its attacks deal an additional 19 (3d12) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The angry makes two attacks with its Hook.

actions.name: Hook
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (3d12 + 3) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Shrieking Charge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The angry moves up to its speed toward the creature that most recently took hostile action against it and makes a melee attack. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be forced to take the attack action on its following turn.

reactions.name: Vicious Outburst
reactions.description: When the angry becomes Maddened, it can move up to half its speed and make a melee attack.

name: Wretch of Kyuss
savingThrows: Str +2, Con +1, Int -3, Wis -2, Cha -4
languages: Understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the wretch takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the wretch takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

traits.name: Worm-Riddled
traits.description: If the wretch is targeted by an effect that cures disease or removes a curse, it dies.

traits.name: Tortured Cries
traits.description: The wretch screams raggedly and calls for help as it attacks. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of 3 or more wretches that can hear them must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened.

actions.name: Frantic Clawing (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Wretched Plea
reactions.description: When the wretch is targeted with a melee attack by a creature within 5 feet, it can allow the attack to hit it without a roll. The attacker must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with the Touch of Kyuss.

name: Spawn of Kyuss
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +4, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -4
languages: Understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Infested Flesh
traits.description: If the spawn is targeted by an effect that cures disease or removes a curse, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or die. On a success, it loses its Burrowing Worm action, and for the next minute regains twice as many Hit Points with its Regeneration, after which it dies.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The spawn regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the spawn takes acid, fire, or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the spawn's next turn. The spawn is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spawn makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Noxious Breath, if available.

actions.name: Writhing Embrace
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). A creature that starts its turn grappled in this way must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be infected with the Touch of Kyuss.

actions.name: Burrowing Worm
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 1 Piercing damage as a worm (AC 6; 1 HP) latches on and begins to burrow into its flesh. At the beginning of the spawn's next turn, the worm slithers into the creature, infecting it with a Worm of Kyuss. The spawn may use this ability as a Bonus Action against a grappled or incapacitated target.

actions.name: Noxious Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The spawn exudes the scent of its worm-riddled innards in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of the spawn's next turn.

reactions.name: Plead for Death
reactions.description:
When a creature grappled by the spawn targets it with a melee attack, the spawn can allow the attack to hit it without a roll. The attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened for as long as it remains grappled.


 Touch of Kyuss. A creature infected by the touch of kyuss suffers from bouts of memory loss and waves of overwhelming nausea. Whenever the infected creature fails a saving throw against being Frightened or Poisoned by 5 or more, it is additionally Stunned until the end of its next turn. Whenever the creature fails one or more Death Saving Throws, its Proficiency Bonus is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0, until this disease is cured.

name: Specter
savingThrows: Str -5, Dex +2
resistances: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
languages: Understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Radiance Sensitivity
traits.description: If the specter takes radiant damage, it loses its damage resistances and it is temporarily made corporeal until the start of its next turn .

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The specter's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

actions.name: Inflict Weakness
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or deal only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the beginning of the specter's next turn.

actions.name: Invisibility (Concentration)
actions.description: the specter becomes invisible until it makes an attack.

reactions.name: Shadow Glide
reactions.description: When the specter takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can teleport up to 60 feet to a location it can see and turn invisible until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

name: Voidsoul Specter
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +3, Con +3, Cha +4
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
languages: Understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the specter takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its Hit Points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

traits.name: Spectral Chill
traits.description: A living creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of three or more voidsoul specters takes 4 Cold damage.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The specter's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

actions.name: Inflict Weakness (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 Necrotic damage. If three or more voidsoul specters contributed to this attack, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or deal only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the beginning of the specter's next turn.

actions.name: Invisibility (Concentration)
actions.description: The specter becomes invisible until it makes an attack.

name: Sword Wraith Warrior
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +3, Int -2, Wis -1, Cha +2
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Flattery Vulnerability
traits.description: As an action, a creature within 30 feet of the wraith can attempt a DC 14 Charisma (Persuasion) check to flatter the wraith's combat prowess. On a success, the wraith's attacks deal half as much damage to that creature for the next minute.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons
traits.description: The sword wraith's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sword wraith makes two weapon attacks, one of which it may replace with its Reckless Challenge.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Attack: +3 range 150/600 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Reckless Challenge
actions.description: The wraith challenges a creature it can see within 30 feet to single combat, forcing it to make a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature gains Advantage on attacks that target the wraith and Disadvantage on all other attacks for the next minute, or until the wraith is destroyed.

name: Sword Wraith Deathseeker
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +4, Wis +1, Cha +2
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Flattery Vulnerability
traits.description: As an action, a creature within 30 feet of the wraith can attempt a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check to flatter the wraith's combat prowess. On a success, the wraith's attacks deal half as much damage to that creature for the next minute.

traits.name: Spectral Weapons

actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage and Hit: 5 (1d8) necrotic damage

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Attack: +5 range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage and Hit: 5 (1d8) necrotic damage.

On a failure, the creature gains Advantage on attacks that target the wraith and Disadvantage on all other attacks for the next minute, or until the wraith is destroyed.

reactions.name: Empathic Lash
reactions.description: When the sword wraith is hit with a melee weapon attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage and be Stunned until the end of the sword wraith's next turn.

name: Sword Wraith Commander
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +4, Wis +3, Cha +2
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage and Hit: 5 (1d8) necrotic damage

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Attack: +8 range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage and Hit: 5 (1d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Reckless Challenge
actions.description: The wraith challenges a creature it can see within 30 feet to single combat, forcing it to make a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature gains Advantage on attacks that target the wraith and Disadvantage on all other attacks for the next minute, or until the wraith is destroyed.

reactions.name: Call to Honor (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the sword wraith is reduced below 63 Hit Points, it can gain Advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn and summon 3 (1d4 + 1) Sword Wraith Warriors in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet.

name: Ulgurstasta
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +1, Con +9, Int -5, Wis +7, Cha +4
resistances: Cold, Necrotic, Attacks made at Disadvantage.
immunities: Acid, Poison, Turned; Charmed, Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Unconscious
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Cloying Mucous
traits.description: The ulgurstasta is covered in distended pores that weep a foul smelling mucous. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the ulgurstasta must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Suffocating Bulk
traits.description: The ulgurstasta may enter the space of any prone creature. A creature whose space the ulgurstasta enters is Blinded, grappled (escape DC 18), and can't speak or breathe.

traits.name: Necromantic Acid
traits.description: A creature killed by Acid damage dealt by the ulgurstasta has its flesh slough off and rises at the beginning of the ulgurstasta's next turn as a Decrepit Skeleton under the ulgurstasta's control. Skeletons are immune to Acid damage dealt by the ulgurstasta.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ulgurstasta makes two attacks with its Body Slam, one of which it may replace with its Swallow Whole or Storm of Tendrils.

actions.name: Swallow Whole
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the ulgurstasta, and it takes Hit: 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns. If the ulgurstasta takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, an opening in its side large enough to permit escape is created. Until the ulgurstasta completes a Short or Long Rest, each creature in the ulgurstasta's stomach may attempt to escape (escape DC 18) by spending its full movement.

actions.name: Body Slam
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Storm of Tendrils (Concentration)
actions.description: The ulgurstasta unfurls millions of hair-thin 40-foot long tendrils coiled within its pores that whip about in a frenzy. For the next minute, or until it take any radiant damage, attacks made by living creatures within 40 feet are made at Disadvantage, and ranged attacks against the ulgurstasta made from outside that area roll three dice and take the lowest result.

actions.name: Skeletonizer Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The ugurstasta forcefully expels the contents of its stomach in a 30-foot cone. Each living creature in the ulgurstasta's stomach and 5 (2d4) Decrepit Skeletons are expelled in the area, then each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or be coated in the ulgurstasta's necromantic acid, taking 14 (4d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature takes an action to scrape it off.

name: Vampire Spawn Starveling
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +5, Con +3, Wis +2, Cha +1
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Blood-Starved
traits.description: If the vampire has not fed on humanoid blood in the last 24 hours, it cannot use its multiattack.

traits.name: Inherited Weaknesses
traits.description: The vampire has each of its creator's weaknesses.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vampire makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft., one grappled, incapacitated, restrained, or willing creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or lose one unexpended hit die, or drop to 0 Hit Points if it cannot. If the creature expends a hit die in this way, the vampire spawn gains resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks Not Made With Wooden Weapons until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Blood-Crazed Advance
reactions.description: When a creature within 30 feet takes piercing or Slashing damage, the vampire can move up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +7, Con +4, Int +2, Wis +3, Cha +1

actions.description: The vampire loses 16 (3d10) Hit Points and another vampire that it can see within 30 feet gains that many Temporary Hit Points. name: Vampire
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +9, Con +4, Int +5, Wis +7, Cha +9
resistances: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than Bonus Actions, and cannot regain any Hit Points until it completes a Long Rest in its resting place. If it does not return to its resting place by the following dawn, the vampire is destroyed.

traits.description: The vampire has two traits from the Common Weaknesses table, two traits from the Uncommon Weaknesses table, and four traits from the vampiric powers table. Its weaknesses must include a method of destruction.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.description: The vampire makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with its Blood Drain.

actions.name: Charm

languages: the languages it knew in life

actions.name: Enchain Essence (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet that the vampire can see must make a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is restrained and has vulnerability to all damage for the next minute. The creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Lacerating Rain (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: A hail of jagged blades formed from blood rain down in a 15-foot radius centered on a point the vampire can see. Each creature in the area make a DC 20 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 31 (7d8) Slashing damage and begins to bleed, losing 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns for the next minute, or until it receives any magical healing. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much Slashing damage.

actions.name: Blood Puppeteering (Recharge 5-6, Level 6 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet that the vampire can see must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or have its body controlled by the vampire for the next minute. On each of the creature's turns, the creature takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage, then moves up to its speed and takes the attack action. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Bestow Wound (Level 2 Spell)
reactions.description: When the vampire is hit with an attack, it can force a creature it can see within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failure, the vampire takes half as much damage from the attack and the target takes the same amount.

reactions.name: Command Ichor (Level 2 Spell)
reactions.description: When a creature the vampire can see within 60 feet takes piercing or Slashing damage, the vampire can force the creature to succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 30 feet in a direction of the vampire's choice.

legendaryActions.name: Reaping Glide
legendaryActions.description: The vampire moves up to its fly speed. Each creature that makes an attack of opportunity provoked by this movement takes 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage.

legendaryActions.name: Dweomer Rupture (0th Level Spell)
legendaryActions.description: One creature the vampire can see within 60 feet must make a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage the next time it casts a spell before the end of the vampire's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Blood Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The vampire makes an attack with its Blood Drain.

legendaryActions.name: Rend Magic (Level 3 Spell, Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The controller of one spell or magical effect the vampire can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw or have the spell or effect end. If the magical effect was produced by an item, the item may not be activated again until the end of the wielder's next turn.

name: Vampiric Mist
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +3, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +3, Cha -2
resistances: Acid, Cold, Lightning, Necrotic, Thunder; and Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Enveloping Mists
traits.description: The mist can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any space that air can pass through without squeezing. A creatrure that starts its turn in the mist must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or have its movement speed halved until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Destroyed by Sunlight
traits.description: A mist that starts its turn in sunlight may take only the Dash action. A mist that ends its turn in sunlight is destroyed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mist makes one (Medium), two (Large), or three (Huge or Larger) attacks with its shred lungs, depending on its size.

actions.name: Hemorrhaging Call
actions.description: Each creature within 5 ft. of the mist must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or lose an unexpended hit die, or drop to 0 Hit Points if it is unable to. If at least one hit die was expended in this way, the mist gains 20 Temporary Hit Points, increases in size by one category to a maximum of Gargantuan, and loses its damage resistances until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Shred Lungs
actions.description: One creature in the mist's space must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage and be unable to speak or breathe for the next minute.

reactions.name: Shifting Mists
reactions.description: When the mist takes damage of a type it is not resistant to, it can move up to half its speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

name: Vitreous Drinker
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +4, Con +4, Int +8, Wis +6, Cha +3
languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Infernal, Telepathy 500 ft.

traits.name: Eyes Everywhere
traits.description: The area in a 500 ft. radius around the drinker is surveilled from above by a murder of spectral crows. The drinker can see everything seen by any of the crows, and by any creature affected by its Curse of Stolen Sight.

traits.name: Piercing Gaze
traits.description: The drinker can read the surface thoughts of any creature it can see.

traits.name: Blind Weakness
traits.description: If the drinker fails a saving throw against an effect that would blind it, it may choose to succeed instead. If it does, the creature most recently affected by its Curse of Stolen Sight is freed from the effect.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The drinker makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Curse of Stolen Sight.

actions.name: Lashing Tongue
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 22 (4d10) necrotic damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Curse of Stolen Sight
actions.description: One creature grappled by the drinker must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed, causing one of its eyes cloud over and giving it Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

actions.name: Descent of Crows (Recharge 6)
actions.description: One creature within 500 ft. that the vitrous drinker can see is mobbed by spectral crows. The creature is Blinded until it moves at least 5 ft., and must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Dimension Door (3/day, Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: The drinker teleports up to 500 feet.

traits.name: Weep Black Bile
traits.description: When the wheep fails a saving throw, poisonous black bile gushes from its empty eye sockets and over its face and body. Until the start of its next turn, a creature that hits the wheep with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Paralyzed until the end of the wheep's next turn.

While the wheep is latched onto a creature, its ceaseless wail ends, and the target cannot speak or breathe as a breathless, endless scream of horror tears out of it. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns or drop to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Broken Claws

immunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Variable Illumination

actions.name: Borrow Life

If the created wisp dies within the next minute, the creature it was created from returns to life with 1 hit point.

actions.name: Invisibility (Concentration)

actions.name: Lure

actions.name: Sparkjump
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d8) lightning damage and the wisp teleports up to 15 feet to a location it can see. If the wisp ends this movement within 5 feet of a creature it has not attacked this turn, it may make an attack against it as part of this action.

actions.name: Lure
actions.description: One creature that can see the wisp must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed by the wisp until the end of the wisp's next turn. While Charmed in this way, a creature must use all of its movement to approach the wisp.

actions.name: Ghostflame Ignition

actions.name: Lure
actions.description: One creature that can see the wisp must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed by the wisp until the end of the wisp's next turn. While Charmed in this way, a creature must use all of its movement to approach the wisp.

reactions.name: Ghostflare
reactions.description: When the wisp is missed with a melee attack, it can make an attack with its Ghostflame Ignition.

reactions.name: Reignite

name: Witherling Rabble

actions.name: Grafted-Blade Claws (Group Attack)
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Vengeful Lunge
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature the witherling can see reduces an ally of the witherling's to 0 Hit Points, the witherling lunges up to half its speed directly towards the creature. If three or more witherlings take this reaction and end this movement within 5 feet of the creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

name: Witherling Clatterbones
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -3, Wis -3, Cha -3

traits.name: Rampage
traits.description: When the witherling reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack on its turn, the witherling can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a Bonecracker Bite attack.

traits.name: Withered Bones
traits.description: If the witherling takes 20 or more damage from a single source, it falls prone and cannot stand until it regains at least one hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The witherling makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Bonecracker Bite.

actions.name: Bonecracker Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage. On a roll of 1, the witherling loses the ability to use this attack as its jaw shatters.

actions.name: Razor Club

traits.name: Volatile Blast
traits.description: If the zombie takes any Fire damage, it dies and explodes in a 20-foot Emanation. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 14 (4d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zombie makes two attacks with its Clumsy Grasp.

actions.name: Clumsy Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Festering Bite
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft., targets one Grappled creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage and Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

name: Zombie Ogre Fleshsiege
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -2, Con +4, Int -4, Wis -2, Cha -3
languages: Understands the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Gatebreaker
traits.description: The zombie deals double damage to objects and structures. When it reduces a Medium or larger object to 0 Hit Points, it can send shrapnel flying in a 15-foot Cone, dealing 3 (1d6) Slashing to each creature in the area.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: When the zombie is reduced to 0 Hit Points by a source other than Radiant damage or a Critical Hit, roll a d6. On a 3+, the zombie regains 1 Hit Point at the start of its next turn, unless it takes any other damage before then.

actions.name: Manthresher Morningstar
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target is pushed 10 feet, knocked Prone, and can't stand for one minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Crushing Stomp
actions.description: One Prone creature within 5 feet must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage and the creature is Grappled (escape DC 14) until the zombie moves. A creature wearing nonmagical metal armor that fails this saving throw has its armor deform. While wearing this armor, the creature is Choking, and can use an Action or Bonus Action on its turn to take a breath.

reactions.name: Stumbling Sweep
reactions.description: Trigger: The zombie misses with an attack. Response: The zombie makes a new attack with Disadvantage against a different target in its reach. If this attack misses, the zombie falls Prone and ends its turn.

name: Chillborn Zombie
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -4, Wis -2, Cha -3
languages: Understands the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Chillborne Aura
traits.description: The zombie radiates bitter cold in a 10-foot Emanation. A creature that starts its turn in this area takes 4 (1d8) Cold damage for each such area it is in.

traits.name: Supercooled
traits.description: If the zombie takes any Bludgeoning damage, it freezes solid, becoming Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zombie makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Freeze Blood.

actions.name: Frost-Rimed Grasp
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). A creature that starts its turn Grappled in this way has its Speed cumulatively reduced by 10 feet for 1 minute. This effect ends early if the creature regains any Hit Points or takes any Fire damage.

actions.name: Freeze Blood
actions.description: One creature Grappled by the zombie must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The creature is Paralyzed until the end of the zombie's next turn. A creature with a Speed greater than 10 feet has Advantage on this saving throw.

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned
languages: Understands the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Unliving Horde
traits.description: If the horde takes 11 or more non-Radiant damage from a single source (after Resistances), roll a d6. On a 3+ the damage is reduced by 5.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The horde can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, can move through any opening large enough for a single zombie, and it can’t regain Hit Points.

actions.name: Grasp of the Dead
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 0 ft. Hit: 18 (5d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or half as much if the horde is Bloodied, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 11).

actions.name: Grisly Feast
actions.description: Each Grappled creature in the horde's space must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: 10 (3d6) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Clumsy Lunge
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the horde. Response: The creature must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The target is Grappled (escape DC 11).

actions.name: Putrid Gout (Recharge 5-6)

traits.name: Deathly Stench

traits.name: Unliving Horde

actions.name: Drag Within
actions.description: The clot engulfs one creature Grappled by it, forcing it to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target is Swallowed (escape DC 16). The Swallowed creature takes 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns. If the clot is Bloodied, the creature has Advantage on checks made to escape.

actions.name: Shackles of Flesh (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The clot flings a clump of corpses at a creature it can see within 30 feet, forcing it to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 33 (6d10) Bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked Prone. Success or Failure: Three Prone Zombie Rotters that act on initiative 0 appear in the nearest unoccupied spaces to the target.

reactions.name: Grasping Mass
reactions.description: Trigger: The clot is hit with a melee attack. Response: The attacker must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target is Grappled (escape DC 16).

name: Ismark
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +1, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Silver Tongue
traits.description: Ismark has Advantage on Charisma based skill checks to interact with guards or other figures of authority.

traits.name: Duelist's Eye
traits.description: Ismark can make two reactions each round, as long as he is not flanked. He may not make more than one reaction in response to a single trigger.

actions.name: Broadsword
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Chivalrous Parry
reactions.description: As a reaction to Ismark or an adjacent creature being targeted with a melee attack, Ismark adds 2 to the target's AC against that attack.

reactions.name: Bon Mot
reactions.description: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, Ismark makes a cutting remark. The attacker must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom Saving Throw or suffer Disadvantage on attack rolls that target Ismark until the end of the attacker's next turn.

immunities: Poison, Turned; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Cursed Resilience
traits.description: When Vladimir is reduced to 0 Hit Points, he does not die or fall unconscious. Instead, he loses the ability to use his multiattack and releases all grappled creatures, and must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw at the end of each of his turns or die. If Vladimir takes radiant or Fire damage while at 0 Hit Points, he is killed immediately.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Unrelenting Advance (Greatsword +3)
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage plus Hit: 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Gauntlet Strike
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

actions.name: Fearsome Gaze
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or become Frightened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Shake Bones (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or have its skeleton rattle within its flesh, taking 42 (12d6) points of Bludgeoning damage and moving up to 10 feet in a direction of vladimir's choice on a failure, or taking half damage on a success. A creature with 0 Hit Points that fails this save dies. At the begining of its next turn, its skeleton tears itself out of the creature's body, acting on the creature's initiative.

reactions.name: Counterattack
reactions.description: Vladimir adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. If this causes the attack to miss, vladimir may make a melee attack as part of this reaction.

reactions.name: Turn The Living (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 90 Hit Points, the Vladimir forces each living creature within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened of him for the next minute. While Frightened in this way, a creature must use its action to dash away from vladimir, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Unrelenting Advance
reactions.description: This blackened silver greatsword gains a cumulative +1 magic bonus at the conclusion of each combat encounter its wielder emerges victorious from, resetting to +0 whenever the wielder completes a Long Rest.

languages: the languages it knew in life
