actions.description: One creature grappled by the weird must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Sticky Seal
reactions.description: When a creature the caramel weird can see within 15 feet begins to cast a spell, it sloshes a gob of sticky sugar into the creature's mouth. For the next minute, whenever the target casts a spell it must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw with DC equal to 10 + the spell's level or have the spell fail. On a successful saving throw, the effect ends.

name: Gummy Owlbear
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Bouncy
traits.description: If the owlbear would take any fall damage, it instead takes half as much, and may jump up to 20 feet at the start of its next turn as a bonus action.

traits.name: Concussive Strength
traits.description: A creature knocked prone by the owlbear must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The owlbear makes two attacks, one of which may be with its beak.

actions.name: Gummy Beak
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. This attack does an additional 4 (1d8) damage to a prone creature.

actions.name: Gummy Claws
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. A creature that takes 10 or more damage from this attack is knocked prone.

reactions.name: Rippling Jiggle
reactions.description:
When the owlbear takes any Bludgeoning damage, it can
force one creature within 5 feet of it to make a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the owlbear gains resistance to the triggering damage, and the target takes an equal amount of Bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

name: Rock Candy Ooze
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -2, Con +4, Int -5, Wis +1, Cha -5
immunities: Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Soluble Form
traits.description: If the ooze is doused in at least one gallon of water, it takes 5 (2d4) Acid damage at the beginning of each of its turns until a creature brushes the water off as an action.

traits.name: Shard Resorption
traits.description: If the ooze takes 10 or more bludgeoning or Thunder damage, a shard (16 AC; 5 Hit Points; immunity to poison damage) of it breaks off and lands in an unoccupied space of the attacker's choice within 10 feet of the ooze. When the ooze enters a space that contains one of these shards, it regains 10 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ooze makes two attacks with its Sugar-Gem Slam.

actions.name: Sugar-Gem Slam
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Crystal Stasis
actions.description: One creature grappled by the ooze must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 13) as the ooze moves into its space and begins to engulf it. A creature that starts its turn restrained in this must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be engulfed and petrified for as long as it remains restrained. A creature Petrified in this way has total cover against outside effects.

actions.name: Candy-Coated Control
actions.description: One creature Petrified by the ooze's Crystal Stasis moves up to its speed and takes an action under the ooze's control.

name: Marshmallow Golem
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -2, Con +2, Int -5, Wis -1, Cha -5
resistances: piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks
immunities: poison, bludgeoning; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned

traits.name: Puffed-Up Expansion
traits.description: If the golem takes 10 or more Fire damage from a single source, it expands, becoming size Large until the end of its next turn. While it is enlarged in this way, the golem's melee attacks are made at Advantage and deal an additional die of damage, and the golem has vulnerability to Fire damage.

traits.name: Limited Magic Resistance
traits.description: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects that target only it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two attacks with its Pillowy Fist.

actions.name: Pillowy Fist
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target is pushed 10 feet away, then takes Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage if it is pushed into a solid object or if the target was grappled. A Medium or smaller creature the target is pushed into is pushed 5 feet away.

reactions.name: Marshmallow Glop
reactions.description: When the golem takes 10 or more Fire damage from a single source, it flings a spray of molten globules in a 15-foot cone. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled in place (escape DC 14)

name: Gummy Worker
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Bouncy
traits.description: If the worker would take any fall damage, it instead takes half as much, and may jump up to 20 feet at the start of its next turn as a bonus action.

traits.name: Acidic Immune System
traits.description: The worker has Advantage on saving throws to resist being poisoned or infected with a disease.

actions.name: Makeshift Weapon
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. or range 20/60, Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Gummy Unity
actions.description: The worker touches a gummybear within 5 feet that was reduced to 0 Hit Points since the end of the worker's last turn, briefly sticking to and melding with it. The worker loses 5 Hit Points, and the target regains 1 hit point.

bonusActions.name: Sour Cloud (1/day)
bonusActions.description: The worker emits prickly sour particles in a 10-foot-radius. Each other creature in the area that needs to breathe must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Featureless Anatomy (1/day)
reactions.description: When a creature it can see hits the worker with a critical hit, the worker can change it into a normal hit, then fall prone.

name: Honeycrust Ant Guard
savingThrows: Str +2, Con +2, Int -3, Cha -1
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Crystal-Honey Shell
traits.description: If the ant takes any Fire damage, its AC is reduced to 10 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Clacking Mandibles
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Honey Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The ant sprays gooey honey in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage and be doused in honey. Until a creature cleans the honey off by magical means or by spending ten minutes, the creature's movement speed is reduced by 10 feet.

reactions.name: Hive Frenzy
reactions.description: When a friendly creature the ant can see within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the ant can move up to 10 feet towards it.

reactions.name: Molten Adhesion
reactions.description: When the ant is hit with a melee weapon attack while its AC is reduced through its Crystal-Honey Shell trait, it can force the attacker to succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or have its weapon stick to the ant. As a bonus action, a creature may attempt a contested Strength (Athletics) check against the ant to free a stuck weapon.

name: Dr. Melissa Blongata, Corrupted Confectioner
savingThrows: Dex +4, Con +3, Int +4, Wis +2, Cha +2

traits.name: Candifying Gaze
traits.description: When a creature that can see Dr. Blongata's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of her, she can force it to succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or gain 10 Temporary Hit Points as crystalline candy begins to grow over its skin. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, a creature is restrained. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn, treating Dr. Blongata as invisible until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Soluble Form
traits.description: If Dr. Blongata is doused in at least one gallon of water, she takes 5 (2d4) Acid damage at the beginning of each of her turns until a creature brushes the water off as an action.

traits.name: Researcher's Resistance (1/Day)
traits.description: If Dr. Blongata fails a saving throw while within 15 feet of one of her experimental candy tanks, she may choose to succeed instead. If she does, the tank is damaged and immediately releases its contents.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Dr. Blongata makes two attacks with her Taffy Garotte or Lollipop Shurikens, one of which she may replace with a use of her Sugarshift Seal.

actions.name: Taffy Garotte
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is Grappled (escape DC 16). While grappled in this way, a creature cannot speak or breathe.

actions.name: Lollipop Shurikens
actions.description: Attack: +8 range 20/60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sugarsift Seal
actions.description: Dr. Blongata sprinkles a dusting of magic sugar on a creature within 5 feet that has any Temporary Hit Points from her Candifying Gaze, causing the rock candy encrusting the creature to expand. The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or become petrified for as long as it has any of those Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Gummysnake Bite Flurry (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Dr. Blongata lashes out at a creature within 5 feet with her gummysnake hair, injecting intolerably sour venom. The creature must make a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature takes 26 (8d8) Acid damage and its mouth puckers up, making it unable to speak until the end of Dr. Blongata's next turn. On a successful saving throw, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects.

reactions.name: Compel Gaze
reactions.description: When a creature that is averting its eyes misses Dr. Blongata with a melee attack, she can force it to stop averting its eyes and immediately make a saving throw against her Candifying Gaze.

legendaryActions.name: Sucker Hail
legendaryActions.description: Dr. Blongata makes up to three attacks with her Lollipop Shurikens, each of which must target a different creature.

legendaryActions.name: Cutthroat Shift
legendaryActions.description: Dr. Blongata moves up to half her speed. Then, if each hostile creature within 30 feet of her is averting its gaze, she may attempt to hide.

legendaryActions.name: Release Experiment
legendaryActions.description: Dr. Blongata magically activates the emergency release valve on an experimental candy tank she can see within 30 feet, releasing its contents immediately.

name: Bedeviled Egg
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex -1, Con +2, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha -2
immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

traits.name: Stiffening Foam
traits.description: Whenever the egg takes Bludgeoning damage, its speed is reduced by 5 feet for the next minute. If the egg's speed is reduced to 0 in this way, the devilish spirit possessing it is exorcised and it transforms into an ordinary egg.

traits.name: Devilish Intolerance
traits.description: The egg cannot voluntarily cross a line of salt. If a creature uses its bonus action to cast salt on the egg, the egg subtracts 1d4 from the first saving throw it makes before the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Sloshing Slam
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage and the egg is pushed 10 feet directly away from the target.

actions.name: Egg Wash
actions.description: The egg flings a translucent glob at a creature it can see within 30 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (4d4) Bludgeoning damage and be encased in a glossy bubble. For the next minute, ranged attacks made by or against the encased creature are at Disadvantage. The bubble pops if the creature takes or deals any damage, ending the effect.

name: Cloud Chicken
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Struggling Flight
traits.description: The chicken falls 10 feet at the end of each of its turns if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its fly speed.

traits.name: Ephemeral Head
traits.description: If the chicken takes 5 or more Slashing damage from a single source, its head turns to mist and disperses until the start of its next turn. The chicken must immediately use its reaction to move its full speed in a random direction or until it hits a solid object. While its head is missing, the chicken is blinded and it can't use its Floaty Peck action.

actions.name: Floaty Peck
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be levitated 10 feet into the air until the end of its next turn. An affected creature can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing.

actions.name: Lay Egg (1/Day)
actions.description: With a mighty squawk, the chicken abruptly lays a cloud egg. One creature directly beneath the chicken must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and be Stunned until the end of the chicken's next turn. If the egg falls more than 5 feet and no creature fails this saving throw, the egg breaks.

bonusActions.name: Cloud Bath (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: The chicken ruffles its feathers and shakes vigorously, absorbing air and moisture from its surroundings until it becomes nearly spherical. The chicken gains 11 Temporary Hit Points and its head is restored if it was missing. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the chicken has resistance to bludgeoning and Slashing damage, and cannot use its fly speed.

name: Spice Devil
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +3, Con +1, Wis +1, Cha +2
resistances: Cold; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

traits.name: Epicure of Pain
traits.description: Whenever the devil takes damage from an ability it controls, it gains resistance to all damage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Limited Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects that are not gastromancy spells.

actions.name: Chili Spray
actions.description: The spice devil flings a spray of caustic pepper from its hands in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 5 (2d4) Acid damage and be blinded until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Gastrointestinal Distress (1/day, Level 1 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the devil can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Acid damage, fall prone and be unable to stand for the next minute. The creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Devour Spell
reactions.description: As a reaction when the devil succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the devil devours the spell's remaining energy, negating its effects. The devil takes 1d10 Force damage per level of the negated spell, then regains a use of its Gastrointestinal Distress.

name: Spore Globe
savingThrows: Str -4, Dex -5, Con -1, Int -5, Wis -5, Cha -5

traits.name: Host-Seeking
traits.description: Whenever a nonplant creature within 60 feet of the globe starts its turn, the globe may move up to 5 feet towards it.

actions.name: Toxic Effluvia
actions.description: Each creature within 5 feet of the globe must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution Saving Throw or take 3 (1d6) poison damage. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with Burrow-Diver Mycosis.

name: Spore Servant Incubator
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -3, Con +3, Int -4, Wis -2, Cha -3
immunities: Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned

traits.name: Spore Host
traits.description: When the spore servant dies, 1d4-1 Spore Globes that act on initiative count 0 emerge from its wounds.

traits.name: Sudden Lunge
traits.description: The spore servant's attacks have a reach of 10 feet for the purposes of making Opportunity Attacks. When it makes an attack of opportunity against a creature more than 5 feet away, the spore servant moves 5 feet towards its target as part of the attack.

actions.name: Shambling Slam
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Death Grip
actions.description: The spore servant dies, and one creature grappled by it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 12) as fungal shoots burst from the spore servant's body. A creature restrained in this way takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the end of each of its turns.

name: Spore Servant Behemoth
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex -1, Con +5, Int -2, Cha +1

traits.name: Greater Spore Host
traits.description: When the behemoth dies, 2d4 + 1 Spore Globes that act on initiative count 0 emerge from its wounds.

traits.name: Creature of the Dark
traits.description: Attacks that deal acid, fire or radiant damage are made at Advantage against the behemoth. If the behemoth takes 10 or more acid, fire, or radiant damage from a single source, a hole is burned in it. Until it completes a long rest, a creature engulfed by the behemoth may escape it as an action with a successful DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check.

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the behemoth may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the behemoth. While climbing on the behemoth, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against the behemoth, and the behemoth has Disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the behemoth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The behemoth makes two attacks with its Stalk Slam, one of which it may replace with a use of its Engulf, and uses its Spore Breath, if available.

actions.name: Stalk Slam
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 15 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 18). Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take half the attack's damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: The behemoth engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. While engulfed, the creature is blinded, restrained, its attacks bypass the behemoth's damage resistances, and it takes 10 (3d6) poison damage at the start of each of the behemoth's turns.

actions.name: Spore Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The behemoth releases a spray of toxic spores in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage and be infected with Burrow Diver Mycosis, or take half as much damage on success.

legendaryActions.name: Roil
legendaryActions.description: A tidal wave of thrashing mycelia spill out from the behemoth in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

legendaryActions.name: Burgeoning
legendaryActions.description: The Behemoth rapidly buds and splits off 1d4 + 1 Spore Globes, which appear in its space and may each immediately move up to 10 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Dream of the Azure Abyss
legendaryActions.description: One creature infected with Burrow Diver Mycosis that the behemoth can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to move up to its speed directly toward the behemoth, then fall prone.

name: Detrivore Sporocyte
savingThrows: Str +1, Con +2, Int -3, Wis -2, Cha -3

traits.name: Creeping Refuse
traits.description: Ranged attacks made against the sporocyte from more than 15 feet away are made at Disadvantage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The sporocyte can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Stinging Spines
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Membranous Expansion
actions.description: The sporocyte fills its internal air sacks, inflating itself and regaining the use of its Spore Gout. The next attack made against the detrivore before the start of its next turn is made at Advantage.

reactions.name: Sudden Drop
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature passes directly beneath the sporocyte, the sporocyte falls from the surface it was climbing on, and the creature must make a DC 11 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, the sporocyte grapples the creature (escape DC 11) and takes no fall damage. On a success, the creature moves into the nearest unoccupied space.

reactions.name: Spore Gout (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the sporocyte releases a torrent of spores in a 15-foot cone. Each nonplant creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and be infected with Burrow-Diver Mycosis.

name: Deathbloom Sporocyte
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +2, Int -3, Wis -2, Cha -3

traits.name: Corpse Drainer
traits.description: If the sporocyte starts its turn within 5 feet of one or more dead or unconscious creatures, it gains 5 (1d10) Temporary Hit Points and each creature in the area takes an equal amount of Necrotic damage. On a roll of 10, a random corpse within 5 feet of the sporocyte dissolves.

actions.name: Rotting Slam
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage immediately fails a Death saving throw.

actions.name: Unfurl Mycelia
actions.description: The sporocyte spreads a carpet of mycelia over the ground within 5 feet of it. square centered on itself. While unfurled, the sporocyte's movement speed is 0, the affected area is difficult terrain, and if the sporocyte would gain Temporary Hit Points, it instead gains twice as many Temporary Hit Points. The sporocyte may retract its mycelia as a bonus action.

reactions.name: Spore Gout (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the sporocyte releases a torrent of spores in a 15-foot cone. Each nonplant creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and be infected with Burrow-Diver Mycosis.

name: Germinator Sporocyte
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +4, Int -1, Wis -2, Cha -2

traits.name: Cyclospore Anima
traits.description: At the beginning of each of the sporocyte's turns, one creature the sporocyte can see within 60 feet gains 11 (2d10) Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, a creature has Disadvantage on Constitution and Death saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sporocyte makes two attacks with its fecund touch.

actions.name: Fecund Touch
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next Constitution Saving Throw it makes before the end of the sporocyte's next turn.

actions.name: Pallid Rooting
actions.description: One creature the sporocyte can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned for the next minute. A creature Poisoned in this way repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 28 (8d6) Piercing damage and being restrained (escape DC 15) until the end of its next turn on a failure.

reactions.name: Spore Gout (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the sporocyte releases a torrent of spores in a 15-foot cone. Each nonplant creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and be infected with Burrow-Diver Mycosis.

name: Gasbide, the Pit-Maddened
savingThrows: Str +1, Con +2, Int +2, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Abyssal Inspiration
traits.description: On its turn, Gasbide may take an additional bonus action for each demonic shrine within 100 feet of him, to a maximum of three total bonus actions. Each shrine is an object that can be attacked (AC 18; 10 HP; immunity to poison and Psychic damage).

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.description: While in sunlight, Gasbide has Disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. Gasbide dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Gasbide makes two attacks with its Toxic Touch, one of which it may replace with a use of its Manatrap Spores, if available.

actions.name: Toxic Touch
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage. This attack is made with Advantage against a Poisoned target.

actions.name: Rhizome Bindings
actions.description: One creature Gasbide can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 12) as pallid tendrils burst from the earth beneath it. While Gasbide has any Temporary Hit Points, it may use this ability as a bonus action.

actions.name: Manatrap Spores (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Gasbide flares its gills and shudders, filling the air in a 20-foot radius around it with faintly luminous spores that last for a minute. A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must make a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature loses its lowest level unexpended spell slot, and Gasbide gains 5 Temporary Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Invocation of the Rot Mother
bonusActions.description: Until the beginning of Gasbide's next turn its melee attacks deal an additional 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage to any creature that is Poisoned or infected with Charnel Lung.

bonusActions.name: Invocation of the Deep Father
bonusActions.description: One creature Gasbide can see must make a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, attacks against that creature score a critical on an 18-20 until the beginning of Gasbide's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Invocation of the Formless One
bonusActions.description: Until the start of his next turn, Gasbide gains Advantage on Strength and Constitution Saving Throws, and suffers no effects on a successful Strength or Constitution Saving Throw.

reactions.name: Ruinous Foundation (1/Day)
reactions.description:
As a reaction when Gasbide is reduced below 69 Hit Points, it causes the ground within 20 feet of it to crack and churn, venting foul vapors as the fungal roots beneath are warped and corrupted. The area becomes difficult terrain, each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned for the next minute. A Poisoned creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.


 Charnel Lung.	An infected creature cannot hold its breath and has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws made to resist breathable toxins.

name: Gorthok the Thunder Boar
savingThrows: Str +5, Con +4, Int -2, Cha +2
resistances: Bludgeoning and Slashing from Attacks Made Without Advantage

traits.name: Sky Scenting
traits.description: Gorthok has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell, and can sense the type, number, and direction of flying creatures within 1 mile.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to Gorthok may spend half of its movement to attempt a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check, climbing onto Gorthok on a success. While climbing on Gorthok, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks against Gorthok and Gorthok has Disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

traits.name: Stark-Light Charge
traits.description: Whenever a creature within 500 feet of Gorthok takes any Lightning damage, Gorthok can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. If Gorthok teleported at least 20 feet in this way, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Vengeance of the Tempest
traits.description: When Gorthok is killed, each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw or be Cursed until Gorthok is returned to life. Whenever a creature Cursed in this way takes any Lightning damage, it takes an additional 4 (1d8) Thunder damage. A creature that magically removes this curse takes 27 (6d8) Lightning damage, then must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma Saving Throw or suffer the same curse.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.description: If Gorthok fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Gorthok makes two melee attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Stormlord's Fury.

actions.name: Crackling Tusks
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) lightning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Thunder-Hoof Trample
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft., one pr Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) thunder damage.

actions.name: Stormlord's Fury
actions.description: Gorthok rears up, calling down a bolt of lightning from the heavens toward a creature he can see within 120 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Lightning damage, or half as much on a success. If Gorthok has fewer than 64 Hit Points, this ability can target a second creature within 15 feet of the first target.

actions.name: Rooting Rush (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Gorthok moves up to half his speed, dragging his tusks through the ground, then flings them forward, spraying debris in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success. The ground that Gorthok passes over with this movement becomes difficult terrain.

reactions.name: Squall-Call Squeal (1/Day)
reactions.description: When Gorthok is reduced below 64 Hit Points, he hurls a deafening squeal skyward, immediately calling down a heavy deluge in a 1 mile radius. For the next hour, each creature in the area subtracts 1d4 from any saving throws it makes against effects that deal Lightning damage.

reactions.name: Foaming Defiance
reactions.description: When he would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, Gorthok can make a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw. On a success, he is instead reduced to 1 hit point. If triggered by Piercing damage or a critical hit, this saving throw is made at Disadvantage.

legendaryActions.name: On Howling Winds
legendaryActions.description: One creature Gorthok can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 20 feet in a direction of Gorthok's choice. If the creature ends this movement in the air, it does not fall until the end of its next turn, or until it takes any damage.

legendaryActions.name: Tear Down the World
legendaryActions.description: Gorthok leaps up to 20 feet, crashing into an unoccupied space and sending out a thunderous pulse in a 15-foot radius. Each nonmagical wall in the area is destroyed, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take 4 (1d8) Thunder damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

name: Namur-Ezid, Ahurazad Agent
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +7, Int +9, Wis +6, Cha +1

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.description: While it is not Bloodied, the agent automatically succeeds on saving throws against any effect that would affect its mind or detect its thoughts.

traits.name: Prophetic Conjecture
traits.description: While the agent isn't Concentrating, it can't be Surprised and the first attack made against it each turn has Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The agent makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Symmetry Loop.

actions.name: Bolt From Beyond
actions.description: Attack: +9 range 120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) psychic damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet in a direction of the agent's choice. This attack hits its target automatically if it was not made with Disadvantage.

actions.name: Symmetry Loop (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A loop of golden threadlight whorls out from the agent in a 20-foot Emanation, forcing each creature in the area to make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The creature is cosmically linked to the agent for 1 minute. Whenever the agent or an affected creature takes any damage, the agent can use its Reaction to deal an equal amount of damage to another affected creature.

bonusActions.name: Glyph of Paradox (Level 2 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The agent traces a glyph in the air; for 1 minute, whenever a creature in a 30-foot Emanation from the glyph casts a spell, the agent can deal 9 (2d8) Psychic damage to it.

bonusActions.name: Glyph of Clarity (Level 3 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The agent traces a glyph in the air; for 1 minute, creatures in a 30-foot Emanation from it have Advantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration. When a creature in the area would fail a saving throw to maintain Concentration, the agent can end this effect to cause it to succeed, instead.

This effect ends early if the pillar is destroyed (AC 20; 60 HP; Vulnerability to Thunder)

actions.name: Erase Deeds (1/Day, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: The agent twists time, attempting to undo the actions of a creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The agent can choose up to two of the following effects. It can choose the same option twice. Each creature the target killed on its previous turn is restored to life with 1 Hit Point. Each creature the target dealt damage to on its previous turn regains 25 Hit Points. Each creature the target restored Hit Points to on its previous turn loses 25 Hit Points. Each effect the target is Concentrating on ends.

bonusActions.name: Misty Step (Level 2 Spell)

reactions.name: Cryptic Twist
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 60 feet makes a d20 Test to prevent a spell they cast from being negated. Response: The creature adds +5 to their roll.

reactions.name: Sphinx's Judgement
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 60 feet that the agent can see casts a spell of Level 1 or above. Response: The creature takes 5 (1d10) Force damage per level of the spell. A creature that takes 25 or more damage in this way is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

actions.description: The sphinx erodes a future moment. Whenever a creature within 60 feet starts its turn, the sphinx can roll a d4. On a roll of 1, the creature ends its turn and this effect ends.

actions.description: One creature the sphinx can see within 60 feet is Restrained and Levitates 10 feet into the air as gravity presses in from all sides. Success: Half damage and the effect ends.

bonusActions.name: Thunderous Rejection
bonusActions.description: Each creature of the sphinx�s choice in a 15-foot Emanation from it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: 16 (3d10) Thunder damage and the creature is pushed up to 20 feet away. Success: Half damage.

legendaryActions.name: Glyph of Fraying (Level 3 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The sphinx traces a glyph in the air; each creature of the sphinx's choice in a 30-foot Emanation from it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: 11 (2d10) Force damage and the creature has Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws for 1 minute. A creature killed by this damage or effect disintegrates.

actions.description: A column of crimson light flares down from the witness, illuminating one creature directly beneath it within 30 feet. Until the start of the witness' next turn, attacks against that creature have Advantage while it is beneath the witness.

actions.description: The witness becomes invisible and gains the Invisible condition. This effect ends if it takes any Action or Reaction, if it takes any damage, or if it moves more than 10 feet in a turn.

actions.name: Blind Gulp
actions.description: Each submerged creature in a 15-foot cone extending from the diplocaulus. Strength Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The creature is dragged up to 10 feet toward the diplocaulus and the next attack made against it before the start of its next turn has Advantage.

name: Ryujin Chrysalis
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex -3, Con +5, Int +2, Cha -1

traits.name: Metamorphic Shroud
traits.description: While the ryujin remains motionless, it is Invisible to creatures more than 30 feet away from it.

actions.name: Nutriment Siphon
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) necrotic damage and the ryujin regains an equal number of Hit Points.

actions.name: Bolster Chrysalis
actions.description: The ryujin loses 10 Hit Points and gains 20 Temporary Hit Points that last for an hour. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the ryujin's AC becomes 20.

name: Mortar Monkey
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Con -1, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Underfoot
traits.description: The monkey can take the Dodge or Hide action as a bonus action if it is within 5 feet of at least two Medium or larger hostile creatures, even if it is not obscured.

traits.name: Undersized
traits.description: While carrying mortar shell or another similarly heavy object, the monkey's speed is reduced by half and it can't take bonus actions.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +1 reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Mortar Shell Bowl
actions.description: The monkey rolls a mortar shell it is carrying up to 30 feet. Each creature in the shell's path must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone, leaping over the shot on a success.

actions.name: Operate Mortar
actions.description:
The monkey interacts with a Monkey Mortar within 5 feet, choosing one of the following options * Load Mortar. The monkey loads a mortar shell it is carrying into the Monkey Mortar. Adjust Aim. The monkey chooses a direction for the mortar to point, and a number of d6s for the shell to scatter when it fires. Light Fuse. The monkey sets a fuse and lights it. At the beginning of the monkey's next turn, the mortar fires.

}}

traits.name: Explosive Shell
traits.description: The shell soars through the air and lands at a point Xd6 times 5 feet in the direction the mortar is pointed, where X is a number between 1 and 20 chosen the last time the mortar was aimed. Each creature within 20 feet of that point must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Fire damage plus 9 (2d8) Slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Ushar, Boondaburra Pirate
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +2, Wis -1, Cha +1

traits.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
traits.description: While Ushar has more than half of her Hit Points, she has resistance to cold and Fire damage.

traits.name: Bucket Howdah
traits.description: Ushar carries a bucket of seawater in which one Medium or smaller creature may ride. A creature riding on Ushar acts on her initiative instead of its own.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ushar attacks twice with her Sporting Jab, one of which she may replace with the Help action.

actions.name: Sporting Jab
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft., one target that isn't prone. Hit: 3 nonlethal Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Paddle-Tail Smack
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

name: Niba, Octopus Veteran
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +2, Int +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: While out of water, Niba can hold her breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Underwater Camouflage
traits.description: Niba has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and Deception (Charisma) checks made to impersonate natural terrain or another aquatic creature.

traits.name: Boneless
traits.description: Niba can move through a space as narrow as 1 feet wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Niba makes two attacks, one of which she may replace with her Quaff Rum, if available.

actions.name: Rigging Blade
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Quaff Rum
actions.description: If Niba has not used her Throw Bottle, she gains 5 Temporary Hit Points that last a minute, then must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the beginning of her next turn.

actions.name: Throw Bottle (1/Day)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 2 (1d4) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Guardian Parry
reactions.description: As a reaction when Niba or a creature she is riding on is targeted with a melee attack, she adds +2 to the target's AC against that attack.

reactions.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 33 Hit Points while underwater, Niba exudes a 20-foot-radius cloud of ink, then moves up to half her speed and attempts to Hide. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink.

name: Gesi, Boondaburra Artillery
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +5, Con +4, Int +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
traits.description: While Gesi has more than half of his Hit Points, he has resistance to cold and Fire damage.

traits.name: Skid-Shot Stance
traits.description: If Gesi would be knocked prone by an effect, he may instead choose to be pushed 10 feet away from the effect's source.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Gesi makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with his Cannon Ram.

actions.name: Cannon Ram
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.

actions.name: Paddle-Tail Smack
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Load Shot
actions.description: Gesi loads a 9-pound shot into his cannon's breach and sets a fresh fuse.

actions.name: Light Fuse (Recharges when Gesi uses his Load Shot)
actions.description: Gesi lights his cannon's fuse, which begins to spark and smoke. At the start of his next turn, the cannon fires, hitting everything in a 100-foot line that is 5 feet wide and knocking Uri prone. Each creature in the area is knocked prone and must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 44 (8d10) Bludgeoning damage. A creature adds +1 to its saving throw for each piece of cover the cannonball passed through before reaching it.

reactions.name: Coordinated Reload
reactions.description: As a reaction when a cannonball from Uri's Buck Shot lands in his space while his cannon's fuse is not lit, Gesi uses his Load Shot.

name: Uri, Trusty Goat
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -3, Cha -2

traits.name: Pushy
traits.description: If Uri moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target is pushed 5 feet away. If it is pushed into a wall or other solid surface, the creature takes an additional 5 (2d4) damage.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.description: The goat has Advantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

traits.name: Shot Cart
traits.description: Uri is pulling a wooden cart bearing three 9-pound cannonballs. While connected to it, Uri's speed is reduced by half, and he may struggle free from the cart as an action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Uri makes two attacks, one with his Bite and one with his Ram.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ram
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Buck Shot
actions.description: Uri kicks his cart, knocking a cannonball free which lands in an adjacent space of Uri's choice. If a creature other than Gesi is in that space, it must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone as the cannonball lands on its toes.

name: Ragas, Boondaburra Pirate
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +4, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Pirate's Panache
traits.description: Once per turn, Ragas may spend half his movement to attempt a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, gaining Panache until the end of his turn on a success, or falling prone on a failure. While he has panache, Siduri's attacks are made at Advantage and a creature he hits with an attack is pushed 5 feet away.

traits.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
traits.description: While Ragas has more than half of his Hit Points, he has resistance to cold and Fire damage.

traits.name: Musiker's Dance
traits.description: If Ragas has panache, he may Dodge as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ragas makes two Cutlass attacks.

actions.name: Cutlass
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or drop one item it is holding.

actions.name: Battleshanty
actions.description: One friendly creature of Ragas' choice within 60 feet that can hear him may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make an attack. If Ragas has Panache, the target may instead use its reaction to move its full speed and take an action.

reactions.name: Dancing Lead
reactions.description: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the Ragas causes the attacker to move up to 5 feet and reroll the attack against another target in range of Ragas' choice.

reactions.name: Peg Stomp
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature attempts to leave his reach, Ragas forces the creature to succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage and have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of the turn.

name: Siduri, Boondaburra Captain
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +9, Con +4, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +7

traits.name: Pirate's Panache
traits.description: Once per turn, Siduri may spend half her movement to attempt a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, gaining Panache until the end of her turn on a success, or falling prone on a failure. While she has panache, Siduri's attacks are made at Advantage and a creature she hits with an attack is pushed 5 feet away.

traits.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
traits.description: While Siduri has more than half of her Hit Points, she has resistance to cold and Fire damage.

traits.name: Fearsome Glint
traits.description: At the beginning of each of her turns, one creature of Siduri's choice within 30 feet that can see her must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the beginning of her next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Siduri makes three attacks with her cutlass. Then, if she has Panache, she may use her Inspiring Advance or Fire Up.

actions.name: Cutlass
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or drop one item it is holding.

actions.name: Flintlock Pistol (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Attack: +9 range 30/90 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Inspiring Advance
actions.description: Siduri moves up to half her speed. Each other creature of her choice within 30 feet that can see her may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and gain Advantage on Strength and Dexterity based checks and saving throws until the beginning of her next turn.

actions.name: Fire Up
actions.description: Siduri shouts a fiery speech, full of alliteration and lofty literary allusions. Each creature of her choice within 30 feet that can hear her deals an additional 2 (1d4) damage with melee attacks until the beginning of her next turn.

reactions.name: Riposte
reactions.description: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, Siduri makes a melee attack against the attacker.

name: Mahuna
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -5, Cha -3

traits.name: Keen Greensight
traits.description: The mahuna has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to detect creatures or objects that are any shade of green.

traits.name: Retractable Fins
traits.description: If the mahuna moves at least 30 feet in a straight line on its turn, it may Dash as a Bonus Action this turn.

actions.name: Bill Nip
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Headbutt
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage. If the mahuna moved at least 40 feet in s straight line this turn, this attack deals an additional 2 (1d4) damage.

name: Pyraja Blaster
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Gnashing Throng
traits.description: Whenever the pyraja misses a creature with a melee attack, up to one other pyraja may use its reaction to make a melee attack against the same target.

traits.name: Packing Powder
traits.description: If the pyraja takes any Fire damage from a source other than this ability, one of the pouches of black powder it is carrying explodes. The pyraja and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Faulty Flintlocks (2 Shots)
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 30/90 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage. If this attack misses, the pyraja makes a second attack roll against a creature within 5 feet of the original target.

actions.name: Fumbling Reload
actions.description: . The pyraja furiously attempts to reload its pistols. Up to one creature within 5 feet may use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against the pyraja.

reactions.name: Stumbling Grace
reactions.description: As a reaction when the pyraja fails a Strength or Dexterity Saving Throw, it halves any damage it would take from the effect and falls prone.

name: Pyraja Scrapper
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -1, Cha +2

traits.name: Gnashing Throng
traits.description: Whenever the pyraja misses a creature with a melee attack, up to one other pyraja may use its reaction to make a melee attack against the same target.

actions.name: Jug Strike (Only if its jug is not smashed)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Jagged Jug (Only if its jug is smashed)
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Smash Jug (1/Day)
actions.description: . The pyraja smashes its jug over the head of a creature within 5 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the pyraja's next turn.

reactions.name: Stumbling Grace
reactions.description: As a reaction when the pyraja fails a Strength or Dexterity Saving Throw, it halves any damage it would take from the effect and falls prone.

name: Nurma, Cavy Pirate Cook
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +2, Wis +2, Cha +2

traits.name: Chef's Panache
traits.description: Once on her turn as part of an attack with her Sashimi Slice, Nurma may attempt a DC 15 Performance check, gaining Panache until the beginning of her next turn on a success. While Nurma has panache, she makes attacks at Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Nurma makes two attacks with her Sashimi Slice, one of which she may replace with a use of her Wheelbarrow Charge or Hurl Octopus, if available.

actions.name: Sashimi Slice
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Mahuna Slap
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Wheelbarrow Charge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Nurma moves up to her speed in a straight line. If this movement is stopped by a creature, the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or take 4 (1d8) damage and be pushed 5 feet away for each 10 feet Nurma moved as part of this action.

actions.name: Hurl Octopus (1/Day)
actions.description: If Nurma has Panache, she flings a live octopus in a the face of a creature within 15 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or be Blinded until the octopus is removed as an Action with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check.

reactions.name: Fling Seasoning (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature ends its movement within 5 feet of Nurma while she has Panache, Nurma flings a handful of secret seasonings in the creature's face.The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of its turn, and aquatic creatures with an Intelligence score of 3 or lower become hostile to the creature until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

name: Temen, Boondaburra Navigator
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +6, Cha +1

traits.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
traits.description: While Temen has more than half of his Hit Points, he has resistance to cold and Fire damage.

traits.name: Guiding Star
traits.description: While Temen can see the sun or stars, he has Advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom Saving Throws, and on checks made to plot a course.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Temen makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with his Anchor Slam.

actions.name: Anchor Slam
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (3d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Paddle-Tail Smack
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Anchor Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Temen sweeps his anchor in a huge arc. Each creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Spur Stomp
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature attempts to stand from prone within 5 feet of him, Temen forces the creature to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and be knocked prone once more.

name: Zigan, Budgekin Bosun
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +7, Con +3, Wis +2, Cha +5

traits.name: Bosun's Panache
traits.description: If Zigan makes a successful DC 15 Intimidation check as part of his movement, Zigan and one friendly creature he can see gain Panache until the start of his next turn. While a creature has panache, it makes attacks at Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Zigan makes two attacks with his cutlass, one of which he may replace with his Belch Smoke ability, if available. Then, if Zigan has Panache, he may use its Split the Shares ability.

actions.name: Cutlass
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or drop one item is is holding.

actions.name: Split the Shares
actions.description: Each friendly pirate within 30 feet that has fewer than half its maximum Hit Points gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Belch Smoke (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of Zigan's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more enters an uncontrollable coughing fit and can't take actions on its following turn.

reactions.name: Flatten Feathers
reactions.description: As a reaction to being targeted with a melee attack, Zigan flattens his feathers, significantly shrinking his profile and reducing the attack roll by 5. If the attack hits regardless, it deals an additional 5 damage.

name: Sertap, Dire Clam God
savingThrows: Str +14, Dex +5, Con +6, Int +2, Wis +10, Cha +4

traits.name: Thousand-Layer Shell
traits.description: Whenever Sertap takes 25 or more damage from a single source, its AC is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 17. If its AC is reduced to 17 in this way, it loses its resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

traits.name: Tempest-Heralded
traits.description: Rough seas and gale-force winds always presage Sertap's arrival. While sertap is within a mile of the surface, the area in a five mile radius above him is plagued by terrible storms. At the beginning of Sertap's turn it chooses a direction. Each creature and vehicle in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 20 feet in that direction.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If Sertap fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Sertap makes three attacks with its Barbed Tendrils, one of which it may replace with a use of its Crushing Clamp, or with its Shell Ram if Sertap has used its Spike Volley Ejection.

actions.name: Barbed Tendrils
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 20 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 21).

actions.name: Crushing Clamp
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 36 (5d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 21). While restrained in this way, a creature ignores Sertap's damage resistances.

actions.name: Shell Ram
actions.description: Sertap moves up to 25 feet toward a creature or vehicle and slams into it. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution Saving Throw or take (10d10 + 7) 62 Bludgeoning damage and be Stunned until the end of Sertap's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Bivalve Jet (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Sertap shoots jets of water in two 120-foot lines that are 10 feet wide. Each creature in one or more of the lines must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or take 49 (14d6) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away, or take half the Bludgeoning damage on a success. A creature in both lines that fails this save is pushed twice as far.

reactions.name: Synthesize Dweomer
reactions.description: As a reaction when Sertap is targeted with a spell, it rolls to recharge its Bivalve Jet as the symbiotic organisms residing in its tissues absorb the magic's residue. If the spell was cast by a creature grappled by it, the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma Saving Throw or lose its highest level unexpended spell slot.

reactions.name: Spike Volley Ejection (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction when Sertap is reduced below 215 Hit Points, it propels the spines from its shell, forcing each creature it can see within 60 feet to succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Piercing damage. For the next minute, Sertap has Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws and can use its Shell Ram in place of its Crushing Clamp as part of its Multiattack.

legendaryActions.name: Jet Intake
legendaryActions.description: One submerged creature that sertap can see must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or be pulled 20 feet toward Sertap.

legendaryActions.name: Benthic Gaze
legendaryActions.description: Sertap turns its ancient gaze upon a creature within 30 feet that it can see, flooding the creature's mind with an eternity of incomprehensible memories of the cold and black. The creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Cold damage plus 11 (2d10) Psychic damage.

legendaryActions.name: Rock Boat (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Sertap rocks a boat or ship within 10 feet. Each unsecured creature on the vehicle's deck is pushed 15 feet in the same direction. If this movement would eject a creature from the vehicle, it makes a DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throw, catching itself on the edge on a success. A creature hanging from the edge of a ship is considered Prone.

name: Gravedigger Minion
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +3, Con +3, Int -1, Wis -1, Cha +1
languages: Understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Bonesense
traits.description: The gravedigger can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 ft. of it, and does not suffer Disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

traits.name: Rattle
traits.description: A creature that hits the gravedigger with a melee attack that deals Bludgeoning damage must succeed a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

actions.name: Shovel Slam
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned.

actions.name: Gravebreaker Pick
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the armor bonus provided by any nonmagical shield the creature is wielding is reduced by 1.

actions.name: Leaping Strike (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The gravedigger leaps up to 20 feet and makes an attack at Advantage. If the attack misses, the gravedigger falls prone and ends its turn.

reactions.name: Stay Down
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature with 0 Hit Points regains Hit Points within 5 feet of the gravedigger, the gravedigger makes a melee attack against it.

name: Kishar, Boondaburra Vampire Hunter
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +6, Int +2, Wis +1, Cha +5

traits.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
traits.description: While Kishar has more than half of his Hit Points, he has resistance to cold and Fire damage.

traits.name: Vampire Knowledge
traits.description: Kishar has Advantage on checks made to determine a vampire's type, traits, and weaknesses.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Kishar makes three melee attacks, or two attacks with his winged repeating crossbow.

actions.name: Silvered Blade
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Paddle-Tail Smack
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Winged Repeating Crossbow
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) magical Slashing damage. The bolt may make a single turn of up to 90 degrees at any point in its flight.

reactions.name: Countersmack
reactions.description: As a reaction when he is targeted with a melee attack, Kishar adds 3 to his AC. If the attack misses, Kishar may make a paddle-tail smack attack as part of this reaction.

name: Garash, Boondaburra Vampire
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +8, Con +4, Int +3, Wis +6, Cha +4
resistances: Necrotic, Poison; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks Not Made With Silvered Weapons

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Garash regains 20 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point.

traits.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
traits.description: While Garash has more than half of his Hit Points, he has resistance to cold and Fire damage.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.description: Garash has the following flaws *

traits.name: Forbiddance
traits.description: Garash can't pass through a doorway to a room that contains empty shoes pointed toward the doorway. *

traits.name: Burned by Salt
traits.description: If Garash has salt cast on him, he takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage and cannot regain Hit Points until the end of its next turn. *

traits.name: Sickened by Sea Parsley
traits.description: If Garash consumes sea parsley or is struck by a weapon coated in it, he must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of his following turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Garash fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Garash makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with his exsanguinating bite.

actions.name: Exsanguinating Bite
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and the target loses 2 unexpended hit dice, or drops to 0 Hit Points if it cannot.

actions.name: Leg Hook
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Crural Spur
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft., one grappled creature. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Tide of Shades (Recharge 5-6)
