actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 15 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If this attack exceeded the target's AC by 5 or more, the target is Grappled (Escape DC 16).

actions.name: Forced Fruition (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The ciorcal touches a creature and wrests its vitality, forcing it to rapidly heal itself. The target takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage, then must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The creature regains 22 (4d10) Hit Points. Success: The creature regains 44 (8d10) Hit Points. A creature that isn't Bloodied has Advantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Pollen Swarm (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A restless golden haze fills the air in a 30-foot Emanation from a point within 60 feet, Lightly Obscuring the area for 1 minute. Whenever a creature in the area ends its turn or begins to speak, the ciorcal can use its Reaction to end this effect and force that creature to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 36 (8d8) Poison damage and the creature begins Choking until the start of its next turn. Success: Half Damage. If an exposed flame enters the area or is present when it appears, each creature in the area takes 14 (4d6) Fire damage and the effect ends.

actions.name: Sprout Spearshoot (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: The ciorcal calls forth a spear of greenwood to burst from the unworked earth at a point it can see within 60 feet, forcing one creature in that space to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 35 (10d6) Piercing damage. Failure by 5 or More: The creature additionally falls Prone and begins Bleeding (1d6).

actions.name: Petal Gale (Recharge 5-6, Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: A torrent of fragrant petals slices forth in a 60-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 35 (6d4 + 20) Slashing damage and the target is both Charmed and Dazed until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage.

legendaryActions.name: Burgeoning Lurch
legendaryActions.description: The ciorcal moves up to its Speed, then makes an attack with its Sweetbriar Snare.

legendaryActions.name: Twirling Dispersal
legendaryActions.description: Each creature Grappled by the ciorcal is flung up to 20 feet away, then must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and the creature falls Prone.

legendaryActions.name: Numbing Nectar
legendaryActions.description: One creature Grappled by the ciorcal must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The creature is Poisoned until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: While Poisoned in this way, the creature is Paralyzed.

name: Mirethbalm Shrub
savingThrows: Dex +1, Con +1, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Forest's Favor
traits.description: The shrub has Advantage on the first D20 Test it makes on each turn. If it fails this D20 Test by 10 or more, it dies and its nearest ally within 30 feet gains 15 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shrub makes two attacks with its Boneshard Rake.

actions.name: Boneshard Rake
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Soothing Salve (1/Day)
actions.description: The shrub ends one condition affecting an ally within 5 feet. If the target is a Beast, Fey, or Plant, it additionally regains 5 (1d10) Hit Points.

name: Odhran, Ciorcal Druid
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +4, Wis +5, Cha -1

traits.name: Heartwood Warden
traits.description: The druid's allies without this trait within 10 feet of it have Resistance to Bludgeoning and Piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The druid makes two attacks with its Moonsilver Falx, one of which it can replace with a use of its Wild Balm.

actions.name: Moonsilver Falx
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) Radiant damage on a hit to a Fiend or Shapechanged target.

actions.name: Wild Balm (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description:
One ally the druid touches regains 10 (2d6 + 3) Hit Points, then gains one of the following effects, selected at random.
1. Boon of Fledging. Until the end of the creature's next turn, it has a 30-foot Fly speed.
2. Boon of Brambles. Until the end of the creature's next turn, any creature that hits it with a melee attack takes 2 (1d4) Piercing damage.
3. Boon of Flames. The creature begins Burning (1d10). While Burning in this way, the creature's melee attacks deal an additional (1d10) Fire damage.
4. Boon of Resilience. One condition affecting the creature ends.

bonusActions.name: Nature's Cradle (1/Day, Level 4 Spell)
bonusActions.description: The druid disappears as greenery swirls to envelop it, reappearing in an unoccupied space of its choice within 30 feet of where it departed at the start of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Bloodshaped Bane (Level 1 Spell)
bonusActions.description: *A drop of blood awakens poison's potency.* The druid chooses one creature that it hit with a melee attack in the last minute. For the next minute, the druid's attacks deal an additional 3 (1d6) Poison damage on a hit to that creature.

name: Torramhan, Ciorcal Druid
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +8, Int +7, Wis +9, Cha +2

traits.name: Heartwood Warden
traits.description: The druid's allies without this trait within 10 feet of it have Resistance to Bludgeoning and Piercing damage.

traits.name: Oldgrowth Resilience
traits.description: If the druid ends its turn with at least one Beast, Fey, or Plant ally within 30 feet of it, it can end one condition affecting it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The druid makes two attacks with its Creakwood Fist, one of which it can replace with a use of its Teeth of Durvain or Rampant Growth.

actions.name: Creakwood Fist
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the druid is Large or larger, this attack deals an additional 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage and pushes the target up to 10 feet on a hit.

actions.name: Teeth of Durvain (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Greenwood spines burst forth from the druid before retracting, forcing each creature of its choice in a 15-foot Emanation to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 27 (6d8) Piercing damage and the creature is pushed up to 10 feet away. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Rampant Growth (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The druid, or a Beast, Humanoid or Plant ally that it touches, becomes size Huge for 1 minute. For the duration, the target gains a +5 bonus to any D20 Test or damage roll that uses Strength, and has Resistance to any damage from attacks made without Advantage.

actions.name: Unseal Sunvault (Recharge 5-6, Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: *A seed bursts, releasing months of captured sunlight* Each creature in a 20-foot radius Sphere within 60 feet. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 22 (4d10) Radiant damage and the creature is Blinded until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage. Plant creatures in the area take no damage from this effect, and instead gain 22 (4d10) Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Trap in Amber (1/Day, Level 6 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Clinging sap begins to bead upon one creature the druid can see within 60 feet. At the start of each of the creature's turns, it must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: Until the start of the creature's next turn, its Speed is halved and it has Disadvantage on attacks. An affected creature that ends its turn without moving at least 5 feet is Petrified until it takes any damage.

legendaryActions.name: Seasons' Tell
legendaryActions.description:
The druid consults nature's will, gaining one of the following effects at random.
1. Sun's Draw. The druid or an ally within 30 feet regains 10 Hit Points.
2. Seedwinds. The druid teleports up to 30 feet, then can make a Creakwood Fist attack.
3. Leafsorrow. Until the end of its next turn, the druid has Advantage on melee attacks and can't regain Hit Points.
4. Untime. Until the end of its next turn, druid's Speed is halved and any damage it deals becomes Cold damage.

legendaryActions.name: Greensong Stanza
legendaryActions.description: One Beast, Fey, or Plant ally within 60 feet can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed or make an attack.

name: Caerthann, God of Growth
savingThrows: Str +12, Dex +3, Con +11, Int +2, Wis +12, Cha +11

traits.name: Terror of the Vine
traits.description: Caerthann has Disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal Fire damage, and on saving throws to maintain Concentration made due to taking Fire damage.

traits.name: The Living Wheel
traits.description: Whenever another creature within 30 feet of Caerthann regains any Hit Points, he regains 5 (1d10) Hit Points. Whenever another creature in the area takes any Necrotic damage, he takes 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Life Unceasing
traits.description: At the end of each of his turns, Caerthann can either end one spell or condition affecting him, or can regain 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Woundfire Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) slashing damage and the target begins Bleeding (1d10).

actions.name: Rampant Growth (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Caerthann, or a Beast, Humanoid or Plant ally that he touches, becomes size Huge for 1 minute. For the duration, the target gains a +5 bonus to any D20 Test or damage roll that uses Strength, and has Resistance to any damage from attacks made without Advantage.

actions.name: Thorn Fortress (Concentration)
actions.description: A maze of shifting brambles sprouts from the earth in a 30-foot Emanation from Caerthann. Creatures in the area have Three-Quarters Cover against effects that originate from outside of it. When a creature moves or is moved into or within the area, Caerthann can deal 7 (2d6) Slashing damage to it for each 5 feet it moves.

actions.name: Bounty Unrelenting (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: One creature Caerthann can see within 60 feet regains 52 (5d20) Hit Points. Then, if the creature has all of its Hit Points, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The creature takes 50 (1d100) Radiant damage.

reactions.name: Slake the Soil
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Response: Each other creature within 10 feet of it regains 10 Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Woundfire Strike
legendaryActions.description: Caerthann leaps up to 15 feet and makes a Woundfire Hooves attack.

legendaryActions.name: Burst Forth
legendaryActions.description: Caerthann crumbles to dust, then grows a new body in a space he can see within 30 feet. Each creature in that space is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 9 (2d8) Slashing damage.

legendaryActions.name: Vigor Surge
legendaryActions.description: One creature Caerthann can see within 60 feet gains 10 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the creature regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns.

legendaryActions.name: Call to Feast (Level 2 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: Caerthann chooses one creature he can see within 30 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of the target can use their Reaction to make a melee attack against it.

name: Atorix, Dinovian Explorer
savingThrows: Dex +3, Con +2, Int +2, Wis +3

traits.name: Barrow-Walker
traits.description: The dinovian has Advantage on saving throws against any effect that would change its form or alter its statistics.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dinovian makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Spellfuse Catalyst, if available.

actions.name: Clawed Kick
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away if it is size Medium or smaller.

actions.name: Spellfuse Catalyst (3/Day)
actions.description: The dinovian casts a clinging powder on a creature or object within 10 feet. At the start of the dinovian's next turn, one spell of Level 3 or below that is affecting the target ends in a burst of energy, dealing 5 (1d10) Force damage per level of the spell to it and each creature within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Potion of Disappearance (1/Day)
actions.description: The dinovian turns invisible and gains the Invisible condition for 1 minute, then can teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. This effect ends early if the dinovian makes an attack, casts a spell, or takes any damage.

bonusActions.name: Skittish Sprint
bonusActions.description: The dinovian moves up to half its Speed directly away from a creature it made a melee attack against this turn.

name: Dinovian Undead Cultist
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -2, Cha +1

traits.name: Deathless Zealot
traits.description: Whenever a creature within 15 feet of it is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the dinovian's attacks gain Advantage until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Barrow-Walker
traits.description: The dinovian has Advantage on saving throws against any effect that would change its form or alter its statistics.

actions.name: Tombtip Glaive
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Soul Crack (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Dark magic spills from the dinovian or from a Cursed creature it can see within 60 feet, forcing each living creature in a 10-foot Emanation to make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The creature is Cursed for 1 minute. The first time each turn that the Cursed creature takes any damage, it takes an extra 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage.

name: Dinovian Warrior
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Cha +1

traits.name: Bony Frill
traits.description: While it has only a single hostile creature within 5 feet of it, the dinovian has Resistance to damage dealt by that creature’s melee attacks.

traits.name: Barrow-Walker
traits.description: The dinovian has Advantage on saving throws against any effect that would change its form or alter its statistics.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dinovian makes two attacks and can use its Aspis Bash or Phalanx Ward.

actions.name: Delver's Gladius
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. On a Critical Hit, the target begins Bleeding (1d6).

actions.name: Aspis Bash
actions.description: The dinovian thrusts with its shield, forcing one creature within 5 feet to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Phalanx Ward
actions.description: The dinovian raises its shield; until the start of its next turn, the dinovian's allies within 5 feet of it have a +2 bonus to their AC.

reactions.name: Joint Assault
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 5 feet is hit with a melee attack by one of the dinovian's allies. Response: The dinovian makes a melee attack against the creature.

name: Lyr'vessa, Dinovian Mage
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +3, Cha +1

traits.name: Booming Crest
traits.description: The dinovian can communicate simple ideas to each creature within 5 miles that understands Dinovian, using low-frequency sound produced in its crest.

traits.name: Barrow-Walker
traits.description: The dinovian has Advantage on saving throws against any effect that would change its form or alter its statistics.

actions.name: Kinetospire Staff
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) force damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Kinetic Thrust (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +5 range 120 ft. Hit: The target is pushed up to 15 feet in a direction of the dinovian's choice. A creature pushed into a solid object or surface in this way takes 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Levitate (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the dinovian can see within 60 feet must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The creature rises 20 feet into the air and Levitates there for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Gravity Sling (Recharge 5-6, Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Gravity twists for a creature the dinovian can see within 60 feet, forcing it to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 22 (4d10) Force damage and the creature is thrown up to 30 feet in a direction of the dinovian's choice. Success: Half damage. Any Bludgeoning damage the creature takes from falling due to this movement is maximized, instead of rolling.

name: Mortivex, Dinovian Necromancer
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +10, Int +12, Wis +11, Cha +9
immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned

traits.name: Deathless Zealot
traits.description: Whenever a creature within 15 feet of it is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the dinovian's attacks gain Advantage until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Barrow-Walker
traits.description: The dinovian has Advantage on saving throws against any effect that would change its form or alter its statistics.

traits.name: Crumbling Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If the dinovian would fail a saving throw it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it takes 10 Force damage for each expended use of this ability.

actions.name: Accursed Claw
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 20).

actions.name: Blightning Strike (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: A bolt of crimson lightning leaps out toward a creature within 120 feet, forcing it to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 14 (4d6) Lightning damage plus 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is unaffected by the first source of healing it receives before the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Burden of Years (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the dinovian can see within 120 feet must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The creature gains 1 level of Exhaustion, then appears to age 10% of its natural lifespan for as long as it has any levels of Exhaustion.

actions.name: Corrupt Marrow (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Bones crack and warp in a 15-foot Emanation within 60 feet, forcing each creature in the area to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: The creature is Paralyzed until the end of the dinovian's next turn.

actions.name: Fossilize (Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: One creature the dinovian can see within 60 feet must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 62 (4d10 + 40) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: If the creature has 20 Hit Points or fewer after taking this damage, it is Petrified.

actions.name: Entomb (1/Day, Level 7 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: One Incapacitated or Prone creature within 60 feet is swallowed into the earth, encasing it in stone and Restraining it (escape DC 20) for 1 minute. When the spell ends, the creature is freed. While Restrained in this way, the creature is Blinded and Choking, has Total Cover from outside effects, and takes 27 (6d8) Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Gravequake (1/Day, Level 9 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The ground lurches in a 100-foot Emanation within 500 feet, releasing ancient vapors and making the area Difficult Terrain until the start of its next turn. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 42 (4d20) Necrotic damage and the creature falls Prone if it lacks a Fly Speed. On each of the dinovian's subsequent turns for the next minute, it can repeat this effect as a Bonus Action.

legendaryActions.name: Deadly Swoop
legendaryActions.description: The dinovian flies up to 30 feet, then can make an attack with its Accursed Claw or use its Blightning Strike.

legendaryActions.name: Preserve in Death
legendaryActions.description: Each Undead creature in a 60-foot Emanation from the dinovian gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Titan's Roar (Costs 2 Actions, Level 4 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The dinovian lets forth a magically amplified roar in a 30-foot Cone; each creature in the area takes 18 (4d8) Thunder damage and must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The creature is Frightened until the end of the dinovian's next turn.

name: Gallotalis
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +1, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha -2

traits.name: Flock Tactics
traits.description: While adjacent to two or more gallotalises, a creature has Disadvantage on attacks that target one of them.

traits.name: Deathless Strut
traits.description: The first time the gallotalis is reduced to 0 Hit Points by bludgeoning, piercing, or Slashing damage, it does not die or fall unconscious immediately. Instead, the gallotalis is Blinded for the next minute, then dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gallotalis makes two attacks with its Slashing Stomp. one of which it can replace with its Grabby Snatch.

actions.name: Slashing Stomp
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage. A prone target hit with this attack begins to bleed, losing 3 (1d6) Hit Points at the end of each of its turns until it regains any Hit Points or until a creature stanches the bleeding as an action.

actions.name: Grabby Snatch
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or have one item carried by it stolen by the gallotalis.

bonusActions.name: Chest Slam
bonusActions.description: The gallotalis slams into a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Skittish Sprint
bonusActions.description: The gallotalis moves up to half its speed directly away from a creature it made an attack against this turn.

name: Rostrosaurus
savingThrows: Str +7, Con +7, Int -4, Wis +2, Cha -3

traits.name: Thunderous Stride
traits.description: If the rostrosaurus moves on its turn, the ground within 15 feet of it becomes difficult terrain for all other creatures until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the rostrosaurus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rostrosaurus makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Head Whip.

actions.name: Flattening Stomp
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. A prone creature hit with this attack takes an additional 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Head Whip
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 20 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus one additional effect: Springy Pouch. If the rostrosaurus' throat pouch is inflated, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 30 feet away. Titan Beak. If the rostrosaurus' throat pouch is not inflated, the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the rostrosaurus' next turn.

actions.name: Tail Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The rostrosaurus sweeps its tail in a 30-foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 28 (8d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage and be pushed 10 feet away on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more cannot stand, speak, or breathe on its following turn.

bonusActions.name: Inflate Throat Pouch
bonusActions.description: The rostrosaurus gulps down air, massively inflating its throat pouch until it ends this effect as a Bonus Action, and gaining Advantage on the next melee attack it makes this turn.

name: Vae'lira, Dinovian Merchant
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +2, Con +1, Wis +1, Cha +3

traits.name: Booming Crest
traits.description: The dinovian can communicate simple ideas to each creature within 5 miles that understands Dinovian, using low-frequency sound produced in its crest.

traits.name: Barrow-Walker
traits.description: The dinovian has Advantage on saving throws against any effect that would change its form or alter its statistics.

actions.name: Defensive Kick
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage. If Vae'lira is mounted and the target is size Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 5 feet away.

actions.name: Quell Panic
actions.description: Vae'lira shouts an authoritative command at another creature she can see within 30 feet. The target can use its reaction to either move up to half its speed or make a saving throw to end an ongoing effect it is affected by.

actions.name: Sacrifice Bag (1/Day)
actions.description: Vae'lira drops a bag containing 10 gp worth of assorted trinkets and two days worth of rations. Each hostile creature with an Intelligence score of 6 or lower within 30 feet becomes indifferent to Vae'lira until the end of her next turn.

name: Dinovian Mercenaries
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex -2, Con +9, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Living Tank
traits.description: If the dinovian is not prone, attacks made against it can't benefit from Advantage and can't score critical hits.

traits.name: Barrow-Walker
traits.description: The dinovian has Advantage on saving throws against any effect that would change its form or alter its statistics.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dinovian makes two melee attacks, one of which can be with its Titanbeaker Tail Club.

actions.name: Craterstone War-Mace
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 28 (5d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is Stunned until the start of its next turn. If this attack was made with Advantage, the target is additionally pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Titanbreaker Tail Club
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature has its movement speed reduced by a cumulative 10 feet, to a minimum of 10 feet, until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Tombdoor Shield Crush
actions.description: The dinovian knocks an Incapacitated creature within 5 feet prone and attempts to pulverize it, forcing it to succeed on a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw or take 55 (10d10) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this damage has its skull crushed.

reactions.name: Brutal Conditioning
reactions.description: When the dinovian fails a saving throw, it may add +4 to its result. If it does, the dinovian takes 5 (1d10) Psychic damage.

name: Valerix Quakecaster, Dinovian Kinetomancer
savingThrows: Dex +1, Con +4, Int +12, Wis +8, Cha +3

traits.name: Bony Frill
traits.description: While it has only a single hostile creature within 5 feet of it, the dinovian has resistance to damage dealt by that creature's melee attacks.

traits.name: Barrow-Walker
traits.description: The dinovian has Advantage on saving throws against any effect that would change its form or alter its statistics.

traits.name: Ablative Ward (Concentration)
traits.description: Any damage dealt to Valerix is reduced by 15. At the beginning of each of Valerix's turns, if he is not concentrating on this ability he may choose to begin concentrating on it.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Valerix fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Valerix makes three attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Heavens' Draw or Shatterstone Field.

actions.name: Kinetic Thrust
actions.description: Attack: +12 range 120 ft. Hit: The target is pushed up to 15 feet in a direction of Valerix' choice. A creature pushed into a solid surface in this way takes 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Weapon Resonance
actions.description: Attack: +12 reach 5 ft. Hit: One weapon the target is wielding springs to life in its hands. For the next minute, whenever a creature makes an attack with that weapon, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength Saving Throw or have Valerix choose the attack's target, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Heavens' Draw
actions.description: Up to three Huge or smaller creatures, objects, or chunks of nonmagical earth and stone that Valerix can see levitate up to 20 feet into the air for the next minute. An unwilling creature can make a DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw to resist the effect, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Shatterstone Field (Concentration)
actions.description: One levitating nonmagical object Valerix can see within 60 feet breaks into a thousand pieces which affix themselves in the air in a 20-foot radius. The area becomes difficult terrain for creatures of Valerix' choice, and when a creature moves or is moved through the area, Valerix can deal 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage to it for each 5 feet it moves.

actions.name: Crater Drop (Recharge 4-6)

reactions.name: Smoke Step
reactions.description: When a hostile creature moves within 5 feet of RuYan while she is mounted on a Huge or larger creature, she can move to any space within 5 feet of her mount without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: LiuYi, Feixian Warrior
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +8, Con +6, Int +9, Wis +4, Cha +2

traits.name: Spirit-Weight Shroud
traits.description: Other creatures within 30 feet of LiuYi have Disadvantage on checks made to perceive anything other than him, and on saving throws to resist being Frightened. When LiuYi speaks at any volume, his voice can be clearly heard by each creature in the area.

traits.name: Slight-Bodied
traits.description: Whenever LiuYi is hit with a melee attack, he is pushed 5 feet away from the attacker.

traits.name: Joined in Death (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
traits.description: If LiuYi is killed, at the start of his next turn he possesses his own corpse, rising in undeath with 117 Hit Points and gaining a 30-foot fly (hover) speed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: LiuYi makes two melee attacks and can use his Haunting Glimpse or Channel Legions, if available.

actions.name: Oversoul Staff
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage for each 10 Temporary Hit Points that Liuyi has.

actions.name: Peachlight Jian
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. Against a fiendish or undead target, this attack deals radiant damage instead of any other type.

actions.name: Haunting Glimpse (Level 2 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: LiuYi sets his spectral allies upon a creature he can see within 60 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened for the next minute. At the end of each of its turns, the Frightened creature takes 4 (1d8) Cold damage plus 5 (1d10) Psychic damage and can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Channel Legions (Level 3 Spell, Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: LiuYi opens himself to the spirits bound to him, gaining 10 Temporary Hit Points, plus an additional 10 Temporary Hit Points for each time he has used this ability in the last minute. These Temporary Hit Points last for a minute, and while he has any of them, he gains the following effects. He has vulnerability to Psychic damage. He is immune to any effect that would incapacitate him. He regains his reaction at the end of each turn.

reactions.name: Drifting Twirl
reactions.description: When LiuYi is dealt damage by an effect that pushes him at least 5 feet, he can allow himself to be pushed an additional 15 feet and gain resistance to the triggering damage.

reactions.name: Fade In
reactions.description: When a creature LiuYi can see ends its turn within 40 feet of him, LiuYi can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

legendaryActions.name: Hollow Call
legendaryActions.description: One creature LiuYi can see within 60 feet is dragged up to 20 feet toward him. A Frightened target additionally takes 11 (2d10) Psychic damage.

legendaryActions.name: Bind the Dying
legendaryActions.description: LiuYi forms a contract with the willing soul of a creature within 30 feet that died in the last minute, immediately recharging and using his Channel Legions. While LiuYi lives, the creature cannot be affected by this ability again or returned to life by any means short of a Wish spell.

legendaryActions.name: Peachlight Glide (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: LiuYi flies up to 20 feet, then can make a Peachlight Jian attack with Advantage.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Rise Together
legendaryActions.description: LiuYi's targets a creature he can see within 60 feet that is affected by his Bind the Dying, raising it in undeath with 20 Hit Points. If LiuYi dies, each creature raised in this way dies.

legendaryActions.name: Mythic: Echoing Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: LiuYi makes an attack with his Oversoul Staff, then up to one creature within 60 feet raised by his Rise Together ability can use its reaction to make a melee attack.

name: Nemesis Waycreeper
savingThrows: Dex +3, Con +1, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha -1

traits.name: Heavenly Abhorrence
traits.description: If the nemesis takes any fire or radiant damage, attacks against it have Advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Blade-Scale Clamber
traits.description: While climbing, the nemesis can't use its Multiattack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nemesis makes two attacks with its Wicked Blades, one of which it can replace with a use of its Springing Fling.

actions.name: Wicked Blades
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Springing Fling
actions.description: The nemesis leaps up to 10 feet and can make a ranged attack using its Wicked Blades (range 20/60 ft.). This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks from the attack's target.

bonusActions.name: Creeping Crawl
bonusActions.description: The nemesis attempts to Hide. If it is prone, it has Advantage on checks made to do so.

name: Nemesis Talonmage
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +6, Con +2, Int +6, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Heavenly Abhorrence
traits.description: If the nemesis takes any fire or radiant damage, attacks against it have Advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Floating Passage
traits.description: Whenever the nemesis hits a creature with an attack, it can immediately fly up to 10 feet without expending movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nemesis makes two attacks with its Recurve Skintalon, one of which it can replace with a use of its Longknife Slash, if available.

actions.name: Recurve Skintalon
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage. A target hit twice in one turn with this attack begins bleeding, losing 2 (1d4) Hit Points at the beginning of each of its turns. This effect ends if the target regains any Hit Points, or if a creature uses its action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

actions.name: Longknife Slash (Level 2 Spell, Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The nemesis sends a spectral echo of its blade sailing forward in a 30-foot long, 5-foot wide line, making a Recurve Skintalon attack against each creature in the area. On a hit, these attacks deal Force damage instead of any other type.

reactions.name: Trade Fates (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: When the nemesis takes damage that would reduce it to 0 Hit Points, it can force one friendly creature it can see within 30 feet to succeed on a DC 14 Charisma Saving Throw or take that damage in its stead.

name: FengYun, Pixiu
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +7, Con +9, Int -1, Wis +6, Cha +5

traits.name: Cursewarden
traits.description: Creatures that can see the pixiu have Advantage on Charisma Saving Throws.

traits.name: Spirit-Hunter's Prowess
traits.description: The pixiu can grapple creatures normally immune to the condition, and damage dealt by its attacks can't be resisted or otherwise reduced in any way.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pixiu makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Prosperous Maw.

actions.name: Prosperous Maw
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) piercing damage. A creature killed by this attack shatters into a spray of gold pieces (5 gp per hit die).

actions.name: Clawed Bound
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 18). Before or after making this attack, the pixiu can leap up to 20 feet.

actions.name: Divine Thunder Roar (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The pixiu quakes the earth with a roar of light and thunder, ending each curse or harmful spell of 5th level or below within 60 feet of it. Each other creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) radiant damage plus 10 (3d6) Thunder damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Tail-Tuft Ward
reactions.description: When a creature within 15 feet of the pixiu is targeted with a ranged attack, the pixiu can intercept the attack with its tail. The attack's target changes to the pixiu if it targeted another creature, and the pixiu gains resistance to the attack's damage.

name: Naila, Hakam Geometer
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +7, Con +3, Int +6, Wis +5, Cha -1

traits.name: Prophetic Conjecture
traits.description: While Naila isn't Concentrating, she can't be Surprised and the first attack made against her each turn has Disadvantage.

traits.name: Golden Temper
traits.description: Naila can treat the total result of any attack, saving throw or check that she makes as 16, instead of rolling.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Naila makes two attacks, one of which she can replace with a use of her Dispersion Chord.

actions.name: Sword of the Golden Ratio
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) force damage, and Naila can add one of the following effects. Measured Probe. On a hit or miss, the next attack Naila makes against the same target this turn has Advantage. Rational Division. This attack scores a critical on a 17-20.

actions.name: Dispersion Chord (Level 2 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Naila carves a bright, 10-foot long line through the air that lasts for a minute. Spells that cross that line or affect an area that includes any part of it have their Save DC and any attack roll made as part of the spell reduced by 2 (1d4).

reactions.name: Predictive Sway (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: When a creature Naila can see hits her with an attack, she can make an Intelligence Saving Throw with DC equal to the attack roll. On a success, Naila can move up to 5 feet and the attack misses.

name: Thuraya, Tannit Geometer
savingThrows: Dex +5, Con +2, Int +6, Wis +4, Cha +1

traits.name: Prophetic Conjecture
traits.description: While Thuraya isn't Concentrating, she can't be Surprised and the first attack made against her each turn has Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Thuraya makes three attacks with her Starlight Skewer.

actions.name: Starlight Skewer
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 100 ft. Hit: 5 (1d10) force damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) radiant damage. This attack has Advantage against a flying or levitating target.

actions.name: Distant Watchers' Draw (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Thuraya alters gravity for creatures in a 15-foot radius centered on a point she can see within 60 feet, forcing each to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or float 10 feet into the air and begin Levitating for the next minute. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or falling up to 30 feet in a direction of Thuraya's choice on a failure.

actions.name: Almagest Downpour (1/Day, Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Helical motes of starlight condense around Thuraya, growing each moment in intensity. At the beginning of her next turn, Thuraya can use her action to make up to two Starlight Skewer attacks against each creature of her choice within range.

bonusActions.name: Star-Strung Glide (Level 2 Spell, Concentration)
bonusActions.description: Tannit gains a fly (hover) speed equal to her movement speed until the end of her next turn.

bonusActions.name: Twist Light. (Level 1 Spell, Concentration)
bonusActions.description: Tannit bends the light in a 60-foot cone extending from her, becoming Invisible to creatures in the area until she moves or takes an action.

name: Qamar, Tara'iq Geometer
savingThrows: Str +1, Con +8, Int +9, Wis +4, Cha +7

traits.name: Prophetic Conjecture
traits.description: While Qamar isn't Concentrating, he can't be Surprised and the first attack made against him each turn has Disadvantage.

traits.name: Recursive Renewal
traits.description: At the end of each of Qamar's turns, each condition affecting him ends and he regains half of his missing Hit Points.

traits.name: Catastrophic Unbinding
traits.description: When Qamar takes 20 or more damage from a single source, he must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw with DC equal to half the damage taken or disintegrate.

actions.name: Fractalizing Touch
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 42 (4d20) force damage. A creature dealt 50 or more damage in this way is Poisoned until the end of Qamar's next turn. While Poisoned in this way, a creature has vulnerability to Force damage and dissolves into a soupy homogenate if killed.

actions.name: Chaos Field (Concentration)
actions.description: Qamar expands the bounds of the field projected by his Barzakh orb, projecting the following effects in a 20-foot radius: Uncertain Trajectories. Any effect that chooses one or more targets in the area chooses those targets at random. Eccentric Divergence. An attack or saving throw made by a creature in the area succeeds on a roll of 11-20, and fails otherwise.

reactions.name: Chance Inversion (Level 2 Spell)
reactions.description: When a creature Qamar can see within 60 feet would make a roll with Advantage, Qamar can cause it to make that roll instead with Disadvantage, or vice versa.

name: Sarab, Tara'iq Geometer
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +2, Con +10, Int +12, Wis +10, Cha +9

traits.name: Prophetic Conjecture
traits.description: While Sarab isn't Concentrating, she can't be Surprised and the first attack made against her each turn has Disadvantage.

traits.name: Stygian Sanctum
traits.description: When she is reduced to 0 Hit Points, a seething portal momentarily opens beneath Sarab. A creature within 5 feet of her can use its reaction to make a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check, preventing her from being drawn through on a success.

traits.name: Barrowsight Apperception (3/Day)
traits.description: When Sarab fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. The range of Sarab's Truesight diminishes by 20 feet for each expended use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Sarab makes two attacks with her Bolt From Beyond, one of which she can replace with a use of her Symmetry Loop.

actions.name: Bolt From Beyond
actions.description: Attack: +12 range 120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) psychic damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet in a direction of Sarab's choice. This attack hits its target automatically if it was not made with Disadvantage.

actions.name: Symmetry Loop (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A looping golden threadlight whorls out from Sarab in a 20-foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw or be cosmically linked for the next minute. Whenever Sarab or an affected creature would take any damage, she can use her reaction to deal an equal amount of damage to another affected creature.

actions.name: Moment Lock (1/Day, Level 7 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Sarab touches a creature, forcing it to succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw or have a single moment in its life smeared across time. On each of the affected creature's turns, it must take the same action it took on its previous turn, expending no resources to do so. The creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or teleporting to the space it began its turn on a failure.

actions.name: Nail to the Sky (1/Day, Level 9 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Sarab forces a creature within the range of her Truesight to succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw or have the effect that gravity has upon it reversed. After one minute, this effect lasts until dispelled and Sarab no longer needs concentration to maintain it.

reactions.name: Causal Reversion (Level 4 Spell)
reactions.description: When a creature within the range of her Truesight casts a spell that targets one or more creatures, Sarab can cause that spell to target the spell caster, additionally.

reactions.name: Time Fracture (1/Day, Concentration)
reactions.description: When Sarab is reduced below 124 Hit Points, she can desynchronize her perceived space from the natural flow of time. Attacks made from outside the area of her Truesight against creatures within it have Disadvantage and cannot benefit from Advantage, and a creature that enters or leaves the area for the first time on a turn takes 22 (4d10) Force damage.

legendaryActions.name: Bolt From Beyond
legendaryActions.description: Sarab makes an attack with her Bolt From Beyond.

legendaryActions.name: Perspective Shift
legendaryActions.description: Sarab forces up to two creatures within the range of her Truesight to succeed on a DC 20 Charisma Saving Throw or be teleported up to 60 feet directly toward or away from her to an unoccupied space within the range of her Truesight.

legendaryActions.name: Eldritch Exegesis (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
legendaryActions.description: Sarab affixes her blind, cyclopean gaze on a creature within 5 feet and details of its immediate past and possible futures pour into her mind. Sarab adds +6 to her AC against attacks made by that creature and to any saving throws against abilities it controls.

name: Gorlag Firepig
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -3, Wis -2, Cha -1

traits.name: Earth Scenting
traits.description: The firepig has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell. It can sense the type, number, and direction of underground plants and animals within 25 feet of it.

traits.name: Water-Warded
traits.description: The firepig can't willingly cross running water. If a creature douses it in water, the firepig is Frightened of that creature until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Fireiron Tusks
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the firepig moved at least 10 feet toward the target this turn, the target is additionally pushed up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Wildfire Wallow (1/Day)
actions.description: Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 14 (4d6) Fire damage and the creature begins Burning (1d10). Success: Half damage. Unattended flammable objects in the area catch fire.

reactions.name: Blistering Squeal
reactions.description: Trigger: The firepig succeeds on a saving throw or takes the Dash action. Response: Each Burning creature within 30 feet of the firepig takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage and the firepig regains a use of its Wildfire Wallow.

name: Ugmak, Goksagu Apprentice
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +3, Wis +2, Cha -1

traits.name: Furnace-Tempered
traits.description: The goksagu has Advantage on saving throws against effects that deal Fire damage or cause the Poisoned condition.

actions.name: Blackcraft Flat-Hammers
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. On a Critical Hit, the target is knocked Prone if it is Medium or smaller.

actions.name: Strikesong Frenzy (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The goksagu makes three attacks, then has Disadvantage on D20 Tests that use Strength or Dexterity until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Foaming Defiance
reactions.description: Trigger: The goksagu is reduced to 0 Hit Points by non-Piercing damage. Response: The goksagu makes a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Success: The goksagu regains 1 Hit Point.

name: Zarnok, Goksagu Weaponsmith
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +5, Con +4, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Furnace-Tempered
traits.description: The goksagu has Advantage on saving throws against effects that deal Fire damage or cause the Poisoned condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The goksagu makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Crashing Slam, if available.

actions.name: Pigsteel Slab-Axe
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) slashing damage. This attack can target up to two creatures within 5 feet of one another.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet.

actions.name: Crashing Slam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The goksagu jumps up to 15 feet and can make a Shield Bash attack. On a Hit, the target must additionally make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target falls Prone and is Stunned until the end of its next turn. On a Miss, the goksagu falls Prone and ends its turn.

reactions.name: Reveal Flaw
reactions.description: Trigger: The goksagu hits a Prone creature with an attack. Response: Instead of dealing damage, the goksagu can destroy one nonmagical weapon the creature is wielding.

reactions.name: Foaming Defiance
reactions.description: Trigger: The goksagu is reduced to 0 Hit Points by non-Piercing damage. Response: The goksagu makes a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Success: The goksagu regains 1 Hit Point.

name: Lokcha, Goksagu Metallurgist
savingThrows: Str +11, Dex +1, Con +4, Int +2, Wis +7, Cha +7

traits.name: Furnace-Tempered
traits.description: The goksagu has Advantage on saving throws against effects that deal Fire damage or cause the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Shed Damage (3/Day)
traits.description: At the end of its turn, the goksagu can end one condition affecting it. Its AC is reduced by 2 for each expended use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The goksagu makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Fluxfire Bolster.

actions.name: Bluescale Warsledge
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet. On a Critical Hit, the target is knocked Prone.

actions.name: Slag Splash
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. or range 15 ft. Hit: 21 (6d6) fire damage and globs of metal cling to the target. Until the target takes an Action to clear them or is hit with an attack, its Speed is reduced by a cumulative 10 feet.

actions.name: Fluxfire Bolster
actions.description: The goksagu binds a searing plate to a Bloodied ally within 5 feet that is wearing metal armor, hastily covering a point of weakness. The creature takes 11 (2d10) Fire damage, then gains 11 (2d10) Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the creature has a +2 bonus to its AC.

reactions.name: Foaming Defiance
reactions.description: Trigger: The goksagu is reduced to 0 Hit Points by non-Piercing damage. Response: The goksagu makes a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Success: The goksagu regains 1 Hit Point.

name: Falling Star, Guanghan Artillery Master
savingThrows: Str +3, Con +2, Int +3, Wis +1, Cha +3

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, until the start of its next turn it can jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guanghan makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Find Range or Orchestrate Fire.

actions.name: Banner Pike
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, each of the guanghan's allies within 30 feet gains 5 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Find Range
actions.description: Up to four creatures the guanghan can see within 60 feet can each use their Reaction to Aim a piece of artillery. Each piece of artillery aimed in this way adds +2 to attack rolls made with it and to its Save DC the first time it is fired in the next minute.

actions.name: Orchestrate Fire
actions.description: Up to four creatures the guanghan can see within 60 feet can each use their Reaction to Fire a piece of artillery at a target of the guanghan's choice.

bonusActions.name: Deft Artillerist
bonusActions.description: The guanghan takes the Utilize action to interact with a piece of artillery.

name: Arcane Step, Guanghan Master Dancer
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +8, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +6, Cha +8

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, until the start of its next turn it can jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guanghan makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Suspend Tempo or the Dodge action.

actions.name: Gliding Strike
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Before or after making this attack, the guanghan can move up to 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

actions.name: Suspend Tempo (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: One ally of the guanghan's choice can reroll its initiative, using the new result, or can trade initiatives with another of the guanghan's allies.

actions.name: Vivacious Rite (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A magical force enlivens the movements of the guanghan's allies in a 30-foot Emanation from it. Affected creatures in the area have their Speed increased by 10 feet, and gain 10 Temporary Hit Points whenever they hit a creature with a melee attack.

reactions.name: Transfer Force
reactions.description: Trigger: The guanghan is hit with a melee attack. Response: The guanghan reduces the attack's damage by up to 11 (2d10), then can deal an equal amount of Bludgeoning damage to a creature within 5 feet.

reactions.name: Syncopate (Level 2 Spell)
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature the guanghan can see within 60 feet begins to cast a spell. Response: Roll a d6. If the result is greater than the level of the triggering spell, the spell fails.

name: Guanghan Dragon Dancers
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +4, Con +2, Int +1, Cha +3
immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the dancers take the Dodge action, until the start of its next turn they can jump up to 10 feet whenever they are missed with a melee attack.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The dancers can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, they can move through any opening large enough for a single goblin, and they can't regain Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dancers make three attacks, one of which they can replace with their Dragon Dance or the Dodge action.

actions.name: Double-Kick
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Dragon Dance (Concentration)
actions.description:
The dancers begin a rousing dance, projecting one of the following effects in a 60-foot Emanation: A Coat of Shining Scales. Each of the dancer's allies in the area benefits from Half Cover as though it were Three-Quarters cover. Wildwind Effigy. Each of the dancer's allies in the area can Dash as a Bonus Action. Phoenix Flame Renews. Each of the dancer's allies in the area has Advantage on saving throws they make to end an ongoing Condition.



}}

name: Cloud Sunder, Guanghan General
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +5, Con +3, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +4

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, until the start of its next turn it can jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

traits.name: Intrepid Presence
traits.description: The guanghan projects an aura of calm resolve in a 30-foot Emanation, granting its allies in the area Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened.

actions.name: Mulltiattack
actions.description: The guanghan makes two attacks and can use its Press Assault or Reform Ranks.

actions.name: Brightblade Guandao
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. Vaporous effects (such as Fog Cloud) struck with this attack are cleared as though by a strong wind.

actions.name: Press Assault
actions.description: The guanghan chooses a creature it can see within 60 feet. Until the start of the guanghan's next turn, its allies can use their Bonus Action to make a melee attack against that target.

actions.name: Reform Ranks
actions.description: Each of the guanghan's allies within 60 feet can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed. Until the start of the guanghan's next turn, each creature that takes this Reaction has Half Cover while within 5 feet of one or more of its allies.

name: Dragon of Winds
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +17, Con +7, Int +7, Wis +17, Cha +17
immunities: Lightning, Thunder; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Living Typhoon
traits.description: A vortex of air spirals around the dragon in a 15-foot Emanation, dragging all others in its wake. A creature that ends its turn in the area is Grappled by the dragon (escape DC 24) until the end of the dragon's next turn.

traits.name: One with Sky
traits.description: Whenever the dragon takes damage, it can move up to 30 feet.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Jaws of the Prism Gate
actions.description: Attack: +18 reach 5 ft. Hit: 64 (10d10 + 9) force damage plus Hit: 55 (10d10) radiant damage. A spellcaster hit with this attack can regain one expended spell slot of up to Level 6.

actions.name: Climbing Swipe
actions.description: The dragon swipes its claw and a curl of climbing winds tears forth through the air in a 300-foot long, 15-foot wide Line. Each structure in the area is destroyed, and each creature in the area must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: 66 (4d12 + 40) Bludgeoning damage and the creature is launched 100 feet into the air. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Apocalypse Maelstrom
actions.description: The sky twists itself into a screaming knot in a 1-mile Emanation from the dragon for the next minute, save for an island of calm at the center. At the start of each of the dragon's turns, each creature in the area that is more than 30 feet from the dragon takes 36 (8d8) Bludgeoning damage and is dragged up to 30 feet toward it.

actions.name: Breath of Dying Wind
actions.description: The dragon breathes forth airless void in a 300-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: 53 (6d10 + 20) Force damage and the creature is Choking until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage. Each Flying creature in the area falls Prone.

actions.name: Breath of Swallowed Skies
actions.description: The dragon breathes forth an angry, roiling cloudhead in a 300-foot Cone, making the area Heavily Obscured until the start of its next turn. A creature that starts its turn in the area must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: 78 (4d8 + 60) Thunder damage and the creature is flung up to 60 feet in a direction of the dragon's choice. Success: Half damage and the creature is flung half as far.

reactions.name: Countervale
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature makes a ranged attack against the dragon. Response: The dragon changes the attack's target to a creature it can see within 90 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Fickle Shift
legendaryActions.description: The dragon moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature it moves within 15 feet of for the first time on a turn takes 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away.

legendaryActions.name: Unseal Thunders
legendaryActions.description: A cascade of lightning strikes the dragon, clinging to it. Until the start of the dragon's next turn, whenever a creature hits the dragon with a melee attack it takes 17 (5d6) Lightning damage.

legendaryActions.name: Wish (Level 9 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The dragon casts any spell of Level 8 or below.

name: Curly-Tailed Shishi
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +1, Int -2, Wis +2, Cha +2

traits.name: Divine Sense
traits.description: The shishi can unerringly detect, by scent, the attitude of other creatures toward it and its allies.

traits.name: Born Companion
traits.description: Creatures friendly to the shishi that can see it add 1d4 to saving throws against being Frightened.

actions.name: Vicious Nip
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Enthralling Paw
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed by the shishi for the next minute, or until it takes any damage. While it is Charmed in this way, attacks against the creature are made at Advantage.

name: Guanghan Assassin
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +7, Con +7, Int +4, Wis +2

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

traits.name: Rooftop Striker
traits.description: The guanghan takes no damage from falls of 20 feet or less. If the guanghan falls at least 10 feet, the next attack it makes this turn scores a critical hit on a 16-20.

traits.name: Veil-Piercer
traits.description: The guanghan has Advantage on skill checks and saving throws made to resist or identify illusions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guanghan makes two attacks with its Fish-Belly Dao, one of which it may replace with the Dodge or Hide action.

actions.name: Fish-Belly Dao
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Wugu Worm Vessel (1/Day)
actions.description: The guanghan coats its blade in the poisonous ichor of a worm created through foul sorcery. The next time it hits a creature with a melee attack in the next minute, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned for the next minute. A creature Poisoned in this way cannot spend any resources that it recovers on a short or long rest, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Underhanded Strike
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature within 5 feet of the guanghan is missed with a melee attack by one of the guanhan's allies, the guanghan makes a melee attack.

name: Sunset Jade, Guanghan Swordswoman
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +7, Con +6, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +2

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

traits.name: Hair Trigger
traits.description: When initiative is rolled, Sunset Jade may move up to half her speed and make a melee attack if she is not surprised.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Sunset Jade makes two attacks with her Yao Guandao, one of which she may replace with her Winding Kick or the Dodge action.

actions.name: Two-Tail Guandao
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.

actions.name: Winding Kick
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away and knocked prone. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more additionally cannot speak, breathe, or stand until the beginning of her next turn.

actions.name: Perilous Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Sunset Jade makes an attack with her Yao Guandao against each creature within reach.

reactions.name: Fierce Protector
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature within 20 feet of her makes an attack against a creature friendly to her, Sunset Jade moves up to 10 feet towards that creature and makes an attack against it.

reactions.name: Vicious Quip
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature she can see misses with an attack or fails a saving throw, Sunset Jade lashes out with a savage taunt. If it can hear her, the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or suffer Disadvantage on attacks that target a creature other than her until the end of her next turn.

name: Coiled Strike, Guanghan Swordsman
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +9, Con +8, Int +1, Wis +3

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

traits.name: Violence Unleashed
traits.description: Coiled Strike regains his reaction whenever he takes 20 or more damage from a single source.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Coiled Strike makes two melee attacks, one of which he may replace with the Dodge action.

actions.name: Blinding Slice
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage. Creatures with a Dexterity score of 18 or lower cannot take reactions in response to this attack.

actions.name: Reckless Thrust
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical hit on a 16-20. On a miss, up to one creature within 5 feet may make an Attack of Opportunity against Coiled Strike.

actions.name: Overwhelming Assault (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Coiled Strike makes four melee attacks. Until the start of his next turn, attacks against him are made at Advantage.

reactions.name: Deft Deflection
reactions.description: As a reaction when he is hit with an attack, Coiled Strike adds 4 to his AC against that attack.

reactions.name: Exploit Opening
reactions.description: As a reaction when he is missed with a melee attack, Coiled Strike makes two melee attacks against the attacker.

name: Indigo Jade, Guanghan Swordswoman
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +10, Con +10, Int +1, Wis +8, Cha +4

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

traits.name: The Unmatched Blade
traits.description: While her blade is drawn, Indigo Jade adds +5 to her AC.

traits.name: Swordmaster's Respite
traits.description: Indigo Jade regains her reaction whenever she is missed with an attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Indigo Jade makes four attacks with her Blinding Slice, one of which she may replace with her Winding Kick or the Dodge action.

actions.name: Blinding Slice
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away. Creatures with a Dexterity score of 18 or lower cannot take reactions in response to this attack.

actions.name: Winding Kick
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away and knocked prone. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more additionally cannot speak, breathe, or stand until the beginning of her next turn.

bonusActions.name: Recenter
bonusActions.description: Indigo Jade gains 10 Temporary Hit Points, and may immediately repeat any saving throw against an ongoing effect, ending the effect on a success. She may take this action even while incapacitated.

bonusActions.name: Sheathe Blade (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description: Indigo Jade sheaths her blade and ends her turn. Each creature she hit with an attack this turn must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or lose 22 (4d10) Hit Points as its wounds open.

reactions.name: Spring Away
reactions.description: As a reaction when Indigo Jade makes a Dexterity Saving Throw, she jumps up to 15 feet. If she ends this movement outside the area effect or range of the spell, she is unaffected by it.

reactions.name: Twirling Disarm
reactions.description: As a reaction when Indigo Jade is missed with a melee attack, she forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or have one item is carrying flung up to 15 feet away.

reactions.name: Punishing Kick
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature within 15 feet of Indigo Jade begins to cast a spell, she moves up to 10 feet towards it and uses her Winding Kick.

reactions.name: Perfect Deflection
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, Indigo Jade adds 1 to her AC against that attack. If this causes the attack to miss, she may make a Blinding Slice attack as part of this reaction.

name: Battle-Sow
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +3, Int -3, Wis -1, Cha -3

traits.name: Earth Scenting
traits.description: The boar has Advantage on Wisdom checks that rely on smell. It can sense the type, number, and direction of underground plants and creatures within 25 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The boar makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Trundle Through or Drop-Slam.

actions.name: Cheerful Chomp
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Trundle Through
actions.description: The boar moves up to 10 feet, and can move through the space of any Huge or smaller creature with this movement. A creature whose space the boar enters this way must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 14 Failure: The creature falls Prone. Success: The creature is pushed 10 feet in a direction of its choice.

actions.name: Drop-Slam
actions.description: The boar sinks heavily onto a Prone creature in its space, falling Prone and forcing the creature to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14 Failure: 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage and the target is Restrained (escape DC 14). Success: Half damage. This restraint ends if the boar moves at least 5 feet or stands from Prone.

reactions.name: Foaming Defiance
reactions.description: Trigger: The boar is reduced to 0 Hit Points by non-Piercing damage. Response: The boar makes a Constitution Saving Throw: DC equal to the damage taken. Success: The boar regains 1 Hit Point.

name: Giant Fox
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha -3

traits.name: Dense Underfur
traits.description: The fox has Advantage on Saving Throws against effects that deal Cold damage.

traits.name: Impeccable Hearing
traits.description: The fox's melee attacks do not suffer Disadvantage due to attacking an Invisible target.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fox makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with its Battle-Scream.

actions.name: Savage Snap
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, plus an extra Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage if this attack had Advantage.

actions.name: Battle-Scream (1/Day)
actions.description: The fox lets out a blood-curdling scream. Each creature of its choice within 30 feet must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12 Failure: The creature is Frightened until the end of its next turn. While Frightened in this way, the creature can't take Reactions.

bonusActions.name: Flying Leap
bonusActions.description: The fox jumps up to 20 feet. If it lands within 5 feet of a creature, the next attack it makes against that creature this turn has Advantage.

bonusActions.name: Skulker's Slink
bonusActions.description: The fox Disengages. At the end of this turn, if it is in Full Cover, it can attempt to Hide.

name: Guanghan Garden Guard
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, until the start of its next turn it can jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guanghan makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Pruning Sweep.

actions.name: Caidao Polecleaver
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage. This attack scores a Critical Hit on an 18-20 against Plant targets.

actions.name: Pruning Sweep
actions.description: The guanghan sweeps its blade in a gleaming arc, forcing one creature within 10 feet to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13 Failure: 7 (2d6) Slashing damage. If this reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the guanghan can immediately use this ability a second time.

name: Soilfruit Spirit
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex -1, Con +1, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -4

traits.name: Earthen Treasure
traits.description: If the spirit ends its turn in an area of loose earth while it has at least 1 Hit Point, it regains 10 Hit Points. Otherwise, it takes 10 Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Gruff Bump
actions.description: Attack: +1 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage and the next attack made against the target has Advantage. A Medium or smaller target hit with this attack is pushed up to 5 feet away.

actions.name: Poison Eye
actions.description: Attack: +1 range 15/30 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) poison damage.

name: Spearleaf Spirit
savingThrows: Dex +1, Con +1, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -4

traits.name: Earthen Treasure
traits.description: If the spirit ends its turn in an area of loose earth while it has at least 1 Hit Point, it regains 10 Hit Points. Otherwise, it takes 10 Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Jagged Chomp
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Whistling Fling
actions.description: The spirit flings a fluttering, bladed leaf, forcing one creature within 30 feet to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: 5 (1d10) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Reroot
actions.description: The spirit burrows down, partially burying itself in loose earth; until it moves at least 5 feet, the spirit has Half Cover and its attacks have Disadvantage.

name: Frillhead Spirit
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +1, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha -4

traits.name: Earthen Treasure
traits.description: If the spirit ends its turn in an area of loose earth while it has at least 1 Hit Point, it regains 10 Hit Points. Otherwise, it takes 10 Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Jagged Chomp
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage.

actions.name: Scatter Dew
actions.description: The spirit scatters a spray of dewdrops in a 15-foot Emanation, coating each Plant in the area for 1 minute. When an affected Plant would take damage of a type it is Vulnerable to, it ignores that Vulnerability, then this effect ends.

name: Hollowstem Spirit
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -4

traits.name: Earthen Treasure
traits.description: If the spirit ends its turn in an area of loose earth while it has at least 1 Hit Point, it regains 10 Hit Points. Otherwise, it takes 10 Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Jagged Chomp
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Soothing Fugue
actions.description: The spirit exudes a soothing gas, forcing each creature in a 5-foot Emanation from it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: Until the end of the creature's next turn, any damage dealt by it is reduced by half.

actions.name: Bulbous Roll
actions.description: The spirit moves up to its Speed in a straight line; if this movement is stopped due to a creature in the spirit's path, that creature must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 6 (1d12) Bludgeoning damage and the creature is knocked Prone.

name: Root Dragon
savingThrows: Str +11, Dex +2, Con +9, Int -2, Wis +9, Cha +2

traits.name: Earthen Treasure
traits.description: If the dragon ends its turn in an area of loose earth while it has at least 1 Hit Point, it regains 10 Hit Points. Otherwise, it takes 10 Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Drop Cutting (3/Day)
traits.description: When the dragon is hit with a Critical Hit or fails a saving throw against an effect that targets it, before being affected it can choose to divide. The dragon creates a new size Large Root Dragon with 25 Hit Points and no Legendary Actions or Multiattack, which acts on Initiative 0, in the nearest unoccupied space. The dragon can choose whether it or the newly-created dragon suffers the triggering effect.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes two attacks and can use its Fibrous Bind.

actions.name: Taproot Slam
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Restrained target takes an extra 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage, then is freed from its restraint.

actions.name: Fibrous Bind
actions.description: Threadlike roots snake forth from the earth, forcing one creature the dragon can see within 30 feet to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The creature is Restrained (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Harrow Ground (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The ground churns around the dragon in a 30-foot Emanation, becoming loose earth. Each non-Plant creature in the area must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage and the creature falls Prone. Success: Half damage. Then, each object, structure, and Unconscious creature in the area is buried beneath 6 feet of soil (escape DC 17).

legendaryActions.name: Encroaching Growth
legendaryActions.description: The dragon or another Root Dragon created by its Drop Cutting moves up to half its Speed and can make a melee attack or use its Fibrous Bind.

legendaryActions.name: Rootfast Regenesis
legendaryActions.description: The dragon and each Plant in a 30-foot Emanation from it each gain 15 Temporary Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Siphon Essence
legendaryActions.description: Each creature Restrained by the dragon's Fibrous Bind must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage and the creature gains one point of Exhaustion, which lasts until it drinks any water.

name: Iron Wall, Guanghan Wrestler
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +4, Con +3, Wis +2

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

traits.name: Deeproot Stance
traits.description: Iron Wall can drag a Medium or smaller creature or object without expending additional movement. A creature must spend twice as much movement to drag him, regardless of its size.

actions.name: Multiattack
