actions.description: Iron Wall makes two attacks, one of which he can replace with his Challenging Glare.

actions.name: Iron Palm Strike
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Iron Wall can grapple the target (escape DC 14) or push it up to 5 feet.

actions.name: Challenging Glare
actions.description: Iron Wall stares fearlessly at a creature within 30 feet that can see him, forcing it to succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or move its speed directly toward him.

reactions.name: Anvilsong Meeting
reactions.description: When a creature enters Iron Wall's reach, he can force it to succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 5 feet away.

name: Iron Heart, Guanghan Wrestler
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +4, Con +7, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

traits.name: Deeproot Stance
traits.description: Iron Heart can drag a Medium or smaller creature or object without expending additional movement. A creature must spend twice as much movement to drag her, regardless of its size.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Iron Heart makes two attacks, one of which she can replace with a use of her Slam Down or Challenging Glare.

actions.name: Iron Palm Strike
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Iron Heart can grapple the target (escape DC 16) or push it up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Slam Down
actions.description: Iron Heart lifts a creature grappled by her bodily and sends it crashing to earth; the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Bludgeoning damage and fall prone. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally Stunned until the end of Iron Heart's next turn.

actions.name: Challenging Glare
actions.description: Iron Heart stares fearlessly at a creature within 30 feet that can see him, forcing it to succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or move its speed directly toward her.

reactions.name: Three-Peak Lunge
reactions.description: When Iron Heart leaps at least 10 feet, she can force one creature within 5 feet of where she lands to make a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, the target takes 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away.

name: Fierce Flame, Guanghan Warrior
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +6, Con +3, Int +1, Wis +2

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Fierce Flame makes two attacks with her Flickering Blade, one of which she can replace with a use of her Steadfast Ward.

actions.name: Flickering Blade
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage. When Fierce Flame makes this attack, she can add one effect that she has not yet chosen this turn: Shield-Masked Thrust. This attack has Advantage. Glint-Sharp Slice. The attack deals an additional 4 (1d8) Slashing damage on a hit. Guarded Return. Fierce Flame regains her reaction.

actions.name: Steadfast Ward
actions.description: Fierce Flame advances her shield; until the beginning of her next turn, hostile creatures within 5 feet of her have Disadvantage on attacks that do not target her.

reactions.name: Create Opening
reactions.description: When a creature makes an attack against Fierce Flame, she can add +2 to her AC against it. If the attack misses and the target is within her reach, she can make a Flickering Blade attack against it.

name: Elegant Sword, Guanghan Swordmaster
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +9, Con +2, Int +3, Wis +7, Cha +3

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

traits.name: Swordmaster's Respite
traits.description: Elegant Sword regains his reaction whenever he is missed with an attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Elegant Sword makes four attacks, or makes two attacks and uses his Conserve Movement.

actions.name: Drifting Cloud Sword
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus one of the following effects. Twistwind Slip. This attack ignores any enhancements to AC from Shields. Breathless Thrust. Creatures cannot take reactions triggered by this attack. Severing Zephyr (Costs 5 Hit Dice). Elegant Sword subtly notches a nonmagical weapon carried by the target. The next time a 1 is rolled on an attack made with that weapon, it snaps in half.

actions.name: Conserve Movement (Costs 2 Hit Dice)
actions.description: Elegant Sword moves with the utmost deliberation and efficiency, spending 20 feet of movement to take the Dodge action.

reactions.name: Savor Tea
reactions.description: When Elegant Sword is missed with an attack, he can take a long sip of tea. If he has fewer than half his hit dice, he regains one hit die.

reactions.name: Rap Knuckles
reactions.description: When Elegant Sword is missed with an attack, he can give the attacker Disadvantage on the next attack it makes this turn. If the triggering attack had Disadvantage, the target must then succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or drop one object it is holding.

name: Madapple Spirit
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex -1, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha -4

traits.name: Top-Heavy
traits.description: If the spirit is forced to move, it additionally falls prone.

traits.name: Earthen Treasure
traits.description: If the spirit ends its turn in an area of loose earth while it has at least 1 hit point, it regains 10 Hit Points. Otherwise, it takes 10 Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Seedtooth Snap
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Rolling Rush
reactions.description: When the spirit falls prone, it can roll up to 20 feet. Then, if it moved at least 10 feet in this way, it can make a melee attack.

name: Wartshell Spirit
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex -1, Con +2, Int -3, Cha -4

traits.name: Top-Heavy
traits.description: If the spirit is forced to move, it additionally falls prone.

traits.name: Earthen Treasure
traits.description: If the spirit ends its turn in an area of loose earth while it has at least 1 hit point, it regains 10 Hit Points. Otherwise, it takes 10 Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Scoopjaw Snap
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage. A prone target hit with this attack is additionally grappled (escape DC 12).

bonusActions.name: Stubby Sprint
bonusActions.description: The spirit moves up to 10 feet, then both the sprout and up to one creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone.

name: Bitterbite Spirit
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -3, Cha -4

traits.name: Earthen Treasure
traits.description: If the spirit ends its turn in an area of loose earth while it has at least 1 hit point, it regains 10 Hit Points. Otherwise, it takes 10 Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Yawning Chomp
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the spirit can grapple the target (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Crispleaf Crunch
actions.description: The spirit chomps loudly, forcing a creature grappled by it to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Piercing damage. On a success, the target takes half as much damage, and can use its reaction to attempt to escape.

actions.name: Rootspring Slam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The spirit leaps up to 10 feet; each creature whose space it lands in is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space, then must make a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone, or takes half as much damage on a success.

name: Sorrowhulk Spirit
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex -1, Con +6, Int -2, Cha -4

traits.name: Earthen Treasure
traits.description: If the spirit ends its turn in an area of loose earth while it has at least 1 hit point, it regains 10 Hit Points. Otherwise, it takes 10 Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spirit makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Root Down.

actions.name: Pungent Chomp
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Root Down
actions.description: The spirit sinks down into an area of loose earth beneath it, partially burying itself. Until it takes this action again to free itself or is forced to move, the spirit has Half Cover against all ranged and melee attacks.

reactions.name: Weepgas Retort
reactions.description: When the spirit takes any piercing or Slashing damage, it can force each creature within 10 feet of it to succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded until the end of the spirit's next turn.

name: Dragon of Earth
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex +12, Con +19, Int +8, Wis +18, Cha +16
immunities: Damage from non-artifact, non-legendary weapons; Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
senses: blindsight 120 ft., darkvision 120 ft., truesight 120 ft.

traits.name: One with Earth
traits.description: The dragon can burrow through earth, wood, and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

traits.name: Living Landslide
traits.description: The dragon can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. The first time the dragon enters a creature's space on a turn, the creature takes 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Jaws of the Middle Realm
actions.description: Attack: +19 reach 15 ft. Hit: 65 (10d10 + 10) piercing damage and the target must make three DC 27 Constitution Saving Throws, taking Hit: 26 (4d12) bludgeoning damage for each failed save, A creature killed by this damage is crushed into a tiny diamond.

actions.name: Cataclysm Swipe
actions.description: The dragon swipes its claw and a shockwave tears forth through the earth below it in a 300-foot line that is 15 feet wide. The area becomes difficult terrain, each structure in the area is destroyed, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 27 saving throw or take 33 (6d10) Force damage plus 36 (8d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Divine Meteor
actions.description: A meteor appears in the sky and begins to descend over a 60-foot radius area centered on a point the dragon can see. At the beginning of the dragon's next turn, the meteor lands. Each creature in the area takes 45 (10d8) bludgeoning, 35 (10d6) fire, and 33 (6d10) radiant damage, or half as much if it was underground.

actions.name: Breath of Earth's Fury
actions.description: The dragon exhales a torrent of earth and stone in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area takes 52 (8d12) Bludgeoning damage and must make a DC 27 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 30 feet away, knocked prone, and restrained under 10 feet of debris. A buried creature may be dug out and freed with a successful DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: Breath of Earth's Nourishment
actions.description: The dragon exhales a luminous, revitalizing mist in a 300-foot cone. The dragon and each creature in the area gain the benefit of a short rest. Each plant creature in the area gains the benefits of a long rest, and increases its size category by 1 for the next minute. While enlarged in this way, the plant's attacks deal an additional die of damage.

reactions.name: Twin Rivers of the Earth (1/Day.)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 411 Hit Points, the dragon immediately uses both of its breath weapons, targeting the same area.

legendaryActions.name: Cataclysm Swipe
legendaryActions.description: The dragon uses its Cataclysm Swipe.

legendaryActions.name: Granite Embrace
legendaryActions.description: One creature the dragon can see must succeed on a DC 27 Dexterity Saving Throw or be encased in a thick layer of solid stone, gaining 50 Temporary Hit Points. While a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it has vulnerability to bludgeoning and Thunder damage, can't speak or breath, is Blinded, and is Restrained.

legendaryActions.name: Wish (Level 9 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The dragon casts any spell of 8th level or below.

name: Dawn Clouds, Guanghan Princess
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +3, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

traits.name: Courtly Grace
traits.description: If the guanghan would make a Dexterity Saving Throw, it may choose to instead make a Charisma (Performance) check against the same DC.

actions.name: Offer Tea
actions.description: Dawn Clouds presents a cup of tea to a creature within 5 feet, which must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or accept it. For the next minute, while it holds the cup a creature is Charmed by Dawn Clouds and cannot willingly relinquish the cup. A creature may end this effect as a bonus action by quickly drinking the tea, taking 1d4 Fire damage.

actions.name: Exhort Propriety
actions.description: Dawn Clouds firmly reminds a creature within 30 feet that can hear her of what propriety demands. If the creature is wielding a weapon, it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or use its reaction to sheath it.

name: Wild Swan, Guanghan Princess
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

traits.name: Courtly Grace
traits.description: If the guanghan would make a Dexterity Saving Throw, it may choose to instead make a Charisma (Performance) check against the same DC.

actions.name: Humbling Wind
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 15 ft. Hit: 1d4 Bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 5 feet away and knocked prone.

actions.name: Imperious Demand
actions.description: Wild Swan brashly expresses a command. Up to one friendly creature within 30 feet that can hear her may use its reaction to move up to its speed or make a melee attack.

name: Empress Moon Shadow, Guanghan Monarch
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +1, Con +1, Int +3, Wis +4, Cha +4

traits.name: Cherished Sovereign
traits.description: Whenever the empress is targeted with an attack, up to one creature within 5 feet of her may use its reaction to switch places with her, becoming the new target of the attack.

traits.name: Courtly Grace
traits.description: If the guanghan would make a Dexterity Saving Throw, it may choose to instead make a Charisma (Performance) check against the same DC.

actions.name: Voice of the Empire
actions.description: The empress speaks a command imbued with all the authority of her station. If a creature within 30 feet of her acts against that command before the beginning of her next turn, up to three creatures friendly to the empress may use their reactions to move up to half their speed toward the creature and attempt to grapple it.

actions.name: Scold
actions.description: The empress speaks a fiery admonishment to a creature that can hear her within 30 feet, which must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or take 5 (2d4) nonlethal Psychic damage and fall prone.

reactions.name: Clear Throat
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature she can see begins to speak or cast a spell with a verbal component, the empress indicates that she is about to speak. Each guanghan within 30 feet that can hear her must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to speak until the end of her next turn.

name: Shining Wave, Guanghan Court Bard
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +3, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +4

traits.name: Duck and Leap
traits.description: When the guanghan takes the Dodge action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

traits.name: Courtly Grace
traits.description: If the guanghan would make a Dexterity Saving Throw, it may choose to instead make a Charisma (Performance) check against the same DC.

actions.name: Lute Bash
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the lute breaks and becomes unusable.

actions.name: Captivating Performance (Concentration)
actions.description: Shining Wave begins a complex and virtuosic performance of a traditional guanghan melody. If he begins his turn concentrating on a performance, each creature that can hear him within 30 feet gains one of the following benefits until the start of his next turn: "Crows Berate the Dragon" Each affected creature adds 1d4 to attack rolls it makes against one Large or larger creature Shining Wave can see. "Bitter Cure Beneath the Snow" Each affected creature gains Advantage on Wisdom (Medicine) checks. "Sunrise Pierces the Fog" Each affected creature may make checks to investigate illusions as a bonus action. "Ambush on Ten Sides" Each affected creature may use its reaction to make a melee attack whenever it is missed with an attack.

reactions.name: Improvised Recovery
reactions.description: When Shining Wave fails a saving throw to maintain concentration, he adds his Charisma modifier to his result. If this causes the saving throw to succeed, he gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

name: Xiangtu Sacred Beast
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +2, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Locus of Purity
traits.description: Creatures within 30 feet of the xiangtu have Advantage on saving throws against poison and disease.

traits.name: Impossible Leap
traits.description: The xiangtu's long jump and high jump are equal to its movement speed, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The xiangtu uses its Leaping Stomp twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Calming Gaze, if available.

actions.name: Leaping Stomp
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Any hit with this attack against a prone creature becomes a critical.

actions.name: Calming Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 15 feet that can see the xiangtu must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to take any hostile action until the beginning of the xiangtu's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls unconscious until it takes any damage or a creature takes an action to wake it.

actions.name: Nuzzled Blessing (1/Day)
actions.description: The xiangtu prods a creature with its wrinkled nose, conferring its blessing upon the creature. Until the xiangtu uses this ability again, the blessed creature adds 1d4 to any death saving throws it makes.

name: Hanzaki Heishi
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +3, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Formation Fighter
traits.description: While within 10 feet of one or more allies with this trait, the hanzaki gains a +2 bonus to its Attack Rolls and AC.

traits.name: Aquatic Renewal (1/Day)
traits.description: While submerged in water, the hanzaki can regain all of its Hit Points or regrow a lost limb over the course of a Short Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hanzaki makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Unwavering Brace.

actions.name: Heishi Naginata
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Unwavering Brace
actions.description: The hanzaki plants itself, gaining the following effects until the start of its next turn: The area in a 10-foot Emanation from the hanzaki is Difficult Terrain for creatures of its choice. The hanzaki can take a Reaction on each turn. Whenever the hanzaki hits a creature with an attack, the creature is pushed up to 10 feet away.

reactions.name: Drop Limb
reactions.description: Trigger: The hanzaki takes 6 or more damage from a single source. Response: The hanzaki drops one of its limbs and reduces the damage to 5. A hanzaki that drops an arm can make one fewer attack with its Multiattack. A hanzaki that drops a leg has its Speed reduced by half.

reactions.name: Sentinel Slash
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature enters or is pushed into a space within 10 feet of the hanzaki. Response: The hanzaki makes a melee attack against the creature.

name: Hanegiri, Hanzaki Ninja
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +9, Con +6, Int +4, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Feather-Step
traits.description: The hanzaki can leap up to its Speed without making a check, and can treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

traits.name: Aquatic Renewal (1/Day)
traits.description: While submerged in water, the hanzaki can regain all of its Hit Points and regrow up to one lost limb over the course of a Short Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hanzaki makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with the Dash action.

actions.name: Ninjato
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage. Before or after making this attack, the hanzaki can move up to 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

actions.name: Oildark Kunai
actions.description: Attack: +9 range 30/60 ft. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 10 (3d6) poison damage.

bonusActions.name: Confounding Tumble
bonusActions.description: The hanzaki leaps and whirls to mask its intent, making a Dexterity (Deception) check. Until the end of his turn, attacks it makes against creatures with a Passive Insight lower than its result have Advantage.

bonusActions.name: Smoke Burst
bonusActions.description: The hanzaki creates a burst of smoke in a 10-foot Emanation within 60 feet, Heavily Obscuring the area until the start of its next turn. Then, if the hanzaki is Heavily Obscured, it can attempt to Hide.

reactions.name: Drop Limb
reactions.description: Trigger: The hanzaki takes 6 or more damage from a single source. Response: The hanzaki drops one of its limbs and reduces the damage to 5. A hanzaki that drops an arm can make one fewer attack with its Multiattack. A hanzaki that drops a leg has its Speed reduced by half.

name: Hayanami, Hanzaki Tidal Mage
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +7, Con +8, Int +2, Wis +9, Cha +4

traits.name: Aquatic Renewal (1/Day)
traits.description: While submerged in water, the hanzaki can regain all of its Hit Points or regrow a lost limb over the course of a Short Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hanzaki makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Flood Rush or Reefbloom.

actions.name: Red King Trident
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Borewater Bolt (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +9 range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (5d8) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet.

actions.name: Flood Rush (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The hanzaki lunges up to 30 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks, landing in a violent splash of icy water. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation from it must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 22 (5d8) Cold damage and the creature is pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Reefbloom (Recharge 5-6, Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: A matrix of jagged coral sprouts forth a 30-foot Emanation from a point within 120 feet, with the following effects: The area becomes Difficult Terrain. Creatures in the area have Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws. Creatures take 4 (1d8) Slashing damage for each 5 feet they move (or are forced to move) through the area.

bonusActions.name: Norinaga's Will
bonusActions.description: One allied creature of CR 5 or below within 60 feet can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed and make a melee attack.

bonusActions.name: Tidespray Edict
bonusActions.description: Hayanami and each allied Hanzaki within 30 feet gains 5 Temporary Hit Points, or can use their Aquatic Renewal to regrow a lost limb, if available.

name: Hamanori, Hanzaki Warrior
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +2, Con +8, Int +2, Wis +7, Cha +4

traits.name: Aquatic Renewal (1/Day)
traits.description: While submerged in water, the hanzaki can regain all of its Hit Points or regrow a lost limb over the course of a Short Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hanzaki makes three attacks, or makes one attack and uses its Counterwhirl Slash.

actions.name: Mankai Naginata
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Counterwhirl Slash
actions.description: Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation from the hanzaki must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 14 (4d6) Slashing damage. Success or Failure: The creature is pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Petal Gale (1/Day, Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: A torrent of fragrant petals slices forth in a 60-foot Cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 35 (6d4 + 20) Slashing damage and the target is both Charmed and Dazed until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Norinaga's Will
bonusActions.description: One allied creature of CR 5 or below within 60 feet can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed and make a melee attack.

bonusActions.name: Hundred Blossoms Edict
bonusActions.description: The hanzaki and each allied creature within 30 feet has Advantage on the first Ability Check or Saving Throw that it makes before the start of the hanzaki's next turn.

name: Hajiroku, Hanzaki General
savingThrows: Str +11, Dex +1, Con +10, Int +8, Wis +3, Cha +11

traits.name: Visions of the Pearl
traits.description: The hanzaki and its allies within 60 feet can't be Surprised, and can each move up to their Speed immediately after rolling Initiative.

traits.name: Aquatic Renewal (1/Day)
traits.description: While submerged in water, the hanzaki can regain all of its Hit Points or regrow a lost limb over the course of a Short Rest.

traits.name: Toll of Destiny (3/Day)
traits.description: When the hanzaki or one of its allies within 30 feet fails a saving throw, the hanzaki can choose for it or its ally to succeed instead. For each expended use of this ability, the hanzaki subtracts 1 from any Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throws that it makes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hanzaki makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Prescient Directive.

actions.name: Ox-Bite Trident
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) acid damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Prescient Directive (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: The hanzaki commands nearby allies to exploit a magically foreseen window of opportunity. The hanzaki and each Humanoid ally within 20 feet that can hear it gains Advantage on the first attack or saving throw it makes before the start of the hanzaki's next turn.

actions.name: Jet-Cutter (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: A thin line of water slices forth from the hanzaki, forcing a creature within 60 feet to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage plus 18 (4d8) Slashing damage. A target killed by this damage, or an object reduced to 0 Hit Points by it, is bisected.

bonusActions.name: Norinaga's Will
bonusActions.description: Up to two allied creatures of CR 5 or below within 60 feet can each use their Reaction to move up to their Speed and make a melee attack.

bonusActions.name: Edict of the Inner-Glow
bonusActions.description: The hanzaki and each allied creature within 30 feet ignore the effects of the Charmed and Frightened conditions until the start of the hanzaki's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Drive Forth
legendaryActions.description: The hanzaki moves up to its Speed, then it and up to two of its allies within 10 feet of it can each make a weapon attack.

legendaryActions.name: Dazzle (Level 1 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: A flash of light and sound bursts from the hanzaki in a 5-foot Emanation, forcing each creature in the area to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The creature is Blinded and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Jet-Cutter (Costs 2 Actions, Level 4 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The hanzaki uses its Jet-Cutter.

name: Aragame Snapping Turtle
savingThrows: Str +9, Con +7, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -4

traits.name: Inflexible
traits.description: The turtle cannot attack a creature that is Grappling or Attached to it.

traits.name: Cold Blooded
traits.description: Whenever the turtle takes Cold damage, it can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. If the turtle is Bloodied, it is also Dazed until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Guillotine Jaws
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 45 (6d12 + 6) slashing damage. On a Critical Hit, the target suffers one of the following effects of its choice: The target takes an extra 20 Slashing damage. The target must make a {{font-variant:small-caps **Constitution Saving Throw:**}} DC 17. {{font-variant:small-caps **Failure:**}} The creature loses a limb of its choice.

actions.name: Seethe
actions.description: The turtle retracts its head and glares, building fury. Until the end of its next turn, it has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and Advantage on melee attacks.

name: Hanzaki Surgeon
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +2, Con +1, Int +2, Wis +2

traits.name: Aquatic Renewal
traits.description: While submerged in water, the hanzaki may regain all of his Hit Points or regrow a lost limb over the course of an hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hanzaki makes two attacks with its Dubious Cure.

actions.name: Dubious Cure
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing, slashing, or poison damage.

actions.name: Madedo Prosthetic
actions.description: The hanzaki straps a somewhat limb-like object to a creature missing a limb within 5 feet, allowing it to ignore the effects of that missing limb for the next hour.

bonusActions.name: Surgical Study
bonusActions.description: The hanzaki targets a creature it can see within 5 feet, making a Wisdom (Medicine) check with DC equal to the target's Constitution score. On a success, the first time the hanzaki hits the creature with an attack in the next minute, it can add one of the following effects. Hasty Excision. The attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) damage and the hanzaki can end one condition or disease afflicting the target. Eyeballed Dose. The target gains 1d20 Temporary Hit Points. While it has 10 or more of these Temporary Hit Points, a creature is Poisoned.

reactions.name: Drop Limb
reactions.description: When the hanzaki takes 6 or more damage from a single source, it can drop one of its limbs, reducing the damage taken to 5. A hanzaki that drops an arm can make one fewer attack with its multiattack. A hanzaki that drops a leg has its speed reduced by half.

name: Hayami, Hanzaki Ninja
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +4, Con +2, Wis +2, Cha +2

traits.name: Aquatic Renewal
traits.description: While submerged in water, the hanzaki may regain all of his Hit Points or regrow a lost limb over the course of an hour.

traits.name: Shuttered Censer
traits.description: At the beginning of each of her turns, Hayami can exude a cloud of smoke in a 10-foot radius, either Lightly or Heavily Obscuring the area until the beginning of her next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Hayami makes three attacks with her Sooted Blades, one of which she can replace with a use of her Confounding Tumble or an attempt to Hide.

actions.name: Sooted Blades
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 7 (2d6) Slashing damage if it was made with Advantage.

actions.name: Confounding Tumble
actions.description: Hayami leaps and whirls to mask her intent, making a Dexterity (Deception) check. Until the end of her turn, attacks she makes against creatures with a Passive Insight lower than her result have Advantage.

reactions.name: Slippery
reactions.description: When the hanzaki is missed with a melee attack, it can move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

reactions.name: Drop Limb
reactions.description: When the hanzaki takes 6 or more damage from a single source, it can drop one of its limbs, reducing the damage taken to 5. A hanzaki that drops an arm can make one fewer attack with its multiattack. A hanzaki that drops a leg has its speed reduced by half.

name: Hanshiro, Hanzaki Ninja
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +5, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Aquatic Renewal
traits.description: While submerged in water, the hanzaki may regain all of his Hit Points or regrow a lost limb over the course of an hour.

traits.name: Shuttered Censer
traits.description: At the beginning of each of his turns, Hanshiro can exude a cloud of smoke in a 10-foot radius, either Lightly or Heavily Obscuring the area until the start of his next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Hanshiro makes three attacks with his Ironsplitter Hachiwari, one of which he can replace with an attempt to Hide.

actions.name: Ironsplitter Hachiwari
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning or Piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of Hanshiro's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Confounding Tumble
bonusActions.description: Hanshiro leaps and whirls to mask his intent, making a Dexterity (Deception) check. Until the end of his turn, attacks he makes against creatures with a Passive Insight lower than his result have Advantage.

bonusActions.name: Billowing Seal (Level 2 Spell, Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.description: Hanshiro exerts his mastery over smoke, gaining the following effects while he is at least Lightly Obscured by smoke until the end of his turn. His melee attacks score a critical on an 18-20. Attacks made against him have Disadvantage. He can spend 10 feet of movement to fly up to 20 feet through an area at least Lightly Obscured by smoke.

reactions.name: Blade Trap
reactions.description: When Hanshiro is missed with a melee weapon attack, he can prevent the attacker from making any further attacks with that weapon this turn.

reactions.name: Drop Limb
reactions.description: When the hanzaki takes 6 or more damage from a single source, it can drop one of its limbs, reducing the damage taken to 5. A hanzaki that drops an arm can make one fewer attack with its multiattack. A hanzaki that drops a leg has its speed reduced by half.

name: Kajika
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +8, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -4

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The kajika can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Bouncing Scurry
traits.description: The kajika ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of mud or shallow water. When the kajika takes any action, each creature riding on it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The kajika makes two attacks with its Blunt-Headed Bash, one of which it can replace with a use of its Rippling Leap.

actions.name: Blunt-Headed Bash
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Rippling Leap
actions.description: The kajika jumps up to 10 feet, and can land in the space of any Large or smaller creature, forcing each creature whose space it lands in to make a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature is knocked and restrained (escape DC 15) until the kajika moves, or moves to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

actions.name: Thunderous Squeak
actions.description: The kajika purses its lips and sends forth a shrill blast of sound and air in a 15-foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, a creature takes 13 (3d8) nonlethal Thunder damage, is Deafened until the end of its next turn, and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

reactions.name: Ballooning Defense
reactions.description: When a creature would grapple, restrain, or swallow the kajika, the kajika can force it to make a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature that would grapple or restrain the kajika is instead pushed up to 10 feet away, and a creature that swallows the kajika can't speak or breathe until it releases the kajika.

name: Hikimasa, Hikiga Hunter
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +1, Con +4, Int +1, Wis +7, Cha +1

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The hikiga's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Swamplore Tracker
traits.description: Hikimasa can tell the age of tracks left in swampy terrain by sight. He has Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to determine a creature's size, equipment, direction, and intended destination from its tracks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Hikimasa makes two melee attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Vindictive Chop.

actions.name: Lilysteel War-Cleaver
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) slashing damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.

actions.name: Flatblade Thwack
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) nonlethal Bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Vindictive Chop
actions.description: Hikimasa crashes his blade down in a 10-foot long, 5-foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 13 (2d12) Slashing damage, or half as much on a success. A prone creature has Disadvantage on this saving throw, and takes maximum damage on a failed save.

reactions.name: Eager Pursuit

savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Aquatic Renewal
traits.description: While submerged in water, the hanzaki may regain all of his Hit Points or regrow a lost limb over the course of an hour.

traits.name: Rocket Leap

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hanzaki uses its Hurl Grenade twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Cook Grenade.

A creature holding its action for when it hears that call may make its full attacks with that held action If Lounes is within 30 feet of the target, the first ranged attack the creature makes as part of that held action is at Advantage and ignores up to 3/4 cover.

The target and each other creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded and Poisoned until the end of its next turn,

traits.description: Whenever Ginchiyo casts a spell, he may treat an onibi servant of his as the spell's source, and have it concentrate on the spell in his stead. He must still use his own senses to target, however.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ginchiyo uses his Onibi command twice, one of which he may replace with use of his Ghostfire Flare, Anchor Spirit, or Snip Bindings.

actions.name: Ghostfire Flare (Level 2 Spell)
