actions.name: Snip Bindings (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Ginchiyo snips carefully away at the threads of magic binding a magical effect or creation within 5 feet of him into being, altering its effects in one of the following ways * If the effect or creation deals damage, it deals two fewer dice of damage. If the effect or creation has a radius or range, its radius or range is decreased by 10 feet. If the effect or creation can move or be moved by its creator, the distance it can move or be moved is decreased by 10 feet. If the effect or creation has a duration, its duration is reduced by half.

actions.name: Living Exorcism (Level 5 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Ginchiyo touches a creature and attempts to empty its body of spirits. The creature and each other spirit inhabiting its body must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw or have its disembodied spirit expelled into the nearest unoccupied space. While disembodied, a creature's spirit gains a fly speed equal to its movement speed and cannot deal damage, but otherwise uses its statistics. A body not inhabited by its native spirit may be Possessed by any disembodied spirit as an action, rising and acting under that creature's control. If the body is already Possessed, a disembodied spirit in the body's space may attempt to take the place of the possessing spirit with a contested Charisma check.

name: Command Post Tsukumogami
savingThrows: Str +16, Dex -1, Con +15, Wis +3, Cha +3
immunities: Poison, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Weapons; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned

traits.name: Composite Construct
traits.description: The tsukumogami is comprised of several parts, each animated by its own spirit that takes an action on its own initiative, instead of rolling.

traits.name: Invulnerable Titan
traits.description: If the tsukumogami would take fewer than 15 damage from a single source, it instead takes no damage. A creature that deals 15 or more damage to the tsukumogami from a single source may force it to make a Constitution Saving Throw with DC equal to the damage dealt. On a failed save, one part of the creature's choice becomes damaged.

traits.name: Facing
traits.description: The tsukumogami is always considered to be facing in a particular direction. Melee attacks it makes against creatures not in the direction it is facing are made at Disadvantage.

traits.name: Titanic Stature
traits.description: A creature within 5 feet of one of the tsukumogami's parts may spend half its movement to attempt to climb onto it, or to move between two connected parts, with a successful DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check. Attacks made against the tsukumogami by a creature climbing on one of its damaged parts are made at Advantage.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The tsukumogami can't be affected or detected by spells of 1st level or below unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects. ### Head Actions (Initiative Count 20)

traits.name: Propagandize
traits.description: The head loudly emanates inspiring music and propaganda. Each friendly creature within 60 feet of it gains Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws until the beginning of the head's next turn.

traits.name: Blare Orders
traits.description:
If the head is not damaged, up to six friendly creatures within 60 feet may each use their reactions to make a melee attack.

### Chest Actions (Initiative Count 15)

traits.name: Emergency Repairs
traits.description: The tsukumogami gains 15 Temporary Hit Points and makes a DC 20 Constitution Saving Throw. On a success, one of its damaged parts ceases to be damaged.

traits.name: Annihilation Beam
traits.description: The tsukumogami rolls a d6 to charge its Annihilation Beam. On a 5-6, the beam successfully charges. At the beginning of the tskukumogami's head's next turn, if its chest is not damaged the beam fires in a 100-foot line that is 10 feet wide and wholly within a 100-foot cone centered on the tsukumogami's current facing. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 44 (8d10) Force damage plus 33 (6d10) radiant damage, or half as much on a success. Each object in the area that isn't worn or carried and each creature killed by this damage is vaporized. ### Arms Actions (Initiative Count 10)

traits.name: Gunbai Sweep
traits.description: The tsukumogami sweeps its fan, sending forth a gust of wind in a 30-foot cone from a point on its front facing. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away. A creature has Advantage on this saving throw if the tsukumogami's Arms are damaged.

traits.name: Gunbai Judgement
traits.description:
If the tsukumogami's Arms are not damaged, it raises its fan, indicating approval of a creature's battlefield heroism. One other creature the tsukumogami can see within 120 feet that reduced an enemy to 0 Hit Points in the last minute gains 15 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the creature has Advantage on melee attacks and cannot be Frightened.
### Waist Actions (Initiative Count 5)

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.description: If the tsukumogami's Waist is not damaged, it makes two attacks with its Spinning Masks, each of which it may replace with a use of its Move Titan.

traits.name: Spinning Masks
traits.description: Attack: +16 reach 10 ft., two targets not climbing on the tsukumogami's Arms or Head. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage. If the tsukumogami's Waist is not damaged, a creature hit by this attack takes an additional 1d10 points of either Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (tsukumogami's choice).

traits.name: Move Titan
traits.description: The tsukumogami flies up to 20 feet, or turns up to 90 degrees.

name: Lamplighter Shagerd
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Protective Uniform
traits.description: The lamplighter has Advantage on saving throws against breathable poisons and against Fire damage.

traits.name: Trip Hazard
traits.description: A Medium creature pushed into the lamplighter's space must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone in the nearest unoccupied space, resisting being pushed on a successful save.

actions.name: Cautious Prod
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage. After making this attack and before any other effects can be triggered, the lamplighter may move up to 5 feet.

actions.name: Set Flame
actions.description: The lamplighter carefully sets a space within 5 feet of it aflame for the next minute. A creature that starts its turn in the space or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (1d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Go Limp
reactions.description: As a reaction when the lamplighter is forced to make a Dexterity Saving Throw against an effect that affects an area, it falls prone and is pushed up to 10 feet from the effect's center. If this pushes it outside the effect's area, the lamplighter takes no damage on a successful saving throw

name: Lamplighter Pari
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +1, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha -2
immunities: Poison, Damage from Falling; Poisoned, Prone

traits.name: Surfacing Suit
traits.description: The pari takes any piercing or Slashing damage, its suit begins to leak flammable gas into the surrounding air. This leaking gas flares brightly if the pari takes any Fire damage from another source, dealing 3 (1d6) Fire damage to the pari and each creature within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Buoyant
traits.description: The pari has Disadvantage on Strength Saving Throws, but has resistance to any damage dealt by an effect that forces it to make one. If the pari would be forced to move any distance, it is instead moved half as far.

actions.name: Searing Lantern
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Confounding Hiss
actions.description: The pari extends a tendril of narcotic gas from its suit. One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned in this way, a creature cannot take reactions and at the start of its turn must use half its movement to move in a random direction.

actions.name: Wax Patch
actions.description: The pari seals shut a leaking suit or pipe within 5 feet with a plug of softened wax, preventing it from leaking further.

reactions.name: Inflated Expansion
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the pari while its suit is not leaking, the pari becomes size Large until the start of its next turn. After it expands, each creature within 5 feet of it is pushed 10 feet away and must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

name: Lamplighter Shishtar
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +3, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Protective Uniform
traits.description: The lamplighter has Advantage on saving throws against breathable poisons and against Fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lamplighter makes two attacks with its Lighting Stick, one of which it may replace with a use of its Percussive Maintenance.

actions.name: Lighting Stick
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) fire damage. A creature hit with this attack twice in a turn must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 5 feet away.

actions.name: Percussive Maintenance
actions.description: The lamplighter makes a melee attack with its Lighting Stick against a construct or vehicle within its reach. On a hit, if the construct or vehicle is affected by a condition that ends on a successful saving throw, it immediately repeats that saving throw at Advantage.

bonusActions.name: Snuff
bonusActions.description: The lamplighter douses one burning creature or space within 10 feet of it.

bonusActions.name: Helmet Plume Overburn (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: The lamplighter bends over and prompts a gout of flame from its helmet. One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or ignite. Until a creature douses it as an action, the creature takes 1d10 Fire damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

name: Marzeh, Lamplighter Gazmarden
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +5, Con +6, Int +4, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Gas Mastery
traits.description: While conscious, the lamplighter is surrounded by a protective shell of air, granting it immunity to damage dealt by breathable poisons and to effects that deal Fire damage in an area.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lamplighter makes two attacks with its Corrupt Breath.

actions.name: Corrupt Breath (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +7 range 30 ft. Hit: 17 (5d6) poison damage. A creature reduced below 10 Hit Points by this damage falls unconscious until it takes any damage or a creature takes an action to wake it.

actions.name: Gas Cushion (Level 2 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The lamplighter conjures a cushion of invisible, pressurized gas that fills a 10-foot cube in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet. A creature that falls onto the cube bounces and takes no fall damage. A creature that attempts to enter the cube must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Hissing Aura (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: The lamplighter conjures an invisible, odorless gas that displaces the air in a 20-foot radius centered on it. A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned until the start of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Ignite Gas (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description: The lamplighter sends a stream of flame to ignite the gas created by a spell it is concentrating on, ending the spell. Each creature within 5 feet of the spell's area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Jahanbaz, Lamplighter Bozorg
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +6, Con +8, Int +9, Wis +3

traits.name: Floating Conveyance
traits.description: Jahanbaz is carried by a Large floating vehicle powered by zarshak gas (AC 16; 115 HP, Immunity to psychic and poison damage). The vehicle has a 20-foot fly (hover) speed and grants its pilot half cover against ranged attacks.

traits.name: Gas-Warped
traits.description: If the lamplighter would take 15 or fewer poison damage from a single source, it instead takes no poison damage. If it would take more than 15 poison damage from a single source, it instead takes twice that much Poison damage.

actions.name: Guildmaster's Command
actions.description: Up to three other lamplighters that Jahanbaz can see may each use their reactions to move up to half their speed or make an attack.

actions.name: Stranglegas (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Gas swirls around the head of one creature Jahanbaz can see within 60 feet for the next minute. At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or fall unconscious until it takes any damage, or until a creature wakes it as an action.

actions.name: Wave of Soot (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Up to three open flames that Jahanbaz can see within 60 feet each expel a burst of soot in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in one or more of the areas must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded and unable to speak or breathe until the end of Jahanbaz's next turn.

actions.name: Barrow Geyser (Level 5 Spell)
actions.description: Jahanbaz opens a 5-foot radius rift in the ground that expels pressurized extraplanar gas to a height of 40 feet for the next minute. Each creature in the area when it appears, and any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or be launched 40 feet above the rift, then immediately falls in an unoccupied space of its choice within 15 feet of the rift. The gas ignites if it touches an open flame, dealing 14 (4d6) Fire damage to any creature that makes a saving throw against the geyser.

actions.name: Wobbling Knop Bash
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the vehicle must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Wax Cascade
actions.description: Each creature directly beneath the vehicle must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 10 (3d6) Fire damage and be coated in molten wax (escape DC 17). A creature coated in wax that has not taken any Fire damage since the end of its last turn is restrained.

actions.name: Twin Labra Flamestream (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Two 20-foot long, 5-foot wide streams of flame extend from the vehicle until the end of its pilot's next turn. A creature that starts its turn in one or more of the areas or enters one for the first time on its turn must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Fire damage, or half as much on a success. If this ability recharges while still active, the pilot may immediately use this ability again as a reaction.

name: Crustacean Servitor
savingThrows: Dex +1, Con +1, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -4

traits.name: Chemoreception
traits.description: While submerged in a body of water, the servitor can detect the presence and location of creatures in that water within 60 feet.

traits.name: Pinch
traits.description: When the servitor takes the Help action to grant an attack Advantage against a target within 5 feet that is Concentrating, the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or lose concentration.

actions.name: Graspers
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: The servitor attaches itself to the target (remove DC 11). A creature's swim speed is reduced by 5 for each servitor attached to it.

actions.name: Echo Cannon
actions.description: If it is submerged in water, the servitor sends a brief pressure wave forth. One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or take 3 (1d6) Thunder damage.

reactions.name: Scuttle
reactions.description: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the servitor moves up to half its speed. If this movement puts the servitor out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the servitor is unaffected.

name: Jellyfish Servitor
savingThrows: Dex -2, Con +2, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -4

traits.name: Chemoreception
traits.description: While submerged in a body of water, the servitor can detect the presence and location of creatures in that water within 60 feet.

traits.name: Drifting Hazard
traits.description: Whenever the servitor takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage. A creature that the servitor is pushed into must immediately save against its Stinging Tendrils.

actions.name: Stinging Tendrils
actions.description: The jellyfish brushes its tendrils against a creature within 5 feet, discharging hundreds of microscopic, venom-coated needles into it. The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 5 (2d4) poison damage. A creature that fails by 5 or more is Paralyzed until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Resonance Bell
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature within 30 feet of the servitor makes a saving throw against a lemurian's song, the servitor amplifies the song, forcing the creature to subtract 1d4 from its rolled result.

name: Tereis, Lemurian Elara
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +5, Con +4, Wis +2, Cha +2

traits.name: Water Dancer
traits.description: The lemurian does not provoke attacks of opportunity from creatures without a swim speed.

traits.name: Battle Anchor
traits.description: While she can hear the song of one or more other lemurians within 60 feet, Tereis is immune to the Frightened condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Tereis makes two attacks with her Aragonite Lantha.

actions.name: Aragonite Lantha
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Palytoxin Zoa (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Tereis coaxes out a venomous polyp from her Aragonite Lantha, then makes an attack with it. If the attack hits, it deals an additional 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned for the next minute. While Poisoned in this way, a creature has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Ethereal Song (Concentration)
actions.description: The lemurian begins to sing a magical melody. A creature that can hear the song and starts its turn within 60 feet of the lemurian must make a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, until the start of its next turn the creature subtracts 1 from any attack rolls it makes against a lemurian for each lemurian within 60 feet of it whose song it can hear.

reactions.name: Deepen Harmony
reactions.description: As a reaction when a friendly lemurian within 30 feet uses its song ability, Tereis uses her Ethereal Song.

name: Melusine, Lemurian Mage
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +6, Int +2, Wis +1, Cha +6

traits.name: Water Dancer
traits.description: The lemurian does not provoke attacks of opportunity from creatures without a swim speed.

traits.name: Inspired Mind
traits.description: While she can hear the song of one or more other lemurians within 60 feet, Melusine may concentrate on up to two effects at once.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Melusine makes two attacks with her Choriaster Wand, one of which she may replace with a use of her Stinging Swarm, if available.

actions.name: Choriaster Wand
actions.description: Attack: +5 range 60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d8) cold damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Stinging Swarm (Recharge 5-6, Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Melusine conjures a swarm of spectral jellyfish in a 20-foot radius centered on a point she can see within 120 feet. A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) poison damage, or half as much on a success. At the beginning of Melusine's turn, the swarm moves up to 10 feet in a direction of her choice.

actions.name: Mollifying Song (Concentration)
actions.description: Melusine begins to sing a magical melody. A creature that can hear the song and starts its turn within 60 feet of her must make a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature gains 5 Temporary Hit Points that last for a minute. While a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it cannot take hostile action against Melusine.

reactions.name: Deepen Harmony
reactions.description: As a reaction when a friendly lemurian within 30 feet uses its song ability, Melusine uses her Mollifying Song.

name: Cyanea, Lemurian Sandwalker
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +6, Int -3, Wis +6

traits.name: Buoyant Pneumatophore
traits.description: While within 15 feet of the ground, the sandwalker has a fly speed equal to its movement speed.

traits.name: Sonic Symbiote
traits.description: The sandwalker doesn't have Actions of its own or roll initiative. Instead, a friendly lemurian within 15 feet of it may use its Actions and Reactions, if the sandwalker can hear it. A lemurian outside of the sandwalker may not use its multiattack. A lemurian pilot within 5 feet may spend half its movement to enter the sandwalker, if it is unoccupied.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sandwalker makes two attacks with its Stinging Lash, one of which it may replace with a use of its Oral Arms.

actions.name: Stinging Lash
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 15 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage. This attack is made at Advantage against a creature directly beneath the sandwalker.

actions.name: Oral Arms
actions.description: One creature within 15 feet of the sandwalker must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 15) and pulled up to 10 feet toward the sandwalker.

reactions.name: Tangling Tendrils
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature grappled by it takes any Action, the sandwalker makes a Stinging Lash attack against it.

name: Brachyur, Lemurian Sandwalker
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +1, Con +8, Int -3, Wis +2

traits.name: Ductile Carapace
traits.description: Whenever the sandwalker takes any Bludgeoning damage, its AC is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 11, until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Sonic Symbiote
traits.description: The sandwalker doesn't have Actions of its own or roll initiative. Instead, a friendly lemurian within 15 feet of it may use its Actions and Reactions, if the sandwalker can hear it. A lemurian outside of the sandwalker may not use its multiattack. A lemurian pilot within 5 feet may spend half its movement to enter the sandwalker, if it is unoccupied.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sandwalker makes three attacks with its Seizer Claw, one of which it may replace with a use of its Crusher Claw or its Paralytic Drip.

actions.name: Seizer Claw
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16) and dragged up to 5 feet towards the sandwalker.

actions.name: Crusher Claw
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 32 (6d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or suffer Disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a Short or Long rest.

actions.name: Paralytic Drip
actions.description: The sandwalker drips a paralytic venom onto a creature grappled by it. Roll 4d8. If this exceeds the grappled creature's current Hit Points, the creature is Paralyzed for the next hour, or until it takes any damage.

reactions.name: Jetting Jink
reactions.description: As a reaction to being targeted with a ranged attack, the sandwalker imposes Disadvantage on the attack and moves up to half its speed. It cannot end this movement closer to the attacker than it began.

name: Xystus, Fidelium Percutor
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex -2, Con +5, Int +10, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Deeproot Chitin
traits.description: Any Piercing or Slashing damage dealt to Xystus is reduced by 5.

traits.name: Dweomersense Antennae
traits.description: Xystus can pinpoint, by scent, any magic items or active spells within 120 feet of it, and has Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws against spells and other magic effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Xystus makes two attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Ground Pound.

actions.name: Gyroid Rattlemace
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. On a Critical Hit against a Medium or smaller target, the target falls Prone.

actions.name: Ground Pound
actions.description: Xystus smashes the earth, sending shockwaves rippling forth in a 10-foot Emanation. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 5 (1d10) Thunder damage and the creature is pushed 5 feet away. Success: Half damage. A Prone creature has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

reactions.name: Smash Blade
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature misses Xystus with a melee attack with a nonmagical weapon. Response: The weapon suffers a permanent and cumulative -1 to its to-hit and damage rolls.

name: Setina, Fidelium Warrior
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +4, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +3

traits.name: Dweomersense Antennae
traits.description: Setina can pinpoint, by scent, any magic items or active spells within 120 feet of it, and has Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws against spells and other magic effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Setina makes two attacks, one of which she can replace with a use of her Wrecking Roll.

actions.name: Greatclaw Graftaxe
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage. On a miss, up to one creature within 5 feet can make an Opportunity Attack against Setina.

actions.name: Wrecking Roll
actions.description: Setina falls Prone and rolls up to 20 feet in a straight line. When she would enter a creature's space in this way, she can force it to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage and the creature falls Prone Success: Setina stops moving and ends her turn.

reactions.name: Reflexive Scrunch
reactions.description: Trigger: Setina is targeted with a melee attack. Response: Until the start of her next turn, Setina's AC increases by +3 and other attacks that target her have Advantage.

reactions.name: Cleave Through
reactions.description: Trigger: Setina reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack. Response: Setina makes an additional melee attack against a different target.

name: Novalis, Fidelium Sniper
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +8, Con +2, Int +5, Wis +4, Cha -1

traits.name: Silent Flight
traits.description: While flying in Dim Light or Darkness, Novalis can Hide without obscurement.

traits.name: Dweomersense Antennae
traits.description: Novalis can pinpoint, by scent, any magic items or active spells within 120 feet of it, and has Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws against spells and other magic effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Novalis makes three attacks with her Needle Stinger.

actions.name: Needle Stinger
actions.description: Attack: +8 range 300/600 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Point-Blank Blast
actions.description: One creature within 10 feet. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 14 (4d6) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage and the creature is pushed up to 10 feet away.

bonusActions.name: Secure Vantage
bonusActions.description: Novalis moves up to half her Speed and attempts to Hide.

bonusActions.name: Deadeye Mark
bonusActions.description: *A piercing gaze, hunting for weakness.* One creature Novalis can see within 300 feet. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: Until the end of this turn, Novalis' attacks against that target ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover, and score a Critical Hit on a 18-20.

name: Celeroptera Gnat
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +6, Con +2, Int -5, Wis +1, Cha -4

traits.name: Rapid Processing
traits.description: While it is not Incapacitated, the gnat has Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws against effects it can see. If the gnat falls Prone, it is Stunned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Spiked Slam
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus Hit: 2 (1d4) poison damage. If the gnat moved at least 20 feet toward the target immediately before attacking it, this attack deals an additional 2 (1d4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Hydraulic Ejection (1/Day)
actions.description: Spines shoot from the gnat in all directions, forcing each other creature in a 20-foot Emanation to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 2 (1d4) Piercing plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

bonusActions.name: Veering Flight
bonusActions.description: The gnat takes the Dodge or Disengage action, then flies up to 10 feet.

name: Mordrax, Colossal Centipede
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +3, Int -5, Wis +3, Cha -4

traits.name: Desiccation Weakness
traits.description: Whenever the centipede takes any Fire or Necrotic damage, it gains a point of Exhaustion.

traits.name: Hundred-Legged Writhe
traits.description: The centipede ignores the effects of Difficult Terrain, and has Advantage on attacks made against a creature that it is Attached to, Grappling, or Grappled by.

traits.name: Reflexive Molt (1/Day)
traits.description: When the centipede fails a saving throw against an effect that does not deal damage, it can choose to succeed by rapidly shedding its exoskeleton, disgorging its soft inner body through its mouth into the nearest unoccupied space. The exoskeleton can be attacked and destroyed (AC 16; 30 HP; Vulnerability to Fire damage) Until it completes a Long Rest or uses its Devour Chitin, the centipede gains Vulnerability to all damage and its AC is reduced to 14.

actions.name: Mandible Slice
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fleshripper Toxicognaths
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15). If the target is Huge or larger, the centipede can become Attached to the target (remove DC 15) instead of Grappling it.

actions.name: Devour Chitin
actions.description: The centipede gorges itself upon its shed exoskeleton, consuming it and regaining a use of its Reflexive Molt. It can't take this action while it is Grappling or Attached to a creature.

bonusActions.name: Heartstopper Venom
bonusActions.description: The centipede pumps venom into a creature it is Grappling or Attached to, forcing it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 21 (6d6) Poison damage. Success: Half damage. Then, if the creature has 20 or fewer Hit Points, it drops to 0 Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Caudal Grip
bonusActions.description: The centipede anchors itself with its pincer-like rear legs and coils up, gaining the following effects until the end of its next turn: The centipede's Speed is reduced to 0. The centipede has Advantage on ability checks and saving throws that use Strength. The centipede's melee attacks have a reach of 30 feet and Advantage.

reactions.name: Skittering Shield
reactions.description: Trigger: An ally the centipede can see within 20 feet is targeted with a ranged attack or spell. Response: The centipede moves up to half its Speed directly toward the ally and becomes the target of the attack or spell in its ally's stead.

name: Noctuoidea Lanceolaria
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +1, Wis +1

traits.name: Delicate Wings
traits.description: If the lanceolaria takes any Fire damage, its fly speed is reduced by 10 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Doctrine of the Mean
traits.description: Whenever the lanceolaria makes a saving throw, it may treat the result rolled as a 10. If this reduces the actual result rolled, the noctuoidea gains 1d10 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Gravity Lance
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage, plus an additional 1d6 damage for each 10 feet the lanceolaria descended this turn. This attack is made at Advantage against a creature wearing heavy armor.

actions.name: Pheromone Encoding
actions.description: The lanceolaria leaves a simple message encoded in a subtle scent that it emits in a 500-foot radius. For the next week, any noctuoidea that passes through the area can detect and understand the message.

actions.name: Cyclone Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or take 6 (1d12) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Take Flight
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the lanceolaria moves up to half its fly speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

reactions.name: Mothdream Dust
reactions.description: As a reaction when it is hit with a melee attack, the lanceolaria sheds soporific scales from its wings. The attacker must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or fall asleep for the next minute, or until a creature wakes it as an action or by dealing damage to it.

name: Fidelium Hunter
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +2, Wis +2

traits.name: Dweomersense Antennae
traits.description: The hunter can pinpoint, by scent, any magic items or active spells within 120 feet of it, and has Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws against spells and other magic effects.

traits.name: Cryptic Camouflage
traits.description: While the hunter remains motionless, it may hide without cover in any natural environment.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hunter makes two attacks with its grafted stingblade, one of which it may replace with its Hydraulic Evisceration, if available.

actions.name: Grafted Stingblade
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus Hit: 5 (2d4) poison damage.

actions.name: Hydraulic Evisceration (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 15 (6d4) Piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Jink
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack while at least 10 feet in the air, the hunter halves the attack's damage.

reactions.name: Mothdream Dust
reactions.description: As a reaction when it is hit with a melee attack, the hunter sheds soporific scales from its wings. The attacker must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or fall asleep for the next minute, or until a creature wakes it as an action or by dealing damage to it.

name: Imperialis, Citheronia Moth
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +6, Con +5, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Light-Attracted
traits.description: If Imperialis starts her turn within 30 feet of a source of bright light, she must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to voluntarily move away from the light until the beginning of her next turn.

traits.name: Erratic Flight
traits.description: While Imperialis is flying, attacks against her and any creatures riding her are made at Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Imperialis makes two attacks, one of which may be with its barbed proboscis.

actions.name: Barbed Proboscis
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 15 ft. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) slashing damage and Imperialis learns what types of flowers the creature has most recently been near.

actions.name: Clinging Claws
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Pollinating Slam
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage. On a hit or miss, the target and each other creature within 5 feet of it are coated in a fine pollen. A creature covered in this pollen gains no benefit from being invisible until a creature uses an action to clear it.

reactions.name: Chaotic Swoop
reactions.description: As a reaction when missed with an attack, Imperialis flies up to 15 feet in a random direction perpendicular to the ground.

reactions.name: Cry For Peace (1/Day)
reactions.description: As a reaction to being reduced below 43 HP, Imperialis releases a haunting sound and begins to glow softly for the next minute. A creature that can see the glow and attempts to attack Imperialis must first make a DC 13 Wisdom saving. On a failed save, the attacker must choose a different target or lose the attack.

name: Eacles, Fidelium Shaman
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +5, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +6, Cha +4

traits.name: Dweomersense Antennae
traits.description: Eacles can pinpoint, by scent, any magic items or active spells within 120 feet of her, and has Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws against spells and other magic effects.

traits.name: Moth Bond (1/Day)
traits.description: While riding Imperialis, Eacles acts on her mount's initiative, rather than rolling her own. If she would fail a saving throw against an incapacitating effect while within 30 feet of Imperialis, Imperialis suffers the effect in her stead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Eacles makes two attacks with her moontrapped stave, one of which she may replace with a use of her Mutation Chant.

actions.name: Moontrapped Stave
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Blinding Globe
actions.description: Attack: +6 range 60 ft. Hit: 27 (6d8) radiant damage and the targets head is trapped in a globe of solid moonlight, which shatters when hit. For the next minute or until the creature is hit with an attack, the creature is Blinded and emits bright light in a 30 ft. radius.

actions.name: Mutation Chant
actions.description: Eacles begins a chant that speeds the mutations caused by Pestilent Lepidopterism. Each infected creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or have its Charisma score reduced by 1d4, to a minimum of 1. A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 1 in this way is enclosed in a magical cocoon, and hatches on its following turn exhibiting cosmetic mutations and Charmed by Eacles until the disease is cured.

actions.name: Pestilent Humors (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Eacles releases a parasitic miasma that slithers forth in a 30-foot cone before dissipating. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or take 21 (6d6) poison damage and contract Pestilent Lepidopterism, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Rider's Jink
reactions.description: As a reaction to Eacles or a moth she is mounted on being hit with a ranged attack while at least 10 feet in the air, Eacles halves the attack's damage.

reactions.name: Mothdream Dust
reactions.description: As a reaction when she is hit with a melee attack, Eacles sheds soporific scales from her wings. The attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or fall asleep for the next minute, or until a creature wakes it as an action or by dealing damage to it.

reactions.name: Pestilent Lepidopterism
reactions.description: An infected creature's skin develops a dry, powdery texture and it loses all apetite. Each dawn, the creature's Charisma score is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1. A creature whose Charisma score is reduced to 1 in this way is enveloped in a cocoon, and over the course of a week has its body dissolve and reform into something new, wondrous and terrible. A creature that emerges from this cocoon cannot distinguish friend from foe. Once the disease has progressed to this point, curing the disease returns the creature's ability to distinguish friend from foe, but the mutations remain. If the infected creature is a noctuoidea, these changes are less extreme and can be guided and controlled to a certain extent through the application of secret medicines and meditation.

name: Nanny Beetle
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex -1, Con +2, Int -5, Cha -3

traits.name: Dreadnaught Shell
traits.description: If the beetle would take 10 or fewer bludgeoning, piercing, or Slashing damage from a single source, it takes no damage instead.

traits.name: Spiracle Breathing
traits.description: The beetle has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws against inhaled toxins.

actions.name: Tarsal Stomp
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. This attack has Disadvantage against a target that is flying or climbing.

actions.name: Crushing Advance
actions.description: The beetle uses all of its remaining movement to move in a straight line, and can attempt to push one Large or smaller creature in its path, which must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed ahead of the beetle for the rest of this move. A creature pushed into a solid surface in this way takes 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and is Restrained (escape DC 13) until the beginning of the beetle's turn, or until the beetle moves.

reactions.name: Shivering Alarm (Recharge 6)
reactions.description: When the beetle sees a creature take a hostile action, it can scrape its legs against its shell, producing a horrid squealing sound audible out to 300 feet. Each creature within 15 feet that can hear it has Disadvantage on the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

name: Mimas, Fidelium Child
savingThrows: Str -2, Con -1, Int -1, Wis +1

traits.name: Dweomersense Antennae
traits.description: Mimas can pinpoint, by scent, any magic items or active spells within 120 feet of him, and has Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws against spells and other magic effects.

traits.name: Pheromonal Ward
traits.description: Whenever Mimas is targeted with an attack, his Nanny Beetle may use its reaction to change the attack's target to itself.

actions.name: Nauseating Puff
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution Saving Throw or take 2 (1d4) poison damage and be Poisoned until the end of Mimas' next turn. While Poisoned in this way, a creature's movement speed is reduced by half and it has Disadvantage on Strength Saving Throws.

actions.name: Parasitic Clutch
actions.description: Mimas flattens himself to the back of his Nanny Beetle and releases a burst of alarm pheromones. Until the start of his next turn, attacks against Mimas have Disadvantage, and his beetle's speed is increased by 10 feet.

name: Cervus Beetle
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex -2, Con +3, Int -5, Wis -1, Cha -3

traits.name: Careening Flight
traits.description: When the beetle begins flying, it must choose a direction to fly in, and must use all of its movement on each of its turns to fly in that direction until it lands or collides with a creature or object.

traits.name: Spiracle Breathing
traits.description: The beetle has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws against inhaled toxins.

actions.name: Oaksplitter Mandibles
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Tactical Collision
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the beetle falls prone.

actions.name: Behemoth Lift
actions.description: The beetle attempts to grasp a Gargantuan or smaller creature with its horns and flip it, forcing the target to succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. A creature grappled by the beetle makes this saving throw with Disadvantage, and is freed from the grapple on a failed saving throw.

reactions.name: Redeploy Wings
reactions.description: When the beetle begins to fall, it can make a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw. On a success, the beetle falls only 10 feet before catching itself in the air.

name: Riodin, Fidelium Knight
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +3, Con +3, Wis +2

traits.name: Dweomersense Antennae
traits.description: Riodin can pinpoint, by scent, any magic items or active spells within 120 feet of it, and has Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws against spells and other magic effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Riodin makes three attacks with his Chitinblade Crashlance, one of which he may replace with a use of his Banking Twist.

actions.name: Chitinblade Crashlance
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage. A creature killed by this damage is sliced in half.

actions.name: Banking Twist
actions.description: Riodin leans heavily, signaling a beetle he is riding. Until the beginning of Riodin's next turn, the beetle can change the direction of its flight as a bonus action.

actions.name: Windblade Slash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Riodin swings his lance with enormous force, sending a burst of bladed air in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 13 (2d12) Slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Collision Strike
reactions.description: When a beetle Riodin is mounted on uses its Tactical Collision, Riodin can make an attack with his Chitinblade Crashlance against the same target. On a hit, the attack deals an additional 7 (2d6) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Mothdream Dust
reactions.description: When Riodin is hit with a melee attack, he can shed soporific scales from his wings. The attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or fall asleep for the next minute, or until a creature wakes it as an action or by dealing damage to it.

name: Neria, Noctuoidea Decertator
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +6, Int +1, Wis +7, Cha +1

traits.name: Delicate Wings
traits.description: If Neria takes any Fire damage, her fly speed is reduced by 10 feet until she completes a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Doctrine of the Mean
traits.description: Whenever Neria makes a saving throw, she can treat the result rolled as a 10. If this reduces the actual result rolled, Neria gains 5 (1d10) Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Neria makes two attacks with her Dancing Claymore, one of which she can replace with a use of her Fortress Defense.

actions.name: Dancing Claymore
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) force damage.

actions.name: Strike Spell
actions.description: Neria swings her blade through a magical effect produced by a spell of 3rd level or lower within 10 feet, ending it and absorbing its energy. For the next minute, attacks made with her Dancing Claymore deal an additional 5 (1d10) Force damage.

actions.name: Fortress Defense
actions.description: Until the beginning of her next turn, Neria can take a reaction on each turn in combat.

reactions.name: Sweeping Rebuff
reactions.description: When a creature enters her reach, Neria can make a Dancing Claymore attack against it with Advantage. On a hit, the target is additionally pushed 5 feet away.

reactions.name: Mothdream Dust
reactions.description: When Neria is hit with a melee attack, she can shed soporific scales from her wings. The attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or fall asleep for the next minute, or until a creature wakes it as an action or by dealing damage to it.

name: Anthyria, Noctuoidea Mage
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +4, Con +2, Int +8, Wis +7, Cha +5

traits.name: Delicate Wings
traits.description: If Anthyria takes any Fire damage, her fly speed is reduced by 10 feet until she completes a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Doctrine of the Mean
traits.description: Whenever Anthyria makes a saving throw, she can treat the result rolled as a 10. If this reduces the actual result rolled, Anthyria gains 5 (1d10) Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Anthyria makes two attacks with her Divalian Starblade, one of which she can replace with a use of her Coursing Lights.

actions.name: Divalian Starblade
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) radiant damage. On a hit or miss, two motes of raw magic fly from the blade, each of which inexorably strikes a creature Anthyria can see within 60 feet, dealing 7 (2d6) Force damage.

actions.name: Coursing Lights
actions.description: Beams of roving light dash through a 30-foot radius area centered on a point Anthyria can see within 100 feet, lingering briefly on each creature they touch. Each hidden creature in the area is revealed, and attacks against creatures in the area are made at Advantage until the beginning of her next turn.

actions.name: Peace of Night's Air (Recharge 5-6, Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: Anthyria sends forth a gust of cool, sweet air in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area gains 10 Temporary Hit Points, then must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or gain Disadvantage on attacks for as long as it has any of these Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Moonfall's Echo (1/Day, Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: An enormous, illusory moon appears high above Anthyria, brightly illuminating a 60-foot radius area centered on a point she can see within 150 feet. At the beginning of her next turn, it crashes to the ground. Each creature in the illuminated area must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence Saving Throw or take 14 (4d6) radiant damage plus 18 (4d8) Thunder damage, or half as much on a success.

reactions.name: Take Flight
reactions.description: When Anthyria is hit with a melee attack, she can move up to half her fly speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

reactions.name: Mothdream Dust
reactions.description: When Anthyria is hit with a melee attack, she can shed soporific scales from her wings. The attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or fall asleep for the next minute, or until a creature wakes it as an action or by dealing damage to it.

name: Attack Primate
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Foe-Climber
traits.description: The primate may spend half its movement to force a Medium or larger creature within 5 feet to make a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the primate climbs onto the creature. While climbing on a creature, the primate moves with it and the creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls that target the primate.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The primate has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the primate's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The primate makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Whirling Slam
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or drop one item it is holding.

reactions.name: Topple
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature it is climbing on misses it with an attack, the primate forces the creature to succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or fall prone.

reactions.name: Screeching Alert
reactions.description: As a reaction when the primate detects a creature that is attempting to hide, it calls out a screeching bark. Each allied creature within 60 feet that can hear the primate gains immunity to the Surprised condition until the end of the primate's next turn, and may use its reaction to attempt a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect the hidden creature.

name: Gerwalt, Okamian Special Forces
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +7, Con +5, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Honorable Fealty
traits.description: While within 30 feet of a friendly humanoid creature of a CR at least 5 higher than its own, the okamian has Advantage on attack rolls and Wisdom Saving Throws.

traits.name: Master of the Black Legend
traits.description: While a creature is Frightened by Gerwalt, it is also Frightened by each of her allies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Gerwalt makes two attacks with her Cruciform Dirks.

actions.name: Cruciform Dirks
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage. On a critical hit, if the target is wearing armor gerwalt slices one of the armor's fasteners, reducing the target's AC by 2 until it takes a short or long rest to repair its armor.

actions.name: Terror Strike (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Gerwalt makes a single melee attack. If the attack hits, it is a critical, and each creature of Gerwalt's choice within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or be frightened until the beginning of her next turn.

reactions.name: Feign Death
reactions.description: As a reaction to taking damage, Gerwalt appears to die, falling prone and slowing his heart rate. A creature may detect that he is still alive with a successful DC 16 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

name: Gerlonus, Okamian Battle Mage
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +6, Con +7, Int +8, Wis +2, Cha +3

traits.name: Honorable Fealty
traits.description: While within 30 feet of a friendly humanoid creature of a CR at least 5 higher than its own, the okamian has Advantage on attack rolls and Wisdom Saving Throws.

traits.name: War-Mage's Subterfuge
traits.description: Gerlonus' spells can't be countered by creatures more than 30 feet away.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Gerlonus makes two attacks with his Crackling Witchblade, each of which he may replace with a use of his Burning Bolt.

actions.name: Crackling Witchblade
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) lightning damage. If it is raining, this attack deals an additional 7 (2d6) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Burning Bolt (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Attack: +7 range 120 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage and the target catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes Hit: 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Battle-Sanctuary (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Gerlonus surrounds himself in a 30-foot radius sphere of dancing air currents that lasts for an hour. Ranged attacks made from outside the area that target creatures or objects within it are made at Disadvantage.

actions.name: Flooding Torrent (Level 5 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Gerlonus sends forth a torrent of water from his staff. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or take 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed 20 feet away, or take half as much damage and be pushed 10 feet on a success.

reactions.name: Torrential Retort
reactions.description: As a reaction when he is hit with a melee attack while it is raining, Gerlonus forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 15 feet away and knocked prone.

name: Berengar, Okamian Shock Knight
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +1, Con +8, Int +2, Wis +8, Cha +3

traits.name: Honorable Fealty
traits.description: While within 30 feet of a friendly humanoid creature of a CR at least 5 higher than its own, the okamian has Advantage on attack rolls and Wisdom Saving Throws.

traits.name: Soul of Iron (3/Day)
traits.description: If Berengar fails a saving throw against being Charmed, Frightened, or Incapacitated, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Gerwalt makes three melee attacks, one of which he may replace with a use of his Ape Command or his Bulwark Charge, if available.

actions.name: Sainted Montante
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) radiant damage. This attack deals an additional Hit: 9 (2d8) radiant damage to a creature native to different plane of existence.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

actions.name: Simian Command
actions.description: Berengar calls out one of the following commands * "Away!" Berengar points at a creature within 60 feet. Up to two friendly attack primates within 20 feet of it that can hear Berengar may each use their reaction to move up to half their speed towards it and make a melee attack. * "To Me!" Up to two friendly attack primates within 60 feet that can hear Berengar may each use their reaction to attempt to grapple a creature within their reach, then move up to half their speed toward Berengar.

actions.name: Bulwark Charge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Berengar raises his shield and moves up to his speed in straight line, and may move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each creature in his path must succeed on a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reactions.name: Retributive Bash
reactions.description: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, Berengar makes an attack with his shield bash.

reactions.name: Reject Quarter
reactions.description: As a reaction when a friendly creature Berengar can see within 30 feet makes a saving throw against being Charmed or Frightened, Berengar gives the creature Advantage on the saving throw. If the creature fails the saving throw, it treats Berengar as hostile for as long as it remains Charmed or Frightened.

name: Ermingild, Okamian Elder Mage
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +9, Int +4, Wis +10, Cha +3

traits.name: Honorable Fealty
traits.description: While within 30 feet of a friendly humanoid creature of a CR at least 5 higher than its own, the okamian has Advantage on attack rolls and Wisdom Saving Throws.

traits.name: Master of the Golden Legend
traits.description: While Charmed by Ermingild, a creature is convinced of the righteousness of Ermingild's cause and the purity of his intent, and treats each creature friendly to Ermingild as friendly.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Ermingild fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ermingild makes two attacks with his cane lash.

actions.name: Cane Lash
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage.

actions.name: Binding Entrustment
actions.description: One creature Charmed by Ermingild must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom Saving Throw or remain Charmed by him for the next 24 hours. On a successful saving throw, the target takes 13 (3d8) radiant damage plus 16 (3d10) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Viceroy's Decree
actions.description: Ermingild shouts a magical command to the natural world, choosing one of the following effects * Conquest of Stone. Ermingild levitates a 15-foot cube of compacted earth or stone out from the ground at an unoccupied point within 120 feet and sends it sliding across the ground up to 30 feet. Each creature in the block's path must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or take 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed ahead of the block, taking half as much damage and stopping the block from moving further on a success. * Conquest of Sea. A geyser of water spews forth from the ground beneath a creature Ermingild can see within 60 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or be launched up to 100 feet into the air. * Conquest of Sky. Ermingild calls up a tempest, causing it to rain heavily in a 1 mile radius for the next hour. Up to ten ten-foot squares that Ermingild can see become difficult terrain as flooding turns them to mud or shallow puddles.

legendaryActions.name: Cane Lash
legendaryActions.description: Ermingild makes an attack with his cane lash.

legendaryActions.name: Redeploy
legendaryActions.description: Ermingild or one friendly creature he can see within 120 feet teleports to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Ermingild.

legendaryActions.name: Extract Tribute

legendaryActions.name: Viceroy's Decree (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Ermingild uses his Viceroy's Decree.

name: Sarugami Bard
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Int +2, Wis +1, Cha +3

traits.name: Band Tactics
traits.description: While within 5 feet of an ally with this trait, the first attack made against the sarugami each turn has Disadvantage.

actions.name: Baiting Barb
actions.description: The sarugami calls out a raucus insult to a creature within 60 feet, forcing it to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: Until the end of its next turn, the creature has Disadvantage on attacks that don't target the sarugami.

actions.name: Vigorous Ditty (Concentration)
actions.description: The sarugami strikes up an invigorating melody; for as long as it maintains Concentration, each of its allies within 30 feet gains a +1 bonus to any attack or saving throw it makes. For allies within range of two or more creatures using this ability, this bonus increases to +1d4.

reactions.name: Tumble Free
reactions.description: Trigger: The sarugami is missed with an attack. Response: The sarugami rolls up to 10 freet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: Koga, Sarugami Zuijin
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +4, Int +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Warden at the Gate of Despair
traits.description: The sarugami and creatures in a 10-foot Emanation from it have Advantage on saving throws against effects controlled by Fiends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sarugami makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of its Pin Down.

actions.name: Silverbloom Partisan
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage (ignores Resistance).

actions.name: Pin Down
actions.description: One Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The creature falls Prone and is Grappled (escape DC 13).

bonusActions.name: Tumbling Rush
bonusActions.description: The sarugami rolls up to 10 feet, then can force a creature within 5 feet to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The creature is pushed up to 10 feet away.

name: Goken, Sarugami Zuijin
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +2, Con +4, Int +3, Wis +5, Cha +2

traits.name: Earth-Defiant
traits.description: Whenever the sarugami makes a melee attack, it can leap up to 15 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. It suffers no negative effects from falling 30 feet or fewer.

traits.name: Warden at the Gate of Despair
traits.description: The sarugami and creatures in a 10-foot Emanation from it have Advantage on saving throws against effects controlled by Fiends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sarugami makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with its War-Door Slam or Fierce Screech.

actions.name: Ambershine Jian
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) radiant damage. On a Critical Hit against a creature using a nonmagical shield, the sarugami can destroy the shield.

actions.name: War-Door Slam
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away. Failure by 5 or More: The target additionally falls Prone.

actions.name: Fierce Screech
actions.description: Each creature of the sarugami's choice in a 20-foot Emanation from it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The creature is Frightened until the end of the sarugami's next turn. Success: The creature becomes immune to this effect for 1 minute.

reactions.name: Beat Chest
reactions.description: Trigger: The zuijin reduces an enemy to 0 Hit Points. Response: Each of the zuijin's allies within 30 feet gains Advantage on the first attack it makes before the end of their next turn.

name: Tetsujin, Sarugami Zuijin
savingThrows: Str +10, Dex +7, Con +9, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +1

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: Attacks made against the sarugami by a creature Attached to it have Advantage, and the sarugami has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures Attached to it.

traits.name: Warden at the Gate of Despair
traits.description: The sarugami and creatures in a 10-foot Emanation from it have Advantage on saving throws against effects controlled by Fiends.

actions.name: Multiatack
actions.description: The sarugami makes two attacks and can use its Prison Vessel Slam or Banishing Toll.

actions.name: Mighty Slap
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) nonlethal Bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 20 feet away.

actions.name: Prison Vessel Slam
actions.description: The sarugami slams its bronze vessel down, forcing each Large or smaller creature in a 5-foot Emanation within 15 feet to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The creature is Restrained (escape DC 18) until the vessel is lifted. Success: The creature moves to the nearest unoccupied space. While Restrained in this way, a creature has total cover against outside effects.

actions.name: Banishing Toll
actions.description: The sarugami strikes its enchanted vessel; each creature within must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The creature is banished to a demon-realm. A non-Fiend banished in this way can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, returning to the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed from on a success.

bonusActions.name: Seal of Subdual (Level 2 Spell)
bonusActions.description: One Incapacitated creature within 5 feet is wrapped in magical bonds, Restraining it (escape DC 15) for 1 hour. The creature can't regain Hit Points while restrained in this way.

name: Baby Kyoka
savingThrows: Str -3, Dex -2, Con +1, Int -4, Cha -4

traits.name: Retract Head
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the kyoka may retract its limbs and head into its shell and end its turn. Until the start of its next turn, the kyoka's AC is increased to 18 and it can't take reactions.

traits.name: Laborious Rocking
traits.description: When the kyoka attempts to stand from prone, it must make a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check in addition to spending half its movement, remaining prone on a failure.

actions.name: Jagged Nip
actions.description: Attack: +0 reach 10 ft., one target wielding a weapon made of wood or other organic material. Hit: The kyoka attaches to the weapon. While attached, attacks with the weapon are made at Disadvantage and the kyoka is dragged with the weapon until it releases its bite as a Bonus Action. A creature may attempt to remove the kyoka as an action with a DC 8 Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: Obstinate Plant
actions.description: Until the start of its next turn, the kyoka gains Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and a Medium or Large creature that attempts to move through its space must succeed on DC 11 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone.

name: Kyoka
savingThrows: Str +4, Con +5, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -4

traits.name: Retract Head
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the kyoka may retract its limbs and head into its shell and end its turn. Until the start of its next turn, the kyoka's AC is increased to 19 and it can't take reactions.

traits.name: Laborious Rocking
traits.description: When the kyoka attempts to stand from prone, it must make a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check in addition to spending half its movement, remaining prone on a failure.

actions.name: Jagged Snap
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (3d12 + 4) piercing damage.
