actions.name: Push Onward
actions.description: Until the end of its turn, the kyoka may move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. A creature whose space the kyoka enters is pushed to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet.

actions.name: Obstinate Plant
actions.description: Until the start of its next turn, the kyoka gains Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and a Gargantuan creature that attempts to move through its space must succeed on DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone.

name: Sommos Jow Kyoka Rider
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +6, Wis +1

traits.name: Waddlebore Pursuit
traits.description: When the jow makes an attack of opportunity, it may move up to half its speed.

actions.name: Casting Rod
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 20 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Nacre Oar
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Scarkok Headbutt (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The jow and one other creature within 5 feet must each succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the jow's next turn.

reactions.name: Hook Set
reactions.description: As a reaction when the jow hits a creature with its Casting Rod, it embeds the hook in the target. While the hook is embedded, the jow cannot attack another creature with its Casting Rod, and the first time the target moves away from the jow, it takes 5 (2d4) Slashing damage and the hook is freed. A creature may remove the hook as an action with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check, or sever the line (AC 15; 8 HP) to end this effect.

name: Sommos Jow Veteran
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +3, Con +8, Wis +2, Cha -1

traits.name: Waddlebore Pursuit
traits.description: When the jow makes an attack of opportunity, it may move up to half its speed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The jow makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Scarkok headbutt, if available.

actions.name: Reefeater Finblade
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage. On a roll of 19-20, this attack deals an additional Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Shell-Shield Bash
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Scarkok Headbutt (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The jow and one other creature within 5 feet must each succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the jow's next turn.

reactions.name: Battle-Honed Flop
reactions.description: As a reaction when the jow is forced to make a Dexterity Saving Throw, it may drop prone and gain Advantage on the saving throw.

name: Orchamus, Sommos Jow Warlord
savingThrows: Str +11, Dex +6, Con +11, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +3

traits.name: Waddlebore Pursuit
traits.description: When Orchamus makes an attack of opportunity, he may move up to half his speed.

traits.name: Obdurate
traits.description: Orchamus may willingly move toward creatures he is Frightened of.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Orchamus makes three attacks with his Bonewrought Dragonhook, one of which he may replace with a use of his Scarkok headbutt, if available.

actions.name: Bonewrought Dragonhook
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) slashing damage. Up to one other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take half the attack's damage.

actions.name: Anglerstrike
actions.description: Orchamus makes an attack at Advantage with his Bonewrought Dragonhook. On a hit, the target is Hooked (escape DC 19). While Hooked, a creature can't leave Orchamus' reach, is dragged with him when he moves, and is freed if Orchamus makes an attack against another creature. A Huge or larger Hooked creature has Disadvantage on attacks made with its bite.

actions.name: Scarkok Headbutt (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Orchamus and one other creature within 5 feet must each succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of the jow's next turn.

reactions.name: Battle-Honed Flop
reactions.description: As a reaction when Orchamus is forced to make a Dexterity Saving Throw, he may drop prone and gain Advantage on the saving throw.

reactions.name: Hookwrench
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature Hooked by Orchamus uses a breath weapon, he forces it to succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or have the direction of its breath weapon shifted up to 45 degrees in a direction of his choice.

name: Gishima, Sommos Mago Tidecaller
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +9, Int +3, Wis +9, Cha +10

traits.name: Violent Tide
traits.description: A creature pushed into a solid object or surface by a spell or ability Gishima controls takes 5 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Pearlbearer's Ward
traits.description: While within line of sight of the sea, if Gishima or a creature within 10 feet of her would take half damage from an effect after succeeding on their saving throw, they instead take no damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Gishima fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Gishima uses her Tidal Stride three times, one of which she may replace with an attack with Shorebreaker Staff.

actions.name: Shorebreaker Staff
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 9 (2d8) cold damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed a number of feet equal to 5 times the amount it failed by.

actions.name: Tidal Stride (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Gishima teleports up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space she can see in a splash of brine. Each creature within 5 feet of the space she teleports to must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Likeness of the Clam God (Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Gishima conjures a watery echo of a gargantuan clam in a 10-foot radius centered on a point she can see. When it appears, each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or be restrained (escape DC 18), moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success. At the beginning of each of gishima's turns, she may fire a jet of water from the clam, forcing one creature within 60 feet of it to succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet away from it.

actions.name: Sudden Sea (Level 7 Spell, Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A torrent of seawater washes out from Gishima in all directions in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or take 45 (10d8) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed 15 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Harbor's Mercy
reactions.description: As a reaction when one or more creatures makes a Strength Saving Throw against an effect Gishima controls, Gishima gives up to three creatures Advantage on the saving throw.

legendaryActions.name: Tidal Stride
legendaryActions.description: Gishima uses her Tidal Stride.

legendaryActions.name: Thalassic Command
legendaryActions.description: Up to two friendly creatures with a swim speed that gishima can see within 60 feet may each use their reactions to move up to half their speed and make a melee attack.

legendaryActions.name: Relentless Deluge (Level 3 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: One creature Gishima can see within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

name: Hokibo, Daitengu Zuijin
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +8, Con +2, Int +3, Wis +7

traits.name: Demon-Eye
traits.description: The daitengu's ranged attacks have Advantage while no enemy is within 15 feet of it.

traits.name: Harbinger of Strife
traits.description: The daitengu and each creature in a 30 foot Emanation from it gain a +1d4 bonus to any attack roll they make.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The daitengu makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with the Dash action or a use of its Sparkshackle.

actions.name: Stilt-Geta Kick
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Before or after attacking, the daitengu can jump up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

actions.name: Silverbore Hinawaju
actions.description: Attack: +8 range 40/120 ft. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) piercing damage. On a Critical Hit, one object the target is wearing or carrying is flung 20 feet in a random direction.

actions.name: Sparkshackle
actions.description: The daitengu binds a crude rocket to a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The creature is Restrained (escape DC 16). At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained creature takes 11 (2d10) Fire damage and is dragged 15 feet in a random direction.

reactions.name: Feign Death
reactions.description: Trigger: The daitengu takes any damage. Response: The daitengu falls Prone and appears to die.

name: Hikenbo, Daitengu Zuijin
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +10, Con +4, Wis +6, Cha +5

traits.name: Restless Qi
traits.description: The daitengu has Advantage on d20 Tests made to end the Grappled, Restrained, or Incapacitated conditions.

traits.name: Harbinger of Strife
traits.description: The daitengu and each creature in a 30 foot Emanation from it gain a +1d4 bonus to any attack roll they make.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The daitengu makes four attacks. If it is not Bloodied, it can replace one of these attacks with a use of its Steel Cyclone.

actions.name: Tempest Cleavers
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) thunder damage.

actions.name: Steel Cyclone
actions.description: The daitegu whirls itself through the air, Flying up to 20 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature it moved within 5 feet of with this movement must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Ironskin Technique
reactions.description: Trigger: The daitengu is hit with an attack. Response: Until the end of this turn, any damage it takes is reduced by 7 (2d6).

name: Daranibo, Daitengu Zuijin
savingThrows: Dex +3, Con +6, Int +2, Wis +7, Cha +9

traits.name: Netherkeeper
traits.description: Undead creatures have Disadvantage on attacks against the daitengu, and the daitengu has Advantage on effects controlled by Undead creatures.

traits.name: Harbinger of Strife
traits.description: The daitengu and each creature in a 30 foot Emanation from it gain a +1d4 bonus to any attack roll they make.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The daitengu makes two attacks with its Smiling Tide, one of which it can replace with a use of its Ghastly Grasp.

actions.name: Smiling Tide
actions.description: Attack: +9 range 40 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) cold damage plus Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. This attack scores a Critical Hit on an 18-20 against a Frightened target.

actions.name: Ghastly Grasp
actions.description: Spectral hands grasp toward a Large or smaller creature within 60 feet, forcing it to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 22 (5d8) Psychic damage and the target is Frightened. While Frightened in this way, the creature is Restrained and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Chainer's Mantra (Recharge 5-6, Level 6 Spell)
actions.description: The daitengu begins an echoing chant, forcing one creature it can see within 30 feet to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target is Paralyzed for 1 minute. Failure by 5 or More: The target is Charmed and under the daitengu's control for 1 minute. An affected creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Drifting Twirl
reactions.description: Trigger: The daitengu takes any damage. Response: The daitengu gains Resistance to the triggering damage and moves up to 15 feet away from the damage's source.

reactions.name: Dark Mirror Domain (1/Day, Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
reactions.description:
Trigger: The daitengu becomes Bloodied. Response: Writhing shadows spread from the daitengu in a 30-foot Emanation, extinguishing all lights in the area. Creatures in the area have Disadvantage on saving throws to resist being Frightened, Paralyzed or Possessed. A creature that enters or leaves the area for the first time on a turn takes 18 (4d8) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Ghostflame Swarm (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)

actions.name: Mountain-Splitting Strike (1/Day, Level 8 Spell)
actions.description: The daitengu slashes with its sword, sending forth a wave of force in a 150-foot long, 10-foot wide Line. Each nonmagical object or structure in the area is destroyed. legendaryActions.name: Double-Slash

legendaryActions.name: Almighty Guard

legendaryActions.name: Soul Burn
legendaryActions.description:
Each creature affected by the daitengu's Ghostflame Swarm takes 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage.

savingThrows: Dex +3, Con +2, Int -5, Cha -5
immunities: Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Short Leash
traits.description: While it is further than 30 feet from its creator, the marionette is Stunned.

traits.name: Unstable Grace
traits.description: The marionette can stand from Prone by spending 5 feet of movement. If the marionette takes any Bludgeoning damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source and falls Prone.

actions.name: Clattering Slash
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. If this attack misses, the marionette gains Disadvantage on the next attack it makes this turn.

actions.name: Spasmodic Twirl
actions.description: The marionette spins, forcing each creature within 5 feet of it to make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 10 (3d6) Slashing damage. If no creature fails this saving throw, the marionette falls Prone and ends its turn.

reactions.name: Defensive Flurry
reactions.description: Trigger: The marionette is targeted with a melee attack. Response: The marionette gains a +2 Bonus to its AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, the marionette regains its Reaction.

name: Kotenbo, Daitengu Outlaw
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +6, Wis +2

traits.name: Harbinger of Strife
traits.description: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds 1d4 to the result.

traits.name: Confounding Masks

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Kotenbo makes two attacks with her Toesmasher Kine and uses her Crawling Snare, if available

actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw or fall prone.

Whenever a creature within 30 feet of a snare casts a spell, Kotenbo may have the snare sprout spindly legs and crawl 10 feet toward that creature.

reactions.name: Vent Flame
reactions.description: As a reaction when Kotenbo is forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, Kotenbo gains Advantage on the save and vents a gout of flame from her mask's horns, dealing 3 (1d6) Fire damage to each other Medium or larger creature within 5 feet of her.

savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +2, Int +4, Wis +1, Cha +6

traits.description: Sojobo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. She may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

traits.name: Harbinger of Strife

actions.name: Looming Gaze
actions.description: Sojobo leans menacingly over a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet, which must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened until the beginning of Sojobo's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls prone.

reactions.name: Launching Gust

traits.description: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds 1d4 to the result.

traits.name: Deliberate
traits.description: If Zenkibo does not make any attacks on his turn, he may use his Multiattack whenever he would make an attack with his reaction.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Zenkibo makes two attacks; one with his Humongous Tetsubo and one with his Studded Fist.

actions.name: Humongous Tetsubo
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone. If this attack misses, Zenkibo may immediately make a second attack roll against a different target in range.

actions.name: Studded Fist
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Grab Scruff
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature within 5 feet makes an attack against a creature other than him, Zenkibo attempts to grapple the creature. While grappled in this way, a creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls that target any creature other than Zenkibo.

name: Usagibo, Daitengu Outlaw
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +9, Con +4, Int +5, Wis +5, Cha +2

traits.name: Feather Step
traits.description: Usagibo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. She may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

traits.name: Harbinger of Strife
traits.description: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds 1d4 to the result.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Usagibo makes four attacks, each of which she can replace with a use of her Yugiri Strike.

actions.name: Iron Geta Kick
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d4 + 6) bludgeoning damage. Before or after attacking, Usagibo may jump up to 10 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity.

actions.name: Painter's Blade
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Yugiri Strike
actions.description: One friendly daitengu may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a melee attack or take the Hide action.

bonusActions.name: Yokai Mischief
bonusActions.description: Usagibo's yokai scamper around a creature she can see within 20 feet, causing one of the following effects: Misstep. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or fall prone. Misplace. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw or have one item it is carrying magically replaced with a stick or rock of similar dimensions. The missing object is hidden at a spot within 20 feet (find DC 15). Misfortune. Until the beginning of Usagibo's next turn, the creature has Disadvantage on all attack rolls. On a roll of 1, the creature hits itself with the attack.

name: Mametama, Bearded Shishi
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Con +2, Int -2, Wis +3, Cha +3

traits.name: Divine Sense
traits.description: Mametama can unerringly detect, by scent, the attitude of other creatures toward it and its allies.

traits.name: Born Companion
traits.description: Creatures friendly to the mastiff that can see it add 1d4 to saving throws against being Frightened.

actions.name: Enthralling Paw
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed by Mametama for the next minute, or until it takes any damage. While it is Charmed in this way, attacks against the creature are made at Advantage.

actions.name: Oblivion Yap (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Mametama lets out a thunderous yap in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma Saving Throw or be disassembled and scattered across the astral plane. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect and reforming in the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed on a success. Beast Core. The shishi's and bakunawa's bodies contain a core of their concentrated magical essence. This core may be extracted intact from their corpse with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Survival) check and may be used to empower the crafting of magical items, or consumed to permanently increase the number of hit dice a creature has by one.

name: Juvenile Bakunawa
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Moon-Eater
traits.description: The bakunawa and each creature riding or climbing on it are immune to radiant damage. While illuminated by moonlight, the bakunawa has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bakunawa makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with its luminous bite.

actions.name: Luminous Bite
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Wriggling Ram
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Before or after making this attack, the bakunawa may move up to a quarter of its speed.

reactions.name: Thrash
reactions.description: As a reaction to failing a saving throw, the bakunawa forces each creature within 15 feet to succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 15 feet away.

name: Ancient Bakunawa
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +5, Con +9, Wis +7, Cha +3

traits.name: Moon-Eater
traits.description: The bakunawa and each creature riding or climbing on it are immune to radiant damage. While illuminated by moonlight, the bakunawa has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Huge Stature
traits.description: A creature adjacent to the bakunawa may spend half its movement to attempt a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the bakunawa. While climbing on the bakunawa, a creature has Advantage on melee attacks made against it.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.description: If the bakunawa fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bakunawa makes three attacks with its wriggling ram.

actions.name: Luminous Bite
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) radiant damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be swallowed. While swallowed, the target's attacks bypass the bakunawa's resistances and it takes 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the bakunawa's turns. If the bakunawa takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the bakunawa regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in the nearest unoccupied space.

actions.name: Wriggling Ram
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away. Before or after making this attack, the bakunawa may move up to a quarter of its speed.

actions.name: Horn Flash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The bakunawa's horns flash with stored moonlight. Each creature within 30 feet that can see the bakunawa must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 (4d10) radiant damage and be Blinded until the end of the bakunawa's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Thrash
reactions.description: As a reaction to failing a saving throw, the bakunawa forces each creature within 15 feet to succeed on a DC 18 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 15 feet away.

name: Myogibo, Kotengu Philosopher
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +6, Con +2, Int +3, Wis +4, Cha +1

traits.name: Sharp-Eyed
traits.description: Creatures without full cover from Myogibo cannot be hidden from him, and his attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover.

traits.name: Feather Step
traits.description: Myogibo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. He may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Myogibo makes two attacks with his Tengu Fan.

actions.name: Tengu Fan
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 15 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be spun around and disoriented, giving it Disadvantage on the next attack it makes before the beginning of Myogibo's next turn.

actions.name: Gust of Five Winds (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Myogibo sweeps his fan, unleashing a torrent of wind. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Embrace Stillness
reactions.description: As a reaction when Myogibo fails an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma Saving Throw, he may choose to succeed. If he does, he is Stunned until the start of his next turn.

name: Tsukibo, Daitengu Archer
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +7, Con +2, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Feather Step
traits.description: Tsukibo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. She may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

traits.name: Harbinger of Strife
traits.description: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds 1d4 to the result.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Tsukibo makes four attacks, or makes two attacks and uses her Suppressing Fire, if available.

actions.name: Daikyu Bow
actions.description: Attack: +7 range 150/600 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage. This attack is made at Disadvantage if Tsukibo is not mounted.

actions.name: Arrow Stab
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Suppressing Fire (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Tsukibo rains a barrage of arrows down in a 15-foot radius centered on a point she can see within 120 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity Saving Throw or have its movement speed reduced by 10 and suffer Disadvantage on ranged attacks until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Mounted Defender
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature hits her mount with an attack, Tsukibo makes an attack against the attacker.

name: Fujinbo, Daitengu Witch
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +8, Con +7, Int +3, Wis +2, Cha +7

traits.name: Feather Step
traits.description: Fujinbo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. She may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

traits.name: Harbinger of Strife
traits.description: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds 1d4 to the result.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Fujinbo makes three attacks with her Serpent's Tongue Windspear, or makes one attack and uses her Rain of Stones, if available.

actions.name: Serpent's Tongue Windspear
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Rain of Stones (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Fujinbo sweeps her spear, unleashing a gale that carries aloft a torrent of stones and grit in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage and be Blinded until the end of Fujinbo's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Disarming Gust
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature enters her reach, Fujino forces the creature to succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or have one object is carrying flung up to 15 feet away.

reactions.name: Twist Breath
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature Fujinbo can hear speaks a command or casts a spell, Fujinbo forces the creature to succeed on a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw or have its words twist in its mouth, producing one of the following effects. The command is changed to one of Fujinbo's choice. The creature instead casts a different spell of the same level of Fujinbo's choice, with the same targets.

legendaryActions.name: Soaring Leap
legendaryActions.description: Fujinbo jumps up 30 feet. Attacks of opportunity provoked by this movement are made at Disadvantage.

legendaryActions.name: Trap Wind
legendaryActions.description: Fujinbo gathers air, compressing it in the tip of her spear. The next time she hits a creature with a melee attack, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 30 feet away.

legendaryActions.name: Cloud Aegis
legendaryActions.description: Fujinbo gains 11 (2d10) Temporary Hit Points. While she has these, a creature that hits her with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 10 feet away.

name: Sagamibo, Daitengu Witch
savingThrows: Dex +8, Con +9, Int +4, Wis +2, Cha +9

traits.name: Feather Step
traits.description: Sagamibo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. She may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

traits.name: Harbinger of Strife
traits.description: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds 1d4 to the result.

traits.name: Mirror Portals
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, Sagamibo can summon one a Mirror Portal at an unoccupied location she can see within 30 feet. Each mirror can be attacked (AC 16; 20 HP; Vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage) She may spend 5 feet of movement to enter one mirror portal and emerge from another. If she can see any of her mirror portals, she may treat any of them as the origin of her attacks and spells.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Sagamibo makes four attacks with her Poison Needle, each of which she may replace with a use of her Gaze of Black Silence.

actions.name: Poison Needle
actions.description: Ranged or *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Gaze of Black Silence
actions.description: One creature that Sagamibo can see must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw or lose two unexpended hit dice and have its movement speed reduced by 10 until the end of Sagamibo's next turn. A creature reduced to 0 hit dice in this way cannot speak or otherwise produce sound for the next minute, or until it destroys a Mirror Portal.

actions.name: Spirit Knot Stasis (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature with 0 unexpended hit dice that Sagamibo can see must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Paralyzed until the end of her next turn.

reactions.name: Reflect Strife
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature she can see misses a mirror portal with an attack, Sagamibo forces the attacker to make a new attack roll against a different target in range.

reactions.name: Enveloping Abduction
reactions.description: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, Sagamibo forces the attacker to succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or be tangled in the folds of her cloak, disappearing entirely. At the beginning of the creature's turn, if Sagamibo has one or more mirror portals active, it reappears within 5 feet of one of them.

legendaryActions.name: Poison Needle
legendaryActions.description: Sagamibo makes an attack with her Poison Needle.

legendaryActions.name: Mirror Flicker
legendaryActions.description: Sagamibo and one Mirror Portal she can see teleport to trade locations.

legendaryActions.name: Confounding Gust
legendaryActions.description: One creature Sagamibo can see must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or be spun around and disoriented, giving it Disadvantage on the next attack it makes before the beginning of Sagamibo's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Equalize Energies (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: One creature Sagamibo can see must make a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature regains one hit die for each hit die it has expended, then takes 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage per hit die regained in this way.

name: Sankibo, Daitengu Zuijin
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +8, Con +3, Int +1, Wis +8, Cha +2

traits.name: Demon-Mind Mantle
traits.description: Sankibo can't be frightened or surprised by fiends, and has Disadvantage on saving throws against being charmed or possessed.

traits.name: Harbinger of Strife
traits.description: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds 1d4 to the result.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Sankibo makes four Demon Fist attacks, or makes two Demon Fist attacks with Disadvantage and takes the Dodge action.

actions.name: Demon Fist
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) magical Slashing damage. On a miss, the target suffers one effect of Sankibo's choice: Deceptive Twist. The target takes half the attack's damage. Sudden Strength. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom Saving Throw or be knocked prone. Springing Leg. Sankibo can use her reaction to make an additional Demon Fist attack.

bonusActions.name: Sinuous Stride
bonusActions.description: Sankibo's footwork becomes erratic and unsettling. Until the beginning of her next turn, Sankibo can move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks whenever she is missed with an attack.

bonusActions.name: Smash and Tear
bonusActions.description: Sankibo's stance hardens. Until the beginning of her next turn, Sankibo can make a Demon Fist attack with Disadvantage whenever she is missed with a melee attack.

name: Akaribo, Daitengu Zuijin
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +9, Cha +8

traits.name: Authority of the Eight-Fold Seal
traits.description: While Akaribo has any Temporary Hit Points, attacks against her made by fiends and undead have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Harbinger of Strife
traits.description: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds 1d4 to the result.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Akaribo makes two attacks with her Eight-Laws Blade.

actions.name: Eight-Laws Blade
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 13 (3d8) psychic damage. On a miss, or if this attack targets an empty space, Akaribo can gain 10 cumulative Temporary Hit Points that last for a minute, to a maximum of 30.

bonusActions.name: Purifying Departure
bonusActions.description: Akaribo points her fan, sending forth a wave of pure authority in a 30-foot cone. Each fiend and undead in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away, or twice as far if Akaribo has at least 15 Temporary Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Investiture of the Heavy Seal (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description: Akaribo stomps, bringing down a concussive blast of spiritual force around her. Each creature of her choice within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma Saving Throw or take Force damage equal to Akaribo's current Temporary Hit Points and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Unshakeable Clarity
reactions.description: When Akaribo is missed with a melee attack, she can move up to 5 feet and make an attack with her Eight-Laws Blade against an empty space.

name: Jirobo, Daitengu Zuijin
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +4, Con +9, Int +1, Wis +7, Cha +2

traits.name: Regain Equilibrium
traits.description: When Jirobo takes the Dodge action, he regains hit dice up to half of his maximum.

traits.name: Harbinger of Strife
traits.description: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds 1d4 to the result.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Jirobo makes two attacks, one of which may be with his Supreme Slash.

actions.name: Sacred Pillar Fist
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage. Additionally on a hit, Jirobo can expend two hit dice to add one additional effect * Thunder Wakes the Stones. Jirobo moves Onimaru up to 30 feet. If it ends this movement in Jirobo's space, Onimaru regains 20 Hit Points. Spirits Flee at Dawn. Each creature of Jirobo's choice within 10 feet of him takes 4 (1d8) Thunder damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away. Closing Gates' Grip. The target is Grappled (escape DC 17). While grappled in this way, a creature has vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Supreme Slash (While wielding Onimaru)
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage plus Hit: 22 (4d10) force damage. Any hit with this weapon against a fiend becomes a critical.

actions.name: Summit's Weight Descends (Costs 4 Hit Dice)
actions.description: One creature grappled by Jirobo is knocked prone and must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or be restrained in place (escape DC 17) as its Qi is bound to the deepest stones of the earth. A creature restrained in this way takes 21 (6d6) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Thunder damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

name: Onimaru, Relic Blade
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +8, Con +5, Int +4, Wis +4, Cha +5
resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Weapons
immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Cultivated Blade
traits.description: Onimaru acts on its wielder's initiative in combat, instead of rolling its own. If it is reduced to 0 Hit Points while not using its Spirit Manifestation, Onimaru falls unconscious but is not destroyed unless targeted with an effect that can destroy magic items.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: The tsukumogami can't be affected or detected by cantrips unless it wishes to be. It has Advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Onimaru makes two attacks with its Seeking Slash, or three attacks if it has a spectral body manifested with its Demon-Spirit Draught.

actions.name: Seeking Slash
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage. If this attack targets a fiend, it scores a critical on a 17-20.

actions.name: Steel-Flash Ring
actions.description: Each creature within 5 feet of Onimaru must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 11 (2d10) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Sailing Deflection
reactions.description: When a creature within 5 feet of it is targeted with an attack, Onimaru can increase the target's AC by +3 against that attack.

reactions.name: Demon-Spirit Draught
reactions.description: When Onimaru reduces or is used to reduce a fiend to 0 Hit Points, it can drink down the fiend's essence, gaining Temporary Hit Points equal to the fiend's number of unexpended hit dice. If Onimaru gains at least 20 Temporary Hit Points in this way, it can manifest a spectral body to wield it that lasts for a minute.

name: Saeno, Sarugami Zuijin
savingThrows: Str +11, Dex +9, Con +4, Int +1, Wis +7, Cha +2

traits.name: Earth-Defiant
traits.description: Whenever Saeno makes a melee attack, he can leap up to 15 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. He suffers no negative effects from falling 30 feet or fewer.

traits.name: Warden at the Gate of Despair
traits.description: Saeno and creatures of his choice within 10 feet of him have Advantage on saving throws against abilities controlled by fiends.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.description: If Saeno fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Saeno makes three attacks with his Iron-Banded Fathom-Staff, one of which he can replace with a use of his Tumbling-Bell Toss, if available.

actions.name: Iron Banded Fathom-Staff
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. This damage can't be reduced in any way.

actions.name: Tumbling-Bell Toss (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Saeno flings his staff, which bounces wildly between up to two creatures he can see within 30 feet before returning to his hand. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

bonusActions.name: Adjust Grip
bonusActions.description: Saeno adjusts his grip on his Iron Banded Fathom-Staff, choosing one of the following effects, which lasts until he uses this ability again. Palm-Driving Grip. The staff gains a reach of 15 feet, and a creature hit by it is pushed up to 5 feet away. Spinning Shield Grip. Saeno increases his AC by +5 against attacks made by one creature he can see. Iron Moat Grip. Saeno climbs to the peak of his staff and balances there, 10 feet above the ground. A creature within 5 feet of the staff can attempt to topple the staff as an action or bonus action with a successful contested Strength (Athletics) check.

legendaryActions.name: Unpredictable Shift
legendaryActions.description: Saeno moves up to half his speed and uses his Shift Grip.

legendaryActions.name: Earth-Crumbling Strike
legendaryActions.description: Saeno makes an Iron Banded Fathom-Staff attack with Advantage. On a miss, the ground within 5 feet of the target becomes difficult terrain.

legendaryActions.name: Swinging Kick
legendaryActions.description: One creature within 5 feet of Saeno must succeed on a DC 19 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away and knocked prone.

name: Guild Debtor
savingThrows: Dex +1, Con +1, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Bondsman's Brand
traits.description: Whenever the debtor deals damage to a creature it is indebted to, it takes 5 (1d10) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The debtor makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Clinging Clutch.

actions.name: Desperate Strike
actions.description:
Attack: +2 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

On a Critical Hit, the target gains the Prone condition.

actions.name: Clinging Clutch
actions.description:
One creature within 5 feet. Strength Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The creature has the Grappled condition.

While Grappled in this way, the creature has Disadvantage on attacks that do not target the debtor.

reactions.name: Debtor's Absolution
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 5 feet takes damage that would reduce it to 0 Hit Points. Response: The debtor takes that damage in the target's stead.

name: Usurer Overseer
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +4, Con +3, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha +1

traits.name: Broker's Due
traits.description: The usurer has Advantage on the first attack it makes each turn against the last creature to deal damage to it.

traits.name: More Fearsome Than Death (1/Day)
traits.description:
If an ally within 60 feet would fail a Wisdom Saving Throw, the usurer can choose for it to succeed.

If it does, the ally gains the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The usurer makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Extract Service.

actions.name: Scepter of Reprimand
actions.description:
*Melee Attack Roll:* +X, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

A Frightened creature hit with this attack is Charmed by the usurer for 1 minute, or until the usurer takes any hostile action against it.

actions.name: Extract Service
actions.description: One ally or creature in the usurer's debt that the usurer can see within 60 feet can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed and make a melee attack.

reactions.name: Painbond (Level 2 Spell)
reactions.description: Trigger: The usurer or an ally it can see within 60 feet takes damage. Response: The usurer chooses another ally within 60 feet to take the damage instead.

name: Taforalt Mercenary
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +7, Con +3, Int +2, Wis +5

traits.name: Battle-Honed Reflexes
traits.description: When the mercenary rolls Initiative, it can move up to half its Speed, then take the Dodge action or drop prone.

traits.name: Advantageous Position
traits.description: The mercenary's attacks have Advantage if made from behind cover or against a target at lower elevation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mercenary makes three attacks, two of which can be with its Sparkjaw Pistols, or makes one attack and uses its Spinning Slash.

actions.name: Weregild Scimitar
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sparkjaw Pistols
actions.description:
Attack: +7 range 30/90 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

Whenever one of this attack's damage dice rolls its maximum value, it deals an additional Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spinning Slash
actions.description: Each creature within 5 feet. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 7 (2d6) Slashing damage and the creature is pushed 5 feet away. Success: Half damage.

name: Arzumat Stitchbeast
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -5, Wis -2, Cha -5

traits.name: Spellbound Service
traits.description: If the arzumat dies, its spirit lingers. The first time each turn that its owner takes damage in the next minute, roll a d20. On a roll of 15+, the arzumat returns to undeath with 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The arzumat makes two attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Grating Hum or Death Looms.

actions.name: Nail-Blade Stomp
actions.description:
Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus Hit: 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

A Prone target takes an additional Hit: 4 (1d8) slashing damage on a hit.

actions.name: Grating Hum (Concentration)
actions.description: Each other creature in a 30-foot Emanation has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration or to resist the Frightened condition.

actions.name: Death Looms
actions.description: *The impassive gaze of death turns.* One creature the arzumat can see within 60 feet. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target additionally gains the Prone condition.

name: Usurer Muqarid
savingThrows: Dex +9, Con +9, Int +10, Wis +8, Cha +2

traits.name: Broker's Due
traits.description: The usurer has Advantage on the first attack it makes each turn against the last creature to deal damage to it.

traits.name: Vast Reserves (5/Day)
traits.description:
When the usurer would fail a saving throw, it can add +5 to its result.

The usurer's Save DC is reduced by 1 for each expended use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The usurer uses its Extract Service twice, each of which it can replace with a use of its Pound of Flesh, Dispossess, or Compounding Burden, if available.

actions.name: Extract Service
actions.description: One ally or creature in the usurer's debt that the usurer can see within 60 feet can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed and make a melee attack.

actions.name: Pound of Flesh (Level 3 Spell)
actions.description: *Flesh brittles and tears at the usurer's touch.* One creature the usurer touches. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 27 (6d8) Necrotic damage and the creature can't regain Hit Points until the end of the usurer's next turn. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Dispossess (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description:
One creature the usurer can see within 60 feet. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The target becomes unattuned to one magic item of its choice that it is attuned to. Failure by 5 or More: The target becomes unattuned to each magic item it is attuned to.

Each item unattuned in this way teleports into the usurer's space.

actions.name: Compounding Burden (Recharge 5-6, Level 6 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description:
Shreds of pure misery manifest, clinging to a creature the usurer can see within 60 feet.

When the usurer casts this spell, and at the beginning of each of its turns, the target must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The target gains one point of Exhaustion, which lasts until the spell ends.

actions.name: Planar Eviction (1/Day, Level 8 Spell)
actions.description:
Each creature in a 20-foot radius Sphere within 60 feet. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 33 (6d10) Force damage and the target is banished to a harmless demiplane for 1 minute. Success: Half damage.

A banished creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect and reappearing in the nearest unoccupied space to the one it departed on a success.

reactions.name: Boon Forfeiture (Level 3 Spell)
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature deals damage to the usurer. Response: The creature must make a Charisma Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: One spell affecting the creature has its effect transferred to the usurer.

reactions.name: Blood Salvage (Level 1 Spell)
reactions.description: Trigger: An ally the usurer can see within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Response: The usurer regains 11 (2d10) Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Extract Service
legendaryActions.description: The usurer uses its Extract Service.

legendaryActions.name: Lease Life (Level 2 Spell)
legendaryActions.description: The usurer loses 10 Hit Points and one ally it can see that died in the last minute returns to life with 10 Hit Points. After 1 minute, the target dies.

legendaryActions.name: Mana Tithe (Costs 2 Actions, Level 5 Spell)
legendaryActions.description:
*Magical reserves bleed away, their wasted power flaring bright.* One creature the usurer can see within 60 feet. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The target loses one spell level worth of spell slots for each point it failed by.

A creature that can't do so instead gains the Dazed condition until the end of its next turn on a failure.

name: Totapari Outrider
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +1, Wis +2

traits.name: Cliff-Racer
traits.description: The totapari is not slowed by Difficult Terrain. While in Difficult Terrain, Opportunity Attacks made against the totapari have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The totapari makes two attacks with its Blueflint Axes.

actions.name: Blueflint Axes
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Outrider Windbow
actions.description: Attack: +4 range 200/900 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage. This attack has Advantage against a target in Difficult Terrain.

actions.name: Sound Warhorn
actions.description:
The totapari blows its horn, which is audible to a range of 500 feet. Each of the totapari’s allies in a 20-foot Emanation from it gain Advantage on the first attack they make before the start of the totapari’s next turn.

name: Morukai, Totapari Mage
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +1, Wis +5, Cha +2

traits.name: Cliff-Racer
traits.description: The totapari is not slowed by Difficult Terrain. While in Difficult Terrain, Opportunity Attacks made against the totapari have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Tellurite Staff
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away. If the totapari moved at least 20 feet toward the target immediately before making this attack, it deals an extra 7 (2d6) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Stone Rain (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: The totapari casts a fistful of gravel, which grows into boulders before falling in a 10-foot radius Sphere within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage. Failure by 5 or More: The creature also falls Prone. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Shard Sling (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: The totapari shatters a rock, sending a blast of fine shards forth in a 15-foot Cone. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 10 (3d6) Piercing damage. Failure by 5 or More: The creature also is Blinded until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Consult the Stones
bonusActions.description:
The totapari beseeches the earth for omens; roll a d20 and note the result. The next time a creature within 15 feet of the totapari would make a d20 Test before the end of the totapari's next turn, it uses that result instead of rolling.

name: Gurak War-Tapir
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +1, Con +1, Int -3, Wis -1, Cha -3

traits.name: Earth-Scenting
traits.description: The tapir has Advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell. It can sense the type, number, and direction of underground plants and animals within 25 feet of it.

actions.name: Trample
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage. This attack does an extra 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage to a Prone target.

actions.name: Goring Gallop
actions.description: The tapir moves up to its Speed, then can force a creature within 5 feet to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: 5 (2d4) Piercing damage and the target is knocked Prone. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Foaming Defiance
reactions.description: Trigger: The tapir would be reduced to 0 Hit Points by damage that is not Piercing or from a Critical Hit. Response: The tapir is instead reduced to 1 Hit Point.

name: Duargen, Gurakhun Warrior
savingThrows: Str +9, Dex +1, Con +8, Int +1, Wis +1

traits.name: Cloud-Eyed
traits.description: The gurakhun has Disadvantage on attacks made against Small or smaller creatures, and on checks made to detect them.

traits.name: Giant Stature
traits.description: Attacks made against the gurakhun by a creature Attached to it have Advantage, and the gurakhun has Disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures Attached to it.

actions.name: Mountain-Mallet
actions.description: Attack: +9 reach 5 ft. Hit: 28 (5d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If this attack deals 30 or more damage, the target is knocked Prone and can't stand on its following turn.

actions.name: Shockwave Stomp
actions.description: The gurakhun's stomp strikes with a crash of thunder, forcing one Prone creature within 5 feet to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Thunder damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target can't stand on its following turn. Success: Half damage. Then, each creature within 10 feet of the gurakhun other than the target is pushed 5 feet away.

actions.name: Regain Strength (1/Day)
actions.description: The gurakhun ravenously devours its trogon-leg, gaining 40 Temporary Hit Points. While it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the gurakhun ignores the effects of Exhaustion and its attacks deal an extra 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage on a hit.

reactions.name: Burn Reserves
reactions.description:
Trigger: The gurakhun would fail a saving throw. Response: The gurakhun adds +5 to its result; if this causes it to succeed, it gains a point of Exhaustion.
