name: Weifeng, Xueren Acolyte
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +4, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +1

traits.name: Third Eye Insight
traits.description: Weifeng has Advantage on Wisdom checks made to determine a creature's relative strength, depth of reserves, and killing intent.

traits.name: Rival's Resilience
traits.description: When a friendly creature Weifeng can see within 30 feet succeeds on a check or saving throw, Weifeng gains Advantage on the first check or saving throw he makes before the end of his next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Weifeng makes two attacks with his Rolling Boulder Fist, one of which he can replace with a use of his Enduring Earthwork Guard.

actions.name: Rolling Boulder Fist
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Additionally on a hit, Weifeng can expend two hit dice to add one additional effect to the attack. Falling Peak Elbow. The target takes an additional 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage. On a roll of 6 on the damage die, the target is knocked prone. Hurled Backfist Drive. Weifeng steps 5 feet into the target's space, pushing it up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Enduring Earthwork Guard
actions.description: Weifeng hunkers down, gaining 10 Temporary Hit Points that last until the start of his next turn. While he has any of these Temporary Hit Points, Weifeng has Advantage on Strength Saving Throws.

actions.name: Unrelenting Assault (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Weifeng makes three attacks with his Rolling Boulder Fist. Until the start of his next turn, attacks against Weifeng have Advantage.

name: Chongyang, Xueren Adept
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +3, Con +4, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha -1

traits.name: Third Eye Insight
traits.description: Chongyang has Advantage on Wisdom checks made to determine a creature's relative strength, depth of reserves, and killing intent.

traits.name: Seething Reserves
traits.description: When Chongyang fails a saving throw, he can expend up to two hit dice, adding +1d4 to his result for each hit die expended in this way.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Chongyang makes two attacks, one of which can be with his Black Tortoise Mace.

actions.name: Black Tortoise Mace
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away. Against a target grappled by Chongyang, this attack has Advantage and pushes the target twice as far on a hit.

actions.name: Abundant Fist
actions.description: Attack: +10 reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. Additionally on a hit, Chongyang can expend two hit dice to add one additional effect to the attack. Rage-Wreathed Blow. The target takes an additional 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Unyielding Grasp. The target is Grappled (escape DC 18). A Medium or smaller creature grappled in this way is restrained.

reactions.name: Brutal Rebuff
reactions.description: When a creature grappled by Chongyang hits him with an attack, Chongyang can make an Abundant Fist attack against it.

reactions.name: Qi Flare
reactions.description: When Chongyang scores a critical hit with a melee attack, he can deal an additional 5 radiant damage, or 10 radiant damage if he has at least 10 unexpended hit dice.

name: Libang Zhao, Xueren Immortal
savingThrows: Str +13, Dex +13, Con +12, Int +5, Wis +13, Cha +6
immunities: Cold, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Charmed, Frightened, Stunned

traits.name: Third Eye Insight
traits.description: Libang Zhao has Advantage on Wisdom checks made to determine a creature's relative strength, depth of reserves, and killing intent.

traits.name: Regain Equilibrium
traits.description: When Libang Zhao takes the Dodge action, she regains hit dice up to half of her maximum.

traits.name: Icon of Bestowal (1/Day)
traits.description: When Libang Zhao dies, she can bequeath her powers to a friendly xueren within 60 feet. The target gains 262 Temporary Hit Points; while it has any of these Temporary Hit Points, the target uses Libang Zhao's stat block, though can still use any actions listed on its own.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Libang Zhao fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Libang Zhao makes three attacks with her Heavenly Gate Fist, one of which she can replace with a use of her Qi Manifestation: Tranquil Koi.

actions.name: Heavenly Gate Fist
actions.description: Attack: +13 reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus one of the following effects: Spirit-Cleansing Palm. Libang Zhao ends one condition or magical effect on the target or herself. Perfected Strike. Any hit with the attack becomes a critical. Great Throne's Embrace. The target is grappled (escape DC 21). If the target ends its turn grappled by her it takes 18 (4d8) radiant damage and is pushed up to 20 feet away.

actions.name: Qi Manifestation: Tranquil Koi (Concentration)
actions.description: Koi-like ribbons of pure life energy begin to drift lazily around Libang Zhao. Until the end of her next turn, each source of damage dealt to her is reduced by 10, and her melee attacks have a range of 60 feet.

actions.name: All-Heavens' Strike (Recharge 5-6, Costs 4 Hit Dice)
actions.description: Libang Zhao touches a creature and calls spears of light to swarm down upon it, forcing it to make three DC 21 Dexterity Saving Throws. The target takes 33 (6d10) radiant damage for each saving throw it failed. If the target fails all three saving throws, it is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Endless Dawn Iris (1/Day, Costs 5 Hit Dice)
actions.description: Libang Zhao releases a controlled stream of energized air in a 100-foot beam that is 1 inch wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 22 Strength Saving Throw or take 45 (10d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 45 (10d8) radiant damage and be pushed up to 50 feet away, or take half as much damage and be pushed half as far on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Heavenly Gate Fist
legendaryActions.description: Libang Zhao makes an attack with her Heavenly Gate Fist.

legendaryActions.name: Serene Gaze
legendaryActions.description: Libang Zhao calmly assesses a creature she can see, giving it Disadvantage on attacks that target her until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Wind-Omen Drift
legendaryActions.description: Libang Zhao moves up to half her speed and gains Advantage on the first saving throw she makes before the beginning of her next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Sink Deep the Wells (Costs 2 Actions, Costs 3 Hit Dice)
legendaryActions.description: Libang Zhao moves up to her speed and uses her Multiattack.

name: Xuehou
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +1, Con +2, Int -3, Wis -2, Cha -2

traits.name: Cliff-Tumbler
traits.description: If the xuehou would be reduced to 0 Hit Points by damage from falling, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Squabblesome Mass
traits.description: A creature that stands from prone must spend 5 additional feet of movement to do so for each xuehou within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Grubby Gnaw
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage. If the target is prone, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength Saving Throw or drop an object of the xuehou's choice it is carrying.

actions.name: Shrieking Tackle
actions.description: The xuehou throws itself at a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 8 Strength Saving Throw or take 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. A Surprised target has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

reactions.name: Pile In
reactions.description: When a creature within 5 feet makes a Strength Saving Throw, the xuehou can fall prone. If it does, the DC of the target's saving throw increases cumulatively by 1.

name: Qingling Shenzhong
savingThrows: Str +6, Dex +3, Con +5, Int -1, Wis +4, Cha +6
immunities: Cold, Poison, Thunder, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Stunned, Unconscious

traits.name: Salt-Sickened
traits.description: If the qingling shenzhong is doused in salt or salt water, for the next minute it takes an additional 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage whenever it is hit with an attack or fails a saving throw.

traits.name: Treasure-Cast Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the qingling shenzhong would fail a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, a fissure opens up in its body. The save DC of the qingling shenzhong's Puretone Toll is reduced by 1 for each expended use of this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The qingling shenzhong makes one attack with its Mallet Ram and uses its Clapper Lash.

actions.name: Mallet Ram
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 15 ft. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If this attack was made with Advantage, the target is additionally pushed up to 15 feet away on a hit.

actions.name: Clapper Lash
actions.description: One randomly selected creature within 15 feet of the qingling shenzhong must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is knocked prone and Stunned until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Drifting Lash
legendaryActions.description: The qingling shenzhong moves up to half its speed and can use its Clapper Lash.

legendaryActions.name: Puretone Toll (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The qingling shenzhong resonates with tones of indescribable clarity in a 500-foot radius, producing one of the following effects: Toll of Invitation. Fey or elemental creatures of total CR 2 or lower are summoned to unoccupied spaces in the area. They are friendly to the qingling shenzhong and remain for 1 minute before disappearing. Toll of Solitude. Each creature in the area is pushed up to 50 feet away, or twice as far if it has fewer than 50 Hit Points. Toll of Contemplation. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom Saving Throw or gain 10 Temporary Hit Points. While a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it can't take hostile actions against other creatures. Toll of Desolation. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Thunder damage, or half as much on a success.

name: Feilan
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +7, Con +3, Wis +6, Cha +3

traits.name: Third Eye Insight
traits.description: The feilan has Advantage on Wisdom checks made to determine a creature's relative strength, depth of reserves, and killing intent.

traits.name: Bolting Reflex
traits.description: When initiative is rolled, the feilan may move up to half its speed away from the nearest enemy without provoking attacks of opportunity.

traits.name: Feather Step
traits.description: The feilan's high jump is up to 15 ft., or up to 30 ft. with a running start. It may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

traits.name: Beast Core
traits.description: The feilan's body contains a core of its concentrated magical essence. This core may be extracted intact from its corpse with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Survival) check and may be used to empower the crafting of magical items, or consumed to permanently increase the number of hit dice a creature has by one.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.description: If the feilan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The feilan makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its horn-crowned head whip.

actions.name: Horn-Crowned Head Whip
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or be knocked Prone and Stunned until the end of the feilan's next turn.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A Prone target takes an additional Hit: 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Falling Slam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The feilan leaps up to 30 ft. in the air, then falls to the ground. Each creature in the space where he lands must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity Saving Throw or be knocked prone and take 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage for each 10 ft. that the feilan fell, or take half as much and be pushed into the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reactions.name: Elusive Sidle
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the feilan, it may move up to half its speed in any direction other than directly away from the creature without provoking attacks of opportunity.

reactions.name: Quick Kick
reactions.description: As a reaction to a creature making an attack against the feilan that benefits from flanking it, the feilan makes an attack with its hooves.

legendaryActions.name: Zephyrburst
legendaryActions.description: Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 30 feet away. A creature that fails by 5 or more is knocked prone, additionally.

legendaryActions.name: Dancing Gale
legendaryActions.description: One creature the feilan can see within 60 feet must make three DC 15 Strength Saving Throws. For each saving throw the creature fails, its is pushed 10 feet in a direction of the feilan's choice and takes 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage.

legendaryActions.name: Breathless Windspout
legendaryActions.description: One creature the feilan can see within 60 feet must make a DC 15 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the creature is carried 30 feet into the air and suspended there until the end of the feilan's next turn. While suspended in this way, a creature is restrained and can't speak or breathe.

name: YuWen Zhu, Xueren Acolyte
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Wis +2, Cha -1

traits.name: Third Eye Insight
traits.description: YuWen Zhu has Advantage on Wisdom checks made to determine a creature's relative strength, depth of reserves, and killing intent.

traits.name: Hard-Headed
traits.description: YuWen Zhu has Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed.

traits.name: Charging Step
traits.description: Whenever a creature is pushed away from her, YuWen may move up to 5 feet towards it without spending any movement.

actions.name: Stampeding Fist
actions.description:
Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) cold damage, and Zhang may expend two hit dice to add one additional effect to the attack.
*

actions.name: Battering Gates
actions.description: The attack deals an additional 3 (1d6) damage, and the next attack made this turn against the target is made at Advantage. Mountain's Ascent. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be launched 10 ft. into the air and knocked prone.

reactions.name: Four Point Grounding
reactions.description: As a reaction when a creature within 5 ft. would push YuWen Zhu, she instead pushes the creature the same distance in the opposite direction.

name: Zhang Linli, Xueren Acolyte
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +2, Wis +1, Cha -1

traits.name: Third Eye Insight
traits.description: Zhang has Advantage on Wisdom checks made to determine a creature's relative strength, depth of reserves, and killing intent.

traits.name: Inexorable Current
traits.description: Whenever Zhang is missed with a melee attack, he may move the attacker 5 feet in any direction.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Zhang makes two attacks with his flowing fist.

actions.name: Flowing Fist
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) cold damage, and Zhang may expend two hit dice to add one additional effect to the attack. Breaking the Water's Surface. The target's AC is reduced by 1 until the start of its next turn. Freezing Tide. The target is pushed 5 feet away, and its movement speed is reduced by 5 until the end of its next turn. Crushing Stone The target takes an additional 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage if it is positioned between Zhang and a solid object, such as a wall.

reactions.name: Iron Resistance
reactions.description: As a reaction when he is hit with a melee attack, Zhang reduces the attack's damage by 5.

name: YuWen Hui, Xueren Master
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +5, Int +2, Wis +4, Cha +3

traits.name: Third Eye Insight
traits.description: YuWen Hui has Advantage on Wisdom checks made to determine a creature's relative strength, depth of reserves, and killing intent.

traits.name: Regain Equilibrium
traits.description: When YuWen Hui takes the Dodge action, she regains hit dice up to half of her maximum.

traits.name: Charging Step
traits.description: Whenever a creature is pushed away from her, YuWen may move up to 5 feet towards it without spending any movement.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If YuWen Hui fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: YuWen Hui makes two attacks with her stampeding fist.

actions.name: Stampeding Fist
actions.description:
Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) cold damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away. Additionally on a hit, YuWen Hui may expend two hit dice to add one additional effect to the attack.
*

actions.name: Battering Gates
actions.description:
The attack deals an additional 7 (2d6) damage, and the next attack made this turn against the target is made at Advantage.
*

actions.name: Mountain's Ascent
actions.description:
The target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be launched 15 ft. into the air and knocked prone.
*

actions.name: Greeting Earth
actions.description: If the target is prone, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw or be Stunned until the end of YuWen Hui's next turn.

actions.name: Stampede of Six Heavens (Costs 4 Hit Dice)
actions.description: YuWen Hui makes three attacks with her stampeding fist. Whenever one of these three attacks hit, she may make an additional attack as part of this action.

reactions.name: Circling Calves
reactions.description: As a reaction when another creature within 5 ft. of YuWen Hui is targeted with a melee attack, she forces the attacker to make a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw. On a failed save, the attack misses and the attacker is pushed 15 ft. away.

legendaryActions.name: Four Point Stance
legendaryActions.description: Until the beginning of her next turn, whenever an effect would push YuWen Hui, that effect's source is instead pushed the same distance in the opposite direction.

legendaryActions.name: Driving Dash
legendaryActions.description: YuWen Hui moves up to half of her speed in straight line, and may move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. Each creature in her path must succeed on a DC 16 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Stampeding Fist (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: YuWen Hui makes an attack with her stampeding fist.

name: Feng Shifu, Xueren Master
savingThrows: Str +3, Dex +4, Con +5, Int +2, Wis +4, Cha +2

traits.name: Third Eye Insight
traits.description: Feng has Advantage on Wisdom checks made to determine a creature's relative strength, depth of reserves, and killing intent.

traits.name: Regain Equilibrium
traits.description: When Feng takes the Dodge action, he regains hit dice up to half of his maximum.

traits.name: Inexorable Current
traits.description: Whenever Feng is missed with a melee attack, he may move the attacker 5 feet in any direction.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Feng fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Feng makes three attacks with his flowing fist.

actions.name: Flowing Fist
actions.description: Attack: +6 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 3 (1d6) cold damage, and Feng may expend two hit dice to add one additional effect to the attack. Breaking the Water's Surface. The target's AC is reduced by 2 until the start of its next turn. Freezing Tide. The target is pushed 10 feet away, and its movement speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn. Reflecting Splash. Feng mirrors his strike with a kick. One creature within 5 ft. other than his target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take the attack's damage. Crushing Stone The target takes an additional 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage, or 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage if it is positioned between Feng and a solid object, such as a wall.

actions.name: Avalanche Strike (Costs 6 Hit Dice)
actions.description: Feng strikes with a crushing blow that draws all heat from air around the target, encasing it in a shell of ice. One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or gain 36 (8d8) Temporary Hit Points. As long as a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it is restrained, Blinded, and has vulnerability to Fire damage. A creature that starts its turn with any of these Temporary Hit Points must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or be forced to expend two hit dice. If it cannot, it drops to 0 HP.

reactions.name: Pressure Circuit
reactions.description: As a reaction when he is hit with a melee attack, Feng halves the attack's damage and gains two hit dice that last until the end of his next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Flowing Fist
legendaryActions.description: Feng makes an attack with his flowing fist.

legendaryActions.name: Centering Breath
legendaryActions.description: Feng regains his reaction.

legendaryActions.name: River's Embrace
legendaryActions.description: Feng moves up to half his speed towards a creature he can see. If he ends this movement within 5 ft. of the creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or be grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained until the end of Feng's next turn.

name: Fox Blade, YuanYang Knight
savingThrows: Str +5, Dex +4, Con +3, Wis +2

traits.name: Wyrmrider Harness
traits.description: While mounted, Fox Blade can't be forced to move or knocked Prone, and must use an Action and her full movement to dismount.

traits.name: Reserved Capacity
traits.description: While the yuanyang is Incapacitated but not Bloodied, it can move up to half its Speed and make a single weapon attack on its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Fox Blade makes two attacks with her Wyrmrider Greatspear, each of which she can replace with a use of her Window of Opportunity.

actions.name: Wyrmrider Greatspear
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. A Large or larger target hit with this attack takes an additional 4 (1d8) damage.

actions.name: Window of Opportunity
actions.description: Fox Blade gestures to a creature she can see within 60 feet with no creatures hostile to it within 5 feet of it; she and each of her allies within 30 feet of her gains Advantage on the first attack it makes against that target before the start of her next turn.

actions.name: Soothe Wyrm
actions.description: Fox Blade touches a Dragon within 5 feet, granting it 15 Temporary Hit Points, which last until the end of her next turn. While the target has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it is Immune to the Frightened condition.

reactions.name: Repelling Thrust
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature enters Fox Blade's reach. Response: Fox Blade makes a melee attack against it. On a hit, the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

name: Emerald Ink, ShuoYu Zhu Warrior Bard
savingThrows: Str +4, Dex +8, Con +1, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +4

traits.name: Preening Pride
traits.description: While the shuoyu zhu has all of its Hit Points, once per turn it can 1d4 to the result of an attack or damage roll it makes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Emerald Ink makes three attacks, or makes one attack and uses his Exuberant Sweep.

actions.name: Honed Glaive
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Flutter-Kick
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away. Before making this attack, Emerald Ink can leap up to 10 feet directly toward the target.

actions.name: Exuberant Sweep
actions.description: Emerald Ink moves up to half his Speed; each creature he moves within 10 feet of in this way must make a Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 11 (2d10) Slashing damage. Success: Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Iridescent Flash (Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.description: Emerald Ink spreads his plumage in a startling display, forcing each creature within 5 feet of him to make a Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The creature loses its Reaction and the next attack made against it before the end of Emerald Ink's next turn has Advantage.

bonusActions.name: Rallying Cry (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: Emerald Ink crows forth a defiant challenge; he and each ally within 30 feet that can hear him gain Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws until the start of Emerald Ink's next turn.

name: Yosuzume Mercenary
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Con +1, Wis +1

traits.name: Blinding Flock
traits.description: A creature within 5 feet of three or more hostile yosuzume has Disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom (Perception) checks.

actions.name: Threshblade Partisan
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage. If this attack had Advantage, it scores a Critical Hit on a 19-20.

actions.name: Overwhelm
actions.description: The yosuzume move up to its Speed, then can force one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of it to make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The creature falls Prone. A target within 5 feet of two or more of the yosuzume's allies has Disadvantage on this saving throw.

reactions.name: Scatter
reactions.description: Trigger: The yosuzume and at least one of its allies make a saving throw against the same effect. Response: The yosuzume moves up to 10 feet and adds +1 to the result of its saving throw for each creature that took this Reaction.

name: Crimson-Crested Wyrm
savingThrows: Str +8, Dex +10, Con +6, Int -2, Wis +11, Cha +3

traits.name: Jewel-Flash Hide
traits.description: A creature that scores a Critical Hit with a Melee Attack Roll against the wyrm is Blinded until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Thrashing Purge
traits.description: At the end of each of the wyrm's turns, it can end one condition affecting it. If it does, it immediately moves half its Speed in a random direction and falls Prone.

actions.name: Starfall Peck
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 10 ft. Hit: 34 (4d12 + 8) piercing damage. If the wyrm moved at least 40 feet toward the target immediately before making this attack, it deals an 18 (4d8) Radiant damage on a hit.

actions.name: Sinuous Whip
actions.description: Attack: +14 reach 15 ft. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) Type Bludgeoning damage plus one of the following effects: The target is pushed up to 15 feet away. The target is Grappled (escape DC 22).

actions.name: Gale Scratch
actions.description: The wyrm slashes its claws, sending blades of wind tearing forth in a 30-foot long, 10-foot wide Line. Each creature in the area must make a Strength Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: 18 (4d8) Slashing damage and the creature is launched 30 feet into the air, then falls Prone. Success: Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Crested Crash
bonusActions.description: The wyrm flies up to half its Speed, then can force one creature within 5 feet of it to make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked Prone. Failure by 10 or More: The target is additionally Stunned until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Celestial Scream (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.description: The wyrm screams a torrent of sparkling motes of starlight into the air that rain down in a 20-foot Emanation around it. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 21 (6d6) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

name: YuanYang Artillerist
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +1, Con +1, Int +1, Wis -1, Cha +1

traits.name: Reserved Capacity
traits.description: While the yuanyang has more than half of its Hit Points, it can move up to half its speed and make a single weapon attack on its turn while incapacitated or unconscious.

traits.name: Sparkguarded
traits.description: The yuanyang has Advantage on saving throws against effects that deal Fire damage.

actions.name: Iron-Banded Spongestaff
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 10 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage. If the target is on fire, it is extinguished as though a gallon of water were splashed on it.

actions.name: Cage-Lantern Strike
actions.description: Attack: +3 reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 2 (1d4) fire damage. On a critical hit, the lantern shatters and the target catches fire; until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Powder Packet
actions.description: The yuanyang throws a paper packet of black powder at a burning creature or object it can see within 30 feet. The target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 7 (2d6) Fire damage and be knocked prone, or take half as much damage on a success.

name: Evergreen, YuanYang Knight
savingThrows: Str +7, Dex +3, Con +3, Int +1, Wis +5, Cha +1

traits.name: Reserved Capacity
traits.description: While the yuanyang has more than half of its Hit Points, it can move up to half its speed and make a single weapon attack on its turn while incapacitated or unconscious.

traits.name: Standard-Bearer
traits.description: While Evergreen is not frightened or incapacitated, each other friendly creature within 30 feet that can see him has Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Evergreen makes three melee attacks, one of which can be with his Swallowtail Lance.

actions.name: Swallowtail Lance
actions.description: Attack: +7 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. On a critical hit against a Medium or smaller mounted target, the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Silent Grove Blade
actions.description:
Attack: +7 reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus one additional effect of Evergreen's choice:
*

actions.name: Boring Roots
actions.description:
The next attack Evergreen makes against the same target this turn has Advantage.
*

actions.name: Weaving Breeze
actions.description:
The target can't make Opportunity Attacks this turn.
*

actions.name: Falling Branch
actions.description: The target takes an additional 3 (1d6) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Keep in Measure
reactions.description: At the end of a turn when Evergreen is mounted and a creature he can see moved out of his reach, Evergreen's mount can move up to half its speed toward that creature.

reactions.name: Unflinching Drive
reactions.description: When a creature makes a melee attack against Evergreen, he can reduce his AC by 1 against that attack. If the attack misses, Evergreen can make a Silent Grove Sword attack with Advantage.

name: Hurricane Bird
savingThrows: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -2

traits.name: Deceptive Neck
traits.description: When a creature the bird can see scores a critical against it, roll a d20. On an 11-20, the critical becomes a miss.

traits.name: Mudstrider
traits.description: The bird ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of mud or shallow water.

actions.name: Perforating Beak
actions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Chest Slam
actions.description: The bird slams into a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a DC 13 Strength Saving Throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Death Blow (Recharges when the bird uses its Extend Neck)
actions.description: The bird strikes a prone creature with blinding speed, making a Perforating Beak attack against it. If the attack hits, it scores a critical.

bonusActions.name: Extend Neck
bonusActions.description: The bird extends its neck, raising up to its full height and making a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect any hidden creatures nearby.

bonusActions.name: Taloned Pin
bonusActions.description: Attack: +5 reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13) until the bird moves.

name: Bright Expanse, YuanYang Mage
savingThrows: Dex +2, Con +7, Int +7, Wis +8, Cha +1

traits.name: Reserved Capacity
traits.description: While the yuanyang has more than half of its Hit Points, it can move up to half its speed and make a single weapon attack on its turn while incapacitated or unconscious.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Bright Expanse makes two attacks with his Four Harmonies Staff, one of which he can replace with a use of his Shell's Embrace or Divine Candle.

actions.name: Four Harmonies Staff
actions.description: Attack: +8 reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage.

actions.name: Shell's Embrace (Level 2 Spell)
actions.description: Bright expanse conjures a scintillating shell of magic around a creature he can see within 30 feet, causing it to gain 20 Temporary Hit Points. While a creature has any of these Temporary Hit Points, it is Blinded and Restrained, stabilizes automatically if reduced to 0 Hit Points, and can use its Bonus Action to lose all its remaining Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Divine Candle (Level 4 Spell)
actions.description: Bright Expanse's staff flares briefly with a radiance that shines through solid objects in a 20-foot radius, revealing each condition and magical effect affecting a creature in the area. Each Invisible creature in the area becomes visible, and cannot become Invisible again until the end of Bright Expanse's next turn. Each magically disguised or shapechanged creature in the area has its creature type revealed.

actions.name: Trustbond (Level 4 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: Bright Expanse forges a magical bond with a creature he can see within 60 feet with an Intelligence score of 7 or lower. For the next hour, the creature is friendly toward Bright Expanse, it can't be Charmed or Frightened, and whenever it would take any damage, it takes no damage and he takes that damage instead.

actions.name: Thermostasis (1/Day, Level 5 Spell, Concentration)
actions.description: A gentle, temperate breeze whirls around Bright Expanse in a 15-foot radius for the next minute, clearing any toxic gasses from the air, melting any ice, and extinguishing any flames in the area. Each creature in the area has resistance to cold and Fire damage, and Advantage on saving throws against airborne poisons.

actions.name: Restore Equilibrium (1/Day, Level 7 Spell)
actions.description: Bright Expanse touches a creature, ending each spell of 3rd level or below and each condition affecting it, and setting the creature's current Hit Points to half its hit point maximum. An unwilling creature can make a DC 16 Charisma Saving Throw, avoiding the effect on a success.

reactions.name: Cloudcatch (Level 3 Spell, Concentration)
reactions.description: When a creature or object Bright Expanse can see within 120 feet begins to fall or makes a Strength Saving Throw, he can conjure a cushion of air to support it, producing the following effects: The target gains a 10-foot fly speed and does not fall if unsupported. The target takes half as much damage on a failed Strength Saving Throw, and no damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Concordant Harmony
reactions.description: When Bright Expanse hits a creature with his Four Harmonies Staff, he can cause it to ring with the target's natural harmonics. Until the end of his next turn, the target has vulnerability to Force damage dealt by his Four Harmonies Staff.

name: Haotu (Brave Rabbit)
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +4, Int -2, Wis +3, Cha +1

traits.name: Perfect Vigilance
traits.description: Creatures with a heartbeat can't be Hidden from the hautu while within 500 feet of it, and the haotu can't be Surprised by such creatures.

traits.name: Reserved Expression
traits.description: Wisdom checks made to evaluate the haotu's emotional state have Disadvantage, and it can't be communicated with telepathically.

actions.name: Springleg Vault
actions.description: The haotu jumps up to 20 feet, then can force one creature within 5 feet of where it landed to succeed on a DC 14 Strength Saving Throw or take 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Impassive Stare
actions.description: The haotu stares unblinkingly at a creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw or be Frightened and unable to concentrate until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Sacrificial Leap
reactions.description: When a creature within 5 feet of the haotu is hit with an attack, the haotu can cause the attack to hit it instead.

name: Peng
savingThrows: Str +11, Dex +8, Con +4, Int -2, Wis +9, Cha +3

traits.name: Sovereign of the Wind
traits.description: While the peng is flying, each other other flying creature within 30 feet of it treats any movement toward it as being over difficult terrain

traits.name: Sage of the Mirror-Lake
traits.description: While the peng is submerged in water, it has telepathy to a range of 30 feet and resistance to damage from spells cast by creatures in that area.

traits.name: Endless Gaze (3/Day)
traits.description: If the peng fails a saving throw against an effect that does not deal damage, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Monkspoon Beak (Bird Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 19). This attack has Advantage against a submerged creature without a swim speed or an airborne creature without a fly speed.

actions.name: Suction Gulp (Fish Form Only)
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target was grappled by the peng and size Medium or smaller, the peng can swallow it. (escape DC 19). While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, and takes 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of the peng's turns.

actions.name: Bufetting Thrash
actions.description: Attack: +11 reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. Before or after making this attack, the peng can move up to half of one of its speeds.

actions.name: Six-Month Gale (1/Day, Bird Form Only, Concentration)
actions.description: Black clouds boil from the sky as the peng conjures a mighty storm in a 300-foot radius centered on itself. When a creature starts its turn in the area, the peng can force it to succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or take 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet in a direction of the peng's choice.

actions.name: Celestial Jet (Recharge 5-6, Fish Form Only)
actions.description: The peng gulps down a mouthful of water, then spits it forth in a 120-foot jet that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area is cured of any poison or diseases, then must succeed on a DC 17 Strength Saving Throw or take 35 (10d8) Bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 30 feet away. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away.

bonusActions.name: Pile the Wind (Bird Form Only)
bonusActions.description: The peng beats its wings, creating a dense cushion of air beneath it. For the next minute, the peng gains 40-foot fly speed, and creatures within 300 feet of it do not fall if unsupported.

bonusActions.name: Heavenward Leap (Fish Form Only)
bonusActions.description: The peng moves up to its speed. Until the end of its turn, it can swim through air as though it were water.

legendaryActions.name: Buffeting Thrash
legendaryActions.description: The peng uses its buffeting thrash.

legendaryActions.name: K'un Reversion
legendaryActions.description: The peng transforms into a Huge fish with a 60-foot swim speed, or back into its Huge bird form, then can roll to recharge its Celestial Jet.

name: Hiina, Yosuzume Mercenary
savingThrows: Str -2, Dex +2, Con +1, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +2

traits.name: Blinding Flock
traits.description: A creature within 5 feet of three or more hostile yosuzume has Disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom (Perception) checks.

traits.name: Yugiri Justice Squadron
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the yosuzume gains 5 Temporary Hit Points for each other friendly creature within 30 feet that is concentrating on a Heroic Pose.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Hiina makes three attacks with her Fluttering Thrust, one of which she can replace with a use of her Special Technique: Night Blind! or her Heroic Pose.

actions.name: Fluttering Thrust
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Before or after making this attack, Hiina can move up to 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. *Special Technique: Night Blind!* Hiina attempts to shroud a creature's head in its own garments. One creature within 5 feet that is wearing clothing or a helmet must succeed on a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw or be Blinded until it takes an action to disentangle itself.

actions.name: Heroic Pose (Concentration)
actions.description: Hiina displays her heroic agility with an extended pose. Until she moves or is knocked prone, Hiina gains Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws and can't be Frightened.

reactions.name: Playful Bet
reactions.description: When Hiina or a friendly creature she can see within 30 feet misses with a melee attack, Hiina can call out a friendly challenge. Until the attack's target takes any damage, the first attack made against it each turn by Hiina or one of her allies has Advantage.

name: Ishi, Yosuzume Mercenary
savingThrows: Str +1, Dex +2, Con +2, Wis +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Blinding Flock
traits.description: A creature within 5 feet of three or more hostile yosuzume has Disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom (Perception) checks.

traits.name: Yugiri Justice Squadron
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the yosuzume gains 5 Temporary Hit Points for each other friendly creature within 30 feet that is concentrating on a Heroic Pose.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ishi makes three attacks with her Downy Strike, one of which she can replace with a use of her Special Technique: Puff Up! or her Heroic Pose.

actions.name: Downy Strike
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Ishi can push the creature up to 5 feet or steal a Tiny item from the creature that it is not wearing or wielding. *Special Technique: Puff Up!* Ishi ruffles her feathers menacingly; until the end of her next turn, she counts as size Medium, has resistance to Bludgeoning damage, and her melee attacks deal an additional 1d4 Bludgeoning damage on a hit.

actions.name: Heroic Pose (Concentration)
actions.description: Ishi displays her heroic stability with an extended pose. Until she moves or is knocked prone, Ishi gains Advantage on Strength Saving Throws and can't be Frightened.

name: Tome, Yosuzume Mercenary
savingThrows: Str -1, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +1, Cha +2

traits.name: Blinding Flock
traits.description: A creature within 5 feet of three or more hostile yosuzume has Disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom (Perception) checks.

traits.name: Yugiri Justice Squadron
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the yosuzume gains 5 Temporary Hit Points for each other friendly creature within 30 feet that is concentrating on a Heroic Pose.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ishi makes three attacks with her Chirp-Chitter Slash, one of which she can replace with a use of her Special Technique: Sleeve Perch! or her Heroic Pose.

actions.name: Chirp-Chitter Slash
actions.description: Attack: +4 reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. A creature hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to concentrate until the end of its next turn. *Special Technique: Sleeve Perch!* Tome grasps a loose bit of clothing worn by a creature within 5 feet. Until she releases it as a Bonus Action, the creature's speed is halved and she is dragged with it when it moves. As an action, the creature can attempt a DC 12 Strength Saving Throw, shaking Tome off on a success.

actions.name: Heroic Pose (Concentration)
actions.description: Tome displays her heroic endurance with an extended pose. Until she moves or is knocked prone, Tome reduces any damage she takes by 2 and can't be Frightened.

reactions.name: War-Hat Tumble
reactions.description: When Tome is targeted with a melee attack by a creature she can see, she lurches her war-hat forward to block it, increasing her AC against the triggering attack by 2. If the attack hits, Tome is knocked prone.
